kriol: wal langa det seimtaim aibin dalim ola boswan, "yumob boswan men en ola wekinmen du, yumob garra ol jidan insaid langa jerusalem ebrinait en nomo gowei blanga silip, wulijim sambala gin lukinat blanga detlot enami olabat naitaim en dumbat ola wek deitaim."
english: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, "Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day."

kriol: wal yawei bin tok, "ola ijip pipul en ola emarait pipul en ola emanait pipul en ola filastain pipul
english: Yahweh said to the children of Israel, "Didn't I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

kriol: en wen im kaman deya, yunbala garra tok langa im. yunbala garra tok, 'yawei det god blanga ola isreil pipul bin jandim minbala blanga dalim yu blanga larramgo im pipul olabat. yu garra larramgo olabat wulijim dei garra go en weship im langa det deset kantri. bat yu nomo bin lisin langa minbala.
english: You shall tell him, 'Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, "Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven't listened."

kriol: wal deibid bin askim det gel na, "jowab na bin dalim yu blanga kaman en tok langa mi, indit?" wal det gel bin tok, "wal trubala ai dalim yu, en ai garra gibit yu det trubalawan ensa, dumaji yawei na witnis weya mi tok langa yu. yuwai. jowab det boswan wekinmen blanga yu bin jandim mi iya, en im na bin dalim mi hau blanga tok.
english: The king said, "Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?" The woman answered, "As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.

kriol: wal ai garra go langa det kantri gulum mesadoniya basdam, en afta wen ai go thru langa det kantri, ai garra kaman deya langa yumob.
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

kriol: en deibin gedim det dubala taun gulum kiriyabeil o kiriyajerim en reiba garram ola lilwan taun du weya jidan raidaran langa det dubala taun.
english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

kriol: en aibin irrim god tok langa detlot najalot siksbala men. imbin tok, "yumob bulurrum im thru langa dijan taun en kilim ded detlot nogudbala pipul hu nomo garram det mak langa olabat hed. yumob nomo larram enibodi jidan laibala, en nomo fil sori en kain blanga olabat.
english: To the others he said in my hearing, "Go through the city after him, and strike. Don't let your eye spare, neither have pity.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin irrim judas tok lagijat, imbin dalim im, "yu libum det gel, dumaji im garra abum det gudsmelwan medisin blanga det taim weya dei garra berrim mi.
english: But Jesus said, "Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

kriol: dislot serramonimen gulum hebaiya, heikas en basilai nomo bin abum enijing blanga shoum hubin olabat grenfatha. det grenfatha blanga det serramonimen gulum basilai bin merrit langa wan gel brom det femili lain blanga basilai langa giliyad en imbin gajim det neim blanga im lambarra. wal dumaji dei nomo bin abum enijing blanga shoum hubin olabat grenfatha dei nomo bin lau jidan serramonimen.
english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

kriol: en nogudwan sowa, en boil o swelapwan ting langa bodi, en moldiwan ting langa klos o langa haus.
english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

kriol: wal wen det neks yiya bin kaman, kedalawoma en im thribala meit bin go garram ola solja blanga olabat, en deibin bidim ola reifait pipul langa det pleis gulum eshtarokanaim, en deibin bidim ola susait pipul langa det pleis gulum hem, en deibin bidim ola emait pipul langa det opin kantri gulum kiriyathaiyim,
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

kriol: wal detlot men weya bin maindimbat det geit bin dalimbat det stori en det wed bin go langa det king deya insaid langa det bigwan haus blanga im.
english: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king's household within.

kriol: det reinbo na garra jidan langa skai, en im jidan pruf blanga det strongwan pramis blanga yumob en blanga ola pipul langa ebri kantri en blanga ola enimul du.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

kriol: detlot mesinja weya yu kaan trastim oldei meigimbat trabul, bat detlot pipul weya yu trastim oldei meigim ebrijing jidan gudwei.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

kriol: wal king hesakaiya bin tok langa detlot pipul na, "wal dumaji yumob jidan klinbala blanga serramoni, wal yumob garra bringimap sekrifais ofring blanga gibitbat theingks langa yawei." en deibin duwit, en sambala deibin bringimap mowa enimul blanga sekrifais langa det barnapwan ofring.
english: Then Hezekiah answered, "Now you have consecrated yourselves to Yahweh. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into Yahweh's house." The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

kriol: beisha bin jandim detlot solja blanga im langa juda en deibin stat blanga bildimap det haibala wol raidaran langa det taun gulum rema, wulijim nobodi kaan gowin o gowei brom juda.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

kriol: "wal detlot wed garra kipum yu brom ola nogudbala gel en brom najamen waif hu oldei tok garram brabli switwan wed blanga meigim yu gudbinji.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife's tongue.

kriol: deibin deigimat im klos, en deibin meigim im werrimon speshalwan pepulwan klos,
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

kriol: im garra bringimap garram dish det laibalawan hotwan eshis brom det faiya pleis langa det teibul blanga ofring, en garram im dubala bingga ful garram gudsmelwan medisin, en im garra bringimap detlot deya langa det brabli seikridwan rum.
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

kriol: "ola juwish pipul sabi mi brom wen aibin lilwan. dei sabi hau aibin oldei jidanbat deya langa main ron kantri wen aibin lilboi, en dei sabi hau aibin oldei jidanbat deya langa jerusalem wen aibin men,
english: "Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

kriol: wal jonathan en ahimas det dubala san blanga det dubala serramonimen bin oldei jidan atsaid langa jerusalem langa det springwoda gulum enrogel, en wanbala wekingel bin oldei kaman langa dubala deya, en imbin oldei dalim dubala det wed brom det dubala serramonimen, en dubala bin oldei go langa king deibid en dalim im. wal dubala bin oldei jidan atsaid langa taun, dumaji dubala nomo bin wandim enibodi blanga luk dubala.
english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn't risk being seen coming into the city.

kriol: wal main gudfren, ai sabi wen ola kristjan braja en sista blanga yunmi oldei go deya langa det pleis weya yu jidan, yu oldei meiksho yu oldei lukaftumbat olabat gudwei. nomeda yu nomo sabi olabat, bat stil yu oldei lukaftumbat olabat.
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

kriol: bebalon bin kilimbat pipul ded langa ebri kantri. wal bebalon garra binijap na dumaji imbin kilim ded loda isreil pipul." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: "As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.

kriol: ebrijing bin hepin jis laik weya yawei bin tok thru langa ilaija. det flauwa en oil nomo bin ranat, najing.
english: The jar of meal didn't run out and the jar of oil didn't fail, according to Yahweh's word, which he spoke by Elijah.

kriol: en ol detlot pipul hubin kamat brom olabat bin jidan olawei brom det kantri gulum misha raidap langa det hil gulum sefa deya langa det reinjis kantri sanraiswei.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

kriol: wal deibin go en gajim mosis, en deibin askim im blanga stap garram olabat, en imbin duwit langa olabat. wal det olmen jethro bin gibit im doda neim sipora langa mosis, en dubala bin merrit,
english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "mosis bin oldei larram men andimwei im waif dumaji yumob brabli adbala pipul. bat wen god bin meigim dijan kantri, im nomo bin lau detkain ting.
english: He said to them, "Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

kriol: detlot lowa blanga yu meigim mi sabi blanga ebrijing. blanga tharran na mi nomo laigim ola nogudbalawei.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN.

kriol: wal king deibid bin dalim ol detlot pipul brom ola najawan kantri hubin jidan deya langa isreil blanga kaman langa jerusalem, en imbin meigim olabat wek. sambala bin kadimbat ola ston blanga meigim det serramoni pleis.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God's house.

kriol: wal detlot twelbala speshalwan mishanri bin jandap na, en pida bin jandap lida langa olabat, en imbin tok langa detlot pipul. imbin tok, "main kantrimen olabat, en ol yumob pipul hu oldei jidanbat iya langa jerusalem, yumob irrim mi na, dumaji ai garra dalim yumob wotfo melabat tok lagijat.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, "You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

kriol: wal if yu garram irriwol, yu garra jinggabat det stori." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

kriol: wal bifo det king brom ijip bin go en fait langa gasa, yawei det trubala god bin tok langa mi blanga ola filastain pipul.
english: Yahweh's word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

kriol: det hanggribala filing blanga sambodi meigim im wek mowa adbala, dumaji im garra wek blanga baiyimbat im daga.
english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

kriol: wal detlot kaunsalamob bin tok langa pailat lagijat blanga meigim det wed garra hepin trubalawei weya jisas bin dalim im wekinmen olabat blanga hau im garra dai.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kriol: afta na ilaisha bin lukinat langa im brabliwei raidap heiseiyel bin filim miselp nogud. en ilaisha bin stat kraikrai.
english: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat na. wen yumob pudum bit langa hos mawus, yumob gin meigim im duwit en go eniwei yumob wandim.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses' mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

kriol: wal langa det seimwan dei yawei bin gibit sekanwan wed langa hegai.
english: Yahweh's word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

kriol: im garram kemp langa jerusalem. im jidan langa saiyan, det bigwan hil.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

kriol: im oldei go garram ola nogudbala pipul,
english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

kriol: wal god na bin meigim ebrijing en yu garra jinggabat langa im wen yu stil yangbala, dumaji det taim garra kaman bambai wen yu git ol en yu abum loda trabul en yu garra tok, "ai nomo abum gudtaim enimo garram main laif, najing."
english: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, "I have no pleasure in them;"

kriol: wal aibin tok, "ol yumob wuman, yumob irrim langa yawei. yumob lafta teiknodis langa im wed. yumob oldei titjimbat ol yumob dodamob hau blanga jidan soriwei, en yumob kipgon titjimbat ol yumob fren blanga singsingbat det fyunral song.
english: Yet hear Yahweh's word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation.

kriol: wal bifo det sebenbala draiwan yiya bin kaman, det waif blanga josef bin abum dubala lilboi blanga im,
english: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

kriol: detlot spirit na nomo bin teiknodis langa god longtaim wen det men neim nowa bin bildimap det bout, en det taim na god bin gibit taim langa ol detlot nogudbala pipul. bat oni 8 pipul bin gowin langa det bout, en god bin seibum olabat brom det fladwoda.
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

kriol: bat yu oni sabi hau blanga jidan brabli gridibala. yu oldei tridimbat gudbala pipul rafwei, en kilimbat gudbala pipul.
english: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence."

kriol: det wei yu luk langa mi, main pramis, en det nekleis yu werrimon, meigim mi brabli hatjamp.
english: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.

kriol: "basdam aibin oni irrimbat wanim najalot pipul bin tok blanga yu, bat tudei na aibin luk langa yu garram main ronwan ai.
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

kriol: sambala serramonimen gulum ferasi bin deya, en deibin irrim jisas tok lagijat, en deibin askim im, "yu nomo toktok blanga melabat, indit? dumaji melabat nomo blainwan."
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, "Are we also blind?"

kriol: wal ilaisha bin tok, "wal dalim im blanga kaman iya." det gel bin kaman en jandap langa det dowawei,
english: He said, "Call her." When he had called her, she stood in the door.

kriol: ai garra jandimdan faiya langa yumob kantri, en if enibodi trai blanga fait langa det kantri dei garra dai. afta na, yumob garra sabi mi na yawei.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

kriol: yu si? jisas krais bin olredi kaman, en im jidan boswan haibala serramonimen blanga ol detlot gudbala ting weya god bin gibit langa wi garram det nyubalawei, en im wek langa det brabli trubalawan seikridwan rum. im nomo wek langa det olbala serramoni pleis weya men bin meigim. im wek langa det mobedawan seikridwan rum weya men nomo bin meigim. det seikridwan rum weya im wek im nomo brom dijan kantri.
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

kriol: yubin kaman langa yawei det trubala god blanga ola isreil pipul, en im garra lukaftumbat yu. yawei garra jinggabat langa yu, ruth, en im garra albumbat yu, dumaji yubin lukbek langa main kantrimen. wal god garra jinggabat yu en album yu brabliwei."
english: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge."

kriol: im luk ola gudwan pipul en ola nogudwan pipul seimwei. im nomo laigim ola jigiwan pipul brabliwei.
english: Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim det men, "yu gobek langa yu kemp na. bat yu nomo gobek langa det taun."
english: He sent him away to his house, saying, "Don't enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village."

kriol: wal jisas bin kipgon tok, "wal im seimwei du lagijat gin. yumob garra jinggabat wanim im garra kos blanga bulurrum mi, dumaji nobodi kaan jidan main wekinmen if im nomo libum ebrijing biyain blanga bulurrum mi.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn't renounce all that he has, he can't be my disciple.

kriol: emrem bin merrit langa libai doda neim jokabed, hubin bon langa ijip. emrem bin abum dubala san neim eran en mosis en wan doda neim miriyam.
english: The name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

kriol: imbin bringimap wi iya en imbin gibit wi dijan gudwan kantri garram gudwan graun blanga growimapbat ola daga.
english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

kriol: wal aibin tok, "enibodi hu oldei gajimbat ola ebrijing nogudbalawei, im jis laik detlot bard hu oldei lukaftumbat detlot eig weya dei nomo bin meigim. wal lagijat wen sambodi stil jidan strongbala im garra lujim ebrijing en jidan nomo garram enijing, en im garra jidan granggibala du.
english: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of his days, they will leave him. At his end, he will be a fool.

kriol: wal heiman bin go en gajim det kout en det hos. imbin meigim modakai werrimon det kout en imbin deigim im garram det hos olawei langa det taun en imbin jinginatbat, "yumob luk iya! dijan na det men weya det king dum gudbala ting blanga shoum rispek brabliwei."
english: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and proclaimed before him, "Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!"

kriol: en dei garra abum bigismob biginini jis laik detlot grinwan bushis weya gro gudwei, en dei garra luk purdiwan jis laik detlot purdiwan olibtri, en pipul garra laigim olabat jis laik dei laigim detlot gudsmelwan tri deya langa lebanan.
english: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

kriol: en joshuwa, det san blanga jehosadek, en ol detlot serramonimen blanga im, en serababal, det san blanga shiyaltiyel, garram im femili olabat, bin bildimap det teibul blanga ofring blanga barnim ola sekrifais serramoni blanga det trubala god blanga ola isreil pipul, jis laik im tok langa det lowa blanga mosis det men blanga god.
english: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

kriol: brom deya jisas bin gowap langa wan hil, en imbin jingat langa detlot men weya imbin wandim blanga go garram im, en deibin kaman langa im,
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

kriol: wal detlot san blanga ihud bin neiman, ahija en gira. deibin jidan boswan blanga ol detlot femilimob hubin jidan langa geba, bat sambodi bin meigim olabat gowei en jidan langa menahath. gira det dedi blanga yusa en ahihad bin go lida blanga olabat wen deibin go en jidan langa menahath.
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers' households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

kriol: yumob solja brom ijip go blanga fait. go kwikbala garram ola bagi en hosis. go garram ola solja brom ithiyopiya en libiya garram olabat shild. en go yumob solja brom lidiya garram yumob bo en erro.'" lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

kriol: wal ola serramonimen, en libai pipul, en ola blijiman en ola wekinmen blanga det serramoni pleis, en ola pleiyamob en ola najalot isreil pipul bin gobek en jidan langa olabat ronwan pleis langa juda.
english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

kriol: bambai na aibin lukaran en aibin luk ola pipul bin wori, en aibin tok, "nomo jinggabat blanga ola enami blanga wi. yu jinggabat det god blanga wi. oni im na gin meigim ola enami bradin langa im, en yumob garra fait blanga yumob kantrimen en ola biginini en ola waif en detlot haus blanga yumob."
english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, "Don't be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses."

kriol: "basdam detlot pipul langa jerusalem bin dumbat nogudbala ting, bat dei nomo bin wori blanga tharran, en wanim garra hepin langa olabat. en wen detlot enamimob bin kaman en bidim olabat brabliwei, deibin jidan brabli nogudbalawei. nobodi kaan album olabat. detlot enami bin bidim olabat, en tudei olabat oldei jingat langa yawei, 'album melabat, dumaji melabat garram detmatj trabul.'
english: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn't remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. "See, Yahweh, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself."

kriol: dumaji mi na yawei det trubala god blanga yumob. yumob garra duwit langa main lowa en langa main wed.
english: I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.

kriol: wal det wekinmen bin tok, "nomo. yu weit basdam. wan men blanga god jidan langa dijan taun, en ebribodi rispek langa im brabliwei, dumaji ebrijing weya im tok, im oldei hepin trubala. wal yunmi lafta go langa im. maitbi im garra dalim yunmi weya yunmi garra faindim detlot dongki."
english: The servant said to him, "Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let's go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go."

kriol: en dumaji sambala wuman bin bilib, wal deibin gedimbek olabat femili brom dedbala. bat sambala pipul hubin bilib nomo bin kamat fri brom det trabul weya deibin abum. wen detlot nogudbala pipul bin oldei trai en meigim olabat tok nogudbalawei blanga god en tenawei brom im, detlot bilibamob nomo bin duwit langa olabat, en detlot nogudbala pipul bin kilim olabat ded. detlot bilibamob nomo bin tenawei en meigim miselp fri, dumaji deibin wandim det mobedawan laif weya god garra gibit olabat bambai.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

kriol: wal wen king sol bin irrim olabat jinginatbat lagijat, im nomo bin laigim, en imbin wail brabliwei, en imbin tok miselp, "dei reken deibid bin kilim bigismob filastain solja en aibin kilim oni lilbit. wal bambai dei garra trai en meigim im jidan king."
english: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, "They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?"

kriol: wal maitbi yumob reken mi tok det daga weya enibodi gibit langa eni drimin sheip im seikridwan, en det drimin im trubalawan du. bat najing.
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

kriol: brom deya det einjul bin gajim det raunwan dish, en imbin bilimap ful garram faiya brom det teibul blanga ofring, en afta imbin tjakamdan det faiya brom hebin raidap langa dijan kantri. laitining en thanda en olkainaba nois bin kamat na, en dijan kantri bin sheik nomo lilbit.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

kriol: en ola speshalwan mesinja blanga god bin tok blanga jisas krais du. if enibodi bilib langa im, wal thru im neim na god garra larramgo olabat fri brom ola nogudbala ting weya deibin oldei dumbat." lagijat na pida bin tok.
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins."

kriol: en wen wibin beptais langa im, imbin jis laik sambodi bin gaburrumap wi langa greibyad garram im, dumaji wi dedi god bin wandi meigim wi jidan laibala garram nyubala laif jis laik weya imbin meigim jisas krais gidap laibala brom det greib garram det brabliwan pawa blanga im.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

kriol: "wen yumob kamat langa eni taun, yumob garra gowin langa det taun en lukabat sambodi hu wandi lukaftumbat yumob, en yumob garra jidan langa im haus raidap yumob gowei brom det taun,
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

kriol: detlot yangwan solja bin kamat brom det taun en go lida langa det fait en ol detlot ami brom isreil bin kaminap biyain langa olabat.
english: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

kriol: yumob nomo lau dumbat nogudwan ting langa main holiwan neim. ola pipul blanga isreil garra sabi mi holiwan. mi na yawei, en mi na meigim yumob jidan holiwan,
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

kriol: wal yawei bin tok, "wal dijan bin hepin dumaji main pipul olabat nomo bin laigim det gudbalawan wed weya aibin gibitbat langa olabat. en olabat nomo bin duwit en teiknodis langa mi wanim aibin oldei dalimbat langa olabat.
english: Yahweh says, "Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,

kriol: brom deya jisas bin libum olabat, en imbin gobek en prei igin, "main dedi, if yu kaan deigidawei dijan trabul brom mi, wal ai garra duwit, dumaji yu wandim mi garra duwit."
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, "My Father, if this cup can't pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done."

kriol: en if wi dum lagijat langa olabat, wal bambai wi garra deigimoba ola ebrijing blanga olabat. ola ship en gout en buligi holot garra jidan blanga wi. wal wi garra meigimap wi main na. wanim yumob reken? dei garra kaman en jidan langa wi?"
english: Won't their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let's give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us."

kriol: en bambai liya bin abum najawan lilboi blanga jeikob, dumaji god bin lisin langa liya wen imbin prei langa im.
english: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

kriol: mi na yawei det boswan god, bin meigim dijan pramis en yumob garra gitkil en detlot wekinmen blanga main garra yusumbat yumob neim nogudbalawei. bat ai garra gibit main wekinmenmob nyubala neim na.
english: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord Yahweh will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,

kriol: "yu king brom asiriya yu lisin langa mi na. yu reken det eks o sowa im mowa strongbala langa det men hu oldei yusumbat im? yu reken det wadi gin lidimap det men hu holdimbat langa im?
english: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

kriol: wal det einjul hubin oldei jidan lida langa ol detlot isreil pipul bin goran biyain langa olabat, en det klaud bin goran biyain langa olabat du,
english: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

kriol: jeihu bin jandim wed ebriweya langa det kantri isreil en ol detlot hubin oldei weship beil bin kaman. dei nomo bin wandi stap. holot bin kaman. deibin bilimap det rum deya langa det seikridwan haus blanga beil.
english: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn't come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.

kriol: im spredimat sno, seimwei laik yu spredimat bleingkit, en im meigim det waitwan ais jidan ebriweya langa graun.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

kriol: wal orait, mi na yawei dalim yu king jehoiyakim. nomo eni biginini blanga yu garra jidan king langa deibid kantri. det dedwan bodi blanga yu garra jidan langa det hotwan san ebri deitaim, en det dyu garra kaman langa det dedwan bodi ebri naitaim.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: "He will have no one to sit on David's throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

kriol: dislot ting na bin hepin, dumaji beisha en im san ela bin oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting, en deibin lidimbat ola isreil pipul blanga dumbat ola nogudbala ting du en deibin meigim yawei det trubala god blanga isreil brabli wail wen deibin meigimbat ola nogudwan drimin sheip.
english: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

kriol: wal eibram bin go, en imbin gajim detlot enimul en bard, en imbin kilim olabat, en imbin kadim det buligi en det nenigout en det ship raitdan langa bekboun, en imbin opinimat olabat. bat im nomo bin kadim det dubala bard.
english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn't divide the birds.

kriol: en imbin go langa det helfaiya. wal wujan men yu wandim blanga jidan speshalwan mishanri?"
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place."

kriol: en imbin jandim sambala wekinmen lida langa im langa wan lilwan taun deya langa det kantri gulum sameriya blanga meigim ebrijing redi blanga im.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

kriol: en aibin dalim olabat, "detlot gel brom najalot kantri na bin meigim king salaman dum nogudbala ting. imbin brabli haibala king en pipul langa najalot kantri nomo bin abum king laik im. god bin laigim im en imbin meigim im king blanga ola isreil pipul. bat detlot gel brom najalot kantri bin meigim im joinin langa detlot nogudbala ting blanga olabat.
english: Didn't Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

kriol: mi na yawei det trubala god, en aibin meigim dis graun en skai en solwoda en ebrijing. imbin deigim mi 6 dei blanga meigim, en langa det namba 7 dei aibin abum spel. blanga tharran na aibin gudbinji blanga det sebathdei, en aibin meigim im difrin brom detlot najalot dei.
english: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

kriol: wal deibid bin tok, "main men olabat nomo bin silip garram enibodi. dei jidan fri brom detkain ting, dumaji wen dei abum wek blanga dum, dei oldei meigim miselp fri brom detkain ting. en blanga dis speshalwan wek tudei deibin meigim miselp brabli klinwan."
english: David answered the priest, and said to him, "Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?"

kriol: kabon, leimam, kitlish,
english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

kriol: en brom deya det boda garra go langa det sauthsaid langa det jampap langa det hil gulum ekrabim, en kipgon thru langa sin, longwei sauthsaid raidap langa keidishbaniya. brom deya det boda garra kipgon sangodanwei langa heisada en kipgon langa esman.
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

kriol: bigismob pipul bin gedimbat shok wen deibin luk wanim bin hepin langa im. deibin gedimbat shok dumaji imbin ardimbat nomo lilbit raidap im nomo bin luk laik men na.
english: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—

kriol: en ai garra meigim olabat gidap laibala olagijawan langa det laswan dei, dumaji main bodipat na det brabliwan daga, en main blad na det brabliwan dringk,
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

kriol: wal detlot benjamin men bin kamdan brom det ston kantri, en detlot isreil pipul bin gibit olabat detlot yanggel blanga merrit. bat dei nomo bin abum naf blanga ebribodi.
english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren't enough for them.

kriol: bat bifo deibin go, imbin dalim olabat, "dijan wed na yumob garra dalim isau. yumob dalim im mi na, jeikob, mi wekinmen blanga im. ai gulum im bos. en yumob dalim im aibin jidan longtaim garram leiban, en aibin jis kambek na.
english: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: 'This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

kriol: wi ol juwish pipul indit? wi biginini olabat gudbala laik ola biginini blanga detlot ritjwan juwish pipul, en wi garra lafta meigim wi biginini olabat wekinmen blanga gedim mani. en wibin olredi selim sambala doda blanga wi blanga jidan wekingel hu jidan jis laiga prisana blanga ola ritjmen. wi kaan dum enijing na dumaji ol wi sid daga en frut tri jidan blanga ola najalot men."
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards."

kriol: wal heran bin dai langa det kantri gulum bebalon. imbin dai langa det seimwan taun gulum yura weya imbin bon, en imbin dai bifo im dedi bin dai. det olmen tera bin stil jidan laibala wen im san heran bin dai. wal heran bin libum thribala biginini biyain, wanbala boi neim lot en dubala gel neim milka en iska.
english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

kriol: wal longtaim afta wen jisas bin gidap laibala brom dedbala, detlot wekinmen blanga im bin jinggabat detlot wed weya imbin tok deya langa det serramoni pleis, en deibin bilib det wed langa oltestaman weya im tok blanga jisas, en deibin bilib detlot wed weya jisas bin tok du.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

kriol: wanbala men jidan iya langa dijan kantri weya yu jidan bos. im garram det spirit blanga im god insaid langa im. wen yu dedi bin jidan king, dijan men bin abum gudbala main blanga jinggabat en sabi ola raitwan ting, jis laik detlot drimin. yu dedi, king nebakanesa bin meigim det men bos langa ola doktabala en klebabala men.
english: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father, light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him. The king, Nebuchadnezzar, your father—yes, the king, your father—made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers,

kriol: wal yu jandim detlot sid daga gulum wit en bali, en det wain en oliboil weya yubin pramisim.
english: "Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

kriol: nobodi kaan tatjim dijan hil. if enibodi pudumbut langa dijan hil, yumob garra kilim im ded garram ston o bo en erro. dis lowa im jidan blanga ola pipul en blanga ola enimul du. dei garra dai if dei pudumbut langa dijan hil. bat wen yumob irrim det hon jingat, det taim na ola pipul garra galimap langa dijan hil." lagijat na god bin tok.
english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.' When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain."

kriol: wal wen king josaiya bin oni 16 yiya ol imbin stat weshipbat god, jis laik im grengrenfatha deibid bin dum. bambai langa 4 yiya taim imbin binijimap ola nogudwan serramoni pleis langa juda en jerusalem, en detlot seikridwan pol blanga weshipbat det gelwan drimin gulum eshara en detlot drimin sheip blanga detlot drimin brom najalot kantri.
english: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.

kriol: detlot pipul hu oldei jinggabat gudwei oldei wandim blanga len mowa.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

kriol: det gel nomo jidan trubala langa im hasbin. im fogedabat det pramis weya imbin meigim lida langa god.
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

kriol: deitaim imbin oldei lidim olabat garram klaud, en naitaim faiya bin oldei barnbarn blanga lidim olabat.
english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

kriol: bambai na det king bin gibit oda langa ola pipul langa det kantri. imbin tok, "wen eni isreil gel abum boiwan beibi, yumob garra tjakam det beibi langa det nail riba en larram im dai deya. bat yumob garra larram ola gelwan beibi jidan laibala."
english: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, "You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive."

kriol: main enami olabat oldei tok nogudwei langa mi. olabat oldei mokimbat mi en oldei yusum main neim nogudbalawei.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

kriol: olabat oldei blandim miselp langa ola sigridwan pleis, en lukinatbat ebrijing mi dumbat, dumaji olabat wandi kilim mi ded.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

kriol: wal wen ol detlot pipul bin binij dagadagat det daga, streidawei jisas bin meigim im wekinmen olabat gowin langa det bout, en imbin dalim olabat blanga go lida langa det pleis gulum bethsaida najasaid langa det bigwan woda. afta na jisas bin jandimwei detlot pipul,
english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

kriol: wal yumob garra oldei jidan gudbinjiwei, dumaji yumob bin joinap garram jisas krais det bos blanga wi. wanmo ai garra dalim yumob. yumob garra gudbinji,
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, "Rejoice!"

kriol: yu si? im seimwei du garram yumob. yumob wandim detlot speshalwan pawa brom det holi spirit. en yumob garra wandim det pawa du weya garra meigim yumob jidan wanbala en meigim det tjetj blanga yumob strongbala.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

kriol: "afta na wanbala brabli strongbala king garra kaman. im garra jidan bos garram pawa langa bigmob kantri, en im garra dum enijing im wandim.
english: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

kriol: wen im det rait taim, god na garra meigim jisas krais kambek. wal nobodi jidan bos. oni god na jidan bos. im na det brabli gudbalawan, en im na det king blanga ola king, en im na det bos blanga ola bos.
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

kriol: en det sneik nomo bin trikim edam. imbin trikim ib, en ib na bin breigim det lowa blanga god.
english: Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

kriol: imbin weshipbat det gelwan drimin gulum estatei, det drimin blanga det kantri gulum saidan, en molek det brabli nogudwan drimin blanga det kantri gulum eman.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

kriol: wal deibin deigim jisas langa det pleis gulum hed boun. garram olabat langgus dei gulum det pleis golgatha,
english: When they came to a place called "Golgotha", that is to say, "The place of a skull,"

kriol: wotfo yu haidim miselp brom melabat? nomo fogedabat melabat pein en trabul.
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

kriol: yumob garra go streit langa det pleis, en wen yumob gowin langa enibodi haus, yumob kaan tok eniwei. yumob garra jis tok, 'god garra meigim yumob jidan gudwei.' lagijat na yumob garra tok.
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace be to this house.'

kriol: bat wen dubala nogudwan, yu kaan luk det lait gudwei, en ebrijing jidan dakbala. wal yu garra meiksho yu gin luk det lait brabliwei, dumaji yu nomo wandi jidan blanga dakbala. yumob jinggabat na, seimwei yu garra jinggabat langa god brabliwei en det wed blanga god im jis laiga lait.
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

kriol: en wen imbin tok lagijat, imbin luk langa najawan men deya, en imbin askim im wanim det king garra gibit langa det men hu garra kilim det filastain men ded, en imbin gedim det seimwan ensa. ebritaim wen imbin oldei askim enibodi, deibin oldei gibit im det seimwan ensa.
english: He turned away from him toward another, and spoke like that again; and the people answered him again the same way.

kriol: brom deya det king bin askim ola mesinja blanga im, "wotkain det men?"
english: He said to them, "What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?"

kriol: if det bingga blanga yu oldei meigim yu dum nogudbala ting en deigidawei yu brom main wei, wal mobeda yu libum det nogudbala ting jis laik yu kadimof det bingga. im nogud blanga yu if yu jidan langa det olagijawan helfaiya garram dubala bingga. mobeda yu jidan garram det olagijawan laif garram wanbala bingga.
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

kriol: mi jingat langa yu, yawei. mi askim yu brabliwei blanga album langa mi.
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

kriol: bat yumob nomo bin len blanga jisas krais lagijat.
english: But you didn't learn Christ that way,

kriol: brom deya najalot pipul brom najawan kantri bin kaman en deigidawei yumob en meigim yumob jidan prisana blanga najing. blanga yumob lidamob bin kraikraibat garram detmatj pein, en ebridei detlot najalot pipul bin oldei mokimbat main neim.
english: "Now therefore, what do I do here," says Yahweh, "seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock," says Yahweh, "and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.

kriol: en imbin gibit mi lilboi." en imbin gulum det lilboi neim josef.
english: She named him Joseph, saying, "May Yahweh add another son to me."

kriol: en deibin tok, "ebribodi iya langa jerusalem sabi blanga dijan speshalwan ting weya dubala bin dum, en wi kaan dalim ola pipul dubala nomo bin dum det ting.
english: saying, "What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can't deny it.

kriol: brom deya mosis bin bringimap det yangwan boiwan buligi blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei, en eran en im sanmob bin pudum olabat bingga ontop langa det buligi hed.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

kriol: en deibin gedim ol detlot taun neim senan, heidasha, migdalged,
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

kriol: en ebribodi garra laigim im brabliwei. dei garra abum filing oni blanga im, en dei garra jinggabat im oldei langa olabat main en adwek blanga im, en dei garra laigim ola najalot pipul brabliwei jis laik dei laigim miselp. wal im gud blanga gibit ofring langa god. bat im mobeda yu duwit langa dijan dubala lowa, dumaji dijan dubala lowa na dubala det meinwan lowa blanga god." lagijat na det lowamen bin tok.
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices."

kriol: wal king deibid bin dalim ol detlot lidamob brom isreil blanga albumbat langa salaman.
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

kriol: wal jowab bin baudan lida langa deibid blanga shoum rispek langa im, en imbin tok, "bos, god garra gudbala langa yu. en ai sabi yu gudbinji langa mi, dumaji yu garra duwit langa mi wanim aibin wandim yu blanga dum."
english: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, "Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant."

kriol: "mi brabli nogudbinji na, dumaji aibin meigim sol jidan king. bat imbin gibit mi bekboun, en im nomo bin duwit wanim aibin dalim im blanga dum." wal semyul bin brabli apset, en olnait imbin askimbat yawei nomo blanga nogudbinji langa king sol.
english: "It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments." Samuel was angry; and he cried to Yahweh all night.

kriol: bat if im nomo seibum melabat, wal yu sabi melabat kaan weship yu drimin sheip, en melabat kaan pudumdan melabat feis langa graun en weship langa det golwan drimin sheip weya yubin meigim." lagijat na deibin tok.
english: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up."

kriol: ai garra dum ol dislot ting blanga meigim pipul sabi mi na yawei en mi na det brabli holiwan god."
english: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh."'

kriol: en deibid bin askim im, "brom weya yubin kaman?" wal det men bin tok, "aibin gidawei brom det kemp weya ola isreil solja bin jidan."
english: David said to him, "Where do you come from?" He said to him, "I have escaped out of the camp of Israel."

kriol: eihes bin 20 yiya ol wen imbin jidan det king blanga juda en imbin jidan king langa jerusalem fo 16 yiya. im nomo bin jidan laik im grengrenfatha king deibid. imbin dumbat ola nogudbala ting weya bin meigim yawei det trubala god nogudbinji,
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn't do that which was right in Yahweh his God's eyes, like David his father.

kriol: brabli gudbinjiwei dei kaman en gowin langa det bigwan haus blanga det king.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king's palace.

kriol: main dedi bin titjimbat mi. imbin oldei tok, 'yu jinggabat en nomo fogedabat main wed. if yu kipum ol detlot wed wal yu garra jidan laibala.
english: He taught me, and said to me: "Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

kriol: bat detlot pipul nomo teiknodis langa mi en olabat kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting, wal ai kaan dum enijing wanim aibin tok.
english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they not obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.

kriol: bat ola blijiman bin kadimof det hed blanga det hed kuk, en deibin heingimap im bodi ontop langa wadi. wal lagijat na imbin hepin jis laik weya josef bin tok blanga dubala drim.
english: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

kriol: wal det dubala san blanga eran gulum neideb en abaihu bin gajim det kopawan dish blanga dubala en dubala bin pudum det laibala tjakol langa dubala dish, en dubala bin miksimap det gudsmelwan medisin en gibit langa yawei det trubala god. bat det faiya im nomo bin seikridwan, dumaji yawei nomo bin dalim dubala blanga gibit.
english: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before Yahweh, which he had not commanded them.

kriol: deibin pikimat wan speshalwan dei en langa det dei na ola pipul nomo bin lau blanga dagat enijing. deibin majurrumap ola pipul en deibin pudum neiboth langa det speshalwan pleis.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

kriol: imbin wokwokbat langa det kona langa det roud weya bin go gulijap langa det haus blanga wanbala gel.
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

kriol: yawei yu lisin brom det skai en yu jadjim det dubala men. yu panishim det giltiwan, en yu larramgo det najawan fri.
english: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

kriol: wen detlot isreil pipul bin luk det faiya bin kamdan brom top en det brabli braitwan lait bin braitinimap det serramoni pleis, olabat holot bin baudan en weship langa yawei en preisimbat im, dumaji imbin brabli gudbala en imbin laigim olabat olagijawan.
english: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh's glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to Yahweh, saying, "For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!"

kriol: ebribodi langa det taun gulum diban bin ol gowap langa detlot nogudbala serramoni pleis en olabat bin kraikraibat. en ol detlot pipul langa moweb bin kraikraibat, en bin sheibum olabat wiska en hed dumaji wanim bin hepin langa det dubala taun gulum neibo en midaba.
english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

kriol: if yumob jidan kwaitbala en lisin langa mi, wal yumob brabli klebabala.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

kriol: god nomo nogudbala, dumaji im garram det rait blanga pikimat enibodi im wandim. wi sabi tharran, dumaji langa mosis imbin tok, "mi oldei kain en sori langa enibodi weya mi pikimat."
english: For he said to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat na. if enibodi reken im klebabala en sabi det wei blanga god, wal im garra dumbat det raitwan ekshan blanga shoum ola pipul. lagijat na im garra shoum olabat. im garra jidan brabli gudbalawei.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

kriol: en yu garra streitinimap det minista en tok langa im streitat langa ola kristjan pipul en gibit woning langa olabat du.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

kriol: en deibin jingat langa ola pipul na, "kaman olabat! wi garra bildimap taun na garram wan bigbala haus. det haus garra gajimap raidap insaid langa skai, dumaji wi nomo wandi spredatbat ebriweya langa ebri kantri. wi wandi jidan wanmob garram bigneim."
english: They said, "Come, let's build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let's make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth."

kriol: wal ol detlot taun en ol detlot kantri mosis bin gibit langa ola femili blanga rubin klen.
english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

kriol: im shoum ol lobala pipul wujei blanga go langa det raitwan wei, en im lenimbat olabat ebrijing im wandim olabat blanga dum.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

kriol: "wal yumob nomo lau sekrifais langa yawei det trubala god blanga wi eni buligi o ship garram eni siknis o enijing nogud atsaidwei langa im bodi, dumaji yawei brabli nogudbinji langa detkain.
english: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

kriol: detlot pipul oldei haidim miselp ebriweya langa kemp, weidabat blanga grebum en kilimbat ola gudwan pipul hu nomo sabi. dei weidabat en lukinatbat sigridwei blanga gedimbat pipul.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

kriol: en im garra bringimap olabat deya langa det serramonimen, en det serramonimen garra pudum det feswan bard langa det ofring blanga nogudbalawei. en im garra breigim det nek, bat nomo det hedpat,
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

kriol: tola bin abum siksbala san neim yusi, refaiya, jeriyel, jamai, aibsam en shemuwel. deibin jidan boswan blanga detlot femili lain blanga tola, en deibin brabli gudwan solja du. wen deibid bin jidan king deibin jidan 22,600 pipul.
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers' houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

kriol: blanga main laif bin binij, jis laik det stakmen tent wen bigwan win bin blowimwei. yubin kadimof main win, jis laik deibin kadimof det kotin brom det rolapwan kotin. kwikbala aibin reken yu garra binijim main laif.
english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd's tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

kriol: detlot wekinmen bin tok, "heiman im deya weidabat blanga tok langa yu." wal det king bin tok, "bringimap im iya insaid."
english: The king's servants said to him, "Behold, Haman stands in the court." The king said, "Let him come in."

kriol: afta na det wanbala men hubin jidanbat olagijawan bin kaman en imbin jadjim olabat en larramgo detlot pipul fri hubin bulurrum det brabli haibala god. wal det taim bin kaman na wen god garra gibit pawa blanga im pipul blanga jidan bos.
english: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

kriol: blanga yu pramis im tok trubalawan. mi laigim det pramis brabliwei.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

kriol: wal nomeda jisas bin dalim det men nomo blanga dalim enibodi, bat stil det wed bin spredat ebriweya blanga jisas, en brom ebriweya detmatj pipul bin kaman langa im blanga irrim im tok en blanga askim im blanga meigim olabat gudbala brom olkain siknis.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

kriol: wal god kaan meigim ola einjul jidan bos blanga det nyubala hebin en nyubala graun.
english: For he didn't subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

kriol: hebin im blanga yu, en dijan wel du. yubin meigim dijan wel en ebrijing weya jidan langa im.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

kriol: deibin gajimap mi! main enami olabat ebriweya. dei weidabat blanga det rait taim blanga berrim mi langa graun.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

kriol: "wal trubala det dubala gabman bos neim herod en panshas pailat bin midap iya langa jerusalem garram ola juwish pipul en ola jintail pipul blanga kilim jisas. im na det brabliwan wekinmen weya yubin pikimat, en yubin meigim im det masaiya.
english: "For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

kriol: wal yawei bin tok langa mi, 'isreil, yu na main ronwan wekinmen wulijim ola najalot pipul garra shoum rispek langa mi.'"
english: He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified."

kriol: dijan na det leda weya deibin jandim langa det boswan.
english: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.

kriol: wal ola pipul langa det taun bin oldei dalimbat laiya, en deibin oldei medrimbat enibodi, en deibin oldei pulumat olabat enijing brom enibodi du. en blanga tharran na ol detlot pipul langa det taun garra binij.
english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.

kriol: bat det king bin tok, "if yawei nomo album yu, wal wanim ai garra dum? ai nomo garram eni daga o wain!
english: He said, "If Yahweh doesn't help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?"

kriol: "bifo eran garra go langa det brabli seikridwan rum, im garra abum bogi en im garra werrimon speshalwan klos blanga serramonimen weya im oldei werrimon, det longwan kout, en shotwan trasis en belt en raunwan het deibin meigim brom det gudwan matiriyal.
english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

kriol: larram detlot praudbala pipul sheim miselp dumaji olabat oldei dalimbat laiya stori blanga mi, bat mi, ai garra duwit langa wanim yu titjimbat mi.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

kriol: yu si? melkisadek bin mowa haibala langa eibrahem, en imbin haibala langa ol detlot serramonimen hubin kamat brom eibrahem du. ol detlot serramonimen bin oldei gajim wanbala ting blanga ebri tenbala enijing brom ola pipul, en bambai deibin ol dai. bat melkisadek bin gajim wanbala ting blanga ebri tenbala enijing brom eibrahem wantaim, en bambai wanim bin hepin langa im? det oltestaman nomo dalim wi imbin dai. im jidan laibala.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

kriol: en olabat garra wek blanga mi na, olabat god, en blanga wanbala king brom deibid femili.
english: but they will serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

kriol: blanga 40 yiya ai nomo bin gudbinji langa detlot pipul. aibin tok, 'olabat nomo garram eni rispek blanga mi. olabat nomo teiknodis langa ol main lowa.'
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, "They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways."

kriol: wen yu irrim det stori blanga det men langa kothaus yu reken det stori im truwan, bat wen sambodi askimbat im kwestjan, yu wanwanbat na.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

kriol: en pailat bin tok, "wal wanim nogudbala ting imbin dum?" bat detlot pipul nomo bin ensim im. deibin kipgon jinginatbat adbala, en deibin kipgon tok, "kilim im! kilim im ded!"
english: Pilate said to them, "Why, what evil has he done?" But they cried out exceedingly, "Crucify him!"

kriol: yu na yawei det trubala god blanga melabat bin redi blanga panishim melabat, en yubin dum, dumaji yu oldei dum wanim gudwan, en melabat nomo bin teiknodis langa yu.
english: Therefore Yahweh has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "dumaji yubin ensim mi klebawei yu gin gobek langa yu kemp na. yu doda im rait. det dibuldibul bin gowei brom im."
english: He said to her, "For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter."

kriol: yu garra dalim olabat blanga meigim det speshalwan shet gulum ifad en det speshalwan nekleis gulum brespleit, en yu garra dalim olabat blanga meigim longwan kout en purdiwan shet en raunwan het en belt. dei garra meigim detlot klos blanga yu braja eran en im fobala san, dumaji dei garra jidan serramonimen blanga mi.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.

kriol: bat aibin jingat langa yawei. aibin jingat langa main god blanga album mi. en imbin irrim mi deya langa det seikridwan pleis blanga im, en imbin lisin langa mi weya aibin jingat langa im blanga album mi.
english: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

kriol: "wal aibin deya ontop langa det hil fo 40 dei en 40 nait jis laik aibin dum basdam. yawei bin lisin langa mi en im nomo bin binijimap yumob.
english: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahweh listened to me that time also. Yahweh would not destroy you.

kriol: ai garra jandim sambala men blanga rudimat det pleis. olabat garra bringimap olabat eks blanga kadimdan ola strongwan sida pol en olabat garra tjakambat detlot pol langa det faiya.
english: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

kriol: "yumob jinggabat na. mi na bin meigim yumob jidan hanggribala langa ol detlot bigwan taun blanga yumob, bat stil yumob nomo bin kambek langa mi.
english: "I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven't returned to me," says Yahweh.

kriol: wal wi sabi wanim pipul jinggabat insaid, dumaji wi gin luk wanim pipul dumbat. pipul silipsilip garram enibodi olkainwei.
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

kriol: en if yumob dum wanim aibin dalim yumob blanga dum, wal yumob na main fren olabat.
english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin luk det lilboi lagijat, imbin askim det lilboi dedi, "haulong dijan lilboi bin lagijat?"
english: He asked his father, "How long has it been since this has been happening to him?" He said, "From childhood.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok na, "wal ai garra jandim brabli poisinwan sneik langa yumob, en yumob kaan neba stapam im brom baidimbat yumob."
english: "For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you," says Yahweh.

kriol: main hat im pamping nomo lilbit. ai kaan jidan kwaitbala. mi tenimbat miselp, mi garram detmatj pein. mi ardimbat nomo lilbit du, dumaji ai gin irrim detlot longwan wisul, en detlot enami jinginat adbala.
english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can't hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

kriol: detlot drimin blanga najalot kantri olabat laiyawan, weya pipul bin meigimbat, bat yawei det trubala god bin meigim ebrijing langa skai.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

kriol: brom deya det men bin dalim mi blanga raidimdan dijan wed langa det einjul blanga det tjetj langa det taun gulum sadis. det men bin holdim detlot 7 spirit blanga god en detlot 7 sta langa im bingga. en dijan na det wed brom im, "ai sabi ebrijing yubin dumbat. olabat reken yu brabli laibliwan. bat najing. yu jidan jis laiga dedbala.
english: "And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: "He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: "I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

kriol: det wekinmen neim huram bin meigim loda pot, shabul en boul du. imbin dum ebrijing weya imbin pramis king salaman im garra dum blanga det serramoni pleis. imbin meigim dubala kopawan pol, en dubala boul weya jidan ontopwei langa det dubala pol, en det pitja garram tjein langa det dubala boul ontop langa det dubala pol, en detlot 400 kopawan pamagrenit weya jidan dubala lain langa det dubala boul ontop langa det dubala pol. en imbin meigim detlot tenbala bagi, en detlot tenbala boul, en det bigwan boul, en detlot 12 buligi weya holdimap det bigwan boul, en detlot pot, shabul en fok. huram det boswan bin meigim ol dislot ting brom shainiwan kopa blanga yusum langa det serramoni pleis blanga yawei, jis laik king salaman bin dalim im.
english: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God's house:

kriol: imbin seibum wi brom wi enami olabat. trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kriol: ai garra oldei kipum main pramis langa im, en main strongwan pramis garra jidan olagijawan garram im.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

kriol: wal sambala pat blanga wi bodi olabat wikwan, en nomeda olabat wikwan, bat stil wi garra abum olabat.
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

kriol: jeihu garra kilim ded enibodi hu trai blanga ranawei brom det bigbala naif blanga heiseiyel, en ilaisha garra kilim ded enibodi hu trai blanga ranawei brom det bigbala naif blanga jeihu.
english: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

kriol: en aibin gajim det wadi garram det neim "kainbala" en aibin breigim im. en tharran bin det pitja blanga ola pipul blanga gibit olabat det wed brom yawei. imbin meigim det strongwan pramis blanga kain langa olabat bat najing na. imbin deigimbek det strongwan pramis blanga im na. sambala pipul hubin abum adtaim bin lukinat mi en deibin sabi god bin gibit olabat det wed lagijat.
english: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

kriol: bambai na job bin lafta jidanbat langa detlot eshis weya deibin oldei tjakidaweibat, dumaji imbin wandim shoum imbin brabli nogudbinji. en imbin oldei grajimbat im sowa garram breikinwan klei dish.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

kriol: dumaji im panishim mi garram stom en meigim mi kipgon abumbat pein blanga najing.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

kriol: wal ebsalom bin tenaran, en imbin tok langa ahithafel na, "wi iya langa jerusalem na. wal wanim wi garra dum?"
english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give your counsel what we shall do."

kriol: "neksdei yu garra gajim nenigout en im kaan abum enijing rong langa im, en yu garra gibit sekrifais blanga ola nogudbalawei. yu garra tjakam detlot blad blanga det nenigout oloba langa det teibul blanga ofring blanga meigim im klinbala blanga serramoni, jis laik yubin dum garram det blad blanga buligi.
english: "On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.

kriol: "ola wuman en ola biginini garra ol go langa detlot bebalon pipul, en yu du kaan ranawei brom olabat. yu garra jidan prisana blanga det king brom bebalon, en olabat garra barnimap dijan taun."
english: They will bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans. You won't escape out of their hand, but will be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon. You will cause this city to be burned with fire.'"

kriol: "gibit eran en im sanmob ol dislot lowa blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei. wal det enimul blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei, dei garra kilim im deya nowathsaid langa det teibul blanga ofring, weya deibin kilimbat detlot najalot enimul blanga det barnapwan ofring. dijan na im brabli seikridwan ofring.
english: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

kriol: "main pipul olabat bin pikimat olabat king miselp, en dei nomo bin askim mi. en deibin pikimat ola boswan blanga olabat du, en dei nomo bin askim mi blanga pikimat olabat. en deibin gajim ola gol en silba en deibin meigimbat ola drimin sheip, en detlot ting na garra meigim olabat dai, dumaji ai nomo laigim det goldinwan buligi weya ol detlot pipul langa sameriya oldei bulurrum, en mi brabli wail langa olabat.
english: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn't approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.

kriol: edama, rema, heisowa,
english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

kriol: bambai na wanwiktaim det beibi bin dai, en ola boswan wekinmen blanga king deibid bin bradin blanga dalim im det bednyus, en deibin tok gija, "bifo det beibi bin dai, king deibid nomo bin oldei lisin langa wi wen wibin oldei wandi tok langa im. wal hau wi garra dalim im det beibi blanga im bin dai, dumaji im mait kilim miselp brabli wen im irrim det bednyus."
english: On the seventh day, the child died. David's servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, "Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn't listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?"

kriol: nomo oni mi garra meigim yumob strongbala, bat yumob garra meigim mi strongbala du, dumaji wen wi luk hau wi bilib, wi garra album gija.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other's faith, both yours and mine.

kriol: "en if det ofring damba weya yu gugumbat ontop langa det aiyan pleit langa det faiya, wal yu garra meigim garram flauwa en oliboil, bat nomo garram eni raising.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

kriol: en beilam bin tok langa beilak, "yu bildimap 7 teibul blanga ofring blanga mi, en yu bringimap langa mi 7 boiwan buligi en 7 dediwan ship."
english: Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here."

kriol: bat aibin bradin nomo lilbit wen aibin abum wan drim.
english: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

kriol: brom deya detlot isreil pipul bin go langa det seikridwan pleis blanga yawei igin, en deya na deibin sori miselp en kraikrai raidap sangodan, en afta deibin askim god, "melabat garra stil gobek en fait langa detmob?" en god bin tok, "yuwai. yumob garra gobek en fait." wal wen god bin tok lagijat, ola isreil solja bin gudbinji, en deibin filim miselp strongbala, en deibin gobek langa det taun, en ola solja bin go en jandap langa det seim pleis blanga fait igin,
english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.

kriol: wal ai dalim yumob. god garra panishim detlot laiyawan titja, dumaji deibin gowei brom det trubalawei, en deibin lujim det trubalawei, en deibin bulurrum det wei blanga beilam det san blanga biyowa. nomeda beilam bin speshalwan mesinja blanga god, bat stil imbin laigim gedimbat mani brom ola nogudbala ting weya imbin oldei dumbat,
english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

kriol: wal jonathan bin tok, "nomo. main dedi nomo wandi kilim yu. im oldei dalimbat mi ebrijing, en if im bina wandi kilim yu, wal im bina dalim mi. bat im nomo wandi kilim yu."
english: He said to him, "Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so."

kriol: aibin trai jinggabat blanga sabi ebrijing blanga ola gudbala pipul en ola brabli nogudbala pipul, bat najing. imbin brabli adwan.
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

kriol: "yu askim mi blanga shoum yu gudbala ting wanim yu nomo bin luk bifo, wulijim yu garra sabi main pramis garra jidan trubalawan. yu askim mi blanga shoum yu samting garra hepin langa det wel weya ola dedbala pipul jidan, o deya langa skai."
english: "Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above."

kriol: en imbin tok, "aibin reken yu nomo bin laigim im, en aibin gibit im langa yu fren. bat im lilwan sista iya im mowa purdibala langa im, en yu gin abum im."
english: Her father said, "I most certainly thought that you utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Isn't her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please, take her instead."

kriol: yu jinggabat det strongwan pramis yubin meigim garram melabat, dumaji ola nogudbala ting jidan langa ebri kantri tudei.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

kriol: wal main biginini olabat, wi garra laigim wi braja en sista olabat brabliwei. wi kaan jis toktok garram wed. wi garra dum gudbala ting langa olabat.
english: My little children, let's not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

kriol: afta tharran aibin brabli nogudbinji en brabli sik longtaim. brom deya aibin gidap en gobek en dum det wek blanga det king, bat aibin brabli wori blanga det drim en ai nomo bin sabi brabliwei.
english: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick for some days. Then I rose up and did the king's business. I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.

kriol: bat det klebabalamen neim elimas bin trai en stapam dubala, dumaji im nomo bin wandim det boswan blanga bilib langa det wed blanga god, en imbin trai en meigim det boswan libum det wed.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

kriol: wal wen ebsalom bin majurrumap ola isreil solja, imbin meigim amasa jidan bos blanga ola solja blanga deigim pleis blanga jowab, dumaji jowab bin go garram king deibid. wal det dedi blanga amasa bin neim jetha, en imbin brom det ishmeil traib, en det mami blanga amasa bin neim ebigeil, en imbin det doda blanga neihesh, en ebigeil sista seruwaiya bin det mami blanga jowab. wal ebsalom en im solja olabat bin krosim det jodan riba,
english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

kriol: ola gudwan ebrijing weya yubin gibit langa im garra jidan olagijawan. en im oldei jidan gudbinjiwei dumaji yu na oldei jidan garram im.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

kriol: bat modakai na bin sabi, en imbin dalim esta blanga jandim wed langa det king blanga det dubala men weya dubala bin meigimbat plen blanga kilim im. brom deya esta bin dalim king seksis. imbin tok, "modakai im na sabi wan nogudbala plen blanga kilim yu ded, en imbin dalim mi blanga jandim wed langa yu."
english: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai's name.

kriol: det namba blanga ola serramoni pleis wekinmen en ola wekinmen blanga salaman hubin kambek brom det kantri weya deibin jidan prisana bin 392.
english: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

kriol: langa det taim wen jehosafet bin jidan king blanga juda blanga 17 yiya, eihesaiya det san blanga eiheb bin jidan det nyuwan king blanga isreil deya langa sameriya dubala yiya.
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

kriol: ebran, reiyob, heiman en kana olawei raidap langa det taun gulum saidan.
english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

kriol: en yawei bin dalim yu blanga larramgo olabat weya dei garra weship langa im. bat yu nomo bin teiknodis langa yawei, en im garra kilim ded det feswan san blanga yu na.' lagijat na yu garra tok langa det king."
english: and I have said to you, "Let my son go, that he may serve me;" and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.'"

kriol: mi brabli gudbinji en mi jinginat brabli adbala, dumaji mi sabi yawei im main god. imbin seibum mi en gibit mi feyago. tharran im jis laik detlot klos weya mi oldei werrimbat. olabat mowa purdiwan langa detlot najalot purdiwan ting det gel o boi oldei werrimon wen dei redi blanga git merrit.
english: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

kriol: aibin oldei go garram yu ebriweya yubin oldei go, en mi na bin oldei bidim ola enami blanga yu wen yubin oldei go en fait langa olabat. en mi na garra meigim yu neim haibala jis laik ola haibala bos langa ola najalot kantri.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.

kriol: afta na sambala wekinmen bin ringimap tent ontop langa det haus blanga det king weya ebribodi gin luk, en deya na ebsalom bin deigim detlot wekingel blanga im dedi, en imbin silip garram olabat ful deitaim.
english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.
