kriol: "wal yu dalim yu kantrimen, mi na yawei, bin jandimwei yumob blanga jidan langa najawan kantri, en mi na bin spredimat yumob oloba langa difrinwan kantri. bat nomeda yumob kaan jidan langa yumob kantri, ai garra stil jidan garram yumob en yumob gin stil preisimbat mi.
english: "Therefore say, 'The Lord Yahweh says: "Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come."'

kriol: yu wotjimbat ola wekingel main weya dei kadimbat det gras garram ola sid daga, en deya na yu garra go en gajimbat ola sid daga yu wandim. en if yu wandim woda, wal yu go en dringgim deya langa detlot bigwan woda dram weya ola wekinmen bin bilimap. aibin dalim main wekinmen olabat nomo hambag langa yu."
english: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven't I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn."

kriol: wal wen aibin gobek deya na, aibin faindim det pleis weya aibin pudum det shot trasis. aibin luk det trasis bin breikinwan en im nomo bin gudwan.
english: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.

kriol: yu en ola pipul meigimbat miselp nokap lagijat. det wek im tumatj. yu kaan dumbat miselp.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

kriol: wal jona nomo bin wandi go deya, en im nomo bin duwit langa yawei. imbin trai ranawei brom im, en imbin go langa det najawan taun gulum jopa deya wansaid langa solwoda, en deya na imbin wandi gedim bout blanga go langa det longweiwan kantri gulum tashish blanga blandim miselp brom god. wal jona bin faindim wan bout deya redi blanga go langa det kantri, en imbin go en gibit mani langa det boswan blanga det bout blanga go garram olabat. brom deya jona bin gowin langa det bout garram detlot boutmen, en deibin gowei brom deya na,
english: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.

kriol: hesakaiya bin gudbinji langa detlot mesinja en imbin shoum olabat ola gudwan ebrijing blanga im, ol detlot silba en gol en gudsmelwan medisin en ola ebrijing blanga fait langa najalot pipul. imbin shoum olabat ebrijing na en imbin deigim en shoum olabat ebrijing ebriweya langa im stowa rum en langa im kantri.
english: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn't show them.

kriol: en deibin gedim detlot taun gulum gibiyan, rema, biroth,
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

kriol: en deibin deigimat det seikridwan stonwan drimin sheip blanga beil, en deibin barnimap. en deibin binijimap tharran en det seikridwan haus du, en olabat bin yusum det haus blanga go langa toilit en im stil jidan lagijat tudei.
english: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

kriol: wal king deibid bin jingat langa detlot serramonimen neim seidok en abaiyatha en det siksbala libai lida neim yuriyel, esaiya, jowal, shemaiya, eliyel en aminadeb.
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

kriol: wal ai wandim det olagijawan prais weya god garra gibit langa wi. det prais na det olagijawan laif. en blanga tharran na mi oldei wek adbala jis laik detlot pipul weya dei ran brabliwei langa reis, en mi oldei wek brabliwei jis laiga gud faita hu oldei fait gudbalawei.
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

kriol: deibin abum 30 rum langa graun, en 30 rum ontop langa olabat, en naja 30 rum bin ontop langa detlot najalot rum. deibin abum 90 rum olagija, en deibin joinap garram det wol langa det serramoni pleis, bat dei nomo bin go insaid langa det wol.
english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

kriol: wal god bin luk wanim detlot pipul bin dum, en imbin luk olabat bin libum olabat nogudbalawei, en imbin gudbinji langa olabat, en imbin jinggabat nomo blanga panishim olabat na.
english: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn't do it.

kriol: imbin askim mi "yu nomo sabi wanim olabat min?" en aibin ensim im, "yuwai bos, ai nomo sabi wanim olabat min."
english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, "Don't you know what these are?" I said, "No, my lord."

kriol: wal aisik bin askim im san, "yubin faindim dijan bif kwikbala, main boi." en jeikob bin tok, "yuwai. dumaji yawei weya yubin oldei bulurrum bin album mi faindim."
english: Isaac said to his son, "How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?" He said, "Because Yahweh your God gave me success."

kriol: en det wed blanga im nomo adwan blanga wi blanga dum, dumaji ebri biginini blanga god garram det pawa blanga bidim dijan wel. yumob sabi? wi garram det pawa, dumaji wi bilib langa jisas krais.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

kriol: wal mosis bin majurrumap ola isreil pipul en imbin tok langa olabat, "yumob bin luk wanim yawei bin dum langa det king deya langa ijip, en langa im wekinmen olabat, en langa im kantri du.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

kriol: ai nomo bin meigim olabat. mi nomo mami en dedi blanga olabat. wotfo yubin askim mi blanga dum diskain blanga maindimbat olabat, en garrimap olabat langa main bingga jis laik beibi olawei langa det kantri weya yubin pramis langa olabat grengrenfathamob?
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, 'Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers'?

garrimap ol detlot faiting giya blanga jowab, aira en gareb hubin brom det taun gulum jeitiya, yuraiya hubin brom det traib gulum hitait, seibad hubin san blanga alai, edina hubin san blanga shisa, en shama en jeiyel, det dubala san blanga hotham hubin brom det taun gulum eroya, jedaiyel en joha, det dubala san blanga shimri hubin brom det taun gulum tis, eliyel hubin brom det taun gulum mahaba, jeribai en joshabaiya, hubin det dubala san blanga elnam, ithama hubin brom det kantri gulum moweb, en eliyel, obed en jasiyel hubin brom det taun gulum soba.
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

kriol: bat detlot najalot men hubin go garram mi bin meigim ola pipul bradin blanga kaman langa dijan kantri. "wal mi, aibin oldei dum wanim yawei bin dalim mi blanga dum,
english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.

kriol: afta na hushai bin go en tok langa seidok en abaiyatha det dubala serramonimen, en imbin dalim dubala blanga det wed weya imbin tok langa ebsalom en detlot boswan isreil men, en imbin dalim dubala blanga det wed weya ahithafel bin dalim olabat du,
english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, "Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

kriol: "wal job, god na wandi bringimap yu brom yu trabul, en meigim yu jidan gudbalawei, en gibit yu detmatj gudwan daga du.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

kriol: imbin tenawei brom yawei det trubala god en imbin kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting, bat im nomo bin jidan nogudwan laik im dedi eiheb o im mami jesabel. imbin pulumdan det drimin sheip im dedi bin meigim blanga weship langa beil.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

kriol: "wal yumob jinggabat det buligi na weya det fama bin lenim im blanga wek. maitbi det buligi nomo laigim dumbat adwek, dumaji im oldei wandi dumbat det isiwan wek. wal det fama garra pudum det yok langa det buligi nek blanga meigim im dum adwek langa det gadin, en im meigim det buligi breigimap ola adwan graun en bastimap det graun blanga meigim sofwan. "wal ol yumob isreil pipul jidan jis laik det buligi na. aibin lenim yumob blanga bulurrum det wei blanga mi. bat yumob bin oldei wandi go yumob ronwei. wal ai garra meigim ad blanga yumob na, en ai garra meigim ad blanga ola juda pipul du.
english: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.

kriol: aibin testimbat yumob wen yumob bin abumbat adtaim, jis laik det silba wen dei meigim klinwan garram brabli hotwan faiya.
english: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok langa olabat na, "yumob garra wotjim miselp en nomo larram enibodi meigim yumob jinggabat najawei, dumaji loda men garra kaman en tok, 'mi na jisas krais. aibin kambek na.' en dei garra deigidawei bigmob pipul brom det trubalawei.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, "Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kriol: mi na, bin meigim im medwan wulijim im kaan sabi matj.
english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

kriol: aibin tok, "mi buldan", bat det filing blanga yu weya yu laigimbat pipul olataim bin lidimap mi.
english: When I said, "My foot is slipping!" Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

kriol: en dei garra kamat brom olabat greibyad. detlot pipul hubin oldei dumbat gudbala ting garra gidap laibala en jidan olagijawan. bat ol detlot pipul hubin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting garra gidap laibala en go langa det pleis weya god garra panishim olabat olagijawan." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

kriol: mi na dalimbat yumob, dumaji ebridei en ebrinait yumob oldei dumbat nogudbala ting. en ola speshalwan mesinja blanga mi dumbat nogudbala ting du jis laik yumob serramonimen dumbat. "wal dijan kantri isreil im yumob mami, en ai garra binijimap yumob mami.
english: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.

kriol: weya det medisin blanga giliyad? eni dokta deya? wotfo main pipul nomo bin gitbeda?"
english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn't the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

kriol: wal ishboseth nomo bin abum eni san. oni det wanbala san blanga im dedbala braja jonathan. det san bin neim mefibosheth, en imbin lilboi wen sol en jonathan bin dai. imbin 5 yiya ol, en wen det bednyus blanga sol en jonathan bin kaman brom det taun gulum jesriyel, det wekingel hubin oldei lukaftumbat det lilboi bin grebum im, en imbin ranawei kwikbala. bat det lilboi bin buldan, en imbin ardim miselp brabliwei, en imbin jidan kripulwan na.
english: Now Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

kriol: wal ol detlot najalot wekinmen hubin deya langa det teibul nomo bin sabi wotfo jisas bin tok lagijat langa judas.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

kriol: wal ebritaim wen deibin oldei go langa det seikridwan tent blanga yawei, pinina bin oldei meigim hena nogudbinji brabliwei, en hena bin oldei kraikrai, en im nomo bin wandi dagat eni daga na,
english: So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh's house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn't eat.

kriol: afta aibin lukap. wanim dijan? aibin luk dubala wuman flaiflai ontop kaminap langa mi en det win bin bringimap dubala. dubala bin abum strongbala wing jis laik detlot wing blanga bigwan bard. dubala bin gajim det baskit en dubala bin flaiwei.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

kriol: wal jowab en im soljamob bin go blanga fait langa detlot siriya solja na, en wen detlot siriya solja bin luk olabat kaminap blanga fait, streidawei deibin ol ranawei.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

kriol: en midulnait dijan gel bin gidap, imbin gajim main beibi brom mi en deigim im langa im sweig en imbin pudum im dedwan beibi langa main sweig wen aibin silip.
english: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

kriol: afta na sambala pipul bin bringimap wan men langa jisas. det men bin abum dibuldibul insaid langa im, en det dibuldibul bin meigim det men blainwan, en im nomo bin larram im tok du. wal jisas bin andimwei det dibuldibul brom det men, en afta det men bin luk, en imbin tok gudwei na,
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you."

english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar "A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God."

english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God will bless you in all that you do.

english: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for Yahweh will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

english: The man said, "The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it."

english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

kriol: en wen yumob gowin langa enibodi haus, yumob garra jis tok, 'god im gud langa yumob.'
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

kriol: "wal oni mi na bin growimap olabat en meigim olabat jandap strongbala. aibin oldei nesimbat olabat en lukaftumbat olabat. bat olabat nomo jinggabat mi weya aibin growimap olabat.
english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn't know that I healed them.

english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

english: "Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

kriol: wal bigmob pipul bin bilib langa jisas wen deibin irrim det gel weya imbin tok, "det men bin dalim mi ebrijing weya aibin dumbat." en deibin go langa jisas deya langa det wel.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

kriol: "det san en mun kaan jidan enimo blanga gibit yu lait. mi na yawei garra jidan det lait blanga yu, en main lait garra shain mowa braitwan langa det mun en san. main brabli shainiwan lait garra shain langa yu.
english: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

kriol: god, yu stakmen blanga ola isreil pipul. yu irrim melabat. yu na det boswan blanga yu ron pipul olabat. yu jidan langa yu speshalwan tjeya deya langa midul langa det dubala golwan sheip garram wing.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lilies of the Covenant." A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

kriol: en brom deya yumob garra libum detlot drimin sheip weya yumob bin meigim brom silba en gol, dumaji olabat rabishwan. en yumob garra tjakidawei detlot ting, jis laik wen yumob oldei tjakidawei det brabli dardiwan reig.
english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, "Go away!"

kriol: ebribodi sabi wi garra ol dai wulijim woda weya wi spilim langa graun. nobodi kaan bringimbek det woda. bat god nomo wandim enibodi hubin ranawei brom im blanga dai. god wandi bringimbek im langa im. en yu du gin faindim wei blanga bringimbek yu san brom det pleis weya imbin ranawei.
english: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can't be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

kriol: en det dubala wekinmen bin go en yusum det mani blanga meigim mowa mani. det wekinmen garram $5,000 bin meigim naja $5,000, en det wekinmen garram $2,000 bin meigim naja $2,000.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?"

english: For "the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you," just as it is written.

kriol: "en ol detlot najalot speshalwan mesinja brom semyul raidap tudei bin tok dijan ting garra hepin lagijat du.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

kriol: wal detlot bos brom ola kantri hubin joinin langa ola nogudbala ting langa bebalon, wen dei garra luk det smok kamat brom det taun weya im barnbarn, dei garra kraikrai blanga det pleis.
english: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

kriol: ol detlot men hubin deya garram mi bin luk det lait. bat dei nomo bin irrim det sambodi hubin tok langa mi.
english: "Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn't understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

kriol: lagijat na det gel bin tok langa im dedi, en afta imbin tok, "dedi, ai garra askim yu samting. yu nomo kilim mi streidawei. yu larram mi jidan garram main fren olabat langa det hil kantri fo 2 mants basdam. deya na ai garra sori miselp, dumaji ai garra dai nomo garram eni biginini."
english: Then she said to her father, "Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions."

kriol: 'ebri 7 yiya yumob isreil pipul garra larramgo fri eni isreil wekinmen o wekingel hu jidan laiga prisana hubin wek blanga yumob blanga 6 yiya.' bat blanga yumob grengrenfathamob dei nomo bin oldei teiknodis en irrim langa mi wen aibin oldei tok langa olabat.
english: At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years. You shall let him go free from you. But your fathers didn't listen to me, and didn't incline their ear.

kriol: wal beraiya en shema, dubala bin jidan bos blanga ol detlot femili hubin jidan langa det taun gulum aijalan, en deibin andimwei detlot pipul hubin jidan langa geth. en detlot san blanga beraiya bin ahiyo, shashak, jeramath, sebadaiya, erad, ida, maikul, ishpa en joha.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers' households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

kriol: en deibin gibit det mani langa detlot speshalwan mishanri, en detlot speshalwan mishanri bin oldei sherimat det mani langa detlot biliba hu nomo bin abum enijing.
english: and laid them at the apostles' feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

kriol: yubin breigim yu strongwan pramis garram yu wekinmen, en yubin tjakamdan im speshalwan het langa graun.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

kriol: brom deya mosis bin majurrumap ola isreil pipul, en imbin dalim olabat, "yawei det trubala god bin dalim mi blanga dalim yumob imbin gibit yumob 6 dei blanga dum yumob wek,
english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, "These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.

kriol: brom detlot twelbala men oni joshuwa en keilab bin jidan laibala.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

kriol: seimwei du garram pipul. maitbi wanbala men jidan laibala moningtaim, en im dai naitaim. en nobodi nomo sabi im enimo.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

kriol: wal im dalim wi blanga libum det nogudbalawei weya wibin oldei jidanbat. wi garra stap jinggabat ebrijing langa dijan wel, en wi garra jinggabat wanwei, en wi garra dumbat ola gudbala ting. tudei na wi garra jidan gudwan seimwei laik god.
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

kriol: "wal langa det dei na yawei garra sheikimap dijan wel brom det yufreitis riba raidap langa det boda blanga ijip, en im garra bringimap ol im pipul olabat mijamet.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

kriol: pipul bin abum trabul bifo. deibin abum trabul brom det taim wen god bin meigim ebrijing raidap tudei, en dei garra kipgon abumbat trabul olawei. bat nomo seimwei laik dijan trabul weya mi tokinabat. dijan im garra jidan brabli weswan trabul.
english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

kriol: en blanga tharran na wi kaan jidan garram nogudbala filing blanga enibodi en dumbat olkain nogudbala ting. wi garra jidan gudbalawei insaidwei en trubalawei atsaidwei.
english: Therefore let's keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

kriol: yuriyel bin det boswan blanga kohath femili en det namba blanga detlot pipul hubin kaman bin 120.
english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

kriol: wal ishmeil det san blanga nethanaiya, en johanan det san blanga kariya, en seraiya det san blanga tanumeth, en detlot san blanga ifai brom det kantri gulum netofa, en jesanaiya brom det kantri gulum meiyaka, deibin go garram olabat men langa gedalaiya langa mispa.
english: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.

kriol: meigim olabat buldan langa olabat ron trep weya olabat bin pudum, en seimtaim album mi blanga gidawei seifwan.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

kriol: detlot nogudbala pipul garra abum brabli adtaim, bat yawei im oldei kipgon laigimbat detlot pipul hu trastim im.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

kriol: afta na rabeka bin go, en imbin tok langa aisik, "det dubala waif blanga isau brom detlot hitait pipul bin meigim mi brabli nogudbinji. en if jeikob wandi merrit langa hitait gel, wal mobeda mi garra dai."
english: Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?"

kriol: en ol detlot pipul deya bin tridim melabat gudbalawei, en deibin meigim faiya blanga melabat blanga womim miselp, dumaji melabat bin kolbala brom det rein.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

kriol: en aibin pikimat en pudum ol dislot kantri langa det pawa blanga main wekinmen king nebakanesa brom bebalon, en aibin meigim detlot wailwan enimul wek blanga im du.
english: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.

kriol: wal wen aibin luk langa dijan wel, ola pipul bin jidan brabli nogudbinjiwei, dumaji ola boswan en ritjwan pipul nomo bin gibit olabat feyago. en aibin luk detlot pipul bin oldei kraikraibat en nobodi bin deya blanga album olabat. dumaji detlot boswan en ritjwan pipul bin abum loda pawa, en deibin yusumbat det pawa rongwei.
english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

kriol: wal wen pol bin irrim wanim bin hepin langa dubala, imbin wandi go en tok langa detlot pipul. bat ola bilibamob nomo bin larram im go,
english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn't allow him.

kriol: wal det olmen bin kamat atsaid langa olabat, en imbin tok, "main fren olabat, yumob kaan dum det brabli nogudbala ting langa det men lagijat. imbin kaman langa mi, en ai garra lukaftum im.
english: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, "No, my brothers, please don't act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don't do this folly.

kriol: main pramis, aibin kaman langa main gadin na. mi gajimbat lilbit gudsmelwan medisin. mi dagadagatbat main switwan shugabeig. mi dringgimbat main wain en milk. yunmi laigim gija. yu gin dagadagatbat en dringgimbat raidap yu brabli bulap, dumaji yunmi laigim gija detmatj.
english: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Friends Eat, friends! Drink, yes, drink abundantly, beloved.

kriol: en afta yu jingat langa ola pipul blanga kaman iya." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting."

kriol: yawei bin gitwail langa eran du en imbin wandi kilim im, bat dumaji aibin prei blanga eran streidawei.
english: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

kriol: wen enibodi nomo tok trubalawei im meigim trabul, bat wen enibodi toktokbat trubala wed streidat, wal im meigim ebrijing wek gudwei.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

kriol: brom deya wen olabat bin binij dagadagat sapa, jisas bin gajim wanbala kap garram wain, en imbin pasimran det wain langa olabat, en imbin tok, "dijan wain det nyubalawei blanga god. ai garra spilim main ronwan blad blanga yumob blanga opinimap det nyubalawei blanga god.
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

kriol: ai nomo dum seimwei laik mosis bin dum. imbin gaburrumap miselp feis garram heinggitjif wulijim detlot isreil pipul kaan luk det lait goweigowei.
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn't look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

kriol: dumaji ebridei ai sabi ai nomo jidan giltiwan.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

kriol: dei oldei jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbala ting. dei oldei meigimap trabul.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

kriol: en maika bin askim im, "brom weya yubin kaman?" en imbin tok, "mi brom libai klen, en aibin kaman brom bethlahem deya langa juda, en mi lukabat pleis blanga jidan."
english: Micah said to him, "Where did you come from?" He said to him, "I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live."

kriol: en if king deibid trai en ranawei en blandim miselp langa eni taun, wal wi pipul olabat garra bajimap loda roup, en garram detlot roup wi garra pulumdan ola haus en tjakidawei ola ston raidap wi faindim im. nomo eni ston garra jandap ontop langa det hil. najing." lagijat na hushai bin tok, dumaji imbin wandi gibit deibid taim blanga gidawei.
english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn't one small stone found there."

kriol: "wal mi askimbat yu na. yu larramgo mi fri brom dis nogudbala ting weya aibin dumbat, en yu garra kaman garra mi langa det serramoni pleis wulijim ai garra weship langa yawei."
english: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahweh."

kriol: en if yu faindim det kap iya langa melabat, wal yu gin kilim ded det men hubin stilim det kap, en melabat najalot lafta jidan prisana en dumbat ola adwek blanga yu."
english: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord's slaves."

english: "'This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

english: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, "Joseph's brothers have come." It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

kriol: en det nyubala serramoni pleis blanga mi garra jidan mowa gudwan langa det olwan, en deya na ai garra meigim main pipul olabat jidan brabli gudwei." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: 'The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,' says Yahweh of Armies; 'and in this place I will give peace,' says Yahweh of Armies."

kriol: en yubin kambek en dagat daga en dringgim woda langa dijan pleis weya imbin dalim yu nomo blanga dagat enijing. dumaji yubin dum lagijat, wal yu garra gitkil en yu bodi kaan berrap deya wansaid langa yu femilimob greib." lagijat na det olbala mesinja bin tok.
english: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, "Eat no bread, and drink no water," your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.'"

kriol: mi na bin pikimat eibrahem blanga shoumbat ola biginini blanga im en ola pipul blanga im hau blanga lisin langa mi en dumbat rait ting en jidan gudbalawei. en if olabat lisin langa mi, wal ai garra dum ebrijing blanga olabat weya aibin pramis langa olabat." lagijat na god bin tok miselp.
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him."

kriol: wal jisas bin kipgon tok, "wal aibin dalim yumob tharran wulijim yumob kaan tenawei brom mi weya yumob bilib langa mi, dumaji dei garra andimwei yumob brom ola juwish miting pleis,
english: "I have said these things to you so that you wouldn't be caused to stumble.

kriol: det bigwan naif garram faiya blanga yawei garra gibit ebribodi feyago ebriweya langa dijan wel en im garra binijimap ol detlot pipul weya imbin faindim giltiwan.
english: For Yahweh will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by Yahweh will be many.

kriol: im garra trai ranimap im boifren olabat. bat im kaan gajimap olabat. im garra lukabat olabat. bat im kaan faindim olabat. en afta det gel garra tok, 'ai garra gobek langa main ronwan hasbin, dumaji aibin abum ebrijing wanim aibin wandim wen aibin jidan garram im.' lagijat na det gel garra tok.
english: She will follow after her lovers, but she won't overtake them; and she will seek them, but won't find them. Then she will say, 'I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.'

kriol: en im garra pudum sambala blad langa shapwan pat langa det fobala kona langa det teibul blanga ofring weya dei barnimbat det gudsmelwan medisin langa det seikridwan tent. en im garra pudum det najalot blad langa det bodamwei langa det teibul blanga barnapwan sekrifais ofring deya gulijap langa det dowawei langa det seikridwan tent.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kriol: yawei, ai garra preisim yu brabliwei insaid langa main hat. ai garra dalimbat blanga ola gudwan ebrijing weya yubin dumbat.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to "The Death of the Son." A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

kriol: jerusalem bin tok na, "yawei det trubala god bin rait, dumaji aibin gibit bekboun langa im en mi nomo bin dum wanim imbin wandim mi blanga dum. yumob pipul ebriweya, yumob irrim mi basdam. mi jidanbat brabli soribala detmatj. main enamimob bin deigidawei prisana ol main boi en gel.
english: "Yahweh is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.

kriol: brom deya detlot 24 olmen hubin jidan langa olabat speshalwan tjeya bin ol tjakam miselp langa graun lida langa god, en deibin tok gudwei langa im.
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God's throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

kriol: wal king josaiya bin wandim ola pipul blanga bulurrum ola lowa langa det buk det hilkaiya det haibala serramonimen bin faindim langa det serramoni pleis. wulijim king josaiya bin andimwei ola pipul hubin oldei toktok laiyawei blanga wanim garra hepin bambai. en imbin bitsimap ola drimin sheip en ola stonwan sheip weya deibin weshipbat deya langa juda en jerusalem.
english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in Yahweh's house.

kriol: en wen melabat bin deya garram yumob, melabat bin oldei tok, "if enibodi nomo wek, wal im kaan abum eni daga."
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: "If anyone is not willing to work, don't let him eat."

kriol: "wal god bin jandim jisas, en im oldei dalimbat det wed blanga god, dumaji god bin gibit im det holi spirit blanga im brabliwei.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

kriol: dislot na detlot neim blanga detlot blijiman blanga det serramoni pleis hubin oldei wotjim ola haus weya deibin kipum ola daga langa detlot geit blanga det serramoni pleis. deibin metanaiya, bekbakaiya, obadaiya, meshalam, talman en eikab.
english: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.

kriol: en blanga tharran na mi oldei shoum ebribodi mi jidan wekinmen blanga god.
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

kriol: dumaji mosis bin bilib, wal imbin gowei brom det kantri, en im nomo bin bradin blanga det king, en imbin jandap strongbala, dumaji imbin sabi det boswan weya nobodi kaan luk.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

kriol: im nogud blanga enibodi if im hipimapbat detmatj enijing blanga imselp iya langa dijan kantri, en im lujim im laif, dumaji wen im lujim im laif, im kaan yusum detlot enijing blanga gedimbek im laif.
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kriol: wal banabas bin wandim deigim det yangmen neim jon mak garram dubala.
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

kriol: "wal ai garra tok na langa yumob hu garra lisin langa mi. yu garra laigim ola bedfren blanga yu, en yu garra dum gudbala ting langa detlot pipul hu heidim yu,
english: "But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

kriol: wal mosis bin dalim det najawan wed na langa detlot lida blanga ola isreil pipul.
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, "This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

kriol: wal jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin jidan langa det lilwan taun gulum bethani langa det haus blanga det men neim saiman lepa,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

kriol: afta na semyul bin deigim sol en im wekinmen langa det haus weya dei oldei dagat det serramoni daga. deibin abum 30 pipul deya hu garra dagat det daga, en semyul bin meigim sol en im wekinmen jidan langa det speshalwan pleis lida langa ol detlot pipul,
english: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.

kriol: en im garra pudum wanbala bingga blanga im raidensaid bingga langa det oliboil, en tjakambat 7 taim deya langa det seikridwan pleis.
english: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Yahweh.

kriol: det king bin tok, "yumob garra meigim ola isreil wekinmen wek mowa adbala, dumaji dei nomo dumbat naf wek, en dei askimbat mi blanga larramgo olabat blanga abum det serramoni blanga olabat god. if dei dumbat loda wek, wal dei kaan abum taim blanga lisin langa detlot stori weya det dubala dalimbat olabat. wal yumob garra meigim olabat adwek mowa weya dei meigimbat ola brik. yumob sabi? yumob kaan gibit olabat detlot speshalwan gras blanga meigim detlot brik. dei garra go en lukabat detlot gras olabat selp, en wen dei meigim detlot brik, dei garra stil gajimap det seim namba weya deibin meigim basdam. yumob kaan tjeinjim det namba." lagijat na det king bin tok.
english: "You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

kriol: wal dei garra lafta pulumdan det haus en tjakidawei ol detlot ston, en wud, en ol detlot klei, en dei garra lafta garrimap en pudum langa naja pleis weya nomo klinbala blanga serramoni atsaid brom det taun.
english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house's mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

kriol: wal god bin pikimat mi blanga jidan speshalwan mishanri en blanga dalimbat det gudnyus en blanga titjimbat ola pipul det trubalawan wed blanga jisas krais,
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

kriol: yumob na bin medrimbat loda pipul iya langa dijan taun en ola strit bulap garram ola dedbala pipul na.
english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain."

kriol: bat ola ritjwan pipul oldei trastimbat olabat ebrijing blanga kipum olabat seifwan, en olabat reken detlot ebrijing jidan jis laik haiwan wol langa bigwan taun.
english: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

kriol: meigim im laif binijap, en larram najamen teikoba det wek blanga im.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

kriol: "wal ola pipul hu tok lagijat nomo sabi brabliwei. bat ol detlot pipul hu bilib langa god sabi im klebabala, en dei sabi det wei blanga god im trubala." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children."

kriol: "wal yawei bin meigim detlot lida blanga ijip nomo sabi enijing, en blanga tharran na detlot lida nomo sabi wanim blanga dum blanga album olabat kantri. olabat jis laik det drangginbala wen im wok en buldan langa im ronwan baku.
english: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

kriol: dumaji im sabi wotkain olabat, im binijimap olabat naitaim.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

kriol: bat yu nomo bin peiyimbek melabat blanga melabat nogudbalawei, wulijim melabat gin shoum rispek langa yu.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

kriol: bat langa det namba 7 dei gulum sebathdei im speshalwan dei blanga main. nobodi nomo lau blanga dum wek langa det dei, nomo yumob o yumob biginini olabat, o yumob wekinmen en wekingel hu jidan laiga prisana o yumob enimul o pipul weya dei jidan streinja langa yumob kantri. blanga ol yumob wekinmen en wekingel hu jidan laiga prisana, dei garra abum spel du jis laik yumob.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

kriol: deya na langa det wanbala pleis yumob garra jidan gudbinjiwei garram im mijamet garram yumob bigininimob en ola pipul weya wek blanga yumob, en detlot pipul brom det libai klen weya dei jidan langa yumob taun. yumob sabi blanga detlot pipul brom det libai klen dei kaan abum eni kantri.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

kriol: wal olabat garra dumbat det wek na blanga yu langa tent, bat olabat nomo lau tatjim eni seikridwan ting langa det seikridwan pleis o det teibul blanga ofring. if olabat dum enijing deya, wal yumob mijamet garra dai.
english: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

kriol: detlot nogudbala pipul oldei lisinbat langa ola nogudwan ting weya nogudbala pipul tokabat, en ola laiyinbala pipul oldei teiknodis langa ola laiyawan wed.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

kriol: wal galaiyath bin oldei jandapbat deya en jinginatbat langa detlot isreil solja, "wotfo yumob oldei jandap deya meigimbat miselp redi blanga fait? yumob luk mi? mi filastain solja. bat yumob nomo solja. yumob jis wekinmen blanga king sol. wal yumob pikimat wanbala men blanga fait langa mi.
english: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, "Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.

kriol: yumob oni jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbala ting, en kilimbat pipul ebriweya langa dijan kantri.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

kriol: imbin dum lagijat dumaji detlot isreil pipul nomo bin abum king blanga lidimbat olabat, en deibin oldei dumbat enijing weya deibin wandi dum.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

kriol: "dislot lowa na im blanga det peiyimbek ofring, en im seim laik det ofring blanga nogudbalawei. detlot bif im blanga det serramonimen hubin dumbat det sekrifais.
english: "'As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

kriol: main olgamen, yu luk brabli purdiwan laik jerusalem, en laik det bigbala taun gulum taisa. langa mi yu luk brabli purdiwan.
english: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.

kriol: "bat melabat nomo bin gibit bekboun langa yawei. ola bigininimob blanga eran jidan serramonimen blanga melabat, en detlot libai pipul album olabat.
english: "But as for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

kriol: wotfo melabat garra go deya? melabat bradin du, dumaji detlot men weya deibin go blanga lukaran det kantri bin dalim melabat ola pipul deya dei brabli strongbala en dei brabli longwan, en dei gin bidim melabat, en olabat jidan langa ola bigwan taun garram brabli haibalawan wol raidaran langa olabat. en brabli bigwan jaiyant bin jidan deya du.'
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, 'The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!'"

kriol: ol yumob juda pipul yumob luk na. deya ontop langa det haibala hil yumob gin luk det mesinja kaminap garram det gudnyus. im kaman na garram det gudnyus weya god garra meigim wi jidan gudwei. wal ol yumob gin abum detlot serramoni blanga yumob na, en yumob garra gibit god ola enijing weya yumob bin pramisim blanga gibit im, en ol detlot nogudbala pipul kaan teikoba det kantri blanga yumob igin, dumaji god bin binijimap olabat brabliwei.
english: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

kriol: det boda blanga olabat kantri bin stat brom sauthsaid langa det solwoda gulum dedsi,
english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "yumob garra gibitbek langa sisa detlot enijing blanga im, en yumob garra gibitbek langa god detlot enijing blanga im du."
english: He said to them, "Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."

kriol: bambai na ai kaan wail langa yumob enimo. ai garra panishim detlot pipul hubin deigimoba langa yumob.
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction."

kriol: "en ai meigim dijan pramis du. ai kaan neba fogedabat yumob en ol detlot biginini weya garra kaman bambai, jis laik det nyubala hebin en nyubala graun weya ai garra meigim, garra jidan olagijawan.
english: "For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me," says Yahweh, "so your offspring and your name shall remain.

kriol: if yu jidan powan, yu ronwan femili olabat nomo laigim yu en yu nomo abum eni fren. nomeda yu trai blanga meigim fren bat olabat ol gowei brom yu.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

kriol: en wen mi shoum olabat god im haibala, god garra shoum olabat mi na haibala garram im. en tudei na im garra dum.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

kriol: wal wan olgamen deya langa det taun bin klebabala langa im main, en imbin galimap ontop langa det wol, en imbin jingat langa detlot solja, "yumob irrim na. yumob dalim jowab blanga kaman iya, dumaji ai wandi tok langa im."
english: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, "Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, 'Come near here, that I may speak with you.'"

kriol: bat if eni speshalwan mesinja im reken miselp en im tok, "yawei bin dalim mi blanga dalim yumob blanga dijan wed," bat imbin tok laiyawan langa yumob, wal blanga tharran na, yumob garra kilim im ded. en seimwei du eni speshalwan mesinja garra dai wen im tok, "detlot drimin bin dalim mi blanga tok dislot wed." ' lagijat na yawei bin tok."
english: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die."

kriol: o maitbi im nomo bin luk weya imbin tjakam ston, en imbin kilim sambodi ded en im nomo bin wandim kilim im en im nomo bin im enami.
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

kriol: if yu kaman garram melabat, wal melabat garra sherimat langa yu ola gudbala ting weya yawei oldei gibitbat langa melabat."
english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you."

kriol: en det serramonimen garra pudum im bingga insaid langa det blad blanga det nenigout, en im garra rabum langa det shapwan pat langa det fobala kona langa det teibul blanga ofring, en im garra pudum ol det najalot blad langa det bodamwei blanga det teibul blanga ofring.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

kriol: wal wan sikbala men bin kaman langa jisas, dumaji im leig en bingga bin swelap,
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

kriol: blanga tharran na ai kaan kipum enijing blanga miselp. oni detlot ting weya main solja olabat bin yusumbat. bat yu garra larram main thribala meit neim eina, eshkol en memrei deigim haf." lagijat na eibram bin tok.
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion."

kriol: yawei, ai trastim langa yu. yu na main god.
english: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, "You are my God."

kriol: imbin pudum langa det serramoni pleis blanga yawei ola silba en gol enijing weya im en im dedi bin gibitbat langa im.
english: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God's house.

kriol: oni wan ting blanga yumob. yumob garra jidan prisana o yumob garra dai. wal yawei im stil wail langa yumob en im garra kipgon panishimbat yumob." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kriol: wal det seim dei deibin kilim 10,000 moweb solja ded. detlot moweb solja bin ol brabli gud faita. bat nomo eni solja bin gidawei laibala,
english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

kriol: wal yawei bin oldei jidan garram im en imbin oldei dum ebrijing raitwei. det king blanga asiriya bin bos oba langa king hesakaiya en det kantri juda, bat bambai king hesakaiya nomo bin wandi lisin en teiknodis langa det king brom asiriya, en im nomo bin wandi jidan wekinmen blanga im du.
english: Yahweh was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn't serve him.

kriol: det najawan san blanga jeikob neim libai bin abum thribala san neim geshan, kohath en merarai. brom detlot thribala boi, thribala femili lain bin kamat garram olabat neim. libai bin jidan longtaim en imbin gajimap 137 yiya.
english: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.

kriol: "wal yumob lafta stap toktokbat jigibalawei langa mi, bambai yumob abum mowa trabul. aibin irrim yawei det boswan god tok strongbalawei blanga binijimap ol dijan kantri."
english: Now therefore don't be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, on the whole earth.

kriol: wi garra preisim god blanga ol detlot sigridwan ting im oldei dumbat, en wi garra preisim detlot king hu sabi wanim det sigridwan ting min.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

kriol: imbin gowap langa det haibalawan hil gulum saiyan, en imbin deigim loda prisana garram im du. ola pipul bin gibit im gudwan ting, en detlot nogudbala pipul hubin gibit bekboun langa im bin gibit im gudwan ting du. yawei det trubala god garra jidan deya na.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

kriol: nomo enibodi garra jidan langa bebalon. detlot wokabatbala pipul kaan jidan deya, en ol detlot hu oldei maindimbat ola ship kaan larram olabat shipmob abum spel deya du.
english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

kriol: bat det wekinmen bin buldan lida langa det king, en imbin askim im, 'yu gibit mi taim, en ai garra peiyimbek det mani!'
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, 'Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!'

kriol: wal wotfo yumob wandi testimbat god? yumob wandim detlot jintail pipul blanga duwit langa ola lowa blanga mosis. bat ol wi juwish pipul nomo bin duwit langa det lowa.
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

kriol: yu na det god hu heidim nogudbala ting, en nogudbala pipul kaan jidan garram yu.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can't live with you.

kriol: en wen jisas bin kamat deya, imbin luk det men leidanbat deya, en imbin sabi imbin kripulwan longtaim, en imbin askim im, "yu wandi jidan gudbala?"
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to be made well?"

kriol: mi jidan giltiwan en im gaburrumap mi brabliwei, jis laik fladwoda. im tumatj blanga mi blanga hendulum. im jis laik det hebiwan loud weya mi garrimap.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

kriol: wal wen king deibid bin irrim det wed, imbin dalim det mesinja, "yu garra gobek en meigim jowab gudbinji, en yu garra dalim im nomo blanga wori, dumaji nobodi kaan sabi hu garra dai langa eni fait. en yu garra dalim im blanga fait brabli adbalawei en bidim detlot pipul deya langa det taun."
english: Then David said to the messenger, "Tell Joab, 'Don't let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.' Encourage him."

kriol: "brom deya ola emarait pipul hubin jidan langa det hil kantri bin kamat langa yumob detmatj na, jis laik bigmob honet weya ranimap yumob. deibin andimwei yumob raidap langa det kantri gulum homa en deibin bidim yumob deya langa det hil kantri blanga idam.
english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

kriol: en deibid bin kamat atsaid brom det keib biyain langa king sol, en imbin jingat langa king sol, "bos!" wal king sol bin tenaran, en deibid bin baudan langa graun blanga shoum rispek langa im,
english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

kriol: en wen yumob wandim det ting en yumob nomo gedim, wal yumob go en medrimbat enibodi blanga det ting. en wen yumob wandi pulumat samting brom enibodi en im kaan gibit yumob, wal yumob stat agamin en fait na. wal yumob kaan gedim enijing yumob wandim, dumaji yumob nomo askim god blanga det ting.
english: You lust, and don't have. You murder and covet, and can't obtain. You fight and make war. You don't have, because you don't ask.

kriol: wal det taim na ol detlot pipul langa ebri kantri bin ol nogudbala, en dei nomo bin stap faidabat oldei. wal god bin lukinat olabat, en imbin luk ol detlot ting weya deibin oldei dumbat bin brabli nogud, dumaji olabat bin meigim ola kantri ebriweya nogudwan.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

kriol: "wal bigismob grashopa bin kaman langa wi kantri, en deibin binijimap ola gadin blanga wi. en afta bigmob bigwan grashopa bin kaman langa wi kantri, en deibin dagadagat ola enijing weya detlot feswan grashopa bin libum. en afta bigmob lilwan grashopa bin kaman langa wi kantri, en deibin dagadagat ola enijing weya detlot bigwan grashopa bin libum. en afta najalot grashopa bin kaman langa wi kantri, en deibin binijimap ola enijing weya detlot lilwan grashopa bin libum.
english: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.

kriol: wal loda kristjan pipul nomo sabi oni wanbala trubala god jidan, dumaji deibin bulurrumbat ol detlot najalot drimin longtaim, en olabat jidan wikwan, dumaji det filing blanga olabat nomo sabi brabliwei wanim rait en wanim rong, en wen dei dagat eni bif weya enibodi bin yusum langa serramoni, wal dei reken det bif im blanga detlot drimin, en dei reken im nomo rait blanga olabat blanga dagat det bif. bat stil dei dagat det bif, en im meigim olabat nogud, dumaji dei dum wanim dei reken im nomo rait blanga olabat blanga dum.
english: However, that knowledge isn't in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

kriol: afta na det king bin meigim nyuwan lowa. imbin tok, "if enibodi hambag langa aisik en rabeka, wal wi garra kilim det sambodi ded."
english: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, "He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death."

kriol: wal wanmo jisas bin pudum im bingga langa det blain men ai, en wen det men bin opinim im ai imbin luk gudwei na.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

kriol: bat god garra shudum olabat garram ol im erro, en streidawei olabat garra gitkil.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

kriol: olabat mami bin libum im hasbin, en imbin gajim najalot men blanga silipsilipbat garram im. det gel bin tok, 'ai garra go en lukabat main boifren olabat, en dei garra gibit mi daga en woda, en dei garra gibit mi sambala wul en gudwan matiriyal, en dei garra gibit mi oil en wain du.' lagijat na det gel bin tok.
english: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, 'I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.'

kriol: yubin seibum mi wen aibin gulijap dai, en yu nomo bin larram mi buldan, wulijim ai garra oldei wok garram yu langa yu lait.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

kriol: en mi tok gudei langa main gudfren empiliyatas hu oldei bulurrum jisas krais det bos blanga wi brabliwei.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

kriol: wal detlot isreil solja bin go en blandim sambala solja raidaran langa gibiya,
english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

kriol: wen god det brabli boswan bin andimwei ola king langa det bigwan hil gulum seilman, imbin meigim sno buldan deya.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

kriol: brom deya detlot pipul hubin jidan langa det kantri bin trai meigim detlot juwish pipul nogudbinji en bradin blanga bildimap det serramoni pleis.
english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

kriol: wi sabi wen det rait taim garra kaman, god garra joinimap ebrijing weya imbin meigim langa dijan wel en langa hebin, en jisas krais na garra jidan boswan blanga olabat.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

kriol: yumob kaan plentimbat eni sid daga, o kadimat en kipumbat det sid daga weya im gro miselp, o gajimbat detlot greip daga weya bin gro langa detlot tri yumob nomo bin lukaftumbat.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

kriol: wal det holi spirit bin kaman, en imbin jidan garram det spirit blanga wi, en dubala shoum wi, wi jidan biginini blanga god.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

kriol: raidap langa det dei wen ai garra dai, ai kaan dum eni rong ting en ai kaan tok yumob rait,
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

kriol: en aibin wandi faindat wotfo detlot pipul bin wandi kilim im. wal aibin jandim im langa detlot juwish bosmen,
english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

kriol: ai garra stil kilim yumob if yumob nomo dalim mi det drim. yumob kipgon agri gija blanga dalimbat mi laiyawan wed, dumaji seimtaim yumob reken ai garra tjeinjim main wed. wal yumob garra dalim mi wanim det drim na, en ai garra sabi yumob gin dalim mi wanim im min du." lagijat na det king bin tok.
english: But if you don't make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation."

kriol: wal job bin kipgon tok, "wotfo ai nomo bin dai wen aibin bon?
english: "Why didn't I die from the womb? Why didn't I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

kriol: yu garra dalim ola isreil pipul det speshalwan oil im blanga mi, en im seikridwan olagija.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

kriol: imbin deigim olabat langa streitwan roud langa det bigwan taun blanga jidan.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

kriol: yu na jeramaiya, yu garra testimbat main pipul olabat, jis laik wen yu testimbat det aiyan, en yu garra faindat wotkain detlot pipul.
english: "I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.

kriol: ai dum ola raitwan ting, en mi trastim yu. wal yu meigim mi jidan laibalawan.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

kriol: en im redi blanga kaman jis laiga fama wen im kadimat ola gudwan daga brom det nogudwan pat. im garra hipimap ola gudwan, en im garra barnimap ola nogudwan langa det olagijawan faiya." lagijat na jon beptis bin tok langa detlot serramonimen.
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire."

kriol: ola gudbala pipul oldei sabi toktok blanga olkain gudbala wed, bat detlot nogudbala pipul oldei toktok ola wed blanga ardimbat pipul.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

kriol: en det kaliko garra jidan 6.6 mita longwei tusaid langa det geit garram thribala pol ontop langa thribala pleit.
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
