english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven't you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

kriol: "wal ola serramonimen kaan neba sheibum olabat hed, en dei kaan larram olabat heya gro brabli longwan, bat dei garra kadim olabat heya brabli gudwei.
english: "'"They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

kriol: oldei ai garra tokabat blanga det raitwei blanga yu, dumaji ol detlot hubin wandim trai kilim mi, dei nomo bin win en dei jidan brabli sheim na.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

kriol: oni yu gin tok mi nomo gilti, dumaji oni yu gin luk wanim trubala.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

kriol: bambai na king herod bin irrim nyus weya detlot klebabalamen hubin kaman brom det kantri sanraiswei bin gobek najawei langa olabat ron kantri. imbin gitwail brabliwei, dumaji dei nomo bin kambek langa im. wal det king bin jinggabat wotaim detlot klebabalamen bin luk det sta, en imbin dalim ola wekinmen blanga im blanga go langa bethlahem en langa ola kemp wansaid langa det taun, en kilim ded ola lilwan boiwan beibi hubin bon afta wen det sta bin kamat. brom deya detlot wekinmen bin go, en deibin kilim ded ol detlot lilboi brom beibiwan raidap langa 2 yiya ol.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

kriol: aibin tok, "bambai na det bigwan hil weya det serramoni pleis blanga yawei oldei jidan garra jidan mowa haibala. im garra jidan mowa haibala langa ola najalot hil. ola pipul brom najalot kantri garra kaman langa det hil,
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh's house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

kriol: "wal if dei garra gibit ship o gout blanga feloship ofring, maitbi boiwan o gelwan nomo garram enijing rong langa im.
english: "'If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

kriol: wal tudei aibin jinggabat blanga jandimbek langa yumob main kristjan braja neim ipefrodaitas. yumob bin jandim im langa mi basdam blanga album mi, en imbin wek adbalawei garram mi, en imbin oldei bekimap mi weya aibin oldei tok blanga det gudnyus.
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

kriol: wal det dubala wekinmen bin dum wanim jisas bin dalim dubala.
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

kriol: wal wotfo im tok, "imbin gowap"? im tok lagijat dumaji jisas krais bin kamdan, en imbin godan raitdan insaid langa graun basdam.
english: Now this, "He ascended", what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

kriol: en wen aibin gowei brom det kantri gulum mesadoniya basdam blanga spredimat det gudnyus, yumob sabi nobodi bin oldei album mi. oni yumob na langa det tjetj deya langa det taun gulum filapai bin albumbat mi.
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

kriol: dislot serramonimen hobaiya, heikas en basilai nomo bin abum pruf blanga shoum hubin olabat grenfatha. det grenfatha blanga det serramonimen gulum basilai bin merrit langa wan gel brom det femili blanga basilai langa giliyad en imbin gajim det neim blanga im waif dedi. wal dumaji dei nomo bin gibit eni pruf dei nomo bin lau blanga jidan serramonimen.
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

kriol: en ebribodi hubin irrim det nyus bin ol hatjamp brabliwei, en deibin tok, "im meigim defwan irrim, en im meigim damwan tok gudwei. im dum ebrijing brabli gudbalawei."
english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, "He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!"

kriol: wal benjamin bin abum thribala san neim bela, beka, en jedaiyel.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

kriol: langa main taim, oni detlot hubin dumbat nogudbala ting bin abum trabul en det seimwan nogudbala ting bin hepin langa olabat du.
english: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin kipgon tok,
english: Moreover Yahweh's word came to me, saying,

kriol: wal wen josef bin kamat langa olabat, deibin grebum im, en deibin pulumat det purdiwan kout brom im,
english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

kriol: wal leiban bin tok, "det lowa blanga melabat tok det yangiswan gel kaan merrit bifo det eldiswan gel.
english: Laban said, "It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

kriol: wal deibid bin olredi ringimap wanbala tent deya, en deibin pudumdan det boks insaid langa det tent, en afta king deibid bin abum sekrifais serramoni blanga yawei, en imbin abum det serramoni blanga det ofring gulum feloship ofring,
english: They brought in Yahweh's ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

kriol: wal nomeda mi o detlot najalot speshalwan mishanri dalimbat pipul det gudnyus, bat stil melabat oldei dalimbat olabat det seimwan wed, en tharran na det wed weya yumob bin bilib.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

kriol: if enibodi hitim im wekinmen o wekingel, en im bastim im ai o breigim im tuth, wal im garra larramgo det wekinmen o wekingel fri blanga peiyim im blanga det ai o det tuth.
english: "If a man strikes his servant's eye, or his maid's eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.

kriol: bat yumob jinggabat dijan na! yawei bin pikimat detlot pipul hu bulurrum im raitwei. wen ai jingat langa im, im irrim mi.
english: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly; Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

kriol: god bin tok brom im brabli seikridwan pleis, "gudbinjiwei ai garra kadimat det taun shekam, en gibit det kantri sukait beli langa main pipul olabat.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kriol: wal pipul oldei tok, "if yu laigim mani detmatj, im kaan meigim yu sedisfaid. yu garra oldei wandim mowa ebrijing. wal ai nomo sabi wotfo im lagijat.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

kriol: wal nebusaradan det boswan wekinmen blanga ola solja, bin deigimwei prisana seraiya det haibala serramonimen, sefanaiya det sekan boswan serramonimen en thribala najalot haibala wekinmen blanga det serramoni pleis.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

kriol: oni langa mi na yu garra bradin, en yu garra shoum rispek oni langa mi na, det holiwan god, yawei det boswan god.
english: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

kriol: en if enibodi tok nogudbalawei langa yumob blanga detkain ting, wal yumob kaan teiknodis langa im, dumaji ol detkain ting nomo enijing. detkain ting bin oni jidan laiga pitja blanga shoum ola pipul wanim garra kaman. bat det brabliwan ting bin kaman olredi, en jisas krais na det brabliwan ting.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ's.

kriol: bambai im garra jandimwei mi langa det kantri weya ola dedbala pipul oldei jidan. wi ol garra go deya.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

kriol: det brabli haibala god bin gibit yu dedi nebakanesa pawa blanga jidan king en imbin meigim im brabli haibala en ola pipul bin shoum rispek langa im.
english: "To you, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.

kriol: "wal aibin lafta gibit olabat najawan lowa weya meigim olabat abum panishmen, en det lowa nomo meigim olabat jidan raitwei.
english: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn't live.

kriol: det enimul bin luk jis laiga big jigiwan bujiget. bat imbin abum bigiswan fut jis laiga beya en mawus jis laiga laiyan. wal det dregan bin meigim det enimul jidan bos. imbin meigim im haibala bos, en imbin gibit det enimul im ron pawa.
english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

kriol: en imbin pudum det dubala kaliko ontop langa det tent jis laik weya yawei bin dalim im blanga dum.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kriol: wal nomeda yumob oldei gulum god dedi wen yumob prei langa im, bat stil yumob sabi god garra jadjim ebribodi, en yumob sabi im garra jadjim ebribodi seimwei, en im garra peiyimbek ebribodi seimwei blanga ol detlot ting weya deibin dumbat. yumob sabi? god garra jadjim ebribodi. en blanga tharran na yumob garra jidanbat iya langa dijan kantri jis laik yumob nomo blanga dijan kantri,
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man's work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

kriol: yu lukaftumbat dijan graun. yu jandimdan rein en meigim det graun jidan brabli gudwan wulijim ola daga garra gro. yu bilimap ola draiwan krik en ola riba garram woda. yu pudum ola plent langa graun blanga ola pipul blanga dagat, en yu growimap olkain daga. yu na dumbat ol dislot ting.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

kriol: "wal yumob jinggabat na. wen sambodi kaman langa enibodi kemp naitaim blanga stilim enijing, im nomo gajim ola enijing brom det kemp. im gajim oni detlot ting weya im wandim. en wen pipul oldei gajimbat daga brom gadin, dei oldei libum sambala daga biyain. bat wen ai garra jandim detlot enami blanga yumob deya, dei garra binijimap yumob brabliwei. dei kaan libum enijing.
english: "If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn't they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn't they leave some gleaning grapes?

kriol: afta na, yumob garra wotjim miselp en nomo foget yumob nomo lau blanga bulurrumbat najalot pipul hu weshipbat olkain drimin sheip, dumaji if yumob bulurrumbat olabat, wal tharran garra meigim bigwan trabul kaman langa yumob. en nomo trai en faindat hau olabat weshipbat olabat drimin, dumaji yumob mait wandi weshipbat yawei seimwei du.
english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, "How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise."

kriol: en wen mosis bin nokap, det dubala men bin bringimap wanbala ston langa im blanga jidan, en dubala bin jandap tusaid langa im, en dubala bin holdimap im bingga wulijim im kaan pudumdan. lagijat na dubala bin dum langa mosis raidap det san bin godan,
english: But Moses' hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

kriol: "en wen yumob kadim det sid daga brom yumob pedik, yumob kaan kadimof det sid daga rait langa boda langa det pedik, en yumob kaan gobek en kadim detlot sid daga igin.
english: "'When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

kriol: wal hoseiya bin tok, "det ifreiyim klen bin meigim miselp jidan haibala langa ol detlot najalot isreil klen, en wen detlot pipul brom ifreiyim klen bin oldei tok, detlot pipul brom detlot najalot klen bin oldei bradin, en deibin oldei bulurrum olabat. bat det ifreiyim klen bin bulurrumbat det drimin gulum beil, en blanga tharran na ola pipul langa det klen garra dai.
english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.

kriol: en detlot isreil solja bin bidim detlot siriya solja, en deibin kilim ded 700 solja hubin oldei fait garram hos en bagi, en deibin kilim ded 40,000 solja hubin oldei raidim hos, en shobak det boswan solja bin dai du, dumaji detlot isreil solja bin kilim im.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.

kriol: aibin pudum det seikridwan boks garram det dubala ston garram det brabli strongwan pramis weya yawei bin meigim garram ola isreil pipul langa det serramoni pleis." lagijat na king salaman bin tok.
english: There I have set the ark, in which is Yahweh's covenant, which he made with the children of Israel."

kriol: wal loda pipul bin raidimdan stori blanga jisas krais en ol detlot ting weya bin hepin iya langa dijan kantri judiya.
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

kriol: god, seibum mi! det woda im raidap langa main nek.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Lilies." By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

kriol: wal det nyus blanga jisas bin spredat ebriweya, en det gabman bos blanga gelali bin irrim ol detlot ting bin hepining ebriweya. det gabman bos bin neim herod, en im nomo bin sabi hu jisas, dumaji sambala pipul bin tok, "jon beptis bin gidap laibala."
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

kriol: dislot na detlot neim blanga ola libaimen. deibin jeshuwa det san blanga esanaiya, binuwai brom det femili lain blanga henaded, kedmiyel, shebanaiya, hodaiya, kelita, pelaiya, henan, mika, reiyob, hashabaiya, sekura, sherebaiya, shebanaiya, hodaiya, bani en beninu.
english: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

kriol: wal langa ol det taim wen jehoiyada det serramonimen bin stil jidan laibala king jowesh bin oldei dum ebrijing gudwei blanga meigim yawei det trubala god gudbinji langa im.
english: Joash did that which was right in Yahweh's eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

kriol: yu garra wotjim miselp hau yu tok. wanim yu tok gin albumbat yu o gibit yu bigis trabul.
english: A man's stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

kriol: "yu dalim detlot serramonimen hu garrimapbat det seikridwan boks blanga kamat brom det riba na."
english: "Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan."

kriol: brom deya det king bin jingat langa eibrahem, en wen imbin kaman langa im, det king bin askim im, "wotfo yubin meigim dijan trabul blanga melabat weya god wandi binijimap mi en main pipul olabat? melabat nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting langa yu. dijan ting weya yubin dum langa mi im brabli nogudwan. yu nomo wandi dum lagijat.
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, "What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!"

kriol: wal deibin teikoba en jidan langa bethel en detlot taun deya gulijap, en raidap sanraiswei langa neiran en raidap sangodanwei langa gisa en detlot taun deya gulijap du. deibin teikoba dubala taun gulum shekam en aiya en ol detlot lilwan taun deya gulijap du.
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

kriol: wal ai garra panishim yumob. wal yumob jinggabat detkain wudwan drimin weya dei gaburrumap im garram silba en gol. im kaan dalimbat yu enijing. maitbi sambodi tok langa det stonwan drimin en langa det wudwan drimin, 'gidap en wok.' dubala kaan duwit, dumaji dubala nomo garram win blanga blowimbat.
english: Woe to him who says to the wood, 'Awake!' or to the mute stone, 'Arise!' Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

kriol: en wi sabi im kaan neba dai igin. det greib kaan jidan bos oba langa im enimo, dumaji wen imbin dai, imbin bidim det pawa blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting, en tudei im jidan laibala garram god.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

kriol: afta na dubala bin lisin sambodi bin jingat adbala brom hebin langa dubala, "yunbala kamap iya na." en dubala bin gowap langa top garram klaud, en detlot bedfren blanga dubala bin lukinat dubala gowap.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here!" They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

kriol: en detlot pipul deya langa jerusalem garra kraikrai nomo lilbit, en dei garra jidan nomo garram enijing."
english: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

kriol: if yu fren askim yu blanga album im yu kaan dalim im, 'yu weit! ai garra album yu tumorro.' nomo. yu kaan tok lagijat. yu garra duwit streidawei.
english: Don't say to your neighbor, "Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you," when you have it by you.

kriol: en deibin tok miselp, "im det san blanga josef neim jisas, indit? wi sabi im dedi en mami. wal im kaan tok imbin kamdan brom hebin."
english: They said, "Isn't this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, 'I have come down out of heaven'?"

kriol: en yu nomo bin larram main enami olabat grebum mi, en yu nomo bin larram mi gibap du.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.

kriol: wal sebul bin tok, "yu na bin tok blanga meigim miselp bos, indit? yu na bin dalimbat ola men nomo blanga bulurrum abimalek, indit? wal yu go na en fait langa im."
english: Then Zebul said to him, "Now where is your mouth, that you said, 'Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?' Isn't this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them."

kriol: yawei, yu luk langa olabat nogudbalawei. yu panishim olabat laik yubin panishim mi blanga main nogudbalawei. mi krai binji detmatj dumaji mi brabli nogudbinji." lagijat na jerusalem bin tok.
english: "Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

kriol: wal iya na mowa brabli gudwan wed blanga king salaman weya detlot sabibala wekinmen blanga king hesakaiya brom juda bin raidimdan.
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

kriol: det libai klen na, garra deigim pleis blanga detlot fesbon san blanga detlot isreil pipul.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kriol: "en if yumob kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting en nomo duwit langa mi, wal ai garra panishim yumob brabli adbalawei.
english: "'If you walk contrary to me, and won't listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

kriol: wal det sabibala tok, "yu teiknodis en lisin langa dislot wed blanga sambala sabibala pipul. yu garra jinggabat gudwei wanim ai titjimbat yu.
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

kriol: bat if det gel kaan kambek garram yu, wal ai larramgo yu fri brom dijan pramis weya yubin meigim garram mi. bat nomeda wanim garra hepin, bat stil yu nomo deigimbek main san langa main ronwan kantri." lagijat na eibrahem bin tok.
english: If the woman isn't willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again."

kriol: aibin luk detlot pipul deya langa det kantri neim kushan deibin bradin, en detlot pipul brom det kantri neim midiyan, olabat bin sheiksheik detmatj.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

kriol: en ol detlot serramonimen bin kamat brom det riba, en streidawei wen deibin pudum olabat fut langa beingk, ol detlot woda bin randan igin seimwei weya imbin jidan bifo, en brom deya detlot serramonimen bin go lida langa ola pipul garram det seikridwan boks. wal det dei na yawei bin meigim joshuwa brabli haibala langa ola isreil pipul. ola pipul bin oldei rispek mosis, en seimwei lagijat igin deibin oldei rispek joshuwa.
english: When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh's covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.

kriol: loda pipul hubin dai basdam garra gidap laibala igin. sambala garra jidan brabli gudbinji olagijawan, en sambala garra sheim miselp na olagijawan.
english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

kriol: if yu laigim silipsilip oldei yu leisiwan en yu garra jidan powan, bat if yu oldei dumbat wek yu garra abum loda daga.
english: Don't love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

kriol: en imbin nambawan hantingmen, dumaji yawei det trubala god bin oldei albumbat im. en ola pipul bin oldei tok, "nimrod im nambawan hantingmen. en maitbi yawei garra meigim yumob jidan seimwei laik im du."
english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, "like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh".

kriol: wal yumob dalim mi na. hubin stapam yumob? god bin stapam yumob? nomo. god nomo bin stapam yumob, dumaji im na bin jingat langa yumob blanga kaman langa im.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin tok lagijat, nobodi bin wandi ensim im, en brom det taim na nobodi bin wandi askimbat im eni kwestjan blanga trai en trikimbat im.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

kriol: en wen deibin sabi imbin det leimbala men hubin oldei jidanbat deya langa det geit, deibin ol hatjamp brabliwei.
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

kriol: ai garra dalim ola bigwan bos detlot lowa blanga yu, en ai kaan sheim blanga tharran.
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

kriol: melabat sabi haibala bos, if dei binij bildimbat dijan taun en ola wol blanga im, yu kaan kipgon jidanbat bos blanga ola pipul langa det kantri sangodansaid brom det yufreitis riba."
english: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

kriol: "isikiyel, ai wandim yu garra jidan jis laik det men hu oldei wotjimbat en yu garra dalim detlot isreil pipul dijan woning brom mi.
english: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

kriol: bat yumob nomo oldei go langa im. yumob oldei deigim yumob kristjan braja langa odinri pipul hu nomo bilib langa god blanga jadjim olabat.
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

kriol: wal streidawei na imbin hepin lagijat. sambala pipul bin andimwei king nebakanesa brom weya imbin jidan garram ola pipul dumaji imbin abum main jis laik enimul, en imbin dagadagatbat gras wulijim ola buligi. det dyu bin buldan langa im bodi, en im heya bin gro brabli longwan jis laik igulok fetha, en ola neil langa im bodi bin gro longwan jis laik det bard fut.
english: This was fulfilled the same hour on Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from men and ate grass like oxen; and his body was wet with the dew of the sky until his hair had grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.

kriol: ailibala neksdei wen josef bin kaman langa dubala, imbin luk dubala feis bin brabli sedwan,
english: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

kriol: wal yumob gel brom jerusalem, yumob garra pramis mi brabli strongbalawei. yumob garra pramis nomo blanga kadimat minbala wen minbala laigim gija detmatj.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up nor awaken love, until it so desires.

kriol: wal jis laik det laiyan weya kamat brom det bush kantri gulijap langa det jodan riba en go langa det grinwan gras kantri blanga gajim detlot ship, ai garra kaman en meigim detlot idam pipul ranawei kwikbala brom olabat kantri. afta tharran, ai garra pikimat wanbala lida hu garra jidan bos langa det kantri. hu gin jidan lebulwan langa mi? hu gin fait langa mi? wujan boswan gin agamin langa mi?
english: "Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?"

kriol: bat aibin tokbek langa yawei det boswan god en aibin dalim im na, "nomo! ai kaan dum lagijat! ai nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting. brom beibitaim ai nomo bin dagat eni daga weya melabat nomo bin lau blanga dagat o eni enimul weya bin jis dai, en ai nomo bin dagat bif brom eni enimul weya eni wailwan enimul bin kilim ded. ai nomo bin dagat eni bif weya det lowa blanga yawei tok nomo blanga dagat." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: Then I said, "Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!"

kriol: detlot pipul hu garra win, ai garra meigim olabat jidan deya langa det haus blanga main god. dei garra jidan deya garram god olagija. en ai garra raidimdan 3 neim langa olabat. ai garra raidimdan langa olabat det neim blanga god, en ai garra raidimdan langa olabat det neim blanga det nyuwan taun blanga main god. det taun na det nyuwan jerusalem, en det taun garra kamdan brom top brom main god. en ai garra raidimdan langa olabat main ron nyuwan neim du.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

kriol: en deibin joinin langa detlot najalot men, en deibin kipgon stonimbat stibin. wal stibin bin jingat langa jisas, "jisas! bos! yu gajim main spirit!"
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!"

english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, 'I have made Abram rich.'

kriol: nobodi sabi det brabliwan pawa wen yu gitwail langa det nogudbalawei blanga pipul. blanga tharran na melabat garra bradin en rispek yu olataim.
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

kriol: wal wen king deibid bin krosim det jodan riba, ola men brom detlot juda pipul en haf ola men brom detlot isreil pipul bin lukaftumbat im weya imbin krosim det riba, en afta deibin ol go langa det taun gulum gilgel, en det men neim kimam bin go deya garram im du.
english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

kriol: nobodi gin luk god, en im garram detmatj pawa. im olweis gibitbat ebribodi feyago.
english: We can't reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

kriol: en afta olabat oldei dalim najalot pipul, 'yumob nomo kaman gulijap langa melabat. dumaji melabat brabli speshalwan blanga god.' olabat jidan jis laik det nogudwan smok weya oldei meigimbat main nos ardim nomo lilbit.
english: who say, 'Stay by yourself, don't come near to me, for I am holier than you.' These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.

kriol: ola wailwan dog en lilwan ship garra wokabat en dagadagat daga mijamet. en ola buligi en laiyan garra dagadagat gras mijamet du. ola sneik garra dagadagat oni graun. olabat kaan baidim enibodi o ardim enibodi langa main seikridwan hil." lagijat na yawei tok.
english: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent's food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain," says Yahweh.

kriol: wen detlot asiriya pipul garra irrim det bois blanga god, en wen olabat garra luk im kaminap en hitimbat olabat garram det aiyanwan stik, olabat garra bradin nomo lilbit.
english: For through Yahweh's voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

kriol: nomo enibodi kaan faindim eni gudbala men langa det taun gulum giliyad, dumaji olabat brabli nogudbala en dei oldei medrimbat enibodi,
english: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.

english: "'Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?' Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way."

kriol: if yu dum lagijat, wal ai garra dalim ola brabli nogudbala pipul wanim yubin dum, en olabat garra tenim miselp en bulurrum yu.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

kriol: "if aibin wandim blanga naja men waif en bin wandim gajim det gel,
english: "If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor's door,

kriol: wal yawei, yu luk wanim detlot asiriya pipul dumbat langa melabat. yu lisin langa ol detlot nogudbala ting weya det boswan king, senakerib, tok blanga yu, det laibalawan god.
english: Incline your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to defy the living God.

kriol: imbin deigim olabat 40 dei blanga pudum det medisin langa det bodi. en seimtaim ola pipul blanga det kantri ijip bin kraikrai blanga det dedbala. deibin kraikrai blanga im longtaim, 70 dei.
english: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.

kriol: iglan, gisa,
english: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

kriol: yubin meigim detlot hosis blanga jamp jis laik grashopa, en blanga bradin ola pipul wen dei jinginatbat?
english: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

kriol: wal yawei det boswan god bin kipgon tok, "ai garra majurrumap ola isreil pipul brom ol detlot kantri weya deibin spredat, en ola pipul langa ebri kantri garra sabi mi na brabli holiwan. detlot isreil pipul garra jidan langa det kantri weya aibin gibit langa main wekinmen jeikob.
english: "'The Lord Yahweh says: "When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

kriol: en afta imbin kipgon tok langa detlot wekinmen blanga im, "lesaras det gudfren blanga wi im silip na. en ai garra go en weikimap im."
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep."

kriol: wal ai askim yu blanga gibit mi klebabala main blanga lukaftumbat ol dislot pipul blanga yu en gibitbat olabat feyago. en yu album mi blanga sabi wanim rait en wanim rong. if yu nomo dum tharran, wal ai kaan sabi hau blanga lukaftumbat ol dislot pipul blanga yu." lagijat na salaman bin tok.
english: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?"

kriol: if yu garra kilim ded ola pipul blanga yu, det najalot pipul hubin irrim ola klebabala ting wanim yubin oldei dumbat garra tok,
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

kriol: en imbin tok, "yumob bin bringimap jisas langa mi, en yumob bin dalim mi imbin trai en meigim ola pipul dum rong. en aibin tok langa jisas rait iya langa yumob ai, en ai kaan faindim eni rong langa im.
english: and said to them, "You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "yumob garra bilib langa god brabliwei, en yumob gin dum detkain ting du.
english: Jesus answered them, "Have faith in God.

kriol: yumob gin kadimdan detlot najalot tri weya nomo abum daga, en yusum detlot tri blanga bildimap detlot step blanga albumbat yumob galimapbat det wol blanga go insaid en teikoba det taun."
english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

kriol: deth bin ebriweya raidaran langa mi. imbin jis laik det greibyad bin redi blanga grebum mi.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.

kriol: wal mosis en ola isreil pipul bin bidim det dubala king, en mosis bin gibit ol detlot kantri blanga det dubala king langa det dubala klen gulum rubin en ged en sambala pipul brom det klen gulum manesa.
english: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

kriol: "wal bambai ai garra breigim det wadi en letha yok weya jidan langa olabat nek en ai garra deigimat detlot tjein, en olabat kaan jidanbat laiga prisana blanga detlot streinja pipul enimo na.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants;

kriol: wal, ai garra tjakidawei yumob brom dijan kantri en mubumbat yumob langa det kantri weya yumob nomo sabi en yumob grengrenfathamob nomo bin sabi du. en deya na yumob garra weshipbat olkain drimin deitaim en naitaim, en ai kaan jidan sori blanga yumob.'"
english: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.'

kriol: jonathan bin tok, "yu nomo bradin. main dedi kaan kilim yu, dumaji im sabi yu garra jidan king blanga ola isreil pipul, en ai garra jidan sekan men langa yu."
english: He said to him, "Don't be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won't find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also."

kriol: en olabat gin jidan eniweya langa dijan kantri. maitbi yu garra larram olabat jidan langa det brabli gudwan kantri deya langa goshin. en if ola braja blanga yu jidan brabli gudwan stakmen, wal yu garra meigim olabat stakmen blanga main."
english: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock."

kriol: streidawei ola pipul blanga juda bin stap weshipbat langa det serramoni pleis blanga yawei en deibin stat weshipbat detlot drimin sheip en det gelwan god gulum eshara. ol dislot nogudbala ting bin meigim yawei brabli wail langa ola pipul langa juda en jerusalem,
english: They abandoned the house of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.

kriol: wal aibin tok, "yumob oldei wandim det dei blanga yawei garra kaman kwikbala, bat det dei garra brabli nogud blanga yumob. yumob reken det dei garra gudwan, bat najing. det dei garra jidan brabli dakbala nomo garram eni lait blanga yumob.
english: "Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.

kriol: afta na king salaman bin irrim det nyus weya edanaija bin go langa det tent en hau imbin holdim detlot kona blanga det teibul blanga ofring, dumaji imbin brabli bradin langa im, en hau imbin tok, "basdam ai wandim king salaman garra meigim pramis im kaan kilim mi ded."
english: Solomon was told, "Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, 'Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.'"

kriol: en ai nomo bin go langa jerusalem blanga tok langa detlot men hubin jidan speshalwan mishanri bifo mi. streidawei aibin go langa det kantri gulum areibiya, en aibin jidan deya lilbit longtaim, en afta aibin gobek langa det taun gulum dameskas.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

kriol: bat yawei garra kipum melabat ola isreil pipul seifwan, en melabat kaan neba sheim."
english: Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.

english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might."

kriol: sambala pipul wotjimbat wen im panishim detlot nogudbala pipul,

english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

english: They asked him, "Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

kriol: wal josef bin tok, "najing! yumob bin kaman iya blanga faindat wujan im gudwei weya yumob wandi teikoba dijan kantri blanga melabat."
english: He said to them, "No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!"

english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn't believe that he listened to my voice.

kriol: wen det win en rein en det fladwoda bin kaman, dei nomo bin deigidawei det haus, dumaji det men bin bildimap det haus brabli strongbala langa det rokibala pleis.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn't fall, for it was founded on the rock.

english: He said to him the third time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?" Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, "Do you have affection for me?" He said to him, "Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you." Jesus said to him, "Feed my sheep.

kriol: wal yu dalim melabat na. wen det taim kaman weya ola dedbala pipul garra gidap laibala, blanga hu waif det gel garra jidan, dumaji imbin merrit langa ol detlot sebenbala braja gija?" lagijat na detlot serramonimen bin tok.
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife."

english: For there is no partiality with God.

english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons' portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.

english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, "I want to. Be made clean."

english: Then the woman said, "Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king." He said, "Say on."

english: "Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

kriol: lagijat na detlot braja blanga jisas bin tok langa im, dumaji dei nomo bin bilib langa im.
english: For even his brothers didn't believe in him.

english: 'For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for my servant David's sake.'"

english: "'Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to Yahweh.

kriol: yu jandim ola enimul langa olabat kemp?
english: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

english: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.

kriol: wal yawei bin brabli gudbinji wen salaman bin askim im lagijat,
english: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

kriol: lagijat na det olmen jeikob bin tok langa im twelbala san blanga gudbai langa olabat. imbin gibit raitwan wed langa ola san blanga im. en brom detlot twelbala san na detlot twelbala klen blanga isreil bin kamat.
english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat na. yumob kaan tok, "tumorro ai garra go samweya tharrei en stap deya wan yiya blanga selimbat enijing blanga meigimap mani."
english: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow let's go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit."

kriol: wal wen deibid bin toktok langa olabat, galaiyath bin kamat en jingat langa ola isreil solja jis laik imbin oldei dumbat, en deibid bin irrim im jingat.
english: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

kriol: olabat bin gibit bekboun langa im en dei nomo bin jidan trubala langa im, laik olabat grengrenfatha bin dumbat longtaim bifo. olabat bin nogud jis laik bendiwan spiya.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

kriol: wal blanga tharran na god jidan garram melabat en im garra go lida langa melabat wen melabat go blanga fait wen detlot serramonimen blowim detlot longwan wisul. wal im nomo eni gud yumob isreil pipul. yumob lafta gibap. yumob kaan bidim yawei det god blanga yumob grengrenfatha weya olabat bin weshipbat." lagijat na king abaija bin tok.
english: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don't fight against Yahweh, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper."

kriol: wal god im brabli haibala, en imbin meigim im san haibala langa ola einjul, en imbin gibit im haibala neim du, en det neim im haibala langa ola neim blanga ola einjul.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

kriol: olabat bin brabli nokap wen deibin ranawei brom detlot bigwan naif en shapwan spiya, dumaji olabat bin bradin blanga faitbek.
english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

kriol: "ol yumob men garram bo en erro, yumob gitredi na blanga fait langa detlot bebalon pipul en yumob majurrumap miselp raidaran langa bebalon. yumob shudum yumob erro langa bebalon, dumaji imbin dumbat nogudbala ting langa mi na, yawei.
english: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her. Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against Yahweh.

kriol: wal wen dubala bin binij dagadagat daga, det olbala speshalwan mesinja bin meigim det dongki redibala blanga det speshalwan mesinja brom juda en imbin gowei.
english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

kriol: ebrijing weya king ela bin dum deibin raidimdan langa det buk gulum ola stori blanga detlot king blanga isreil.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kriol: bambai na imbin gidap brom im dedbala waif, en imbin go langa det miting pleis deya langa det geit weya ola boswan blanga detlot hitait pipul bin oldei jidanbat,
english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

kriol: dei oldei go langa detlot seikridwan pleis blanga ol detlot najalot pipul deya ontop langa ola bigwan hil, en deya na dei oldei abum sekrifais serramoni, en ontop langa ola lilwan hil dei oldei barnim ola gudsmelwan medisin andanith langa ola bigwan tri. en blanga tharran na yumob doda olabat oldei dumbat nogudbala ting du. dei oldei go en silipsilipbat garram enibodi, en ola gel hu merrit langa yumob san oldei go en silipsilipbat garram enibodi du.
english: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.

kriol: bat wen king abaija bin stil toktokbat, king jerabowam bin jandim sambala solja blanga fait det juda amimob brom biyain, en najalot bin fait lida langa olabat.
english: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.'"

english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped."

english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

english: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more."

english: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, "No, but we will have a king over us,

english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up." They were exceedingly sorry.

english: For the Scripture says, "You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain." And, "The laborer is worthy of his wages."

english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

english: He called him, and said to him, 'What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.'

english: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I will not be inquired of by you!
