kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok,
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

kriol: afta na jisas bin tok langa det bos blanga det haus, "wen yu abum dina o sapa, yu kaan go en askim yu gudwan fren o yu braja o yu rileishan o yu ritjwan fren en dalim olabat blanga kaman en dagat langa yu kemp, dumaji olabat garra askim yu blanga kaman en dagat langa olabat kemp afta, en wen dei dum lagijat, dei peiyimbek yu.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, "When you make a dinner or a supper, don't call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

kriol: en im garra pulumat det spiya garram im raidensaid bingga weya im garram det wed jerusalem. streidawei im garra jinginat brabli adbala blanga fait langa jerusalem. im garra dalim detlot solja blanga pailimap graun blanga meigim roud blanga go oba langa det wol, en gajim bigwan hebiwan pos blanga nokamdan det geit en det brabli strongbala wol blanga teikoba det taun.
english: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.

kriol: wal edanaija bin askim joweb, en det serramonimen gulum abaiyatha, en dubala bin tok dubala garra album im blanga jidan king. joweb mami bin neim seruwaiya.
english: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

kriol: "brom deya yawei bin tok langa wi, 'wal yumob na bin reken ola enami garra deigimwei ol yumob bigininimob, bat najing. detlot biginini nomo bin sabi enijing, dumaji deibin ol lilwan. wal mi na garra gibit olabat det kantri en olabat garra teikoba det kantri.
english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

kriol: wal jisas bin kipgon tok, "ai dalim yumob. im lagijat du langa hebin wen eni nogudbala pipul kambek langa god. ola einjul oldei gudbinji blanga detlot pipul hu oldei jidan gudbalawei. bat wen wanbala nogudbala pipul kambek langa god, ola einjul gudbinji brabliwei."
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

kriol: wen yawei bin gitwail langa im enami olabat, dei kaan blandim miselp brom im, dumaji im brabli strongbala. en wen imbin jingat, im strongwan wed bin kadimat det solwoda blanga shoum ola meinwan pat weya holdimap dijan wel.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

kriol: det king garra grebum im enami olabat en meigim olabat jidan prisana. im garra grebum ol detlot hu heidim im du.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

kriol: wal king josaiya bin gibit oda blanga abum det pasoba serramoni deya langa jerusalem blanga preisim yawei det trubala god. wal langa det namba 14 dei langa det feswan manth deibin kilim detlot lilwan boiwan ship blanga abum det pasoba serramoni.
english: Josiah kept a Passover to Yahweh in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

kriol: yu garra andimwei mi brom main kantri, en yu garra andimwei mi brom yuselp du, en ai garra oldei wokaranbat ebriweya nomo garram main ronwan kemp. en if enibodi faindim mi, dei garra kilim mi ded."
english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me."

kriol: yu garra sekamsais yu ronwan san en ola wekinmen blanga yu hu jidan jis laiga prisana en hubin bon langa yu kemp en ola wekinmen weya yu bin baiyim brom najalot kantri. ol detlot na yu garra kadim olabat. dijan mak garra jidan pruf langa yumob bodi blanga det strongwan pramis weya aibin meigim garram yu olagija.
english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

kriol: wal yawei det boswan god bin tok, "dumaji detlot pipul langa moweb reken juda im nomo difrin brom najalot kantri,
english: "'The Lord Yahweh says: "Because Moab and Seir say, 'Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,'

kriol: nomeda weya ol detlot isreil pipul jidan, bat stil dei nomo lau yusum det blad blanga bard o enimul blanga daga.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

kriol: wal wen ebigeil bin luk deibid, streidawei imbin godan brom im dongki, en imbin nildan langa graun lida langa deibid blanga shoum rispek langa im, en imbin askim im, "bos, yu lisin langa mi na. yu garra pudum bleim langa mi.
english: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground.

kriol: wen sambodi baiyim samting brom det stowa im tok, "yu wandim tumatj mani." afta im gowei en im tok, "aibin baiyim dijan garram oni lilbit mani."
english: "It's no good, it's no good," says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

kriol: wal yumob kaan tokabat pipul nogudwei en dalimbat laiya!
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

kriol: wal aibin kipgon tok, "yawei det boswan god bin meigim dijan pramis na, 'wal ebrijing garra hepin jis laik aibin tok.
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, "Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

kriol: "wal afta, wen 490 yiya garra gopas, god garra larramgo fri detlot pipul blanga yu en det seikridwan taun brom ola nogudbala ting blanga olabat. god garra larramgo olabat fri brom ol det nogudbalawei. im garra tridim olabat raitwei en gibit olabat feyago olagijawan. lagijat na det drim en det wed brom god garra jidan trubalawan, en det serramoni pleis garra jidan seikridwan igin.
english: "Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

kriol: "wal ai kaan panishim ol detlot gel, dumaji ol yumob men oldei go en silipsilipbat garram ol detlot gel weya dei oldei yusum langa detlot serramoni, en yumob oldei abumbat sekrifais serramoni garram detlot gel du. trubala ai dalim yumob. detlot pipul hu nomo jinggabat gudwei garra ol binijap.
english: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.

kriol: jeinim, betapuwa, afeka,
english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

kriol: bambai wi holot bin tenbek en gobek langa det deset kantri, weya wibin bulurrum det roud langa det solwoda gulum redsi jis laik yawei det trubala god bin dalim wi blanga dum. wal wibin wokabat langa det hil kantri blanga idam longtaim na.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat ol detlot kristjan pipul hubin dai olredi. bifo deibin dai, deibin irrim det gudnyus, en det gudnyus na bin meigim olabat bulurrum jisas krais, en blanga tharran na detlot nogudbala pipul bin tok nogudbalawei blanga olabat. bat oni langa dijan laif iya langa dijan wel detlot nogudbala pipul bin tok nogudbalawei blanga detlot kristjan pipul en gibit olabat trabul, dumaji tudei detlot kristjan pipul jidan hau god wandim olabat blanga jidan deya langa hebin garram im.
english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

kriol: ailibala neksdei na det king bin jingat langa ola hedbos blanga im, en imbin dalim olabat blanga det drim weya imbin abum, en det wed bin bradinimbat olabat detmatj.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

kriol: en deya na yu garra dai langa det hil jis laik yu braja eran bin dai langa det hil gulum hora,
english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

kriol: brom deya wan sebathdei jisas bin go langa det haus blanga wan boswan serramonimen gulum ferasi blanga dagat daga, en ola pipul bin lukinat langa im brabliwei if im garra dum eni klebabala ting.
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

kriol: bambai na jisas bin jingat langa det twelbala wekinmen blanga im, en imbin tok, "ai gibit yumob pawa blanga andimwei nogudbala spirit en blanga meigim sikbala pipul gudbala.
english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

kriol: en det golwan lemp en det teibul blanga det damba ofring en det teibul blanga barnim det gudsmelwan medisin
english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

kriol: "wal yumob bin irrim det najawan wed weya im tok, 'if eni men jandimwei im waif, wal im garra gibit im waif det peipa blanga dalim im waif im garra jandimwei im.'
english: "It was also said, 'Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,'

kriol: det brabli siliwan men im jidan mobeda den det silibala men hu reken im brabli sabibala.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kriol: "yumob sabi? mi na det tri, en yumob ola wadi, en if yumob kipgon jidan joinap garram mi en mi garram yumob, wal yumob garra abum bigmob daga. bat if yumob nomo jidan garram mi, wal yumob kaan dum eni gudwan ting,
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

kriol: wal wan leimbala men bin jidan deya langa det purdiwan geit. det men bin leimbala brom beibitaim, en ebridei sambodi bin oldei garrimap im langa det geit, en wen enibodi bin oldei go langa det geit blanga gowin langa det serramoni pleis, imbin oldei askimbat olabat blanga mani.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

kriol: 'brom det taim na wen aibin bringimap main pipul olabat brom ijip raidap tudei, ai nomo bin pikimat eni taun langa isreil blanga bildimap serramoni pleis weya olabat gin weship mi. en ai nomo bin pikimat enibodi blanga lidimbat ol main pipul.
english: 'Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

kriol: yubin olredi irrim hau melabat, ola asiriya pipul, bin binijimap ola najalot pipul. wotfo yu reken yu garra jidan seifwan?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

kriol: "yumob sabi wanim mi toktok? mi na det speshalwan men, en nobodi sabi wotaim ai garra kambek. wal yumob garra meigim miselp redi, dumaji ai mait kambek enitaim weya yumob nomo sabi." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don't expect him."

kriol: god garra tridim yu gudbalawei, dumaji yubin jinggabat blanga dum raitwei, en yubin stapam mi brom kilimbat detlot men ded blanga peibek.
english: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

kriol: en ola laitining bin flesh en ola heilston bin buldan, en det brabliwan lait blanga im bin shain thru detlot klaud.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

kriol: maitbi yumob askimbat god blanga enijing, en im nomo gibit langa yumob. bat im nomo bin gibit langa yumob, dumaji yumob wandi yusum det ting blanga yumob ronselp, en yumob wandi meigim yumob selp sedisfaid.
english: You ask, and don't receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

kriol: en afta tenbala solja blanga jowab bin gowap langa ebsalom, en deibin binijimap im.
english: Ten young men who bore Joab's armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

kriol: detlot isreil pipul bin tok langa mosis na, "wal melabat binij na, if enibodi hu kaman gulijap langa det seikridwan tent garra dai, wal maitbi melabat holot garra ol dai du." lagijat na deibin tok.
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

kriol: wal ilaihu bin kipgon tok langa job, "wal yu jinggabat brabli gudwei blanga ol detlot klebabalawei blanga god na.
english: "Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

kriol: "wal lagijat na aibin prei, bat dumaji yumob bin dumbat nogudbala ting, blanga tharran na yawei bin wail langa mi en im nomo bin teiknodis langa mi. imbin tok, 'binij na! nomo toktok oldei blanga dijan ting!
english: But Yahweh was angry with me because of you, and didn't listen to me. Yahweh said to me, "That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

kriol: en hairam bin jandimbek mesij langa salaman, "aibin irrim yu mesij en mi redi blanga dum enijing yu tok. ai garra gibit langa yu detlot sidatri en paintri weya yu wandim.
english: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, "I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

kriol: en wen leimek bin gro, imbin merrit langa dubala gel neim eda en sila.
english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

kriol: wal yu kaan bilib langa det bednyus weya yu san olabat bin dai. oni emnon bin dai." lagijat na jonadeb bin tok.
english: Now therefore don't let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead."

kriol: imbin kilim ded detlot boswan weya ebribodi sabi. trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kriol: god, yu panishim olabat blanga olabat nogudbalawei. yu gitwail en binijimap olabat.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

kriol: if eni femili blanga yu dai deya langa det taun, wal ola dog garra dagat det bodi blanga olabat, en if olabat dai deya langa det opin kantri, wal detlot bard gulum boltja garra dagat det bodi blanga olabat." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: The dogs will eat Baasha's descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat."

kriol: bat ola praudbala pipul olabat hepi. wen detlot nogud pipul wandim samting dei gedim det ting, en wen dei testim god blanga faindat if im wotjimbat olabat wal im nomo panishim olabat du.' lagijat na yumob bin tok nogudbalawei blanga mi." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.'

kriol: imbin dum seimwan ting langa detlot taun weya bin bitsimap langa manesa, ifreiyim en simiyan raidap langa det boda blanga neftali.
english: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.

kriol: ola hosis dei yusum langa wo kaan win. detlot strongbala hosis kaan seibum enibodi.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

kriol: wal jeikob bin tok, "orait, yu meigim det pramis weya yu garra duwit." wal josef bin meigim det pramis, en jeikob bin gudbinji brabli, en imbin theingkyu langa god, en afta imbin leidan langa im bed.
english: Israel said, "Swear to me," and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed's head.

kriol: wal detlot lida bin tok, "melabat nomo bin gedim eni leda blanga dijan stori brom det kantri judiya, en nobodi bin kaman iya en dalimbat melabat eni nyus blanga yu o tokabat yu.
english: They said to him, "We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

kriol: brom deya king deibid bin tok, "bringimap seidok, neithan, en benaiya langa mi." en wen deibin kaman insaid,
english: King David said, "Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada." They came before the king.

kriol: wal langa det taim na det dubala speshalwan mesinja neim hegai en sekaraiya det san blanga ido, bin dalimbat ola wed brom det god blanga ola isreil pipul, en langa ola juwish pipul langa juda en jerusalem.
english: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.

kriol: dumaji yu na oldei maindimbat mi. yu na brabli strongbala blanga seibum mi brom main enamimob jis laiga strongwan haus.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

kriol: deibin luk wanim yawei gin dum wen imbin dum ola gudwan ting langa solwoda.
english: these see Yahweh's deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

kriol: nomo larram mi plei gita igin if mi fogedabat yu, jerusalem.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

kriol: nobodi garra jidan deya en baiyim ola gol en silba en purdiwan ston en pelbid nekleis. nobodi kaan baiyim ola pepulwan en redwan en waitwan en silkwan matiriyal blanga werrimon na. nobodi deya na blanga baiyim ola enijing weya deibin meigim garram det speshal gudsmelwan wud en det purdiwan wud en detlot shainiwan boun blanga elafen en det aiyan en det strongwan aiyan en det mabul ston.
english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

kriol: ol detlot breibwan ting na benaiya bin dum,
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.

kriol: wal wen sol bin jidan king, ola isreil pipul bin abum loda enami ebriweya, en king sol bin oldei fait langa olabat. imbin fait langa detlot pipul langa detlot thribala kantri gulum moweb, eman en idam, en imbin fait langa ola king blanga detlot pipul gulum soba, en imbin fait langa ola filastain pipul du. nomeda weya imbin oldei fait, bat stil imbin oldei bidim olabat,
english: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.

kriol: wal yumob bin bon igin, en blanga tharran na yumob garra libum det nogudbalawei, en yumob kaan dalimbat laiya, en yumob kaan jidan tufeis, en yumob kaan jelasbat miselp, en yumob kaan tok nogudbalawei blanga enibodi.
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

kriol: dijan na det mesij yawei det trubala god bin dalim mi blanga det kantri gulum bebalon en im pipul olabat.
english: The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

kriol: nomeda ol detlot ting bin hepin langa job, im nomo bin tok nogudbala ting, en im nomo bin bleim langa god.
english: In all this, Job didn't sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

kriol: wal blanga tharran na mi askimbat yumob blanga meigim mi brabli gudbinji en jidan wan pipul garram wan filing en wan main, en yumob garra laigim gija brabliwei.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

kriol: yawei, yu irrim olabat langa top en larramgo fri detlot isreil pipul brom det nogudbalawei blanga olabat en titjimbat olabat blanga jidan gudwei. en afta yawei, yu jandim rein langa dijan kantri blanga yu, weya yubin gibit langa yu pipul olabat blanga jidan olagijawan.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

kriol: mi jidan garram loda trabul en mi jidan nogudbinjiwei, bat detlot lowa blanga yu meigim mi jidan brabli gudbinji.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

kriol: en wen detlot bilibamob bin gedim det nyus, deibin deigim sol langa det taun gulum sesariya, bat brom deya deibin jandim im langa det taun gulum tasas.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

kriol: wal wen menahem bin jidan king blanga isreil, tiglathpalisa det king blanga asiriya, bin go blanga teikoba langa isreil. en king menahem bin peiyim 34,000 kilogrem silba langa king tiglathpalisa blanga album im jidan strongbalawan blanga lukaftumbat det kantri.
english: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

kriol: wal king reiyabowam bin meigim ola kopawan shild blanga deigim pleis blanga ola golwan shild, en imbin gibit detlot langa ola solja hubin oldei lukaftumbat detlot geit langa detlot bigwan haus blanga im.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house.

kriol: brom deya na ol detlot haibala serramonimen en lowamen en najalot bosmen bin deigim jisas langa det gabman bos neim pailat,
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

kriol: jisas bin tok, "wanbala brom yumob nomo klinwan," dumaji imbin sabi wujan det men garra hendimoba im langa detlot pipul hu garra kilim im ded.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, "You are not all clean."

kriol: ai garra meigim blanga yu golwan tjein garram loda purdiwan silbawan sheip langa det tjein.
english: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.

kriol: jisas bin askim detlot pipul na, "wal wanim yumob reken det boswan blanga det gadin garra dum? ai dalim yumob. im garra kaman en kilim detlot fama ded, en im garra larram najalot fama rentim det gadin.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

kriol: nobodi kaan grebum det enami blanga im en larramgo im fri. bat yubin dum lagijat langa mi. wal yawei garra gudbala langa yu, dumaji yubin gudbala langa mi.
english: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me today.

kriol: brom detlot bigwan hil langa lebanan wi garra kadimdan ola sidatri yu wandim. wi garra taiyimap holbit en pudum langa solwoda, wulijim dei gin flout olawei langa jopa. brom deya yu gin deigim langa jerusalem." lagijat na king hairam bin raidimbat det leda.
english: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem."

kriol: wal yawei bin tok langa eran,
english: Then Yahweh said to Aaron,

kriol: deya lida langa ol im pipul olabat ai garra gibit im wanim aibin pramis.
english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

kriol: en im ranimapbat olabat brabli faswan, en blanga im dubala fut oni tatjim det graun lilbit en im kaan ardim im fut wen im ranranbat. najing.
english: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

kriol: "en wen im kaman, detlot blainwan pipul garra luk, en detlot hu nomo irrim enijing, olabat garra irrim gudwei na.
english: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

kriol: bat if det sowa im waitwan en nomo dipwan en im stil gudwan rait insaid, en det heya im nomo waitwan, wal det serramonimen garra gajim im en deigidawei im fo 7 dei, en im garra jidan miselp en nobodi nomo lau blanga luk im.
english: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn't deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn't turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

kriol: yawei, langa yu, ola nogudbala pipul jidan jis laik rabish. blanga tharran na, ai laigim bulurrumbat ol yu lowa.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

kriol: wen lilwan biginini bilib langa mi en sambodi meigim im gowei brom mi, wal mobeda det sambodi taiyimap miselp garram bigbala ston en tjakam miselp langa woda en kilim miselp ded bifo im meigim det biginini bulurrum det nogudbalawei.
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

kriol: yawei nomo laigim detlot ofring weya detlot nogudbala pipul oldei gibitbat, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot trubala pipul weya oldei preipreibat.
english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

kriol: "wal ai nomo bin sabi wanim blanga dum, en aibin lafta askim pol if im wandi go langa jerusalem en larram olabat kotim im deya blanga detlot ting.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

kriol: "deigim det men atsaid brom det kemp. ebribodi hubin irrim im tok nogudbalawei garra pudum olabat bingga ontop langa det men hed en dei garra tok im gilti na. afta na ola pipul brom det kemp garra kilim im ded garram ston.
english: "Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

kriol: bat det najawan rum biyain langa det ketin bin det brabli seikridwan rum,
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

kriol: "wal wen det 70 yiya garra gopas, yawei garra larram pipul jidan langa taya igin en dumbat wek. det taun garra stat selimbat ebrijing igin langa najalot kantri en meigimbat loda mani.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

kriol: wal aibin stat kraikrai detmatj na, dumaji det einjul nomo bin faindim enibodi gudwan blanga opinimap det rolapwan peipa en luk insaid.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

kriol: wal yawei det boswan god bin kipgon tok, "langa det feswan dei langa det feswan manth dei garra kilim wanbala yangwan buligi en im kaan abum enijing rong langa im en dei garra gibit blanga det sekrifais ofring blanga meigim det serramoni pleis jidan klinbala.
english: "'The Lord Yahweh says: "In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

kriol: im meigim detlot bigwan hil langa lebanan jamparanbat wulijim gabigabi, en im meigim det bigwan hil gulum heman jamp wulijim yangwan buligi.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

kriol: "yu garra bradin blanga god dumaji im na bos blanga hebin.
english: "Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

kriol: yawei det trubala god bin kipgon tok,
english: Yahweh's word came again to me, saying,

kriol: wal jon bin tok, "mi oldei beptaisimbat pipul garram woda. bat sambodi im iya langa yumob, en yumob nomo sabi im.
english: John answered them, "I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don't know.

kriol: en det stori blanga mosis bin jis laiga pitja blanga jisas, dumaji jisas krais bin duwit langa god brabliwei du. bat imbin jidan laiga san. im nomo bin jidan wekinmen blanga det haus blanga god seimwei laik mosis bin jidan. jisas bin jidan bos blanga det haus, en blanga tharran na im haibala langa mosis. wal wi na jis laiga haus blanga god, en wi garra gudbinji en dalimbat ola najalot pipul, en wi kaan bradin blanga enijing en nokap, dumaji if wi gobekgobek, wal wi nomo jidan jis laiga haus blanga god.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

kriol: "if enibodi nomo sabi en dumbat nogudbala ting en breigim det lowa, wal im stil gilti en im garra pei blanga det nogudbala ting.
english: "If anyone sins, doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, though he didn't know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

kriol: "yawei oldei lukaftumbat mi, en wen mi oldei abum trabul, mi oldei go langa im, dumaji im jis laiga strongbala ston weya ai gin blandim miselp brom main enami olabat.
english: and he said: "Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

kriol: afta esra bin gowei brom det serramoni pleis en imbin gowin langa det rum blanga jehohana det san blanga eliyashib en deya na imbin nogudbinji brabliwei wen imbin jinggabat blanga detlot nogud ting weya detlot pipul hubin kambek brom det kantri weya deibin jidan prisana bin dumbat. im nomo bin dagat o dringgim enijing.
english: Then Ezra rose up from before God's house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn't eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

kriol: "main pipul olabat, yumob na jidan main witnis, en main ronwan wekinmen olabat. mi na bin pikimat yumob. ai wandim yumob garra sabi mi, en trastim mi en sabi oni mi na god. mi na wanbala god olagijawan. nobodi mowa jidan laik mi. najing.
english: "You are my witnesses," says Yahweh, "With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

kriol: larram det einjul blanga yawei kilim olabat wen dei buldanbat olawei langa det dakbala en slipriwan roud.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh's angel pursuing them.

kriol: imbin jinggabat langa imselp, "maitbi detlot drimin blanga detlot siriya pipul bin album det king blanga bidim mi. maitbi if ai gibit sekrifais ofring langa detlot drimin sheip dei gin album mi." wal tharran bin det brabli nogudwan ting weya king eihes bin dumbat en imbin go mowes blanga im en juda bin binijap du.
english: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, "Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me." But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

kriol: afta wen king eihes bin go langa dameskas blanga midim king tiglathpalisa, imbin luk det teibul blanga ofring en imbin jandimbek lilwan teibul jis laik det teibul blanga ofring langa det serramonimen neim yuraiya wulijim im gin bildimap detkain teibul blanga ofring.
english: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

kriol: wal laswan na jisas krais bin shoum miselp langa mi wen mi nomo bin bulurrum im.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

kriol: wal yumob garra kilim ded ebri yangboi. en yumob garra kilim ded ebri gel hubin silipsilipbat garram eni men,
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

kriol: wal wen yumob jinggabat mi en apalas en pida, yumob kaan jinggabat melabat jidan haibala men. yumob garra jinggabat melabat wekinmen blanga jisas krais, en yumob garra jinggabat melabat jidan bos blanga detlot wed blanga god weya imbin oldei blandimbat bifo.
english: So let a man think of us as Christ's servants and stewards of God's mysteries.

kriol: en juda bin dedi blanga peres en sera, en det mami blanga peres en sera bin neim teima. peres bin dedi blanga hesran, en hesran bin dedi blanga rem.
english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

kriol: "wal ol yumob serramonimen hu oldei wek langa det seikridwan teibul deya langa det serramoni pleis, yumob garra werrimon rabishwan klos blanga sori miselp, en yumob garra go langa det serramoni pleis en kraikrai deya olnait, dumaji nomo eni sid daga en wain blanga gibit ofring langa yawei.
english: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God's house.

kriol: bat det pleis weya detlot haibala serramonimen oldei dumbat olabat wek, im nomo det riliwan seikridwan pleis. im jis laiga kopi blanga det riliwan seikridwan pleis deya langa hebin. im jis laiga pitja blanga det riliwan pleis. wi sabi tharran, dumaji god bin gibit woning langa mosis wen imbin dalim im blanga bildimap det seikridwan tent. imbin tok, "yu garra meiksho yu bulurrum det plen weya aibin gibit yu ontop langa det hil."
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, "See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain."

kriol: bat stil deibin go langa det hil kantri, bat det seikridwan boks en mosis nomo bin libum det kemp.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh's covenant and Moses didn't depart out of the camp.

kriol: trubala ai dalim yumob. im brabli nogud if det laibalawan god garra panishim yu.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

kriol: wanmo mi dalim yumob. im brabli ad blanga ritj pipul blanga go langa hebin. yumob jinggabat det kemul na. det kemul kaan gowin langa det hol blanga nidul. bat ai dalim yumob. im isibala blanga det kemul blanga gowin langa det nidul hol. bat im ad blanga ritjmen blanga gowin langa hebin."
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom."

kriol: wal mosis bin tok, "wen wibin jidan deya langa det hil gulum sainai, yawei det trubala god blanga wi bin tok langa wi, 'yumob bin jidan longtaim na langa dijan pleis.
english: "Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, 'You have lived long enough at this mountain.

kriol: garram ol detlot ting na, nebusaradan det boswan wekinmen bin deigimwei seraiya det haibala serramonimen, sefanaiya det sekanwan serramonimen, en detlot thribala haibala wekinmen blanga det serramoni pleis en imbin meigim olabat jidan prisana na.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,

kriol: en jisas bin holdim det blain men langa im bingga, en imbin deigim im atsaid brom det taun, en jisas bin spit langa det blain men ai, en imbin pudum im bingga langa im ai, en afta jisas bin askim im if im gin luk,
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

kriol: wal mosis bin dalim im, "det nois im nomo det nois weya deibin win langa fait, en im nomo det nois weya sambodi bin bidim olabat langa fait du. det nois yu irrimbat olabat singsing."
english: He said, "It isn't the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear."

kriol: yu lisin langa olabat brom det skai. larramgo fri det king en ola pipul brom isreil brom olabat nogudbalawei. titjimbat olabat blanga dumbat ola raitwan ting. afta na yu jandim rein langa dijan kantri blanga yu, weya yubin gibit langa yu pipul olabat blanga abum olagija.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

kriol: ai sabi bigmob brom yumob bin dum olkain nogudbala ting weya olabat bodi bin wandim olabat blanga dum. ai sabi olabat bin silipsilipbat garram enibodi en dumbat olkain nogudbala ting lagijat. en mi wori blanga yumob, dumaji wen ai garra kaman deya, god garra meigim mi brabli sheim, en ai garra brabli nogudbinji blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin dumbat basdam, dumaji yumob nomo bin libum det olbalawei, en yumob kipgon dumbat ol detlot nogudbala ting.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

kriol: yumob bin kaman langa jisas. im na bin meigim det nyubalawei blanga wi garram im blad, en yumob bin kaman langa det blad, dumaji thru langa det blad blanga jisas, god bin meigim brabli gudwan pramis. det pramis im mobedawan langa det pramis weya imbin meigim thru langa det blad blanga eibul.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

kriol: bambai na det bos blanga im garra kambek wen im nomo sabi im garra kambek,
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn't expect it and in an hour when he doesn't know it,

kriol: wal deibin gibit ola femili blanga kohath hubin kamat brom det serramonimen neim eran dislot taun na.
english: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:

kriol: olabat jidanbat langa det dakbala pleis, en olabat nomo langa lait na.
english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

kriol: im tok, "haulong yumob garra kipgon jadjimbat ebribodi rongwei? haulong yumob garra kipgon bekimap detlot nogudbala pipul?
english: "How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?" Selah.

kriol: yumob oldei meigimbat plen blanga dum nogudbala ting langa najalot pipul. olabat jis laik ol detlot poisinwan sneik weya kamat brom detlot eig blanga det poisinwan sneik. en detlot plen im jis laik yumob trai blanga meigim klos brom det spidaweb, bat yumob kaan meigim klos garram det web en yumob kaan blandim miselp biyain langa tharran, dumaji yumob brabli nogudbala en krulbala.
english: They hatch adders' eggs and weave the spider's web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok, "ol yumob isreil pipul, yumob bin kamat brom jeikob femili lain, en brom det klen blanga juda. yumob oldei tok blanga weship langa mi na yawei, bat yumob oldei dalimbat laiya.
english: "Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by Yahweh's name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—

kriol: brom deya aibin tok, "yumob irrim mi na yumob isreil pipul. yumob tridimbat detlot lobala pipul brabli nogudbalawei en yumob oldei wandim blanga binijimap detlot powan pipul langa dijan kantri.
english: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,

kriol: en jehoiyada en ola boswan solja hubin oldei wotjimbat det king en det bigwan haus, bin ol go garram im. deibin deigim king jowesh brom det serramoni pleis raidap langa det bigwan haus. en ola pipul bin bulurrum olabat. king jowesh bin gowin langa det solja geit en imbin jidan langa det speshalwan tjeya.
english: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from Yahweh's house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. He sat on the throne of the kings.

kriol: en if enibodi askim yunbala wotfo yunbala deigimat det dongki, wal yunbala dalim im, 'dumaji bos wandim.'"
english: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying it?' say to him: 'The Lord needs it.'"

kriol: bambai na wen imbin gulijap taim blanga god garra deigimbek jisas langa hebin, jisas bin jinggabat blanga go langa jerusalem,
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem.

kriol: king eihes bin dai en deibin berrim im bodi langa det greibyad blanga ola king deya langa jerusalem det taun blanga deibid. en im san hesakaiya bin jidan det nyuwan king.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David's city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

kriol: bat if im nomo baiyimbek bifo det yiya bin binij, wal im garra lujim det haus, en det haus garra jidan blanga det men hubin baiyim en blanga im bigininimob. det haus kaan gobek langa det men wen det namba 50 yiya garra kaman wen ola kantri garra gobek langa ola fesmob boswan blanga det kantri.
english: If it isn't redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

kriol: en det king bin majurrumap ola men brom det taun blanga ranimap olabat, en joshuwa en detlot solja bin meigim olabat kipgon gowei longwei brom det taun.
english: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

kriol: wal detlot pipul deya langa det miting pleis bin meigimbat bigismob nois, dumaji deibin ol jinginatbat olkain difrinkain wed, en dei nomo bin sabi wotfo deibin ol midap deya langa det miting pleis.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn't know why they had come together.

kriol: "yumob garra teiknodis langa mi. yumob kaman langa mi wulijim yumob garra jidan laibala. ai garra meigim strongwan pramis garram yumob. ai garra kipgon laigim yumob detmatj en ai garra oldei jidan garram yumob, jis laik aibin meigim pramis langa king deibid.
english: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

kriol: en wi garra yusum detlot ebrijing weya im gibit wi blanga dum gudbala ting langa pipul, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, "gudbala pipul oldei gibit enijing langa detlot pipul hu nomo garram enijing, en dei oldei tridim olabat raitwei olataim." lagijat na im tok langa oltestaman.
english: As it is written, "He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever."

kriol: if yu jidanbat leisiwan yu garra abum trabul eniweya yu go, bat if yu jidan trubalawei wal yu kaan abum eni trabul.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

kriol: wal enibodi hu ridim dijan buk garra jinggabat brabliwei dijan woning weya jisas bin gibit langa ola wekinmen blanga im. jisas bin tok, "longtaim det speshalwan mesinja blanga god neim denyul bin raidimdan dijan wed langa oltestaman, 'brabli nogudbala ting garra jidan langa det juwish serramoni pleis.' lagijat na denyul bin tok.
english: "When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

kriol: imbin dalim dubala, "yunbala go lida langa det wan taun, en deya na yunbala garra faindim wanbala yangwan dongki im taidap. nobodi bin raidim det dongki bifo. en yunbala garra deigimat det roup en bringimbek det dongki iya langa mi.
english: saying, "Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

kriol: wal king jehosafet bin jidan mowa brabli haibala king na. olaran langa juda imbin bildimap brabli strongbala taun,
english: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim olabat, "yumob nomo wandi stapam im, dumaji if enibodi nomo tok nogudbalawei blanga mi, wal im langa wi said."
english: Jesus said to him, "Don't forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us."

kriol: wal det king bin tok, "hu yunbala reken yunbala? yunbala kaan meigim ola wekinmen libum olabat wek. yunbala dalim olabat blanga gobek langa wek na.
english: The king of Egypt said to them, "Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!"

kriol: en afta wen ol detlot pipul hubin majurrumap miselp deya bin luk wanim bin hepin, deibin ol gobek langa olabat kemp, en deibin kraikrai en kilimbat miselp langa olabat tjes, dumaji deibin nogudbinji brabliwei.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

kriol: imbin gibit oda langa im wekinmenmob blanga gajim mi en beldim mi en taiyimap mi garram tjein gulijap langa det benjamin geit langa det serramoni pleis.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh's house.

kriol: wal god na gin album yumob blanga nomo tenbek langa det nogudbalawei, en im gin meigim yumob jidan brabli gudwei, rili klinwan nomo garram eni bleim, en afta wen im meigim yumob jidan gudwei lagijat, im garra deigim yumob langa imselp.
english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

kriol: en imbin jandim najawan wed igin langa king eiheb, "ai garra bringimap ola solja main blanga binijimap ebrijing langa sameriya en nomo enijing kaan jidan. dumaji detlot drimin garra kilim mi ded if ai nomo dum dis ting." lagijat na detlot mesinja bin tok.
english: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, "The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me."

kriol: en waitwan hosis bin pulumbat det namba 3 bagi, en ola brabli strongwan hosis garram loda spot bin pulumbat det namba 4 bagi.
english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

kriol: detlot nogudbala pipul heidim god brabliwei. dei oldei tok miselp, "god kaan panishim wi." wotfo god larram olabat tok lagijat?
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, "God won't call me into account"?

kriol: wal pida bin kipgon tok, "lagijat na det ting bin hepin, dumaji longtaim deibid bin raidimdan dijan wed langa det buk gulum saam. imbin tok, 'nobodi kaan jidan langa det pleis. im garra jidan emtiwan.' en imbin tok, 'sambodi garra deigim pleis blanga im en dumbat im wek.' lagijat na deibid bin tok.
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, 'Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;' and, 'Let another take his office.'

kriol: dei garra jidan laik strongwan solja hu gin kipgon fait ontop langa ola madiwan roud. dei garra fait detlot solja garram hosis en bidim olabat dumaji mi na yawei garra jidan garram olabat."
english: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because Yahweh is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.

kriol: wal ola juwish pipul bin grebum dijan men, en deibin nili kilim im ded. bat wen aibin faindat imbin abum det rait seimwei laik ola roman pipul, aibin jandim main solja olabat blanga seibum im,
english: "This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

kriol: en yu garra jidan seifwan en najing kaan ardim yu.
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won't stumble.

kriol: wal imbin pudumat im bingga en imbin grebum main heya, en det spirit blanga god bin lidimap mi brabli haibala langa top en imbin deigim mi langa jerusalem. imbin deigim mi insaid langa det nowathwei geit blanga det serramoni pleis, en deya na wanbala brabli nogudwan drimin sheip bin jidan en imbin meigim god brabli wail.
english: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

kriol: wal ola kristjan pipul hu jidan powan garra gudbinji, dumaji god garra meigim olabat ritj langa im wei.
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

kriol: brom deya det haibala wekinmen bin jandap en imbin jingat garram det hibru langgus, "yumob lisin na langa dijan mesij brom det boswan king langa asiriya.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spoke, saying, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.

english: Now therefore don't let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don't believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?"

english: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.

kriol: yumob sabi? yumob garra abum det seimwan main laik jisas krais bin abum. en wotkain main imbin abum?
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

english: His name shall be called in Israel, "The house of him who had his sandal removed."

english: He burned Yahweh's house, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.

english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father's wife.

kriol: detlot jintail pipul hu bulurrum god garra kipum dislot lowa na, dumaji brom longtaim wibin oldei ridimat det lowa blanga mosis langa ola juwish miting pleis ebri sebathdei, en wibin oldei titjimbat detlot lowa langa ola pipul langa ebri taun du." lagijat na jeims bin tok.
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath."

kriol: detlot olibtri garra gro ebriweya langa yumob kantri, bat yumob kaan abum eni oliboil, dumaji detlot olib daga garra buldan.
english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won't anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

kriol: ilaisha bin askim im, "weya det eks bin buldan?" en det men bin shoum im det pleis weya imbin buldan en ilaisha bin kadim wan stik en imbin tjakam insaid langa det woda en imbin meigim det hedpat blanga det aiyan eks flout.
english: The man of God asked, "Where did it fall?" He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.

kriol: deibin testimat god brabliwei wen deibin dalimbat im wanim deibin wandim blanga dagat.
english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

kriol: bat detlot stakmen bin tok, "melabat garra weidabat iya blanga ola najalot stakmen. wen olabat kaman, melabat garra rolimwei det ston, dumaji wantaim melabat oldei wodarim ola ship blanga melabat."
english: They said, "We can't, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well's mouth. Then we will water the sheep."

kriol: ol yumob pipul langa ninaba, yumob luk na! det ami weya garra binijimap yumob bin kaman blanga fait langa yumob na. wal yumob garra meigim miselp redi blanga fait. ola solja blanga yumob garra jidan redi deya langa det taun, en dei garra wotjimbat det roud du,
english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

kriol: wal yawei, god blanga melabat, yu seibum melabat brom detlot asiriya pipul wulijim ol detlot pipul ebriweya langa dijan wel garra sabi oni yu na yawei det trubala god." lagijat na king hesakaiya bin prei.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone."

kriol: wal wen det king bin kilim jeims, ola juwish pipul bin gudbinji, dumaji dei nomo bin wandim enibodi blanga bulurrum jisas, en wen det king bin luk olabat bin gudbinji, imbin jinggabat blanga kilim pida du, en wen deibin abum det serramoni gulum damba nomo garram raising, imbin pudum pida langa jeil, dumaji imbin wandi kotim im lida langa ola pipul wen det serramoni garra binij. wal det king bin dalim sambala solja blanga maindimbat pida, en deibin abum 16 solja deya langa det jeil, en ebritaim fobala solja bin oldei maindimbat im,
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

kriol: yu si? wen mi jidan garram juwish pipul, mi oldei meigim miselp jidan jis laiga juwish men, dumaji ai wandi meigim detlot juwish pipul bilib langa jisas krais. nomeda det lowa blanga olabat nomo jidan bos blanga mi, bat stil ai larram det lowa jidan bos blanga mi, dumaji ai wandim olabat garra lisin langa mi wulijim dei garra bilib langa jisas krais.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

kriol: goma bin abum thribala san neim eshkenes, rifeth en togama.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

kriol: en blanga tharran na mi askimbat yumob blanga go langa im en shoum im yumob laigim im brabliwei.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

kriol: if enibodi dalim yumob, jisas krais bin kambek olredi, yumob kaan bilib det wed. yumob kaan nogudbinji streidawei. maitbi dei reken det holi spirit bin gibit melabat det wed, o maitbi dei reken melabat bin toktok det wed, o maitbi dei reken melabat bin raidimdan det wed langa leda.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

english: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.

kriol: yawei det trubala god blanga wi, im na nambawan. ola drimin sheip en ol det najalot pawa nomo enijing. im na det brabli haibala strongbalawan god en yumob garra duwit wanim im tok. im gibit ebribodi feyago. im nomo meigim enibodi peiyim im mani blanga tok blanga im.
english: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn't respect persons or take bribes.

kriol: wal hau gin wi jidan brabli gudbala langa im? wi jidan jis laik detlot wem." lagijat na bilded bin tok.
english: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!"

kriol: bambai na det olgamen bin tok, "ruth, opa bin gobek langa im kantrimen olabat en langa im drimin. wal yu gobek garram im du."
english: She said, "Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law."

kriol: wal if enibodi abumbat trabul, im garra prei langa god. en if enibodi gudbinji, wal im garra sing blanga gibit theingks langa god.
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

kriol: en joshuwa bin majurrumap ola isreil solja, en imbin dalim ola boswan solja, "yumob kaman iya en pudum yumob fut langa dislot faibala king nek." en deibin kaman deya, en deibin pudum olabat fut ontop langa olabat nek.
english: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, "Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings." They came near, and put their feet on their necks.

kriol: en imbin lukaftumbat im wen imbin abum det trabul, en afta wen imbin go langa det king, god bin meigim im klebabala, en god bin meigim det king laigim im, en det king bin meigim im jidan bos blanga det kantri en blanga det king haus du.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

kriol: wal wen dubala bin dalimbat olabat, jisas bin kamat langa olabat deya gin, en imbin tok, "gudei main braja olabat."
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, "Peace be to you."

kriol: wal nomo longtaim na det skai bin go brabli dakbala en det bigiswan win bin kaman en hebiwan rein bin stat buldan na. king eiheb bin gedim im bagi en imbin gobek langa im kemp langa jesriyel.
english: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

kriol: wen deibin dringgimbat wain, det king bin askim esta igin, "wanim yu wandim esta? yu gin askim mi blanga haf main kantri en ai gin gibit langa yu haf."
english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, "What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed."

kriol: afta na besalel bin meigim det najawan teibul blanga ofring garram det wud brom det wadultri blanga barnim detlot gudsmelwan medisin. imbin meigim det teibul skweyawan, en det teibul bin jidan 0.45 mita longwei en 0.45 mita kroswei en 0.9 mita apendan. imbin meigim fobala ampat ontop langa ola kona blanga det teibul,
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

kriol: "ol detlot isreil pipul bin meigimbat bigismob bigwan haus. bat dei nomo jinggabat mi hubin meigim olabat. en detlot juda pipul bin bildimap bigismob strongbala taun weya olabat enami kaan bidim olabat. bat ai garra barnimap ol detlot strongbala taun blanga olabat." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses."

kriol: yumob sabi wanim garra hepin, en yumob sabi samting deya im nomo oldei larram detlot ting hepin yet. bat seitin im olredi deya, en im meigimbat ola pipul nomo wandim teiknodis langa det lowa blanga god. det brabli wikitwan men garra kamat wen im det rait taim. bat detlot ting kaan hepin raidap god garra deigidawei det sambodi hubin holdimbek det wikitwan.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

kriol: jis laik detlot gudsmelwan purdiflawa jidan langa lilwan beig langa main nek, wal main olmen leidanbat langa main tjes.
english: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.

kriol: wal hena nomo bin wandi go garram ola femili, en imbin dalim elkana, "ai kaan deigim dis lilboi yet, dumaji im stil dringgimbat milk brom mi. afta wen im binij dringgimbat milk, det taim na ai garra deigim im langa det seikridwan tent blanga yawei en gibit im langa god, en afta im garra jidanbat deya olagija."
english: But Hannah didn't go up, for she said to her husband, "Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahweh, and stay there forever."

kriol: nomo larram mi dai, dumaji mi jidan trubala langa yu. seibum mi dumaji mi blanga yu wekinmen, en mi trastim yu.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written."

english: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

english: To the woman he said, "I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you."

english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, "Don't say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?' (that is, to bring Christ down);

english: 'Speak to the house of Israel, "The Lord Yahweh says: 'Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

kriol: brom bigininitaim yubin sabi det wed blanga god, en det baibul na gin meigim yu sabi hau god garra seibum yu wen yu bilib langa jisas krais.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

kriol: afta thrideistaim, jerabowam en ol detlot pipul bin gobek langa king reiyabowam jis laik imbin dalim olabat.
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, "Come to me again the third day."

english: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, "There is the noise of war in the camp."

kriol: wal yawei bin jandim im spirit langa othniyel, en imbin meigim im lida blanga detlot isreil pipul. brom deya othniyel en ola isreil solja bin go en fait langa det king en im solja olabat, en yawei bin meigim othniyel win,
english: Yahweh's Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

kriol: en ol im pipul olabat bin bilib im wed, en deibin sing song blanga preisim im.
english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

kriol: det dokta neim luk im brabliwan fren blanga wi, en im en det men neim dimas dubala tok gudei langa yumob du.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

english: saying, "This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law."

english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

kriol: "wal nomeda yawei bin libum wi, bat stil im garra sori langa wi bambai.
english: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

english: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

english: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.

kriol: wal wen jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin kamat langa jerusalem, deibin go langa det serramoni pleis blanga ola juwish pipul, en deya na jisas bin luk loda pipul bin baiyimbat en selimbat olkain ting blanga yusum langa det serramoni. wal jisas bin gitwail, en imbin andimwei ol detlot pipul atsaid brom det pleis, en imbin tipimoba ola teibul blanga detlot pipul hubin hendulumbat ola mani, en imbin tjakidawei ola tjeya blanga detlot pipul hubin selimbat ola bard,
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kriol: wal yawei det boswan god bin pikimat det dei wen detlot pipul hu oldei jidan praudbala en laigim miselp garra jidan brabli lobala.
english: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—

english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

english: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen's equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.

kriol: im garra meigim det kantri jidan garram loda gudwan frut daga, en meigim det frut daga brabli gudwan ebri sisan.
english: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

english: After Methuselah's birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
