english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, "Sit here while I pray."

kriol: wal job bin tok langa elifas,
english: Then Job answered,

kriol: bat det bos bin tok, 'nomo! ai nomo sabi yumob.'"
english: But he answered, 'Most certainly I tell you, I don't know you.'

kriol: sambala pipul nomo gibit feyago langa ola po pipul blanga growimap daga langa detlot gudbala graun langa detlot pedik weya olabat nomo yusumbat.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people's fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

kriol: brom juda na det haibala bos blanga main pipul olabat garra kaman. im garra jidan laik det meinwan ston weya holdimap det haus. en ola strongbala bos, en ola boswan blanga ola solja garra ol kaman brom juda na.
english: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

kriol: jandim yu lait en yu trubalawei blanga lidim en deigimbek mi langa jerusalem langa yu seikridwan hil, en langa yu speshalwan pleis weya yu jidan.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

kriol: wal pol bin tok, "jon bin oldei beptaisim detlot pipul hubin tenim miselp brom olabat nogudbalawei, en imbin oldei dalim ola isreil pipul blanga bilib langa det boswan hu garra kaman biyain langa im. en jisas krais na det boswan."
english: Paul said, "John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus."

kriol: oni wanbala ting yu garra jinggabat. en yu sista meri bin sabi det rait ting, en nobodi kaan deigidawei det ting brom im."
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her."

kriol: wal det seim dei det king bin gibit oda langa detlot jigibala ijip bos blanga detlot isreil pipul, en imbin gibit det oda langa ola isreil ofsaida weya detlot bos bin pikimat brom detlot isreil pipul.
english: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,

kriol: en dei garra meigim gudsmelwan medisin en teibul garram dubala pol weya dei garra barnim det medisin, en dei garra meigim ketin blanga det dowa blanga det tent,
english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

kriol: ebritaim wen deibin oldei shifdim kemp, olabat bin oldei jidan langa det seimwan oda. det juda klen garram det naja dubala klen garra oldei go lida, en neishan det san blanga aminadeb, im na det boswan blanga det juda klen.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

kriol: wal huwa bin det feswan san blanga keilab en im waif neim efrath, en im bigininimob bin stadimap det taun gulum bethlahem. huwa bin abum thribala san neim itam, penyuwel en isa. itam bin abum thribala san neim jesriyel, ishma en aidbash, en wanbala doda neim heisalelponai. penyuwel bin stadimap det taun gulum gedowa, en isa bin stadimap det taun gulum husha.
english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

kriol: "bat stil yumob isreil pipul oldei tok, 'mi brabli gudbala. yawei im nomo wail langa mi.' bat mi na yawei garra panishim yumob dumaji yumob reken yumob brabli gudbala.
english: "Yet you said, 'I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.' "Behold, I will judge you, because you say, 'I have not sinned.'

kriol: wal wen josef bin jinggabat lagijat, god bin gibit im drim, en langa det drim wan einjul bin kamat langa im, en det einjul bin tok, "josef! grengrensan blanga deibid! yu nomo libum det yanggel. yu garra gajim im blanga yu waif, dumaji det holi spirit bin gibit im det beibi.
english: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, don't be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

kriol: en wen det taim blanga kraikrai bin binij, deibid bin jandim wed langa det gel blanga kaman langa im, en wen imbin go langa im kemp, deibid bin merrit langa im, en det gel bin abum lilboi blanga im. wal yawei nomo bin gudbinji langa king deibid blanga tharran na weya imbin silip garram det gel en afta hau imbin meigim det gel hasbin dai langa fait.
english: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahweh.

kriol: meiseiya, ilaija, shemaiya, jehiyel en yusaiya brom det femili blanga herim,
english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

kriol: brom deya neksdei na det bigwan gel bin tok langa im lilwan sista, "aibin silip garram yunmi dedi naitaim. wal yunmi garra meigim im jidan drangginwan igin, en yu lafta silip garram im tunait. yu lafta dum lagijat wulijim yunmi gin abum beibi blanga yunmi ronwan dedi."
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, "Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let's make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father's family line."

kriol: nomo eni king win dumaji im garram strongbala ami. nomo eni solja win dumaji im strongbala.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

kriol: wal nobodi kaman langa det serramoni pleis na en weshipbat ebri seikridwan dei. detlot roud langa jerusalem jidan emtiwan, en nobodi nomo oldei gowei brom det taun en nobodi kaman deya, najing. ol detlot gel hubin oldei singsingbat, olabat garram brabli nogudwan trabul, en detlot serramonimen kraikraibat du.
english: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.

kriol: det einjul blanga yawei wotjimbat detlot pipul hu abum rispek langa yawei. im seibum olabat brom ola trabul.
english: Yahweh's angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

kriol: "wal god garra panishim ola pipul hu jidanbat tudei. im garra peibek blanga ol detlot mesinja weya deibin kilimbat ded brom det taim wen god bin meigim ebrijing en deibin kilimbat ded eibul raidap weya deibin kilimbat ded sekaraiya rait langa midul langa det serramoni pleis blanga ola juwish pipul. deibin kilim im ded langa midul langa det seikridwan pleis en det teibul blanga ofring. "trubala ai dalim yumob. god garra panishim ola pipul hu jidanbat tudei blanga peibek blanga ol detlot mesinja weya deibin kilimbat ded longtaim.
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

kriol: en eni mani dei meigim brom detkain ting dei kaan deigim deya langa det serramoni pleis blanga yawei blanga kipum det pramis blanga im. yawei brabli nogudbinji blanga detkain nogudbala ting.
english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

kriol: brom deya yu garra majurrumap ola isreil pipul, en detlot libai pipul garra jandap lida langa det seikridwan tent blanga main.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

kriol: ai garra jandim pipul brom najawan kantri blanga binijimap bebalon, jis laik det win weya blowimweibat det draiwan gras. wen det taim garra kaman, olabat garra fait langa detlot bebalon solja brom ebrisaid en libum det kantri nomo garram enijing.
english: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.

kriol: brom deya aibin go langa jerusalem. aibin deya thrideis blanga abum spel,
english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

kriol: yu na main seifhaus en yu maindimbat mi. yu shoum mi wanim blanga dum, en lidim mi jis laik yubin pramis.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name's sake lead me and guide me.

kriol: yu garra jidan seifwan en yu kaan bradin, nomeda olabat tok nogudbala wed en trai blanga ardimbat yu.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

kriol: wal yawei bin brabli wail langa olabat, en imbin larram det king brom det kantri gulum mesapoteimiya go en fait langa olabat en bidim olabat. det king bin neim kusharishathaiyim, en imbin jidan bos blanga olabat fo 8 yiya.
english: Therefore Yahweh's anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

kriol: en im garra meigim ola dediwan jinggabat ola biginini en laigim olabat, en im garra meigim ola biginini jinggabat en laigim olabat dedi du, wulijim ai kaan kaman en toktok nogudbalawei blanga binijimap yumob kantri." lagijat na yawei det haibala bos bin tok. binij na.
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse."

kriol: bat olabat nomo bin tok enijing. wal jisas bin gajim det sikbala men, en imbin meigim im gudbala, en afta imbin jandimwei im.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

kriol: wal detlot jigiwan grashopa bin redi blanga go en fait na. deibin jis laiga hos weya solja oldei raidimbat blanga go en fait. langa olabat hed deibin abum samting jis laiga speshalwan goldinwan het, en deibin abum feis jis laik pipul.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people's faces.

kriol: wal yawei bin ensim mi, "orait. ai garra larram yu yusum buligi guna blanga meigim daga blanga yu blanga dagat. yu garra gugumbat garram det buligi guna.
english: Then he said to me, "Behold, I have given you cow's dung for man's dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it."

kriol: wal ol yumob ritj pipul, yumob lisin langa mi na. yumob garra kraikrai, dumaji bigwan trabul garra kaman langa yumob,
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

kriol: bat ai dalim yumob. yumob nomo wandi adwek blanga detkain daga weya oldei go nogud. yumob garra adwek blanga detkain daga weya meigim yu jidan laibala olagijawan. nobodi kaan gibit yumob detkain daga. oni mi na, dumaji mi na det speshalwan men, en main dedi god bin shoum yumob mi na garra gibit yumob det daga weya garra meigim yumob jidan garram det olagijawan laif." lagijat na jisas bin tok langa detlot pipul.
english: Don't work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him."

kriol: yumob granggibala! god bin meigim det atsaidpat, en imbin meigim det insaidpat langa yu du.
english: You foolish ones, didn't he who made the outside make the inside also?

kriol: wal sambodi bin bringimap denyul langa det king, en det king bin tok langa im, "yu na denyul det juwish men hu main dedi king nebakanesa bin bringimap brom juda, indit?
english: Then Daniel was brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, "Are you that Daniel of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

kriol: wal ol detlot enijing weya king reiyabowam bin dum, deibin raidimdan langa det buk gulum ola stori blanga detlot king blanga juda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kriol: wal wen detlot filastain pipul bin irrim det nois, deibin askimbat miselp, "wotfo ola isreil pipul jingatbat deya?" en wen deibin irrim ola isreil pipul bin abum det seikridwan boks blanga yawei, deibin brabli bradin,
english: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, "What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?" They understood that Yahweh's ark had come into the camp.

kriol: wal blanga detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum siriya yawei det trubala god im tok, "detlot pipul langa det taun gulum dameskas oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en blanga tharran na ai garra panishim olabat. deibin kilimbat ola pipul brom det kantri gulum giliyad brabli krulbalawei.
english: Yahweh says: "For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;

kriol: wal ebriyiya det men en im femili bin oldei go langa det taun gulum shailo blanga weship en gibit ofring langa yawei det boswan god. wal wan men deya langa det taun bin neim ilai, en imbin det serramonimen blanga yawei, en imbin abum dubala san neim hofni en finiyas, en det dubala san blanga im bin serramonimen blanga yawei du.
english: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to Yahweh of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to Yahweh, were there.

kriol: en yumob garra go ebriweya na en dalimbat ola najalot pipul blanga bulurrum det nyubalawei blanga god.
english: He sent them out to preach God's Kingdom and to heal the sick.

kriol: wal yu garra jinggabat wanim god bin dum. hu gin streitinimap samting weya god bin meigim krukidwan? nobodi kaan dum.
english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

kriol: wal pol bin kipgon jidan lilbit longtaim garram detlot bilibamob langa korinth, en afta imbin gowei brom olabat garram prisila en akwila, en deibin go langa det taun gulum sinkriyai, en deya na pol bin meigim speshalwan pramis langa god, en imbin kadimof im ronwan heya blanga kipum det pramis. brom deya deibin gowin langa bout, en deibin stat blanga go langa det kantri gulum siriya.
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

kriol: en yu holdim det dubala wadi mijamet, wulijim dubala garra jidan jis laik wanbala wadi.
english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

kriol: bat wen sambala pipul oldei abumbat detmatj trabul en adtaim, god oldei opinap olabat irriwol blanga titjimbat olabat.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

kriol: ai garra pudum aiyanwan yok langa ola pipul langa ebri kantri, en olabat garra dum adwek blanga king nebakanesa brom bebalon. ai garra meigim ola wailwan enimul dum adwek blanga im du." lagijat na aibin dalim im wanim yawei bin tok.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, "I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field."'"

kriol: lagijat na detlot lida blanga ola isreil pipul bin tok langa deibid wen deibin kaman langa im deya langa hebran. wal deibid bin agri langa olabat, en imbin meigim pramis langa olabat blanga jidan gudbala king blanga olabat, en imbin meigim det pramis lida langa yawei, en afta deibin spilim speshalwan oil ontop langa deibid hed blanga meigim im jidan king blanga ola isreil pipul.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.

kriol: imbin abum loda pipul brom det dubala kantri gulum taya en saidan bringimap blanga im loda sidatri wud.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

kriol: wal wen detlot blijiman bin kamat deya langa det serramoni pleis, jisas bin stil deya toktok langa detlot pipul, "ai kaan jidan iya longtaim garram yumob, dumaji ai garra gowei brom iya en gobek langa tharran hubin jandim mi.
english: Then Jesus said, "I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

kriol: imbin meigim det solwoda jidan drai graun. wi femilimob hubin jidan bifo bin krosoba langa det riba garram fut. deya na, wibin jingat gudbinjiwei blanga wanim imbin dum.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

kriol: bat god im giltiwan na. im oldei faindimbat folt langa mi.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

kriol: "detlot pipul hu meigim trabul langa yumob, ai garra meigim olabat bradin langa mi, en wen dei kaman blanga fait langa yumob, ai garra meigim olabat go ebriweya, en ai garra meigim olabat tenim miselp en ranawei brom yumob.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

kriol: wal wandei wen jisas bin titjimbat en dalimbat ola pipul det gudnyus deya langa det serramoni pleis, detlot haibala serramonimen en lowamen en ola lidawan olmen bin ol kaman langa jisas,
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

kriol: en olabat garra jidanbat wulijim det greiptri weya detlot rauwan frut daga oldei buldan langa graun, en laik det olibtri weya oldei lujimbat im purdiflawa.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

kriol: im oldei tok trubala wed, en raitwan panishmen im oldei gibit. im na bin jadjim bebalon, det nogudbala wuman hubin oldei silip garram enibodi. god bin jadjim bebalon det taun hubin meigim dijan kantri nogud. imbin panishim bebalon, dumaji bebalon bin kilimbat ola wekinmen blanga im." praise
english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand."

kriol: yawei, ai kaman langa yu blanga kipum mi seifwan. nomo larram enibodi bidim mi en meigim mi sheim. yu na det brabli haibala god, nomo garram enijing rong. mi prei langa yu blanga seibum mi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

kriol: en blanga tharran na wen det taim bin kaman blanga det fait, detlot isreil solja nomo bin abum eni bigwan naif en spiya. oni king sol en jonathan bin abum.
english: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

kriol: "wal if eni isreil men grebum en deigimwei im kantrimen brom im femilimob en meigim im jidan laiga prisana blanga adwek blanga im, o selimbat im, wal im nogud lagijat. yumob garra lafta binijimap det men. wen yumob dum lagijat yumob git fri brom det nogudbala ting.
english: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kriol: brom deya langa main drim aibin lisin sambodi langa det serramoni pleis blanga god. det sambodi bin tok adbala langa detlot 7 einjul, "yumob go garram detlot 7 dish na, en yumob spilim detlot trabul langa ola kantri, dumaji god garra panishimbat ola nogudbala pipul."
english: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!"

kriol: en wen imbin wokwok, imbin luk wan men neim libai det san blanga elfiyas bin jidanbat langa det haus weya imbin oldei gajimbat det teks mani blanga gabman. wal jisas bin go langa libai, en imbin tok, "yu bulurrum mi." en libai bin gidap, en imbin bulurrum jisas.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, "Follow me." And he arose and followed him.

kriol: det wekinmen bin deigim det lilboi raitbek langa im mami en im mami bin holdim det lilboi raidap dinataim en imbin dai.
english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

kriol: "en wen det taim garra kaman, yawei garra meigim yumob jidan brabli sheimwan. im garra peiyim det king brom asiriya blanga bringimap shapwan naif brom najasaid brom det yufreitis riba, en dei garra sheibum yumob hed, en ola heya langa yumob bodi, en yumob wiska du. det king blanga asiriya garra jidan bos oba langa yumob.
english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

kriol: en nomeda wi abum trabul, bat stil wi gudbinji, dumaji wi sabi det trabul garra meigim wi jidan mowa strongbala.
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

kriol: en im oldei dum lagijat igin langa det aiyan en kopa.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

kriol: dei garra maindimbat ola enijing insaid langa det seikridwan tent, en dei garra wek blanga ola isreil pipul.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

kriol: wal wotfo yunbala dedi oldei gitwail langa mi? "olredi imbin tjeinjim main pei 10 taim. bat god nomo bin larram im ardim mi.
english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn't allow him to hurt me.

kriol: "yu garra meigim naja dubala kaliko, wanbala garram det ship skin weya deibin meigim redwan en det najawan garram det skin brom det nenigout. det ship skin kaliko garra jidan raidoba ontopwei langa det tent, en det nenigout skin kaliko garra jidan ontop langa det ship skin kaliko."
english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kriol: wal dubala bin go langa jisas, en wen jisas bin luk nathenyul kaman langa im, imbin dalim detlot najalot pipul deya, "deya na brabli trubala juwish men weya kaan trikimbat enibodi nogudbalawei."
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"

kriol: detlot pipul brom juda en jerusalem garra jidan seifwan wen ai seibum olabat. dei garra gulum det taun yawei bin seibum wi.
english: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell safely. This is the name by which she will be called: Yahweh our righteousness."

kriol: if yu weit en tok kwaitbalawei, nomeda haulong, yu gin tjeinjim det main blanga eni boswan, en yu gin sodimat eni trabul.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

kriol: en pipul ebriweya garra trastim im.' lagijat na god bin tok."
english: In his name, the nations will hope."

kriol: en afta imbin meigim deibid meigim det pramis langa im, dumaji imbin laigim deibid brabliwei.
english: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had to him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

kriol: "wal yawei garra deigimwei yumob en yumob king langa najawan kantri, weya yumob en wi grengrenfathamob nomo bin go, en deya na yumob garra weshipbat detlot drimin sheip deibin meigim brom wadi en ston.
english: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

kriol: olabat garra dagadagat ola sid daga en frut daga blanga yumob, en olabat garra kilim yumob doda en san. en olabat garra kilim yumob enimul, en kadimdan ola greip en figtri. detlot strongbala taun weya yumob reken yu jidanbat seifwan, det amimob blanga olabat garra binijimap yumob."
english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok, "wen dijan garra hepin sebenbala gel garra gajim seimwan men, en detlot gel garra tok, 'melabat garra baiyim melabat ronwan daga en klos. yu garra merrit langa melabat, blanga meigim melabat gudbinji en nomo sheim.'" lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, "We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach."

kriol: "im na meigim strongbala pipul jidan wikwan, en im meigim wikwan pipul jidan strongbala.
english: "The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.

kriol: wanim melabat garra gedim wen melabat oldei preipreibat en weshipbat langa yu, god?
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?'

kriol: bat bambai detlot nogudbala pipul garra jandap lida langa god, en dei garra dalim im wotfo deibin kipgon jidanbat langa det nogudbala laif, dumaji god im redi blanga jadjim ola laibala pipul en ola dedbala pipul du.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

kriol: "detlot pipul hu kaman en bulurrum det nyubalawei blanga god, olabat jis laik detlot pipul hubin go langa bigbala padi weya wan king bin abum blanga im san wen imbin merrit.
english: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

kriol: bat tudei ai nomo garram eni enami, dumaji yawei na bin meigim ola enami jidan gudbinji langa mi.
english: But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

kriol: jeihu bin jidan det king blanga isreil 28 yiya, en imbin oldei jidan langa sameriya.
english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

kriol: deibin jidan insaid langa olabat tent en deibin grambulbat, en olabat nomo bin teiknodis langa yawei.
english: but murmured in their tents, and didn't listen to Yahweh's voice.

kriol: nobodi kaan tok wi nomo lukaftumbat im brabliwei. wal yumob nomo wandi meigimbat trabul iya. yumob garra jidan gudbalawei.
english: Seeing then that these things can't be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

kriol: en aibin dalim yumob tharran wulijim wen im garra hepin, yumob garra jidan gudbinjiwei, dumaji yumob jidan wanbala garram mi. nomeda ola pipul langa dijan wel garra gibit yumob trabul, bat stil yumob kaan bradin, dumaji aibin bidim dijan wel." lagijat na jisas bin dalim im wekinmen olabat.
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world."

kriol: en ebrijing ai dalim yumob naitaim kwaitbalawei, yumob garra dalimbat ola pipul deitaim adbalawei. en ebrijing ai dalim yumob insaid langa haus, yumob garra dalimbat ola pipul atsaid langa det haus.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

kriol: det haibala wekinmen bin tokbek langa olabat, "wanim yumob thribala reken? dijan mesij im oni blanga det king en yu thribala? najing! det king bin jandim mi blanga dalim ebribodi. bambai olabat garra lafta dagat olabat ronwan guna, en dringgim olabat ronwan gumbu, seimwei laik yumob thribala."
english: But Rabshakeh said to them, "Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn't he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?"

kriol: afta na jisas bin askim detlot pipul hubin kaman langa im, "yumob nomo sabi det stori blanga detlot sid? if yumob nomo sabi det stori, wal hau yumob garra sabi ola najalot stori?
english: He said to them, "Don't you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

kriol: melabat askim yu blanga gibit melabat daga blanga dagat tudei.
english: Give us today our daily bread.

kriol: bat wen aibin meigim yumob nogudbinji, yumob bin tjeinjim det nogudbalawei blanga yumob. en tharran na meigim mi gudbinji. en yumob gudbinji du. yu si? ai nomo bin ardim yumob, dumaji god bin yusum det leda weya bin meigim yumob nogudbinji blanga meigim yumob tjeinjim det nogudbalawei blanga yumob.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin tok langa detlot pipul langa jerusalem. imbin tok, "ai garra album yumob, en ai garra peiyimbek detlot enami blanga yumob blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya deibin dumbat langa yumob. ai garra draiyimap ola riba en ola springwoda.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: "Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

kriol: "wal mi na yawei det boswan god. aibin growimap ola isreil en juda pipul, bat nomo dijan taim na. ai garra rabishim olabat en libum olabat du. olabat bin bringimap dijan trabul langa olabat ronselp, dumaji olabat bin dumbat nogudbala ting. olabat bin meigim mi brabli wail wen deibin gibit sekrifais langa beil." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

kriol: wal eibram bin baudan langa graun blanga shoum rispek langa god,
english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

kriol: en deibin go en wek langa det gadin. en wen imbin dinataim, det fama bin faindim mowa men, en imbin dalim olabat blanga go en wek langa im gadin. en wen imbin aftanun smokotaim imbin dum seimwei igin.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

kriol: wal wi kaan hatjamp blanga tharran, dumaji seitin du gin tenim miselp en meigim miselp luk jis laiga einjul.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

kriol: ebribodi garra album gija blanga berrim detlot dedwan bodi en blanga tharran na ol detlot najalot pipul garra gibit rispek langa ola isreil pipul langa det taim wen ai garra kaman garram brabli shainiwan lait.
english: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified," says the Lord Yahweh.

kriol: wen imbin stil toktokbat langa mi, aibin buldan langa graun jis laik aibin deigim fit, bat imbin tatjim mi en imbin meigim mi jandap.
english: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me and set me upright.

kriol: wal det gel bin tok, "nomeda mi oni wekingel, bat stil yubin gibit langa mi gudwan wed." afta na det gel bin gowei brom deya gudbinjiwei, en imbin gobek, en imbin dagadagat det daga weya imbin libum basdam.
english: She said, "Let your servant find favor in your sight." So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn't sad any more.

kriol: en olabat bin bulurrum det nogudbalawei blanga detlot pipul weya yawei bin andimwei brom det kantri wen imbin bringimap ola isreil pipul brom ijip. olabat bulurrum det nogudbalawei blanga detlot najalot king blanga isreil.
english: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

kriol: wal main gudfren olabat, ai garra meigim yumob jinggabat wanim god bin titjim wi. imbin tok wi garra lafta laigim wi braja en sista olabat brabliwei. tharran nomo nyubala wed, dumaji yumob bin sabi tharran brom wen yumob bin fes bilib.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

kriol: wal detlot juwish serramonimen deya langa jerusalem gulum ferasi bin jandim sambala serramonimen brom det libai klen en sambala najalot serramonimen blanga askim jon beptis hu im, en wen deibin kamat langa im, deibin askim im, "hu yu?"
english: This is John's testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"

kriol: wal detlot isreil pipul bin teikoba brom detlot emarait pipul det taun gulum heshban en det najalot taun du weya jidan raidaran langa det taun en olabat bin jidan deya na.
english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

kriol: ai preisim yu dumaji yubin meigim mi klebabalawei. mi hatjamp wen mi jinggabat tharran. yu sabi mi brabliwei.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

kriol: yumob garra larramgo ola prisanamob brom dakbala pleis, wulijim olabat garra luk det lait. wen olabat garra wokwok bek langa det roud langa olabat ronwan kantri, olabat garra faindim loda daga blanga dagadagatbat, nomeda im langa draiwan hil kantri.
english: saying to those who are bound, 'Come out!'; to those who are in darkness, 'Show yourselves!' "They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "trubala tharran yumob tok. sambala men kaan merrit, dumaji deibin kadim olabat jis laik dei kadim boiwan buligi. en sambala men bin bon lagijat. bat dijan wed im nomo blanga ebribodi. im oni blanga detlot men weya god bin pikimat olabat. detlot men na kaan merrit, dumaji dei garra jinggabat wanwei en wek blanga god. en if dijan wed im blanga yu, wal yu garra duwit."
english: But he said to them, "Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

kriol: oni ola haus deibin barnimap. deibin runimdan det taun, en det taun stil jidan nogudwan lagijat tudei.
english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

kriol: "wal mi na det gudwan stakmen weya jidan redi blanga dai blanga ola ship.
english: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

kriol: bat yubin luk ebrijing bin hepin, yawei. wal yu nomo jidan kwaitbala, main bos. nomo jidan longwei.
english: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don't keep silent. Lord, don't be far from me.

kriol: detlot ent nomo garram eni bos o lida, najing,
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

kriol: detlot pipul hu dumbat wek garra gedim wanim dei wandim, bat detlot pipul hu toktokbat oldei garra jidan powan.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

kriol: bat yumob nomo sabi hau blanga bulurrum jisas krais brabliwei yet, dumaji yumob oldei lukinatbat ebrijing atsaidwei. ai sabi tharran, dumaji sambala pipul deya reken olabat blanga jisas krais en seimtaim dei reken mi nomo blanga im. bat dei garra jinggabat adbala, dumaji mi blanga jisas krais seimwei laik olabat blanga im.
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ's, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ's, so we also are Christ's.

kriol: afta na aibin dalim det reikebait klen wanim yawei det brabli boswan god blanga isreil bin tok, "yumob bin duwit langa det lowa weya yumob grengrenfatha jonadeb bin gibit langa yumob. yumob bin bulurrum ol detlot wed, en yumob bin dum ebrijing weya imbin dalim yumob.
english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, "Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: 'Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,'

kriol: king eman bin gibit bekboun langa yawei seim laik im dedi king manesa bin dum, en imbin weshipbat en gibitbat sekrifais langa detlot drimin sheip im dedi bin meigim.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

kriol: "im garra stapam detlot pipul hu oldei kaman brom najawan kantri blanga fait gija. dei garra bitsimap detlot bigwan naif en spiya, en dei garra meigim reik en shabul brom detlot na wulijim olabat kaan neba fait igin en kilimbat najalot pipul.
english: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

kriol: "wal det sekanwan wekinmen bin kaman na, en imbin tok, 'bos, yubin gibit mi wanbala mani, en aibin meigim faibala.'
english: "The second came, saying, 'Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.'

kriol: "wal aibin lafta larram detlot asiriya men abum im na, dumaji imbin laigim olabat detmatj.
english: "Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.

kriol: jis laiga woda weya im bilimap det solwoda, wal ebri kantri du garra abum detmatj pipul hu sabi en rispek mi na.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh's glory, as the waters cover the sea.

kriol: brom ola difrin kantri blanga ol yumob klen, yawei garra pikimat wanbala pleis weya im garra jidan en weya ola pipul garra majurrumap miselp langa im, en deya na olabat garra weship langa im.
english: But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

kriol: wal detkain haibala serramonimen na wi garram, en blanga tharran na wi kaan bradin blanga askim god blanga album wi. nomeda god im brabli haiwan bos, bat stil im brabli kainbala, en im garram filing blanga wi, en wen wi askim im, im garra album wi, dumaji det serramonimen blanga wi im deya, en wen wi abum trabul o jidan wikwan, god garra album wi.
english: Let's therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

kriol: en deibin kipgon raidap deibin kamat langa det nait kemp. deya na wanbala bin opinim det beig blanga im blanga gibit daga langa det dongki blanga im, en imbin faindim det mani insaid.
english: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

kriol: wal aibin dalim yumob wanim yawei bin tok, bat yumob nomo bin lisin. yumob bin gibit bekboun langa im en yumob bin reken miselp wen yumob bin go langa det hil kantri.
english: So I spoke to you, and you didn't listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

kriol: nomo enibodi gibit feyago langa enibodi. nomo enibodi tok trubalawei langa det kothaus bat oldei toktok ola laiyawan wed.
english: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can't enter.

kriol: wal job bin prei langa god, "ai garra askim yu oni blanga dubala ting, main god. if yu ensim mi ai kaan neba blandim miselp brom yu.
english: "Only don't do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

kriol: en yawei bin gibit mi mowa blanga dijan wed. imbin tok,
english: Moreover Yahweh's word came to me, saying,

kriol: en det men weya yu garram tudei im nomo blanga yu hasbin. trubala tharran yubin tok. yu nomo bin laiya weya yubin dalim mi yu nomo garram hasbin."
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly."

kriol: yu jidan kain langa mi, yawei, dumaji mi wikwan. meigim mi gudwan igin, yawei, dumaji main bodi ardimbat mi.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

kriol: wal yu garra dalim detlot ritjwan kristjan pipul blanga jidan gudbalawei en dumbat bigmob gudbala ting, en dei garra jidan redibala blanga album najalot pipul en nomo jidan gridibalawei.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

kriol: "yumob bin jandim yumob mesinja langa jon beptis, en imbin dalim yumob det trubala wed blanga mi, dumaji imbin jidan witnis blanga mi.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

kriol: heisowadata, keriyothesran o heisowa,
english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

kriol: wal det isreil men neim simri, bin det san blanga salu hubin gitkil garram det midiyan gel. wal im na bin det boswan blanga det klen en det femili blanga simiyan.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers' house among the Simeonites.

kriol: "mi na yawei det boswan god garra blowin langa yumob en yumob garra gidap laibala igin.
english: The Lord Yahweh says to these bones: "Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

kriol: wal wi nomo detkain pipul hu tenim miselp brom god olagija. god garra panishim detkain pipul brabliwei. bat wi nomo lagijat, dumaji wi bilib brabliwei, en im garra seibum wi.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

kriol: en deibin dalim olabat, "yumob garra dalim laiya. yumob spredimat yan en dalim ola pipul detlot wekinmen blanga jisas bin kaman naitaim en deibin deigidawei im bodi wen yumob bin silip.
english: saying, "Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

kriol: "wal yumob bin irrim det wed weya bin jidan longtaimwan weya im tok, 'yumob nomo lau blanga medrim enibodi. if yu medrim enibodi, wal dei garra deigim yu langa kot, en afta dei garra panishim yu.'
english: "You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, 'You shall not murder;' and 'Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.'

kriol: god, yu jis laiga shild blanga mi. yu kipum mi seif wen trabul kaman, yu lukaftum ol yu pipul hu teiknodis langa yu.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

kriol: "if yu o yu dubala san dringgimbat wain o biya, wal tharran hubin dringgimbat nomo lau go insaid langa det seikridwan tent blanga main. if yumob dum lagijat, wal yumob garra dai. wal dijan lowa yu en ola bigininimob hu garra kaman afta yu garra kipgon dumbat.
english: "You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

kriol: en imbin dalim olabat, "aibin wandi dagat brabli dijan pasoba sapa garram yumob bifo dei ardim mi.
english: He said to them, "I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

kriol: det taun bin brabli shainiwan garram lait brom god. imbin shain jis laiga brabli klinwan glas en jis laiga purdiwan ston.
english: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

kriol: wal joshuwa en det serramonimen neim eliyeisa bin tjakambat det dubala speshalwan ston blanga pikimat ol detlot taun na, en deibin gibit detlot taun garram ola pedik langa ol detlot femili blanga libai klen jis laik yawei bin dalim olabat blanga dum.
english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.

kriol: yawei, boswan god, yu meigim melabat strongbala igin. yu luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis en seibum melabat.
english: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kriol: deibin ol klebawan blanga yusum det bigwan naif, en dei sabi fait nomo lilbit. dei ol garram bigwan naif langa olabat bingga, en ebrinait olabat jidan redi blanga fait.
english: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.

kriol: nomo. yumob nomo wandi larram enibodi trikim yumob en meigim yumob gobek langa det nogudbalawei. trubala ai dalim yumob. nogudbala pipul meigim gudbala pipul go nogudwei.
english: Don't be deceived! "Evil companionships corrupt good morals."

kriol: ebriwan bin raidimdan olabat neim dumaji lagijat na yawei bin dalim mosis. en yawei bin gibit oda langa mosis blanga det wek weya olabat garra oldei dumbat.
english: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kriol: wal yawei garra jadjim yunmi mijamet, en im kaan faindim enijing rong langa mi. bat im garra faindim rong langa yu, en im garra panishim yu blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yu oldei dumbat langa mi.
english: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.

kriol: bat taya im jidan rabishwan na. en detlot solwoda pipul hubin lukinatbat, olabat bradin nomo lilbit.
english: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.'

kriol: bat if yu nomo larram im go, wal wi garra jidan iya nomo garram daga, dumaji det hedbos bin tok lagijat na langa melabat."
english: but if you don't send him, we won't go down, for the man said to us, 'You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.'"

kriol: wotfo yubin breigim yu pramis en yu nomo bin duwit langa mi?
english: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahweh and the commandment that I have instructed you with?"

kriol: wal geman mi sheim blanga dalim yumob dijan. bat wen aibin deya garram yumob, ai nomo bin tridim yumob adbalawei lagijat, dumaji aibin wikwan. bat ai sabi ai garra tok praudbalawei langa yumob. nomeda mi granggibala blanga tok lagijat, bat stil ai garra tok praudbalawei seimwei laik detlot pipul hu reken miselp mishanri blanga yumob.
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

kriol: en mi brabli wail langa ol detlot pipul brom ola najalot kantri hu reken olabat seif. dumaji wen aibin holdimbek miselp brom main pipul ol detlot najalot pipul bin kipgon ardimbat olabat.

english: For they said, "Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people."

english: I said to them, 'Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.' So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf."

english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!"

english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

english: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh's offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, "For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning." His father wept for him.

english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;

english: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, "Your brother Ben Hadad." Then he said, "Go, bring him." Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast and don't lie against the truth.

english: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

english: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

english: Shimei said when he cursed, "Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

english: But if you don't believe his writings, how will you believe my words?"

english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, "There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!"

english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.

english: "Yahweh of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

english: Previously saying, "Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn't desire, neither had pleasure in them" (those which are offered according to the law),

kriol: wal wen detlot juda soljamob bin galimap raidap langa top langa det haibala wol weya deibin luk langa det deset kantri, deibin luk detlot enamimob bin olredi dedwan en bin ol leidan ebriweya langa graun. nomo enibodi bin ranawei, najing.
english: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.

kriol: det klos blanga im bin go brabli shainiwan en brabli waitwan. nobodi kaan meigim klos brabli waitwan lagijat langa dijan kantri.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

kriol: "afta na aibin gajim woda blanga washimwei detlot blad brom yu bodi, en aibin rabum yu skin garram det oliboil.
english: "'"Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

kriol: en imbin bos blanga det hil kantri gulum heman en det taun gulum salaka, en imbin bos blanga det kantri gulum beishan raidap langa det dubala kantri gulum geshuwa en meiyaka, en imbin bos blanga haf det kantri gulum giliyad raidap langa det boda blanga det kantri blanga king saihan.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

kriol: wal deibid bin tok, "wotfo yu nomo bin bradin blanga kilim ded det men weya yawei bin pikimat blanga jidan king blanga ola isreil pipul?
english: David said to him, "Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh's anointed?"

kriol: "'langa det taim bambai ai garra go thru langa jerusalem lukabat ola pipul langa ebri haus, jis laik pipul lukabat enijing garram lemp. ai garra panishim detlot pipul hu jidan leisiwan en abumbat isibala laif. dei tok gija, "wi rait." dei jinggabat miselp lagijat, "yawei nomo oldei dum enijing. im nomo album wi. im nomo panishim wi."
english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, "Yahweh will not do good, neither will he do evil."

kriol: "yawei, yu det boswan god en yu god blanga ola isreil pipul du. yu jidan deya langa top langa yu speshalwan tjeya en det dubala golwan sheip garram wing jidan tusaid langa det tjeya. yu na bin meigim det skai en dijan graun, en oni yu na wanbala jidan bos blanga ola kantri langa dijan wel.
english: "Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "maitbi wanbala speshalwan mesinja o sambodi hu sabi blanga dalimbat mining blanga ola drim im mait pramisim yumob ola klebabala ting blanga meigim yumob weshipbat en bulurrum detlot drimin sheip weya yumob nomo bin sabi. nomeda det klebabala ting weya imbin pramis bin hepin, yumob stil kaan teiknodis langa im. yawei det trubala god yusumbat im blanga testimbat yumob blanga faindat if yumob laigim im garram yumob filing holbit.
english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

kriol: brom deya jisas bin dalim dubala ebrijing wanim det oltestaman bin tok blanga im brom jenasis raidap langa melakai.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

english: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

english: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

english: Nicodemus answered him, "How can these things be?"

english: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.

english: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

english: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, yumob jinggabat detlot titja hu oldei titjimbat god wed langa ola pipul. god garra jadjim detlot titja brabli strongbalawei, en blanga tharran na oni sambala pipul garra jidan titja. ebribodi oldei meigim misteik. if wi nomo tok eni nogudbala ting wi gin hendulum miselp brabli gudbalawei.
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

kriol: wal det seikridwan boks blanga yawei det trubala god bin jidan deya langa det filastain kantri fo 7 mants,
english: Yahweh's ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

english: but every man's servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

english: Yahweh said to Moses, "If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn't she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again."

english: "'Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."

english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness." Selah.

english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

english: Doesn't the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

kriol: en main enami olabat garra tok, "wibin bidim im!" en detlot pipul hu fait langa mi garra gudbinji, dumaji deibin bidim mi.
english: lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed against him;" lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

kriol: ai garra spredimat olabat langa ebri kantri en olabat kaan neba dumbat detlot nogudbala ting enimo.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.

kriol: wal basdam wen deibid bin jidan langa siklag weya imbin go blanga ranawei brom king sol det san blanga kish, loda gudwan soljamob bin midap garram im,
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, "Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, 'This is what Yahweh says, "Let my people go, that they may serve me.

english: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

english: "Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn't overtake them in Gibeah.

english: "Behold, the days come," says Yahweh, "that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

english: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, "We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.

kriol: en if yumob wandi tokabat enijing, wi gin abum miting iya langa dijan pleis. bat wi garra abum det miting brabliwei.
english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

english: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

kriol: jisas bin kipgon tok, "aibin yusum olkain stori blanga dalim yumob ol dislot ting. bat det taim garra kaman wen ai kaan yusum olkain stori blanga tok langa yumob. ai garra jis dalim yumob streidat blanga main dedi.
english: "I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

kriol: maitbi yu laigim bradinimbat mi wen mi oldei jidanbat wikwan. mi jis laik det draiwan lif weya im buldan.
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

english: "I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.

kriol: mi blanga yu, main olmen, en yu oldei wandimbat mi olataim.
english: I am my beloved's. His desire is toward me.

english: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.

english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

kriol: olabat los langa dakbala pleis, en dei oldei wokwokbat jis laiga drangginbala."
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

english: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.

kriol: en imbin tok, "mi na det speshalwan men, en ai garra abum loda trabul, dumaji ola boswan olmen en ola haibala serramonimen en ola lowamen garra ol tjakidawei mi, en dei garra kilim mi ded. bat thrideistaim ai garra gidap brom dedbala en jidan laibala." lagijat na jisas bin tok langa im wekinmen olabat.
english: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up."

english: The watchman said, "He came to them, and isn't coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously."

english: "Behold, siege ramps have been built against the city to take it. The city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, of the famine, and of the pestilence. What you have spoken has happened. Behold, you see it.

kriol: afta yu garra deigim detlot daga langa det teibul blanga ofring, en yu garra pudum detlot daga ontop langa det pleis weya yubin barnimap det feswan ship basdam, en deya na yu garra barnimap detlot daga du blanga daga ofring langa mi, en det smel garra meigim mi gudbinji.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

english: However, God's firm foundation stands, having this seal: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness."

kriol: jis laik det san weya im godan, wal lagijat na main laif im jidan. mi jidan laik draiwan gras.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

kriol: wal mosis bin lidimap det wokinstik en imbin hidim det rok dubala taim, en streidawei det bigis woda bin kamat brom det rok, en ola pipul en enimul bin dringgim det woda.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

kriol: brom deya banabas bin go, en imbin lukabat sol deya langa tasas,
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

english: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how Yahweh had visited his people in giving them bread.

english: They burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

kriol: wal benaiya bin ensim im na, "yuwai, maitbi yawei det god blanga yu reken tharran raitwei du.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, "Amen. May Yahweh, the God of my lord the king, say so.

kriol: en detlot hubin jidan langa det draiwan graun bin irrim ol detlot jinginatbat wen deibin draun langa det solwoda.
english: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.

english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. "The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don't need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

kriol: wal god garra dum det plen blanga im garram det gudnyus, en thru det gudnyus na ola jintail pipul garra gedim ebrijing weya god gibit langa ola juwish pipul, en god garra joinimap jintail pipul garram juwish pipul en meigim olabat wanbala, en det pramis weya god bin meigim langa ola juwish pipul garra go langa ola jintail pipul du, dumaji olabat joinap garram jisas krais.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

english: But others said, "He is Elijah." Others said, "He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets."

english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

english: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, "See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, 'Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?'"

english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

english: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.

english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

kriol: yubin gibit dijan oda, 'wen enibodi irrim det myusik stat im garra pudumdan im feis langa graun en weship det golwan drimin sheip.
english: You, O king, have made a decree that every man who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music shall fall down and worship the golden image;

english: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.

english: He said to me, "This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people."

english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

english: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
