kriol: wal mi na maika bin tok, "ol yumob pipul brom ebri kantri, yumob irrim mi na. ebribodi hu jidan laibala garra lisin langa mi, dumaji yawei det boswan god garra tok brom det brabli seikridwan pleis blanga im, en im garra jadjim yumob.
english: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord Yahweh be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok langa mi,
english: Now Yahweh's word came to me, saying,

kriol: en sisera bin dai deya gin langa det graun. deya gin wansaid langa det fut blanga jeiyel imbin leidan ded.
english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

kriol: "wal melabat dedi bin dalim melabat, 'yumob sabi main waif reitjul bin abum oni dubala boi main.
english: Your servant, my father, said to us, 'You know that my wife bore me two sons.

kriol: "'yumob nomo lau blanga stilimbat enijing.
english: "You shall not steal.

kriol: wal ilaihu bin kipgon tok, "wal aibin irrim wanim yubin tok. yu reken yu nomo bin dum enijing rong, en yu reken yu jidan friwan brom eni nogudbala ting.
english: "Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

kriol: wal ola lowa weya deibid bin dalim detlot serramonimen en libaimen blanga detlot stowahaus en najalot ting, deibin dum holbit.
english: They didn't depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

kriol: dei garra tok lagijat dumaji god bin dum loda gudbala ting blanga mi. god im brabli haibala, en im garram loda pawa. im na det brabli holiwan,
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

kriol: gitwail en ranimap olabat raidap yu gajim olabat. dumaji yu wail langa olabat, wal yu panishim olabat.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

kriol: laik wen dei mokim kripulwan pipul, wal lagijat na deibin mokimbat mi. deibin baidim miselp tang langa mi, dumaji deibin gitwail nomo lilbit langa mi.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

kriol: ai garra meigim yumob en yumob kantri jidan strongbala igin. en yumob garra pleiplei yumob lilwan dram gulum tembarin, en yumob garra densdensbat gudbinjiwei.
english: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry.

kriol: dijan na detlot lowa weya dalim yumob wanim nomo klinbala, o wanim klinbala blanga serramoni." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

kriol: olabat nomo jinggabat blanga enijing, en nomo bradin du. olabat sabi brabliwei olabat enamimob kaan win, najing.
english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

kriol: yumob sabi? melabat oldei abum trabul. bat det trabul kaan smeshimap melabat. en nomeda samtaim melabat nomo sabi wanim blanga dum, bat stil melabat kaan gibap.
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

kriol: wal im lagijat blanga ol yumob yangmen du. yumob garra teiknodis langa ola olmen, en yumob garra meigim miselp lobala en album miselp, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, "god nomo gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu meigim miselp haibala. bat im gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu meigim miselp lobala."
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for "God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble."

kriol: orait, mi na pol, en mi speshalwan mishanri blanga jisas krais, dumaji god en jisas krais bin dalim mi blanga jidan speshalwan mishanri. god na bin seibum wi, en wi sabi jisas krais garra meigim wi jidan olagija garram det olagijawan laif.
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

kriol: streidawei ola boswan wekinmen blanga jeihu bin spredimat olabat kout deya ontop langa det step blanga jeihu blanga jandap ontop en deibin blowim det longwan wisul en jingat brabli adbala, "jeihu im det nyuwan king blanga isreil."
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, "Jehu is king."

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, ai dalim yumob. det kristjan sista blanga wi neim fibi im brabli gudwan gel. imbin wekingel blanga det tjetj langa det taun gulum sinkriyai.
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

kriol: wal wanbala krik deya bin wodarimbat det gadin, en det krik bin kadimat miselp langa fobala riba lodan weya det krik bin kamat brom det gadin.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

kriol: detlot pipul hu dum ebrijing kwikbala en kaan weit blanga enijing, garra jinggabat gudwei, en enibodi hu nomo sabi hau blanga tok gudwei, wal dei garra tok gudwei na.
english: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

kriol: en imbin tok langa ola pipul deya, "yawei bin tok dijan hau im garra breigim det yok weya king nebakanesa bin pudum langa ola pipul nek brom ebri kantri, en im garra dum lagijat langa det dubala yiya." afta tharran aibin gowei brom deya.
english: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, "Yahweh says: 'Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.'" Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

kriol: god, yu lisin langa main preya. yu lisin langa ol main wed.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

kriol: nomeda det wuman bin breigim det lowa, bat stil god garra seibum ola wuman. im garra seibum olabat wen dei abum beibi, en im garra seibum olabat if dei kipgon bilib langa im en kipgon laigimbat ola pipul en kipgon jidanbat gudbalawei hau im wandim olabat blanga jidan.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

kriol: yawei yu gud langa mi, yu wekinmen, wulijim ai garra jidan laibala blanga teiknodis en duwit langa yu wed.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

kriol: "wal ai garram loda wed blanga dalim yumob. bat yumob kaan hendulum ol detlot wed tudei.
english: "I still have many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.

kriol: detlot hos bin brabli jigiwan garram olabat mawus, en olabat teil bin jis laiga jigiwan sneik du, en garram olabat teil detlot hos gin baidim pipul.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

kriol: wal sambala pipul brom det taun gulum sif bin go langa king sol deya langa det taun gulum gibiya, en deibin tok, "deibid bin blandim miselp langa horesh deya langa det hil gulum hekila sauthsaid brom det pleis gulum jeshimon.
english: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, "Doesn't David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?

kriol: main bos, album mi blanga tok strongbalawei, wulijim ai garra dalim najalot pipul yu brabli gudwan.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

kriol: yumob sabi? det dedi laigim im san detmatj, en imbin meigim im san jidan bos blanga ebrijing,
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

kriol: blanga detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum filastain yawei bin tok, "detlot pipul langa det taun gulum gasa oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en blanga tharran na ai garra panishim olabat. deibin deigidawei ol main pipul brom wan pleis en deibin selim olabat langa detlot pipul brom det kantri gulum idam.
english: Yahweh says: "For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;

kriol: brom deya detlot isreil pipul bin go langa det seikridwan pleis blanga yawei igin, en deibin sori miselp en kraikrai en nomo dagat eni daga raidap det san bin godan, en deibin gibit det ofring gulum feloship ofring langa god, en deibin abum det sekrifais serramoni blanga im du.
english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

kriol: wal josef bin bringimap faibala braja blanga im langa det king na,
english: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

kriol: 'ai garram det bifpat brom det sekrifais ofring langa main kemp,
english: "Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

kriol: "wal det boswan bin jandim najawan wekinmen, en detlot fama bin beldim im en tridim im nogudwei, en deibin jandimbek im nomo garram enijing du.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

kriol: ailibala neksdei eibrahem bin gibit heiga wodabeig en sambala daga, en imbin jandimwei dubala. en dubala bin gowei en wokabat langa det deset kantri gulum biyashiba.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

kriol: yumob sabi wanim melabat toktok? melabat kaan reken miselp en tok melabat gin dum det wek miselp, dumaji melabat nomo garram ronwan pawa blanga dum det wek. nomo. melabat bin gedim det pawa brom god.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

kriol: en dei nomo garram det gudwan filing insaid langa olabat blanga dalim olabat wanim rait en rong, en dei nomo kipum olabat ron wed, en dei nomo kain en sori langa enibodi.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

kriol: wal bifo jisas bin dai, imbin pikimat twelbala speshalwan mishanri blanga jidan mishanri blanga im, en afta wen imbin gidap brom dedbala, imbin shoum miselp 40 deis langa detlot lebenbala speshalwan mishanri, en olabat ol witnis trubala im laibala, dumaji deibin luk im lodataim bifo imbin gowap langa hebin. wal wen deibin oldei luk langa im, imbin oldei dalimbat olabat blanga god en hau im garra jidan bos blanga olabat. garram det pawa blanga det holi spirit imbin oldei titjimbat olabat.
english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

kriol: wal wen imbin sebathdei, melabat bin go langa det riba wansaid langa det taun, dumaji melabat bin reken melabat garra faindim pleis deya weya ola juwish pipul bin oldei midap blanga prei, en melabat bin faindim sambala wuman deya, en melabat bin jidan en tok langa olabat.
english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

kriol: weya det strongbala pawa blanga yawei hubin oldei wokwokbat garram mosis? wi garra gibitbat theingks langa yawei olataim, dumaji im na bin kadimat det solwoda gulum redsi.
english: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses' right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

kriol: en afta im gro brabli bigwan tri. wal lagijat na oni lilbit pipul bin bulurrum det wed blanga god basdam. bat mowa en mowa garra bulurrum det wed."
english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow."

kriol: wal lagijat na jowab en ebishai bin kilim ebna ded blanga peiyimbek im blanga dubala braja esahel weya imbin kilim langa det fait weya deibin abum deya langa det pleis gulum gibiyan. wal wen king deibid bin irrim det bednyus, imbin tok, "yawei im sabi mi en main pipul olabat nomo bin kilim ebna. im nomo melabat folt. jowab en im femili bin medrim im, en olabat na garra abum trabul brom dis ting, en sambala pipul langa im femili garra oldei abumbat siknis, en sambala pipul garra oldei abum leprasi, en sambala pipul garra oldei jidan kripulwan, en sambala pipul garra oldei dai langa fait, en sambala pipul garra oldei jidan hanggriwan du. olagijawan det femili blanga jowab garra jidan lagijat." lagijat na king deibid bin tok.
english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, "I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

kriol: wal jesi bin bringimap det najawan san blanga im neim shama, en semyul bin tok, "nomo. yawei nomo bin pikimat im."
english: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, "Yahweh has not chosen this one, either."

kriol: "wal yumob jinggabat det wed weya detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga god bin raidimdan langa oltestaman. det wed im tok, 'god imselp garra lenimbat ola pipul.' en ol detlot pipul hu lisin langa main dedi en gajimap det wed blanga im garra kaman langa mi,
english: It is written in the prophets, 'They will all be taught by God.' Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

kriol: aibin deya wansaid langa im, jis laik det men weya oldei meigim det plen hau blanga bildimap haus. aibin oldei meigim im gudbinji ebridei, en aibin brabli gudbinji blanga jidanbat garram im.
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

kriol: en wen deibin kamat langa det taun gulum sukait, gidiyan bin askim ola bosmen deya, "yumob garra gibit main solja olabat sambala daga. melabat nokap, en melabat ranimapbat det dubala midiyan king neim seba en seilmuna."
english: He said to the men of Succoth, "Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."

kriol: detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei garra jidan gudbalawei jis laik detlot tri weya oldei abum detmatj daga, en jis laik detlot sidatri weya oldei jidan strongbala.
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

kriol: yawei, gidap na en album mi garram main trabul. yu luk tharran garram yu ron ai. yawei, main boswan god, en god blanga ola isreil pipul, gidap na en panishim ol detlot pipul brom ebri kantri. yu nomo sori langa detlot hu jidan nogudbala en tufeiswan.
english: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

kriol: wal afta na king salaman bin tok langa abaiyatha det serramonimen, "yu gobek langa yu ronwan kantri einanoth. ai bina kilim yu ded, bat najing. ai kaan kilim yu ded na, dumaji yubin det boswan blanga det seikridwan boks blanga yawei wen yubin jidan iya garram main dedi deibid, en yubin oldei album im wen imbin abum trabul."
english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord Yahweh's ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted."

kriol: "wal if det haibala serramonimen dumbat nogudbala ting, im meigimbat ol detlot isreil pipul jidan giltiwan. wal im garra lafta deigim det yangwan boiwan buligi nomo garram enijing rong langa im, en im garra gibit sekrifais ofring langa mi blanga im nogudbalawei.
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to Yahweh for a sin offering.

kriol: en oni im na gin seibum wi. en wen imbin det rait taim, imbin shoum wi det wei, en imbin gibit det gudnyus langa mi, en imbin dalim mi blanga meigim ola pipul sabi det gudnyus.
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

kriol: en imbin dalim im, 'yu garra libum yu kantri en yu kantrimen olabat, en yu garra go langa det kantri weya ai garra shoum yu.'
english: and said to him, 'Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.'

kriol: god bin yusum im ron pawa blanga meigim olabat jinggabat eniwei, en afta deibin bulurrum det brabli wikitwan men.
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

kriol: wal afta na king deibid bin gobek langa im ron kemp du blanga luk im femili olabat, en im waif mikal bin kamat atsaid blanga midim im, en imbin dalim king deibid nogudbalawei, "yu haibala men, dumaji yu king blanga ola isreil pipul, indit? bat tudei yubin meigim miselp brabli lobala, dumaji yubin densdensbat jis laiga granggibala men lida langa ol detlot wekingel en wekinmen blanga yu, en yu nomo bin werrimon eni klos. yubin oni gaburrumap miselp garram det shet." lagijat na mikal bin tok.
english: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, "How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants' maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!"

kriol: wal bambai wen deibin meigim det seikridwan boks blanga yawei, imbin dalim mosis blanga dalim eran blanga pudum det dram lida langa det seikridwan boks, en deya na deibin oldei kipum det dram.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

kriol: blanga main bifpat, maitbi im garra binijap, bat brom dijan bodi ai garra luk langa god na.
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

kriol: en ola keinanait pipul en ola najalot pipul garra irrim det nyus, en afta dei garra majurrumap miselp raidaran langa melabat, en dei garra kilim melabat holot ded. wal wanim yu garra dum blanga lukaftumbat det haibala neim blanga yu? dumaji if melabat holot dai, wal nobodi kaan sabi yu neim en rispek langa yu." lagijat na joshuwa bin tok.
english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will you do for your great name?"

kriol: bat detlot juda pipul bin dum ola nogudbala ting, en deibin meigim yawei gitwail brabliwei, dumaji deibin dum mowa nogudbala ting langa olabat femilimob weya bin jidan bifo.
english: Judah did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

kriol: obedidam bin lafta wotjimbat det sauthwei geit, en detlot san blanga im bin lafta wotjimbat detlot stowa rum.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

kriol: "saiman, yu nomo bin welkam mi garram kis. bat dijan gel im kipgon kiskis main fut.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

kriol: "aibin kipgon fait langa detlot emanait pipul deya langa det taun, en aibin teikoba det wodahol blanga olabat.
english: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, "I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.

kriol: en apekshed bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen, en imbin dai wen imbin 438 yiya ol.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kriol: yu ronwan sanmob garra go langa bebalon du weya olabat garra jidan sheimwan, en olabat garra oldei wekwekbat blanga det king langa im speshalwan haus."
english: 'They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon's palace.'"

kriol: "wal mi na, yawei, en ai garra panishim olabat garram fobala nogudbala ting. sambala garra dai brom faitfaitbat langa wo, en detlot wailwan dog garra deigimawei olabat bodi, en detlot bard garra dagadagat detlot bodi, en ola wailwan enimul garra dagat detlot boun en ola leftobawan bodipat.
english: "I will appoint over them four kinds," says Yahweh: "the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

kriol: wen im kaman langa olabat im garra binijimap olabat laiga bigwan faiya weya im barnbarn. yawei garra gitwail en binijimap olabat brabliwei jis laiga bigwan faiya weya barnimap ebrijing brabliwei.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

kriol: wal deibin jinggabat blanga kaman en fait en meigimbat trabul langa melabat isreil pipul blanga meigim melabat nomo jinggabat det wek.
english: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

kriol: god, seibum mi garram yu pawa, en garram yu pawa shoum pipul mi nomo rong.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Isn't David hiding himself among us?" Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

kriol: wal salaman bin jidan bos blanga ola najalot kantri sangodanwei langa det yufreitis riba, brom tifsa langa det yufreitis riba raidap sangodanwei langa det taun gulum gasa. en salaman bin jidan bos langa ola najalot king weya bin jidan sangodanwei langa det yufreitis riba, en ola pipul langa detlot kantri bin jidan gudbinji langa im.
english: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on all sides around him.

kriol: wal wi sabi tharran, dumaji langa oltestaman jisas bin tok, "god, ai garra dalim main braja en sista olabat wanim yubin dum, en ai garra preisim yu wen dei majurrumap miselp."
english: saying, "I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise."

kriol: ilaisha bin dalim det king det neksdei olabat garra baiyim ola gudwan sid daga deya langa sameriya garram lilbit silbawan mani.
english: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, "Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;"

kriol: deya langa det taun aibin luk wanbala purdiwan kout brom det kantri gulum bebalon, en aibin gajim det kout, en sambala silba en gol du. aibin gajim 2 kilogrem silba en 500 grem gol dumaji, wen aibin luk detlot ting, aibin laigim detlot ting brabli, en aibin gajim detlot ting, en afta aibin deigim detlot ting langa main kemp. deya na aibin blandim detlot ting insaid langa main tent. aibin grajim hol, en aibin pudum det silba andanith en ola najalot ebrijing ontop langa det silba, en afta aibin gaburrumap ol detlot ting." lagijat na det men bin tok.
english: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it."

kriol: "wal aibin luk ebrijing weya pipul oldei dumbat langa dijan wel, en ai dalim yu, im brabli adwan blanga sabi. wal im jis laik aibin trai dalimbat det win wujei blanga go.
english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

english: Of the angels he says, "He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire."

english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

english: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

kriol: "wal afta yawei bin tok langa mi igin,
english: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,

english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

english: Sarah, my master's wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

kriol: en imbin dalim olabat, "tudei na wen yumob bin irrim mi ridimat det wed, det wed bin hepin trubala."
english: He began to tell them, "Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing."

english: Then Job answered,

english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,' says the Lord Yahweh."

english: "Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

kriol: yu jis laik det bigwan wol weya oldei stapam pipul brom ardimbat im, en nomo oni im, bat holot im bigininimob, en ol im kantri du. yu oldei meigim im brabli haibala blanga ola gudbala ting im oldei dumbat, en ol im enimulmob oldei jidan ebriweya.
english: Haven't you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

kriol: "yawei im jis laiga brabli strongwan ston weya kipum yumob seifwan. im neba dum eni rong ting. yumob gin oldei trastimbat god. im brabli gudbala en im oldei gibit feyago.
english: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

kriol: bat tudei olabat jidan dedwan langa ola roud, en nobodi nomo bin sabi wotkain olabat feis. olabat jidan rotinwan. blanga olabat bodi bin go draiwan en nogud jis laiga wadi.
english: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.

kriol: en det men bin kaman iya langa dijan taun garram leda brom det boswan haibala serramonimen blanga deigidawei ola pipul hu oldei bulurrum yu."
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name."

kriol: preisim yawei det trubala god! preisim god langa im serramoni pleis! preisim im blanga im pawa langa hebin!
english: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

kriol: wal wen ethalaiya det mami blanga king eihesaiya bin irrim im san bin dai, streidawei imbin gibit oda blanga kilim ded ola king femili langa juda.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

kriol: yawei, yu panishim main enami olabat lagijat na, ol detlot na hu tok nogudbalawei langa mi.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

kriol: afta na det gel bin dalim semsan, "yubin meigim fan langa mi igin, en yu nomo bin tok trubala langa mi. wal yu dalim mi na hau dei garra taiyimap yu blanga bidim yu." wal semsan bin tok, "if yu pletim main heya garram det mishin weya yu oldei meigim matiriyal, en if yu meigim im taitwan, wal ai garra jidan jis laik enibodi."
english: Delilah said to Samson, "Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound." He said to her, "If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom."

kriol: wal yumob garra jandap brabli strongbalawei weya yumob bilib langa jisas krais, en yumob kaan larram det dibuldibul deigidawei yumob, dumaji yumob sabi ola kristjan pipul ebriweya langa dijan wel oldei go thru langa det trabul du.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

kriol: wal ola daga weya salaman bin oldei wandim ebridei bin 1,500 kilogrem sofwan flauwa, 3,000 kilogrem rafwan flauwa,
english: Solomon's provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,

kriol: afta na mosis bin tok, "yawei bin tok wi garra seibum sambala mena wulijim ola biginini blanga wi hu garra bulurrum wi biyain garra luk wotkain daga imbin gibit langa wi wen imbin deigidawei wi brom ijip."
english: Moses said, "This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, 'Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.'"

kriol: wal wen det rait taim bin kaman, det king bin werrimon im speshalwan klos, en imbin jidan langa det speshalwan tjeya, en imbin tok langa ola pipul,
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

kriol: imbin mowa klebawan langa ola men. en imbin mowa klebawan langa ithan det esrahait men en heiman en kelkol en dada hubin detlot san blanga mahol, en langa ola pipul langa najalot kantri bin sabi imbin brabli klebabalawan.
english: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.

kriol: wal afta na king deibid bin dalim jowab en detlot solja blanga im blanga breigim olabat klos en blanga werrimon sekbeigwan klos blanga kraikrai blanga ebna. en wen deibin abum det fyunral, deibid bin bulurrumbat det boks biyain blanga shoum rispek langa ebna.
english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, "Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner." King David followed the bier.

kriol: langa det dei wen yumob gibit det sid daga ofring, yumob garra gibit det barnapwan sekrifais ofring du, wan lilwan boiwan ship en nomo garram enijing rong langa im.
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

kriol: afta na eibrahem bin berrim det dedbala waif blanga im deya langa det keib weya imbin baiyim gulijap langa det taun gulum hebran deya langa det kantri gulum keinan.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

kriol: pipul blanga jerusalem, larram dijan trabul jidan woning blanga yumob. if yumob nomo teiknodis langa dijan woning en libum yumob nogudbalawei wal ai garra gibit bekboun langa yumob, ai garra meigim det taun blanga yumob jidan brabli rabishwan jis laik deset kantri weya nobodi kaan jidan deya." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land."

kriol: ol yumob gel brom jerusalem, irrim mi na. mi blekwan, en mi brabli purdiwan. mi brabli blekwan wulijim detlot tent blanga detlot deset pipul, en mi brabli purdiwan wulijim detlot ketin langa det haus blanga salaman.
english: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar's tents, like Solomon's curtains.

kriol: det haibala hebin im jidan blanga yawei, bat imbin gibit ola kantri langa dijan wel langa wi.
english: The heavens are Yahweh's heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "yumob jinggabat wanim det amalekait traib bin dum langa yumob wen wibin kaman brom ijip.
english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

kriol: ailibala neksdei na eibrahem bin gajim faiyawud blanga barnimap im san, en imbin loudimap det faiyawud langa wanbala dongki, en imbin gajim im san aisik en dubala wekinmen blanga im, en deibin ol go langa det kantri weya god bin dalim im blanga go.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

kriol: en langa det seimwan dei wen det gel bin kaman langa im, othniyel bin dalim det gel blanga go en askim im dedi blanga gibit im fam, en det gel bin go langa im dedi, en wen imbin godan brom im dongki, im dedi bin askim im, "wanim yu wandim?"
english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, "What do you want?"

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim im, "filip, brom longtaim aibin jidan garram yumob. bat stil yu nomo sabi mi brabliwei, dumaji yubin dalim mi blanga shoum yu main dedi. bat ai dalim yu. ebribodi hubin luk mi bin luk main dedi du.
english: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, 'Show us the Father'?

kriol: wen im oldei blowim, im oldei meigim faiya kamat brom im mawus, en im barnimap ebrijing.
english: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

kriol: en deibin bildimap insaid langa det bekwan wol blanga det serramoni pleis, det brabli insaidpat rum weya dei gulum det brabli seikridwan rum. en imbin jidan 9 mita long en deibin meigim det wol garram sidatri wud brom det flopat raidap langa top.
english: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

kriol: afta na jisas bin stat titjimbat im wekinmen olabat blanga imselp weya im garra dai. imbin tok, "mi na det speshalwan men, en ai garra abum loda trabul. ola haibala bos en ola haibala serramonimen en ola lowamen garra ol tjakidawei mi, en dei garra kilim mi ded. bat thrideistaim ai garra gidap brom dedbala en jidan laibala."
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

kriol: olabat garram irriwol bat olabat kaan lisin enijing, en blanga olabat nos kaan smelim enijing.
english: They have ears, but they don't hear. They have noses, but they don't smell.

kriol: wal aibin kipgon tok, "det kantri gulum ithiyopiya im sauthwei brom ijip en im oldei jidan garram loda insek ebriweya.
english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

kriol: wal jeikob bin jandim juda lida blanga askim josef blanga midim olabat langa det kantri gulum goshin,
english: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

english: He said to them, "When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?" They said, "Nothing."

kriol: yu jinggabat na. main laif kaan jidan longtaim. yubin meigim pipul blanga dai.
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

english: The rest of the dead didn't live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

english: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, "Why have your servants set my field on fire?"

kriol: en afta detlot filastain pipul bin jandim wed langa ola serramonimen blanga olabat en langa ola doktabala blanga olabat, en wen deibin kamat deya, detlot pipul bin askim olabat, "wanim wi garra dum garram det seikridwan boks? hau wi garra jandimbek det boks langa det isreil kantri weya imbin oldei jidanbat?"
english: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, "What shall we do with Yahweh's ark? Show us how we should send it to its place."

kriol: lagijat na deibin tok blanga dum, en deibin ol agri blanga fait langa detlot pipul langa det taun.
english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

english: For through the anger of Yahweh, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

kriol: im trubala yawei, detlot asiriya king bin meigim loda kantri jidan jis laik deset kantri.
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,

english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God's Kingdom."

kriol: "wal lagijat na im garra hepin langa yumob isreil pipul deya langa det taun gulum bethel, dumaji yumob bin dumbat det brabli nogudbala ting. en streidawei wen det trabul garra stat, det king blanga ol yumob isreil pipul garra dai." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.

kriol: ola drimin blanga najalot pipul, olabat bin meigim brom silba en gol. garram olabat ronwan bingga olabat bin meigim detlot drimin.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

kriol: en wen jon beptis bin gulijap binij det wek weya god bin gibit im, imbin dalim ola pipul. 'yumob lisin langa mi na. mi nomo det boswan weya yumob weidabat. det boswan garra kaman biyain langa mi, en mi nomo gudinaf blanga dum enijing blanga im.' lagijat na jon beptis bin tok blanga jisas.
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, 'What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.'

kriol: wen wikitwan pipul jidan laibala dei reken nomo enijing garra hepin langa olabat dumaji deibin oldei trastimbat ola ebrijing, bat wen olabat dai, ol detlot ting nomo bin album olabat.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

kriol: wal det wegan bin pulap wansaid langa bigwan ston deya langa det fam blanga wan men brom bethshemesh neim joshuwa, en ola pipul bin ran langa det wegan, en ola men brom det libai klen bin lidimap det seikridwan boks en det najawan boks brom det wegan, en deibin pudum det dubala boks ontop langa det ston. afta na ola pipul bin breigimap det wegan, en deibin meigim faiya garram det wud, en deibin kilim ded det dubala buligi, en deibin barnimap blanga gibit ofring langa yawei, en deibin gibit najalot ofring langa im du.
english: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

kriol: ol detlot sheip na yumob garra meigim, en yumob garra shoum rispek langa det drimin blanga ola isreil pipul. maitbi im garra stap panishimbat wi en ola drimin blanga wi en ola kantri blanga wi.
english: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.

kriol: "en yawei garra gibit yumob detmatj gudwan sid daga en ola daga weya yumob meigim redibala blanga dagat.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

kriol: bat if det holi spirit jidan bos blanga wi, wal det lowa kaan jidan bos blanga wi.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

kriol: "wal aibin meigim det boks garram det wadultri wud en aibin kadim dubala ston laik det dubala feswan en aibin deigim dubala deya ontop langa det bigwan hil.
english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

kriol: larram ol detlot pipul hu bleimbat najalot pipul jis fo najing nomo abum enijing gudwan hepin langa olabat. larram brabli nogudbala ting binijimap ola jigiwan pipul.
english: An evil speaker won't be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
