english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

kriol: "detlot powan pipul hu owim yu mani, yubin pulumat olabat klos raidap olabat bin peiyimbek yu det mani deibin owim yu.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

kriol: bambai na wan wekingel bin luk pida deya langa det faiya, en imbin tok, "dijan men bin deya garram jisas."
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, "This man also was with him."

kriol: "wal im garra brabli nogud blanga ol yumob lowamen en serramonimen, dumaji yumob tufeis. yumob oldei bulurrum det lowa weya im tok yumob garra gibit haf ola ebrijing blanga yumob langa ofring. bat yumob nomo bulurrum det haibala lowa weya im tok yumob garra tridimbat ola pipul kainwei en gibit olabat feyago en nomo tok laiyawei langa olabat. wal im gud yumob oldei gibitbat det ofring. bat yumob garra bulurrum det haibala lowa du.
english: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kriol: brom deya yawei bin dalim mosis,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kriol: "ol yumob pipul hu oldei kraikrai, yumob garra gudbinji, dumaji god garra album yumob en meigim yumob gudbinji.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

kriol: wal ai wandim yumob garra sabi mi oldei adwek brabliwei blanga ol yumob kristjan pipul deya langa det taun gulum kalosai en blanga ol detlot kristjan pipul langa det taun gulum leiyadasiya en blanga ol detlot najalot kristjan pipul hu nomo bin luk mi.
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

kriol: en aibin kamdan brom det hil. en jis laik yawei bin dalim mi aibin pudum det dubala ston insaid langa det boks weya aibin meigim en deibin jidan deya insaid olataim.
english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.

kriol: olkain pitja blanga detlot einjul gulum tjerabim en pamtri bin jidan langa detlot dowa wulijim detlot wol. en wud bin gaburrumap det atsaidwan dowawei langa det brenda.
english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

kriol: "wal tudei na ai wandim yumob blanga pikimat wanim yumob wandim. yumob wandim yawei garra jidan gudbala blanga yumob en album yumob, o yumob wandim im blanga gitwail en panishim langa yumob?
english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

kriol: en det nogudwan spirit im gowei, en im gajim naja sebenbala spirit mowa nogudwan, en dei ol kaman en jidan insaid langa det sambodi. en wen dei dum lagijat, det sambodi im brabli nogudwan na, nomo laik bifo wen imbin abum oni det wanbala nogudwan spirit insaid langa im. "wal yumob irrim mi na. if enibodi nomo langa main said, wal im fait langa mi. en if enibodi nomo album mi majurrumap pipul langa god, wal det sambodi andimwei olabat brom god."
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first."

kriol: detlot serramonimen na nomo bin lau blanga wek langa det serramoni pleis, bat olabat bin lau oni blanga dagat damba nomo garram raising jis laik detlot serramonimen blanga jerusalem.
english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn't come up to Yahweh's altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

kriol: wal wen detlot pipul deya langa det juwish miting pleis bin irrim im tok lagijat, deibin ol brabli wail,
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

kriol: brom deya yawei bin dalim mosis, "tumorro ailibala yunbala eran garra go en midim det ijip king wen im go langa det riba, en yunbala garra tok langa im. yunbala garra tok, 'yawei det trubala god wandim yu garra larramgo im pipul olabat wulijim dei garra go en weship langa im.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, "Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, 'This is what Yahweh says, "Let my people go, that they may serve me.

kriol: wal afta wen deibid bin kilim galaiyath, imbin kambek langa det kemp blanga ola isreil solja, en ebna bin deigim im langa king sol, en deibid bin stil abum det hed blanga galaiyath langa im bingga,
english: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

kriol: bat im garra binijimap detlot enami blanga im jis laiga strongwan fladwoda, en im garra jandim ol detlot pipul hu oldei fait langa im langa det brabli dakbala pleis.
english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

kriol: en wen imbin fait langa detlot pipul brom det kantri gulum amalek, imbin lafta fait brabli adbala. bat stil imbin bidim olabat, en imbin seibum ola isreil pipul brom ol detlot pipul hubin kaman blanga fait langa olabat.
english: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.

kriol: detlot lilwan hil en detlot bigwan hil maitbi ol garra binijap, bat ai garra oldei maindimbat en jidan brabli kainbala langa yumob. ai kaan neba breigim main pramis weya aibin meigim garram yumob."
english: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed," says Yahweh who has mercy on you.

kriol: wal aibin faindat dijan. im meigim mi brabli nogudbinji wen sambodi binijap, bat aibin faindat naja samting mowes. im det nogudwan gel hu jidan laiga trep redibala blanga gajulum sambodi en taiyimap im garram det strongbala tjein en holdim im adbala laik deth. im mowes den wen sambodi dai. bat if yu laigim god, yu gin ranawei brom det gel bat det gel gin gajulum detlot pipul hu jidan nogudbalawei.
english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

kriol: king amasaiya bin kilim ded 10,000 idamait solja deya langa det pleis gulum solt beli en imbin teikoba det taun gulum sela en imbin gulum det taun jokthiyel en im stil garram det neim tudei.
english: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

kriol: "imbin faindim yumob wokabat langa deset kantri, det draiwan pleis weya strongbala win bin oldei bloblobat. imbin deya en imbin lukaftum yumob, jis laik im lukaftumbat imselp.
english: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

kriol: en wen yumob meigim det teibul garram det wud, yumob garra libum im emtiwan insaid, en yumob garra bulurrum dis plen na weya ai gibit yu langa dijan hil.
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

kriol: nomeda deibin meigim det golwan buligi sheip en deibin tok, 'dijan na det drimin hubin deigidawei melabat brom ijip.' nomeda deibin mokimbat yu lagijat,
english: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, 'This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,' and had committed awful blasphemies,

kriol: wen ola najalot pipul garra irrim dis stori, dei garra bradin brabliwei. wen ola filastain pipul garra irrim dis stori, dei garra bradin brabliwei.
english: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim dislot wed langa im wekinmen olabat du, "if wanbala brom yumob go langa im fren haus midulnait, en yu askim im,
english: He said to them, "Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

kriol: ai nomo wandi kaman langa yumob streidawei, dumaji ai wandi jidan deya garram yumob lilbit longtaim. en if jisas krais det bos blanga wi larram mi, wal ai garra dum lagijat na. maitbi ai garra kaman kolwethataim en jidan deya raidap kolwetha binij, dumaji if ai jidan garram yumob lilbit longtaim, wal yumob gin album mi wen ai gowei brom yumob. bat ai nomo sabi weya ai garra go wen ai gowei brom yumob.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

kriol: yumob sabi? sambala pipul oldei jinggabat olabat ronselp, en dei nomo wandi teiknodis langa det trubala wed, dumaji dei wandi bulurrum det nogudbalawei. wal god garra gitwail detmatj langa detlot pipul, en im garra panishim olabat. ebribodi hu oldei kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting garra abum detmatj pein en trabul. ebribodi garra abum det trabul. ola juwish pipul garra abum trabul en ola jintail pipul garra abum trabul du. bat sambala pipul oldei kipgon dumbat olkain gudbala ting, dumaji dei wandim god garra tok gudbalawei blanga olabat en meigim olabat jidan haibala en meigim olabat jidan laibala olagija. en god garra duwit langa olabat en gibit olabat det olagijawan laif weya kaan neba binij.
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

kriol: en yu garra tjakidawei det graun en skai jis laik sambodi tjakidawei ola olwan klos. yu garra tjeinjim dubala jis laik sambodi tjeinjim im klos. bat yu kaan neba tjeinj, en yu kaan neba binij du." lagijat na god bin tok langa im san.
english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won't fail."

kriol: en yumob garra jidan langa det wan haus. yumob kaan go eniwei. oni deya na langa det wanbala haus yumob garra dagadagat daga. det men im garra lukaftum yumob blanga dagasaid dumaji yumob dumbat wek blanga god.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don't go from house to house.

kriol: yu garra dalim olabat if olabat wandi jidan laibala, olabat kaan garrimapbat eni loud langa det namba 7 dei gulum sebathdei. olabat kaan garrimap enijing thru langa detlot geit blanga jerusalem,
english: Yahweh says, "Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.

kriol: en wen det bednyus bin spredat langa detlot isreil pipul hubin jidan deya langa det jesriyel beli, en deibin irrim det bednyus blanga sol en im san olabat, deibin ol ranawei brom olabat taun. en ola filastain pipul bin teikoba ol detlot taun blanga olabat.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kriol: en imbin barnim det bif en skin atsaid brom olabat kemp.
english: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

kriol: wal king jehosafet en im ami bin go langa detlot kemp, en deibin faindim loda buligi, en loda klos, en najalot gudwan ting en deibin deya 3 dei gajimbat detlot ting, bat detlot ebrijing bin tumatj blanga olabat blanga deigimbek, en deibin lafta libum sambala ting deya.
english: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. They took plunder for three days, it was so much.

kriol: en imbin deigimwei ola ebrijing brom det serramoni pleis blanga yawei en brom detlot bigwan haus blanga det king, en imbin deigimwei ola goldinwan shild weya king salaman bin meigim du.
english: and he took away the treasures of Yahweh's house and the treasures of the king's house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

kriol: raidimdan detlot lowa langa det dowawei en langa det geit langa yumob kemp.
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

kriol: dumaji main skin im brabli draiwan im kamatkamatbat, en main bodi im barnbarn nomo lilbit.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

kriol: "yu garra dalim detlot isreil pipul, olabat garra gibit det libai klen, sambala bigwan taun blanga jidanbat, en sambala gras kantri raun langa detlot taun.
english: "Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

kriol: wal wen detlot braja blanga josef bin luk detlot ishmeil pipul, juda bin tok, "wotfo wi garra kilim det braja blanga wi en blandim im bodi?
english: Judah said to his brothers, "What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

kriol: wal yu jinggabat na. yu garram olkain dish en jag deya langa yu haus. yu garram sambala dish en jag weya deibin meigim eniwei, en yu oldei yusum detlot dish en jag blanga pudum enijing. en yu garram sambala brabli gudwan dish en jag weya deibin meigim garram gol en silba, en yu oldei yusum detlot dish en jag wen yu abum speshalwan dina.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

kriol: wal yumob dalim mi na. hu garram det pawa blanga bidim dijan wel? nobodi. oni detlot pipul hu bilib jisas krais na det san blanga god.
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

kriol: wal yawei bin gibit oda langa gidiyan na, "yu brabli strongbala men, en yu garra go en seibum ola isreil pipul brom detlot midiyan pipul, dumaji mi na dalim yu blanga go."
english: Yahweh looked at him, and said, "Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven't I sent you?"

kriol: ai nomo jandim yu langa detlot pipul hu tok difrinwan langgus, bat ai garra jandim yu langa detlot isreil pipul.
english: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

kriol: en if yumob kipgon bilib langa det wed weya aibin dalimbat yumob, wal god garra seibum yumob. bat if yumob nomo kipgon bilib langa det gudnyus, wal yumob jis weistimbat taim.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

kriol: en mosis bin tok, "tudei na yumob garra dagat dis daga, dumaji im det speshalwan dei blanga yawei, en yumob kaan faindim eni daga tudei.
english: Moses said, "Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to Yahweh. Today you shall not find it in the field.

kriol: yu si? wibin joinin garram jisas krais, en wi garra abum trabul seimwei laik imbin abum. en god garra album wi brabliwei seimwei laik imbin album jisas.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

kriol: langa det dei bambai najalot pipul garra tok langa detlot pipul langa jerusalem. dei garra tok, 'nomo bradin, yumob pipul blanga saiyan. nomo nogudbinji en ranawei.
english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, "Don't be afraid, Zion. Don't let your hands be weak."

kriol: yu kaan dalim yu braja yu garra deigimat det lilwan ting brom im ai wen yu kaan luk dumaji yu garram det bigwan ting langa yu ron ai. yu granggibala if yu trai en dum lagijat. yu garra deigimat det bigwan ting brom yu ronwan ai basdam, en afta yu gin luk gudwei, en yu gin deigimat det lilwan ting brom yu braja ai na. "yumob sabi? yu garra streitinimat yu ronwan laif bifo yu gin album yu braja streitinimat im laif.
english: Or how can you tell your brother, 'Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,' when you yourself don't see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye.

kriol: wal wen detlot isreil solja bin ranimap detlot filastain solja, deibin kamat langa det bush kantri weya loda shugabeig tri bin jidan,
english: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground.

kriol: wal yawei bin ensim na, "yumob reken det gel gin fogedabat im biginini hubin oldei wandim dringgimbat milk brom im? yumob reken im garra libum im lilwan beibi hubin bon brom im ronwan bodi? nomeda det gel gin fogedabat im beibi, bat ai kaan neba fogedabat yumob.
english: "Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!

kriol: det gridiwan men im hariyap blanga meigim miselp jidan ritjwan. im nomo sabi im garra jidan powan bambai.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn't know that poverty waits for him.

kriol: afta wen jisas bin tok lagijat, imbin jingat adbala, "lesaras! yu kamat!"
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"

kriol: ola ebrijing king pekahaiya bin dum deibin raidimdan langa det buk gulum, ola stori blanga ola king brom isreil.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

kriol: brom deya najawan einjul bin kamat igin. dijan einjul bin boswan blanga det faiya, en imbin kamat brom det pleis weya deibin abum det teibul blanga ofring, en imbin jingat adbala langa det najawan einjul hubin abum det krukidwan naif, "yu garra gajim ola nogudwan pipul langa ola kantri na. jis laik ola kukwan greiptri daga yu garra gajimbat. yu yusum det krukidwan naif en kadim detlot greiptri daga, dumaji olabat kukwan na."
english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, "Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth's grapes are fully ripe!"

kriol: en langa det namba 4 dei melabat bin go langa det serramoni pleis en kaundimap ola silba en gol en najalot enijing en melabat bin gibit langa det serramonimen neim meremoth det san blanga yuraiya. eliyeisa det san blanga finiyas en naja dubala libaimen, josabed, det san blanga jeshuwa, en nowadaiya, det san blanga binuwai, bin deya garram im.
english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.

kriol: ai garra tjakam yumob langa jeil en jandimbek wanbala langa yumob kantri blanga bringimap det yangboi iya langa mi. en if im nomo bringimbek im, wal ai sabi yumob kaninbala orait."
english: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies."

kriol: en detlot najalot lilwan taun raidap langa beilath. deibin raidimdan ola femilimob en weya olabat bin oldei jidan.
english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

kriol: im tok, "det boswan bin tok im garra meigim nyubalawei blanga ola pipul, en wen im meigim det nyubalawei, im garra raidimdan det wed insaid langa olabat hat en main brabliwei.
english: "This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days," says the Lord, "I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;" then he says,

kriol: dei kaan gaburrumap yu langa det graun laik najalot king. yubin meigim yu kantri jidan rabishwan, en yubin medrimbat yu ronwan pipul olabat. yu brabli krulbala enimul! dei nomo wandim sabi blanga yu femilimob enimo.
english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

kriol: en jisas bin tok, "wal yu luk na! yu gudbala na, dumaji yubin bilib langa mi."
english: Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you."

kriol: det serramonimen garra luk tharran igin langa det namba 7 dei, en if det moldiwan bin spredat mowa, det ting im nomo klinbala blanga serramoni.
english: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

kriol: nomeda trabul deya blanga stapam olabat laik solwoda, bat ai garra meigim olabat kipgon nomeda dei abum trabul. ai gin meigim det solwoda jidan kwait, en ai gin draiyimap ola woda langa det nail riba. detlot pipul langa asiriya tok, 'nobodi gin bidim wi!' bat ai garra bidim olabat brabliwei. detlot pipul langa ijip tok, wi garram pawa! bat ai garra meigim olabat wikwan.
english: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat wanim bin hepin langa jisas. nomeda ol detlot nogudbala pipul bin tridim im brabli nogudbalawei, bat stil im nomo bin larram olabat stapam im. en yumob garra lagijat du. yumob kaan larram enibodi meigim yumob nogudbinji en meigim yumob gibap.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don't grow weary, fainting in your souls.

kriol: afta na eibul bin bringimap det feswan lilwan ship weya bin bon, en imbin kilim det lilwan ship, en imbin gibit det gudwan bifpat blanga ofring langa yawei. wal yawei bin gudbinji blanga det ofring weya eibul bin gibit im.
english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,

kriol: wal nomo eni speshalwan mesinja laik mosis bin jidan langa detlot isreil pipul dumaji yawei bin tok garram im feis tu feis.
english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,

kriol: en deya na aibin luk sanraiswei. aibin luk det brabli shainiwan lait blanga god, det god blanga ola isreil pipul. det nois aibin irrimbat bin brabli bigwan nois jis laik det solwoda wen im abum bigwan weib, en ebrijing aibin luk bin shain brabliwei, dumaji det brabli shainiwan lait blanga im bin deya.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

kriol: bat wen det rait taim bin kaman, god bin jandim im ronwan san, en imbin bon jis laik wi,
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

kriol: wal job bin gitwail langa god. imbin tok, "mi nomo laigim jidanbat laibala en brom insaid main hat mi grambul langa yu main god.
english: "My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

kriol: yumob lidamob reken yumob jidan seif jis laik det bif langa det aiyanwan pot, bat dijan taun kaan kipum yumob seif. ai garra panishim yumob nomeda weya yumob jidan langa isreil.
english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

kriol: wal yu garra meiksho yu gin luk det lait brabliwei, dumaji yu nomo wandi jidan dakbala.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn't darkness.

kriol: en imbin tjeinjim det sanrais win, en imbin meigim brabli strongbala win kaman brom sangodanwei, en det win bin deigidawei ola grashopa brom det kantri en tjakidawei olabat langa det solwoda gulum redsi. nomo eni grashopa bin jidan langa det kantri na.
english: Yahweh sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.

kriol: ola kap blanga king salaman en ola ebrijing langa det rum gulum lebanan tri rum, deibin meigim brom gudwan gol. olabat bin reken det silba nomo brabli gudwan langa king salaman taim.
english: All King Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

kriol: afta na detlot isreil pipul bin tenim miselp brom yawei en dumbat nogudbala ting, en yawei bin meigim det king brom det kantri gulum moweb mowa strongbala langa detlot isreil pipul. det king bin neim iglan,
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in Yahweh's sight.

kriol: en olabat garra abum det seimkain daga wulijim najalot serramonimen deya. olabat gin kipum detlot ting weya olabat femilimob jandim blanga olabat."
english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

kriol: wal jonathan bin tok, "wal kaman na. yunmi go det said en shoum miselp langa detlot filastain solja,
english: Then Jonathan said, "Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.

kriol: en imbin gobek langa im dedi en mami, en imbin tok, "aibin luk wanbala filastain gel deya langa timna, en ai wandim yunbala garra go en gajim im, dumaji ai wandi merrit langa im."
english: He came up, and told his father and his mother, saying, "I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. Now therefore get her for me as my wife."

kriol: en blanga tharran na ai garra gajimbek ola daga brom im wen det daga im kukwan, en ai garra deigidawei ola wain brom im wen det wain im redibala blanga dringgim, en ai garra pulumat im ola wul en gudwan matiriyal weya aibin gibit im blanga meigim klos blanga werrimon.
english: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.

kriol: yawei, yubin luk insaid main hat, en yu sabi ebrijing weya mi dum en jinggabat.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

kriol: "isikiyel, wanim garra hepin langa det lilwan wadi brom det greiptri afta det fama kadimof? im nomo laik detlot najalot tri.
english: "Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

kriol: en dei oldei bitsimap det olib daga blanga meigim oliboil, en detlot greip daga blanga meigim wain, bat stil olabat jidan thestibala.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

kriol: hu gin kaundimap ola sta? nobodi. oni god na en brom im na det lait bin kaman en im shain ebriweya.
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

kriol: "en nomo eni isreil men o wuman kaan silipsilipbat garram enibodi blanga mani deya langa det serramoni pleis.
english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

kriol: detlot wuliwan ting garra meigim yumob jinggabat blanga kipum main wed, en yumob garra jidan brabliwei blanga mi.
english: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

kriol: det silibala men hu tok garram sabibala wed, im jis laik det men hu garram dubala kripulwan leig en kaan mubaran.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kriol: en wen mefibosheth bin kaman langa im, imbin baudan lida langa king deibid blanga shoum rispek langa im, en king deibid bin dalim im, "mefibosheth." en mefibosheth bin tok, "mi na yu wekinmen."
english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, "Mephibosheth?" He answered, "Behold, your servant!"

kriol: "bat yu en yu amimob reken yumob gin jandap strongbala en fait langa detlot pipul weya yawei bin gibit langa ola bigininimob blanga deibid. bat yumob oni sabi ola drimin sheip weya king jerabowam bin meigim garram gol weya luk jis laik buligi.
english: "Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of Yahweh in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.

kriol: wal ai dalim yumob. yumob brabli granggibala. det teibul blanga ofring im mowa haibala langa detlot ofring, dumaji det teibul meigim detlot ofring seikridwan.
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

kriol: god sabi ebrijing, bat yu dalim mi hau god meigim laitining shain oloba langa skai, en hau im oldei pudum detlot klaud langa det emtiwan pleis.
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

kriol: wal wen pol bin tok lagijat, detlot boswan blijiman bin gobek langa detlot roman bos, en deibin dalim olabat wanim pol bin tok, en wen detlot roman bos bin irrim dubala bin abum det rait, seimwei laik ola roman pipul, deibin bradin,
english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

kriol: wal wandei ruth bin askim neiyomi, "yu larram mi go langa fam blanga gajimbat detlot sid daga weya detlot wekinmen oldei libum biyain. maitbi sambodi garra larram mi wek langa im fam." wal neiyomi bin tok, "orait, main gel. yu gin go."
english: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, "Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor." She said to her, "Go, my daughter."

kriol: wal king neiko bin jandim mesij langa king josaiya, "ai nomo wandim fait langa yu, king blanga juda. melabat kaan fait langa yu. bat god bin dalim mi blanga go kwikbala en binijimap main enamimob. god im langa main said, en if yu stapam mi, wal god garra binijimap yu."
english: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, "What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you."

kriol: yu si? god bin kain langa yumob jintail pipul, en blanga tharran na detlot juwish pipul bin gibit im bekboun, en dei nomo dum wanim im wandim olabat blanga dum. en dumaji dei nomo dum wanim im wandim olabat blanga dum, wal im gin kain langa olabat jis laik imbin kain langa yumob.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

kriol: yunbala gobek langa yunbala kantrimen, dumaji mi olgamen na. ai kaan merrit igin. ai kaan merrit tunait en abum san blanga merrit langa yunbala.
english: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, 'I have hope,' if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,

kriol: wal det san blanga eibrahem neim aisik bin abum dubala san neim isau en jeikob.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

kriol: yawei bin libum detlot traib deya blanga testim ola isreil pipul blanga faindat if dei garra dum wanim detlot lowa bin tok weya mosis bin gibit langa olabat grengrenfathamob.
english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to Yahweh's commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

kriol: wal sambala lowamen en serramonimen gulum ferasi bin deya du, en deibin gitwail wen deibin luk detlot pipul, en deibin tok, "wotfo dijan men laigim ol detlot nogudbala pipul? wotfo im oldei dagadagat daga garram olabat?"
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, "This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them."

kriol: bambai na jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin go thru langa jeriko. loda pipul bin deya garram olabat, en wen deibin kamat najasaid langa det taun, deibin luk wanbala men bin jidanbat deya, en imbin blainwan. det blain men bin san blanga tameiyas, en imbin neim batameiyas, en imbin jidanbat deya wansaid langa det roud askimbat enibodi blanga mani.
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

kriol: dumaji pipul nomo abum det panishmen streidawei blanga olabat nogudbalawei, wal pipul reken im rait en dei kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting olataim.
english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

kriol: "wal ai garra majurrumap ola isreil pipul, en ai garra panishim olabat holot, en nomo longtaim na det haibala king brom asiriya garra meigim olabat abumbat adtaim, en dei garra ardimbat nomo lilbit.
english: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.

kriol: wen aibin oldei jinggabat ola nogud ting, en aibin oldei ardimbat,
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

kriol: wal king deibid bin dalim ebishai en im braja jowab, "nobodi bin askim yunbala blanga tok. wal wotfo yunbala pudum miselp? maitbi yunbala wandi meigim trabul blanga mi. bat ai dalim yunbala. mi na det king blanga ola isreil pipul. en nomo eni isreil pipul garra dai tudei."
english: David said, "What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don't I know that I am king over Israel today?"

kriol: olabat bradin langa yu brabliwei, en olabat rispek yu brabliwei du.
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

kriol: wal wotfo wi lisin olabat tok garram wi ron langgus?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

kriol: "afta na, detlot libai pipul garra pudum olabat bingga langa det dubala hed blanga det dubala buligi. wanbala bin blanga det ofring blanga det nogudbalawei, en det najawan bin blanga det barnapwan ofring. dijan na blanga meigim detlot libai pipul jidan fri brom det panishmen brom olabat nogudbalawei.
english: "The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

kriol: wen main pipul bin abum brabli nogudwan sowa, yumob bin tok, 'im rait.' bat im nomo bin rait.
english: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

kriol: en imbin gajim det shugabeig garram im bingga, en imbin dagadagat wen imbin wokwok langa det roud, en afta imbin gibit sambala shugabeig langa im dedi en mami, en dubala bin dagat du. bat im nomo bin dalim dubala imbin gajim det shugabeig brom det dedwan laiyan.
english: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn't tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion's body.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "yumob isreil pipul, yumob garra teiknodis en duwit ebrijing yawei det trubala god blanga wi bin tok blanga im lowa. yumob dum ebrijing weya imbin dalim yumob blanga dum.
english: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

kriol: "im garra brabli nogud blanga yumob, dumaji yumob blainwan lida. yumob oldei tok, 'if enibodi meigim pramis, en im yusum det neim blanga det serramoni pleis blanga bekimap det wed blanga im, wal im gin oldei breigim det pramis. bat if im yusum det neim blanga ola gol deya langa det serramoni pleis blanga bekimap det wed blanga im, wal im kaan breigim det pramis.' lagijat na yumob oldei tok.
english: "Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, 'Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.'

kriol: dei garra kilim yu sanmob blanga peibek yu blanga yu brabli nogudbalawei. olabat kaan abum dijan kantri. olabat kaan bildimap eni taun eniweya iya langa dijan graun.
english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

kriol: "'bambai wen det 40 yiya garra gopas, ai garra bringimbek yu pipul olabat brom detlot kantri weya aibin spredimat olabat.
english: "'For the Lord Yahweh says: "At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.

kriol: wen king eiheb bin dai, im san eihesaiya bin jidan det nyuwan king.
english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

kriol: afta na aibin tok, "yawei, yu sabi. yu jinggabat mi en yu album mi. yu larram mi fait langa detlot pipul hu oldei ardimbat mi. yu nomo jidan kwaitbala, en larram olabat kilim mi. yu sabi ol dislot ting bin hepin langa mi, dumaji mi na wekinmen blanga yu.
english: Yahweh, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don't take me away. Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.

kriol: en yu garra tok, 'dijan na wanim garra hepin langa bebalon. jis laik dijan buk garra godan langa woda, en neba gidap igin, bebalon garra binijap, dumaji yawei na det trubala god garra binijimap im.'" ol detlot wed blanga jeramaiya im binij iya na.
english: Then you shall say, 'Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.'" Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

kriol: en im na bin seibum mi brom ola pipul hu nomo laigim mi. wal yawei, yu na det trubala god, en yu na bin meigim mi bidim main enami olabat, en yu na bin oldei lukaftumbat mi wen enibodi bin wandi kilim mi ded.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

kriol: wal ebribodi deya bin joinin langa olabat, en deibin jinginat ebriweya langa det taun, en deibin grebum det dubala men brom mesadoniya hubin wek garram pol. det dubala men bin neim gaiyas en aristakas, en deibin deigim dubala langa det bigwan pleis weya ola pipul bin oldei hipap.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel.

kriol: yumob sabi? pipul oldei gibitbat mi trabul dumaji mi dumbat det wek blanga jisas krais, en dei oldei gibitbat mi adtaim blanga det wek blanga im, en dei oldei tok nogudbalawei blanga mi, en dei oldei meigim mi jidan wikwan du. bat nomeda mi oldei abum detkain trabul, bat stil mi oldei gudbinji, dumaji wen mi jidan wikwan garram main ronwan pawa, det taim na mi jidan strongbala garram det pawa blanga god.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

kriol: deibin oldei taiyimap im, en deibin deigim im langa det king langa bebalon. deibin lokimap im deya wulijim dei kaan neba irrim im jinginatbat igin langa det hil kantri langa isreil.
english: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

kriol: "wen enibodi abum trabul en im brabli apset wal im jingat langa sambodi blanga album im.
english: "However doesn't one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

kriol: sambala pipul oldei meigimbat olabat ronwan plen, bat oni yawei na garra meigim det ting hepin.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.

kriol: wal im lagijat du wen enibodi gibit bekboun langa god, en im nomo sabi im wei, en im garra binijap.
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

kriol: wal wen imbin tok lagijat, ol detlot serramonimen bin stat agamin na,
english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

kriol: wal deibin oldei tenawei brom mi en gibit mi bekboun en bulurrumbat ola najalot drimin. brom det taim wen aibin deigidawei olabat brom ijip raidap tudei deibin oldei dumbat lagijat langa mi. en tudei dei dumbat seimwei langa yu na.
english: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

kriol: if det merrit gel meigim pramis, o pramis im kaan dum samting,
english: "If she vowed in her husband's house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

kriol: pipul garra kaman brom ebriweya en joinin langa det bigbala padi weya dei garra abum deya langa det pleis blanga god.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God's Kingdom.

kriol: king salaman bin abum 4,000 haus blanga im hosis en bagi, en imbin abum 12,000 hosis blanga wo. sambala bin jidan langa jerusalem en sambala langa najalot taun.
english: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

kriol: en ebrijing weya aibin oldei wandim aibin oldei gajim. aibin trai dum ebrijing blanga meigim mi brabli gudbinji. wen aibin dum adwek tharran na bin meigim mi gudbinji blanga lilwail.
english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn't keep from them. I didn't withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

kriol: dumaji yawei det trubala god im brabli wail langa ebri pipul langa ebri kantri, im garra kilim olabat.
english: For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

kriol: bat detlot men blanga deibid bin oldei gudbala langa melabat. wen melabat bin deya langa olabat, dei nomo bin gibit melabat eni trabul, en dei nomo bin stilim enijing brom melabat du,
english: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn't miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

kriol: afta na sedakaiya det san blanga kenana bin go langa maikaiya en imbin hitim im langa im feis en sedakaiya bin tok, "wal brom wotaim det spirit blanga yawei bin libum mi en tok langa yu?"
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, "Which way did Yahweh's Spirit go from me to speak to you?"

kriol: wen ebribodi garra lisin langa tharran ting, wal dei garra bradin na en nomo enibodi garra ensabek igin."
english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

kriol: en seim taim detlot san blanga jeikob bin kambek brom det pedik. en wen deibin irrim det nyus blanga olabat sista, deibin hatjamp, en deibin temperap detmatj, dumaji shekam bin dum det nogud ting langa det gel blanga jeikob, en imbin meigim bed neim blanga ola isreil pipul. im nomo bina dum det ting lagijat.
english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

kriol: "main pipul olabat yumob jingat adbala en yumob tok, 'yawei bin shoum wi holot wi nomo giltiwan. wal wi garra go en dalim detlot pipul langa jerusalem wanim yawei det trubala god blanga wi bin dum.'" lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: 'Yahweh has produced our righteousness. Come, and let's declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.'

kriol: selman bin dedi blanga bowes, en det mami blanga bowes bin neim reiheb. bowes bin dedi blanga obed, en obed bin dedi blanga jesi.
english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

kriol: en deibin askim det lilboi dedi, "olmen, wanim neim yu wandi gibit det lilboi?"
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

kriol: olabat na garra album yumob blanga sabi mowa en jidan gudbalawei. olabat garra titjim yumob hau blanga jidan trubalawei, en hau blanga gibit feyago en blanga jidan raitwei.
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

kriol: wal det wekinmen weya jisas bin laigim brabliwei bin deya wansaid langa im,
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus' chest.

kriol: "wal yumob luk langa mi na, rait langa main dubala ai. ai kaan dalim yumob laiya.
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "wanim yumob reken? wen dei abum det padi blanga det men weya im garra merrit, dei garra ol jidan hanggribala wen im deya garram olabat? nomo. dei kaan jidan hanggriwan. dei garra dagat.
english: He said to them, "Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

kriol: ai nomo bin len blanga jidan sabibala blanga jinggabat gudwei, en ai nomo sabi blanga god.
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

kriol: en deibin grebum olabat en lokimap langa jeil.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

kriol: wotfo main mami bin nesimbat mi en gibitbat mi milk en larram mi jidan laibala?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

kriol: "wal yumob jandap iya na, dumaji ai garra meigim yumob jinggabat blanga ol detlot gudbala ting weya yawei bin dum blanga yumob en blanga yumob grengrenfatha olabat.
english: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before Yahweh concerning all the righteous acts of Yahweh, which he did to you and to your fathers.

kriol: "wal yumob na main biginini olabat. bat ai kaan jidan longtaim garram yumob iya. en yumob garra lukabat mi. en ai dalim yumob jis laik aibin dalim detlot juwish serramonimen. yumob kaan go weya ai garra go.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going, you can't come,' so now I tell you.

kriol: bat detlot pipul hu lisin gudwei langa mi garra jidan gudbalawei langa seifwan pleis. nomo enijing kaan ardimbat olabat na en dei kaan bradin blanga enijing." lagijat na det brabli sabibalawan bin tok.
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm."

kriol: en yunmi garra meigim pramis hau yunmi pipul olabat garra merrit.
english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

kriol: deibin raidimdan ol dislot wed wen jotham bin jidan king blanga juda, en jerabowam bin jidan king blanga isreil.
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

kriol: olabat bin brabli praudbala en dei nomo bin teiknodis langa enibodi, en deibin laigim dumbat ol detlot ting weya mi nomo laigim. wal yu sabi wanim aibin dum. aibin binijimap olabat na.
english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

kriol: olabat garra gajim detlot pipul hu oldei jidan deya langa detlot taun en langa detlot strongbala pleis, en meigim olabat jidan prisana. langa tharran dei na, detlot moweb solja garra bradin nomo lilbit, jis laik det wuman wen im garra abum im beibi.
english: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

kriol: ola gudbala pipul sabi hau blanga tridim detlot po pipul en gibit olabat feyago, bat detlot wikitwan pipul nomo sabi hau blanga albumbat po pipul raitwei.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren't concerned about knowledge.

kriol: en det femili lain blanga goma bin detlot pipul langa eshkenes, rifeth en togama.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

kriol: ola isreil gel garra go langa eni ijip gel en askim im blanga klos en gol en silba, en yumob garra meigim yumob san en doda werrimon detlot enijing, en yumob garra gowei brom det kantri garram ola gudbala ting blanga detlot pipul." lagijat na god bin tok langa mosis.
english: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians."

kriol: langa det laswan lain wanbala straipiwan grinwan en wanbala straipiwan yelawan en wanbala grinwan ston garra jidan. dei garra pudum detlot ston langa golwan ting blanga holdimap detlot ston,
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

kriol: wal deibin gobek na langa det taun sameriya. deibin go en jingat langa ola men hubin maindimbat det geit, "wen melabat bin go langa det kemp blanga ola siriya ami. melabat nomo bin irrim enijing en melabat nomo bin luk enibodi bin deya du. deibin libum ola hosis en dongki lagijat gin garram roup en deibin libum ola ebrijing langa olabat tent du."
english: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, "We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man's voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were."

kriol: ol yumob pipul hu gibit rispek langa god, kaman en irrim wanim imbin dum blanga mi.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

kriol: dei oldei tok olkain laiyawan wed, en detlot wed weya kamat brom olabat mawus im jis laik det poisin brom jigiwan sneik, en wen dei opinim olabat mawus en tok detlot wed, dei oldei ardimbat pipul.
english: "Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit." "The poison of vipers is under their lips."

kriol: bambai na god bin tok langa jeikob, "yu go kwikbala langa det pleis gulum bethel, en yu jidan deya na. en yu garra pailimap ston deya du, en yu garra barnim bif ontop langa detlot ston blanga sei theingkyu langa mi en meigim mi gudbinji, dumaji mi na tharran hubin kamat langa yu wen yubin ranawei brom yu braja isau."
english: God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother."

kriol: wal jowal bin tok langa detlot juda pipul na, "yumob garra blowim det wisul en jingat ontop langa det seikridwan hil blanga god gulum saiyan. en ol yumob pipul garra sheiksheik en bradin, dumaji det dei blanga yawei det trubala god im gulijap na,
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of Yahweh comes, for it is close at hand:

kriol: dumaji det libai klen garra jidan main ronwan pipul na. langa det taim na wen aibin kilim detlot fesbon san blanga detlot ijip pipul, aibin oni pikimat detlot fesbon san brom detlot isreil pipul, en detlot enimul du blanga jidan main ronwan pipul. bat ai nomo wandim detlot fesbon san brom detlot isreil pipul garra jidan main ronwan pipul, bat ai wandim oni det libai klen garra jidan main ronwan pipul, dumaji mi na yawei." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kriol: bat det einjul bin dalim olabat, "yumob nomo bradin. aibin kaman iya langa yumob blanga dalim yumob gudnyus, en det gudnyus garra meigim ebribodi brabli gudbinji.
english: The angel said to them, "Don't be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

kriol: nebusaradan bin deigim mi atsaid en imbin tok langa mi, "wal yawei det trubala god blanga yu bin tok im garra panishim en bitsimap dijan kantri,
english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him, "Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;

kriol: wal wen detlot fishamen bin pudumdan olabat fishnet, deibin gajim detmatj fish, en det fishnet bin gulijap breik,
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

kriol: aibin toktok det nogudbala wed blanga panishim ol yumob juda pipul strongbalawei dumaji yumob stilimbat ebrijing brom mi lagijat na.
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

kriol: wal langa det feswan dei, joshuwa bin dalim detlot serramonimen blanga garrimap det seikridwan boks raidaran langa det taun wantaim, en imbin dalim detlot solja nomo blanga jingat, en deibin dum wanim imbin dalim olabat, en afta deibin ol gobek langa olabat kemp.
english: So he caused Yahweh's ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.

kriol: det kantri garram detmatj riba en im brabli ritjwan en im garram detmatj mani en ola gudbala ting, bat blanga im taim im binij na, en det laif blanga im bin kadof jis laik wen yu kadim det kotin.
english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "ebriyiya yumob garra gibit wanbala brom ebri tenbala blanga ola ebrijing yumob bin growimapbat langa yumob ronwan pedik.
english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim olabat, "aibin meigim sikbala men gudbala langa sebathdei. en blanga tharran na yumob bin gitwail langa mi. wal yumob jinggabat det lowa blanga sebathdei en blanga sekamsais. nomeda mosis bin gibit yumob det lowa blanga sekamsais, bat stil det lowa nomo bin kamat brom im, dumaji yumob grengrenfatha olabat bin abum det lowa longtaim bifo mosis bin jidan. en yumob nomo wandi breigim det lowa blanga sekamsais. en blanga tharran na yumob oldei sekamsais ola lilboi. en nomeda im sebathdei, bat stil yumob oldei sekamsais ola lilboi. en nomeda yumob sekamsais ola lilboi langa sebathdei, bat stil yumob nomo breigim det lowa blanga sebathdei. yu si? wal wotfo yumob bin gitwail langa mi wen aibin dum det klebabala ting en meigim det men gudbala langa det sebathdei? aibin meigim yumob brabli hatjamp wen aibin dum det klebabala ting.
english: Jesus answered them, "I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

kriol: benabinadeb hubin merrit langa tafath det doda blanga king salaman, bin bos blanga ol det kantri gulum nafodowa.
english: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon's daughter, as wife);

kriol: wal yawei bin dalim mosis en eran, "iya na ola lowa blanga det pasoba serramoni. nomo eni streinja pipul kaan dagat det pasoba sapa.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, "This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

kriol: en if yumob gibit eni enimul garram enijing rong blanga im, wal mi na nomo wandim lagijat.
english: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

kriol: en najawan men neim sheba bin oldei raidimbat ola leda en enijing blanga deibid. en seidok en abaiyatha bin serramonimen blanga king deibid.
english: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,

kriol: en potafa bin gudbinji langa josef, en imbin meigim im raidenmen blanga im. imbin meigim josef bos raidoba langa ola pipul langa im kemp en blanga ebrijing weya imbin abum.
english: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

kriol: yu jis laiga det strongwan shild weya oldei stapam enijing weya gin ardim mi. mi oldei trastim oni langa yu. oni yu na gin album mi. yu oldei meigim mi gudbinji. wal ai garra kipgon preisimbat langa yu. ai garra kipgon singsing ola song blanga yu.
english: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim olabat, "wal yumob tjakam det fishnet langa det raidensaid langa det bout, en yumob garra gajim sambala fish." wal deibin tjakam det net, en wen deibin trai blanga pulumbek, najing, dumaji deibin gajim detmatj fish.
english: He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." They cast it therefore, and now they weren't able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

kriol: brom yumob na det gudnyus blanga jisas krais det bos blanga wi bin go ebriweya langa det dubala kantri, en ebribodi langa ola najalot kantri bin irrim yumob bilib langa god brabliwei. wal melabat kaan dalim enibodi blanga yumob weya yumob bin bilib langa jisas krais, dumaji ebribodi bin irrim det nyus blanga yumob olredi.
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.

kriol: yu kipgon laigimbat ol detlot hu sabi yu, en yu dum gudbala ting langa ol detlot hu jidan raitwei en nomo garram enijing rong.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

kriol: "aibin deigimwei ola hebiwan loud brom yumob bekboun, ol detlot brabli adwek langa ijip.
english: "I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

kriol: nomeda weya deibin go ola pipul brom najalot kantri bin tok nogudbalawei blanga mi. deibin tok aibin fosim olabat blanga gowei brom olabat ronwan kantri.
english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, 'These are Yahweh's people, and have left his land.'

kriol: "wal yunmi jidan iya raidap ailibala, dumaji ailibala yunmi garra faindat if im wandi lukaftumbat yu. en if im tok yuwai, wal im rait. bat if im tok im nomo wandi lukaftumbat yu, wal trubala ai dalim yu. ai garra lukaftumbat yu brabliwei. wal yu leidan iya na raidap ailibala." lagijat na bowes bin tok.
english: Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman's duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as Yahweh lives. Lie down until the morning."

kriol: detlot enami solja bin kamat brom det taun, en deibin fait langa detlot isreil solja, en deibin kilim ded sambala boswan isreil solja, en deibin kilim yuraiya ded du.
english: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David's servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

kriol: wal mosis bin dalim ola isreil pipul, "yumob garra gitredi blanga go en fait na dumaji yawei im wandi panishim detlot midiyan pipul blanga wanim olabat bin dum langa yumob.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh's vengeance on Midian.

kriol: wulijim ai garra jidan gudbinji en preisim yu garram ol yu pipul olabat blanga ola gudbala ting weya yu gibit melabat.
english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

kriol: en aibin meigim jandap dijan ston blanga makam dijan seikridwan pleis, en langa dijan seim pleis dei garra bildimap haus blanga yu bambai. en ebrijing weya yu gibit langa mi, ai garra gibitbek haf langa yu. blanga ebri tenbala ting yu gibit mi ai garra gibitbek yu wanbala ting." lagijat na jeikob bin meigim pramis langa god.
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God's house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you."

kriol: afta imbin meigim detlot taun brabli strongbala imbin pudum ola boswan solja lida langa ebri taun en imbin gibit daga, oliboil en wain langa ebriwan,
english: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.

kriol: brom deya ilaisha bin dalim im blanga opinimap det windo sanraisaid, en imbin dum, en ilaisha bin dalim im blanga shudum det erro, en wen imbin shudum det erro ilaisha bin tok, "yu na jis laik det erro blanga yawei hu garra album yu bidim ola siriya pipul langa det fait deya langa afek."
english: He said, "Open the window eastward;" and he opened it. Then Elisha said, "Shoot!" and he shot. He said, "Yahweh's arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them."

kriol: yumob sabi? wen enibodi dai, ola nogudbala ting nomo garram pawa langa im na. im jidan fri brom ol detlot nogudbala ting.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

kriol: wal det klen blanga ged bin jidan nowathwei brom det klen blanga rubin langa det kantri gulum beishan en raidap sanraiswei langa det pleis gulum salaka.
english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

kriol: wal god im det brabli haibalawan dedi weya jisas krais det bos blanga wi bin oldei bulurrum, en mi oldei askimbat im na blanga gibit yumob det holi spirit blanga meigim yumob sabi ebrijing en blanga meigim yumob sabi im brabliwei.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

kriol: afta na wen ola isreil pipul bin bidim detlot pipul brom det dubala taun gulum jeriko en eiyai, det nyus bin spredat ebriweya langa ola kantri sangodansaid langa det jodan riba. det nyus bin spredat langa ola hil kantri en langa ola plein kantri en langa ola kantri wansaid langa det solwoda gulum medatareiniyan olawei raidap langa det kantri gulum lebanan,
english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it.

kriol: wal wen job bin irrim ol dislot nyus imbin breigim im klos en sheibum im hed, dumaji imbin brabli nogudbinji. en imbin nildan langa graun en imbin weship langa god.
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

kriol: en wen yu dum, det neim blanga yu garra jidan brabli haibala, en ola pipul garra oldei tok lagijat. dei garra tok, 'yawei det boswan god en im na det god blanga ola isreil pipul.' lagijat na dei garra tok. en yu garra meigim det femili lain blanga main kipgon jidanbat king olagijawan.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, 'Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.'

kriol: king deibid bin tok langa god, "aibin dum brabli nogudbala ting weya aibin kaundimap ola pipul, en mi askimbat yu blanga larramgo mi fri brom dijan nogudbala ting weya aibin dumbat."
english: David said to God, "I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly."

kriol: yu si? insaid langa main hat en main, ai abum gudbala filing blanga det lowa blanga god.
english: For I delight in God's law after the inward person,

kriol: "detlot biginini hu nomo garram eni dedi, sambala nogudbala pipul oldei deigimwei olabat brom olabat mami, blanga peiyimbek det mani langa detlot nogudbala pipul weya dei owim.
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

kriol: wal wen det dubala witnis garra binij dalimbat det wed blanga god, wanbala najakain enimul garra kamat brom det dipwan hol blanga fait langa dubala, en im garra bidim dubala. im garra binijimap dubala,
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

kriol: detlot pipul hubin jidan bos langa melabat bifo, olabat bin dai na. olabat kaan kambek iya igin. yubin panishim olabat en yubin binijap olabat, en nobodi kaan jinggabat blanga olabat enimo.
english: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

kriol: yumob garra tenim miselp brom ijip. yumob garra pudumdan yumob hed en yumob garra jidan brabli sheimwan na, dumaji mi na, yawei bin nokambek detlot pipul yumob bin oldei trastimbat. yumob kaan gajim enijing brom olabat du."
english: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you won't prosper with them.

kriol: wal langa det namba 5 yiya wen joram hubin det san blanga eiheb bin jidan det king blanga isreil, jehoram det san blanga jehosafet bin jidan det nyuwan king blanga juda.
english: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

kriol: afta na det tjetj langa entiyak bin jandim pol en banabas en sambala najalot biliba langa jerusalem, en wen deibin go thru langa det dubala kantri gulum fanisha en sameriya, deibin dalimbat ola bilibamob deya blanga detlot jintail pipul hubin bulurrum det wei blanga god, en det nyus bin meigim olabat brabli gudbinji.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

kriol: "wal langa det sekan dei yumob garra gibit dijan ofring, 12 yangwan boiwan buligi, dubala dediwan ship en 14 boiwan ship wan yiya ol, holot nomo garram enijing rong langa olabat.
english: "'On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kriol: wal jisas bin askimbat olabat kwestjan na deya langa det serramoni pleis weya imbin titjimbat olabat. imbin tok, "wotfo detlot lowamen tok det speshalwan bos gulum masaiya im grensan blanga king deibid?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, "How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

kriol: "yawei garra meigim olabat brabli hatjamp en im garra binijimap ol detlot pipul hu ranawei en haidim miselp.
english: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

kriol: bat yu nomo lisin en teiknodis langa im. yu garra kilim im ded en yu nomo lisin langa im wen im jingat, 'nomo kilim mi.' yu nomo fil sori blanga det nogudbalawan en nomo stapam enibodi wen dei kilim im ded.
english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

kriol: imbin opinimap det nyubalawei thru langa det ketin. nomo rili det ketin. thru im ron bodi imbin opinimap det nyubalawei, en det wei na im jisas krais hu jidan laibala olagijawan,
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

kriol: dumaji deibin sabi im nomo bin det king brom isreil, en deibin stap det fait en deibin libum im na.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

kriol: nomeda aibin lukaftumbat olabat en meigim olabat strongbala, bat stil dei oldei jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbalawei langa mi,
english: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

kriol: wal det seim dei joshuwa bin meigim det pramis blanga ola isreil pipul deya gin langa det taun gulum shekam, en imbin dalim olabat ola lowa blanga bulurrum,
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

kriol: "wal im garra brabli nogud blanga yumob, dumaji yumob jis laiga greibyad weya nobodi sabi. nobodi kaan luk det greib, en wen dei wok ontop langa det greib, dei nomo sabi det greib im deya garram det nogudwan bodi insaid. "yumob sabi? atsaidwei yumob luk gudwan. bat insaidwei yumob nogudwan." lagijat na jisas bin tok langa det serramonimen.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don't know it."

kriol: wal wen jisas bin tok lagijat, ol detlot pipul deya bin tok, "nobodi wandi kilim yu! wotfo yu tok lagijat? maitbi yu garram nogudwan spirit insaid langa yu."
english: The multitude answered, "You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?"

kriol: en ai garra jandimwei yumob biginini olabat langa ola streinjawan kantri en larram olabat dai deya."
english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

kriol: nobodi kaan kaman garram yu, en nobodi kaan wokabat eniweya langa det hil, en nomo eni ship en buligi garra fidabat eniweya langa det hil du."
english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain."

kriol: en bambai sambala mesinja bin kaman blanga tok langa king jehosafet, "nomo jidanbat. bigismob ami kaminap brom najasaid brom idam en brom det dedsi blanga binijimap wi. deibin olredi teikoba engedi."
english: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, "A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar" (that is, En Gedi).

kriol: en streidawei det gel bin ran langa im hasbin, en imbin tok, "det men hubin kamat langa mi najadei, imbin kamat igin, en luk im deya!"
english: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, "Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me."

kriol: en ebdan bin abum 40 san en 30 grensan, en deibin oldei raidimbat 70 dongki ebriweya. wal ebdan bin jidan lida fo 8 yiya,
english: He had forty sons and thirty sons' sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.

kriol: yu garra jidan strongbala en nomo bradin, en yu garra meiksho yu oldei bulurrum ol detlot lowa weya main wekinmen mosis bin gibit langa yu. if yu nomo libum ol detlot lowa, en if yu duwit langa detlot lowa, wal yu garra win olawei nomeda weya yu go.
english: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don't turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

kriol: im garra lafta gibit im wanim det lowa tok det feswan san garra abum, nomeda im nomo det san blanga det waif weya im laigim brabliwei. wal det men garra lafta gibit det feswan san wanim det lowa tok im garra gibit."
english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

kriol: dena, kiriyasefa o debiya,
english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

kriol: en afta yu en det dubala san blanga yu garra go insaid langa yumob kemp en jadimap det dowa en yumob garra bilimap detlot jag garram det oliboil." lagijat na ilaisha bin tok.
english: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full."

kriol: en imbin pramis blanga gajim wi brom ola bedfren blanga wi wulijim wi garra wek blanga im en nomo bradin blanga enijing.
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

kriol: apekshed bin abum san neim shela, en shela bin abum san neim iba,
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

kriol: bat wen im stat ranranbat im gin laf langa det men hu raidimbat brabli faswan hos.
english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

kriol: wal filip bin go en imbin dalim endru det najawan wekinmen blanga jisas, en dubala mijamet bin go langa jisas, en dubala bin dalim im detlot grik pipul bin wandi luk langa im.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

kriol: wal det einjul bin tok, "yu nomo ardim det lilboi. yu nomo dum enijing langa im. ai sabi na trubala yu oldei lisin langa god, dumaji yu nomo bin holdimbek yu ronwan san brom im."
english: He said, "Don't lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me."

kriol: en yumob garra meigim ola sikbala pipul langa det taun gudbala, en yumob garra dalim ola pipul deya. yumob garra tok, 'god wandim yumob blanga bulurrum im brabliwei.' lagijat na yumob garra tok.
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, 'God's Kingdom has come near to you.'

kriol: en wen pida bin gobek langa jerusalem, detlot juwish bilibamob hubin bulurrum det lowa blanga sekamsais bin tok brabli adbalawei langa im.
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

kriol: en det king bin gibit oda langa ola solja blanga lukabat im. bat dei nomo bin faindim im, en afta det king bin kotim detlot solja hubin maindimbat im, en det king bin kilim detlot solja ded, dumaji deibin larram det prisana kamat. brom deya det king bin gowei brom det kantri judiya, en imbin go en jidan langa det taun gulum sesariya.
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn't find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

kriol: afta na wen semyul bin gro bigwan, yawei bin oldei jidan garram im, en imbin oldei dalim semyul wanim garra hepin, en imbin oldei meigim ebrijing hepin trubala jis laik weya imbin oldei tok,
english: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,
