english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

kriol: im meigim ola serramonimen en ola boswan jidan brabli lobala.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

kriol: god, yubin meigim mi abumbat det pein oldei, en ebri ailibala yubin oldei panishimbat mi.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

kriol: lagijat na imbin askimbat olabat, dumaji imbin sabi detlot haibala serramonimen bin jelas langa jisas, en blanga tharran na deibin hendimoba jisas langa im.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin dalim mosis blanga gibit ol dislot lowa langa detlot isreil pipul.
english: "Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

kriol: ai sabi yu testimbat ebribodi hat insaidwei, en yu brabli gudbinji langa pipul wen dei onap blanga olabat nogudbalawei en jidan trubalawei. wal trubalawei aibin gibit ol dislot ebrijing langa yu na, en aibin luk hau ol dislot pipul hubin majurrumap miselp iya, deibin oldei gudbinji blanga bringimap ola ofring blanga yu.
english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

kriol: god, yu na bin meigim yu pipul olabat strongbala. dumaji yu na oldei meigim olabat brabli gudbinji, en olabat oldei preisimbat langa yu na, jis laik wen detlot wekinmen weya wekwekbat langa olabat fam gajimbat detlot daga, o jis laik detlot soljamob wen olabat kadimatbat ola enijing wen olabat bin win langa fait.
english: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

kriol: en brom det baskit garram damba ofring yu garra gajim wanbala damba garram oliboil en wanbala damba nomo garram oliboil en wanbala lilwan damba,
english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.

kriol: yubin oldei jidan garram ola pipul bat olabat garra andimwei yu na en yu garra jidan garram ola wailwan enimul. blanga 7 yiya yu garra dagadagatbat gras jis laik ola buligi. afta na yu garra sabi mi det brabli haibala god. mi na det bos blanga ebribodi en ola boswan du. mi na gin gibit pawa langa enibodi blanga jidan bos weya mi pikimat."
english: You shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You shall be made to eat grass like oxen. Seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.'"

kriol: wal jeikob bin go gulijap na, en aisik bin tatjim im, en det olmen bin tok, "ai lisin yu tok jis laik jeikob. bat yu garram bingga jis laik isau."
english: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, "The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau."

kriol: wal det king bin tok, "wi kaan faindim eni gudwan men blanga dijan wek. oni josef na, dumaji det spirit blanga god im jidan garram im."
english: Pharaoh said to his servants, "Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?"

kriol: wal det yangmen bin tok, "aibin bulurrum detlot lowa. bat wanim mowa ai garra dum?"
english: The young man said to him, "All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?"

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat na. wen yu nomo garram lowa, god kaan bukumdan yu blanga nogudbala ting, dumaji yu nomo bin breigim eni lowa. wal bifo god bin gibit det lowa langa mosis, pipul bin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting,
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

kriol: bambai na kolwethataim deibin abum det serramoni deya langa jerusalem blanga meigim det serramoni pleis seikridwan,
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

kriol: wal det seikridwan boks bin jidan langa jerusalem insaid langa det tent weya king deibid bin pudumap. imbin bringimap det seikridwan boks brom det taun gulum kiriyajerim.
english: But David had brought God's ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

kriol: en deibin tok, "yuwai. melabat kaan kilim yu. melabat garra taiyimap yu en hendimoba yu langa detlot pipul." wal deibin taiyimap semsan garram dubala nyuwan roup, en deibin godan brom det hil,
english: They spoke to him, saying, "No, but we will bind you securely and deliver you into their hands; but surely we will not kill you." They bound him with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.

kriol: en deibin pudum lilwan sainbod ontop langa det kros. det sainbod bin tok, "dijan im jisas det king blanga ola juwish pipul."
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, "THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS."

kriol: beibai bin det san blanga henaded, en bos blanga det naja haf kantri raidaran langa det taun gulum keila, en imbin bildimbek najawan pat.
english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

kriol: wen detlot gudbala pipul abumbat loda trabul olataim olabat nomo gibap, bat wen detlot wikitwan pipul abum bigiswan trabul olabat garra binijap.
english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

kriol: "'yumob na main biginini, bat yumob bin gibit mi bekboun. yumob kaman en jidan langa mi, dumaji yumob blanga main. ai garra deigim wanbala brom ebri taun, en dubala brom ebri klen, en ai garra bringimbek olabat langa det bigwan hil gulum saiyan.
english: "Return, backsliding children," says Yahweh, "for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

kriol: wal det wuman bin werrimon pepulwan en redwan klos, en imbin werrimon olkain purdibala ston du. langa im bingga imbin holdim goldinwan kap bulap garram ola brabli nogudbala ting weya imbin dumbat garram men.
english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

kriol: afta ola pipul bin abum det serramoni gulum damba nomo garram raising fo 7 dei.
english: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

kriol: wal najawan nambawan solja bin neim benaiya. imbin det san blanga jehoiyada brom det taun gulum kebsil, en imbin dum olkain breibwan ting. wantaim imbin kilim ded dubala brabli strongwan solja brom det kantri gulum moweb. en wantaim wen deibin abum sno ebriweya langa det kantri, imbin godan insaid langa wan hol weya laiyan bin jidan, en imbin kilim det laiyan ded.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

kriol: en wanbala speshalwan mesinja bin deya neim sedakaiya det san blanga kenana. imbin meigim dubala brabli strongwan hon laiga buligi hon. en imbin tok langa king eiheb, "dijan na wanim yawei tok, 'yu garra fait langa ol detlot siriya mob, jis laiga buligi garram brabli strongbala hon, en yu garra binijimap olabat.'"
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, "Yahweh says, 'With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.'"

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin kipgon dalimbat mosis blanga gibit ol dislot wed langa detlot isreil pipul. imbin tok, "yumob garra bringimap brabli gudwan en klinwan oliboil, blanga det lemp insaid langa det seikridwan tent wulijim det lait gin kipgon barnbarnbat.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kriol: nomo enibodi garra titjimbat im ronwan kantrimen hau blanga sabi yawei, dumaji ebribodi garra sabi mi, nomeda olabat lobala o powan o boswan. ai garra larramgo olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei, en ai kaan jinggabat ol detlot nogudwan ting weya olabat bin oldei dumbat. mi na yawei bin tok dijan."
english: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, 'Know Yahweh;' for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest," says Yahweh, "for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more."

kriol: sambala pipul oldei reken dei jidan brabli gudbala, bat dei oldei jidan brabli praudbalawei.
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

kriol: det bigwan san bin neim jowal, en det lilwan san bin neim abaija, en dubala bin jidan langa det taun gulum biyashiba.
english: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

kriol: mi tok langa yawei, "yu main god." yawei, irrim mi jingat langa yu blanga album mi.
english: I said to Yahweh, "You are my God." Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

kriol: detlot wol langa det serramoni pleis bin abum loda windo. detlot windo bin mowa lilwan atsaidwei langa det insaidpat.
english: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

kriol: wal blanga tharran na ai garra preisimbat yu neim en dalimbat ola pipul langa ebri kantri blanga yu, en ai garra singim song blanga preisimbat yu ebridei.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

english: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won't turn away until they are consumed.

kriol: tenim miselp en kambek langa yawei ol yumob lobala pipul langa dijan kantri, ol yumob pipul hu teiknodis langa im. yumob garra trai en dum ola gudbala ting, en yumob garra kipgon en jidan lobala pipul en maitbi yawei garra blandim yumob langa seifwan pleis langa det dei bambai wen im garra panishim ola najalot pipul."
english: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of Yahweh's anger.

kriol: wal im anggul bin askim im, "wanim imbin dalim yu?"
english: Saul's uncle said, "Please tell me what Samuel said to you."

english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight. He didn't depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh's house.

kriol: en sambodi bin deigimwei det pawa brom detlot najalot enimul, bat imbin larram olabat jidan laibala blanga lilwail.
english: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

kriol: wal detlot wekinmen bin bradin brabliwei, en deibin tok miselp, "wotkain men dijan? im tok langa win en langa weib, en dubala duwit langa im!"
english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, "Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"

kriol: bambai na detlot isreil pipul bin jingat langa yawei, "melabat bin dumbat nogudbala ting langa yu, dumaji melabat bin gibit yu bekboun. yu na melabat god. bat melabat bin go en weship det drimin gulum beil."
english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, saying, "We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals."

english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

english: He said to the near kinsman, "Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's.

kriol: wal beilam bin ensim im, "aibin dalim yu, ai garra dum ebrijing wanim yawei bin dalim mi." lagijat na beilam bin tok.
english: But Balaam answered Balak, "Didn't I tell you, saying, 'All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do'?"

kriol: if ai nomo bin dum tharran, wal wanim ai garra dalim god wen im garra jadjim mi?
english: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

kriol: "wal yawei, mi askim yu blanga dum wanim yubin pramis blanga dum blanga mi en main femili olabat.
english: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

kriol: ol detlot pipul hu wandim yumob blanga reken olabat haibala, olabat oldei trai en fosim yumob blanga bulurrum det lowa blanga sekamsais, dumaji dei nomo wandim enibodi blanga gibit olabat trabul. yumob sabi? if dei dalimbat det trubala gudnyus blanga jisas krais weya imbin dai langa det kros, wal loda pipul garra gibit olabat adtaim, dumaji det gudnyus oldei meigim loda pipul nogudbinji weya im dalim olabat blanga libum olabat olbalawei.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

kriol: wal detlot nogudbala pipul weya detlot mishanri bin tokabat, olabat na meigimbat ola agamin weya kadimatbat yumob kristjan pipul, en olabat na meigimbat ola trabul weya yumob nomo jidan wanmob. detlot nogudbala pipul oldei bulurrum olabat ronwei, dumaji dei nomo garram det holi spirit blanga god.
english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

kriol: aibin pikimat wanbala gudbala einjul blanga lukaftumbat yu haus langa main seikridwan hil, weya yubin oldei wokwokbat langa detlot purdiwan ston weya bin oldei laitlaitbat wulijim faiya.
english: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.

kriol: yawei, yu album mi blanga sabi ol yu lowa, en ai garra teiknodis en bulurrum olabat brabliwei garram main laif holbit.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

kriol: "wal main god yu luk langa melabat en irrim melabat preya langa dijan pleis.
english: "Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

kriol: god, meigim melabat strongbala igin! yu luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis en seibum melabat.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kriol: wal mosis bin gajim det speshalwan oliboil en imbin pudum langa det seikridwan tent blanga yawei, en langa ebrijing insaid langa det tent, en lagijat na imbin meigim ebrijing seikridwan blanga yawei.
english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "ai garra askim yumob kwestjan du, en if yumob ensim mi, wal ai garra ensim yumob du.
english: Jesus answered them, "I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kriol: en imbin tok, "yumob shoum mi wotkain det mani." en wen deibin shoum im det mani, imbin tok, "wal blanga hu pitja en neim langa dijan mani?" en deibin tok, "blanga det haibala gabman bos neim sisa."
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?" They answered, "Caesar's."

kriol: afta na wen det sebathdei bin binij, detlot thribala gel neim meri megdalin en meri det mami blanga jeims en det najawan gel neim salomi, deibin baiyim det gudsmelwan medisin blanga rabum det bodi blanga jisas,
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

kriol: wal ai garra jandimwei yumob brom dijan kantri weya aibin gibit langa yu, en ai garra libum dijan serramoni pleis, dijan pleis weya aibin meigim seikridwan blanga weshipbat mi. en pipul ebriweya garra meigimbat fan en rabishim dijan pleis.
english: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

kriol: det wei blanga god im mobedawan langa ol detlot purdiwan ston gulum koral, jespa en rubi.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

kriol: en nobodi bin geim blanga askimbat im enimo kwestjan.
english: They didn't dare to ask him any more questions.

kriol: en aibin dalim olabat dijan na weya yawei bin tok, "ai garra gibit dijan taun langa detlot bebalon ami, en olabat garra deigimoba dijan taun."
english: Yahweh says, 'This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.'"

kriol: wal maitbi sambodi deya kaan teiknodis langa dijan woning weya melabat gibit yumob langa dijan leda. en if yumob luk sambodi lagijat, wal yumob kaan larram im joinin langa yumob. en im garra sheim miselp.
english: If any man doesn't obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

kriol: brom deya jisas bin go wokabat wansaid langa leik gelali, en deya na imbin luk dubala braja gija neim saiman pida en endru. dubala bin gajimbat fish garram fishnet, dumaji dubala bin fishamen.
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "wal yumob jinggabat. maitbi wanbala men bin merrit langa wanbala gel, en afta imbin jinggabat im nomo wandim det gel na,
english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin dalim mi blanga go en baiyim sambala shot trasis blanga werrimon, en imbin dalim mi nomo blanga washim langa woda.
english: Yahweh said to me, "Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don't put it in water."

kriol: wal im mobeda blanga irrim kwaitbala wed brom det klebabala men, den blanga irrim det boswan men jingat adbalawei langa detlot granggibala men.
english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

kriol: en wen deibin kamat langa det kemp, ola pipul deya bin meigim speshalwan sapa blanga jisas. matha bin albumbat olabat bringimap ola daga, en lesaras bin deya langa det teibul garram jisas.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

kriol: larram olabat binijap wulijim det wem weya im draiyap. larram olabat jidan wulijim beibi wen im bon dedwan.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

kriol: wal rabeka bin irrim aisik weya imbin tok langa isau,
english: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

kriol: yumob stap kraikraibat na. ol detlot ting weya yumob bin dum blanga yumob bigininimob ai garra jinggabat en dum gudbala ting blanga yumob. olabat garra kambek langa olabat ronwan kantri.
english: Yahweh says: "Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded," says Yahweh. "They will come again from the land of the enemy.

kriol: wal najalot libaimen bin lukaftumbat ola ebrijing deibin yusum blanga weshipbat. ebritaim wen enibodi bin yusumbat detlot enijing olabat bin kaundimap ebrijing wen deibin deigimat en wen deibin bringimbek.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

kriol: en yu kaan go langa det kantri miselp, dumaji ai garra go garram yu, en bambai ai garra bringimbek ola biginini blanga yu raitbek iya langa dijan kantri weya yu jidan na. en bambai wen yu garra dai, yu san josef garra deya garram yu." lagijat na god bin tok.
english: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph's hand will close your eyes."

kriol: det wed blanga det gudbala men im jis laik det woda weya yu dringgim weya meigim yu jidan laibala, bat det wed blanga det nogudbala men im rabishwan en jigibala.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kriol: en blanga tharran na ai garra binijimap yumob, jis laik det wegan weya im garrimap detlot sid daga en im galimap ontop langa yumob en kilim yumob ded.
english: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.

kriol: en det namba 7 dei im brabli seikridwan dei blanga yawei, en nobodi kaan dum eni wek langa det dei, en if enibodi dum wek langa det dei, im garra dai.
english: 'Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

kriol: wal sambala serramonimen gulum ferasi en sambala lowamen bin deya du en deibin askimbat detlot wekinmen blanga jisas, "wotfo yumob dagadagat daga en dringgimbat garram detlot pipul hu oldei gajimbat mani en garram detlot najalot nogudbala pipul?"
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, "Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?"

kriol: brom longtaim, bifo aibin bon, yawei bin pikimat mi blanga wek blanga im blanga bringimbek ol detlot isreil pipul langa im. en yawei na bin meigim mi strongbala en haibala.
english: Now Yahweh, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in Yahweh's eyes, and my God has become my strength.

kriol: en ola najalot traib garra wek blanga yu, en olabat garra lukbek langa yu. en yu garra jidan bos blanga ola najalot braja blanga yu, dumaji ola biginini blanga yu mami garra lukbek langa yu. en if enibodi ardim yu, wal god garra ardim olabat du. en detlot pipul weya olabat gud langa yu, wal god garra gud langa olabat du." lagijat na det olmen bin gibit im laswan wed langa jeikob.
english: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother's sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you."

kriol: lagijat na mosis bin dum.
english: Moses counted them according to Yahweh's word, as he was commanded.

kriol: en god bin pudum mi langa det pleis weya im spiya gin kilim mi rait langa main binji en meigim main binji kamat, en im nomo fil sori blanga mi, najing.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

kriol: imbin kadimat brom detlot 70,000 pipul blanga garrimap ola ebrijing, en 80,000 pipul blanga kadimap ola ston langa detlot bigwan hil en 3,600 boswan lida blanga det wek.
english: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.

kriol: dumaji mi jinginatbat langa ola pipul langa detlot nowathsaid kantri blanga kaman. en olabat king garra pudumap olabat speshalwan tjeya deya langa detlot geit deya langa jerusalem en raidaran langa det wol, en raidaran najalot taun langa juda.
english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north," says Yahweh. "They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

kriol: olabat oldei wandim dumbat nogudbala ting en dei oldei jidan redi blanga kilim enibodi.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

kriol: wal aibin baiyim det trasis en aibin werrimon na.
english: So I bought a belt according to Yahweh's word, and put it on my waist.

kriol: wen ai blowim main hon, yumob holot garra blowim yumob hon du, en yumob garra jingat adbala, 'dijan na det longwan naif blanga yawei det trubala god en blanga gidiyan!'" lagijat na gidiyan bin dalim detlot 300 isreil solja.
english: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, 'For Yahweh and for Gideon!'"

kriol: "wal det wei blanga ola gudbala pipul im jis laik det san wen im gidap ailibala en im kipgon meigim ebrijing mowa braitwan.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

kriol: en wen imbin gulijap deilait, yawei bin luk detlot ami brom det faiya en klaud, en imbin meigim olabat brabli bradin,
english: In the morning watch, Yahweh looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.

kriol: wal eibram bin jidanbat langa det kantri gulum keinan langa 10 yiya, en im waif serai nomo bin abum eni biginini blanga im. wal serai bin abum wan wekingel hubin jidan jis laiga prisana neim heiga brom det kantri gulum ijip,
english: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

kriol: "yumob sabi? nobodi kaan jidan wekinmen blanga dubala bos, dumaji im garra laigim det wanbala en im garra heidim det najawan. en if yumob garram dubala bos, yumob garra lisin langa wanbala en nomo teiknodis langa det najawan bos. en if yumob wandi jidan wekinmen blanga god, wal yumob kaan meigim mani jidan bos blanga yumob." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren't able to serve God and Mammon."

kriol: wal langa det taim na wen sol bin jidan king, det klen blanga rubin bin fait langa detlot heigrait pipul, en deibin kilim olabat langa wo, en deibin teikoba olabat kantri, en deibin jidan deya sanraiswei langa giliyad.
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

kriol: wal det gel neim meri megdalin en det najawan meri bin jidanbat deya lukinatbat det keib weya josef bin pudum det bodi blanga jisas.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

kriol: yu si? detlot pipul hu garram det pawa blanga dalimbat wed brom god garra hendulum det pawa brabliwei.
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

kriol: wal esra bin tok, "preisim yawei det trubala god blanga wi grengrenfatha olabat! imbin meigim det king abum rispek lagijat blanga det serramoni pleis blanga yawei det trubala god deya langa jerusalem.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify Yahweh's house which is in Jerusalem;

kriol: langa det wo wanbala isreil solja neim sikri bin kilim thribala men, det san blanga king eihes neim meiseiya, en esrikam det boswan blanga det haus blanga det king, en elkana hubin sekan bos blanga det king.
english: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king's son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

kriol: bat dei gudbinji garram wanim yawei titjimbat olabat. dei jinggabat det wed deitaim en naitaim. dei teiknodis langa im wed.
english: but his delight is in Yahweh's law. On his law he meditates day and night.

kriol: jisas bin dalim olabat najawan pitja stori na. imbin tok, "ai garra dalim yumob hau god im garra jidan brabli haibalawan bos. im jis laik wen det gel gajim raising, en im miksimap det raising garram blendibala flauwa raidap im raisap holbit. wal lagijat na det wed blanga god garra tjeinjim yumob laif."
english: He spoke another parable to them. "The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened."

kriol: "wal yu dalim melabat na. wen det taim garra kaman blanga ola dedbala pipul garra gidap laibala, blanga hu waif det gel garra jidan, dumaji imbin merrit langa ol detlot sebenbala braja gija?" lagijat na detlot serramonimen bin askim jisas.
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife."

kriol: en nomeda if detlot pipul nomo lisin langa yu, olabat garra sabi yu na det speshalwan mesinja bin deya garram olabat.
english: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

kriol: en tjeinjim im klos. im garra jidan insaid langa det men kemp en kraikrai oldei blanga im mami en dedi blanga 1 manth en afta 1 manth det men gin merrit det gel.
english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

kriol: wal aibin reken yubin andimwei mi olagija, en aibin reken ai kaan luk det seikridwan serramoni pleis blanga yu deya langa main kantri enimo.
english: I said, 'I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.'

kriol: ai garra sterrap sambala strongbala pipul brom nowathsaid en meigim olabat go en fait langa bebalon. olabat garra ol majurrumap miselp blanga fait langa detlot pipul langa bebalon en olabat garra bidim detlot pipul. olabat brabli gudwan hanta. olabat gin shudum garram olabat bo en erro en nomo misdim.
english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.

kriol: "wal yumob jinggabat na. yu kaan mindimap olwan klos garram nyuwan reig, dumaji wen yu washim det nyuwan reig, im garra godan lilwan, en im garra breigim det olwan klos mowa.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

kriol: "yumob sabi? ola gudbala pipul dumbat gudbala ting, dumaji olabat gudbala insaid langa olabat hat. en ola nogudbala pipul dumbat nogudbala ting, dumaji olabat nogudbala insaid langa olabat hat. en im lagijat du wen yu tok. ol detlot ting yu jinggabat langa yu hat, wal yu meigim detlot ting na kamat brom yu mawus.
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

kriol: bat king jehowesh bin jandimbek dijan mesij langa im, "wal wantaim wanbala bindiyai gras langa det hil kantri gulum lebanon bin jandim mesij langa det bigwan sidatri. 'yu gibit yu doda blanga merrit langa main san.' brom deya wanbala wailwan enimul bin pudumbut langa det bindiyai gras en imbin dai.
english: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, 'Give your daughter to my son as wife.' Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.

kriol: bat jisas bin jis wokawei brom olabat, en imbin go langa najawan pleis.
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

kriol: bat if det sambodi bin dai en im nomo garram eni rileishan, wal det sambodi hubin dum det nogudbala ting garra gibit det mani langa yawei blanga det serramonimen. im garra gibit det mani seimtaim garram det dediwan ship ofring blanga meigim im fri brom det nogudbalawei.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest's, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

kriol: "en brom det feswan yiya wen daraiyas brom det kantri gulum midiya, bin jidan bos, wal mi na bin oldei albumbat maikul.
english: "As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.

kriol: wal ai garram bigmob wed blanga dalim yu. bat ai kaan raidimdan langa peipa, dumaji ai wandi kaman dregli en dalim yu miselp.
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

kriol: wal wan nogudbala men brom det benjamin klen bin deya langa det taun gulum gilgel. imbin neim shiba, en im dedi bin neim bikri. wal wen detlot juda pipul en detlot isreil pipul bin kipgon agamin gija blanga king deibid, shiba bin blowim det wisul, en imbin jingat langa ola isreil pipul, "tjakidawei king deibid! melabat kaan bulurrum im enimo! ol yumob isreil pipul, yumob kaman na, dumaji wi garra gobek langa wi ron kantri en libum detlot juda pipul!"
english: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, "We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!"

kriol: en im lagijat gin garram jisas krais. im nomo bin meigim miselp haibala, en im nomo bin meigim miselp jidan boswan serramonimen. god bin pikimat im en meigim im jidan haibala serramonimen. wi sabi tharran, dumaji god bin dalim jisas, "yu na main san, en tudei na ai garra jidan dedi blanga yu."
english: So also Christ didn't glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, "You are my Son. Today I have become your father."

kriol: bat ebritaim detlot najalot juwish pipul hubin oldei jidan gulijap langa detlot enami bin oldei kaman en wonimbat melabat wen ola enami bin oldei meigim plen.
english: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, "Wherever you turn, they will attack us."

kriol: sambala pipul dei jis laik detlot sid weya bin buldan langa det gudwan graun. dei irrim det wed, en dei bilib langa det wed, en det wed im wek langa olabat laif na. blendibala daga bin kamat brom detlot sid weya bin buldan langa det gudwan graun. det wed meigim olabat jidan strongbala mowa en mowa ebridei."
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty."

kriol: "wal wi garra pikimat sambodi brom melabat iya blanga deigim pleis blanga judas. wi garra pikimat sambodi hubin oldei bulurrum jisas wen imbin wokabat garram melabat olawei brom det taim wen jon beptis bin beptaisim im raidap det taim wen imbin gowap langa hebin.
english: "Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

kriol: "bat maitbi dijan men garram san hu oldei stilimbat en kilimbat,
english: "If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

kriol: god bin tok, 'mi na det god blanga eibrahem en blanga aisik en blanga jeikob.' wal yumob jinggabat na. god im god blanga laibala pipul. im nomo god blanga dedbala pipul. yu si? yumob rong wen yumob tok dedbala pipul kaan gidap en jidan laibala."
english: 'I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living."

kriol: nomeda dijan wel en ebrijing weya jidan laibala langa dijan wel sheiksheik nomo lilbit, ai garra meigim im meinwan pat jidan strongwan.
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

kriol: "wal bambai wen ai garra meigim det nyubalawei garram olabat, ai garra raidimdan det wed insaid langa olabat hat en main brabliwei, en ai garra jidan god blanga olabat, en dei garra jidan main ronwan pipul,
english: "For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days," says the Lord: "I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

kriol: bat yumob kaan bradin dumaji aibin meigim plen blanga dum ola gudbala ting blanga main pipul olabat langa jerusalem en juda.
english: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don't be afraid.

kriol: afta na aisaiya bin dalim ola wekinmen blanga det king blanga smeshimap det frut daga gulum fig en pudum ontop langa det boil, blanga meigim im gudbala igin.
english: Isaiah said, "Take a cake of figs." They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

kriol: ol detlot 16 biginini en grenkid blanga silpa bin go langa ijip garram jeikob.
english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

kriol: wal king hesakaiya en im boswan wekinmen olabat bin jandim detlot mesinja oloba langa juda en oloba langa isreil garram dijan mesij na. deibin tok, "yumob isreil pipul hu stil jidan laibala afta detlot asiriya pipul bin teikoba dijan kantri. yumob garra kambek langa yawei det trubala god, det god blanga eibrahem, aisik en jeikob, en im garra album yumob.
english: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, "You children of Israel, turn again to Yahweh, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

kriol: wal yumob irrim mi na. if ola nogudbala ting langa dijan wel jidan bos blanga enibodi, wal im nogud blanga im. bat if imbin gidawei brom ol detlot nogudbala ting dumaji im sabi jisas krais det bos blanga wi hubin seibum wi, wal im brabli gudbala ting blanga im. bat if imbin gidawei brom ol detlot nogudbala ting, en afta im gobek en larram detlot nogudbala ting jidan bos blanga im igin, wal im brabli nogud blanga im.
english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

kriol: mi oldei album ola king en ola lida olabat blanga jidan bos, en meigim ola gudwan lowa.
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

kriol: if yu nomo go en tok langa det king wal sambodi garra kaman en album ola juwish pipul en seibum olabat, bat yu en ol melabat femili garra binij. maitbi yu jidan det nambawan waif blanga det king blanga dijan taim na wulijim yu gin album yu pipul olabat." modakai bin jandim wed lagijat.
english: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father's house will perish. Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this?"

kriol: wal deibin wandi bradinim melabat. deibin wandi melabat blanga stap wek. aibin prei, "god, yu meigim mi strongbala en nomo bradin."
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, "Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done." But now, strengthen my hands.

kriol: "maitbi ai garra jandim solja blanga go en fait en binijimap detlot pipul langa det kantri weya olabat dumbat nogudbala ting, en ai garra binijimap ola enimul du. en nomeda if detlot thribala men bina jidan deya langa det kantri, mi na yawei det boswan god, trubala ai dalim yu, dei kaan seibum olabat bigininimob. dei garra oni seibum olabat ronselp.
english: "Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, 'Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal'—

kriol: wal leiban bin kipgon tok igin, "if yu hendulum det dubala doda main rafwei o maitbi yu merrit langa najalot gel, wal maitbi ai nomo faindat. bat yu garra jinggabat god, dumaji im na oldei lukinatbat yu.
english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you."

kriol: if yu gibit enijing langa najalot pipul wal yu garra jidan brabli ritjwan en if enibodi albumbat najalot pipul wal sambodi garra album im du.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok na, "jeramaiya, if yu brabli nokap brom ranimap detlot men, hau yu garra reis garram detlot hosis? if yu buldan deya langa det opin bush kantri, hau yu garra jandap langa det bigwan bush kantri deya langa det jodan riba?
english: "If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

kriol: wal langa ola dislot libai femili grup na deibin kaundimap ola boiwan hubin wan manth ol en oba, en olabat namba bin 23,000. dei nomo bin raidimdan olabat neim en edimap det namba garram ola najalot klen blanga isreil, dumaji olabat kaan abum eni kantri langa isreil.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

kriol: yumob sabi na? yumob garra oldei jinggabat yumob wikwan braja en sista olabat, dumaji jisas krais bin dai blanga olabat du. en if yumob dagat det daga, dumaji yumob sabi yumob fri blanga dagat, wal yumob garra meigim detlot wikwan braja o sista blanga yumob kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting,
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

kriol: en imbin dalim olabat, "wen wi kamat deya gulijap langa det kemp, yumob garra blandim miselp raidaran langa det kemp, en yumob garra wotjim mi, en wen yumob luk wanim ai garra dum, yumob garra dum du.
english: He said to them, "Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.

kriol: "bat yumob toktok, 'wanim yawei oldei dumbat im nomo rait.' wal yumob isreil pipul, yumob irrim mi na. yumob reken blanga main wei im nomo rait? bat blanga yumob wei im nomo rait.
english: "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not equal.' Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren't your ways unequal?

english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

english: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, "I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

kriol: wal im garra deigim dubala bard, en sambala wud brom det sidatri, en redwan roup, en sambala bushis gulum hisap.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

kriol: en deya na imbin luk det nyuwan king langa det serramoni pleis, jandapbat wansaid langa det longwan stonwan pol, deya na langa det pleis weya ola nyuwan king garra jandap. ola boswan solja en ola pipul hubin blowimbat ola longwan wisul bin jandap olaran langa im. ola pipul deya bin singsing gudbinjiwei en blowimbat ola longwan wisul. ol detlot hubin plei det myusik langa det serramoni pleis bin lidimbat olabat langa det hepi taim. kwin ethalaiya bin brabli nogudbinji. imbin breigimap im klos en imbin jingat, "yumob bin trikimbat mi brabliwei. yumob bin trikimbat mi brabliwei."
english: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, "Treason! treason!"

kriol: ola pipul brom det dubala filastain taun gulum gasa en eshkalan garra jidan brabli soribalawei. olabat garra sheibum olabat hed, en jidan kwaitbala, nomo tok, en kadim miselp soribalawei.
english: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?

kriol: en wen imbin kamat langa det taun gulum sesariya, imbin godan brom det bout, en imbin go langa jerusalem, en imbin tok langa ola bilibamob deya langa det tjetj, en afta imbin go langa det taun gulum entiyak.
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

kriol: afta na sambala pipul deya bin dalim jisas blanga sambala kantrimen blanga im brom gelali. wen detlot kantrimen blanga im bin abum sekrifais serramoni blanga god, det gabman bos neim pailat bin kilim olabat ded.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

kriol: wal det men bin deigimbek mi na langa det atsaidwan kotyad gulijap langa det sanrais geit langa det serramoni pleis. aibin luk detlot dowa blanga det geit bin jadap.
english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

kriol: "wal yumob garra prei langa god en askim im nomo blanga larram dijan trabul hepin kolwethataim o langa sebathdei, dumaji dijan trabul na garra jidan brabli weswan.
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, "This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner."

kriol: en wanim yumob reken det stakmen hu garram 100 ship garra dum wen wanbala ship gowei? im garra libum detlot 99 ship fidabat langa pedik, en im garra go en lukabat det wanbala hubin los raidap im faindim im.
english: "What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn't he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

kriol: bambai na wandei loda stilinbala en nogudbala pipul bin kaman langa jisas blanga lisin langa im.
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

kriol: ol main enami olabat toktok blanga kilim mi, en mi bradin brabliwei na. mi jidan brabli nogudbinji brom ol detlot enami hu oldei gibit mi adtaim. olabat oldei meigim trabul kaman langa mi, en olabat oldei wail en heidim mi.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

kriol: wal det taim garra kaman na wen yumob kaan gulum det pleis tofeth o hinam beli, bat im garra abum det neim kila beli, dumaji yumob garra berrimbat pipul deya na, dumaji nomo eni pleis iya blanga berrimbat yumob na, najing.
english: Therefore behold, the days come", says Yahweh, "that it will no more be called 'Topheth' or 'The valley of the son of Hinnom', but 'The valley of Slaughter'; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

kriol: en blanga tharran na ai garra jandim faiya langa olabat kantri blanga barnimap ola strongbala haus deya langa det taun gulum keriyoth. en olabat garra dai langa det bigwan fait weya ola solja garra jinginatbat nomo lilbit en dei garra blowimbat olabat wisul brabli adbalawei.
english: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;

kriol: if enibodi hitim eni men, en im kilim im ded, wal im garra dai du.
english: "One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

kriol: "ola pipul langa ol detlot kantri garra meigim miselp redi, en dei garra majurrumap miselp deya langa jadjim beli,
english: "Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

kriol: en afta wen imbin gidap laibala, imbin shoum miselp langa pida, en afta imbin shoum miselp langa detlot twelbala mishanri blanga im mijamet.
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

kriol: wal jeikob bin kaminap brom det pleis gulum biyashiba, en imbin wandi go langa det pleis gulum heran,
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

kriol: en god garra ensim yu preya, en yu garra kipum det pramis weya yubin meigim garram im.
english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

kriol: wal king hesakaiya bin tok, "det mesij yubin bringimap brom yawei im brabli gudwan." dumaji imbin reken blanga im kantri garra jidan gudbalawei raidap langa det taim im garra dai.
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "Yahweh's word which you have spoken is good." He said moreover, "For there will be peace and truth in my days."

kriol: afta na deibin jingat langa jonathan dubala, "yumob kaman iya ontop. melabat shoum yumob hau blanga fait." wal jonathan bin dalim det wekinmen blanga im, "yu bulurrum mi na, dumaji yawei garra meigim yunmi bidim olabat, en yunmi pipul garra win."
english: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, "Come up to us, and we will show you something!" Jonathan said to his armor bearer, "Come up after me, for Yahweh has delivered them into the hand of Israel."

kriol: samtaim wen wi abum samting weya meigim wi brabli nogudbinji im album wi blanga tjeinjim wi laif en jidan gudwei.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

kriol: wen heiman bin kaman, det king bin askim im, "ai wandim shoum rispek brabliwei langa wan men. wanim ai garra du blanga im?" wal heiman bin tok miselp, "blanga hu im jinggabat? ai reken mi na det men weya det king wandim dum gudbala ting."
english: So Haman came in. The king said to him, "What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?" Now Haman said in his heart, "Who would the king delight to honor more than myself?"

kriol: yumob grengrenfatha olabat bin jis laik ola jigiwan sneik, en yumob jis laik ola jigiwan sneik du! yumob kaan faindim eniwei blanga gidawei brom det helfaiya.
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

kriol: wal jisas bin luk langa olabat, en imbin tok streidat langa olabat, "men kaan dum miselp. bat god gin dum, dumaji god gin dum enijing."
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, "With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."

kriol: ol detlot juwish pipul bin abum lowa blanga washimbat olabat bingga bifo dei dagat daga, dumaji longtaim detlot serramonimen bin meigimbat olkain lowa blanga washimbat enijing. wen dei baiyim eni daga brom shop, dei garra washim det daga bifo olabat dagat, en dei garra washimbat olabat kap en jag en sospen en olabat sweig du. deibin meigimbat ol detlot lowa, dumaji deibin reken detkain ting garra meigim god gudbinji langa olabat. wal sambala serramonimen gulum ferasi en sambala lowamen bin kaman brom jerusalem, en deibin midap garram jisas, en deibin luk sambala wekinmen blanga im bin dagadagat daga garram dardiwan bingga. dei bina washim olabat bingga basdam. bat najing.
english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

kriol: langa det serramoni pleis na. wal aibin deigim olabat insaid langa det rum blanga detlot wekinmen blanga det speshalwan mesinja neim henan, det san blanga aigdaliya. det rum bin jidan ontopwei langa det najawan rum blanga meiseiya det san blanga shalum, hubin det boswan wekinmen blanga det serramoni pleis. tharran rum bin jidan gulijap langa detlot najalot rum blanga det najalot boswan wekinmen.
english: and I brought them into Yahweh's house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

kriol: en enibodi langa yu femilimob hu dai deya langa det taun, wal ola dog garra dagat olabat, en enibodi hu dai deya langa det opin kantri, wal ola bard gulum boltja garra dagat olabat.'" lagijat na ilaija bin tok det wed brom yawei.
english: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field."

kriol: afta tharran, king senakerib bin gobek langa asiriya, en imbin jidan langa det taun gulum ninaba.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat na wanim sambodi bin tok langa oltestaman, 'sambala kapinta bin bildimap stonwan haus, en deibin tjakidawei det wan ston, dumaji deibin reken imbin nogudwan. bat det ston bin det meinwan, en dei nomo bin sabi.
english: Haven't you even read this Scripture: 'The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

kriol: wal yumob garra sheikhen gija du. wal mi askim god blanga meigim ol yumob pipul hu bulurrum jisas krais blanga jidan brabli gudbalawei. binij na.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kriol: main olgamen, yu jis laik det speshalwan gadin. det gadin garram wol raidaran, en im garram im ronwan springwoda.
english: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.

kriol: wal langa det yiya wen ibalmeradak bin jidan det nyuwan king blanga bebalon, imbin kain langa king jehoiyakin blanga juda en imbin larramgo im brom det jeil. dijan na bin langa det namba 27 dei blanga det namba 12 manth langa det namba 37 yiya brom det taim wen king nebakanesa bin pudum im langa det jeil.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

kriol: en im garra pulumat yumob haf ola sid daga en ola greip daga, en im garra gibit ol detlot daga langa ola boswan wekinmen deya langa im ronwan haus en langa ola najalot boswan wekinmen blanga im.
english: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

kriol: god na im bos blanga ol dislot kantri langa dijan wel, en ebribodi hu jidan langa dislot kantri olabat jis laik detlot lilwan insek. im na bin spredimat det skai wulijim kaliko.
english: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,

english: She said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife."

kriol: wal hairam bin gibit salaman ola sidatri en paintri weya imbin wandim.
english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

english: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.

english: Paul said, "I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds."

english: He said, "Take it." So he put out his hand and took it.

english: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, "If he is alone, there is news in his mouth." He came closer and closer.

english: For the kingdom is Yahweh's. He is the ruler over the nations.

english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

english: But they forgot Yahweh their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.

kriol: en yumob garra dalimbat olabat det gudnyus.

english: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before Yahweh's house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, "Peace! Be still!" The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kriol: en blanga tharran na ai wandi dalim det gudnyus langa ol yumob pipul deya langa rom du.
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

kriol: en imbin go insaid langa det bigwan haus en imbin dagat daga. brom deya imbin tok, "nomeda im brabli nogudwan, bat imbin blanga det king doda. wal yumob go en berrim im bodi."
english: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, "See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king's daughter."

kriol: "if detlot men blanga ged en rubin krosim det jodan riba redi blanga go en fait wen yawei dalim olabat, en if olabat album yumob en yumob gajim ol det kantri, wal yumob garra gibit det kantri gulum giliyad blanga olabat ronwan kantri.
english: Moses said to them, "If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

kriol: imbin gudbala men, en im en im femili olabat bin bilib langa god, en imbin oldei album ola powan juwish pipul, en imbin oldei prei langa god du.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
