english: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

kriol: wal maitbi yumob nomo agri blanga tharran deya weya aibin tok. maitbi yumob tok, "sambala pipul reken dei garra jis bilib, en dei reken tharran im naf. en najalot pipul reken dei garra jis dum det ekshan, en dei reken tharran im olrait. en ai reken dubala gija rait." maitbi yumob tok lagijat langa mi. bat ai dalim yumob. nobodi kaan bilib brabli if im nomo dum det ekshan. yu si? yumob sabi ai bilib brabliwei, dumaji yumob gin luk det ekshan main.
english: Yes, a man will say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

kriol: wal ola pipul brom kiriyajerim bin go langa bethshemesh, en deibin gajim det seikridwan boks, en deibin deigimbek det boks langa det haus blanga wan olmen neim abinadeb. det haus blanga im bin jidan ontop langa hil kantri, en detlot pipul bin meigim det san blanga im neim eliyeisa jidan bos blanga det seikridwan boks blanga yawei det trubala god.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh's ark, and brought it into Abinadab's house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep Yahweh's ark.

kriol: wen yu biginini olabat growap, yu wandim olabat blanga album yu, nomo detlot streinja pipul.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

kriol: bat sambala pipul hubin deya bin gobek langa jerusalem, en deibin dalim detlot serramonimen gulum ferasi wanim jisas bin dum,
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

kriol: en wen deibin kaman gulijap langa det haus, detlot pipul bin go mowes, en deibin trai en grebum pol, en detlot solja bin lafta garrimap im, en olawei detlot pipul bin kipgon jinginatbat, "kilim im! kilim im!"
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

kriol: wandei det king brom isreil bin wokwok deya ontop langa det bigwan wol langa det taun en wanbala wuman bin luk im en imbin jingat, "bos, yu album mi."
english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, "Help, my lord, O king!"

kriol: en yubin meigim miselp jidan god blanga melabat. en yubin meigim melabat jidan blanga yu ronwan pipul olagijawan.
english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

kriol: wal det najamen hubin jidan enami blanga king salaman bin det san blanga neibat gulum jerabowam, imbin brom det pleis gulum sereda deya langa det kantri gulum ifreiyim. im mami bin det widogel neim seruwa.
english: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

kriol: "wal langa det dei na wen olabat garra faitfaitbat, olabat garra jinginatbat adbala jis laik det bigwan solwoda weya im meigimbat bigbala nois. en wen yumob garra lukinatbat langa det kantri, yumob garra lukinat oni dakbala pleis en trabul, dumaji det dei na im garra jidan garram brabli hebiwan klaud en im garra jidan brabli dakbala."
english: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

kriol: en dei garra tok, 'kaman! wi lafta go deya langa det bigiswan hil blanga yawei det trubala god blanga jeikob, en weship im deya langa im serramoni pleis. yawei garra titjimbat wi detlot lowa en wi garra teiknodis en duwit langa im.'
english: Many peoples shall go and say, "Come, let's go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths." For the law shall go out of Zion, and Yahweh's word from Jerusalem.

kriol: en finiyas bin dalim det thribala klen, "wi sabi yawei im jidan garram wi holot, dumaji yumob nomo bin gibit im bekboun. en wi sabi im kaan panishim ol im pipul olabat na."
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, "Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahweh. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of Yahweh's hand."

kriol: wal detlot pipul langa jerusalem bin jinginatbat. deibin jingat, "melabat ardimbat iya brabliwei. melabat garram sowa en im nomo gitbeda, najing. en melabat bin reken melabat gin hendulum dijan trabul, bat najing.
english: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, "Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it."

kriol: wulijim pipul langa ebri kantri langa dijan wel garra sabi yu na yawei det trubala god en nomo najalot drimin o enibodi jidan wulijim yu.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh himself is God. There is no one else.

kriol: bat najing. yumob bin go en bulurrumbat det nogudbalawei, en yumob garra abum det trabul weya kamat brom det nogudbalawei na. yumob garra abum det trabul jis laik det fama weya im plentim sid langa nogudbala graun, en wen im taim blanga gajim det daga, im gajim ola nogudwan daga. en yumob bin reken yumob garram strongwan ami en ebrijing, en yumob bin trastim ol detlot ting na blanga album yumob.
english: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.

kriol: yubin jandim detlot mesinja blanga yu blanga tok praudbalawei langa mi. deibin dalim mi, yubin deigim yu soljamob garram ola bagi blanga yu ontop langa detlot bigiswan hil deya langa det kantri gulum lebanon. deya na weya bigmob tri gro yubin kadimdan ola brabli bigwan tri gulum sidatri en ola brabli gudwan tri gulum paintri.
english: By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, "With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.

kriol: en ai kaan abum spel o silip,
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

kriol: wen wi luk lilwan biginini garram olabat dedi, im laigim im biginini olabat du. wal lagijat du yawei garram det filing blanga detlot pipul hu oldei rispek langa im.
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

kriol: en yu dumbat mowa gudbala ting blanga melabat, dumaji yubin meigim pramis blanga main femili olabat wanim garra hepin bambai. yawei, nomeda mi oni wekinmen blanga yu, bat stil yubin tok langa mi laik aibin jidan haibala.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant's house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.

kriol: yu jis laik det gel hu oldei wandim silipsilipbat garram najalot streinja pipul, bat nomo yu ronwan hasbin.
english: "'"Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

kriol: sambala pipul peiyim mani langa sambodi blanga dum nogudbala ting, en dei reken wen dei peiyim sambodi dei gin meigim enibodi dum enijing olabat wandim.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

kriol: en rem bin dedi blanga aminadeb,
english: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,

kriol: en detlot serramonimen garra barnimap detlot langa det teibul blanga ofring garram det barnapwan ofring. det smel blanga det ofring garra meigim mi brabli gudbinji.
english: Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

kriol: wal det najawan waif neim hena nomo bin abum eni biginini, dumaji yawei nomo bin larram im abum eni biginini, en nomeda im nomo bin abum eni biginini, bat stil det men bin laigim im brabliwei, en imbin oldei gibit im daga brom det sekrifais ofring du. bat im nomo bin gibit im haf daga. imbin oldei gibit im bigmob daga.
english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.

kriol: wen yu laigim god brabli trubalawei, wal im garra larramgo yu fri brom ola nogudbala ting yubin oldei dumbat. wen yu duwit langa yawei nomo eni nogudwan ting garra hepin langa yu.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

kriol: yumob bin askim, 'weya det kemp blanga det haibala men hu oldei dumbat nogudbala ting?'
english: For you say, 'Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?'

kriol: en ebrijing weya yumob dumbat, yumob garra dum brabliwei, dumaji yumob laigim god en ola pipul olabat.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

kriol: ai garra breigimdan det wol raitdan langa det bodamwan pat. wen det wol garra buldan im garra kilim ol detlot laiyawan speshalwan mesinja. afta tharran, ebribodi garra sabi mi na yawei.
english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

kriol: ol detlot solja garra gajim ola gudbala ting blanga yumob. en olabat garra pulumdan ola bigwan wol en dei garra bitsimap ola gudbala haus blanga yumob. dei garra libum oni wud en ston en dei garra tjakidawei holot yumob ebrijing langa det solwoda.
english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

kriol: yawei bin brabli jelas wen imbin luk yumob weshipbat olkain drimin sheip. det nogudbala ting bin meigim im brabli wail.
english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

kriol: detlot wadi blanga det tri bin kamat langa det medatareiniyan solwoda en langa det yufreitis riba.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

kriol: en dei kaan laigim enibodi, en dei kaan larramgo fri enibodi hubin dum nogudbala ting langa olabat, en dei garra tok olkain laiyawan stori blanga enibodi, en dei garra oldei gitwail brabliwei, en dei kaan holdimbek miselp blanga enijing, en dei kaan laigim enijing weya im jidan gudbala,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

kriol: god garra meigim dijan kantri jidan garram detmatj daga. det god blanga wi na garra gibit wi ebrijing.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

kriol: mi na oldei meigim det skai jidan dakbala jis laik det sekbeigwan klos weya yu oldei werrimonbat langa fyunral." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering."

kriol: "wal yu dalim melabat hau melabat garra tok langa god. melabat nomo sabi hau blanga dalim god blanga melabat trabul.
english: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can't make our case by reason of darkness.

kriol: en imbin gibitbek ola golwan en silbawan enijing weya king nebakanesa bin gajim brom det serramoni pleis langa jerusalem en imbin pudum langa det serramoni pleis deya langa det taun gulum bebalon. king sairas bin gibit detlot enijing langa det men weya imbin meigim bos blanga juda. det men bin neim sheshbasa.
english: The gold and silver vessels of God's house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

kriol: wal det kantri garra abum loda trabul wen det king im jidan yangboi, en im lidamob wandim dagadagat olataim.
english: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!

kriol: wal saiman pida bin deya du, en imbin abum bigwan naif, en imbin deigimat det naif, en imbin kadim wanbala men deya hubin wekinmen blanga det boswan haibala serramonimen. det wekinmen bin neim melkas, en saiman pida bin kadimof det raidensaid irriwol blanga im.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

kriol: wal pailat bin larram detlot haibala serramonimen dum wanim deibin wandim, en detlot solja bin go en breigim detlot leig blanga det dubala men heingimap deya wansaid langa jisas.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

kriol: wal sol bin tok langa det wekinmen blanga im hubin oldei garrimapbat ol detlot ebrijing blanga fait. imbin tok, "yu deigimat yu bigwan naif en kilim mi ded, dumaji ai nomo wandim detlot filastain soljamob hu nomo sabi god blanga kilim mi. dei nomo sabi god, en dei mait mokimbat langa mi nogudbalawei." bat det yangmen bin bradin nomo lilbit blanga kilim im. wal sol bin lafta deigimat im ronwan bigwan naif, en imbin tjakamdan miselp ontop langa det bigwan naif blanga kilim miselp ded.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, "Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me." But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kriol: "bat yawei bin tok, 'yumob nomo bin irrim langa mi. yumob bin meigim mi brabli wail garram detlot drimin sheip blanga yumob, en yumob bin bringimap det panishmen langa yumob ronselp.
english: "Yet you have not listened to me," says Yahweh, "that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt."

kriol: en if yu gibit ebrijing brom yu hat langa ola po pipul, wal god garra meigim ebrijing klinbala blanga yu.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

kriol: deibin libum ola ded bodi blanga yu pipul olabat blanga ola bard blanga dagadagatbat, en deibin libum ola bifpat blanga yu wekinmen olabat blanga ola wail enimul blanga dagadagatbat.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

kriol: en yu kaan silipsilipbat garram eni doda o grendoda if yubin silipsilipbat garram im mami basdam. wal im maitbi yu ronwan femili, en tharran na im brabli nogud.
english: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

kriol: wal detlot emanait solja bin kamat brom det taun blanga olabat gulum reiba, en deibin meigim miselp redi blanga fait deya gin gulijap langa det taun. en ola siriya solja en ola najalot solja weya bin kaman blanga album olabat bin meigim miselp redi blanga fait langa det opin kantri lilbit longwei brom det taun.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.

kriol: en yumob garra trai en jidan gudbalawei garram ebribodi. yumob kaan jidan eniwei. oni blanga god yumob garra jidan, dumaji nobodi kaan luk god if dei nomo jidan lagijat.
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

kriol: yubin larram melabat enami olabat jidan krulbala bos langa melabat, jis laik deibin ranimdan melabat garram olabat hosis en bagi. melabat bin abum brabli adtaim, jis laik wen faiya o fladwoda binijimap ebrijing blanga pipul. bat yu na bin bringimap melabat langa seifwan pleis garram detmatj daga.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

kriol: detlot rum bin seim wulijim detlot rum langa detlot haus langa det nowathsaid en deibin ol abum roud blanga wokwokbat du.
english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

kriol: en im kaan neba stap raidap im garra dum ebrijing im wandim dum. wen det dei garra kaman bambai im pipul olabat garra sabi." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: Yahweh's anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.

kriol: det spirit blanga god en det pramis blanga jisas, dubala dalim jisas, "yu kaman na!" en ebribodi hu lisin langa dubala tok lagijat garra tok lagijat gin, "yu kaman na!" en if enibodi thestibala, en im wandim det woda blanga laif, wal im gin gajim, dumaji det woda im friwan.
english: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" He who hears, let him say, "Come!" He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

kriol: detlot geit blanga jerusalem bin leidan breikinwan langa graun, dumaji detlot enami bin bitsimap detlot pos. det king en ol detlot boswan lidamob en ola femili blanga olabat dei oldei jidan laiga prisana langa najawan kantri na. detlot serramonimen nomo titjimbat det lowa na, en detlot speshalwan mesinja nomo oldei gedimbat eni wed brom yawei enimo na.
english: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.

kriol: en ebribodi garra luk det boswan weya god garra jandim blanga seibum olabat." lagijat na aisaiya bin tok. en det wed bin tok blanga jon beptis weya imbin dalimbat ola pipul blanga libum olabat nogudbalawei.
english: All flesh will see God's salvation.'"

kriol: wal eibrahem bin brabli olmen na, en yawei det trubala god bin brabli gudbala langa im blanga ebrijing weya imbin dumbat.
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

kriol: if aibin breigim eni lowa weya im tok dei garra kilim mi ded, wal ai nomo askim yu blanga larramgo mi fri. bat if ai nomo bin dum wanim dislot juwish lida bin reken aibin dum, wal nobodi kaan hendimoba mi langa olabat. ai wandi go langa det brabli haibala gabman kot deya langa rom." lagijat na pol bin tok.
english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don't refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!"

kriol: brom deya pailat bin tok langa detlot haibala serramonimen en ola najalot pipul deya. imbin tok, "ai kaan faindim eni rong langa dijan men."
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."

kriol: wan yangbala men bin deya bulurrumbat jisas. imbin jis werrimon im silipinwan klos, en detlot pipul bin trai en grebum im du.
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

kriol: wal ai nomo wandim yumob blanga witnis blanga mi bat ai dalimbat yumob dislot wed, dumaji im garra seibum yumob.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

kriol: wal job bin kipgon tok, "dijan na wanim god det brabli haibalawan oldei dumbat langa detlot nogudbala en brabli krulbala men.
english: "This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

kriol: wal nomeda jisas bin laigim matha en meri en lesaras detmatj, bat stil wen imbin irrim det wed weya lesaras bin sik, im nomo bin go streidawei. imbin jidan deya gin dubala dei,
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

kriol: yumob nomo bulurrumbat en dumbat nogudbala ting laik ol detlot pipul deya langa ijip weya yumob bin jidan bifo o detlot pipul hubin jidan langa det kantri gulum keinan weya ai garra deigim yumob bambai.
english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

kriol: "wal blanga tharran na detlot juwish pipul bin grebum mi wen aibin deya langa det serramoni pleis, en deibin trai en kilim mi ded deya gin.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

kriol: wal yawei im tok dijan langa yu, 'ai garra meigim yu jidan brabli nogudwan langa yu ronselp, en langa yu ronwan frenmob, en yu garra luk garram yu ronwan ai wen olabat garra gitkilbat langa wo garram detlot bigwan naif brom yumob enamimob. en ai garra meigim det king brom bebalon garra abum detmatj pawa oba langa yumob. det king garra deigimwei sambala pipul langa im ronwan kantri, en im garra meigim olabat jidan prisana, en im garra kilimbat sambala pipul ded.
english: For Yahweh says, 'Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.

kriol: "wal haibala bos, ai wandim yu garra jidan olagijawan. yu bulurrum main wed, en nomo dum nogudbala ting. yu dum wanim gudwan en yu garra kain langa ola powan pipul. if yu dum lagijat na, yu garra kipgon jidan gudwei garram ola ebrijing." lagijat na denyul bin tok.
english: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your tranquility."

kriol: aibin silip, bat main hat im oldei weik. mi oldei drimdrimbat main olmen oldei noknok langa dowa. det men im sing. larram mi kaman, main olgamen, main gelfren. main hed im wetwan brom det dyu, en main heya im wetwan du.
english: I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: "Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; for my head is filled with dew, and my hair with the dampness of the night."

kriol: detlot pipul hu garra win garra werrimon detkain waitwan klos du, en ai kaan rabumat olabat neim brom det buk weya garram ola neim blanga ebribodi hu garra jidan laibala olagija. ai kaan rabumat olabat neim brom det buk blanga laif. ai garra tok streidat blanga olabat langa main dedi en langa im einjul olabat.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

kriol: en blanga tharran na mi abumbat dijan trabul weya mi jidan langa jeil taidap garram tjein jis laiga brabli nogudbala men. nomeda deibin taiyimap mi en stapam mi brom go ebriweya, bat stil nobodi kaan taiyimap det wed blanga god en stapam det wed brom spredatbat ebriweya.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God's word isn't chained.

kriol: pudum det emtiwan sospen ontop langa det faiya raidap im garra git brabli hotwan wulijim det faiya garra deigimat det rastiwan pat en meigim brabli klinwan.
english: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.

kriol: wal jisas bin brabli apset langa olabat, en imbin tok, "wotfo yumob oldei lagijat? wotfo yumob askim mi blanga dum speshalwan klebabala ting? yumob irrim mi na. trubala ai dalim yumob. yumob kaan gedim pruf brom eniweya."
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, "Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation."

kriol: ai garra pudum ola gudbala pipul langa main raidensaid en ola nogudbala pipul langa main lefthensaid.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin tok lagijat, det nogudbala spirit bin meigim det men deigim fit, en det nogudbala spirit bin jingat adbala, en imbin kamat brom det men.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

kriol: "yumob reken ola dedbala pipul kaan gidap laibala. bat mosis bin shoum yumob ola dedbala pipul garra gidap laibala. det stori langa oltestaman blanga det tri weya bin barnbarn garram faiya, im tokabat god lagijat na. im tok, 'mi na det god blanga eibrahem en aisik en jeikob.'
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord 'The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

kriol: jowahes bin jidan king raidap wen neko det king blanga ijip bin gajim im en meigim im prisana langa det pleis gulum ribla langa det kantri gulum heimath. det king blanga ijip bin meigim ola juda pipul peiyim im 3,400 kilogrem silbawan mani en 34 kilogrem gol blanga shoum rispek langa im.
english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

kriol: orait, det ifreiyim klen en det naja dubala klen garra jidan garram olabat lida sangodanwei langa det seikridwan tent garram olabat ronwan fleig. dislot na det lida en namba blanga detlot klen. blanga det ifreiyim klen det lida bin ilaishama det san blanga amihad en det namba bin 40,500. blanga det manesa klen det lida bin gameiliyal det san blanga pedasura en det namba bin 32,200. blanga det benjamin klen det lida bin abidan det san blanga gidiyanai en det namba bin 35,400. holot bin 108,100. ol dislot na garra bulurrum det libai klen ebritaim wen olabat shifdim kemp langa najawan pleis.
english: "On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

kriol: en deibin deigim 10,000 solja prisana en deibin deigim olabat ontop langa wanbala haibala hil gulijap langa det taun gulum sela en deibin pushumdan olabat en olabat bin ol gitkil wen olabat bin buldan langa detlot ston langa bodam.
english: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.

kriol: en if yu trai en deigimat det lilwan wadi brom yu braja ai, wal yu brabli granggibala. yu si? yu garra deigimat det bigwan wadi brom yu ron ai basdam, en afta yu gin luk gudwei, en yu gin deigimat det lilwan wadi brom yu braja ai na. yu sabi na? yu garra streitinimap yu ron laif basdam, en afta yu gin go en album yu braja streitinimap im laif.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother's eye.

kriol: imbin bringimap olabat langa im seikridwan kantri, en langa detlot bigwan hil weya imbin teikoba.
english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

kriol: weya im buldan kolwethataim, en detlot riba en bilibong go brabli aisiwan jis laik rok?"
english: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

english: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, 'Give me a king and princes'?

english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

english: Give to him who asks you, and don't turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

english: Then they asked him, "Who is the man who said to you, 'Take up your mat and walk'?"

kriol: afta na jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin gowei, en wan men bin ran langa im, en imbin baudan lida langa im, en imbin askim im, "gudbala titja, wanim ai garra dum blanga abum det olagijawan laif?"
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, "Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"

kriol: "wen sambodi kadimdan det tri, im stil gin gro igin.
english: "For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

english: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won't lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.

kriol: wal det nait na dubala bin gibit wain langa lot, en meigim im jidan brabli drangginwan, en afta det bigwan doda blanga im bin silip garram im na, en im nomo bin sabi im doda bin silip garram im, dumaji imbin brabli drangginwan.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn't know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

kriol: en ilaija bin tok, "yawei yu na boswan god, en aibin oldei wek blanga yu en nomo blanga najalot. bat detlot isreil pipul nomo bin kipum det brabli strongwan pramis weya yubin meigim garram olabat, en deibin breigimap detlot teibul blanga ofring, en deibin kilim ola speshalwan mesinja blanga yu, en oni mi na wanbala speshalwan mesinja laibala tudei, en olabat trai blanga kilim mi ded!"
english: He said, "I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away."

kriol: olabat garra lukinatbat olabat bigininimob wen detlot men garra kilimbat olabat ded krulbalawei, en wen dei garra stilimbat ebrijing brom olabat haus, en wen dei garra fosimbat olabat waif du.
english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

kriol: yumob oldei dagat det daga brom det ofring. bat stil yumob oldei jidan hanggriwan. en yumob oldei silipsilipbat garram ol detlot gel weya dei oldei yusumbat langa detlot laiyawan serramoni pleis blanga ola najalot drimin. dei yusumbat detlot gel langa detlot laiyinwan serramoni blanga meigim ola gadin gro gudwei en blanga meigim ola wuman abum bigismob biginini. bat najing. yumob gadin kaan growimap daga, en yumob kaan abum eni biginini, dumaji yumob bin gibit mi bekboun, en yumob oldei bulurrum detlot drimin." lagijat na yawei tok.
english: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to Yahweh.

english: The angel answered the women, "Don't be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

kriol: wal bigmob pipul bin deya insaid garram jisas, en deibin dalim im, "yu mami en yu braja en yu sista olabat deya atsaid lukabat yu."
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, "Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you."

kriol: bat wen det lida bin dai, detlot isreil pipul bin oldei gobek langa det nogudbalawei seimwei laik olabat dedi bin oldei dumbat. bat deibin mowes, en deibin oldei bulurrum en weship detlot najalot drimin, en dei nomo bin wandi tenim miselp brom olabat nogudbalawei.
english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn't cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

kriol: yumob garra weidabat atsaid, raidap im garra bringimat langa yumob imselp.
english: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

kriol: "wal mi wail langa ola boswan blanga juda pipul, dumaji olabat bin go en shifdimbat ola ston weya bin jidan langa det boda langa yumob kantri. en ai garra panishim olabat jis laiga fladwoda weya im tjakidawei ola ebrijing.
english: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

kriol: ol detlot pipul weya yubin pikimat en bringimap blanga jidan langa det seikridwan haus blanga yu, jidan gudbinjiwan. melabat garra jidan gudbinjiwei garram ola gudwan ting langa det seikridwan haus blanga yu.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

kriol: ol det kantri weya salaman bin jidan king bin brom det yufreitis riba raidap langa det boda blanga filastain kantri, en raitdan langa det boda blanga ijip. deibin oldei peiyim im teks mani en detlot pipul bin oldei wek blanga im olataim wen imbin jidan king.
english: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

kriol: en afta yu garra go en spilim det oliboil langa jeihu det san blanga nimshi blanga meigim im jidan king blanga isreil. en afta yu garra spilim det oliboil langa ilaisha det san blanga shafat brom det taun gulum eibulmehola en im na garra jidan det speshalwan mesinja blanga deigim det pleis blanga yu.

english: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out of Egypt."

english: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.

english: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

kriol: en olabat kaan dringgim eni wain bifo olabat garra go insaid langa det insaidwan kotyad.

english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

english: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.

english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

english: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.

english: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.

english: Yahweh's angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

english: Yahweh's Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, "Speak, 'Yahweh says: "Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

english: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

english: Others, mocking, said, "They are filled with new wine."

english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

kriol: im fut bin tjeinap en aiyanwan tjein bin raidaran langa im nek,
english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

english: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move, for he had not tested it. David said to Saul, "I can't go with these, for I have not tested them." Then David took them off.

kriol: en if god gibit sambodi ola ebrijing en im larram im abum gudtaim, wal im garra jidan brabli gudbinjiwei blanga wanim imbin wekwekbat. god na gibit im dijan.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

kriol: en im garra meigim redi 9 kilogrem sid daga en 3 lita oliboil blanga gibit sekrifais ofring garram ebri buligi en boiwan ship.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

kriol: wal det men neim apefras im jidan iya langa dijan jeil garram mi, dumaji imbin dalimbat det gudnyus blanga jisas krais du. en im sei gudei langa yumob.
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

kriol: wal ai reken dijan na det brabli gudwan ting wi gin dumbat. wi gin dagadagatbat en dringgimbat en wi gin dumbat adwek gudbinjiwei langa dijan laif, dijan na meigim wi jidan gudbinjiwei langa dijan wel, en ai sabi god im gibit ebribodi dijan.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

kriol: bat god bin shoum wi imbin laigim wi detmatj, dumaji wen wibin stil nogudbala pipul, det taim na jisas krais bin deigim pleis blanga wi en dai blanga wi.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

kriol: "wal ai garra gibit det wuman siknis na. en detlot men hu oldei silip garram im garra abum det brabli nogudwan siknis du. if dei tenim olabat selp brom det nogudbalawei, wal ai kaan gibit olabat det siknis.
english: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "yunbala nomo sabi wanim yunbala toktok. yunbala reken yunbala gin go thru langa det trabul weya ai garra go thru? yunbala reken yunbala gin dai seimwei laik mi?"
english: But Jesus said to them, "You don't know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?"

kriol: wal deibid bin tok, "bos, mi oldei maindimbat main dedi ship olabat, en ebritaim wen laiyan o beya bin oldei kaman en grebum lilwan ship, aibin oldei ranimap det laiyan o beya, en aibin oldei gajimbek det lilwan ship. en if det laiyan o beya bin trai en fait langa mi, wal aibin oldei grebum im langa im throut en kilim im langa hed.
english: David said to Saul, "Your servant was keeping his father's sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,

kriol: ailibala neksdei, olabat bin stat wokwokbat blanga deigimoba det hil kantri en olabat bin tok, "wi redi blanga go langa det pleis weya yawei bin dalim wi. wi sabi wibin dum nogudbala ting."
english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, "Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised; for we have sinned."

kriol: wal yu dalim mi na. yu garram eni daga iya? wal yu gibit mi faibala damba o enijing weya yu garram deya."
english: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available."

kriol: imbin kilimbat mi oldei raidap main bodi bin ardim brabliwei.
english: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.

kriol: wal wen yumob kantrimen blanga detlot taun kaman en bringimap enibodi hubin medrim sambodi, o hubin breigim najalot lowa, yumob garra dalim im hau im garra jidan langa det kotkeis, wulijim im nomo dum nogudbala ting blanga yawei. if yumob nomo dum tharran, wal yawei garra wail langa yumob. bat if yumob dum tharran wal yumob nomo gilti.
english: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you must warn them, that they not be guilty toward Yahweh, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers. Do this, and you will not be guilty.

kriol: en raidimdan ola men brom 30 yiya ol raidap langa 50 yiya ol, hu gin wek langa det seikridwan tent blanga yawei.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

kriol: wal judas det wekinmen blanga jisas hu garra hendimoba im nomo bin deya garram olabat. bat imbin sabi jisas garra go langa det gadin, dumaji im en ol detlot najalot wekinmen bin oldei go deya garram jisas blanga jidanbat.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

kriol: wal ol dislot men na bin abum waif brom naja kantri. deibin libum olabat waif en deibin jandimwei olabat waif en biginini olabat. binij na.
english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

kriol: enibodi hu tok brabli nogudbalawei langa im dedi en mami garra binij jis laik lemp wen im stap barnbarn.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

kriol: sambala wekinmen bin jinggabat maitbi jisas bin dalim im blanga go en baiyim ola enijing weya deibin wandim blanga det serramoni, dumaji judas bin oldei lukaftumbat ola mani blanga olabat. o maitbi imbin go blanga gibit sambala mani langa ola po pipul.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, "Buy what things we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.

kriol: 'yawei det boswan god bin meigim pramis blanga binijimap bebalon en ebriwan hu jidan deya, wulijim nobodi kaan jinggabat blanga olabat enimo.
english: "I will rise up against them," says Yahweh of Armies, "and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son's son," says Yahweh.

kriol: ai garra meigim olabat jidan wanbala, en ai garra larram olabat ol jidan mijamet langa isreil. oni wanbala king garra jidan bos blanga olabat, en dei kaan kadimat miselp en jidan dubala grup igin.
english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won't be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

kriol: "wen det taim garra kaman, sambala men garra hendimoba olabat ron braja langa ola haibala men blanga kilim olabat dumaji olabat laigim mi, en sambala dediwan garra hendimoba olabat ron biginini langa ola haibala men du blanga kilim olabat dumaji dei laigim mi, en sambala biginini garra dum lagijat du langa olabat ron mami en dedi,
english: "Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kriol: yawei, yu filing blanga laigim pipul im jidan mowa bigwan raidap langa hebin. en det trubalawei blanga yu im gajimap det skai.
english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kriol: en wen imbin kamat atsaid brom det haus blanga emnon, imbin tjakam eshis ontop langa im hed, dumaji imbin sheim, en imbin breigim im klos, en imbin gaburrumap miselp feis garram im bingga, en imbin gowei brom deya kraikrai olawei raidap langa im ron kemp.
english: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.

kriol: wal deibin jingat langa hushai, en wen imbin kaman langa olabat, ebsalom bin dalim im wanim ahithafel bin tok, en afta imbin tok, "wal wanim yu reken? det ting weya ahithafel bin dalim mi blanga dum, im gudwan? if najing, wal yu dalim mi wanim ai garra dum."
english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, "Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up."

kriol: en langa detlot twelbala ston deibin pudum detlot twelbala neim blanga detlot twelbala san blanga jeikob. wanbala ston bin jidan blanga ebri klen blanga detlot isreil pipul.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

kriol: ola men en wuman hubin wandi bringimap bin bringimap olkain nekleis en ring en purdiwan golwan ting weya deibin oldei werrimbat, en deibin gibit detlot ting blanga ofring langa yawei,
english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.

kriol: yu si? seimwei god bin dum lagijat na. imbin wandim shoum ola pipul hau im gitwail, en imbin wandi shoum olabat det pawa blanga im wulijim dei garra sabi. bat nomeda imbin gitwail langa detlot pipul weya im garra panishim olabat, bat stil imbin gibit olabat taim, en im nomo panishim olabat streidawei.
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

kriol: main god, ebrijing weya yu jinggabat, olabat gudwan langa mi, mowa den enijing. ai kaan kaundimap ola difrin ting weya yu jinggabat.
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

kriol: deibin raidimdan ola neim blanga ola boswan blanga detlot femili blanga det libai klen raidap det taim wen jonathan det grensan blanga eliyashib bin jidan haibala serramonimen.
english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers' households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

kriol: if yu dum yu wek gudwei, yu garra wek blanga det king en yu kaan jidan wekinmen blanga odinri pipul.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won't serve obscure men.

kriol: en god gin meigim ola graun sheiksheikbat nomo lilbit,
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

kriol: en im garra deigim atsaid brom olabat kemp en pudum langa det klinwan pleis blanga serramoni weya deibin oldei pudum detlot eshis. en deya na det serramonimen garra barnimbat holot langa faiya wud.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

kriol: im siliwan blanga tok nogudbalawei blanga enibodi. if yu garram gudwan main, wal yu garra jidan kwaitbala.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

kriol: wal jowahes bin 23 yiya ol wen deibin meigim im jidan det king blanga juda en imbin jidan king deya blanga 3 manth. im mami bin neim hematal hubin det doda blanga jeramaiya hubin jidan langa det taun gulum libna.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

kriol: wal yumob bin irrim wanim main grengrenfathamob en mi bin dum langa detlot najalot kantri. wal yumob reken detlot drimin blanga ola najalot kantri bin bidim melabat?
english: Don't you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?

kriol: en deibin gedim ol detlot taun gulum sora, eshtayol, aishamesh,
english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

kriol: en imbin tok, "langa oltestaman god bin tok, 'dijan serramoni pleis main im oni blanga prei.' lagijat na god bin tok. bat yumob bin tenimran dijan pleis en meigim blanga selimbat enijing en pulumatbat mani brom ola pipul."
english: saying to them, "It is written, 'My house is a house of prayer,' but you have made it a 'den of robbers'!"

kriol: main god, ola nogud pipul bin teikoba yu kantri. deibin dum nogud ting langa yu serramoni pleis, en deibin libum jerusalem rabishwan.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

kriol: wen ola pipul kaman mijamet blanga weship langa yu, ai dalim olabat det gudnyus hau yubin seibum mi. yu sabi ai nomo wandi stap dalimbat pipul det gudnyus.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

kriol: yumob weship yawei det trubala god blanga wi brabliwei, nomo laik ola najalot pipul hu weshipbat ola difrinkain drimin, dumaji dei dumbat ola brabli nogudbala ting weya yawei nomo laigim. dei barnimapbat olabat biginini langa faiya ontop langa det teibul blanga ofring.
english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

kriol: wal pol bin jandap lida langa ol detlot haibala men, en imbin tok, "ol yumob haibala men iya langa dijan taun, yumob rispek en bilib brabliwei langa ola drimin.
english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, "You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

kriol: nomo jandimwei mi. nomo deigidawei yu holi spirit brom mi.
english: Don't throw me from your presence, and don't take your Holy Spirit from me.

kriol: "wal ai garra askim yu na god blanga dum dubala ting blanga mi bifo ai dai.
english: "Two things I have asked of you. Don't deny me before I die.

kriol: wal wandei detlot thribala solja brom detlot 30 gudwan solja bin go langa det keib gulijap langa det keib gulum edulam weya king deibid bin jidan. king deibid bin jidan deya langa det keib ontop langa det strongwan hil, en sambala filastain solja bin kemp deya gin langa det pleis gulum reifait beli.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kriol: dumaji ai lafta kipgon tok. ai kaan jidan kwait.
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

kriol: afta na eibrahem bin kadimat sebenbala lilwan ship,
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

kriol: brom deya imbin jandim im wekinmen mosis en eran dubala weya imbin pikimat.
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

kriol: if ai gowap langa hebin, yu deya. if ai godan langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul go, yu deya.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

kriol: bambai na detlot wekinmen bin binij meigimbat det seikridwan tent en ol detlot enijing jis laik weya yawei bin dalim mosis blanga dum,
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.

kriol: "wal bifo det dei wen ola pipul garra bradin detmatj, ai garra jandim ilaija, det speshalwan mesinja langa yumob.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

kriol: "yumob enamimob gibit sain blanga git redi blanga fait. blowim det longwan wisul wulijim ola pipul langa najalot kantri gin irrim en sabi blanga gitredi na. yumob holot garra fait langa bebalon langa det wo. dalim detlot pipul blanga eraret, minai, en eshkenes blanga fait. pikimat det boswan solja blanga go lida blanga fait. bringimap detmatj hosis jis laik bigmob grashopa.
english: "Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!

kriol: wal job bin abum sebenbala san en thribala doda.
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

kriol: "yu na bos blanga melabat en god blanga melabat. nobodi kaan jidan brabli haibala garram pawa. oni yu na jidan brabli haibala garram pawa. oni yu na melabat gin rispek. oni yu na melabat gin gulum bos. dumaji yu na bin meigim ebrijing. yu na bin gibit laif langa ebrijing, dumaji yubin wandi gibit olabat laif." lagijat na detlot olmen bin oldei tok.
english: "Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!"

kriol: tharran bin meigim ilaisha gitwail en imbin tok langa det king, "wotfo yubin oni hitim thribala taim? wotfo yu nomo bin hitim 5 o 6 taim? wal if yu bina hitim det graun 5 o 6 taim yu bina bidim ola siriya pipul bat dumaji yubin hitim oni thribala taim, wal oni thribala taim na yu garra bidim olabat."
english: The man of God was angry with him, and said, "You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times."

kriol: en imbin tok, "yawei, basdam bifo aibin libum main kemp yubin dalim mi blanga go langa det taun en dalim detlot pipul yu garra panishim olabat, indit? bat aibin sabi yu kaan panishim olabat. en blanga tharran na aibin trai ranawei langa det longweiwan kantri. "ai sabi wotkain god yu. yu laigim olkain pipul, en yu sori langa olabat, en yu nomo gitwail streidawei, dumaji yu gudbala langa olabat, en yu oldei jinggabat nomo blanga panishim olabat.
english: He prayed to Yahweh, and said, "Please, Yahweh, wasn't this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.

kriol: wulijim yumob garra abum det kantri weya wi grengrenfathamob olabat bin jidan, en im garra meigim yumob bigismob pipul, en det namba garra jidan mowa brom wen wi grengrenfathamob olabat bin jidan.
english: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

kriol: brom deya det namba 3 einjul bin spilimat im dish langa ola riba en springwoda na, en ola freshwoda bin go blad.
english: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

kriol: bat imbin stil kipgon jandimbat speshalwan mesinja blanga dalimbat detlot pipul blanga kambek langa im. detlot pipul nomo bin wandi lisin.
english: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to Yahweh, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.

kriol: en meigim yu sabi ola sigridwei blanga im, en yu bina sabi god bina panishim yu brabli adbala na, bat im oni bin panishim yu lilbit.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

kriol: wal selma hubin stadimap bethlahem bin grengrenfatha blanga detlot pipul brom netofath en ethrobethjowab, en detlot sorait pipul hubin brom det dubala femili langa det kantri gulum menahath.
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

kriol: wal wen sambala lowamen deya bin irrim jisas tok lagijat, deibin gitwail, en deibin jinggabat en tok miselp,
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

kriol: wal ola pipul blanga god, olabat jis laiga haus blanga god, en mosis bin jidan wekinmen blanga det haus blanga god, en imbin duwit langa god brabliwei,
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

kriol: yubin meigim melabat laiga rabish langa dijan wel.
english: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

kriol: "wal ai dalim yumob. nomo longtaim na ai garra sheikimap dis graun wanmo. ai garra sheikim ola graun en ola solwoda en hebin du,
english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: 'Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

kriol: afta na teima bin gobek langa im kemp, en imbin deigimat detlot klos weya bin meigim men wandim im, en imbin werrimon detlot klos weya imbin werrimon basdam.
english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

kriol: wal bifo king deibid bin teikoba det taun, ola pipul bin oldei gulum det taun saiyan, dumaji det taun bin ontop langa det hil gulum saiyan. bat afta deibid bin oldei jidan deya, en deibin gulum det taun deibidtaun, dumaji king deibid bin bildimap det taun mowa bigwan. imbin stat bildimap det taun brom det pleis weya deibin hipimap loda graun sanraisaid langa det hil, en imbin bildimap det taun raidaran langa det hil.
english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David's city. David built around from Millo and inward.

kriol: mosis bin pudum im bingga langa joshuwa hed en meigim im jidan det nyuwan lida. imbin dum lagijat na dumaji yawei bin dalim im.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

kriol: deya na joshuwa bin dalim det men, "wotfo yubin meigim dijan trabul blanga ola isreil pipul? wal yu en yu femili olabat garra abum trabul brom yawei!" brom deya ola pipul bin stonim det men ded, en deibin stonim im femili olabat du, en deibin barnimap olabat bodi garram ola enijing blanga olabat,
english: Joshua said, "Why have you troubled us? Yahweh will trouble you today." All Israel stoned him with stones, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

kriol: wal edanaija bin tok, "ai wandim yu blanga askim king salaman blanga gibit mi ebisheg det gel brom shunam blanga jidan main waif. ai sabi king salaman kaan nokambek yu blanga larram mi deigim ebisheg."
english: He said, "Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you 'no'), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife."

kriol: lagijat na det dubala san blanga ilai bin oldei dumbat, en yawei bin oldei lukinat langa dubala, en det ting weya dubala bin oldei dumbat bin brabli nogudwan langa imwei, dumaji dubala nomo bin tridim detlot ofring blanga god gudwei.
english: The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised Yahweh's offering.

kriol: im garra brabli nogud blanga yumob moweb pipul! ol yumob pipul hu oldei weship det drimin gulum kemosh garra abum trabul! yumob drimin oldei larram yumob men jidan streinja, en ol yumob wuman jidan prisana blanga det emarait king gulum saihan.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

kriol: jisas bin pikimat dislot men na. saiman, jeims en im braja jon, endru, filip, bathalamyu, methyu, tamas, jeims det san blanga elfiyas, thediyas, saiman peitriyat en judas askeriyat. jisas bin pikimat dubala saiman, en imbin gulum det feswan pida, en det sekanwan deibin gulum im peitriyat. det dubala san blanga sebadi neim jeims en jon, jisas bin gulum dubala thanda.
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

kriol: longtaim wen yumob bin kamat brom ijip, aibin pramisim yumob ai garra jidan garram yumob olataim. wal yumob kaan bradin, dumaji mi stil jidan iya garram yumob.
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. 'Don't be afraid.'
