kriol: wal ai garra tok langa yumob blanga ola merrit gel na. dei garra kipgon jidanbat garram olabat hasbin raidap olabat hasbin dai. bat afta wen eni gel hasbin dai, det widogel im fri blanga go en merrit langa najawan men. bat im kaan merrit langa eni men. oni langa det men hu bulurrum jisas krais det bos blanga wi.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok, "ai garra meigim det purdiwan lait main gopas langa yu, en ai garra gulum main ronwan neim blanga yu. mi na yawei, en mi oldei kain en sori langa enibodi weya mi pikimat.
english: He said, "I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh's name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy."

kriol: "wen yawei garra gibit det oda, ola bigwan haus en ola lilwan haus garra breikap brabliwei.
english: "For, behold, Yahweh commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.

kriol: imbin jandim seidok, neithan en benaiya en detlot speshalwan solja blanga go garram im. en deibin meigim im raidim det speshalwan dongki blanga det king.
english: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king's mule.

kriol: lagijat na jisas bin tok langa ol detlot pipul, en wen imbin binij dalimbat stori langa olabat, deibin ol jidan brabli kwaitbala, dumaji imbin titjimbat olabat difrinwei brom ol detlot lowamen.
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

kriol: jadimap olabat mawus weya dei oldei dalimbat laiya, en wen dei oldei reken miselp en tok nogudwei blanga detlot pipul hu oldei jidan raitwei.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

kriol: abadait, semarait en hemathait. bambai ol detlot keinan pipul bin spredat ebriweya.
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

kriol: en ai garra tjakidawei yu langa najawan kantri. deya na yu garra dai en deya na blanga yu ola brabli gudwan bagi garra jidanbat breikapwan du. yu nomo eni gud langa yu bos, najing.
english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord's house.

kriol: det kwin brom shiba bin irrim blanga king salaman weya imbin sabi ebrijing brabliwei, en imbin luk detlot bigwan haus weya king salaman bin bildimap.
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

kriol: wal det feswan enimul bin meigim det sekanwan enimul jidan bos, en det sekanwan enimul bin dumbat olkainaba sain wen det feswan enimul bin deya langa im. imbin meigim faiya kamdan brom top raidap langa graun, en bigmob pipul bin luk det faiya garram olabat ron ai. det enimul bin trikimbat ola pipul langa ebri kantri, en detlot sain bin meigimbat olabat go nogudbalawei. wal det sekanwan enimul bin dalim ola pipul blanga bildimap sheip weya luk jis laik det feswan enimul, en ola pipul bin lafta buldan en weship det enimul sheip.
english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "yumob pipul langa isreil, yumob garra rispek en lisin langa yawei wanim im wandim yumob blanga dum. yumob garra weship langa yawei en yumob garra duwit langa im weya im dalim yumob blanga dum. en yumob garra laigim im garram yumob filing holbit en yumob garra gibit miselp blanga wek blanga im.
english: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

kriol: en wen im tok langa detlot pipul hu nomo agri langa im, wal im garra streitinimap olabat en tok gudwei langa olabat. dumaji wi wandim god blanga album olabat tjeinjim det insaidwei filing blanga olabat wulijim dei garra sabi det trubalawan wed blanga im,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

kriol: wal detlot serramonimen en lowamen en najalot boswan bin kotim jisas na, en deibin trai blanga faindim folt langa im blanga kilim im ded. bat dei nomo bin faindim eni folt langa im.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok, "wal tudei if yumob pipul meigim pramis o tok strongbala wed dei tok, 'trubala ai dalim yu. yawei na bin bringimat melabat brom ijip.' bat bambai wen ai garra bringimbek yumob brom nowathwei en detlot najalot kantri weya aibin spredimat oloba, yumob garra tok, 'trubala ai dalim yu. yawei na bin bringimbek melabat brom nowathwei en detlot najalot kantri weya imbin spredimat melabat.' wal ai garra bringimbek yumob langa yumob ronwan kantri na weya aibin gibit langa yumob grengrenfathamob basdam."
english: "Therefore behold, the days come," says Yahweh, "that it will no more be said, 'As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;'

kriol: en king sol bin tok, "wal yu go en askimbat olabat."
english: The king said, "Inquire whose son the young man is!"

kriol: wan manth ol en oba, en det namba bin 22,273.
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim im, "wotfo yu gulum mi gudbala? oni god imselp im gudbala. yu kaan gulum enibodi gudbala.
english: Jesus said to him, "Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

kriol: blanga gibit dijan wed langa king reiyabowam en detlot pipul blanga benjamin en juda klen en ola najalot pipul.
english: "Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

kriol: "wen ai gowei, ai garra meigim yumob jidan gudbalawei, en yumob kaan bradin en nogudbinji, dumaji garram main ronwei ai garra meigim yumob jidan gudbalawei. nomo garram det wei blanga dijan wel.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

kriol: detlot biginini oldei gajimbat faiyawud, en detlot men oldei bildimap faiya, en detlot wuman oldei meigimbat keik blanga det drimin gulum kwin blanga hebin. olabat oldei spilimbat det wain ofring blanga ol detlot drimin blanga ardimbat main filing.
english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

kriol: en detlot pipul hu jidan laibala en bilib langa mi kaan dai olagijawan. matha, yu bilib dijan weya mi dalimbat yu?"
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?"

kriol: detlot biginini blanga yu enamimob hubin heidimbat yu en tridimbat yu nogudbalawei, olabat garra kaman en nildan langa yu fut. olabat garra tok, 'dijan na det taun gulum saiyan. im det taun blanga yawei det brabli holiwan god blanga ola isreil pipul.'
english: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you Yahweh's City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

kriol: im garra tok, 'yumob men brom isreil, yumob lisin na. tudei yumob garra go blanga fait. nomo hatjamp en sheiksheikbat o jidan bradin blanga ola enami,
english: and shall tell them, "Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don't let your heart faint! Don't be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

kriol: olabat garra growap wulijim gras, en wulijim det tri gulum wilotri weya gro gulijap langa wodasaid.
english: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

kriol: yu gibit olabat en dei dagat. yu oldei gibit olabat daga garram yu ronwan bingga en dei oldei sedisfaid.
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

kriol: wal streidawei denyul bin go en askim det king blanga gibit im mowa taim wulijim im gin dalim det king wanim det drim min.
english: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin dalim mosis blanga tok langa ola isreil pipul. imbin tok, "wal if enibodi langa yumob, o pipul brom najalot kantri hu jidan garram yumob, yusumbat yumob bigininimob blanga weshipbat det drimin gulum molek, wal yumob garra kilim im ded garram ston.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kriol: nomeda yumob gibit theingks langa god gudbalawei langa det preya blanga yumob, bat stil det preya kaan album detlot pipul deya langa det miting pleis hu nomo sabi.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

kriol: imbin ridim ola lowa brom det buk weya mosis bin raidimdan, en ola isreil pipul bin irrim im ridim det buk. nomo jis oni ola men. ola wuman en ola biginini en ola najalot kantrimen hubin oldei jidan garram olabat bin ol irrim detlot lowa brom det buk du.
english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn't read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who were among them.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin luk det widogel, imbin fil sori blanga im, en imbin dalim im, "yu nomo krai."
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, "Don't cry."

kriol: meigim ola king nildan lida langa im, en ola pipul brom ebri kantri garra wek blanga im.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

kriol: wal langa det namba 7 yiya wen jeihu bin jidan king langa isreil, deibin meigim jowesh jidan det nyuwan king blanga juda en imbin jidan king blanga juda 40 yiya. en jowesh mami bin neim saibiya en imbin brom det taun gulum biyashiba.
english: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

kriol: yu kipgon yet. kwikbala yu go." lagijat na imbin tok, en det yangboi bin gajim det erro, en imbin deigimbek langa jonathan.
english: Jonathan cried after the boy, "Go fast! Hurry! Don't delay!" Jonathan's boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

kriol: bat stil langa dijan leda aibin lafta tok sambala wed streidat langa yumob blanga meigim yumob jinggabat detlot wed, dumaji god bin kain langa mi,
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

kriol: mi na garra jidan prisana en dumbat ola adwek blanga yu, dumaji ai kaan gobek langa main dedi nomo garram im san. ai kaan meigim trabul blanga main dedi en meigim im dai." lagijat na juda bin tok.
english: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn't with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father."

kriol: en king jehosafet bin baudan raitdan garram im feis langa graun, en ola pipul bin baudan garram im en deibin weship langa yawei.
english: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before Yahweh, worshiping Yahweh.

kriol: "wal tudei yumob meigim sekrifais eniweya yumob wandim, dumaji yumob nomo jidan langa det kantri weya yawei det trubala god blanga wi garra gibit yumob en weya im garra maindimbat yumob en weya yumob gin jidan kwaitbala nomo garram eni trabul. bat wen yumob krosoba langa det jodan riba en yumob teikoba det kantri, yawei garra lukaftumbat yumob brom ola enami blanga yumob. yawei garra pikimat wanbala pleis weya yumob garra weship im, en deya na yumob garra bringimap ebrijing weya aibin tok. en deya na yumob garra bringimap ola sekrifais ofring weya yumob garra barnim, en ola najalot sekrifais ofring, en ebri tenbala ebrijing yumob bin growimap yumob garra gibit wanbala langa mi en ola ofring en ola enijing weya yumob bin pramisim blanga gibit langa yawei.
english: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

kriol: en deibin gedim ol detlot taun langa det hil kantri du. detlot taun bin neim shamiya, jeitiya, sako,
english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

kriol: en deibin gowei brom det keib, en deibin gobek en dalimbat det nyus. detlot gel bin meri megdalin, jowena, en meri det mami blanga jeims. en deibin go en dalim detlot najalot gel, en afta deibin ol go en dalim detlot lebenbala speshalwan mishanri en ola najalot pipul wanim bin hepin deya langa det keib.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

kriol: wal aibin tok, "ol detlot nogudbala pipul langa jerusalem, olabat bradin en olabat sheiksheikbat nomo lilbit wen olabat askim, 'hau wi garra jidan gudwei wen det faiya im kipgon barnbarnbat?'
english: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

kriol: en wen jeikob en im femili olabat bin kamat langa goshin, josef bin gedim det wed, en imbin go garram im bagi, en imbin midim im dedi deya na. en wen josef bin kamat langa im dedi, imbin pudumran im dubala am langa im, en dubala bin kraikrai detmatj.
english: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

kriol: "wal ai garra peiyimbek olabat blanga det blad. ai kaan larramgo olabat fri brom det nogudbala ting weya deibin dum langa main pipul olabat. bat juda en jerusalem garra jidan garram detmatj pipul olagijawan. en mi na yawei garra jidan deya na ontop langa det seikridwan hil gulum saiyan." lagijat na yawei bin tok. binij na.
english: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

kriol: en dislot neim blanga detlot hubin bulurrum olabat, meiseiya, shemaiya, eliyeisa, yusi, jehohana, melkija, elam en isa. jesrahaiya bin lida blanga ola singamob weya bin sing adbala.
english: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

kriol: afta na yawei bin tok langa mi, "jeramaiya, wanim yu gin luk?" aibin ensim im, "ai gin luk det fig daga. detlot gudwan frut daga im brabli gudwan, en detlot nogudwan frut daga im brabli nogud blanga dagat."
english: Then Yahweh asked me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" I said, "Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so bad that they can't be eaten."

kriol: en jis laik det solja oldei werrimon im but redi blanga go en fait, yumob garra oldei jidan redi du blanga go en dalimbat det gudnyus, dumaji det gudnyus na garra meigim pipul jidan gudwei.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

kriol: det taim garra kaman wen yawei garra stap panishimbat yumob. im garra andimwei yumob enami olabat. yawei, det trubala god, im det king blanga yumob isreil pipul en im garra jidan deya garram yumob. yumob kaan bradin blanga eni nogud ting mowa na.
english: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

kriol: orait, longtaim wen god bin stat meigimbat ebrijing, nomo enijing bin jidan. imbin jis eniwei, nomo garram enijing. oni strongbala woda bin goran goran ebriwei, en imbin brabli dakbala, en det spirit blanga god bin mubabat ontop langa det woda.
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

kriol: weya olabat gin lukdan en faindim daga?
english: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

kriol: ai garra grebum yumob jis laik det mamiwan beya weya bin lujim im biginini. ai garra breigimap yumob jis laik ol detlot wailwan enimul breigimap olabat daga. ai garra binijimap yumob wanwei jis laiga wailwan enimul.
english: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.

kriol: wal streidawei king hesakaiya bin gajim detlot boswan wekinmen brom det taun en imbin bringimap olabat langa det serramoni pleis.
english: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to Yahweh's house.

kriol: en sambala men bin go langa det keib, en deibin faindim im lagijat gin weya detlot gel bin tok, en dei nomo bin luk im bodi." lagijat na det men bin tok.
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn't see him."

kriol: bat det widogel bin pudum mowa mani langa olabat, dumaji detlot ritjmen bin pudum speyawan mani weya deibin abum. bat det widogel bin oni abum det dubala lilwan mani, en imbin pudum holot langa det mani boks, en im nomo garram enijing blanga baiyim daga na." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on."

kriol: enibodi hu tatjimbat detlot ting, im nomo klinbala blanga serramoni. wal im garra lafta washim im klos en abum bogi, en im garra jidan nomo klinbala blanga serramoni raidap sangodan.
english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kriol: wal det neksdei na jon beptis bin jandapbat deya langa det seim pleis garram dubala wekinmen blanga im,
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

kriol: wal wen det wekinmen blanga ilaija bin gobek det namba 7 taim imbin tok, "aibin luk wan lilwan klaud kaminap brom det solwoda. im oni lilwan jis laiga men bingga." ilaija bin dalim det wekinmen blanga im, "yu go deya langa king eiheb en dalim im blanga gedim im bagi en gobek langa im kemp bifo det rein stapam im."
english: On the seventh time, he said, "Behold, a small cloud, like a man's hand, is rising out of the sea." He said, "Go up, tell Ahab, 'Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn't stop you.'"

kriol: "wal yumob jinggabat na wotfo aibin kaman. ai nomo bin kaman blanga tjakidawei detlot lowa en ola wed weya detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga god bin raidimdan. aibin kaman blanga streitinimap det lowa brabliwei en blanga shoum yumob det trubala mining wanim god bin tok.
english: "Don't think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn't come to destroy, but to fulfill.

kriol: en olabat kaan larram enibodi dagat detlot ofring hu nomo lau blanga dagat detlot ofring. if dei dagat, wal dei garra jidan gilti en abum panishmen. mi na yawei det trubala god, en mi na meigim detlot ofring seikridwan.
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.'"

kriol: dumaji olabat na bin kilim ola pipul blanga yu, deibin meigim yu kantri nogudwan.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

kriol: if det king im brabli wail, im jis laik det laiyan wen yu meigimbat im wail. im mait kilim yu ded.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

kriol: bat ai dalim yumob. im garra kipum ola woning jis laik imbin kipum ola pramis.
english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you,

kriol: yawei, nomo jidan longwei brom mi. yu kaman kwikbala blanga album mi, en yu meigim mi jidan strongbala.
english: But don't be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

kriol: im nomo gud ting blanga shudum erro langa enibodi hu gopas langa yu, en im nomo gud ting blanga meigim detlot pipul hu nomo sabi enijing wek blanga yu du.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

kriol: "melabat bin askim detlot boswan blanga detlot pipul, hubin dalim olabat blanga bildimap det serramoni pleis en blanga pudum ebrijing deya.
english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, "Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?"

kriol: dei garra lukaftumbat ola seikridwan ting brom insaid det seikridwan tent, ebritaim ola isreil pipul garra shifdim olabat kemp langa najawan pleis.
english: "This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

kriol: yawei bin gibit wi dubala irriwol blanga irrimbat en dubala ai blanga lukinatbat.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.

kriol: "detlot wekinmen oldei go longwei andanith langa det graun weya ola igulok kaan luk en weya ola laiyan nomo sabi.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon's eye seen it.

kriol: wal wen det king bin tok lagijat, aisik bin gowei en imbin meigim kemp langa det pleis gulum gera beli weya im dedi eibrahem bin oldei jidanbat longtaim.
english: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

kriol: bigismob pipul oldei haidim olabat nogudbalawei brom najalot pipul, bat ai nomo dum lagijat. najing.
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

kriol: god, yubin gibit bekboun langa melabat, en yubin bidim melabat. yubin gitwail brabliwei langa melabat, bat melabat askim yu blanga kambek en meigim melabat yu ronwan pipul igin.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lily of the Covenant." A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

kriol: praise wal main braja en sista olabat, det bos blanga wi laigim yumob, en melabat garra oldei gibit theingks langa god blanga yumob, dumaji god bin pikimat yumob en ola najalot kristjan pipul basdam wen imbin meigim ebrijing, en imbin seibum yumob. det holi spirit blanga god bin kadimat yumob blanga im, en seimtaim yumob bin bilib det trubala wed blanga im.
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

kriol: det namba blanga ol detlot pipul hubin jidan prisana en hubin kambek bin 42,360. deibin bringimap najalot pipul garram olabat du, ola men en gelwan wekinmen - 7,337 en ola men en gelwan hubin oldei singsing - 200 ola hosis - 736 ola mul - 245 ola kemul - 435 ola dongki - 6,720.
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

kriol: en enibodi hubin kilim eni enimul blanga najawan men, wal im garra lafta gajim najawan enimul en gibitbek langa det men. tharran na dalim wi, det laif deigim pleis blanga det laif.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

kriol: bat jisas bin sabi wanim olabat bin jinggabat, en imbin dalim olabat, "if ola pipul langa eni traib kadimat miselp en fait gija, wal detlot pipul blanga det traib garra binijimap miselp. en if ola femili langa wan kemp kadimat miselp en fait gija, wal det femili garra binijimap miselp du.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

kriol: bat if yumob gin shoum mi giltiwan, wal ai garra lafta gibap en dai." lagijat na job bin tok.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.

kriol: en aibin dalim olabat hau god bin jidan garram mi en imbin album mi en aibin dalim olabat wanim det king bin dalim mi. wal deibin tok, "wi garra stat bildimap det wol igin." en deibin meigim miselp redi blanga wek.
english: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king's words that he had spoken to me. They said, "Let's rise up and build." So they strengthened their hands for the good work.

kriol: if yumob kaan lisin langa mi, wal mi garra kraikraibat sigridwei, dumaji yumob oldei jidanbat praudbalawei. ai garra kraikraibat brabli soribalawei, dumaji detlot enami bin deigimwei detlot pipul blanga yawei prisana na."
english: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh's flock has been taken captive.

kriol: bat pol bin dalim ol detlot solja, "if detlot boutmen ranawei, nomo enijing kaan seibum yumob."
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, "Unless these stay in the ship, you can't be saved."

kriol: yumob bin abum detmatj pein fo longtaim na, en mi na yawei, mi brabli wail detmatj. ola pipul langa najalot kantri bin oldei mokimbat yumob.
english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, 'The Lord Yahweh says: "Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations."

kriol: afta na det gel bin dalim semsan, "yubin tok yu laigim mi. bat yu nomo laigim mi, dumaji yu oldei dalim mi laiya. yubin meigim fan langa mi 3 taim, en yu nomo bin dalim mi wanim oldei meigim yu jidan strongbala."
english: She said to him, "How can you say, 'I love you,' when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies."

kriol: det king bin dalim ibadmelak blanga deigim 3 men blanga pulumap mi brom det wel bifo ai garra dai.
english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, "Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies."

kriol: en bambai yumob san olabat garra merrit langa detlot gel brom det kantri, en detlot gel garra deigidawei olabat brom mi, en dei garra bulurrum detlot drimin blanga olabat.
english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

kriol: bat det einjul bin tok, "yu gin kipgon garram dislot men, bat yu garra tok oni wanim ai dalim yu blanga tok." wal beilam bin kipgon garram olabat na.
english: Yahweh's angel said to Balaam, "Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you." So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok na, "det nogudbala ting garra kaman langa idam. im garra brabli nogudwan, en ebribodi hu garra wokpas deya garra hatjamp en bradin nomo lilbit.
english: "Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.

kriol: wal streidawei eriyak bin deigim denyul langa king nebakanesa en eriyak bin dalim det king, "brabli haibala bos, aibin faindim wanbala juwish men hu gin dalim yu det drim."
english: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: "I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation."

kriol: brom deya god bin meigim dubala pipul laik imselp. imbin meigim boiwan en gelwan,
english: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them.

kriol: wal det spirit blanga god bin jidan langa det wanbala solja gulum amasai. imbin jingat, "deibid san blanga jesi, melabat blanga yu wekinmen olabat, en melabat wandim yu blanga jidan brabli gudwan, en ol detlot hu albumbat yu du, dumaji god im jidan garram yu." lagijat na amasai bin tok. afta na imbin jidan boswan blanga detlot 30 solja. en deibid bin welkam detlot men en imbin meigim olabat boswan blanga ol im amimob.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, "We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you." Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

kriol: wal yumob garra laigim ola pipul brabliwei lagijat, dumaji yumob sabi wanim det taim. yumob sabi im taim blanga jinggabat en dumbat gudbala ting, dumaji det taim weya god garra seibum im pipul olabat im gulijap na. im nomo longtaim laik wen wibin bilib basdam.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

kriol: yunbala kaan dum lagijat, dumaji im brabli nogudwan stori tharran weya im spredat ebriweya langa ola pipul hu bulurrum yawei.
english: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make Yahweh's people disobey.

kriol: wen mi tok blanga jidan kwaitbalawei, olabat wandi fait.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

kriol: eltekei, gibathan, beilath,
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

kriol: en im waif bin gajim det drimin sheip weya imbin abum langa det haus, en imbin meigim det drimin sheip leidan langa im bed, en imbin gajim wan pila weya imbin meigim garram gout heya, en imbin pudum det heyapat langa det hed blanga det drimin sheip, en imbin gaburrumap det drimin sheip garram bleingkit.
english: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair at its head and covered it with clothes.

kriol: yu luk detlot hu nomo laigim yu! yu enami olabat gidap redi blanga fait.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

kriol: wal jeikob bin dalim im mami, "luk, mami. isau garram herriwan skin. mi klinwan skin nomo garram heya.
english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

kriol: wen eiheb bin luk langa im imbin tok, "yu iya na. yu na oldei meigimbat detmatj trabul iya langa isreil."
english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, "Is that you, you troubler of Israel?"

kriol: wal wen jisas bin luk olabat dumbat lagijat, imbin gajim sambala roup, en imbin meigim jis laiga wip, en imbin andimwei olabat garram ol detlot enimul, en imbin tipimoba detlot teibul en meigim detlot mani buldan ebriweya,
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers' money and overthrew their tables.

kriol: wal semyul bin tok, "nomeda yubin reken miselp basdam yu lobala, bat stil yu haibala langa ola isreil pipul na, dumaji yawei bin meigim yu jidan king blanga olabat,
english: Samuel said, "Though you were little in your own sight, weren't you made the head of the tribes of Israel? Yahweh anointed you king over Israel;

kriol: en imbin jidan boswan blanga ol detlot nogudwan solja weya bin oldei jidan langa bush kantri. dislot ting bin hepin afta deibid bin bidim heidadesa, en imbin kilim ded ola siriya solja, detlot fren blanga heidadesa. reson en im solja bin go jidan langa dameskas, weya deibin meigim im jidan det nyuwan king blanga siriya.
english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

kriol: en yumob garra jidan deya langa det seikridwan tent blanga yawei 7 dei, raidap yumob binij det serramoni blanga meigim yumob serramonimen.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

kriol: "wal im nogud blanga enibodi if im hipimapbat detmatj enijing blanga im ronselp iya langa dijan wel en im lujim im laif.
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

kriol: en minbala dedi nomo laigim minbala. minbala jidan jis laiga streinja langa im, en imbin selim minbala langa yu, en imbin weistimbat det mani langa im ronselp.
english: Aren't we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

kriol: dislot men bin ridim det buk garram ola lowa du, en afta deibin dalim detlot pipul wanim det lowa bin tok garram olabat ronwan langgus wulijim dei gin sabi wanim detlot serramonimen bin ridimat.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

kriol: sebenbala step bin gowap langa det geit langa det feswan rum weya olabat oldei gowin thru langa det longwan rum, en imbin feising langa det kotyad langa det serramoni pleis. ola pitja blanga detlot pamtri bin jidan langa det wol olawei langa det longwan rum.
english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

kriol: bat olabat nomo bin lisin en duwit langa mi. olabat bin stil kipgon olabat ronwei en dum nogudbala ting olataim. aibin dalim olabat blanga kipum det strongwan pramis, bat olabat nomo bin duwit. wal aibin bringimap langa olabat ola panishmen en ola nogudbala ting weya det strongwan pramis bin tok.
english: Yet they didn't obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn't do them.'"

kriol: yu garra deigim tenbala lilwan daga en sambala keik en botul garram shugabeig blanga im. yu garra askim im wanim garra hepin langa yunmi san abaija, en im garra dalim yu." lagijat na king jerabowam bin tok langa im waif.
english: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child."

kriol: en nomo fait langa enibodi o heidim im olagijawan. wal yumob garra laigim olabat laik yumob laigim miselp dumaji mi na yawei det trubala god blanga yumob.
english: "'You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

kriol: aibin meigim main pramis, dumaji olabat bin gibit bekboun langa main wed en deibin breigim main lowa en deibin rabishim det sebathdei, en deibin oldei wandim weship detlot drimin sheip.
english: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn't walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

kriol: ai kaan fil sori blanga yumob en ai kaan kain langa yumob. ai garra panishim yumob blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin dumbat wulijim yumob garra sabi mi na yawei det boswan god.
english: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.'

kriol: bat det namba 7 dei im sebathdei blanga main. yumob en yumob biginini olabat en yumob wekinmen en wekingel en ola enimul blanga yumob en eni streinja pipul hu jidan garram yumob, nobodi nomo lau blanga dum eni wek langa det sebathdei.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

kriol: if god wandim deigimbek wi laif,
english: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

kriol: yumob garra gibit detlot brabli gudwan ting langa yawei.
english: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.'

kriol: midulnait na yawei bin dalim gidiyan, "yu gidap na en go en fait langa detlot midiyan solja deya langa olabat kemp, en ai garra meigim yu bidim olabat.
english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, "Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

kriol: yu reken yu gin dalim detlot klaud blanga jandimdan bigmob rein,
english: "Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

kriol: en wi sabi im garra gibit wi det ting weya wi askim im, dumaji wi sabi im oldei irrim wi wen wi askim im.
english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

kriol: en deya na yu garra deigimat det serramoni klos brom eran en pudum langa eliyeisa, dumaji deya na eran garra dai." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there."

kriol: en deibin jinggabat wanim mosis en eran bin dalim olabat basdam, en deibin go en askim detlot ijip pipul blanga klos en enijing weya deibin meigim garram gol en silba,
english: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.

kriol: brom deya imbin deigim wanbala damba nomo garram raising brom det baskit weya deibin gibit langa yawei. wanbala damba deibin meigim garram oliboil, en wanbala biskit. imbin pudum detlot ontop langa det fet en det raidensaid bekleig.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

kriol: det lilboi blanga yu garra jidan jis laiga wailwan dongki, en im kaan laigim ebribodi, en ebribodi kaan laigim im du, en im kaan jidan gudwei garram im braja olabat." lagijat na det einjul bin tok.
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers."

kriol: wal dijan na det femili lain weya bin kamat brom geshan. olabat neim bin libnai, jeihath, sima, jowa, ido, sera, en jetharai.
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

kriol: wen ilaija bin irrim det sambodi tok, imbin gaburrumap im feis garram im kout en imbin kamat en jandap lida langa det keib. det sambodi bin tok langa im, "ilaija wanim yu dumbat iya?"
english: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

kriol: metanaiya bin det san blanga mika en grensan blanga seibdai brom det femili lain blanga eisaf. imbin det lida blanga detlot singamob hubin sing detlot song blanga preya en gibitbat theingks langa det serramoni pleis. bekbakaiya bin jidan sekan bos langa metanaiya. ebda bin det san blanga shamuwa en grensan blanga geilal brom det femili lain blanga jedathan.
english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

kriol: en yumob garra gibit ol detlot najalot ofring weya yumob bin gibit langa det feswan dei.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kriol: olabat pudum olabat rutpat raidaran langa rok.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

kriol: orait ai wandi tok dijan na. det titja bin jidan klebabala, en imbin kipgon dalimbat ola pipul wanim imbin sabi. en imbin jinggabat ol detlot gudwan wed brabli adbalawei, en imbin trai faindat en sabi loda ting langa dijan laif en detlot gudwan wed, en brom deya imbin raidimdan gudwei.
english: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

english: "Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

kriol: wal wandei koniliyas bin abum drim aftanuntaim, en langa det drim imbin luk wan einjul blanga god bin kaman langa im, en det einjul bin jingat, "koniliyas!"
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, "Cornelius!"

kriol: en det rait taim blanga lukabat enijing, en det rait taim nomo blanga lukabat enijing, en det rait taim blanga seibum ebrijing, en det rait taim blanga tjakidawei ebrijing,
english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

kriol: en detlot wekinmen bin go en weikimap jisas, "bos! yu seibum melabat! wi garra dai na!"
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, "Save us, Lord! We are dying!"

kriol: im oldei meigim faiya kamat brom im mawus.
english: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

kriol: bat stil god kaan irrim langa praudbala en nogudbala pipul wen dei prei.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

kriol: en nobodi kaan hipimap en deigidawei eni sid daga.
english: with which the reaper doesn't fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

english: For if you turn again to Yahweh, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because Yahweh your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him."

kriol: ol detlot pipul hu album ola powan pipul, olabat na garra jidan gudbinjiwei. yawei garra album olabat wen olabat abum trabul.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

kriol: "ai garra gibit yumob bigmob woda blanga yumob draiwan kantri, en ai garra gibit main spirit langa ol yumob bigininimob.
english: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

kriol: if eni femili blanga yu dai deya langa det taun, ola dog garra dagat detlot bodi blanga olabat, en if olabat dai deya langa opin kantri, ola bard gulum boltja garra dagat detlot bodi blanga olabat.' lagijat na yawei bin tok."
english: The dogs will eat he who belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field, for Yahweh has spoken it."'

kriol: trubala aibin irrim main pipul jinginat, en aibin luk hau detlot ijip pipul oldei meigimbat olabat nogudbinji.
english: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.

kriol: bat wen ahija bin irrim im kaminap insaid langa det dowa imbin tok, "kaman insaid. ai sabi yu blanga king jerabowam waif. wotfo yu meigim miselp laik najawan gel? ai garram nogudwan nyus blanga dalim yu.
english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, "Come in, Jeroboam's wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

kriol: wal king sol bin abum thribala san neim jonathan, ishbai en melkishuwa, en imbin abum dubala doda du. det bigwan gel bin neim merab, en det yangwan gel bin neim mikal.
english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

kriol: en langa ebri taun deya langa juda imbin meigim detlot pleis blanga weshipbat ola drimin brom najalot kantri. wal ol dislot ting bin meigim yawei det god blanga im grengrenfathamob brabli wail.
english: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers, to anger.

kriol: imbin luk jis laik detlot kala blanga det reinbo, en aibin sabi im na yawei. wal wen aibin luk im, aibin pudumdan main feis langa graun en streidawei aibin irrim sambodi bin tok langa mi.
english: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of Yahweh's glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.

kriol: "wal main biginini, yu garra lisin langa yu mami en dedi, wanim dubala dalimbat yu.
english: My son, listen to your father's instruction, and don't forsake your mother's teaching;

kriol: "god bin dum ola brabli klebabala ting en wibin luk im pawa. im garram loda pawa blanga dum klebabala ting! god na jidan king, en im na garra jidan bos olagijawan.
english: How great are his signs! How mighty are his wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. His dominion is from generation to generation.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok, "orait, yu gin meigim job abum detmatj pein if yu wandim dum lagijat, bat yu nomo kilim im ded." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, "Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life."

kriol: wal wen johanan en ol im ami lidamob bin irrim blanga det nogudwan ting wanim ishmeil bin dum,
english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

kriol: bat sambala nogudbala men nomo bin laigim sol, en deibin tok, "dis men kaan album wi!" en dei nomo bin gibit im eni gudwan ting seimwei laik ola najalot pipul bin dum. bat sol nomo bin tok enijing blanga olabat. imbin jis larramgo olabat.
english: But certain worthless fellows said, "How could this man save us?" They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.

kriol: im garra jidan laik det men hu jidan wansaid langa det faiya en wotjim det silba raidap det faiya meigim im gudwan. im garra jidan garram detlot libai serramonimen en im garra meigim olabat klin brom ol detlot nogudbalawei blanga olabat. jis laik det men hu kipgon pudumbat wud langa det faiya raidap det silba o gol jidan brabli klinwan, wal im garra kipgon meigimbat ola libai serramonimen gudwan raidap dei bringimap ofring langa mi raitwei.
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to Yahweh offerings in righteousness.
