english: Yahweh will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

kriol: bat detlot laiyawan titja oldei tok nogudbalawei blanga olkain ting weya dei nomo sabi, dumaji olabat jis laiga wailwan enimul weya men oldei lukabat en kilimbat. dei dumbat enijing weya det filing blanga olabat wandim. bat ai dalim yumob. god garra gajim olabat en binijimap olabat jis laik det hanta weya im gajim det wailwan enimul en kilim im ded, dumaji god garra peiyimbek olabat en gibit olabat trabul blanga detlot trabul weya dei oldei gibit enibodi.
english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

kriol: ai oldei kipgon jinggabat lagijat, en mi brabli nogudbinji.
english: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

kriol: jerusalem im oldei jidan miselp kantri, en ola pipul deya oldei jinggabat det gudwan laif weya deibin oldei abumbat bifo. wen loda enami bin kaman nobodi bin deya blanga album olabat. detlot hubin bidim olabat bin oldei laflafbat langa olabat.
english: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.

kriol: afta na detlot men bin kambek langa det king en olabat bin tok langa im, "haibala bos, yu sabi det lowa yubin meigim blanga det dubala kantri gulum midiya en pesha en nobodi kaan tjeinjim eni oda weya yubin meigim."
english: Then these men assembled together to the king, and said to the king, "Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed."

kriol: en langa det taim na yawei garra tok blanga im gudwan greip fam, "wi garra singim song blanga detlot brabli gudwan daga langa detlot greiptri.
english: In that day, sing to her, "A pleasant vineyard!

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim olabat, "god bin jandim mi iya, en ai wandi dum wanim im wandim mi blanga dum, en ai wandi binijim det wek blanga im, dumaji tharran na jis laik main daga.
english: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

kriol: afta na jisas bin tok, "yu irrim mi na! ai garra kaman dregli. en detlot pipul hu lisin langa ola bambaiwan wed langa dijan stori garra jidan brabli gudbinjiwei."
english: "Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."

kriol: wal ola kristjan wekinmen hu jidan laiga prisana garra jinggabat olabat bos gudbalawei en shoum rispek langa olabat, dumaji wi nomo wandim enibodi tok nogudbalawei blanga det neim blanga god, en wi nomo wandim enibodi blanga rabishim det trubala wed weya wi lenimbat miselp.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

kriol: bat yubin dalim melabat if melabat nomo bringimbek im, wal wi kaan kambek langa yu igin.
english: You said to your servants, 'Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.'

kriol: wal filip bin galimap langa det bagi, en imbin luk det stori weya det men bin ridimbat, en det stori bin tok, "im nomo bin tok enijing. imbin jidan kwaitbala, jis laik det ship weya sambodi lidimbat im langa det yad blanga dai. en imbin jidan kwaitbala jis laik det lilwan ship wen olabat kadim im wuliwan heya.
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, "He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn't open his mouth.

kriol: wal beilak bin tok langa beilam, "yu nomo bin wandim singim detlot isreil pipul, bat yu kaan bekimap olabat en tok gudbalawei langa olabat." lagijat na beilak bin tok.
english: Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all."

kriol: "hu dijan weya gidap jis laik det nail riba wen im jidan bigwan fladwoda?
english: "Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?

kriol: langa det kantri weya yumob garra jidan bos, deya na yumob garra breigimdan ola weship pleis weya detlot najalot pipul oldei weship olabat drimin sheip deya ontop langa haiwan en lilwan hil en andanith langa ola sheidiwan tri.
english: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

kriol: olabat nomo wori langa olabat kemp, en god nomo panishim olabat.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin tok langa mi,
english: Yahweh's word came to me, saying,

kriol: wen yu album yu rileishan im garra kipum yu seif jis laik bigwan wol kipum det taun seifwan, bat if yu agamin langa im, wal im kaan album yu, najing.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

kriol: brom deya ilaisha bin go langa detlot solja en imbin tok, "yumob langa rong roud. dijan nomo det taun weya yumob lukabat. yumob bulurrum mi en ai garra shoum yumob det pleis weya det men hu yumob lukabat im jidan." en imbin lidim olabat langa sameriya.
english: Elisha said to them, "This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek." He led them to Samaria.

kriol: bat yumob wotjim miselp en nomo larram enijing deigimwei yumob brom yawei blanga weshipbat en bulurrumbat eni drimin.
english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

kriol: wal wen ebribodi bin luk det gel bodi lagijat, deibin ol tok, "wi nomo bin luk diskain ting bifo, en wi nomo bin irrim enijing du. brom det taim weya wi grengrenfatha olabat bin gowei brom ijip raidap tudei wi nomo bin luk enijing lagijat bifo. najing. wal wi garra jinggabat dijan nogudbala ting weya bin hepin, en wi garra lafta dum samting blanga tharran."
english: It was so, that all who saw it said, "Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak."

kriol: if wi kipgon jidanbat laibala afta god panishim wi, wal wi kaan tok nogudbalawei blanga im.
english: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

kriol: wal eran bin tok, "yumob pulumat ola golwan ring brom yumob waif en san en doda weya dei werrimbat langa olabat irriwol, en yumob bringimap detlot ring langa mi."
english: Aaron said to them, "Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me."

kriol: wal jisas bin andimwei ol detlot nogudbala spirit brom det men, en imbin jandim olabat langa detlot bigibigi. det namba blanga detlot bigibigi bin 2,000, en detlot nogudbala spirit bin gowin insaid langa detlot bigibigi, en deibin meigim detlot bigibigi randan langa det klif, en deibin buldan langa det bigwan woda, en deibin ol draun.
english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

kriol: "wal nomeda tudei ola pipul langa ebri kantri bulurrumbat olabat ronwan drimin, bat stil wi garra bulurrum yawei det trubala god blanga wi olagijawan." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

kriol: wi kaan dumbat ola nogudbala ting, dumaji wen yumob gibit miselp langa sambodi blanga duwit langa im, yumob meigim miselp wekinmen blanga im. yu si? if yu meigim miselp wekinmen blanga det nogudbalawei, wal det nogudbalawei meigim yu dai. bat if yu meigim miselp wekinmen blanga god en duwit langa im, wal im meigim yu jidan raitwei langa im.
english: Don't you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

kriol: en yumob kaan slekbek, dumaji if yumob bulurrum mi olawei, wal god garra seibum yumob.
english: "By your endurance you will win your lives.

kriol: brom tudei na oni det libai klen garra maindimbat det seikridwan tent, en olabat na garra jidan boswan. dijan na det brabliwan lowa ai gibit langa yumob en yumob bigininimob. det libai klen kaan abum eni kantri langa isreil.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

kriol: pipul nomo laigim detlot silibala pipul hu oldei jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbala ting.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

kriol: en deibin oldei breigimbat olabat pramis, en deibin oldei meigimbat olkain nogudwan pramis du, en deibin oldei kotim enibodi nogudbalawei, en deibin go mowa nogudbala jis laik det nogudwan gras weya gro langa gadin en weya kaan larram det gudwan daga kamat.
english: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.

kriol: wal olawei langa det roud deibid bin jinggabat lagijat, "wotfo aibin maindimbat ola enijing blanga det men iya langa dijan deset kantri? aibin gudbala langa im, en nobodi bin stilim enijing blanga im. bat im nomo bin peiyimbek mi gudbalawei.
english: Now David had said, "Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.

kriol: "en detlot najalot pipul garra lafta preisim detlot pipul blanga yawei, dumaji im panishim detlot najalot pipul hubin kilim ded im pipul olabat. yawei garra meigim detlot enami pei, en im garra meigimbat im pipul olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei."
english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

kriol: yawei, det solwoda jinginat adbalawei jis laik thanda. im jinginat nomo lilbit.
english: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

kriol: "mi na det boswan god, en trubala ai dalim yu. yu nomo lau toktokbat detlot seimwan wed langa isreil enimo.
english: "As I live," says the Lord Yahweh, "you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

kriol: ola kantrimen bin gibit olabat loda enijing. deibin gibit olabat silbawan enijing, gol, daga, enimul blanga garrimap ola enijing en blanga yusum blanga ola serramoni, en najalot gudwan enijing en ofring blanga det serramoni pleis.
english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

kriol: "ol detlot grashopa garra binijimap ebrijing jis laiga faiya barnimap ola gadin. det kantri luk brabli purdiwan lida langa detlot grashopa. im jidan jis laik det gadin gulum idin. bat wen detlot grashopa garra go thru langa det kantri, im garra jidan jis laiga draiwan deset kantri. en nomo enijing kaan gro weya detlot grashopa garra jidan.
english: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.

kriol: en deibin tjakam im langa det draiwan wel.
english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

kriol: "bambai wen yumob jidan langa det kantri weya yawei garra gibit yumob maitbi yumob irrim nyus brom wanbala taun, hau sambodi bin dum nogudbala ting langa yawei en imbin breigim det brabli strongwan pramis blanga yawei
english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God's sight in transgressing his covenant,

kriol: bat yu na yawei, yu gin larram olabat bigininimob jidan hanggribala raidap olabat dai, en larram olabat gitkil brom faitfaitbat. larram ol detlot wuman lujim olabat hasbin en bigininimob. larram ola men dai brom nogudwan siknis, en detlot yangmen gin gitkil brom faitfaitbat.
english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives become childless and widows. Let their men be killed and their young men struck by the sword in battle.

kriol: nomo gibit yumob biginini blanga sekrifais ofring langa det drimin gulum molek, dumaji tharran meigim mi brabli nogudbinji.
english: "'You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

kriol: oni langa god na mi oldei trastimbat. mi bilib oni langa im wanbala.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

kriol: en wen dubala faindim det feswan san, wal im garra jidan san blanga det dedbala men, en im garra abum im femili lain kipgon olawei deya langa isreil.
english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

kriol: en langa det taim na, detlot pipul hubin jidanbat defwan longtaim garra irrim sambodi ridimbat langa olabat, en detlot pipul hubin oldei jidanbat blainwan garra luk gudwei.
english: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

kriol: en wen imbin kamat langa det jampap langa det hil gulum heres, imbin grebum wanbala yangmen deya brom det taun gulum sukait, en imbin askimbat im olkain kwestjan, en det yangmen bin raidimdan ola neim blanga det 77 men hubin jidan bos langa det taun.
english: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

kriol: wal mosis bin go langa det king, en imbin tok, "yawei det trubala god bin dalim mi im garra go ebriweya langa dijan kantri midulnait,
english: Moses said, "This is what Yahweh says: 'About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,

kriol: wal deibid bin tok, "wal yu dalim mi wanim bin hepin." wal det men bin tok, "detlot filastain solja bin kilim bigismob solja blanga wi ded, en ola najalot solja blanga wi bin ranawei brom det fait. en detlot filastain solja bin kilim king sol en im san jonathan ded du."
english: David said to him, "How did it go? Please tell me." He answered, "The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also."

kriol: afta na sambala serramonimen gulum ferasi bin kaman langa jisas, en deibin tok, "yu lafta gowei brom iya en go samweya, dumaji det gabman bos neim herod wandi kilim yu."
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, "Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you."

kriol: en yumob jinggabat det dubala taun gulum sadam en gamora. ol detlot pipul bin brabli nogudbala pipul, en god bin barnimap det dubala taun, en imbin binijimap ol detlot pipul, en imbin dum lagijat blanga shoum ola nogudbala pipul wanim garra hepin langa olabat.
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

kriol: bat if det wed im nogudwan, wal yumob kaan teiknodis en duwit langa det wed.
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

kriol: ailibala neksdei na jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin gobek langa det seim roud blanga go langa jerusalem, en deibin luk det tri nomo garram daga bin draiyap. holbit det tri bin draiyap.
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

kriol: ai garra dalimbat blanga det haibalawei blanga yu, main god, en main king, ai garra gibitbat theingks langa yu olagijawan.
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

kriol: "wotfo yunbala bin bringimap melabat blanga meigim melabat dai iya langa dijan deset kantri nomo garram daga? melabat bin abum loda bif en olkain daga deya langa ijip. mobeda yawei det trubala god bina meigim melabat dai deya."
english: and the children of Israel said to them, "We wish that we had died by Yahweh's hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger."

kriol: wal job bin kipgon tok, "wotfo det boswan god nomo irrim en ensim mi? if aibin dum enijing rong, wal larram god shoum mi, en larram im raidimdan langa peipa.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

kriol: wal blanga 40 yiya detlot isreil pipul bin oldei dagadagat det daga gulum mena. deibin dagat det daga raidap deibin go en jidan langa det kantri gulum keinan.
english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

kriol: en wen jisas bin lukbek, imbin luk dubala bulurrumbat im, en imbin tok langa dubala, "wanim yunbala wandim?" wal dubala bin tok, "rebai, weya yu oldei kemp?" lagijat na garram dubala langgus dubala bin gulum im rebai. bat garram det grik langgus det wed im tok titja.
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, "What are you looking for?" They said to him, "Rabbi" (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), "where are you staying?"

kriol: brom deya jonathan bin galimap ontop langa det hil. imbin lafta yusum im bingga en fut blanga galimap det hil, dumaji imbin stipwan, en det wekinmen blanga im bin bulurrum biyain langa im du, en wen dubala bin kamat langa top, jonathan bin nokamdan detlot solja, en det wekinmen bin kilim olabat ded.
english: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.

kriol: wal mi nomo sheim blanga det gudnyus, dumaji det gudnyus na det pawa blanga god weya im oldei yusumbat blanga seibumbat detlot pipul hu bilib langa det gudnyus. imbin gibit det gudnyus langa ola juwish pipul basdam, en afta det gudnyus bin kamat langa ola jintail pipul.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

kriol: afta na deibid bin dalim ebishai en ola najalot boswan wekinmen blanga im, "yumob kaan hatjamp langa dis men wen im tok nogudbalawei langa mi. yumob garra hatjamp langa main ronwan san, dumaji im na wandi kilim mi ded. dis men nomo brom main ron klen. im brom det benjamin klen. en yumob kaan jinggabat im. yumob garra jis larramgo im, dumaji yawei det trubala god bin jandim im blanga tok nogudbalawei langa mi.
english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, "Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for Yahweh has invited him.

kriol: "preisim yawei hubin meigim im pipul olabat jidan gudwei, jis laik wen imbin pramis. imbin kipum ola gudwan pramis imbin meigim thru langa im wekinmen mosis.
english: "Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

kriol: bambai na jeikob bin gibit dijan wed langa im san olabat, "mi filim miselp gulijap dai na. wal afta wen ai garra dai, yumob garra pudum main bodi langa det keib weya deibin pudum detlot bodi blanga main dedi en main grenfatha olabat bifo.
english: He instructed them, and said to them, "I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

kriol: imbin binijimap detlot teibul blanga ofring en serramoni pleis blanga detlot drimin blanga najalot pipul. imbin smeshimap detlot stonwan drimin sheip, en kadimdan detlot seikridwan pol deibin yusum blanga weshipbat det gelwan drimin gulum eshara.
english: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

kriol: yumob kaan meigim miselp haibala blanga jidan garram mi. if yumob wandi jidan haibala garram mi, wal yumob garra meigim miselp lobala jis laik dijan lilwan biginini iya.
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kriol: weya olabat garra jidan prisana. deya na olabat garra jinggabat mi na en sabi aibin panishim olabat en meigim olabat brabli sheim miselp, dumaji deibin oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip. olabat garra brabli sheim miselp du, dumaji deibin dumbat detlot brabli nogudbala ting.
english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

kriol: wal streidawei jisas bin sabi pawa bin kamat brom im, en imbin tenim miselp, en imbin lukaran langa detlot pipul, en imbin askim olabat, "hubin tatjim mi?"
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, "Who touched my clothes?"

kriol: "wal if det wuman bin silipsilip garram najawan men, wal det woda garra meigim im abum loda pein, en im kaan abum eni biginini, en im neim garra jidan nogudbala langa im ronwan kantrimen olabat.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

kriol: wal brom ol detlot boswan serramonimen aibin pikimat det dubala men neim sherebaiya en hashabaiya en 10 men brom det dubala femili.
english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

kriol: bat wanbala ting deya maitbi yumob nomo sabi. yumob nomo sabi hau blanga shoum rispek langa sebis. yumob irrim mi na. jisas krais im bos blanga ola men, en ola hasbin olabat bos blanga olabat waif, en god im bos blanga jisas krais.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

kriol: en wen sisera bin kamat langa det kemp, det waif blanga hiba neim jeiyel bin go atsaid brom im tent blanga midim sisera, en imbin dalim im, "yu kaan bradin. yu gowin insaid langa main tent." en imbin gowin insaid langa det tent, en det gel bin blandim im deya biyain langa kaliko.
english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, "Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don't be afraid." He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

kriol: bat dijan iya lilwan san blanga yu bin weistimbat ola enijing blanga yu langa ola nogudbala yanggel. en wen imbin kambek, yubin kilim det gudwan gabigabi blanga im.' lagijat na det bigwan san bin tok.
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.'

kriol: wal det gel bin tok, "nomo, bos. mi nomo drangginwan. mi nomo bin dringgimbat enijing. mi brabli nogudbinji dijan, en aibin toktok langa yawei blanga ola trabul weya mi garram.
english: Hannah answered, "No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.

kriol: wal elifas bin kipgon tok, "job yu garra jidan gudbinjiwei. nomeda god det brabli haibalawan bin panishim yu, bat stil yu garra jidan hepiwan. im mait meigim yu abumbat pein en ardimbat detmatj, bat im garra bendijimap en meigim yu sowa gudwan.
english: "Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

kriol: "wal sambala pipul brabli wikitwan en dei oldei goran ebriweya en dalimbat laiya.
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

kriol: wal yumob garra jinggabat det gudnyus weya yumob bin irrim basdam, en yumob garra meiksho yumob abum det gudnyus insaid langa yumob hat, dumaji if yumob abum det gudnyus insaid langa yumob hat, wal yumob garra oldei jidan joinap garram det san en det dedi.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

english: The other disciples therefore said to him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe."

kriol: garram det silba dei garra gajim det seikridwan daga, det sid daga blanga gibit det sid daga ofring ebridei, detlot enimul blanga kilim en barnimap langa det sekrifais serramoni ebridei, en detlot seikridwan ofring blanga det serramoni blanga det sebathdei, en detlot serramoni weya melabat abum ebri manth en ebriyiya. garram det silba dei garra baiyim detlot enimul weya dei garra kilim blanga meigim melabat ola isreil pipul fri brom melabat nogudbalawei, en enijing weya dei wandim blanga det serramoni pleis.
english: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

kriol: en wen enijing ardim wanbala pat langa wi bodi, ola najalot pat garra filim det pein du. en im seimwei du wen enijing meigim wanbala pat langa wi bodi brabli gudwan, ola najalot pat garra filim miselp gudwan du.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

kriol: brom deya imbin deigim im pipul olabat jis laiga stakmen en imbin deigim olabat thru det deset kantri.
english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, "Where is Yahweh your God?" My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

kriol: job, if ai bina yu, ai bina askim god blanga album mi.
english: "But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

kriol: yawei bin tok langa detlot doda blanga selafad, 'yumob gin merrit langa eni men brom yumob ronwan klen.'
english: This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, 'Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

kriol: wal dijan na det wanbala ting aibin faindat. god bin meigim pipul jidan garram streitbala main, bat pipul bin tjeinjim ebrijing.
english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions."

kriol: yu wandim god garra meigim dijan kantri jidan nomo garram eni rein en nomo garram eni daga fo thribala yiya? o yu wandim god garra meigim detlot enamimob kaman iya en meigim yu ranawei fo thribala mants? o yu wandim god garra meigim bigiswan siknis kaman langa dijan kantri fo thribala deis? yu garra jinggabat detlot thribala ting na, en yu garra dalim mi wujan yu wandim mi blanga dalim yawei blanga dum."
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh's angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.'"

kriol: if ai bina trai blanga lidimap main bingga en yusum main pawa rongwei langa kothaus blanga ardimbat eni biginini hu nomo garram mami o dedi,
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

kriol: en if detlot gel dedi en braja olabat kaman langa yumob en askim yumob blanga pulumat detlot gel brom yumob, wal yumob garra tok, 'yumob larram melabat abum olabat, dumaji melabat nomo bin fait langa yumob blanga deigidawei olabat brom yumob. en yumob nomo bin breigim det pramis blanga yumob, dumaji yumob nomo bin gibit olabat langa melabat.'" lagijat na detlot boswan bin tok langa detlot benjamin men.
english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, 'Grant them graciously to us, because we didn't take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.'"

kriol: "ol yumob pipul hu oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip, yumob garra tok gija en dalim miselp, nomo wori!
english: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, "Be strong!"

kriol: en dei garra meigim sebenbala lemp en ola oil en enijing blanga detlot lemp en wanbala pol blanga holdimap detlot lemp,
english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

kriol: mi na det sain blanga yumob en yumob garra dum ebrijing wanim aibin dumbat. en wen im hepin lagijat yumob garra sabi yawei na det boswan god." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.'"'"

kriol: wal josef bin dalim olabat, "yumob kaman iya gulijap langa mi." en wen deibin kaman gulijap langa im, imbin kipgon tok langa olabat, "mi na braja blanga yumob. mi josef. mi na det braja blanga yumob weya yumob bin selim langa detlot najalot pipul. deibin deigim mi iya langa dijan kantri na.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, "Come near to me, please." They came near. He said, "I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

kriol: jeikob bin deigim sebyulan det najawan san blanga im garram im thribala boi neim sered, ilan en jaliyel.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

kriol: "wal wotfo yumob kaan jinggabat ol dislot ting weya im hepin langa yumob?
english: "This is what Yahweh of Armies says: 'Consider your ways.

kriol: if sambodi kilim ded sambodi hu nomo im enami en im nomo bin wandi kilim im, wal im gin ranawei langa wanbala seifwan taun.
english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn't hate him in time past—

kriol: en god garra meigim sambodi brom yu ron femili garra meigim trabul langa yu. trubala dis ting garra hepin langa yu. en yu garra sabi im trubala det taim na wen yu luk god deigidawei yu waif olabat en gibit olabat langa najawan men, en det men garra silipsilip garram olabat, en ebribodi garra sabi im silipsilip garram olabat.
english: "This is what Yahweh says: 'Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

kriol: wal ilai bin askim im na, "wanim yawei bin dalim yu? nomo blandim enijing brom mi. yu dalim mi ebrijing. if yu kaan dalim mi, wal god garra panishim yu brabliwei."
english: He said, "What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don't hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you."

kriol: en wi gin jandap strongbala lida langa god, dumaji wi sabi im oldei irrim wi wen wi askim im blanga enijing weya im wandim wi blanga abum.
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

kriol: wal sambala femili blanga det femili gulum kohath bin abum sambala taun en gudwan kantri blanga buligi en ship brom det ifreiyim klen. deibin gedim shekam, det seifwan taun langa det hil kantri blanga ifreiyim, gisa, jomiyam, betharan, ejalan en geriman. en langa det kantri blanga det sangodanwei manesa klen deibin abum dubala taun gulum eina en biliyam en det gudwan kantri blanga buligi en ship gulijap langa dubala taun.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

kriol: wal hushai det gudfren blanga deibid bin duwit langa im, en imbin gobek langa jerusalem, en imbin kamat langa det taun seimtaim weya ebsalom bin kamat deya.
english: So Hushai, David's friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

kriol: langa ebri kantri en ebri taun en langa ol detlot najalot pleis weya det wed blanga det king bin go, ola juwish pipul bin brabli gudbinji detmatj. deibin dagat daga mijamet en deibin brabli gudbinji. brom deya najamob pipul bin go langa detlot juwish lidamob, dumaji deibin wandim meigim miselp juwish pipul du, dumaji deibin brabli bradin blanga detlot juwish pipul na.
english: In every province and in every city, wherever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

kriol: yu en eran garra luk detlot geshan femili garra dum det wek en garrimap ebrijing wanim eran en im sanmob dalim olabat.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

kriol: wen detlot enimul bin oldei mub, wal detlot wil du bin oldei mub garram olabat en wen detlot enimul bin lidimap miselp brom graun en gowap langa top, wal detlot wil bin oldei dum det seimwan ting du.
english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

kriol: wal wi garra gibit theingks langa god det dedi blanga jisas krais det bos blanga wi, dumaji imbin brabli kain langa wi, en imbin gibit wi nyubala laif wen imbin meigim jisas krais gidap laibala brom dedbala, en blanga tharran na wi sabi trubala wi garra gedim ol detlot ting weya god garram deya langa hebin blanga im pipul olabat, en wi sabi detlot ting kaan go nogudwan en binij. dei garra jidan olagijawan. praise
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

kriol: olabat gin dum gudbala ting, en olabat oldei jidan brabli strongbala,
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

kriol: "yu garra bringimap det libai klen en meigim olabat wekinmen blanga eran.
english: "Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

kriol: ai garra jinggabat ebrijing yubin oldei dum. ai garra jinggabat olataim blanga ebrijing yubin oldei dumbat garram yu strongbalawan pawa.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

kriol: yawei bin irrim olabat en imbin album olabat blanga fait langa detlot keinanait pipul. wal detlot isreil pipul bin bidim detlot keinanait pipul, en deibin binijimap olabat, en olabat taun, en deibin gulum det pleis homa.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

kriol: wal im brabli wail na, jis laik det stom weya kaman garram bigwan win, en det win im brabli strongwan langa detlot nogudbala pipul,
english: Behold, Yahweh's storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.

kriol: ola powan pipul kaan oldei jidan rabishwan. dei weidabat blanga god blanga album olabat. god kaan larram olabat blanga jidanbat lagijat enimo.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

english: "The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many days to come."

english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

english: Yahweh said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

english: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for Yahweh's house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in Yahweh's house continually all the days of Jehoiada.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok langa mi, "yu garra luk olabat dum mowa brabli nogudbala ting iya."
english: He said also to me, "You will again see more of the great abominations which they do."

english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

english: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

english: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

english: I will cause it to go out," says Yahweh of Armies, "and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones."

kriol: "wal wen det taim garra kaman, yawei garra blowim det wisul en detlot ami garra kaman brom ijip wulijim flai, en detlot ami brom asiriya wulijim shugabeig flai.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

kriol: bat god nomo bin larram enibodi ardimbat olabat. imbin oldei dalim detlot boswan king.
english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "Didn't you hate me, and drive me out of my father's house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?"

kriol: brom deya jeftha bin gobek langa im haus deya langa mispa, en wen imbin kamat langa im haus, feswan imbin luk im doda bin kamat brom det haus blanga midim im. det gel bin pleiyimbat det lilwan dram gulum tembarin, en imbin dens olawei,
english: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

kriol: en mi askim det trubala wekinmen main deya blanga album det dubala olgamen, dumaji dubala bin oldei adwek garram mi wen aibin spredimat det gudnyus. dubala bin wek garram det wekinmen blanga mi neim klimint en garram ol detlot najalot wekinmen main deya, en god bin raidimdan olabat neim langa det buk blanga im weya im garram ola neim blanga detlot pipul hu garram det brabliwan laif.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

kriol: detlot pipul nomo bin trubala langa olabat king. dei nomo bin laigim im. bat deibin haidim detlot filing blanga olabat jis laik det hotwan tjakol weya im barnbarn andanith langa ola eshis. olnait det tjakol jidan hotwan andanith langa detlot eshis, en ailibala wen im rait taim blanga gugum daga, dei opinimap detlot eshis en det hotwan tjakol meigim miselp faiya na.
english: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat na. wen yu pudum lilbit raising langa flauwa, im meigim det daga raisap holbit. en im lagijat du langa yumob laif. if yumob lisin langa det sambodi hubin stapam yumob, wal yumob laif garra go nogud holbit.
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

kriol: "wal wen men o gel abum sowa langa hed o langa feis,
english: "When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

english: Don't listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?

kriol: wal ai sabi yu oldei bulurrumbat det trubalawan wed, en wen sambala kristjan braja en sista blanga yunmi bin kaman iya, deibin dalim mi yu stil kipgon bulurrumbat det trubalawan wed brabliwei, en det nyus bin meigim mi brabli gudbinji. en im oldei meigim mi brabli gudbinji wen mi irrim detkain nyus blanga ol detlot kristjan pipul hu jidan jis laik main ronwan biginini olabat.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

kriol: wal detlot pipul bin tok, "nomo. yu nomo bin dum enijing rong. yu nomo bin gibit melabat adtaim en pulumat enijing brom enibodi."
english: They said, "You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone's hand."

kriol: brom deya aibin lisin sambodi bin tok langa mi brom hebin, "yu raidimdan dijan. brom tudei na ola kristjan pipul hu dai, dumaji olabat wekinmen blanga jisas krais garra brabli gudbinji nomo lilbit." wal det holi spirit bin tok na, "trubala dijan. detlot pipul garra abum brabli gudwan spel, dumaji god sabi wanim olabat bin dumbat blanga im, en im garra peiyimbek olabat."
english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Write, 'Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.'" "Yes," says the Spirit, "that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them."

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "yumob garra duwit langa detlot lowa aibin titjimbat yumob. if yumob dum lagijat yumob gin teikoba det kantri weya yawei det trubala god, det god blanga wi grengrenfathamob gibitbat yumob.
english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.

kriol: nomeda dei tok mi god blanga olabat en olabat sabi mi, bat stil deibin tjakidawei ola gudbala ting. en blanga tharran na detlot enami blanga olabat garra ranimap olabat.
english: They cry to me, 'My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!'

kriol: en deya na wen josef en meri bin deigim det lilboi blanga det serramoni, det olmen bin gajim det lilboi, en imbin holdim im garram im bingga, en imbin gibit theingks langa god.
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

kriol: "'wal god na bin pikimat dijan kantri blanga im pipul olabat, en imbin meigim olabat jidan iya na, en dei garra jidan gudbalawei olagijawan. dei kaan jidan wekinmen blanga najalot pipul enimo. en nomeda loda nogudbala pipul bin oldei kaman en fait langa olabat iya langa dijan kantri, bat stil brom tudei na dei kaan abum detkain trabul na. "'en god bin pramis blanga meigim yu jidan gudbalawei nomo garram eni trabul brom yu enami olabat. en imbin pramis blanga gibit yu bigismob biginini olabat.
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

kriol: 'kaman. wi garra fait langa detlot pipul hu reken olabat jidanbat seifwan. olabat taun nomo garram geit en im nomo lokap, en nobodi nomo oldei maindimbat detlot taun.'
english: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care," says Yahweh; "that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.

kriol: en wanbala speshalwan mesinja bin deya neim sedakaiya det san blanga kenana. imbin oldei meigim sambala aiyanwan hon. en imbin tok langa king eiheb, "yawei bin tok dijan, 'yunbala garra yusum dislot hon blanga fait langa ol detlot siriya pipul, en yunbala garra binijimap olabat holbit.'"
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, "Yahweh says, 'With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.'"

kriol: "wen god im garra jidan brabli haibalawan bos im jis laik wen sambodi faindim brabli diyawan ting insaid langa graun. im gudbinji blanga det ting, en im gaburrumap det ting, en im go en selim ebrijing blanga im blanga baiyim det pedik weya imbin faindim det ting dumaji im wandim det ting.
english: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

kriol: brom deya aibin luk najawan einjul bin kamat brom det serramoni pleis blanga god deya langa hebin, en det einjul bin abum shapwan krukidwan naif du.
english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

kriol: wen imbin meshurum det frantpat blanga det serramoni pleis en det opin pleis langa frant, imbin 50 mita.
english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

kriol: en wen deibin stil lukinatbat langa skai, dubala men garram waitwan klos bin jandap wansaid langa olabat,
english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

kriol: ai garra jidan kwaitbala. ai kaan tok enijing dumaji yu na bin panishim mi en meigim mi jidan lagijat.
english: I was mute. I didn't open my mouth, because you did it.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin irrim im, imbin stap, en imbin dalim olabat blanga bringimap det blainwan men langa im, en wen imbin kaman gulijap langa im, jisas bin askim im.
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

kriol: en wen jisas bin godan brom det bout, wan men brom det taun bin midim im deya. wal det men bin abum nogudbala spirit insaid langa im, en im nomo bin werrimbat klos brom longtaim, en im nomo bin jidanbat langa im kemp du. imbin oldei jidanbat langa detlot keib weya deibin oldei pudumbat ola dedbala pipul.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn't live in a house, but in the tombs.

kriol: if yu oldei jidan praudbala en silibala en meigimbat nogudwan plen, yu garra stap dumbat lagijat.
english: "If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

kriol: en ai sabi det prais im weidabat blanga mi deya langa hebin. god garra gibit det prais langa ol detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei langa im. im na det bos blanga wi, en im garra jadjim ola pipul raitwei, en wen im garra jadjim ebribodi, det taim na im garra gibit mi det prais. nomo oni langa mi, bat langa ol detlot pipul hu weidabat blanga im brabliwei blanga kambek.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

kriol: wen mi stil jinggabat wanim ai garra tok, yawei, yu sabi tharran du.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

kriol: afta imbin brabli hanggri, en det boswan dibuldibul bin kamat langa im, en imbin stat temtimbat im na. imbin stat toktok olkainwei langa jisas, "yu reken yu san blanga god. wal yu dalim dijan ston blanga meigim miselp daga blanga yu."
english: The tempter came and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread."

kriol: en deibin jandim sambala men hu nomo bin bradin blanga enijing, en detlot men bin trebulin olnait raidap deibin kamat langa det taun weya detlot bodi bin heinginap, en deibin pulumdan detlot bodi brom det wol, en deibin deigimbek detlot bodi langa olabat ronwan taun, en deya na deibin barnim detlot bodi,
english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

kriol: ola isreil pipul garram detmatj mani en gol en silba en bigismob hosis en bagi du.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

kriol: blanga main wekinmenmob en ol main frenmob hubin oldei kaman langa main kemp, dei reken mi streinja na.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

kriol: wal shaharaiyim bin andimwei im dubala waif hushim en beira. afta na wen imbin jidan langa det kantri gulum moweb imbin merrit langa hodesh, en dubala bin abum sebenbala san neim jobab, saibiya, misha, melkam, jeyus, sekiya en mirama. ol im san olabat bin jidan bos langa olabat femili.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

kriol: olabat bin jidan raidaran langa mi, bat aibin binijimap olabat garram det pawa blanga yawei.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh's name I indeed cut them off.

kriol: en im lagijat du blanga seitin. if seitin en im dibuldibul olabat kadimat miselp en faitfait gija, wal dei garra binijimap miselp gin, en afta seitin kaan jidan boswan na.
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

kriol: ebridei yumob oldei kaman en weshipbat mi, en yumob reken yumob wandim len wanim mi oldei titjimbat langa yumob. yumob reken yumob oldei dum ebrijing mi tok en dum wanim rait. yumob askim mi blanga gibit yumob feyago, en yumob meigim yumob ronselp gudbinji wen yumob weshipbat mi. bat yumob jis geman. yumob nomo bulurrum mi brabli trubalawei.
english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn't forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.

kriol: "wal detlot pipul hu sabi dumbat ola gudwan klebabala ting garra jidan brabli hepiwan en olabat garra jidan gudbinji blanga len mowa.
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

kriol: "en detlot pipul oldei jinggabat rongwei blanga god weya im garra jadjim olabat, dumaji dei reken im kaan jadjim olabat. bat im garra jadjim olabat, dumaji imbin olredi jadjim det bos blanga dijan wel. en det bos na im seitin. en det holi spirit garra shoum detlot pipul dei nomo jinggabat raitwei blanga god weya im garra jadjimbat olabat.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

kriol: ai garra tridim im femili olabat seimwei laik aibin dum langa detlot femili blanga det dubala king gulum jerabowam en beisha brom isreil.
english: I will make Ahab's house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

kriol: en wen deibin irrim wanim god bin dumbat langa detlot jintail pipul, deibin preisim god. afta na deibin dalim pol, "braja, bigmob juwish pipul iya bin bilib du, en olabat stil kipum det lowa blanga mosis brabliwei du.
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, "You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

kriol: wal detlot pipul deya bin gitwail langa det blainwan men, en deibin dalim im blanga jidan kwait. bat imbin jingat mowa brabli adbala, "grengrensan blanga deibid! yu sori langa mi!"
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, "You son of David, have mercy on me!"

kriol: if yumob meigim pramis garram main neim en bulurrum mi trubalawei en gibit olabat feyago, wal ola najalot pipul garra askim mi blanga album olabat du, en olabat garra preisimbat oni langa mi.
english: and you will swear, 'As Yahweh lives,' in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him."

kriol: wal detlot pipul brom idam deibin kadimat miselp langa dislot klen na, timna, elba, jetheth, oholibama, ela, painan, kenas, teman, mibsa, megdiyel en airam.
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

kriol: wal josef bin tok, "nomo. mi nomo sabi. bat god gin dalim yunmi wanim det dubala drim tok."
english: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, "It isn't in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace."

kriol: wal bigmob najalot hedbos blanga det kantri bin kamat brom isau. blanga olabat neim bin timna, elba, jetheth,
english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

kriol: deibin kilim ded loda enamimob, dumaji god bin jidan garram olabat. en deibin kipgon jidan deya langa det kantri raidap det taim wen det asiriya king bin deigim olabat prisana langa im kantri.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

kriol: afta na jisas bin dalim ol detlot pipul deya dijan stori, "wantaim wan men bin meigim ebrijing redi blanga growimap gadin, en afta imbin gajim sambala fama blanga rentim det pleis, en imbin gowei brom deya longtaim.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

kriol: detlot men garra mindimap detlot klos garram bluwan, pepulwan en redwan wul en garram golwan thred en gudwan matiriyal.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

kriol: en if enibodi kaan duwit langa dijan wed, wal im rabishim god. im nomo rabishim men. im rabishim god hubin gibit yumob im holi spirit.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn't reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

kriol: basdam detlot olmen lidamob bin oldei sodimat eni trabul langa det taun, bat najing na. en detlot yang pipul nomo pleipleibat myusik en singsingbat song na.
english: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "wal maitbi dubala brom det isreil traib go langa kot blanga streitinap det agamin weya dubala abum. wal wanbala im gudwan en det najawan im giltiwan.
english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

kriol: "wal nomeda yumob garra jidan langa det kantri longtaim en abum loda biginini, bat stil yumob nomo lau dum nogudbala ting en meigim enikain drimin sheip. det nogudbalawei im nomo gudwan blanga yawei, dumaji im meigim im brabli wail.
english: When you father children and children's children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God's sight to provoke him to anger,

kriol: en mi oldei askim im blanga meigim jisas krais jidan insaid langa yumob dumaji yumob bilib langa im, en mi oldei askim im blanga meigim yumob dumbat ola gudbala ting dumaji yumob laigim god en ola pipul,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

kriol: wal aibin dalim det skai blanga jidan nogudbinji en sheiksheik nomo lilbit,
english: "Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate," says Yahweh.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin tok lagijat, ol detlot boswan serramonimen bin tok miselp, "wotfo imbin tok wi kaan go langa det pleis weya im garra go? maitbi im garra kilim miselp ded en go langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul jidan."
english: The Jews therefore said, "Will he kill himself, because he says, 'Where I am going, you can't come'?"

kriol: bat ol detlot ting weya ai bina trastim blanga album mi, wal ai reken olabat nomo enijing, dumaji ai sabi wanim jisas krais bin dum blanga mi.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

kriol: imbin dum ola nogudbala ting seimwei laik king eiheb en detlot najalot king blanga isreil bin dum, dumaji imbin merrit langa det doda blanga king eiheb. imbin dum nogudbala ting langa yawei,
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab's house, for he had Ahab's daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight.

kriol: wal ebritaim wen deibin abum det pasoba serramoni, pailat bin oldei larramgo wanbala prisana fri, en imbin oldei larram ola pipul pikimat wujan prisana deibin wandim go fri.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

kriol: en wen yumob go langa det kantri weya yawei bin pramisim yumob, yumob garra kipgon abumbat dijan serramoni,
english: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.

kriol: wal wen detlot mesinja bin kamat langa det kantri blanga detlot emanait pipul, ola bosmen blanga detlot pipul bin dalim henan, "yu reken deibid bin jandim detlot men blanga shoum rispek langa yu dumaji yu dedi bin dai? nomo. imbin jandim olabat iya blanga lukaran dis taun blanga wi wulijim im garra sabi hau im garra teikoba langa wi."
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn't David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?"

kriol: det king nomo bin teiknodis langa dubala. imbin jis gibit dubala bekboun, en imbin gobek langa im haus.
english: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn't even take this to heart.

kriol: en yu garra heingimap det kaliko langa 20 kopawan pol garram loda huk en lilwan silbawan reil, en detlot bigwan kopawan pol garra jandap ontop langa 20 kopawan pleit.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

kriol: dumaji yawei bin dalim mi nomo blanga dagat o dringgim enijing, en imbin dalim mi nomo blanga gobek langa det seimwan roud weya aibin kamat brom."
english: for so was it commanded me by Yahweh's word, saying, 'You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don't return by the way that you came.'"

kriol: en imbin gibit im pawa oba ol det king wekinmen olabat, en blanga dalimbat olabat wanim blanga dum.
english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

kriol: wal im garra hepin lagijat langa yumob, dumaji god bin pikimat yumob blanga meigim yumob bilib langa jisas krais, en imbin pikimat yumob blanga abum trabul blanga im du.
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

kriol: preisim yawei det trubala god blanga wi, en weship im langa im seikridwan hil. yawei wi god, im holiwan.
english: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!

kriol: yumob garra dum ebrijing gudbalawei en meigim miselp jidan nomo garram enijing rong. yumob garra jidan brabli gudbala pipul blanga god, dumaji dijan wel weya wi jidan im garram olkain nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, en yumob garra jidan jis laiga lait blanga olabat. yumob garra jidan jis laik ola sta weya shain langa skai,
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

kriol: det gel garra lidim yu blanga dai. det wei blanga im garra go streit langa greibyad.
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

kriol: wal king sedakaiya nomo bin wandim lisin en teiknodis langa nebakanesa det king blanga bebalon. en king nebakanesa bin go langa jerusalem blanga king sedakaiya garram ol im soljamob. dis ting bin hepin langa det namba 9 yiya wen king sedakaiya bin jidan det king en langa det namba 10 dei blanga det namba 10 manth. wal deya na langa jerusalem, king nebakanesa en ol im soljamob bin meigim kemp raidaran langa det wol blanga teikoba det taun, en deibin pudumbat ola ebrijing deya blanga fait langa olabat.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

kriol: en imbin gajim loda kopa du brom det dubala taun gulum taibath en kun weya king heidadesa bin jidan. bambai salaman bin yusum detlot kopa blanga bildimap loda ebrijing langa det serramoni pleis.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

kriol: afta na jisas bin tok langa ola pipul deya, "main dedi bin gibit mi ebrijing. bat nobodi kaan sabi main dedi san. oni main dedi sabi im san. en nobodi kaan sabi main dedi du. oni mi na sabi im, dumaji mi na det san blanga im. en detlot pipul weya ai garra pikimat en shoum main dedi langa olabat, detlot pipul du garra sabi main dedi."
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, "All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him."

kriol: ola nogudbala wed weya nogudbala pipul toktok garra meigim trabul blanga yu, bat det sabibala wed brom gudbala pipul garra seibum yu.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

kriol: yu garra titjim yu biginini olabat blanga jidan raitwei en wen olabat gro bigwan, wal olabat garra sabi hau blanga jidan raitwei.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

kriol: yu na bin draiyimap det dipwan solwoda blanga meigim roud blanga yu pipul olabat blanga krosoba langa det riba, indit?
english: Isn't it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

kriol: wal aibin tok, "ol yumob pipul brom isreil yumob irrim wanim yawei bin tok. yumob garra meigim miselp lobala en irrim langa mi.
english: Hear, and give ear. Don't be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.

kriol: bambai na det einjul blanga yawei bin faindim det wekingel langa wanbala springwoda langa det roud deya langa det deset kantri gulum shuya,
english: Yahweh's angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "wal maitbi sambodi bin gitkil brom dumbat rong ting, en deibin heingimap im bodi ontop langa shapwan wadi.
english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

kriol: "en deya na wibin jidan langa det beli wansaid langa det taun gulum bethpiyowa."
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

kriol: imbin tok, "if enibodi askim yumob blanga kaman langa det padi weya im garra merrit, wal yumob kaan go en pikimat det gudbala pleis blanga jidan. maitbi det boswan bin askim sambodi mowa haibala langa yumob blanga kaman langa det padi du.
english: "When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don't sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

kriol: en seimtaim detlot isreil solja bin tenaran en stat fait langa detlot benjamin solja, en detlot benjamin solja bin bradin, en dei nomo bin sabi wanim blanga dum, dumaji deibin sabi detlot isreil solja garra bidim olabat,
english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.

kriol: en wandei wen imbin aftanuntaim, king deibid bin gowap ontop langa im haus blanga lukaran kantri, en wen imbin deya, imbin faindim wan gel bin bogibogi, en det gel bin brabli purdibala.
english: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king's house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.

kriol: detlot isreil pipul jis laiga brabli strongwan laiyan. im nomo abum spel raidap im dagadagat en dringgim det blad blanga det enimul weya imbin kilim." lagijat na beilam bin tok.
english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain."

kriol: en ola isreil pipul bin gibit olabat sambala taun en sambala pedik brom olabat ronwan kantri jis laik god bin dalim olabat blanga dum.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.

kriol: im garra gibit ola enimul en sid daga en wain blanga detlot sekrifais wen yumob abum detlot nyumanth serramoni en langa detlot sebathdei, en detlot najalot speshalwan dei blanga mi. im garra yusum ol detlot ofring blanga detlot nogudbalawei ofring, detlot sid daga ofring en detlot barnapwan ofring en detlot feloship ofring. ai garra brabli gudbinji blanga tharran en ai garra larramgo main pipul olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei."
english: It shall be the prince's part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel."

kriol: wal wen detlot haibala serramonimen en detlot najalot serramonimen gulum ferasi bin irrim jisas tok det wed, deibin wandi grebum im en lokimap im, dumaji deibin sabi imbin tokin blanga olabat en blanga im ronselp langa det stori. bat dei nomo bin grebum im, dumaji ola pipul deya bin reken jisas bin speshalwan mesinja blanga god, en detlot serramonimen bin bradin langa olabat.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

kriol: if yu go langa kothaus en yu dalim laiya yu garra abum panishmen, en yu kaan ranawei eniweya.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

kriol: imbin tok langa olabat, "yumob garra deigim ola boswan wekinmen blanga main en yumob garra larram main san salaman raidim main ronwan dongki. yumob garra go en deigim im raidap langa det spring gulum gihon.
english: The king said to them, "Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

kriol: en langa det bigwan deset kantri du. yumob sabi brabliwei hau imbin maindimbat yumob gudbalawei raidap langa dijan pleis, jis laik det dediwan weya im garrimapbat im biginini.'
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place."

kriol: bat yumob pipul hu bilib, god na bin pikimat yumob, en yumob jidan jis laiga speshalwan serramonimen blanga jisas krais det king, en yumob jidan jis laiga ronwan traib blanga im, en yumob na det ronwan pipul blanga god, en imbin pikimat yumob blanga dalimbat ebribodi blanga ola gudbala ting weya imbin dumbat. basdam yumob nomo bin jidan ronwan pipul blanga god, en yumob nomo bin sabi god im kainbala. bat tudei yumob jidan ronwan pipul blanga im, en yumob sabi im kainbala, dumaji imbin jingat langa yumob wen yumob bin jidan langa det dakbala pleis, en imbin dalim yumob blanga kaman en jidan langa det brabli gudwan lait blanga im.
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

kriol: detlot serramonimen hubin jidan gulijap langa jerusalem bin bildimbek naja pat blanga det wol. dislot na ola neim blanga olabat.
english: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.

kriol: en olabat bin boswan blanga det seikridwan tent, insaidwei en atsaidwei, en blanga det ketin langa det dowawei,
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kriol: o im sista hu nomo bin merrit, en jidan langa im kemp.
english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
