kriol: "dijan na det oda weya sairas det king blanga det kantri gulum pesha bin gibit. "'yawei det trubala boswan god weya jidan langa hebin bin meigim mi jidan haibala bos langa ola kantri langa dijan wel en imbin dalim mi blanga bildimbek igin det serramoni pleis blanga im langa jerusalem deya langa juda.
english: "Cyrus king of Persia says, 'Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

kriol: wal king sol bin dalim doweg det men brom det kantri gulum idam, "wal yu kilim olabat ded." en doweg bin duwit. det seim dei gin doweg bin kilim 85 serramonimen ded. nomeda detlot serramonimen bin oldei werrimon det speshalwan shet gulum ifad, bat stil imbin kilim olabat ded,
english: The king said to Doeg, "Turn and attack the priests!" Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

kriol: wal olabat bin godan laibala langa tharran pleis blanga ola dedbala, en garram ola ebrijing blanga olabat du. det graun bin gaburrumap olabat en olabat bin ol binijap na.
english: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

kriol: wal neftali bin abum fobala san neim jasiyel, gunai, jesa en shalum. deibin det femili lain weya bin kamat brom bila.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

kriol: enibodi hu nomo klinbala blanga serramoni wen im tatjim samting, wal det samting im jidan nomo klinbala blanga serramoni, en enibodi mowa hu tatjim det samting, im jidan nomo klinbala blanga det serramoni raidap sangodan." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: "Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening."

kriol: naitaim wen mi leidan mi oldei jinggabat langa yu, en olnait mi jinggabat langa yu,
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

kriol: en im oldei kipum mi seifwan jis laiga diya weya jidan langa hil kantri.
english: He makes his feet like hinds' feet, and sets me on my high places.

kriol: if yumob sheiksheik wen yawei tok, yumob garra irrim langa im gudwei. im tok, "sambala yumob ronwan pipul nomo laigim yumob en olabat gibit bekboun langa yumob, dumaji yumob laigim en jidan trubala langa mi. olabat oldei meigimbat fan blanga yumob en dei oldei tok 'larram yawei shoum im pawa. larram wi luk im meigim olabat jidan brabli hepiwan.' bat detlot pipul hu tok ol dislot ting garra sheim miselp brabliwei." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Hear Yahweh's word, you who tremble at his word: "Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name's sake, have said, 'Let Yahweh be glorified, that we may see your joy;' but it is those who shall be disappointed.

kriol: en afta yumob biyainmob garra kaman en go streidin langa det taun en kilim ebribodi ded. yawei garra meigim yumob win,
english: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for Yahweh your God will deliver it into your hand.

kriol: imbin oldei toktok blanga ola tri en plent brom detlot bigwan sidatri brom lebanan raidap langa ola rili lilwan plent weya gro langa wol. imbin oldei toktok blanga ola enimul en ola bard en ola sneik en ola fish.
english: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

kriol: samtaim pipul reken olabat dumbat ola rait ting, bat bambai detlot ting garra meigim olabat dai.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kriol: wal wen det rait taim weya god bin pikimat garra kaman, jisas krais garra kambek, en ola pipul blanga im garra preisim im brabliwei. ol detlot pipul hubin bilib langa im, garra hatjamp wen dei garra luk langa im, en yumob garra jidan deya du garram olabat, dumaji yumob bin bilib langa det wed weya melabat bin dalimbat yumob.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

kriol: brom deya detlot 72 men bin go langa ol detlot taun, en wen deibin kambek langa jisas, deibin brabli gudbinji, en deibin tok, "bos, wen melabat bin yusumbat yu neim, ol detlot dibuldibul bin duwit wanim melabat bin dalim olabat."
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!"

kriol: "yumob garra kipum main lowa weya aibin gibit yumob, wulijim yumob garra jidanbat gudwei langa det kantri gulum keinan weya ai garra bringimap yumob.
english: "'You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

kriol: "bat im garra ensa, 'ai kaan dum eni gudbala ting blanga yumob. yumob kaan meigim mi jidan lida blanga yumob. ai nomo garram eni klos en daga langa main haus.'
english: In that day he will cry out, saying, "I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people."

kriol: prayer wal wen melabat prei, melabat oldei jinggabat yumob, en melabat oldei gibit theingks langa wi dedi god blanga yumob
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "wotfo yu kaan sabi? yu haibala titja iya langa dijan kantri isreil, indit?
english: Jesus answered him, "Are you the teacher of Israel, and don't understand these things?

kriol: nafodowa deya langa solwodasaid, goyim deya langa det kantri gulum gelali, en taisa.
english: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

kriol: wal langa det namba 3 yiya wen nomo eni rein bin buldan yawei det trubala god bin tok langa ilaija, "yu garra go en shoum miselp langa king eiheb en ai garra jandim rein."
english: After many days, Yahweh's word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, "Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth."

kriol: wal mi na sekaraiya bin kipgon tok, "wal wen im taim blanga detlot daga blanga gro, askim yawei det trubala god blanga jandim rein. yawei na oldei jandim ola klaud en rein, im meigim ola tri langa ola gadin grinwan blanga im pipul olabat.
english: Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

kriol: "'wal yawei garra panishim enibodi hu medrimbat sambodi sigridbalawei.' "en ola pipul garra tok, 'yuwai! trubala dijan im tok!'
english: 'Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.'

kriol: bambai na det jeil bin sheik, en det graun weya det jeil bin jidan bin sheik detmatj du, en streidawei ola dowa langa det jeil bin opin, en ola tjein weya deibin taiyimap ola prisana bin kamat du.
english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone's bonds were loosened.

kriol: ai dalim yumob dijan blanga meigim yumob sheim, dumaji yumob bin oldei go langa detkain pipul na blanga streitinimat yumob trabul. wal ai sabi yumob kristjan pipul garram sambodi deya hu sabi hau blanga streitinimat yumob trabul.
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

kriol: melabat brabli gudbinji wen melabat raidimbat dijan leda langa yumob, blanga meigim yumob jidan miselp brabli gudbinjiwei du.
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

kriol: yubin meigim main frenmob tenawei en bradin brom mi en deibin libum mi miselp. mi trep na en ai kaan ranawei.
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can't escape.

kriol: "nomo larram det femili blanga kohath
english: "Don't cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

kriol: olabat bin jandap langa skweya en nomo bin luk miselp, en ola wing bin tatjim miselp. deibin ol mubabat wanwei seimtaim en olabat nomo bin tenimran olabat bodi.
english: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn't turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

kriol: "brom deya yu dalim detlot isreil pipul blanga deigim wan boiwan nenigout blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei, en wan lilwan buligi, en wan lilwan ship, nomo garram enijing rong langa olabat, dumaji detlot na blanga det barnapwan ofring,
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

kriol: "yumob nomo foget aibin meigim detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat aiyanwan ebrijing blanga fait. dei meigim langa det hotwan faiya. en aibin meigim ol detlot solja hu yusum detlot aiyanwan ting blanga fait en bitsimap ebrijing.
english: "Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.

kriol: en det jigininbala tri bin tok, 'if im trubala yumob wandi meigim mi jidan king, wal yumob kaman en jidan andanith langa main sheid. en if yumob kaan kaman en faindim eni sheid, wal faiya garra kamat brom main bushis en barnimap ola bigwan sidatri hu jidan bos blanga yumob.'" lagijat na jotham bin tok langa detlot men, dumaji imbin sabi abimalek bin jis laik det jigininbala tri weya kaan meigim ola pipul jidan gudbalawei, en imbin sabi abimalek garra meigim trabul blanga olabat.
english: "The bramble said to the trees, 'If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.'

kriol: brom deya aibin luk najawan einjul bin kaminap brom sanraiswei, en imbin abum namba bren blanga ola pipul blanga det laibalawan god. det einjul bin jingat brabli adbala langa detlot fobala einjul.
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

kriol: dumaji yawei det trubala god na bin meigim yumob jidan jis laik yumob silipiwan. yumob speshalwan mesinja garra lafta abum gudwan ai, bat yawei bin gaburrumap yumob ai.
english: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

kriol: deibin dalim mosis, "melabat bin lukaran det kantri. im brabli gudwan en ritjwan kantri, en iya na sambala frut daga melabat bin gajim brom deya.
english: They told him, and said, "We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

kriol: wal yu garra dalim ola olmen nomo blanga jidan drangginwan, dumaji dei garra lukaftum miselp en jinggabat streitbalawei, en dei garra bilib langa jisas krais brabli trubalawei, en dei garra laigim ola pipul brabliwei, en dei kaan gibap.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

kriol: wal detlot pipul bin tok, "wal wanim ofring melabat garra jandim?" wal detlot serramonimen en doktabala bin tok, "yumob garra gajim sambala gol, en yumob garra meigim faibala golwan sheip jis laik detlot boil weya yumob bin abum, en yumob garra meigim faibala golwan sheip jis laik detlot lilwan enimul gulum maus weya meigimbat ola kantri blanga wi brabli nogud. yumob garra meigim faibala sheip, wanbala blanga ebri filastain king, dumaji detlot boil bin kamat langa detlot faibala king du.
english: Then they said, "What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?" They said, "Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.

kriol: bat im kaan jandim eni flai langa det kantri gulum goshin weya ola isreil pipul jidan. im garra tridim im pipul olabat difrinwei brom ola pipul blanga yu blanga meigim yu sabi im na yawei det trubala god hu dumbat dislot ting. tumorro na im garra dum dis klebabala ting.' lagijat na yunbala garra tok langa det king."
english: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am Yahweh on the earth.

kriol: ai nomo go garram pipul hu oldei dumbat nogudwan ting. mi jidan longwei brom olabat.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

kriol: oba en oba deibin oldei testimbat god, en deibin oldei ardimbat det filing blanga im na, det brabli holiwan god blanga isreil.
english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

kriol: wal wanim yumob reken? det lowa im nogudwan? nomo. det lowa im gudwan, dumaji det lowa bin meigim wi sabi wanim nogudwan ting. yumob sabi? det lowa im tok, "nomo wandimbat blanga najamen enijing." bat if det lowa nomo bina tok lagijat, wal wi nomo bina sabi im nogudbala ting blanga jidan gridibala.
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn't have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn't have known coveting unless the law had said, "You shall not covet."

kriol: en mosis bin dalim detlot lida blanga ola isreil pipul, "yumob garra weit iya blanga minbala raidap minbala kambek. ai garra libum det dubala men eran en huwa iya garram yumob, en if enibodi abum agamin, det dubala na garra sodimat det agamin."
english: He said to the elders, "Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them."

kriol: wal leiban bin tok, "yu kaman na. yu kambek langa main kemp. wotfo yu weidabat iya? ai garram rum redi blanga yu en yu wekinmen olabat en ola kemul blanga yu, dumaji yawei im gudbinji langa yu."
english: He said, "Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels."

kriol: en bambai det gel bin abum boiwan beibi, en mosis bin tok, "wal ai garra gulum im neim gesham, dumaji mi streinja langa dijan kantri."
english: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, "I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land."

kriol: yumob garra jinggabat wen yumob bin jidan wekinmen en wekingel jis laiga prisana deya langa ijip, en deya na yawei bin meigim yumob fri, en blanga tharran na aibin gibit yumob dijan lowa.
english: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

kriol: bat dubala bin go en spredimat det nyus ebriweya langa det kantri.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

kriol: "bat wen aibin wokwokbat langa det roud, aibin faindim yu rolimbat miselp langa yu ronwan blad. yubin jidan garram loda blad oloba langa yu bodi, bat ai nomo bin libum yu deya blanga dai.
english: "'"When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, 'Though you are in your blood, live!' Yes, I said to you, 'Though you are in your blood, live!'

kriol: god bin bringimap olabat brom ijip. im oldei fait blanga olabat laiga wailwan buligi. dei oldei bidim olabat enami. dei breigim olabat boun en tjakidawei olabat spiya.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

kriol: wal deibin gajim det buligi en deibin meigim im redibala ontop langa det teibul blanga ofring en deibin preiprei langa beil raidap dinataim. deibin jingat adbala, "ensim melabat, beil!" en deibin kipgon densdens raidaran langa det teibul weya deibin bildimap. bat najing. beil nomo bin ensim olabat.
english: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, "Baal, hear us!" But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

kriol: blanga detlot isreil pipul. enibodi hu gibit feloship ofring im garra bringimap sambala blanga det speshalwan ofring langa mi.
english: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

kriol: en ola najalot speshalwan mesinja bin tok det seimwan wed, "yunbala garra fait langa detlot pipul langa remoth en yunbala garra bidim olabat. yawei garra meigim yunbala bidim olabat."
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, "Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king."

kriol: detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat nogudwan plen garra hatjamp wen olabat garra sabi wanim garra hepin langa olabat bambai, bat detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat gudwan plen garra jidan brabli hepi.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

kriol: en imbin dalim yu laiyawan stori blanga mi. bat ai sabi yu garra dum wanim yu reken im gudwan blanga dum, dumaji yu jis laiga einjul brom god.
english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

kriol: imbin ensim mi, "olabat detlot fobala win, en deibin kaman brom det boswan blanga ola graun, en deibin kaman blanga dum im wek."
english: The angel answered me, "These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

kriol: brom deya jeihu bin dalim det boswan serramonimen hubin lukaftumbat detlot seikridwan kout blanga bringimap ola seikridwan kout en gibit detlot pipul hubin oldei weshipbat beil.
english: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, "Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!" So he brought robes out to them.

kriol: nomeda mi nomo gilti ai stil kaan agaminbat langa god. ai gin oni jingat langa im blanga albumbat mi en kain langa mi.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn't answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

kriol: deya na melabat bin faindim najawan bout bin redi blanga go langa det kantri gulum fanisha, en melabat bin gowin langa det bout,
english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

kriol: imbin baiyimbek im pipul olabat, en imbin meigim det olagijawan brabli strongwan pramis garram olabat. im na det holiwan en det haibalawan god.
english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

kriol: wal god bin grebum mi, en imbin gulijap jugum mi,
english: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

kriol: wal aisik bin tok, "mi brabli olmen na, en mi gulijap binij.
english: He said, "See now, I am old. I don't know the day of my death.

kriol: melabat garram sista deya, bat im yangwan en im dubala milk stil lilwan. wanim melabat garra du blanga im wen im pramis garra kaman en wandi merrit langa im?
english: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?

kriol: oni det libai klen garra abum det wek blanga album eran en im dubala san.
english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kriol: wal god bin ensim mi na. imbin tok, "detlot pipul langa isreil en juda, olabat brabli giltiwan brom olabat nogudbalawei. deibin medrimbat loda pipul ebriweya langa dijan kantri, en olabat bin dum loda nogudbala ting langa jerusalem. en olabat tok, 'yawei kaan luk langa melabat. imbin fogedabat dijan kantri.'
english: Then he said to me, "The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, 'Yahweh has forsaken the land, and Yahweh doesn't see.'

kriol: yawei, yu dum ebrijing raitwei, en ol yu lowa olabat gibit pipul feyago.
english: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

kriol: wal dijan na detlot gudbala wed weya mosis, det men blanga god bin gibit ola isreil klen bifo imbin dai.
english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

kriol: wal wen king sol bin luk deibid go en fait langa galaiyath, imbin askim ebna det boswan blanga im solja olabat, "hu det yangboi dedi?" wal ebna bin tok, "bos, ai nomo sabi."
english: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, "Abner, whose son is this youth?" Abner said, "As your soul lives, O king, I can't tell."

kriol: wal seimtaim det san blanga gira neim shimiyai brom det benjamin klen bin go blanga midim king deibid deya langa det jodan riba du,
english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

kriol: "isikiyel, detlot pipul brom det taun gulum taya bin abum bigwan padi. olabat bin brabli gudbinji dumaji jerusalem bin binij en olabat bin singsingbat ola song. 'jerusalem bin binij na. imbin oldei jidan brabli strongbala en imbin abum mowa pawa langa najalot taun en imbin selim ebrijing. bat imbin binij en wi garra deigim im pleis na.' lagijat na deibin sing.
english: "Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, 'Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;'

kriol: wal yawei bin tok langa mosis, "wal yu kaan jidan laibala longtaim. yu jingat langa joshuwa en bringimap im langa det seikridwan tent wulijim ai garra dalim im wanim im garra dum." wal mosis en joshuwa bin go langa det seikridwan tent,
english: Yahweh said to Moses, "Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him." Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

kriol: "en if enibodi tok nogudbalawei blanga mi, wal god gin larramgo im fri brom det ting. bat if enibodi tok nogudbalawei blanga det holi spirit, wal god kaan larramgo im fri brom tharran.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

kriol: det wed na brom det king bin dalim ola juwish pipul langa ebri taun, dei garra majurrumap miselp blanga stapam detlot pipul weya dei oldei wandim kilim olabat. en ola juwish pipul gin kilim en binijimap eni pipul brom eni kantri hu kaman blanga ardim olabat. en dei gin deigidawei ola enijing brom detlot enami.
english: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,

kriol: det braja blanga esel gulum eshek bin abum thribala san neim yulam, jeyus en elifalet.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

kriol: ai kaan jandim enibodi blanga binijimap yumob taun igin, en if enibodi faitfaitbat langa yumob, wal yumob garra meigim detlot pipul jidan prisana en wek blanga yumob.
english: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

kriol: en det ofring garra meigim detlot serramonimen fri brom ola nogudbalawei blanga olabat. yu garra barnim ola bif en skin en detlot najalot binjipat blanga det buligi atsaid brom yumob kemp.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

kriol: en wen deibid bin kamat langa king sol, imbin dalim king sol, "bos, nobodi kaan bradin langa det filastain men. ai garra go en fait langa im."
english: David said to Saul, "Let no man's heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine."

english: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, Yahweh, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and I will do it."

english: "For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.

english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters. They come to the cisterns, and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

english: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

english: You say also, 'Behold, what a weariness it is!' And you have sniffed at it", says Yahweh of Armies; "and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?" says Yahweh.

english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, "Are you also one of this man's disciples?" He said, "I am not."

english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, "I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way."

english: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, "Is all well?"

english: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.

english: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don't eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

english: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

english: "Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don't invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.

english: They answered, "'John the Baptizer,' but others say, 'Elijah,' and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again."

english: He said, "Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath." She said, "It's all right."

For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has."

english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

kriol: "en yumob gin dagat ola fish weya dei garram fin en skeil.
english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

kriol: wal wen jowab bin gedim det leda brom king deibid, imbin duwit langa im, en deya gin langa det taun weya deibin fait, jowab bin jandim yuraiya lida blanga fait langa ola enami weya det fait bin brabli strongbala.
english: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.

kriol: yu na main god. shoum mi wanim yu wandim mi blanga dum. yu jidan gudbala langa mi en yu deigim mi langa det seifwan roud.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

kriol: wal king deibid bin tok, "mi brabli nogudbinji blanga dijan, en mi nomo sabi wanim blanga dum. bat mi sabi mi nomo wandim eni men blanga panishim mi. mi wandim yawei blanga panishim mi, dumaji im kainbala."
english: David said to Gad, "I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh's hand, for his mercies are very great. Don't let me fall into man's hand."

kriol: en det taim na aibin meigim det pramis blanga deigimwei olabat brom ijip en deigim olabat langa det kantri weya aibin pikimat blanga olabat. det kantri im brabli nambawan kantri, en im abum blendibala daga.
english: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

kriol: im nomo bin dum lagijat blanga najalot pipul brom najalot kantri. dei nomo sabi ol im lowa. preisim yawei det trubala god!
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don't know his ordinances. Praise Yah!

kriol: en yumob sabi wanim god wandim yumob blanga dum, en det lowa bin lenim yumob blanga pikimat det raitwei.
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

kriol: blanga im pipul olabat oldei kraikraibat wen dei lukabat blanga daga. dei oldei gajimbat olabat ronwan purdiwan gol en enijing blanga selimbat blanga gajim mowa daga blanga meigim olabat jidan laibala." lagijat na det speshalwan mesinja bin tok. jerusalem im jingat langa yawei, "yawei, yu luk langa mi dumaji mi oldei jidan brabli nogudbinji.
english: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. "Look, Yahweh, and see, for I have become despised."

kriol: en deibin askim im, "yu dalim melabat. hubin gibit yu det rait blanga dum ol dislot ting weya yu dumbat iya langa dijan serramoni pleis? hubin gibit yu det rait blanga titjimbat olabat pipul iya langa dijan pleis?"
english: They asked him, "Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?"

kriol: wal det king bin jingat langa mosis en eran, en imbin dalim dubala, "yumob go en abum det sekrifais serramoni blanga yumob god. bat yumob garra abum det serramoni iya gin langa dijan kantri."
english: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!"

kriol: "en if det serramonimen kaman en luk det moldiwan ting, en if im nomo bin kambek afta deibin pudum det nyuwan klei, wal det serramonimen garra tok, det haus im klinbala blanga serramoni, dumaji det moldiwan ting bin gowei na.
english: "If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn't spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

kriol: wal mi na. aibin bildimap haibala wol raidaran langa det solwoda, en aibin lokimap det geit.
english: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

kriol: wal deibin go langa det greibyad en deibin jadimap det keib brabliwei. deibin pudum mad raidaran langa det ston dowa langa det keib, en deibin libum detlot solja deya blanga maindimbat det keib.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

kriol: detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola raitwan ting garra jidan seifwan, bat detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat rong ting garra dai.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

kriol: ola ship jidan detmatj langa det kantri, en sid daga gaburrumap ola plein kantri. im jis laik ebrijing brabli gudbinji en sing en preisim yu.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

kriol: detlot asiriya pipul garra ol binijap, nomo garram detlot bigwan naif blanga pipul, bat garram det bigwan naif blanga god. ola yangmen garra trai ranawei, bat sambodi garra gajim olabat en meigim olabat jidan prisana.
english: "The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

kriol: wal sambodi bin gibit longbala waitwan kout langa ol detlot pipul hubin gitkil, en sambodi bin dalim olabat dei garra weit lilbit longtaim. dumaji detlot nogudbala pipul garra kilimbat olabat baba. dei garra kilimbat detlot wekinmen en wekingel blanga jisas. bambai wen dei gajimap det rait namba, det taim na god garra panishimbat olabat.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

kriol: bat jisas bin oldei gowei langa kwaitbala pleis weya imbin oldei prei langa im dedi langa hebin.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

kriol: imbin tok, 'king senakerib, detlot pipul langa jerusalem nomo laigim yu en dei laflaf langa yu.
english: This is the word that Yahweh has spoken concerning him: 'The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

kriol: lagijat na im ron kantrimen olabat bin tok, en deibin gibit im bekboun. wal jisas bin dalim olabat, "pipul ebriweya oldei shoum rispek langa speshalwan mesinja blanga god. bat nomo detlot pipul langa im ron taun. ola femili en rileishan blanga im kaan teiknodis langa im en rispek langa im."
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house."

kriol: yu reken detlot bigwan stoniwan hil langa lebanan nomo bin abum sno? najing. yu reken detlot riba weya randan brom det hil jidan draiwan? najing.
english: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin shoum mi dubala baskit garram detlot fig daga. deibin jidanbat lida langa det serramoni pleis. dijan bin hepin afta king nebakanesa brom bebalon bin deigimwei det king blanga juda neim jehoiyakin, det san blanga jehoiyakim. king nebakanesa en im soljamob bin deigim im prisana brom jerusalem langa bebalon, en deibin deigim detlot lidamob brom juda, en ol detlot klebabala men hubin oldei meigimbat olkainaba ting brabli gudwei.
english: Yahweh showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs were set before Yahweh's temple, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

kriol: imbin lidimat ola isreil pipul brom ijip, en deibin garrimap silba en gol, en olabat holot bin strongwan en nomo sikwan.
english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

kriol: wal yawei det boswan god bin kipgon tok, "ol yumob boswan langa isreil, yumob bin stilimbat en tjidimbat main pipul. ai wandim yumob garra stap dumbat nogudwan ting en yumob garra stat dumbat ola gudbala ting en gibit pipul feyago. yumob kaan neba andimwei main pipul olabat brom olabat ronwan kantri enimo. mi na yawei det boswan god bin tok dijan.
english: "'The Lord Yahweh says: "Enough you, princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!" says the Lord Yahweh.

kriol: wal detlot wekinmen bin go ebriweya, en deibin dalimbat ola pipul blanga tenim miselp brom ola nogudbalawei blanga olabat,
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

kriol: yu garra dalim eran ebrijing ai dalim yu, en im garra dalim det king blanga larramgo ol detlot isreil pipul brom im kantri.
english: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

kriol: wal trubala ai dalim yumob. mi na yawei det boswan god blanga ola isreil pipul, en bambai ai garra binijimap yumob kantri gulum moweb jis laik weya aibin binijimap det taun gulum sadam. ai garra binijimap yumob kantri gulum eman, jis laik weya aibin binijimap det taun gulum gamora. ola bindiyai gras garra gaburrumap det dubala kantri blanga yumob, en soltiwan graun garra jidan deya weya gudwan graun bin jidan bifo. no daga garra gro deya olagijawan. en main pipul hu nomo gitkil garra kaman en deigidawei ola gudbala ting blanga yumob, en dei garra teikoba moweb en eman." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Therefore, as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

kriol: en deibin bidim detlot isreil solja brabliwei, en 20,000 solja bin dai.
english: The people of Israel were struck there before David's servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

kriol: brom deya detlot isreil pipul bin jandim wed langa saihan det king blanga detlot emarait pipul.
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

kriol: en imbin jingat adbala, "larram mi dai iya gin garram ola filastain pipul!" en imbin pushum det dubala ston brabli adbala, en imbin meigim det haus buldan ontop langa detlot faibala king en ola najalot pipul deya, en semsan bin dai deya du. wal wen semsan bin laibala, imbin kilim loda filastain pipul ded. bat ol detlot pipul bin lilbit langa detlot pipul weya imbin kilim deya langa det haus weya imbin dai.
english: Samson said, "Let me die with the Philistines!" He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords, and on all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life.

kriol: en yu na bin oldei meigim olabat ranawei brom mi wen deibin oldei luk mi kaman, en aibin oldei binijimap ol detlot enami main hu nomo bin laigim mi.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

kriol: meigim dijan kantri jidan gudbalawei garram ebrijing, dumaji yu pipul bulurrum det raitwei blanga yu.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

kriol: ol detlot pipul hubin wandi bringimap bin bringimap olabat ofring blanga yawei blanga dum detlot wek weya imbin dalim mosis.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

kriol: wal lot bin pikimat ol detlot jodan riba kantri blanga imselp, en imbin go sanraiswei. lagijat na lot en eibram bin splidap.
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim olabat, "aibin olredi dalim yumob mi na im. en if yumob lukabat mi, wal yumob larramgo dislot najalot men."
english: Jesus answered, "I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,"

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, lagijat na det holi spirit bin tok, en yumob garra wotjim miselp en meiksho nobodi brom yumob hafbilib en jidan nogudbala insaid, dumaji wen enibodi jidan lagijat, bambai im garra tenim miselp brom det brabliwan god.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

kriol: wal yawei na gibit laif langa ola biginini. en im garra larram saiyan abum bigismob biginini." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?" says Yahweh. "Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?" says your God.

kriol: langa det dei na wen yumob garra binijimap yumob enamimob, en teikoba en nokamdan olabat strongbala haus, ola woda garra randan langa ebri krik en hil.
english: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

kriol: en dijan na ola neim blanga detlot serramonimen hubin blowimbat detlot hon. deibin eliyakim, meiseiya, miniyamin, maikaiya, eliyeinai, sekaraiya en henanaiya,
english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

kriol: en mathusala bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kriol: wal ai lafta gobek langa main dedi en dalim im, "dedi, aibin dum nogudbala ting langa god en langa yu.
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, "Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

kriol: wen mi jinggabat detlot laiyawan mesinja, mi brabli nogudbinji, en mi sheiksheikbat nomo lilbit, jis laiga drangginbala, dumaji yawei bin tok strongbalawei langa detlot mesinja, garram im holiwan wed.
english: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahweh, and because of his holy words.

kriol: yu garra oldei duwit langa det king en nomo joinin garram najalot hu wandi gibit bekboun langa im. yu jidan klebabala if yu duwit lagijat langa im, en yu sabi det rait taim blanga dum enijing.
english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "main dedi nomo bin jandim mi blanga albumbat enibodi. oni ola isreil pipul, dumaji olabat jis laiga ship hubin gitbush brom olabat bos."
english: But he answered, "I wasn't sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel."

kriol: if enibodi dagat det fetpat blanga eni enimul weya deibin barnimap blanga ofring langa mi, wal im nomo blanga main pipul olabat.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

kriol: wal simiyan bin abum faibala san neim nemyuwel, jeimin, jarib, sera en shaul.
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

kriol: "isikiyel, detlot pipul hu jidan langa detlot taun weya deibin bitsimap langa isreil, olabat toktokbat, 'eibrahem im oni wanbala men, bat yawei bin gibit im holot dijan kantri. bigismob pipul jidan iya. wal dijan kantri im blanga wi.'
english: "Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, 'Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.'

kriol: "yu garra deigim eran en im sanmob langa det dowawei langa det seikridwan tent blanga main, en yu garra bringimap detlot serramoni klos, en det speshalwan oliboil, en wanbala yangwan boiwan buligi blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei, en det dubala dediwan ship, en det baskit garram damba weya im nomo garram raising.
english: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

kriol: bat det enami nomo pipul. mi fait langa laiyawan wed, en mi oldei bidim detlot laiyawan wed, en mi oldei tjakidawei ola praudbala wed weya stapam pipul brom sabi god, en mi oldei go shotkat langa detlot nogudbala wed weya pipul jinggabat, en mi oldei tenimran detlot wed blanga meigim olabat duwit langa det wed blanga jisas krais.
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

kriol: wal detlot wekinmen nomo bin sabi wanim imbin tokinabat, en deibin bradin blanga askim im blanga dalim olabat wanim imbin min.
english: But they didn't understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

kriol: wal ai garra lafta krai blanga ola pipul langa moweb en blanga detlot pipul brom det taun gulum kireres.
english: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.

kriol: neksdei na sambala juwish pipul bin midap, en deibin meigim plen blanga kilim pol ded, en deibin pramisim miselp nomo blanga dagat daga en dringgim enijing raidap dei garra kilim im ded.
english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

kriol: yubin gaburrumap im garram solwoda laik longwan dres, en woda bin gaburrumap ola bigwan hil.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

kriol: "ol yumob pipul hu jidan langa solwodasaid, yumob garra lafta krai en yumob lafta jampin langa yumob bout en krosoba det solwoda en gowei longwei brom iya.
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

kriol: en mosis bin deigim olabat atsaid brom det kemp blanga midim god, en deibin jandap gulijap langa det hil.
english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

kriol: brom deya jesabel bin raidimdan sambala leda en imbin sainim blanga king eiheb neim langa detlot leda. en jesabel bin yusum det ronwan mak blanga king eiheb langa detlot leda. afta na, imbin jandim detlot leda langa ol detlot olmen lidamob en langa ola haibala bos hubin jidan deya langa det taun gulum jesriyel.
english: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

kriol: en ol detlot pipul hu dumbat nogudbala ting nomo laigim det lait, en dei kaan kaman langa det lait, dumaji dei nomo wandim ola nogudbala ting weya dei dumbat garra shoum miselp.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn't come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

kriol: wal wan speshalwan mesinja bin go deya langa king eiheb en imbin tok, "dijan wanim yawei bin tok, 'dumaji detlot siriya mob bin tok mi det drimin blanga det hil kantri en ai nomo det drimin blanga ola opin kantri, wal tudei na ai garra larram yumob binijimap olabat bigwan ami, en yumob garra sabi mi na yawei det trubala god.'" lagijat na det speshalwan mesinja bin tok det wed brom yawei.
english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, "Yahweh says, 'Because the Syrians have said, "Yahweh is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys," therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahweh.'"

kriol: wal ai garra larram detlot ami brom najalot kantri kaman en fait langa detlot pipul hu jidan langa detlot taun weya dei oldei lukaftumbat det boda blanga moweb en langa detlot pipul hu jidan langa detlot thribala strongwan taun gulum bethjeshimoth, beilmiyon en kiriyathaiyim.
english: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, ai wandim yumob garra sabi dijan trabul weya mi abum tudei bin meigim det gudnyus spredat mowa en mowa,
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

kriol: nomeda yu haibala o lobalawan, en nomeda yu ritjwan o powan.
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

kriol: bambai na wen ola isreil solja bin ranimapbat detlot filastain solja, ola isreil solja bin brabli nokap, dumaji deibin brabli hanggri. bat dei nomo bin dagat eni daga, dumaji sol bin dalim olabat nomo blanga dagat eni daga raidap dei garra binijimap detlot filastain solja. imbin tok adbalawei langa olabat, "if enibodi dagat daga bifo wi binijimap detlot enami, wal im garra dai."
english: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, "Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies." So none of the people tasted food.

kriol: en yawei garra meigim yumob nomo sabi wanim yumob dumbat, en im garra meigim yumob blainwan en im garra meigim yumob brabli granggibala.
english: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

kriol: ola kau en beya garra jidan mijamet langa det grinwan gras, en ola lilwan beibi blanga olabat garra silip mijamet. ola laiyan en ola buligi garra dagat gras mijamet du.
english: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

kriol: wal nomo enijing rong langa det klebabalawei brom hebin, en detlot pipul hu bulurrum det klebabalawei brom hebin kaan meigimbat eni trabul, dumaji dei garra kain langa enibodi, en dei garra laigim olabat, en dei garra fil sori blanga olabat, en dei garra dumbat gudbala ting blanga olabat du. dei kaan toktok dubalawei en kadimatbat pipul jis fo najing.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

kriol: wal king deibid bin majurrumap ola najalot solja blanga im, en deibin go langa det taun reiba, en deibin fait langa detlot emanait pipul deya, en deibin bidim olabat, en deibin teikoba det taun blanga olabat,
english: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

kriol: wal detlot pipul hubin abum kemp gulijap langa im kemp bin luk imbin gudwan, en detlot najalot pipul hubin oldei luk im askimbat blanga mani bin luk imbin gudwan du, en deibin ol askim miselp, "dijan det seimwan blain men hubin oldei jidanbat eniweya askimbat blanga mani, indit?"
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, "Isn't this he who sat and begged?"

kriol: dumaji ai garra gibit ola pipul langa dijan kantri nogudwan bos. im kaan lukaftum detlot pipul jis laik det nogudwan stakmen kaan lukaftum ola ship. det stakmen nomo lukaftum detlot sikwan ship en im nomo lukabat detlot ship weya imbin lujim. wen samting ardim olabat im nomo meigim olabat gudwan en im nomo deigim detlot gudwan ship blanga daga en woda.
english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

kriol: wal josef bin go na blanga gaburrumap det dedbala.
english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

kriol: en imbin gibit wi det nyubalawei garram strongwan pramis. wen deibin oldei meigim detlot men brom det libai klen jidan serramonimen, god nomo bin meigim det strongwan pramis langa olabat.
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath.

kriol: god bin meigim yumob fri, en yumob garra jidan friwan. bat yumob nomo fri blanga dumbat olkain nogudbala ting. nomo. yumob garra jidan jis laiga wekinmen blanga god,
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
