english: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn't come near the other all night.

kriol: deibin go raidaran langa det taun wantaim, en afta deibin gobek langa olabat kemp. lagijat na deibin dumbat raidap langa det namba 6 dei.
english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

kriol: en imbin pudum olabat deya blanga jidan deitaim en naitaim en blanga kadimat det lait brom det dakbala. en wen imbin luk ebrijing bin gudwan, imbin gudbinji.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

english: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

english: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

english: "Also, when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father's house, in her youth,

english: "Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

english: "But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

kriol: imbin meigim det san shain deitaim. trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, 'Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.'

kriol: dei garra fogedabat detlot, jis laik deibin abum drim,
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

kriol: afta na yawei bin jingat brom ontop jis laiga thanda, en ebribodi bin irrim det brabli haibala god bin jingat,
english: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kriol: imbin swit tok, bat im hat bin abum det nogudwan filing blanga heidimbat. ebri wed blanga im bin jis laik oil, bat insaidwei detlot wed bin ardim jis laik shapwan naif.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

kriol: detlot pipul hu nomo sabi enijing kaan gajim enijing, dumaji dei oldei dumbat ola siliwan ting, bat detlot sabibala pipul garra sabi mowa, dumaji dei oldei dumbat ola gudwan ting.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

kriol: brom deya aibin lisin det boswan einjul blanga ola woda bin tok, "god, yu na brabli gudwan. yubin iya longtaim, en yu stil jidan. en yu oldei gibit ebribodi feyago. wal yubin jandim ol dislot trabul langa det kantri, dumaji ola pipul nogudwan.
english: I heard the angel of the waters saying, "You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

kriol: wal ai sabi dei kaan kilim mi ded, dumaji im mobeda mi jidan laibala en album yumob bilib mowa strongbalawei en jidan brabli gudbinjiwei.
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

kriol: wal wen detlot pipul bin luk det speshalwan klebabala ting weya jisas bin dum, deibin tok, "trubala dijan na det speshalwan mesinja weya god bin tok im garra jandim langa dijan kantri."
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, "This is truly the prophet who comes into the world."

kriol: detlot raunwan het en trasis weya dei oldei werrimon dei garra jidan gudwan matiriyal wulijim detlot serramonimen kaan swetgidap brom wekwekbat langa det serramoni pleis.
english: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

kriol: en wen jisas bin godan brom det bout, wanbala men bin kamat langa im. det men bin abum nogudbala spirit insaid langa im,
english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

kriol: "ai sabi yu garram loda wori. ai sabi yu nomo garram mani o enijing. bat nomeda, dumaji yu jidan ritjwan langa godwei. ai sabi detlot nogudbala pipul hu reken miselp juwish pipul. bat dei nomo god pipul. dei blanga seitin pipul. dei blanga det boswan dibuldibul. en ai sabi dei oldei spredimatbat yan blanga yu.
english: "I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

kriol: wal detlot klebabalamen blanga det king nomo bin kaman en shoum olabat pawa, dumaji deibin abum boil du seimwei laik ola najalot pipul blanga det kantri.
english: The magicians couldn't stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

kriol: yawei, yu jidan kainbala langa mi dumaji mi brabli nogudbinji. aibin kraikrai detmatj en mi brabli wikwan.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

kriol: mi jinggabat ol detlot dei weya bin binij, en mi jinggabat ebrijing weya yubin dum.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

kriol: wal ol yumob pipul, det wei blanga god im brabli gudwan, en yumob gin trastim detlot wed weya imbin tok. yawei im jis laiga shild blanga detlot pipul hu askim im blanga album olabat.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh's word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

kriol: en esta bin ensim im, "main king, if yu brabli gudbinji langa mi, en if yu lukaftum mi lagijat gudwei, wal larram mi jidan laibala. lagijat na mi wandim. en larram ol main pipul olabat jidan laibala du. lagijat na mi askim yu.
english: Then Esther the queen answered, "If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

kriol: wal najawan nambawan solja bin neim benaiya. imbin det san blanga jehoiyada brom det taun gulum kebsil, en imbin dum olkain breibwan ting. wantaim imbin kilim ded dubala brabli strongwan solja brom det kantri gulum moweb. en wen imbin kolwethataim, benaiya bin godan insaid langa wan hol weya laiyan bin oldei jidan, en imbin kilim det laiyan ded.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

kriol: detlot pipul brom jerusalem tok, "king nebakanesa brom bebalon bin bidim melabat en binijimap melabat deya langa jerusalem, jis laik imbin kadimap jerusalem en imbin dagat. imbin meigim det taun jidan emtiwan, nomo garram enijing, jis laik emtiwan botul, en jis laik det bigwan sneik weya bin julurum ebrijing imbin wandim. imbin deigim ebrijing imbin wandim, en imbin deigidawei melabat brom melabat ronwan kantri, jis laik imbin tjakidawei melabat.
english: "Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me. He has crushed me. He has made me an empty vessel. He has, like a monster, swallowed me up. He has filled his mouth with my delicacies. He has cast me out.

kriol: bos, yu oldei gud langa melabat en oldei larramgo melabat fri. en langa ol detlot hu oldei jingat langa yu, yu laigim olabat olagijawan.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

kriol: wi garra jinggabat wi braja en sista olabat blanga meigim olabat gudbinji en blanga meigim olabat bilib strongbalawei du.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

kriol: det serramonimen garra luk langa im. if detlot heya langa det spot bin meigim miselp waitwan en if imbin gro dipwan insaid langa det skin, tharran na wan brabli nogudwan skin siknis, weya bin stat wen imbin barn, det serramonimen garra dalim im, 'yu nomo klinbala blanga serramoni'.
english: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

kriol: olabat bin tok, "yawei bin dalim yumob blanga kadimat det kantri langa ola isreil pipul wen yumob tjakambat detlot speshalwan ston. en imbin dalim yumob blanga gibit det kantri langa det men gulum selafad langa im doda.
english: They said, "Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok langa aisaiya, "wal skai en graun yunbala lisin langa mi na. ol detlot biginini weya aibin growimapbat bin gibit bekboun langa mi na.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: "I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.

kriol: "yu garra meigim teibul blanga ofring garram det wud brom det wadultri. im garra jidan 0.9 mita longwei en 0.45 mita kroswei en 0.66 mita apendan,
english: "You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

kriol: mi nokap na en ai kaan dum enijing. mi jingat dumaji mi ardimbat detmatj en mi fil nogudbinji.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

kriol: nomo trai stapam mi na, dumaji ai garra binijimap olabat en nobodi kaan sabi langa olabat enimo. ai garra meigim yu det dedi blanga bigismob pipul weya garra jidan brabli strongbala, en mowa strongbala langa dislot pipul iya tudei.'
english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they."

kriol: dei nomo askimbat mi trubalawei blanga enijing. dei oldei jingat langa mi jis laik detlot najalot pipul oldei jingat langa olabat drimin. en wen dei oldei prei blanga meigim ola gadin gro gudwei blanga gibit olabat loda daga en wain, dei oldei kilim miselp blad kamat jis laik ol detlot najalot pipul oldei dumbat. dei oldei tenawei brom mi en dum detkain nogudbala ting na.
english: They haven't cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

kriol: yumob garra gitredi tumorro blanga fait langa olabat wen dei kaminap brom det beli gulum sis en yumob garra midim olabat gulijap langa det beli weya go raidap langa det bush kantri deya gulijap langa jeruwel,
english: Tomorrow, go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

kriol: bat langa det namba 5 yiya yumob gin dagat detlot frut daga na. if yumob dum lagijat detlot frut tri blanga yumob garra abum detmatj frut daga. wal mi na yawei det trubala god blanga yumob.
english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.

kriol: en wen detlot wekinmen bin gowei garram det bout langa det solwoda, det brabli strongbala win bin kaman brom sanraiswei en breigimap yu.
english: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

kriol: wal wen neibal bin tok lagijat, detlot yangmen bin gobek langa deibid, en deibin dalim im ebrijing wanim imbin tok,
english: So David's young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.

kriol: ai garra tjakidawei yu en ola fish langa det deset kantri, en nobodi garra berrim yu, en detlot wailwan enimul en ola bard garra dagadagat yu bodi wulijim ebribodi langa ijip garra sabi mi na yawei. "'yu en ol yu pipul olabat bin jidan jis laik det breikinwan wadi, en yumob nomo bin strongbala blanga album detlot isreil pipul wen deibin askim yumob.
english: I'll cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You'll fall on the open field. You won't be brought together or gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.

kriol: detlot shop menija brom ola kantri garra kraikrai en sori blanga bebalon du, dumaji nobodi garra jidan deya na en baiyim enijing brom olabat.
english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

kriol: kohath bin det dedi blanga emrem, isa, hebran, en yusiyel,
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kriol: en aibin ensim im, "bos, ai wandim yu jidan haibala bos olataim. mi nogudbinji dumaji mi jinggabat det kantri blanga main pipul olabat, en det taun weya ola greib blanga main grengrenfatha olabat jidan. ola solja bin breigimap det taun en deibin barnimap ola geit garram faiya."
english: I said to the king, "Let the king live forever! Why shouldn't my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?"

kriol: wal jehoiyada nomo bin wandi kilim kwin ethalaiya deya insaid langa det serramoni pleis, en imbin dalim ola boswan solja, "deigim im atsaid deya langa midul langa detlot solja en kilim ded enibodi hu trai blanga seibum im."
english: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, "Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword." For the priest said, "Don't kill her in Yahweh's house."

kriol: god bin dum ol detlot klebabala ting garram im pawa langa det plein kantri gulum sowan, langa det kantri ijip. en detlot femili blanga olabat bifo bin lukinat imbin dumbat.
english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

kriol: en ai garra bitsimap ola taun blanga yumob. en detlot kantri blanga yumob garra jidan wulijim deset kantri na. en yumob garra sabi mi na yawei det trubala god.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

kriol: en if yumob nomo kipgon jidan garram mi, wal god garra tjakidawei yumob jis laiga fama weya im tjakidawei detlot wadi weya nomo abum daga. afta detlot wadi oldei go draiwan, en det fama oldei gajimbat detlot wadi en tjakam olabat langa faiya, en detlot wadi oldei barnap.
english: If a man doesn't remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

kriol: en olabat bin oldei jinginatbat gija, 'holi, holi, holi! yawei im det boswan god. im garram mowa pawa langa enijing langa dijan wel.'
english: One called to another, and said, "Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!"

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin kipgon tok, "det taim na ai garra gibitbek ola gudbala ting langa main pipul olabat deya langa jerusalem en juda.
english: "For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

kriol: wal langa det namba 27 yiya wen asa bin jidan det king blanga juda, simri bin jidan det king blanga isreil blanga sebenbala dei deya langa det meinwan taun gulum taisa. dislot ting bin hepin seimtaim wen ola ami blanga isreil bin meigim kemp gulijap langa gibathan det wanbala taun deya langa filastain,
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

kriol: wal wen det moweb traib bin irrim det thribala king bin kaminap blanga fait langa olabat, king mesha bin majurrumap ola strongbala men blanga garrimap ola enijing blanga go en fait. brom deya deibin go gulijap langa det kantri gulum idam.
english: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

kriol: seraiya bin det san blanga hilkaiya en grensan blanga meshalam. sambala grengrenfatha blanga im brom bifo bin seidok, meraiyoth en ahitab hubin det haibala serramonimen.
english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God's house,

kriol: wal god bin wandi det lowa garra meigim wi jidan laibala.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

kriol: en ai nomo wandi gibit tjens langa olabat blanga tok praudbalawei, dumaji olabat nomo trubala speshalwan mishanri. olabat gemanwan, en dei dalimbat laiya blanga olabat wek, en dei meigim miselp luk jis laiga trubalawan speshalwan mishanri blanga jisas krais.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ's apostles.

kriol: brom deya bowes bin merrit langa ruth, en yawei bin brabli gudbinji blanga dubala. dubala bin silip, en afta ruth bin abum lilboi,
english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and Yahweh enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.

kriol: lagijat na deibin jinginatbat gudbinjiwei, "king sol bin kilim loda filastain solja ded. bat deibid bin kilim bigismob ded."
english: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands."

kriol: imbin pikimat jeikob en ola isreil pipul blanga im ronselp.
english: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

kriol: wal wotfo yumob kaan sabi? mi nomo dalimbat yumob blanga daga. mi dalimbat yumob blanga wotjim miselp blanga det nogudbalawei weya detlot serramonimen oldei dumbat!"
english: How is it that you don't perceive that I didn't speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

kriol: ol detlot ting na yu garra rabum garram det speshalwan oil en hendimoba olabat langa mi, en dei garra jidan brabli seikridwan na. en if enibodi tatjim olabat, detlot ting garra meigim im jidan seikridwan du.
english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

kriol: wal det men bin deigimbek mi langa det geit sanraiswei langa det serramoni pleis,
english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.

kriol: wal jisas bin gowei brom ol detlot pipul na, en imbin gowin insaid langa wan haus, en ola wekinmen blanga im bin kaman langa im, en deibin askim im, "yu dalim melabat wanim yubin tokinabat garram det stori blanga detlot rabishwan gras."
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, "Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field."

kriol: if det king gitwail wal maitbi im garra kilim sambodi ded, bat det sabibala men im oldei trai meigim det king jidan gudbinjiwei.
english: The king's wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

kriol: det shapwan pat blanga det erro garra go rait thru langa olabat bodi, en olabat garra brabli bradin na.
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

kriol: detlot brabli krulbala solja garra kilim ded ol detlot soljamob blanga yu, en ebrijing yubin abum dei garra bitsimap.
english: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.

kriol: wal dijan det lowa im blanga yumob en detlot pipul brom najalot kantri hu jidan langa yumob, dumaji mi na yawei det trubala god blanga yumob." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.'"

kriol: yu garra meigim miselp redi, en tumorro ailibala yu garra kaman langa mi ontop langa det hil gulum sainai.
english: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

kriol: "wal nomo longtaim na yumob kaan luk mi, en nomo longtaim afta yumob garra luk mi igin." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: "A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me."

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok, "mi na wanbala god. nomo eni drimin en nomo enibodi jidan wulijim mi. jinggabat wanim bin hepin longtaim.
english: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.

kriol: king deibid bin pikimat 2,700 gudwan lida brom det femili blanga jeraiya, en imbin meigim olabat boswan lida blanga rubin, ged en det sanraiswei manesa klen weya bin ol jidan sanraiswei langa jodan riba. olabat bin dum ol detlot wek blanga god en blanga det king.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers' households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

kriol: aibin gobek, dumaji god bin shoum mi ai garra gobek, en aibin abum miting garram ola juwish tjetj lidamob, en aibin dalim olabat blanga det gudnyus weya mi oldei dalimbat ola jintail pipul, dumaji ai nomo bin wandim olabat blanga tok aibin oldei dalimbat laiyawan wed langa detlot jintail pipul, en ai nomo bin wandim enibodi garra meigim det wek main nogud.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

kriol: yumob pipul hu oldei jidan langa det taun gulum diban, yumob kaan jidan haibala enimo, en yumob garra jidan langa graun langa det das, dumaji blanga moweb enamimob iya na, en olabat garra libum ola strongbala taun rabishwan.
english: "You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.

kriol: imbin tok, "ol yumob isreil pipul, mi na yawei det brabli holiwan god, en oni mi na wanbala gin seibum langa yumob. blanga yumob ronselp, aibin titjimbat yumob det gudbalawei, en aibin lidimbat yumob langa det raitwan roud blanga bulurrum mi.
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: "I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

kriol: ola yangmen garra gitkil langa det taun langa strit, en ola solja du garra ol binijap langa det dei na, dumaji mi na yawei bin tok blanga dijan.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets. All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day," says Yahweh.

kriol: "'yumob garra rispek en teiknodis langa yumob dedi en mami. mi na yawei det trubala god blanga yumob en yumob garra dum wulijim ebrijing gin jidan gudwan blanga yumob en yumob gin jidan longtaim langa det kantri weya ai garra gibit langa yumob.
english: "Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

kriol: en imbin meigim ol detlot men klebabala blanga dum olkainaba wek blanga meigim det seikridwan tent. dei garra kadimbat ston en dumbat olkain sheip en mindimbat enijing garram olkain matiriyal en wul.
english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

kriol: en mi tok gudei langa yubanas det wekinmen blanga jisas krais hubin oldei wek garram mi. en mi tok gudei langa main gudfren stakiyas.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

kriol: lagijat gin aibin meigim strongbala pramis langa main wekinmen deibid. im garra olweis abum biginini blanga jidan king, en aibin meigim strongbala pramis langa detlot serramonimen brom libai klen, wulijim olabat garra oldei wek blanga mi, en detlot strongbala pramis nobodi kaan neba breigim.
english: then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won't have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin tok, 'ai garra jidan kwaitbala en ai garra lukdan brom top brom main kemp, wulijim det san weya jidan ebri dinataim o wulijim detlot klaud wen im jidan langa det taim wen dei oldei gajimbat ola sid daga.
english: For Yahweh said to me, "I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."

kriol: en ola pipul bin bringimap sambala brom olabat sid daga, wain, en oil langa det haus weya deibin oldei kipum ola enijing.
english: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.

kriol: ola yangwan biginini oldei gibit mi bekboun en wen mi oldei wandim go gulijap langa olabat, dei oldei meigimbat fan langa mi.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

kriol: "wal yawei bin dalim detlot pipul brom najalot kantri blanga kaman en fait langa yumob. imbin blowin det longwan wisul, en olabat kaminap kwikbala.
english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

kriol: "haibala bos, wanim dislot men bin dum im nomo rait. olabat bin pudum jeramaiya insaid langa det wel weya im garra dai brom jidanbat hanggriwan, dumaji nomo eni daga iya langa dijan taun."
english: "My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city."

kriol: en det speshalwan bodi kaman biyain, dumaji god bin meigim det feswan edam brom graun. bat jisas krais det sekanwan edam bin kaman brom hebin.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

kriol: wal loda grinwan gras bin deya ebriweya, en jisas bin dalim im wekinmen olabat, "yumob meigim detlot pipul jidan." wal ol detlot pipul bin jidan deya, en det namba blanga ola men bin gulijap 5,000.
english: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

kriol: det loud brabli hebibala jis laik det sengraun weya jidan langa solwodasaid. ai kaan jinggabat wanim aibin tok basdam.
english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

kriol: enibodi hu shoum rispek langa yawei garra jidan gudbalawei en im bigininimob garra jidan seifwan du.
english: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

kriol: afta na det men bin dalim det gel, "yu gibit mi woda, dumaji mi thestiwan." en det gel bin opinim det wodabeig, en imbin gibit im milk brom det wodabeig blanga dringgim, en afta imbin blandim im igin,
english: He said to her, "Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty." She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

kriol: yu gitredi blanga luk mi feis du feis na. yu reken yu gin ensim ola kwestjan mi askim yu?
english: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

kriol: pipul trastimbat ola strongwan hosis, en ola solja hu nomo bradin blanga enijing langa fait, bat yawei nomo laigim detkain pipul.
english: He doesn't delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

kriol: en wen imbin stil toktokbat, jonathan det san blanga ebaiyatha, det serramonimen, bin kamat deya en edanaija bin tok, "kaman insaid. maitbi yu bringimap brabli gudwan nyus!"
english: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, "Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news."

kriol: wotfo mi jidan brabli nogudbinji? wotfo main hat im nomo opin? ai garra libum ebrijing langa god, en afta na ai garra preisim im. im main god, en im oldei seibum mi.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

kriol: afta tharran, gridibala en hanggribala pipul kaman en binijimap ola sid daga blanga olabat, en stilimbat ola ebrijing.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

kriol: en job bin abum sebenbala san, en thribala doda.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

kriol: bat ai nomo bin larram beilam singim yumob. nomeda imbin trai singim yumob, bat stil imbin gibit yumob gudbala wed blanga album yumob, en lagijat na aibin meigim yumob bidim det king.
english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

kriol: afta na wen deibin ol jandap deya, joshuwa bin ridim det buk garram ola lowa langa olabat, en imbin ridim ola gudbala wed en ola woning du.
english: Afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

kriol: imbin tok, "wantaim wan men bin go blanga plentimbat sid, en imbin tjakam detlot sid ebriweya, en sambala sid bin buldan langa roud weya ola pipul bin pudumbut en ola bard bin dagat.
english: "The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "wanim yumob reken? wen dei abum det padi blanga det men weya garra merrit, dei kaan jidan hanggribala wen im deya langa olabat. dei garra dagat.
english: Jesus said to them, "Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can't fast.

kriol: wal wen deibin barnimap det taun, joshuwa bin gibit woning langa ebribodi, "if enibodi bildimap dijan wol blanga dijan taun igin, wal yawei garra panishim im. det men weya im garra pudum det feswan ston langa dijan wol, im garra lujim im feswan san. en det men weya im garra meigim jandap det laswan ston blanga dijan geit, im garra lujim im laswan san."
english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, "Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates."

kriol: if biginini tridim im dedi nogudbalawei en im meigim im mami gowei brom im haus, im meigim im mami en dedi jidan sheimwan na.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

kriol: wal job bin ensimbek langa im waif, "yu tok jis laik det olgamen hu nomo bin sabi god. if wi abum gudbala ting brom god, wal wi garra abum trabul du." lagijat na job bin tok. im nomo bin grambul langa god.
english: But he said to her, "You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?" In all this Job didn't sin with his lips.

kriol: hu gin opinimap im mawus garram brabli shapwan tuth? nobodi! oni mi na!
english: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

kriol: "wal yumob jinggabat na. wen enibodi andimwei nogudwan spirit brom insaid langa sambodi, det nogudwan spirit garra go ebriweya lukabat pleis blanga jidan. en if det nogudwan spirit kaan faindim pleis blanga jidan, im garra tok miselp, 'ai garra gobek langa det seim sambodi weya aibin jidan basdam.'
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, 'I will turn back to my house from which I came out.'

kriol: yumob garra raidimdan dislot lowa langa yumob amben en langa yumob hedben en werrimon langa yumob am en hed, wulijim im garra meigimbat yumob jinggabat langa im lowa olataim.
english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

kriol: if dei prei langa mi en sori miselp en stap dumbat ola nogudbala ting, wal ai garra irrim brom top, en ai garra larramgo olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei, en meigim det kantri blanga olabat abum loda gudwan ebrijing igin.
english: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

kriol: wal basdam king nebakanesa bin fosim king sedakaiya blanga meigim pramis langa god neim blanga jidan trubala langa king nebakanesa. bat king sedakaiya bin gibit bekboun langa yawei det trubala god blanga ola isreil pipul, en imbin gibit bekboun langa king nebakanesa du.
english: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

kriol: wal bifo det fobala men bin kamat langa det siriya ami kemp yawei bin meigim detlot siriya solja irrim bigwan nois jis laik ola isreil ami bin kaminap garram ola hosis en bagi. deibin reken ola isreil pipul bin joinimap miselp garram det king brom ijip en det hitait king garram olabat ami blanga fait.
english: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, "Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us."

kriol: en im waif bin det doda blanga eiheb hubin det king blanga isreil bifo. en jehoram det king blanga juda bin tenawei brom yawei en imbin kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting jis laik det femilimob blanga king eiheb, en imbin oldei bulurrum det nogudbalawei blanga detlot king blanga isreil.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab's house, for he married Ahab's daughter. He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight.

kriol: bambai na jisas bin luk detlot wekinmen blanga im bin adwek pedulumbat det bout, dumaji det win bin blowim langa olabatwei. wal wen imbin longwei deilait bifo det san bin gidap, jisas bin wok ontop langa det woda. imbin wandi gopas langa im wekinmen olabat.
english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

kriol: "wal ol yumob isreil lida, yumob irrim mi na. yumob nomo oldei laigim tridimbat pipul raitwei, en yumob oldei tenimran det gudbalawei en meigim nogud.
english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

kriol: en yumob garra dagat langa main teibul deya langa main pleis, en yumob garra jidan langa detlot speshalwan tjeya blanga jidan bos langa det twelbala klen blanga ola isreil pipul." lagijat na jisas bin tok langa im wekinmen olabat wen deibin askimbat miselp wujan brom olabat garra jidan haibala langa olabat.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel."

kriol: yumob stap dumbat nogudbala ting wulijim yumob garra jidan gudwei. yumob nomo kopikopibat najalot pipul en yumob garra sabi blanga ola gudbala ting." lagijat na ola wekingel bin jinginatbat.
english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding."

kriol: nobodi kaan sabi wanim ol detlot ting detlot king oldei jinggabat. ola ting weya detlot king oldei jinggabat im jis laik dei go raidap langa skai en raitdan langa dipwan solwoda.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

kriol: blanga jonadeb bigininimob deibin dum wanim imbin dalim olabat, nomo blanga dringgimbat wain, en brom det taim na raidap tudei olabat nomo bin dringgimbat eni wain. bat aibin kipgon toktok langa yumob, bat yumob neba teiknodis langa mi.
english: "The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father's commandment; but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking, and you have not listened to me.

kriol: king jotham bin oldei meigim yawei gudbinji, jis laik im dedi bin dum, bat im nomo bin barnim gudsmelwan medisin deya langa det serramoni pleis laik im dedi bin dum. bat detlot pipul langa juda bin kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh's eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn't enter into Yahweh's temple. The people still acted corruptly.

kriol: bat det holi spirit bin meigim stibin tok sabibalawei, en detlot men nomo bin sabi hau dei garra tok,
english: They weren't able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

kriol: wal detlot filastain pipul bin fait brabli adbalawei na, en deibin bidim detlot isreil pipul brabliwei. deibin meigim olabat ranbek langa olabat ronwan kemp, en deibin kilim ded 30,000 isreil solja,
english: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

kriol: ebritaim wen god bin oldei kilim ded sambala pipul, det najalot bin oldei kambek langa im. deibin oldei libum olabat olbalawei en prei brabliwei langa im.
english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

kriol: if yu tridim detkain wuman en biginini nogudbalawei, en dei jingat langa yawei, wal im garra album olabat,
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

kriol: god, ai kaan haidim ol main nogudbalawei brom yu. yu sabi wen mi jidan nogudbala.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren't hidden from you.

kriol: en aibin tok, 'bos, hu yu?' en det sambodi bin tok, 'mi na jisas, en yu na bin oldei ardimbat mi.'
english: I answered, 'Who are you, Lord?' He said to me, 'I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.'

kriol: dislot enijing aibin gibit langa olabat. deibin weiyimap ebrijing en det silba bin 22 tan, detlot 100 silbawan enijing bin 70 kilogrem, det gol bin 3,400 kilogrem, detlot 20 golwan dish bin 8 kilogrem, en det 2 gudwan kopawan dish bin kos seim laik dubala golwan dish.
english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

kriol: wal yumob garra oldei albumbat miselp. ebridei yumob garra albumbat miselp en nomo weistimbat taim, dumaji wi nomo wandim det nogudbalawei blanga trikim enibodi en meigim im gibit bekboun langa god, dumaji wibin ol joinap garram jisas krais,
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called "today", lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

kriol: wal yawei det boswan god bin tok langa ola isreil pipul na, "yumob garra kadimat gija dijan kantri blanga yumob 12 difrin klen, en ola klen garra abum det seimsais len, bat josef klen garra gedim dubala len. longtaim aibin pramis blanga gibit dijan kantri langa yumob grengrenfathamob en olabat bigininimob, en blanga tharran na yumob garra gedimbek dijan kantri.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: "This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

kriol: deibin olredi teikoba ol detlot pipul brom detlot taun gulum kelno, kakamish, heimath, apad, sameriya en dameskas.
english: Isn't Calno like Carchemish? Isn't Hamath like Arpad? Isn't Samaria like Damascus?"

kriol: king nebakanesa bin deigimwei bigmob pipul prisana langa im ronwan kantri en imbin deigim ola san en doda blanga det king en ola boswan lidamob en ol detlot pipul hubin sabi hau blanga meigim difrindifrin ting, bat oni ola powan pipul imbin libum langa juda.
english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

kriol: olabat maitbi brabli ritjwan en brabli fetwan,
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

kriol: en wen detlot emanait soljamob bin luk detlot siriya soljamob bin ranawei, deibin ranawei brom ebishai, en deibin gobek insaid langa det taun blanga olabat. en wen jowab bin luk detlot emanait soljamob bin gobek insaid langa det taun, imbin dalim ola isreil soljamob blanga libum olabat, en deibin ol gobek langa jerusalem.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

kriol: jis laik wanim detlot yangmen bin dalim im blanga tok, "main dedi bin meigim yumob wek adbala, bat ai garra meigim yumob wek mowa adbala. main dedi bin yusum wip langa yumob, bat ai garra yusum brabli strongwan stokwip langa yumob."
english: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions."

kriol: imbin gedim wed weya yu deigimatbat detlot wul brom yu ship olabat, en imbin jandim melabat blanga dalim yu ola stakmen blanga yu bin deya langa melabat langa det deset kantri, en deibid bin tridim olabat gudbalawei, en olataim weya deibin iya langa dijan pleis weya dei jidan tudei, nobodi bin stilim enijing brom olabat.
english: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn't harm them. Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel.

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, ai wandi meigim yumob sabi brabli det gudnyus weya aibin dalimbat yumob basdam. wen yumob bin irrim det gudnyus, yumob bin bilib langa det gudnyus.
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

kriol: wal wen det mami en dedi blanga det lilboi jisas bin lisin det olmen tok lagijat blanga det lilboi, dubala bin brabli hatjamp.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

kriol: wal ola pipul deya langa jerusalem bin luk ol detlot ting weya detlot speshalwan mishanri bin dumbat, en deibin deigim ola sikbala pipul en libum olabat eniwei langa roud garram olabat sweig wulijim wen det speshalwan mishanri neim pida garra wokpas, maitbi det shedo blanga im garra tatjim olabat en meigim olabat gudwan.
english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

kriol: en yawei garra shoum detlot ljip pipul hu im, wulijim olabat garra sabi blanga weship oni langa im na. olabat garra bringimap sekrifais en ofring langa im, en olabat garra kipum olabat pramis langa im.
english: Yahweh will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know Yahweh in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to Yahweh, and will perform it.

kriol: ai nomo bin kipum det nyus blanga main ronselp. aibin dalim olabat blanga yu, "yawei, im oldei dum wanim imbin pramisim. im seibum wi brom olkain nogud ting." ai nomo bin jidan kwaitbala blanga det nyus, bat aibin dalim olabat, "yawei, im brabli kainbala, en im laigim wi olagijawan, en im oldei dum wanim imbin pramis." lagijat na aibin dalim ol detlot pipul.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

kriol: "wal det taim bin kaman na wen bebalon garra oni abum dibuldibul en detlot nogudwan spirit, en detlot bard weya nomo klinbala blanga serramoni. nomo eni pipul garra jidan deya igin, najing.
english: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation.

kriol: wal melabat bin kraikraibat langa yawei blanga album melabat. imbin irrim melabat en imbin jandim mesinja blanga lidim melabat brom ijip. tudei melabat langa keidish, det taun weya jidan langa det boda langa yu kantri.
english: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

kriol: en deibin gibit im det rolapwan peipa weya det speshalwan mesinja neim aisaiya bin raidimdan. wal jisas bin deigimat det peipa, en imbin faindim det rait pleis, en imbin ridim na.
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

kriol: yumob sabi? jisas krais na bin raidimdan det leda blanga melabat, dumaji im na bin tjeinjim yumob laif thru det wek weya melabat bin dum. en im nomo bin raidimdan det leda garram ink. imbin raidimdan det leda garram det holi spirit blanga det laibalawan god. en im nomo bin raidimdan det leda langa ston. imbin raidimdan det leda langa yumob hat.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

kriol: "nomo go langa det haus weya pipul abumbat padi. yu nomo jidan garram olabat blanga dagat o dringgim enijing.
english: "You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink."

kriol: en langa sauthwei langa juda, en langa det plein kantri na weya gulijap langa det kantri gulum sowa raidap langa jeriko. det taun na bin abum loda pamtri.
english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

kriol: wal det men bin meshurum det insaidwan kotyad en imbin 50 mita kroswei en 50 mita longwei. en aibin luk wanbala teibul blanga ofring bin jidan langa frant rait langa det serramoni pleis.
english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

kriol: wal ol detlot isreil pipul, ol detlot femili blanga jeikob bin jidan langa ijip langa det kantri gulum goshin, en deibin abum bigismob biginini olabat, en deibin jidan brabli ritjwan du.
english: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

kriol: if yu nomo duwit yu en yu pipul olabat garra dai langa wo en brom jidanbat hanggriwan en brom nogudwan siknis. lagijat na yawei bin dalim mi detkain ting na garra hepin langa eni pipul if im kaan wek blanga det king brom bebalon.
english: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

kriol: afta na jisas bin gobek langa gelali, en imbin abum pawa brom det holi spirit, en imbin spredimat det gudnyus blanga god ebriweya deya langa det kantri.
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

kriol: wal aibin sing dijan song. "yawei na bin meigim dijan wel garram im pawa, dumaji im brabli klebabala. imbin meigim ebrijing langa skai du.
english: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.

kriol: "if enibodi kaan gibit det nenigout o ship, wal im garra lafta bringimap dubala dab o dubala pijin langa mi blanga pei blanga det nogudbalawei weya imbin dumbat. wal det wanbala blanga im ofring blanga nogudbalawei, en det najawan blanga det barnapwan ofring.
english: "'If he can't afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to Yahweh; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

kriol: "ol yumob pipul hu meigim miselp lobala langa god, yumob garra gudbinji, dumaji yumob jidan blanga god, en im na garra meigim yumob haibala.
english: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kriol: yawei, yu lenim mi wanim detlot lowa blanga yu min, wulijim ai garra oldei teiknodis langa olabat.
english: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

kriol: bat detlot hu weshipbat enikain drimin garra nogudbinji detmatj. ai nomo wandi gibit blad ofring sekrifais langa detlot drimin, en ai nomo wandi gulum olabat neim.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

kriol: if ai bina dum lagijat, wal god bina panishim langa mi.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

kriol: olabat garra tok, 'moweb im brabli nogudwan dumaji det enamimob bin bidim wi. yumob kraikrai blanga wi kantri. yumob garra tok langa ebribodi weya jidan gulijap langa det anan riba. dalim olabat moweb bin binijap na.'
english: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

kriol: yu nomo bulurrum det wei blanga detlot nogudwan pipul, en yu nomo dum detlot nogudbala ting olabat dumbat.
english: Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of evil men.

kriol: detlot ritj pipul oldei jidan bos blanga ola powan pipul, en detlot hu oldei borobat mani, olabat jidan prisana blanga detlot hu oldei lendimbat olabat mani.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

kriol: deya na imbin libum det boks, en det boks bin jidan deya fo thribala mants, en yawei bin brabli gudbala langa det men en im femili olabat.
english: God's ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom's house and all that he had.

kriol: "bat ai garra larram sambala pipul jidan laibala en olabat garra jidan langa najawan kantri,
english: "'"Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

kriol: wal semyul bin tok, "yawei en det king weya imbin pikimat, dubala na bin irrim yumob tok yumob nomo bin faindim eni rong langa mi." wal detlot pipul bin tok, "yuwai, lagijat na yawei jidan witnis blanga melabat."
english: He said to them, "Yahweh is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand." They said, "He is witness."

kriol: brom deya god bin tok, "larram samting jidan blanga kadimat det woda en meigim det woda jidan miselpmiselp."
english: God said, "Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters."

kriol: "wal det dubala hon blanga det boiwan ship, dubala shoum yu blanga det dubala kantri gulum midiya en pesha.
english: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

kriol: brom deya wan strongwan einjul bin gajim det bigwan granding ston, en imbin tjakamdan det ston adbala rait langa midul langa solwoda, en wen imbin tjakamdan det ston lagijat, imbin tok, "lagijat na dei garra tjakamdan dijan iya taun gulum bebalon, en nobodi kaan luk langa det taun enimo na.
english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, "Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

kriol: en det dei na, detlot pipul bin brabli gudbinji wen deibin dagadagat daga en dringgimbat en yawei bin deya garram olabat. wal dijan na det sekantaim deibin meigim salaman king. en langa det neim blanga yawei, deibin spilim oliboil langa im hed. en deibin meigim seidok jidan det serramonimen blanga olabat.
english: and ate and drank before Yahweh on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before Yahweh to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

kriol: "detlot serramonimen garra oldei titjimbat main pipul olabat wanim im seikridwan en wanim im nomo seikridwan en wanim klinbala en wanim nomo klinbala blanga serramoni.
english: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

kriol: amasaiya bin 25 yiya ol wen imbin jidan king. imbin jidan langa jerusalem en imbin king blanga juda 29 yiya. blanga im mami bin neim jehoyadin en imbin brom jerusalem.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

kriol: yawei, gudbinjiwei ai garra gibit yu sekrifais ofring. ai garra preisim yu neim dumaji yu gudwan.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

kriol: bat detlot pipul hu jidan brabli nogudwan garra wokwokbat jis laik blainwan en olabat nomo sabi weya olabat garra go. dei gin oni gidawei brom olabat trabul wen olabat dai." lagijat na sofara bin tok.
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit."

kriol: bat det soltiwan graun weya im jidan olawei wansaid langa det woda garra oldei jidan soltiwan wulijim detlot pipul garra yusumbat det solt.
english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

kriol: ol detlot pipul hu oldei kadimbat wud, en detlot pipul hu oldei meigim golwan ting, en detlot najalot wekinmenmob, yumob garra oldei tok gija gudwei en dalim miselp, 'wibin dum brabli gudwan wek.' afta tharran, olabat garra neilimap det drimin sheip langa wadi, wulijim im kaan buldan."
english: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, "It is good;" and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.

english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

english: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and God's Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News."

kriol: bat stil yumob kaan kaman langa mi blanga gedim det olagijawan laif.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

kriol: dislot fobala brabli lilwan enimul jidan langa dijan wel, bat olabat brabli klebawan.
english: "There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.'"

english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

kriol: afta na yawei bin tok langa jeihu, "yubin dum ebrijing weya aibin dalim yu blanga dum langa ol det femilimob blanga king eiheb. wal ai meigim dijan pramis langa yu. wanbala brom yu femilimob garra oldei jidan king blanga isreil. im garra hepin lagijat raidap langa yu grengrensan olabat."
english: Yahweh said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab's house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."

kriol: wal wandei jonadeb bin luk emnon bin nogudbinji, en imbin askim im, "nomeda yu san blanga det king, bat stil ebridei mi oldei luk yu nogudbinji. wanim rong langa yu?" wal emnon bin tok, "mi laigim teima det sista blanga main braja ebsalom, en mi wandim im brabli."
english: He said to him, "Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won't you tell me?" Amnon said to him, "I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister."

kriol: basdam sambala men bin ridim det lowa blanga yawei, olabat god blanga 3 awa, en blanga najawan 3 awa afta tharran ola pipul bin onap blanga olabat nogudbalawei en deibin weship yawei det trubala god blanga olabat.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped Yahweh their God.

english: Then the king said to me, "What is your request?" So I prayed to the God of heaven.

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, yumob nomo wandim slekbek. yumob garra weit en jandap strongbala raidap jisas krais det bos blanga wi garra kambek. wal yumob jinggabat det fama. wen im plentim ola sid langa graun, im kaan meigim det daga kamat streidawei. im garra weit raidap det rein buldan blanga meigim det daga kamat.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

kriol: wal wen king salaman bin binij ola detlot wek langa det serramoni pleis imbin pudum ola ebrijing weya im dedi deibid bin gibit langa yawei langa ola stowa rum deya langa det serramoni pleis. imbin pudum detlot silba, gol en ola enijing langa detlot rum na.
english: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in Yahweh's house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of Yahweh's house.

kriol: afta na jisas bin dalim olabat dijan wed du, "yu kaan breigim nyuwan klos blanga mindimap olwan klos. if yu dum lagijat, wal yu meigim det nyuwan klos nogud, en dubala kaan luk gud na.
english: He also told a parable to them. "No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

kriol: brom deya det sekanwan einjul bin spilimat im dish langa solwoda na, en det solwoda bin go blad. en det blad langa det solwoda imbin thikwan laiga ded pipul blad, en ebrijing weya bin jidan langa solwoda bin binij.
english: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

english: Yahweh said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered Yahweh, and said, "From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it."

kriol: detlot geit bin feising ebriwei, nowathwei, sauthwei, sanraiswei en sangodanwei, en ebri geit bin abum boswan wekinmen.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin dalim mosis en eran blanga detlot isreil pipul na, wujei dei garra pudumap olabat ronwan kemp gulijap langa olabat ronwan fleig. ebri klen grup garra jidan gulijap langa olabat ronwan fleig. det libai klen garra oldei pudumap olabat kemp raidaran langa det seikridwan tent. en det najalot klen garra kemp raidaran langa det libai klen.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kriol: enibodi hu tatjim det dedwan bodi en nomo washim miselp, im jidan nomo klinbala blanga serramoni, dumaji det woda meigim im brabli klinbala blanga serramoni im nomo bin spil oba langa im. imbin meigim nogud det seikridwan tent blanga yawei, en im kaan jidan blanga god pipul enimo.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn't purify himself, defiles Yahweh's tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

kriol: brabli adbala deibin jinginat, en deibin deigimat olabat klos, en deibin meigim ola das gidap detmatj.
english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

kriol: en yu garra meigim dubala longwan pol garram det wadultri blanga garrimap det teibul, en yu garra gaburrumap det dubala pol garram gol.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

kriol: en ola gudwan enijing blanga yumob garra binijap. ol detlot insek garra dagat ola gudwan klos blanga yumob,
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

kriol: nomeda ola brabli nogudbala pipul jidan haibala blanga lilwail, bat olabat garra gowei olagijawan, en olabat jidan laik det gras weya sambodi kadimbat, en afta na im draiyap en dai.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

kriol: yumob nomo meigim olabat gibitbek ol detlot sid daga, wain o oliboil, ola ebrijing weya olabat bin gajimbat brom yumob. en yumob garra gibitbek ola graun weya dei growimap ola sid daga en frut daga, en olibtri en ola haus streidawei." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them."

kriol: bat wen ai go langa eni tjetj miting pleis, ai wandim ola pipul garra sabi brabli wanim mi toktok. en blanga tharran na ai kaan toktok detmatj wed garram difrinkain langgus weya nobodi sabi wanim mi toktok. nomo. im mobeda ai toktok lilbit wed garram odinri langgus weya pipul sabi.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

english: They shall tell the elders of his city, "This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard."

english: "Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

english: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

english: Samuel said to Saul, "I will not return with you; for you have rejected Yahweh's word, and Yahweh has rejected you from being king over Israel."

They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

english: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

english: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her into David's city until he had finished building his own house, Yahweh's house, and the wall around Jerusalem.

english: You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

english: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, 'We are utterly ruined! My people's possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!'"

english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

english: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

english: saying: "We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

english: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king's delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

english: Because it is contained in Scripture, "Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed."

english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

english: But we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

english: Let's therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

kriol: bat bebalon im binij na. pipul lafta krai blanga im, en gajim medisin blanga im sowa, en maitbi im garra gitbeda.
english: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.

kriol: nomo enijing iya langa dijan graun wulijim im. labaiyathan nomo sabi bradin langa enijing.
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kriol: bat maitbi yu nomo bilib mi jidan garram main dedi en main dedi jidan garram mi." lagijat na jisas bin tok langa filip. afta na jisas bin kipgon tok langa ol im wekinmen olabat, "ol dislot wed weya aibin dalim yumob nomo bin kaman brom mi. dislot wed bin kaman brom main dedi, dumaji main dedi jidan garram mi, en im na dum ol detlot wek blanga im.

english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, "This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

english: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, "Come! Let's return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us."

kriol: en im oldei wotjimbat mi blanga enijing ai dumbat.
english: Doesn't he see my ways, and count all my steps?

kriol: bat god im brabli kainbala, en im laigim wi detmatj,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

english: "'Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: "Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you," says the Lord Yahweh.

english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

english: In his teaching he said to them, "Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

english: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don't be afraid. Don't be discouraged."

english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

kriol: god, yubin lidim yu pipul olabat jis laiga stakmen wen yubin pikimat mosis en eran blanga lidimbat yu pipul olabat.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kriol: wal yu garra pudumdan langa buk ola neim blanga detlot widogel hu nomo garram enibodi blanga maindimbat olabat, en det tjetj garra lukaftumbat ol detlot widogel hu garram olabat neim langa det buk. yu kaan pudumdan enibodi neim langa det buk. oni detlot widogel hubin gajimap 60 yiya en hubin trubala langa olabat hasbin en hubin oldei dumbat olkain gudbala ting weya ola pipul bin sabi.
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

kriol: maitbi ai garra dai if ai dalim god ai wandim tok langa im.
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

kriol: wal yunbala luk det lilwan taun deya gulijap? yunbala larram mi go en jidan deya na langa det lilwan taun, wulijim ai kaan dai deya."
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn't it a little one?), and my soul will live."

kriol: en sambala pipul blanga det libai klen, brom det dubala femili gulum kohath en kora bin jandap en jinginat brabli adbala en deibin preisim yawei det trubala god blanga ola isreil pipul.
english: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.

kriol: blanga kadimat ola kantri, yu garra tjakambat detlot speshalwan ston, en yu garra gibit ol detlot bigis pat langa detlot klen hu jidan blendibala pipul, en yu garra gibit ol detlot lilbit pat langa detlot klen hu jidan lilbit pipul." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

kriol: "bambai im garra brabli nogud blanga yumob. yumob grengrenfatha olabat bin oldei kilimbat ded ola speshalwan mesinja blanga god, en afta yumob oldei abum serramoni blanga makam detlot greib blanga detlot mesinja.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

kriol: en king deibid bin dalim im, "if yu kaman garram mi, yu kaan album mi.
english: David said to him, "If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;

kriol: yu panishim olabat brabliwei en meigim olabat brabli nogudbinji.
english: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

kriol: wal det insaidpat bin 27 mita long, en 9 mita kroswei en 13.5 mita apendan.
english: The house which King Solomon built for Yahweh had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

kriol: yumob garra dalim olabat blanga ran kwikbala streit langa jerusalem, en blandim miselp langa seifwan pleis, dumaji ai garra jandim brabli nogudbala ting brom nowathsaid blanga bitsimap ebrijing.
english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don't wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction."

kriol: wal mathusala bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 187 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim leimek,
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

kriol: yu garra jidan adbala bos blanga ol yu enami olabat. yu garra beldim olabat garram det aiyanwan wadi. yu garra tjakamdan olabat en breikimap olabat jis laik wen sambodi tjakamdan botul en im bitsap.'"
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel."

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "ebribodi hu dringgim woda brom dijan wel garra thesti igin.
english: Jesus answered her, "Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

kriol: en im garra peiyimbek ebribodi blanga ola enijing weya deibin dumbat. im garra peiyimbek nogudbala ting langa detlot pipul hubin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, en im garra peiyimbek gudbala ting langa detlot pipul hubin oldei dumbat gudbala ting.
english: who "will pay back to everyone according to their works:"

kriol: wal detlot bout blanga hairam weya bin bringimap bigismob gol brom det kantri gulum ofiya, bin bringimap bigmob junipa timba en ola purdiwan ston du.
english: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.

kriol: en wen imbin lisin pida bin jingat, imbin sabi im, en imbin gudbinji. bat im nomo bin opinim det dowa. imbin ranbek en dalim detlot najalot bilibamob. imbin tok, "pida im deya atsaid."
english: When she recognized Peter's voice, she didn't open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin tok, "ol yumob serramonimen en isreil pipul, yumob irrim mi na. en yumob femili blanga det king, yumob lisin langa mi du, dumaji ai garra jadjim ol yumob na. yumob bin trikim ola pipul en yumob bin meigim olabat bulurrum det nogudbalawei blanga yumob. im jis laik yumob bin meigim trep langa det taun gulum mispa blanga gajim ola pipul. en im jis laik yumob bin meigim net spredat ontop langa det hil gulum teibowa blanga gajim ola pipul.
english: "Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

kriol: olabat garram brabli adwan hat, jis laik kopa en aiyan. en olabat nomo trubala. olabat oldei go en spredimatbat detlot laiyinbala wed.
english: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.

kriol: en sambala fish en ebrijing insaid langa solwoda bin binij, en sambala brom detlot bout weya bin flout ontop langa solwoda bin barnap du.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

kriol: nomo. god im oldei rait, dumaji if im nomo rait, wal im kaan jadjim ebribodi langa dijan wel.
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

kriol: en nomeda wi dumbat olkain difrinwan wek blanga det bos blanga wi, bat stil oni wanbala brabliwan bos im jidan.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

kriol: wal maitbi sambala pipul reken mi nomo speshalwan mishanri blanga olabat. bat mi speshalwan mishanri blanga yumob, dumaji yumob bin bilib langa jisas krais thru det wek weya aibin dalimbat yumob det gudnyus. yumob pruf mi jidan speshalwan mishanri.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

kriol: wal wen ebigeil bin irrim det wekinmen tok lagijat, streidawei imbin gajim bigismob daga blanga deigim langa deibid. imbin gajim 200 damba, 2 skinbeig ful garram wain, 5 kukwan ship, 17 kilogrem kukwan sid daga, en bigmob detkain daga dei gulum reisan en fig. afta na ebigeil bin loudimap detlot daga langa sambala dongki,
english: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

kriol: brabliwei ai wandim main pipul olabat blanga lisin langa mi. if dei bina duwit langa mi,
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

kriol: en jeikob bin tok, "aibin wokabat langa kantri tumeni yiya, 130 yiya. ai nomo bin jidan longtaim, nomo laik main grenfatha olabat bin jidan. bat aibin abum lilbit raftaim, bobala."
english: Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage."

kriol: im mobeda blanga jidan powan en trubala, den blanga jidan ritjwan en laiyinbala.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

kriol: en god bin gitwail langa olabat en imbin tjakidawei olabat.
english: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

kriol: wal ol detlot men hubin deya garram sol bin jandap deya kwaitbala nomo tok, dumaji deibin irrim det sambodi tok langa sol. bat dei nomo bin luk langa im.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

kriol: "det taim wen ai garra kambek garra jidan jis laik det taim blanga lot det san blanga eibrahem braja. ebribodi bin kipgon dagadagat daga en dringgimbat en baiyimbat enijing en selimbat enijing en plentimbat gadin en bildimbat haus.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

kriol: dijan wel garra jidan brabli nogudwan, dumaji ola pipul bin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting langa god. olabat bin breigim det speshalwan pramis weya deibin meigim garram im.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok, "meigim det roud streitwan en redibala blanga main pipul olabat blanga kambek.
english: He will say, "Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people."

kriol: wal jisas bin sabi wanim detlot lowamen bin jinggabat, en imbin tok langa olabat, "wotfo yumob jinggabat detkain ting?

kriol: afta na besalel bin meigim det pol blanga lemp garram gudwan gol. imbin meigim det pol en ebrijing langa det pol garram wanbala gudwan gol.
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

english: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.

kriol: god, mi preisim yu. nomo jidan kwaitbala!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don't remain silent,

english: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.
