english: Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?"

kriol: main gudfren olabat, if god bin laigim wi lagijat, wal wi garra laigim gija du.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

english: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can't touch their garments.

english: You have said, 'It is vain to serve God,' and 'What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?

english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

kriol: yubin stap gitwailbat langa olabat en yubin holdimbek yuselp.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

kriol: en det seim nait yawei bin kamat langa im, en imbin tok, "mi na det god blanga yu dedi eibrahem. en yu nomo wandi bradin blanga enijing, dumaji ai garra albumbat yu en jidan garram yu olataim. en ai garra gibit yu bigmob san en grensan du, dumaji aibin meigim pramis garram eibrahem det wekinmen main." lagijat na god bin tok.
english: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, "I am the God of Abraham your father. Don't be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham's sake."

english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, "What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me."

kriol: detlot grenfatha en grenmatha oldei gudbinji blanga olabat grenkid, en ola biginini oldei gudbinji blanga olabat mami en dedi.
english: Children's children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

english: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.

kriol: "mi abumbat detmatj pein jis laik det wuman weya im garra abum im beibi. mi hatjamp en mi garram detmatj pein, ai kaan irrim en luk gudwei, najing.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can't hear. I am so dismayed that I can't see.

kriol: detlot wailwan dongki jandapbat ontop langa detlot hil, en olabat brabli nokap, nomo garram win, jis laik det wailwan dog gulum jekal. olabat kaan luk gudwei du, dumaji olabat nomo garram eni daga blanga dagat.
english: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.

kriol: wal det taim bin kaman blanga yawei det trubala god blanga deigimwei ilaija langa skai garram bigis wiliwili. ilaija en ilaisha bin go brom det taun gulum gilgel.
english: When Yahweh was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

kriol: wal job bin kipgon tok, "main fren olabat, mi brabli nogudbinji. maitbi nomeda ai nomo rispek det boswan god brabliwei enimo, bat yumob garra stil kain langa mi.
english: "To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

kriol: wen mi oldei abum trabul en gulijap dai, im oldei seibum mi. im kain langa mi, en im laigim mi detmatj.
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

kriol: ailibala neksdei wen king deibid bin gidap, ged bin go langa im, en imbin dalim im blanga det wed weya yawei bin gibit im, "wal yu garra pikimat wujan yu wandim god blanga dum. yu wandim god garra meigim dijan kantri jidan nomo garram rein en nomo garra daga fo 3 yiya? o yu wandim god garra meigim yu enami olabat rijimbat yu fo 3 mants? o yu wandim god garra meigim bigiswan siknis kaman langa dijan kantri fo 3 deis? yu garra jinggabat detlot thribala ting na, en yu garra dalim mi wujan yu wandim mi blanga dalim yawei blanga dum." lagijat na ged bin tok.
english: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, "Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days' pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me."

kriol: god na bin bringimat olabat brom ijip garram strongwan pawa jis laik wailwan buligi.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

kriol: en im nomo bin abum pawa blanga meigim enibodi jidan raitwei garram god. en god bin gibit wi mobedawei blanga kaman langa im,
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim meri, "nomo holdim mi, dumaji ai nomo bin gobek langa main dedi langa top. bat yu gobek en dalim main braja en sista olabat ai garra gobek langa main dedi. en yu dalim olabat main dedi im blanga yumob dedi du, en main god im blanga yumob god du."
english: Jesus said to her, "Don't hold me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, 'I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'"

kriol: moweb, yu jinggabat hau yubin oldei meigimbat fan langa detlot isreil pipul. yubin oldei tridimbat olabat jis laik deibin rabishwan.
english: For wasn't Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

kriol: en wen semsan bin shoum miselp langa det padi pleis, detlot filastain pipul bin gibit im 30 yangmen blanga jidan deya garram im,
english: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

kriol: "yumob nomo lau blanga bulurrum eni drimin. oni mi na.
english: "You shall have no other gods before me.

kriol: yumob bin luk detlot brabli nogudwan drimin sheip blanga olabat, weya deibin meigim detlot brom wud, ston, silba en gol.
english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

kriol: "wal yumob garra wotjim miselp, dumaji mi dalimbat yumob ebrijing bifo det taim garra kaman.

english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

kriol: blanga yu mami bin jidan wulijim det greiptri. imbin grogrobat wansaid langa riba. loda woda bin deya, en imbin abum bigismob bushis en frut daga.
english: "'Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

kriol: ai nomo bulurrum det nogudbalawei, dumaji ai wandi duwit langa yu wed.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

kriol: en bambai ebritaim wen imbin oldei gowin insaid langa det seikridwan tent weya yawei bin oldei jidan, bifo imbin gowin blanga tok langa im, imbin oldei deigimat det heinggitjif, en wen imbin oldei kamat brom deya, imbin oldei dalim detlot isreil pipul ebrijing wanim yawei bin oldei dalim im blanga tok,
english: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

kriol: jeikob bin deigim neftali det najawan san blanga im garram im fobala boi neim jasiyel, gunai, jesa en shilam.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

kriol: wal jisas krais bin gibit ebribodi weya imbin pikimat ola difrinwan speshalwan wek jis laik god im tok langa oltestaman.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

kriol: im garra jidan brabli trubala men, en im garra oldei gibitbat feyago langa ebribodi.
english: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

kriol: melabat grengrenfatha olabat bin oldei trastimbat yu. olabat bin trastim yu en yubin seibum olabat.
english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

english: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kriol: en imbin tok, "mi fil sori blanga dislot pipul, dumaji deibin jidan iya garram mi 3 dei, en dei nomo garram eni daga blanga dagat na.
english: "I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

kriol: main god, meigim mi nyu insaid. meigim mi jinggabat blanga ola gudwan ting.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim im, "yu go na, dumaji yu san im gudbala." wal det gabman bos bin bilib det wed blanga jisas, en imbin gowei.
english: Jesus said to him, "Go your way. Your son lives." The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

kriol: melabat yangwan sista im stil fletwan laiga wol. melabat garra lafta meigim im purdiwan laiga haiwan haus garram silba. en melabat yangwan sista im stil fletwan laiga dowa. melabat garra lafta meigim im purdiwan jis laik det sidatri wud weya dei meigim purdiwan.
english: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

kriol: en imbin dalim eibrahem, "dijan kantri im blanga mi. bat yu gin kemp eniweya yu wandim."
english: Abimelech said, "Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you."

kriol: bat det feswan wekinmen nomo bin gibit im taim, en deibin pudum im langa jeil blanga meigim im peiyimbek im det mani.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

kriol: en dei garra stat singsingbat song en preisimbat langa mi. nomeda weya yumob jidan, mi na yawei garra album yumob en meigim yumob jidan gudbinjiwei.
english: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near," says Yahweh; "and I will heal them."

kriol: en det dediwan bin tok, "brom beibitaim. lodataim det dibuldibul bin tjakambat im langa faiya en langa woda blanga trai en kilim im. bat if yu gin dum enijing, wal yu sori langa melabat en album melabat."
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us."

kriol: en wen yu dai en dei berrim yu garram yu grengrenfatha olabat, wal god garra meigim wanbala san blanga yu jidan king, en im garra meigim det san blanga yu jidan strongbala king.
english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

kriol: en deibin bringimap det seikridwan boks garram lid en dubala pol en ketin blanga jadimap det boks weya dei garra pudum det dubala fletwan ston garram ola lowa,
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

kriol: en det haibala serramonimen garra deigim sambala blad blanga det buligi langa det seikridwan tent,
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

kriol: bat stil yumob kaan bilib langa mi, dumaji yumob nomo main ship.
english: But you don't believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

kriol: ai garra meigim pramis blanga lukaftumbat en kipum olabat seifwan.
english: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down," says the Lord Yahweh.

kriol: god, wen yu irrim melabat preya yu oldei dum ola brabli gudbala ting en seibum melabat. pipul langa ebri kantri en brom najasaid langa solwoda du trastimbat yu, god.
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, ai dalim yumob. dijan gudnyus weya mi oldei dalimbat ebribodi nomo bin kamat brom men. imbin kamat brom god.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

kriol: wujei yu dai, ai garra dai deya du. en wujei dei garra gaburrumap yu, dei garra gaburrumap mi deya du. ai kaan larram enijing kadimat yunmi. if yu dai, orait. det ting im garra kadimat yunmi. bat if ai libum yu miselp, wal yawei garra panishim mi brabli." lagijat na det gel bin tok.
english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me."

kriol: wi sabi tharran, dumaji god nomo bin tok langa eni einjul lagijat, "yu na main san, en tudei na ai garra jidan dedi blanga yu." en im nomo bin tok blanga eni einjul lagijat, "ai garra jidan dedi blanga im, en im garra jidan main san."
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, "You are my Son. Today I have become your father?" and again, "I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?"

kriol: wal yumob garra wokaran langa dijan deset kantri blanga 40 yiya, dumaji yumob bin lukaran det kantri aibin pramis yumob blanga 40 dei. yumob garra wokaranbat blanga 40 yiya, en yumob garra sabi wanim im laik wen ai panishim yumob.
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.'

kriol: bat if yumob kaan dalim mi wanim det stori min, wal yumob garra gibit mi gudwan matiriyal en gudwan klos." lagijat na semsan bin tok. wal detlot men bin tok, "wal gowan. yu dalim melabat det stori."
english: but if you can't tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing." They said to him, "Tell us your riddle, that we may hear it."

kriol: nomo larram olabat tok gija lagijat, "gudjob! im binij na! wibin meigim im gowei na! lagijat na wibin wandim!"
english: Don't let them say in their heart, "Aha! That's the way we want it!" Don't let them say, "We have swallowed him up!"

kriol: wen deibin kamat langa det hil weya ilaisha bin jidan, gehasi bin gajim det dubala beig en imbin garrimap insaid langa det haus, en imbin jandimbek det dubala wekinmen blanga neiman.
english: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.

kriol: en deibin askim jisas kwestjan blanga tharran, dumaji deibin wandi trai en trikim im. deibin tok, "titja, mosis bin gibit melabat wan lowa weya im tok if eni men dai en im waif nomo bin abum biginini, wal det dedbala men braja garra gajim det gel en merrit langa im wulijim im garra abum biginini hu garra jidan jis laik im bigininimob.
english: saying, "Teacher, Moses said, 'If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.'

kriol: wal aibin tok, "wal det taim im kaminap na wen yawei det trubala god garra meigim dijan kantri brabli gudwan igin en abum loda daga, en detlot isreil pipul hu stil jidan laibala garra jidan brabli gudbinji wen olabat kantri garra abum loda frut daga en sid daga.
english: In that day, Yahweh's branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

kriol: wal arauna bin tok, "bos, yu gin abum dijan iya pleis, en yu gin abum enijing yu wandim blanga gibit ofring langa yawei. iya na det dubala buligi main. yu gin deigim dubala blanga det ofring weya yu garra barnim. en iya det yok blanga dubala en det bowad weya aibin oldei yusum blanga deigimat det rabishwan gras. yu gin deigim blanga meigim det faiya." lagijat na arauna bin tok,
english: Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

kriol: en denyul bin dalim olabat blanga prei langa god langa top, en askim im blanga jidan kainbala en album olabat en shoum olabat wanim det drim im min wulijim olabat en detlot najalot klebabala en doktabala kaan dai.
english: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

kriol: detlot pipul weya mi laigim olabat, mi oldei tok streidat langa olabat, en wen dei dumbat nogudbala ting, mi oldei panishim olabat. "wal yu garra teiknodis na en tenim miselp brom ola nogudbala ting.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

kriol: en imbin luk wan men brom det kantri bin beldimbat wanbala kantrimen blanga im. wal mosis bin wandi album im kantrimen, en imbin kilim det ijip men ded.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

kriol: yu irrim olabat preya brom yu kemp langa top en yu ensim olabat, wulijim ola pipul langa dijan wel garra sabi yu en duwit langa yu, jis laik yu pipul olabat dumbat. en wulijim dei garra sabi dijan serramoni pleis aibin bildimap, im det pleis weya dei garra oldei weshipbat langa yu.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

kriol: wal joshuwa bin meigim miselp redibala na. imbin pikimat 30,000 brabli gudwan solja, en wen imbin naitaim, imbin jandim olabat lida blanga blandim miselp.
english: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

kriol: "wal ai garra dalim yumob najawan stori blanga shoum yumob hau ai garra gibit prais langa ola pipul wen ai garra kambek. wantaim wan men bin wandi gowei wokabat longwei, en imbin jingat langa im thribala wekinmen olabat, en imbin dalim olabat blanga maindimbat ola ebrijing blanga im,
english: "For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

kriol: en yawei bin tok, "dijan im dalim yu, dubala traib garra kamat brom det dubala boi, en det dubala traib kaan jidan gudfren. wanbala traib garra jidan brabli strongwan, en det bigwan boi garra wek blanga im lilwan braja." lagijat na god bin tok.
english: Yahweh said to her, "Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger."

kriol: en yumob garra kipgon adwek blanga meiksho god garra seibum yumob holot, dumaji god na oldei wek langa yumob laif. im na meigim yumob abum det filing blanga duwit langa im, en im meigim yumob dum wanim im wandim yumob blanga dum.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

kriol: en imbin tok, "im na jon beptis, bat imbin gidap laibala igin."
english: and said to his servants, "This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him."

kriol: "wal if yu garrimap brabli hotwan eshis langa yu briskit yu garra barnimap yu klos.
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

english: They said to you, "In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts."

english: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: "Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

english: However, Jehu didn't depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

kriol: "wal bambai ai garra laflaf langa yumob wen yumob garra abum trabul, en ai garra meigimbat fan langa yumob wen nogudbala ting garra hepin langa yumob.
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, "Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

kriol: afta na wen aisik bin binij toktok en jeikob bin go thru langa det dowa, isau bin jis kambek brom hanting,
english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

kriol: en im garra pudum det ship langa im sholda en deigimbek langa im kemp, en afta im garra jingat langa ola fren blanga im, en im garra tok, 'mi gudbinji na, dumaji aibin faindim main lilwan ship weya bin gitbush. en yumob garra gudbinji garram mi du.'"
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!'

kriol: brom deya ai gin gibit yu theingks rait deya na langa ol yu pipul olabat. ai garra preisim yu rait langa olabat ai.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

kriol: en det fladwoda bin stil kipgon godan slobala raidap langa det namba 10 manth, en langa det feswan dei langa det namba 10 manth ola hil bin stat kamat na.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

kriol: wal det wekinmen na bin dalimbat ola pipul blanga detlot ting weya jisas bin dumbat, en im na bin raidimdan ol detlot stori iya langa dijan buk, en wi holot sabi ol detlot ting weya imbin tok im trubala.
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

kriol: en wen dubala bin go, jisas imselp bin midim dubala langa roud, en imbin tok, "wujei yunbala go?" wal dubala bin baudan langa graun lida langa im, en dubala bin holdim im langa im fut, en dubala bin weship langa im,
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, "Rejoice!" They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

kriol: mi na, yawei det boswan god tok, 'nomeda det men jidan king, dei garra deigimat det speshalwan het. nomo enijing kaan jidan seim. detlot pipul hu nomo garram eni pawa garra jidan bos. detlot pipul hu jidan haibala garra jidan lobala.
english: the Lord Yahweh says: "Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.

kriol: en blanga tharran na aibin tok, 'yumob garra dai, dumaji yumob bulurrum det nogudbalawei.' "wal mi na mi. en if yumob nomo bilib langa mi, wal yumob garra dai blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob oldei dumbat."
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins."

kriol: main spirit garra blowin langa yumob en meigim yumob jidan laibala igin. ai garra bringimbek yumob langa yumob ronwan kantri en yumob garra sabi aibin oldei kipum main pramis.'"
english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it," says Yahweh.'"

kriol: lagijat na jeftha bin tok langa det emanait king. bat det king nomo bin teiknodis langa im wed.
english: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn't listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

kriol: "mi na det feswan blanga dalim detlot pipul langa jerusalem, 'yumob luk wanim garra hepin. mi na, aibin dalim det gudnyus langa saiyan.'
english: I am the first to say to Zion, 'Behold, look at them;' and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.

kriol: "if enibodi nomo teiknodis langa det wed dei kaan jidan laibala blanga luk det deilait.
english: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don't speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

kriol: wal detlot pipul bin weshipbat yawei. bat deibin stil weshipbat olabat ronwan drimin sheip. en raidap tudei ola bigininimob blanga olabat dumbat ola seimwan ting weya olabat bin dumbat.
english: So these nations feared Yahweh, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children's children. They do as their fathers did to this day.

kriol: en bambai wen yu luk ola spadidwan main, yu garra sabi aibin dum trubalawei langa yu. bat if yu faindim eni klinwan nenigout en biligout en eni waitwan ship, wal yu garra sabi aibin stilim olabat brom yu."
english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen."

kriol: yu nomo fogedabat yu enami olabat hu oldei jinginatbat. dei oldei kipgon jinginat.
english: Don't forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

kriol: wanbala im jidan laibala. bat det najawan bin dai. maitbi wailwan enimul bin dagat im, dumaji ai nomo bin luk im bodi.
english: One went out from me, and I said, "Surely he is torn in pieces;" and I haven't seen him since.

english: He said, "I have observed all these things from my youth up."

english: saying to them, "Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

english: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

kriol: wal wen god streitinimap wi, wi oldei nogudbinji. wi nomo gudbinji. bat afta wi gudbinji, dumaji im meigim wi jidan brabli gudbalawei wen im treinimap wi langa det raitwei.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

english: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.

english: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.

english: I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, Yahweh, have spoken it."

kriol: dei garra kotimbat ola pipul raitwei. en dei kaan larram enibodi gibit olabat mani snikinwei blanga bekimap im, dumaji detkain na gin meigim det klebabala en trubala men tok laiyawan wed.
english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

kriol: bat pida bin jandap atsaid langa det geit, dumaji dei nomo bin sabi im. bambai na det wanbala wekinmen bin kamat atsaid, en imbin go en tok langa det gel hubin maindimbat det geit, en afta imbin bringimap pida insaid langa det yad.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

kriol: yawei, brom longtaim yubin oldei jidan laiga seifwan pleis blanga melabat.
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

kriol: deibin randan brom ontop langa ola bigwan hil raitdan langa ola beli, langa detlot pleis weya yubin meigim blanga olabat.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

kriol: wal wen geil bin luk langa olabat, imbin dalim sebul, "yu luk deya! sambala men dei kamindan brom detlot hil!" wal sebul bin tok, "nomo. tharran yu lukinatbat nomo men. tharran shedo."
english: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, "Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains." Zebul said to him, "You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men."

kriol: wal ai dalim yumob. aibin reken oni lilbit dei garra gibit. bat dei nomo bin gibit oni mani. deibin gibit miselp langa jisas krais det bos blanga wi du. en afta deibin meigim miselp wekinmen blanga album mi jis laik god bin wandim olabat blanga dum.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

kriol: "wal dijan na yumob garra dum. yumob garra gajim nyuwan wegan en dubala mamiwan buligi weya nomo bin pulum wegan bifo, en yumob garra taiyimap det dubala buligi langa det wegan, en afta yumob garra deigidawei det dubala gabigabi brom det dubala mamiwan, en yumob garra deigimbek det dubala gabigabi langa yad.
english: "Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

kriol: bat wen melabat bin weshipbat det drimin gulum beil, det drimin garram sheim, imbin meigim melabat lujim ola ship en ola buligi, en melabat bigininimob du, en ola ebrijing weya melabat grengrenfathamob bin oldei wek adbalawei brom longtaim.
english: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

kriol: wal enibodi hu ridim dijan buk garra jinggabat dijan woning brabliwei weya jisas bin gibit langa ola wekinmen blanga im. imbin tok, "wen yumob luk det brabli nogudbala ting deya langa det juwish serramoni pleis, wal ol detlot pipul hu bilib langa mi garra ranawei streidawei brom dijan kantri judiya en go langa najalot hil kantri.
english: "But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not" (let the reader understand), "then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

kriol: wal aibin tok na, "ol yumob pipul langa jerusalem, yumob kaan go eniweya na, dumaji detlot enami bin majurrumap miselp raidaran langa yumob taun. yumob lafta majurrumap ola ebrijing blanga yumob.
english: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

kriol: wal main gudfren olabat, wen god bin tok detlot wed, imbin pramisim detlot wed langa wi. en blanga tharran na wi garra meigim miselp klinbala en nomo bulurrumbat detlot nogudbala ting weya meigim wi nogud insaidwei en atsaidwei. en wi garra trai en jidan brabli gudbalawei nomo garram enijing rong, dumaji wi garra rispek god brabliwei.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let's cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

kriol: bat ai sabi na det wei im rili kaman brom det boswan god.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

kriol: ola klaud bin meigim rein buldan, en thanda bin meigim nois brom skai en laitining bin laitlaitbat brom ebri said.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

kriol: en ebna bin tok, "wal yu stap rijimbat mi. yu rijim det najawan solja en kilim im, en yu pulumat im ola enijing." bat esahel nomo bin teiknodis langa ebna, en imbin kipgon rijimbat im.
english: Abner said to him, "Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor." But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god blanga isreil bin tok langa mi na, "jeramaiya, detlot pipul oldei toktokbat hau blanga faitfait, en blanga jidan hanggribala, en blanga detlot brabli nogudwan siknis garra meigim det king brom bebalon jidan bos blanga dijan taun. wal yu irrim mi na. ai garra dalim yu mowa.
english: Now therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, about which you say, "It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:"

kriol: afta wen jisas bin tok lagijat langa im wekinmen olabat, imbin brabli nogudbinji, en imbin dalim olabat streidat, "trubala dijan mi dalim yumob. wanbala brom yumob garra hendimoba mi langa detlot pipul weya garra kilim mi ded."
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, "Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me."

kriol: det wed blanga nogudbala wuman im laik det brabli dipwan hol, en if yu meigim yawei gitwail, wal yu garra buldan insaid deya na.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh's wrath will fall into it.

kriol: imbin tok, "preisim yawei det trubala god blanga isreil dumaji imbin kipum det pramis langa main dedi deibid wen imbin tok langa im,
english: He said, "Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

kriol: wal mosis en eran bin tok langa ol detlot pipul, "wen yumob agamin langa minbala, yumob nomo agamin langa minbala. yumob agamin langa yawei. wal sangodantaim tudei yumob garra sabi yawei na bin bringimap yumob iya brom ijip, en ailibala yumob garra luk det shainiwan lait blanga im."
english: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, "At evening, you shall know that Yahweh has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

english: They told him, saying, "Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt." His heart fainted, for he didn't believe them.

english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

english: Seven days were fulfilled, after Yahweh had struck the river.

english: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab," says Yahweh.

english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

kriol: wal deibin gajim det dubala speshalwan mishanri, en deibin meigim dubala jandap lida langa olabat, en deibin askim dubala, "wanim pawa yunbala bin yusum blanga meigim det leimbala men wok? en blanga hu neim yunbala bin yusum?"
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, "By what power, or in what name, have you done this?"

kriol: bat aibin jinggabat blanga sabi hau blanga jidan klebabala en hau blanga faindat mowa, en aibin wandi sabi wotfo ola brabli nogudbala pipul jidan granggibala, en wotfo ola granggibala pipul nomo sabi enijing.
english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

kriol: "yu garra dalim detlot isreil pipul blanga kipum det lowa blanga main sebathdei. im det dei blanga abum spel, dumaji det sebathdei na garra rimaindim wi olataim blanga det pramis weya aibin meigim garram olabat, en im shoum olabat mi na bin pikimat olabat blanga jidan main ronwan pipul.
english: "Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, 'Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

kriol: wal wen pailat bin irrim olabat tok lagijat, imbin askim olabat, "trubala dijan men brom gelali?"
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

english: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

english: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still."

english: Be careful that you don't let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

english: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for Yahweh's name.

english: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!"

english: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

kriol: if yu stap jinggabat raitwei yu garra faindim miselp langa greibyad.
english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

english: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

english: Moreover Yahweh's hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

english: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

english: Don't give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

english: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

english: The woman answered, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You said well, 'I have no husband,'

english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

english: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don't let your eyes rest.

kriol: en det king bin jidan bos blanga olabat fo 18 yiya.
english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

english: Jesus answered them, "Be careful that no one leads you astray.

english: Yahweh appointed a set time, saying, "Tomorrow Yahweh shall do this thing in the land."

english: "'He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

kriol: yu garra jidan sabibala en yu garra jidan brabli gudbinji wen yu sabi brabliwei.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

kriol: imbin opinimap bigwan ston en imbin gibit olabat detmatj woda.
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, "Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn't a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

kriol: yumob garra go langa det wanbala pleis blanga weship blanga abum det speshalwan sapa gulum pasoba en deya na yumob garra kilim wanbala buligi o ship blanga yumob, blanga shoum rispek langa yawei.
english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

kriol: en deibin bringimap detlot sebenbala lemp en ola oil en enijing blanga detlot lemp en det wanbala golwan pol blanga holdimap detlot lemp,
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
