english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children's children, on the third and on the fourth generation."

english: "'The Lord Yahweh says: "Because they say to you, 'You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;'

english: Moses said to the people, "Don't be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.

kriol: ebribodi garra shoum rispek langa det gudwan waif, dumaji imbin wek brabli gudwei, en olabat garra tok gudwei blanga im. binij na.
english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

kriol: yumob sabi na hu detlot biginini blanga god en hu detlot biginini blanga det boswan dibuldibul? enibodi hu nomo dum rait ting en nomo laigim im braja o sista olabat, im na nomo blanga god biginini.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn't do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn't love his brother.

english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

english: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

english: Yahweh said to Moses, "Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

kriol: deya na langa det lilwan pleis ontop langa det hil dubala bin kilim ded gulijap 20 filastain solja.
english: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow's length in an acre of land.

english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, "Are you the King of the Jews?" Jesus said to him, "So you say."

kriol: en yu garra kraikrai en abumbat loda pein en yu bodi garra binijap.

english: Behold, one came to him and said, "Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?"

english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don't know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit."

english: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever."

english: Yahweh thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of Yahweh is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?

english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, 'We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.'"

english: Yahweh's angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, "See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.

english: But Jesus said to her, "Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs."

kriol: afta na jonathan bin dalim deibid, "yu gowei gudbinjiwei, dumaji yunmi bin pramis blanga laigim miselp brabliwei olagija, en yawei garra meiksho yunmi kipum det pramis, en yunmi femili olabat garra kipum det pramis olagija du." brom deya deibid bin gowei na, en jonathan bin gobek langa haus.
english: Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh's name, saying, 'Yahweh is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.'" He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.

kriol: bat nomo eni mani garra jidan deya langa det taun, dumaji det mani blanga yawei, en olabat garra yusum blanga baiyim ola daga en gudbala klos blanga detlot pipul hu oldei weshipbat langa yawei."
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

kriol: en blanga tharran na deibin gulum det wodahol lahairoi spring, en det woda im stil jidan deya tudei langa midul langa det dubala taun gulum keidish en berad.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

kriol: det nyubalawei kaan jidan seimwei laik det olbalawei weya aibin meigim garram olabat grengrenfatha olabat. aibin meigim det olbalawei garram olabat wen aibin deigidawei olabat brom ijip. bat dei nomo bin bulurrum det wei blanga mi, en ai nomo bin maindimbat olabat.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn't continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them," says the Lord.

kriol: dumaji olabat na bin meigim detlot trabul en laiyinbala wed." lagijat na elifas bin tok.
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit."

kriol: "wal ol dislot ting garra hepin dumaji ola isreil pipul bin tenim miselp brom god, en deibin dumbat olkain nogudbala ting. "wal hubin meigim ola isreil pipul tenim miselp brom god? olabat ronwan kantrimen gin hu oldei jidan langa sameriya. en hubin meigim ola juda pipul bulurrumbat ola najalot drimin? olabat ronwan kantrimen gin hu oldei jidan langa jerusalem." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: "All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn't it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren't they Jerusalem?

kriol: wal nomeda imbin deigim im longtaim, bat stil joshuwa bin teikoba ola kantri. imbin teikoba ola hil kantri en ola plein kantri nowathwei en sauthwei raidap langa det deset kantri en det najawan kantri gulum goshin, en imbin teikoba ola kantri langa det jodan beli du.
english: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

kriol: "if yu gibit enijing langa po pipul, wal yu kaan jingat langa ebribodi seimwei laik ol detlot tufeis pipul oldei dum. dei oldei jingat langa enibodi langa det miting pleis en eniweya langa roud, en dei oldei dalimbat olabat blanga meigim olabat preisim olabat. ai dalim yumob. deibin gedim olabat prais olredi brom detlot pipul hubin preisimbat olabat.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don't sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kriol: yumob bin luk aibin abum trabul blanga det gudnyus wen aibin deya garram yumob, en stil tudei yumob bin irrim ai garram trabul blanga det gudnyus. wal yumob sabi na? yumob garra abum trabul du, dumaji yumob bulurrumbat jisas krais.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

kriol: afta na ilaija bin dalim im wekinmen, "yu go luk langa det solwodawei if eni klaud kaminap." wal det wekinmen bin go en luk en imbin tok, "ai nomo bin luk enijing!" ilaija bin dalim im blanga go en luk igin. 7 taim imbin hepin lagijat.
english: He said to his servant, "Go up now and look toward the sea." He went up and looked, then said, "There is nothing." He said, "Go again" seven times.

kriol: gidap, yawei! kaman en gitwail langa main enami olabat! kaman en stapam detlot hu wail langa mi, dumaji yubin tok blanga det dei wen yu garra jadjim pipul.
english: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

kriol: yumob sabi wotfo? if eni odinri pipul jidan deya langa det miting pleis weya yumob preisimbat god garram yumob spirit, wal dei kaan sabi wanim yumob toktok. en if dei kaan sabi, wal hau dei garra tok "trubala" wen yumob gibit theingks langa god?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the "Amen" at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn't know what you say?

kriol: blanga detlot isreil pipul. dei nomo lau dagat eni fetpat brom det buligi, o ship, o gout.
english: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

kriol: wen yumob garra kamat feis du feis langa detlot amalekait pipul en keinanait pipul, yumob garra dai langa det fait. yawei nomo jidan garram yumob, dumaji yumob nomo bin bulurrum im holbit."
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you."

kriol: wen sambodi gibit yu gudwan wed langa det rait taim im jis laik imbin gibit yu det brabli purdiwan golwan frut daga weya jidan insaid langa silbawan baskit.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

kriol: en deya na det boswan blanga det jeil bin washim ola sowa blanga dubala weya deibin beldimbat dubala basdam, en afta dubala bin beptaisim im en im femili olabat,
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

kriol: afta na joshuwa en ola isreil solja bin gobek langa olabat kemp deya langa det pleis gulum gilgel.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

kriol: wal barak bin dalim debra, "ai gin go if yu kaman garram mi. bat if yu kaan kaman garram mi, wal ai kaan go."
english: Barak said to her, "If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go."

kriol: wal wen eibrahem bin deigimat im naif, streidawei det einjul blanga yawei det trubala god bin jingat brom hebin, "eibrahem! eibrahem!" en eibrahem bin ensim, "wanim? mi iya."
english: Yahweh's angel called to him out of the sky, and said, "Abraham, Abraham!" He said, "Here I am."

kriol: "det bandri lain blanga yumob kantri garra stat langa det woda gulum redsi, en brom deya im garra gowap langa det solwoda gulum medatareiniyan raidap langa det yufreitis riba, en brom deya im garra godan langa det deset kantri. ai garra pudum ol detlot pipul hu oldei jidanbat deya langa yumob bingga, en wen yumob go en spredimat miselp, yumob garra andimwei olabat.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

kriol: bambai na yawei det trubala god bin tok langa det speshalwan mesinja neim jeihu det san blanga henanai. imbin gibit im dijan wed blanga beisha.
english: Yahweh's word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

kriol: wal detlot ting weya hepin langa yumob, dei shoum wi god garra gibit feyago langa ebribodi wen im garra kaman en abum det laswan kotkeis garram ebribodi. en wen im kaman, im garra dalim yumob blanga kaman en jidan garram im, dumaji nomeda yumob bin abum loda trabul wen yumob bin bulurrum im, bat stil yumob nomo bin slekbek.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God's Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

kriol: en ai garra stapam im brom abumbat olkain difrinwan serramoni weya imbin oldei abumbat. ai garra stapam detlot serramoni weya imbin abum ebriyiya en ebrimanth en ebriwik. ai garra stapam ol detlot serramoni,
english: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.

kriol: yawei, yu oldei maindimbat ola powan pipul en detlot pipul hu garram trabul. yu wulijim det shelta brom win en rein blanga olabat. yu wulijim sheid tri langa hotwan san weya barnimbat pipul. detlot strongbala en krulbala enami weya kaman blanga faitfait, dei jis laik det brabli strongbala stom weya garra binijap ebrijing. bat stil oni yu na yawei oldei maindimbat olabat.
english: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

kriol: wal langa det taim na wen jehoiyakim bin jidan king, king nebakanesa brom bebalon bin go en teikoba juda en blanga 3 yiya king jehoiyakim bin lafta teiknodis langa im. brom deya im nomo bin laigim lisin en teiknodis langa im.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

kriol: en det wekinmen nomo bin abum naf mani blanga peiyimbek det king. det king bin tok blanga selim det wekinmen en im femili en ola enijing blanga im blanga gedimbek det mani weya imbin owim im.
english: But because he couldn't pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

kriol: wal keinan san neim saidan bin det bigiswan san. en keinan bin grengrenfatha blanga detlot hitait pipul, en ol detlot jebusait, emarait, gegashait, hibait, akait, sinait, abadait, semarait en hemathait pipul.
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

kriol: nomeda yu nomo luk eni rein o win, bat dis draiwan riba garra jidan bulap garram woda en ola buligi en ola najalot enimul blanga yumob garra dringgim det woda.'"
english: For Yahweh says, 'You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.

kriol: wal yu garra go en tok langa detlot serramonimen hu garrimapbat det seikridwan boks en yu garra dalim olabat, wen dei kamat langa det riba, dei garra gowin langa det woda en jandap deya gin." lagijat na god bin tok langa joshuwa.
english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, 'When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.'"

kriol: en nobodi kaan kaman langa mi. oni detlot pipul weya main dedi oldei bringimap olabat gulijap langa mi gin kaman langa mi. en ai garra meigim detlot pipul na gidap laibala olagijawan langa det laswan dei.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

kriol: "wal yumob garra abum bigbala trabul na! yumob reken det rongwei im det raitwei, en yumob reken det dakbala im lait, en yumob reken det bitawan teist switwan.
english: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

kriol: bat ol yumob hubin jidan trubala langa yawei, yumob stil jidan laibala tudei.
english: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.

kriol: wal wen deibin tok lagijat, deibin meigim ola pipul en ola boswan langa det taun gitwail brabliwei.
english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

kriol: thrideistaim na eibrahem bin luk det hil, en det hil nomo bin longwei na,
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

kriol: enibodi hu laigim agamin oldei laigim meigimbat trabul, en enibodi hu oldei jidan praudbala oldei lukabat blanga trabul.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

kriol: deibin gibit bekboun langa yawei, en dei nomo bin jidan trubalawei. deibin oldei agamin langa yawei, en deibin oldei dalimbat im laiya en deibin oldei nokambek im en dei nomo bin teiknodis langa im wed.
english: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh's law;

kriol: wal mosis bin gobek langa im lambarra, en imbin askim im, "yu larram mi gobek langa main ron pipul deya langa ijip. ai garra faindat if dei stil jidan laibala." lagijat na mosis bin dum, dumaji yawei bin dalim im blanga gobek langa ijip, en yawei bin tok, "ol detlot pipul hubin wandi kilim yu, dei bin ol dai na." wal jethro bin gudbinji langa mosis, en imbin larramgo im,
english: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, "Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive." Jethro said to Moses, "Go in peace."

kriol: if det jadj tok dei garra beldim det giltiwan men, det jadj garra meigim im leidan feisdan en beldim im garram wip. det namba blanga det wip mak garra jidan det rait namba blanga det nogudbala ting weya imbin dumbat.
english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

kriol: wal deibin ol tok, "yuwai. melabat gudbinji blanga det wed weya yunbala bin tok." en det seim dei olabat bin sekamsais ola men en ola boi.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

kriol: afta na yawei bin gibit dis wed langa hegai blanga dalim ola pipul.
english: Then Yahweh's word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

kriol: bambai detlot solja blanga king deibid bin fait langa detlot filastain solja deya langa det seimwan pleis gulum gob, en wan solja blanga king deibid neim elanan det san blanga jaiyiya brom bethlahem bin kilim ded wanbala brabli bigwan filastain solja neim galaiyath. det filastain solja bin brom det taun gulum geth, en det spiya blanga im bin brabli thikwan.
english: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite's brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

kriol: ola pipul bin blandim miselp langa ola keib en langa bigwan ston. ola haibala men en ola bigbala bos langa ebri kantri, en ola boswan solja en ola strongbala men, en ola ritj pipul en ola wekinmen en wekingel, ebribodi bin blandim miselp langa ston kantri.
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

kriol: en imbin bulurrum det juwish lowa, dumaji imbin kaman blanga larramgo wi fri brom det lowa en blanga meigim wi jidan biginini blanga god.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

kriol: en olabat garra jidan garram wan main, en dei garra joinin langa det enimul. dei garra hendimoba olabat pawa langa im, en im garra bos oba langa olabat.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

kriol: wal aibin irrim wanim imbin tok, bat ai nomo bin sabi. wal aibin lafta askim im, "bat bos, wanim garra hepin afta ol dislot ting binij?"
english: I heard, but I didn't understand. Then I said, "My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?"

kriol: nomeda if im men o wuman o biginini weya bin pramis langa mi brabli trubalawei, yu kaan baiyimbek. im garra lafta dai.
english: "'No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

kriol: wal longtaim ola speshalwan mesinja blanga god bin wandi faindat hau god garra seibum im pipul olabat en wotaim im garra seibum olabat. detlot speshalwan mesinja bin tok olkain wed blanga god weya im garra seibum yumob. yumob sabi? det spirit blanga jisas krais bin jidan langa detlot speshalwan mesinja, en imbin shoum olabat hau god garra seibum im pipul olabat en wotaim im garra seibum olabat. bat dei nomo bin sabi brabliwei, dumaji deibin tok blanga det trabul weya jisas krais bin abum en blanga ola gudbala ting weya bin hepin afta. bat dei nomo bin sabi tharran na bin det ensa.
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

kriol: "trubala ai dalim yumob. ol detlot pipul hu bilib langa mi garram det olagijawan laif.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

kriol: brom deya detlot pipul bin jingat igin, "aleiluya! smok im gidap brom det bigbala taun weya im barnbarn olagija!"
english: A second said, "Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever."

kriol: wal king seksis bin tok langa esta, en langa modakai, det juwish men. imbin tok, "irrim mi na. aibin gibit esta det haus blanga heiman en ol im enijing, en aibin heingim heiman langa det speshalwan pos raidap imbin dai, dumaji imbin meigim det plen blanga kilimbat ola juwish pipul.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, "See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.

kriol: en im garra gibitbek sambala mani langa detlot yiya weya im stil garra kaman bifo det namba 50 yiya wen ola kantri garra gobek langa ola fesmob boswan blanga det kantri.
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

kriol: wal bambai na ebritaim wen king sol bin oldei jandim deibid blanga fait, deibid bin oldei win, en king sol bin meigim im jidan boswan solja, en ola solja en najalot boswan solja bin gudbinji blanga deibid.
english: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

kriol: wal langa detlot taun weya aibin olredi gibit langa yumob, yumob gin libum yumob waif en ola biginini en detlot bigmob enimul weya ai sabi yumob garram.
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

kriol: en denyul bin askim det king blanga pudum shedrek, mishak en ebadinago bos blanga dum ola wek langa bebalon du, en det king bin duwit. en denyul na bin oldei jidanbat insaid langa det king haus.
english: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, but Daniel was in the king's gate.

kriol: yawei garra jidan brabli kainbala langa detlot hu bradin blanga dum nogudbala ting. bat if yu jidan krulbala yu garra faindim miselp langa trabul.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

kriol: "jeramaiya, yu garra godan langa det haus blanga det men hu oldei meigimbat detlot pot brom det klei, en ai garra dalim yu det mesij deya na."
english: "Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear my words."

kriol: en det taim na ai garra dum wanim aibin pramis langa olabat, en ai garra larramgo olabat fri brom ola nogudbala ting weya deibin dumbat."
english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins."

kriol: olabat oldei dalimbat yumob laiyawan wed garram main neim. bat ai nomo bin jandim olabat, najing.
english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them," says Yahweh.

kriol: wal ai garra tok na blanga detlot pipul hubin pramisimbat miselp blanga merrit. maitbi afta dei garra tok nomo blanga merrit. bat maitbi det men kaan hendulum det filing blanga im weya im wandim det gel, en maitbi im tridim det gel jis laik imbin olredi merrit langa im. wal if det men reken dubala garra merrit, wal dubala lafta merrit. en wen dubala merrit, wal tharran im rait.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn't sin. Let them marry.

kriol: brom deya ol detlot isreil pipul bin libum keidish, en deibin kamat langa det hil gulum hora,
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

kriol: afta na yawei bin dalim semyul,
english: Then Yahweh's word came to Samuel, saying,

kriol: bat det king brom idam bin tok, "nomo! melabat kaan larram yumob go thru langa melabat kantri. if yumob trai blanga go thru, melabat garra kaman en kilim yumob ded."
english: Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you."

kriol: en langa det namba 15 dei, det speshalwan serramoni gulum damba nomo garram raising garra stat, en langa det 7 dei na yumob nomo lau blanga dagat eni damba garram raising.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

kriol: en ol detlot serramonimen bin agri langa wanim king jowesh bin dalim olabat.
english: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

kriol: wal aibin kipgon tok, "yawei, yu pudum yu bingga langa mi en meigim mi strongbala. yu seibum mi brom main enami, en ai garra jidan seifwan. dumaji oni langa yu na ai garra preisimbat.
english: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.

kriol: det midul pat blanga det pol garra abum fobala sheip jis laik det purdiflawa blanga det amantri,
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kriol: ai garra meigim yu jidan wulijim det brabli strongbala wol weya deibin meigim brom kopawan en weya jandap brabli haibala. olabat reken olabat garra fait langa yu, bat olabat kaan bidim yu. ai garra go garram yu, en ai garra maindim yu en yu garra jidan seifwan na.
english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you," says Yahweh.

kriol: bat tudei yumob bin gibit bekboun langa main dedi femili, en yumob bin kilim ded ola san blanga im. wal wotfo yumob bin kilim olabat ded? ai sabi wotfo. main dedi bin abum san brom det wekingel blanga im, en det wekingel im yumob kantrimen, en blanga tharran na yumob bin meigim abimalek jidan king blanga dijan taun.
english: and you have risen up against my father's house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);

kriol: "melabat wandim yu blanga dalim melabat ebrijing blanga det wed weya yubin toktok, dumaji melabat bin lisin yu toktok sambala difrinwan wed deya weya melabat nomo sabi, en melabat wandi faindat wanim detlot wed min."
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean."

english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

kriol: en blanga im dedi imbin jandim tenbala dongki bulap garram ola gudbala ting brom det kantri, en imbin jandim tenbala gelwan dongki bulap garram olkain daga blanga roud.
english: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok, "isikiyel, yu luk langa detlot gel langa yu ronwan pipul. olabat reken dei jidan speshalwan mesinja, bat najing. olabat toktokbat garram olabat ronwan wed.
english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

kriol: wal neksdei bifo detlot thribala men bin kamat langa jopa, pida bin gowap ontop langa det haus dinataim blanga prei,
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

kriol: dijan wel garra jidan nomo garram enijing. najing. trubala yawei bin tok blanga dijan.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.

kriol: wal wen det namba 7 dei bin kaman, deibin ol gidap ailibala igin, en deibin wok raidaran langa det taun seimwei igin. bat distaim deibin wok raidaran langa det taun 7 taim,
english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

kriol: wen sambodi irrimbat eni yan im meigim im wandi irrimbat mowa, jis laik wen yu dagat shugabeig yu wandim dagat mowa.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

kriol: wal wotfo yumob kaan jinggabat ol detlot ting weya god bin meigim hepin langa yumob wen yumob bin bilib?
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

kriol: wal dijan det mesij weya yawei det trubala god bin gibit langa mi. mi na aisaiya det san blanga eimas, blanga dalim detlot pipul deya langa juda en jerusalem.
english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

kriol: detlot tjerabim bin detlot seimwan tjerabim weya aibin luk deya wansaid langa det keba riba. wal wen detlot tjerabim bin gidap en go langa top,
english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

kriol: wen pipul gibit najalot adtaim, yawei oldei luk detlot pipul hu oldei abumbat trabul, en gibit olabat feyago. im oldei tridim pipul raitwei.
english: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

kriol: wal detlot solja opinimap detlot geit weya det riba bin go thru langa det taun, en ola pipul langa det haus blanga det king olabat bradin na,
english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

kriol: wal king amasaiya bin jidan laibala fo 15 yiya afta king jehowesh blanga isreil bin dai.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

kriol: "brom deya wanmo taim igin aibin leidan feisdan blanga weship langa yawei fo 40 dei en 40 nait en ai nomo bin dagat daga en dringgim enijing. aibin dum dijan dumaji yumob bin dumbat nogudbala ting langa yawei en yumob bin meigim im gitwail brabliwei.
english: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, to provoke him to anger.

kriol: "en langa det namba 6 dei yumob garra gibit dijan ofring, 8 yangwan boiwan buligi, dubala dediwan ship en 14 boiwan ship wan yiya ol, holot nomo garram enijing rong langa olabat.
english: "'On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kriol: wal wen ola solja blanga king deibid bin bidim detlot enami blanga im, dei bina gudbinji brabliwei. bat dei nomo bin gudbinji, dumaji sambodi bin dalim jowab blanga king deibid weya imbin jidanbat nogudbinji en kraikrai blanga im san ebsalom, en detlot solja bin irrim det nyus weya deibid bin wori miselp blanga im san ebsalom,
english: Joab was told, "Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom."

kriol: en deibin meigim bigwan raunwan kopawan boul wulijim teingk. en imbin 2 mita apendan en 4 mita kroswei en 13 mita raidaran.
english: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

kriol: wal ola boswan en detlot pipul bin tok, "nomo lisin langa im! nomo dum enijing im dalim yu blanga dum."
english: All the elders and all the people said to him, "Don't listen, and don't consent."

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok langa mosis, "yu garra meigim skweyawan teibul blanga ofring garram wud brom det wadultri blanga barnimbat enimul. im garra jidan 2.2 mita longwei en 2.2 mita kroswei en 1.3 mita apendan.
english: "You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, yumob bin oldei lisin en duwit langa mi wen aibin deya garram yumob, en nomeda mi nomo deya garram yumob, bat stil yumob garra kipgon duwit langa wanim mi tok. wal yumob kaan bradin langa enibodi. yumob garra bradin oni langa god,
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

kriol: "aibin wek 20 yiya blanga yu. nomeda ola nenigout en ola biligout en ola ship blanga yu nomo bin stap bridap, bat stil ai nomo bin dagat eni kila blanga yu.
english: "These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven't eaten the rams of your flocks.

kriol: wen yu gowei brom iya tudei, yu garra midim dubala men gulijap langa det greibyad blanga reitjul deya langa det taun gulum selsa langa det kantri blanga det benjamin klen, en det dubala men garra dalim yu, 'deibin faindim detlot dongki weya yubin lukabat, en yu dedi nomo jinggabat olabat na. im jinggabat blanga yu, en im askimbat miselp hau im garra faindim yu.'
english: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel's tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, 'The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, "What shall I do for my son?"'

kriol: bambai na ola pipul langa ijip bin binijimap olabat ronwan daga, en wen deibin ranat blanga daga, deibin go langa det king, en deibin askim im blanga daga na. wal det king bin dalim olabat, "yumob go langa josef, en yumob duwit langa im, wanim im dalim yumob blanga dum."
english: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do."

kriol: deibin oldei trai en lukabat blanga sambodi blanga album olabat en seibum olabat brom mi. bat nobodi bin seibum olabat. deibin jingat langa yu. bat yu nomo bin lisin langa olabat.
english: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn't answer them.

kriol: wal ilaihu bin kipgon tok langa job, "najalot pipul oldei preisimbat god blanga wanim im oldei dum. wal wotfo yu kaan joinin langa olabat du?
english: "Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

kriol: yu garra lukaftumbat langa mi, bat yu kaan kaundimat ol detlot nogudbala ting blanga main.
english: But now you count my steps. Don't you watch over my sin?

kriol: "wal god bin dalim yu im laigim yu detmatj en im fil sori blanga yu. yu reken tharran im naf blanga yu?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

kriol: god na bin jandim im einjul blanga meigim detlot laiyan jidan kwaitwan wulijim olabat kaan ardim mi. imbin dum dijan dumaji imbin sabi ai nomo bin dum enijing rong, en ai nomo bin dum enijing rong langa yu, haibala bos."
english: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions' mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm."

kriol: trastim yawei ol yumob isreil pipul. im kaan neba stap laigimbat yumob, en im oldei redi blanga seibumbat yumob.
english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.

kriol: "'ai garra oldei lukaftumbat yumob brom enijing det meigim yumob jidan nomo klinwan blanga serramoni. blanga yumob fam garra jidan garram detmatj sid daga en yumob kaan neba jidan hanggriwan.
english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

kriol: lagijat na ebsalom bin oldei dum langa ola isreil pipul wen deibin oldei kaman langa jerusalem blanga askim king deibid blanga album olabat streitinimap olabat trabul. en ebsalom bin meigim detlot pipul stat laigimbat im en nomo laigimbat king deibid.
english: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

kriol: imbin irrim ola prisana jinginatbat soribalawei, en imbin larramgo fri ol detlot weya detlot enami bin tok dei garra dai.
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

kriol: ai bina gajim yu en deigimwei yu langa main mami kemp, weya yunmi bina jidan mijamet. en ai bina gibit yu olkain switwan wain blanga meigim yu jidan gudbinji.
english: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.

kriol: en deibin gedim ola taun raidap langa det taun sauthwei gulum beilabiya o rema. wal ola femili brom simiyan klen bin gedim ol detlot taun en ol detlot kantri na.
english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

kriol: afta na deibin ol gowei langa olabat kemp, en king deibid bin gowei langa im kemp blanga jidan langa im femilimob du.
english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

kriol: en wen det king garra fait en teikoba ol detlot kantri, im garra teikoba ijip du.
english: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won't escape.

kriol: "yawei, yu jinggabat langa mi. aibin oldei jidan brabli trubala langa yu en aibin oldei bulurrum yu en aibin oldei trai blanga dum ebrijing weya yu wandim mi blanga dum." en hesakaiya bin kraikrai soribalawei.
english: "Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

kriol: wal aibin kipgon tok, "yumob pipul hu oldei askimbat detlot pipul brom ijip blanga album yumob, wal yumob garra abumbat trabul na. yumob oldei trastimbat detlot solja garram detlot hosis en bagi en strongbala amimob. bat yumob nomo jinggabat blanga yawei det brabli holiwan god blanga ola isreil pipul en askim im blanga album yumob.
english: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don't look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don't seek Yahweh!

kriol: en wen ola pipul bin luk jisas, deibin sabi im, en deibin jandim wed ebriweya langa det kantri, en deibin garrimap ola sikbala pipul langa im,
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

kriol: yu oldei maindimbat yu pipul olabat wen najalot pipul meigimbat plen blanga dum nogudbala ting langa olabat. yu nomo larram eni nogudbala wed kaman en ardim langa olabat.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

kriol: "yumob jinggabat na. wen yumob san askim yumob blanga fish, wanim yumob gibit olabat? yumob gibit olabat jigiwan sneik o yumob gibit im fish?
english: "Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won't give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

kriol: yumob teiknodis en duwit brabliwei langa mi en nomo fogedabat ebrijing weya ai dalimbat yumob, en blanga yumob bigininimob garra jidan gudbinjiwei olagija na, dumaji tharran na im raitwei en meigim yawei det trubala god blanga wi brabli gudbinji."
english: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in Yahweh your God's eyes.

kriol: ol detlot najalot isreil pipul, en detlot najalot serramonimen en detlot najalot libai pipul bin stap langa olabat kemp langa ola taun langa juda, langa olabat femili kantri.
english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

kriol: en enibodi hu garram im san garram det olagijawan laif. en detlot pipul hu nomo garram im san nomo garram det olagijawan laif.
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn't have God's Son doesn't have the life.

kriol: wal jon bin tok, "nobodi kaan abum pawa blanga dum enikain wek lagijat. oni if god gibit langa im.
english: John answered, "A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

kriol: en sambala lida brom yumob garra kaman garram mi en kotim im deya."
english: "Let them therefore", he said, "that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him."

kriol: wal yu garra dalim olabat wanim mi na yawei det boswan god toktokbat, 'ol yumob gel, yumob garra abum panishmen. yumob oldei meigimbat klebawan amben blanga ebribodi blanga werrimon, en yumob oldei meigim klebawan heinggitjif blanga ebribodi blanga werrimbat langa olabat hed wulijim dei gin abum pawa en jidan bos blanga najalot pipul. yumob wandi jidan bos blanga olabat laif en deth dumaji yumob wandi yusum olabat blanga yumob ronwan selp.
english: and say, "The Lord Yahweh says: 'Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

kriol: "yumob jinggabat detlot purdiflawa. dei nomo wek adbala blanga meigim det kala blanga olabat. ai dalim yumob. king salaman bin brabli ritjmen, en imbin abum olkainaba purdiwan klos.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

kriol: kwikbala imbin kaman jis laik imbin flai garram det speshalwan einjul blanga im, en imbin kaman langa det win jis laik imbin abum wing.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

kriol: bat yu laf langa olabat, yawei. yu mokim ol detlot pipul brom ebri kantri hu nomo bilib langa yu.
english: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

kriol: wal mosis bin tok, "ola isreil pipul kaan lisin langa mi. en det king kaan lisin langa mi du, dumaji ai kaan tok gudwei."
english: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, "Behold, the children of Israel haven't listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?"

kriol: "'wal ai garra gajim yu garram det bigwan net en ai garra larram detlot pipul brom najalot kantri pulumat yu.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: "I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.

kriol: wal wen king deibid bin brabli olmen na, imbin meigim im san salaman jidan king blanga ol detlot isreil pipul.
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

kriol: wen yu jidan brabli hepiwan, wal yu luk hepiwan, bat wen yu jidan sedwan, wal yu luk brabli sedwan.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

kriol: wal ebigeil bin gobek langa im kemp na, en imbin faindim im hasbin neibal abumbat bigbala padi garram ebrijing jis laiga king. imbin brabli gudbinji, dumaji imbin brabli drangk. wal ebigeil nomo bin dalim im enijing, dumaji imbin drangk.
english: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light.

kriol: "wal wen mosis bin jidan deya langa det kantri 40 yiya, wan einjul bin kamat langa im jis laiga faiya langa lilwan tri deya langa det deset kantri gulijap langa det hil gulum sainai.
english: "When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

kriol: oni yu na gin album melabat, en oni yu na gin seibum melabat brom det trabul du. wotfo yu jidanbat wulijim streinja langa melabat kantri, jis laik det men hubin kaman en jidan iya oni blanga wan nait en im kipgon langa najawan kantri na?
english: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

kriol: wal mi askim god blanga jidan brabli kainbala langa yumob. binij na.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

kriol: en king deibid bin tok, "ai kaan dringgim dijan woda dumaji detlot thribala solja bin redi blanga gibit miselp laif blanga mi." wal im nomo bin dringgim tharran na. dislot na ola ting detlot thribala solja bin dum.
english: and said, "My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?" For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

kriol: en imbin deigim olabat insaid langa det haus, en imbin bringimap woda langa olabat blanga washim olabat fut, en imbin fidim ola dongki blanga olabat du.
english: The man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.

kriol: en imbin tok, "yunbala kaman langa main haus. deya na yunbala gin abum bogi, en yunbala gin silip deya du, en ailibala yunbala gin kipgon. wal yunbala kaman langa main haus na, en ai garra lukaftum yunbala." lagijat na lot bin tok. bat dubala bin tok, "nomo. minbala go en silip eniweya langa pak."
english: and he said, "See now, my lords, please come into your servant's house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way." They said, "No, but we will stay in the street all night."

kriol: afta wen ebrijing blanga det serramoni bin binij, ola pipul bin stat blanga gobek langa olabat ron taun na. bat jisas bin stap biyain langa jerusalem. en im mami en dedi nomo bin sabi imbin stap biyain.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn't know it,

kriol: brom deya isau bin gobek raitbek langa im ron kantri idam.
english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

kriol: bat if det widogel garram biginini o grenkid olabat, wal detlot biginini en grenkid olabat garra shoum rispek langa olabat ron femili olabat, en dei garra lukaftumbat det widogel blanga olabat, dumaji god wandim olabat blanga lukaftumbat olabat ron femili. en wen dei lukaftumbat olabat lagijat, im jis laik dei peiyimbek olabat mami en dedi en ol detlot ol pipul blanga olabat, en dei meigim god gudbinji langa olabat.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

kriol: "yumob sabi na? yu kaan oldei wori en jinggabat weya yu garra faindim daga blanga dagadagat, en yu kaan oldei wori en jinggabat weya yu garra faindim klos blanga werrimon, dumaji god nomo bin gibit yu laif jis blanga dagat daga, en im nomo bin gibit yu bodi jis blanga werrimonbat klos.
english: Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn't life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

kriol: aibin oldei duwit langa det lowa blanga yawei det trubala god, en ai nomo bin tenim miselp brom main god.
english: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

kriol: wal wanmo ting god bin dum blanga wi. imbin meigim wi brabli gudbinji, dumaji jisas krais det bos blanga wi bin meigim wi jidan fren blanga god.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

kriol: imbin kadimat det solwoda gulum redsi. trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
english: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kriol: bat mosis bin tok langa yawei, "yawei, yubin bringimap dislot pipul brom ijip garram yu ronwan pawa. wen detlot ijip pipul garra irrim wanim yubin dum langa yu pipul olabat,
english: Moses said to Yahweh, "Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

kriol: god, yu sori langa melabat, en yu dum ola gudbala ting blanga melabat. yu garra luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis,
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

kriol: en nomo sekrifais gelwan buligi en im lilwan gabigabi, o ship en im lilwan ship, o nenigout en im gidigidi langa det seimwan dei.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

kriol: afta na, blanga shoum mi yumob bin tok langa mi trubalawei, yumob garra bringimbek det yangiswan braja blanga yumob. en if yumob bringimbek im, wal ai kaan binijimap yumob." wal deibin ol tok, "yuwai. melabat dum lagijat."
english: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won't die." They did so.

kriol: en loda pipul bin bilib langa jisas deya.
english: Many believed in him there.

kriol: bambai na pida bin kaman langa det taun gulum entiyak weya aibin jidan,
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

kriol: bat stil aibin jidan gulijap langa yu, en yu holdim main bingga.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

kriol: jis laik det san weya im godan, wal lagijat na mi gulijap binij. mi wulijim insek weya det win blowimwei.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

kriol: en ola bilibamob langa detlot tjetj bin bilib mowa strongbalawei, en det namba blanga ola bilibamob bin gowap mowa en mowa ebridei.
english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

english: He answered, "Don't be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them."

kriol: en imbin tok, 'koniliyas, god bin irrim yu preya, en imbin luk ola gudbala ting weya yubin oldei dumbat blanga ola po pipul.
english: and said, 'Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

kriol: wal king deibid bin pudum eisaf en najalot libaimen blanga deigim feloship sebis langa det pleis weya det seikridwan boks bin jidan. deibin lafta wek deya ebridei.
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh's covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required;

kriol: afta na ola pipul brom juda bin meigim im san yusaiya jidan det nyuwan king en imbin oni 16 yiya ol.
english: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

kriol: wal melabat nomo bin dalimbat yumob laiyawan wed. en melabat nomo bin dalimbat yumob det gudnyus jis blanga meigim yumob gibit melabat samting. en melabat nomo bin trai en trikimbat enibodi du. najing.
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

kriol: "wal wen det taim garra kaman, sambala pipul garra tok, 'yu luk! deya det boswan dei gulum krais!' en sambala pipul garra tok, 'iya det boswan dei gulum masaiya! yu luk!'
english: Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there!' don't believe it.

kriol: "aibin irrim ola pipul jinginat adbalawei. deibin jinginat brabli bradinbalawei.
english: For Yahweh says: "We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok, "dumaji aibin meigim strongwan pramis langa yumob en yumob bin tok blanga kipum en meigim det pramis strongwan garram det blad blanga det sekrifais ofring, yumob sabi ai garra larramgo yumob pipul fri. jis laik nogudbala men pudum prisana insaid langa det draiwan wel, wal ola enami bin pudum yumob pipul langa ola nogudbala pleis du, bat ai garra larramgo yumob fri.
english: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

kriol: dei meigimbat fan langa detlot king en laflaf langa detlot boswan, en dei laflaf langa ola strongwan wol. dei bildimap det graun laiga haiwan hil weya dei gin galimap en bidim ol detlot taun.
english: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

kriol: wal hubin meigim dislot ting hepin lagijat? en hu boswan langa ol dislot ting weya bin hepin langa pipul? oni mi na gin dum detlot ting. mi na yawei. aibin deya olataim. en ai garra jidan raidap ebrijing garra binij.
english: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he."

kriol: afta tharran imbin deigim mi atsaid langa det najawan pleis langa det kotyad, en imbin shoum mi lilwan hol langa wol.
english: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

kriol: jowal det san blanga sikri bin bos blanga ol detlot pipul langa det taun, en juda det san blanga hesanuwa bin det sekan bos afta im. dislot ola serramonimen na.
english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

kriol: yubin go lida langa yu pipul olabat garram longwan klaud deitaim, en garram longwan faiya naitaim.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

kriol: wal ol detlot isreil pipul bin go med ebriwei, en eran bin larram olabat dumbat olkain nogudbala ting, en ola enami blanga olabat bin laf langa olabat na.
english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

kriol: yumob sabi na? detlot pipul nomo bin go langa det gudbala kantri, dumaji dei nomo bin bilib brabliwei.
english: We see that they weren't able to enter in because of unbelief.

kriol: wal mosis bin gibit sambala kantri langa ged klen.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

kriol: detlot femili blanga detlot wekinmen blanga det serramoni pleis hubin kambek brom det kantri weya deibin jidan prisana. siha, hesafa, tebayoth, keros, siyaha, padon, lebana, heigaba, eikub, heigab, shamlai, henan, gidel, geiha, riyaiya, resin, nekoda, gasam, yusa, paseya, besai, esna, meyunim, nefisim, bekbak, heikafa, hehura, beslath, mehida, hasha, bakos, sisera, tema, nesai en hetafa.
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

kriol: wal det dedi blanga det boswan bin brabli sik. imbin barnbarn bodi en imbin gatseik. wal pol bin go langa im, en imbin prei blanga im, en imbin pudum bingga langa im, en imbin meigim im gudwan,
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

kriol: bat jeikob bin tok, "nomo. yu go lida langa melabat, en melabat garra kaman biyain slobala, dumaji ola biginini main nokap na, en ola nenigout en ship en kau garram beibi mait dai if ai kipgon trebulin kwikbala garram yu. melabat kaman biyain slobala. bambai melabat gajimap yu langa det kantri idam."
english: Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

kriol: "im garra brabli nogud blanga ol yumob lowamen en serramonimen, dumaji yumob tufeis. yumob jis laik det greibyad weya dei meigim luk gudwan garram purdiflawa atsaidwei. bat andanith langa det greibyad ola boun en nogudwan bodipat jidan.
english: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men's bones and of all uncleanness.

kriol: en yu garra jidan brabli hepiwan wen yu oldei weshipbat langa im.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

kriol: mi na yawei meigim dijan pramis. wanbala brom deibid femili garra olweis jidan king blanga isreil,
english: For Yahweh says: "David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.

kriol: bat if im stil seimwei en im nomo bin spredat ebriweya, en im nomo garram eni boil en yu gin oni luk weya det boil bin jidan, det serramonimen garra dalim im, 'yu klinbala blanga serramoni'.
english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn't spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

kriol: nomo weship ola drimin sheip blanga ol detlot pipul weya jidan gulijap langa yumob.
english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

kriol: bat dei nomo bin go gulijap langa jisas, dumaji detlot pipul bin jadimap det haus, en detlot fobala men bin lafta galimap ontop langa det haus, en deibin deigimat det ruf rait ontop langa jisas weya imbin jandap, en wen deibin binij deigimatbat det ruf, deibin pudumdan det leimbala men garram det sweig.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

kriol: "wal det ritjmen bin tok, 'wal eibrahem, mi askimbat yu blanga jandim lesaras langa main dedi kemp, dumaji ai garram faibala braja deya laibala yet.
english: "He said, 'I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father's house—

kriol: bat im bos bin dalim im, "wi kaan stap iya, dumaji detlot pipul nomo wi kantrimen. wi garra kipgon en kamat langa det taun gulum gibiya.
english: His master said to him, "We won't enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah."

kriol: trubala ai dalim yumob. hebin en graun garra tjeinj. bat main wed kaan neba tjeinj.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kriol: en afta det gel bin dai du.
english: After them all, the woman died.

kriol: orait, mi na pol, en mi jidan speshalwan mishanri. bat mi nomo speshalwan mishanri dumaji men bin pikimat mi. nomo. nobodi bin meigim mi jidan speshalwan mishanri. oni jisas krais en god det dedi blanga wi hubin meigim im gidap laibala brom dedbala bin meigim mi jidan speshalwan mishanri.
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

kriol: deibin kipgon toktok langa im lagijat oldei, bat stil im nomo bin pudumdan hed blanga heiman en imbin dalim olabat im juwish men en im nomo rait blanga dumbat lagijat. en deibin dalim heiman, dumaji deibin wandim sabi wanim heiman garra dum langa modakai. deibin tok, "modakai im nomo rispek langa yu, en im nomo pudumdan hed langa yu laik det king bin tok. im nomo teiknodis dumaji im juwish men."
english: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn't listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.

kriol: nomeda pipul jidan ritjwan, olabat garra stil dai jis laik ola enimul.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn't endure. He is like the animals that perish.

kriol: wal yumob gin luk ola solja garram hosis kaminap na, en yumob gin luk ola bigwan shainiwan naif en ola shainiwan spiya du. wal ola dedbala bodi hipap detmatj na. nobodi kaan kaundimap olabat, en ola solja buldan ontop langa olabat.
english: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies.

kriol: afta na jisas bin dalim im wekinmen olabat, "trubala ai dalim yumob. im brabli ad blanga eni ritjmen blanga bulurrum det wei blanga god.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, "Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

kriol: "wal ai garra panishim yumob, dumaji yumob bin meigim yumob femilimob ritjwan garram najalot pipul ebrijing. yumob bin tok yumob jidan mowa haibala langa eni lowa.
english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

kriol: loda pipul bin bulurrum jisas deya, en imbin meigim ola sikbala pipul gudbala.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

kriol: yunmi oldei wek brabli adbala, dumaji yunmi trastim det laibalawan god blanga seibum yunmi, en im na garra seibum ebribodi hu bilib langa im.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

kriol: jeiban bin abum fobala san neim ilaisha, tashish, kitim en dodanim.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

kriol: dei nomo bin laigim dumbat wanim yubin dalim olabat, en deibin fogedabat ol detlot ting yubin dumbat blanga album olabat. deibin gibit bekboun langa yu. en deibin pikimat wanbala men blanga deigimbek olabat langa ijip en jidan jis laiga prisana en dumbat ola adwek. bat yu na det god hu oldei larramgo pipul fri brom olabat nogudbalawei. yu kain en gudbinji langa pipul. yu nomo gitwail kwikbala. yu laigim pipul detmatj. yu nomo bin gowei en libum melabat grengrenfatha olabat.
english: and refused to obey. They weren't mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn't forsake them.

kriol: "bat det sekanwan men bin jandap lilbit longwei, en imbin sheim blanga lukap langa hebin, en imbin hitim miselp, dumaji imbin sori blanga im nogudbalawei, en imbin tok, 'god, yu sori langa mi, dumaji mi nogudbala.'"
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn't even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, 'God, be merciful to me, a sinner!'

kriol: irrim mi na, joshuwa. yu jidan haibala serramonimen, en ol detlot najalot serramonimen hu wek garram yu, yumob jidan laik gudbala ting blanga ola pipul wulijim dei garra luk yumob en sabi bambai ai garra dum mowa gudbala ting blanga olabat. ai garra shoum pipul main wekinmen hu dei garra gulum nyuwan wadi!
english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "yu larram ol detlot pipul hu kaan bulurrum mi lukaftumbat det olmen, en yu kaman en bulurrum mi."
english: But Jesus said to him, "Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead."

kriol: en streidawei imbin go langa ola juwish miting pleis, en imbin dalimbat ola pipul det gudnyus blanga jisas, en imbin oldei tok, "jisas na det san blanga god."
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

kriol: yu garra gajim olkain bard en olkain enimul. nomeda olabat bigwan o lilwan, bat stil yu garra gajim olabat, en yu garra pudum olabat langa det bout weya olabat kaan draun.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

kriol: en melabat wandim dubala garra kain langa yumob en meigim yumob jidan gudbalawei.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kriol: yu garra jinggabat gudwei wanim blanga tok blanga lukaftum yu laif, dumaji enibodi hu tok enijing eniweya en nomo jinggabat garra oni binijimap im laif.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

kriol: afta na jisas bin tok langa ola wekinmen blanga im, "yumob irrim mi na. yumob nomo wandi wori en oldei jinggabat weya yumob garra faindim daga blanga dagadagat. en yumob nomo wandi wori en oldei jinggabat weya yumob garra faindim klos blanga werrimon, dumaji god nomo bin gibit yumob laif jis blanga dagat daga. en im nomo bin gibit yumob bodi jis blanga werrimon klos.
english: He said to his disciples, "Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

kriol: wal maitbi yumob nomo agri langa mi blanga tharran, en yumob reken yumob garra dum difrinwei. wal yumob dalim mi na. det wed blanga god bin kamat brom yumob? nomo. det wed nomo bin kamat brom yumob. o maitbi yumob reken nobodi garram det wed blanga god. oni yumob garram det wed. bat najing, dumaji god bin gibit im wed langa ola najalot tjetj ebriweya.
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

kriol: 'tudei na yumob garra kipgon thru det kantri gulum moweb, en yumob garra go thru det taun gulum eiya.
english: "You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

kriol: yawei yu gajim yu shild en jandap lida main en seibum mi.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

kriol: imbin pudum wanbala goldinwan buligi deya langa det taun gulum bethel, en det najawan langa det taun gulum den.
english: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

kriol: im seibum olabat brom daidaibat, en im nomo larram olabat dai wen nomo eni daga jidan langa olabat kantri.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

kriol: "wal yawei det boswan god bin kipgon tok langa detlot ijip pipul, 'yumob oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip langa det taun gulum mimfas. wal ai garra bitsimap ol detlot drimin sheip. nomo enibodi garra jidan bos deya langa yumob kantri, en yumob garra bradin nomo lilbit.
english: "'The Lord Yahweh says: "I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis. There will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt. I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

kriol: lagijat na mi oldei dalimbat enibodi hu wandi testim mi, dumaji sambala pipul reken minbala banabas nomo garram det rait. dei reken minbala garra wek blanga gedim minbala ron enijing, dumaji minbala nomo mishanri.
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

kriol: olabat oldei gibitat en lendimbat enijing langa najalot pipul, en olabat biginini olabat oldei meigim olabat gudbinji.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

kriol: en raidaran langa det brik yu garra bildimap brabli strongbala wol, en pailimap graun blanga meigim roud weya garra go oba langa det wol, en yu garra gajim hebiwan pos blanga nokamdan det geit jis laik ola soljamob oldei dumbat wen dei meigim kemp olaran langa eni taun blanga teikoba det taun.
english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

kriol: dumaji blanga dijan, mi na yawei det boswan god blanga isreil garra panishim king nebakanesa en det kantri seimwei laik aibin panishim det boswan brom asiriya.
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

kriol: en yumob oldei dumbat brabli krulbala ting langa yumob kantrimen, en yumob dumbat nogudbala ting, en yumob nomo rili trubala langa yumob waif, bat stil yumob reken dijan kantri blanga yumob.
english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor's wife. So should you possess the land?"'

kriol: detlot krulbala pipul oldei dalimbat laiya, en olabat oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, en olabat oldei wandim meigimbat krulbala plen blanga binijimap ola po pipul, nomeda deibin askimbat blanga gibit olabat feyago.
english: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

kriol: yawei na oldei meigim det plen blanga wi laif. hau wi gin sabi wotkain laif wi garra abum?
english: A man's steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?

kriol: "'en afta yumob bin jidan deya langa bebalon fo 70 yiya, ai garra shoum yumob ai laigim yumob en ai garra kipum main pramis. ai garra bringimbek yumob langa yumob ronwan kantri na.
english: For Yahweh says, "After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

kriol: wal det king bin dalim detlot pipul blanga dum lagijat, en deibin heingimap detlot tenbala san blanga heiman deya langa susa.
english: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

kriol: nomo fogedabat det gudfren blanga yu femili olabat. yu nomo go langa yu femilimob blanga album yu wen yu abum trabul. yu fren hu jidan gulijap langa yu im mobeda den yu femilimob hu jidan brabli longwei.
english: Don't forsake your friend and your father's friend. Don't go to your brother's house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

kriol: sebenbalataim ebridei mi tok theingkyu langa yu dumaji wen yu jadjim pipul yu gibit olabat feyago.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kriol: eliyel bin det boswan blanga hebran femili en det namba blanga detlot pipul hubin kaman bin 80.
english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

kriol: "ai nomo jidan blanga dijan wel, en seimwei du dei nomo jidan blanga dijan wel.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

kriol: nomeda deibin oldei taiyimap im langa bingga en langa fut, bat stil imbin oldei pulumat det tjein brom im bingga en breigim det tjein langa im fut. nobodi bin strongbala blanga stapam im.
english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

kriol: wal wen ishboseth bin stil jidan king blanga ola isreil pipul, ebna en ola najalot isreil solja blanga ishboseth bin gowei brom det taun gulum mahanaiyim weya deibin oldei jidan, en deibin go najasaid langa det jodan riba langa det taun gulum gibiyan.
english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

kriol: wal wen jisas en detlot thribala wekinmen blanga im bin kambek langa detlot najalot wekinmen, deibin luk bigmob pipul deya langa olabat. wan men bin kaman langa jisas, en imbin baudan lida langa im,
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

kriol: "wal ai dalim yumob wanim det stori im tok. det sid im jis laik det wed blanga god.
english: "Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

kriol: en imbin seibum wi. im nomo bin seibum wi, dumaji wibin dumbat gudbala ting. wibin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting. imbin seibum wi, dumaji imbin fil sori blanga wi, en imbin seibum wi garram det holi spirit blanga im. det holi spirit bin klinim wi, en imbin meigim wi bon igin, en imbin gibit wi nyubala laif.
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

kriol: wal detlot klebabalawan gel bin tok, 'nomo. melabat nomo garra naf blanga gibit langa yumob. yumob go langa shop en baiyim yumob ron oil.'
english: But the wise answered, saying, 'What if there isn't enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.'

kriol: en dubala bin tok, "ei! ol yumob men brom gelali! wotfo yumob jandapbat iya lukinatbat langa top? det seim jisas weya yumob bin luk im gowap langa hebin, im garra kambek lagijat seimwei igin."
english: who also said, "You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky."

kriol: wal iba bin merrit, en wen imbin 34 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim peleg.
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

kriol: en deibin jingat langa detlot pipul hu nomo sabi brabliwei, "kaman langa det haus blanga det brabli sabibalawan." en deibin jingat langa ola silibala pipul,
english: "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!" As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kriol: "wal yumob irrim mi na. god bin meigim det sebathdei blanga album men. im nomo bin meigim det sebathdei blanga meigim men nogudbinji.
english: He said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

kriol: wal meri bin go langa detlot wekinmen blanga jisas, en imbin dalim olabat imbin luk det bos blanga olabat, en imbin dalim olabat wanim jisas bin dalim im.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

kriol: wal langa det namba 3 dei na esta bin werrimon ola speshalwan klos blanga det nambawan waif blanga det king. imbin go langa det king haus en imbin go rait insaid weya detlot pipul oldei jandapbat en weidabat blanga go en tok langa det king. det king bin jidanbat langa det speshalwan tjeya langa im rum en imbin luk deya langa det najawan rum.
english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king's house, next to the king's house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

kriol: "wal yu garra meigim pramis langa mi en langa yawei. yu garra pramis nomo blanga kilim main femili olabat, en yu garra larram det neim blanga main femili olabat kipgon olagija." lagijat na king sol bin tok.
english: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father's house."

kriol: wal wen finiyas, det san blanga eliyeisa en det grensan blanga eran det serramonimen, bin luk tharran, imbin gidap en libum det miting pleis en imbin go en gajim im spiya.
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

kriol: ol detlot solja brom det dubala taun gulum mimfas en teipanes deya langa ijip bin smeshimap yumob hed boun.
english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

kriol: yu garra laflafbat wen yu irrimbat ola nogudbala ting garra hepin, en wen dei tok yu nomo garram eni daga. en yu kaan bradin blanga eni wailwan enimul.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

kriol: en deya garram det dubala gel bigismob men bin oldei jidan en deibin meigimbat loda nois. deibin ol kaman brom deset kantri, en deibin gibit det dubala gel purdiwan amben en purdiwan het.
english: "The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.

kriol: wal yumob jinggabat hau yumob bin oldei jidanbat basdam bifo yumob bin bilib langa jisas krais. olkain nogudbala spirit bin jidan bos blanga yumob, en deibin deigidawei yumob en meigim yumob bulurrum olkain drimin weya nomo enijing.
english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

kriol: wen joiyakim bin jidan det haibala serramonimen, dislot na detlot neim blanga detlot serramonimen hubin lida blanga detlot femili blanga ola serramonimen. meraiya bin brom det femili blanga seraiya, henanaiya bin brom det femili blanga jeramaiya, meshalam bin brom det femili blanga esra, jehohana bin brom det femili blanga amaraiya, jonathan bin brom det femili blanga melakai, josef bin brom det femili blanga shebanaiya, edna bin brom det femili blanga herim, helkai bin brom det femili blanga meraiyoth, sekaraiya bin brom det femili blanga aido, meshalam bin brom det femili blanga ginathan, sikri bin brom det femili blanga abaija, wanbala lida brom det femili blanga miniyamin, piltai bin brom det femili blanga mowadaiya, shamuwa bin brom det femili blanga bilga, jehonathan bin brom det femili blanga shemaiya, metenai bin brom det femili blanga joiyarib, yusi bin brom det femili blanga jedaiya, kalai bin brom det femili blanga salai, iba bin brom det femili blanga emak, hashabaiya bin brom det femili blanga hilkaiya, en nethanel bin brom det femili blanga jedaiya.
english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers' households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

kriol: "yumob sabi wanim mi toktok? det lait im iya garram yumob. en mi na det lait. en yumob garra bilib langa mi wulijim yumob garra jidan pipul blanga det lait." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light." Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

kriol: mi jidanabat brabli gudbinjiwei dumaji mi oldei teiknodis langa yu wed.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH.

kriol: o garram waif blanga najamen. en sambala oldei silipsilipbat garram im sista, o det dedi silipsilipbat garram det waif blanga im ronwan san.
english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor's wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father's daughter.

kriol: en wen sekaraiya bin luk det einjul, imbin hatjamp, en imbin bradin du.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

kriol: yu sabi yubin meigim mi brom det klei. wal yu nomo pudumbek mi langa det graun igin.
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

kriol: en stibin bin tok, "yumob luk! ai gin luk hebin im opin, en ai gin luk det speshalwan men weya god bin pikimat. im jandapbat deya raidensaid langa god."
english: and said, "Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!"

kriol: wal jowab en im solja olabat bin go blanga fait langa detlot siriya solja na, en wen detlot siriya solja bin luk olabat kaminap blanga fait, streidawei deibin ol ranawei.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

kriol: "en yawei garra gibit yumob bigmob biginini, en bigmob sid daga, en bigmob buligi en ship.
english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

kriol: nomeda if oni lilbit pipul jidan laibala, bat stil olabat garra ol binijap. bat jis laik det rutpat blanga det tri weya jidan afta deibin kadimdan, wal sambala pipul weya aibin pikimat garra jidan laibala lagijat du.' lagijat na yawei bin tok."
