english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump."

kriol: "wal det feswan wekinmen bin kaman, en imbin tok, 'bos, yubin gibit mi wanbala mani, en aibin meigim tenbala.'
english: The first came before him, saying, 'Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.'

kriol: en langa det neksdei imbin dalim im wekinmen olabat, "kaman na. wi gobek langa judiya."
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, "Let's go into Judea again."

kriol: if im nomo bin wandi kilim det men ded, wal im garra gowei langa det pleis weya god garra pikimat, en dei kaan kilim im ded deya.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

kriol: en dei garra singim dijan fyunral song blanga yumob. "deibin binijimap det bigwan taun weya jidan wansaid langa det solwoda. basdam im pipul olabat bin jidan bos blanga det solwoda, en deibin oldei bradinbat enibodi hubin go deya.
english: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, "How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!"

kriol: wal yawei bin tok, "wotfo yubin dum dijan nogudbala ting? det blad blanga yu braja im jinginatbat langa mi brom det graun. im jinginat langa mi blanga peibek blanga im.
english: Yahweh said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries to me from the ground.

kriol: bat wen yawei laigim im pipul, im laigim olabat olagijawan. im kipgon laigimbat olagijawan, detlot pipul hu oldei rispek im, en hu oldei teiknodis langa im strongwan pramis weya imbin meigim. im dum rait ting blanga olabat biginini, en blanga olabat biginini weya garra kaman bambai.
english: But Yahweh's loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children's children,

kriol: wal dislot men en olabat grup garra dum ol detlot wek deya langa det serramoni pleis jis laik olabat grengrenfatha eran bin oldei dumbat blanga yawei det trubala god blanga ola isreil pipul.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh's house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

kriol: wal wen pol bin tok lagijat, det boswan haibala serramonimen neim enanaiyas bin dalim detlot men hubin jandap gulijap langa pol blanga beldim im langa mawus, dumaji imbin reken pol bin laiya langa god.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

kriol: en lagijat igin afta wen deibin binij det sapa, jisas bin gajim det wain, en imbin tok, "dijan wain im det nyubalawei blanga god. ai garra spilim main ronwan blad blanga yumob blanga opinimap det nyubalawei blanga god. en ebritaim wen yumob dringgim dijan wain, yumob garra dringgim blanga jinggabat mi." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me."

kriol: "blanga main pipul olabat, deibin abum loda panishmen, mowa langa detlot brabli nogudbala pipul blanga sadam. pipul nomo bin nokamdan det taun, najing. yawei det trubala god na bin dum.
english: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.

kriol: en if detlot juwish pipul tenim miselp langa im en bilib langa im brabliwei, wal im garra pudumbek olabat langa olabat seim pleis weya deibin kadof, dumaji im garram det pawa blanga pudumbek olabat.
english: They also, if they don't continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

kriol: wal loda pipul bin irrim det nyus weya jisas bin deya langa bethani, en deibin go deya blanga luk langa im, en deibin go blanga luk lesaras du, dumaji jisas bin meigim im gidap laibala brom dedbala.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

kriol: prayer wal main grenfatha olabat bin oldei wek gudbalawei blanga god, en mi oldei wek gudbalawei blanga im du, en mi oldei gibit im theingks en jidan garram det brabli gudwan filing, en ebridei en ebrinait mi oldei jinggabat yu en prei blanga yu en gibit im theingks blanga yu.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day.

kriol: wal ilaisha bin askim olabat blanga sambala flauwa, en imbin tjakam det flauwa langa det pot en imbin tok, "pudum mowa supsup blanga olabat." en wen deibin dagat, nomo enijing bin rong, imbin gudwan.
english: But he said, "Then bring meal." He threw it into the pot; and he said, "Serve it to the people, that they may eat." And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

kriol: en det beibi mami bin oldei jinggabat brabli detlot wed weya detlot stakmen bin dalimbat olabat.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

kriol: ol detlot pipul brom isreil garra stap jelasbat langa detlot pipul brom juda, en olabat kaan jidan enami enimo.
english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won't envy Judah, and Judah won't persecute Ephraim.

kriol: wal ai garra panishim olabat blanga olabat nogudbalawei. ai garra meigim olabat ardimbat blanga olabat nogudbalawei.
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

kriol: wal yu kaan faindim enijing weya god nomo lau langa det taun. en det graun weya god bin meigim adwan longtaim nomo deya du, dumaji det speshal boswan tjeya blanga god en jisas krais im deya insaid langa det taun, en ola wekinmen blanga god garra weship im deya du.
english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

kriol: wal shiba bin go thru ola kantri blanga ola isreil klen, en imbin kamat langa det taun gulum eibulbethmaka, en ola femili blanga im dedi bikri bin majurrumap miselp, en deibin go deya langa det taun garram shiba.
english: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

kriol: en wen deibin luk im wokwok ontop langa woda, deibin brabli bradin, dumaji deibin reken dibuldibul bin kaminap, en deibin stat jingat bradinbalawei detmatj.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, "It's a ghost!" and they cried out for fear.

kriol: yu garra dalim ola pipul god garra larramgo olabat brom olabat nogudbalawei, en im garra meigim olabat jidan fri, dumaji det god blanga wi im brabli kainbala en soribala.
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

kriol: det wekinmen hu jidan laiga prisana en dei meigim im king, det silibala men hu oldei dagadagatbat tumatj daga,
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

kriol: det king bin pudum dubala pol 15.5 mita apendan, en deibin pudum dubala lida langa det serramoni pleis. dubala bin abum najawan ting laiga boul langa top, en deibin 2.2 mita apendan.
english: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

kriol: bat wi blanga god. en detlot pipul hu sabi god lisin langa wi. bat detlot pipul hu nomo blanga god nomo lisin langa wi. yumob sabi na? if enibodi lisin langa det wed blanga god weya wi tok, wal im garram det holi spirit weya oldei tok trubalawei. bat if im nomo lisin langa det wed blanga god weya wi tok, wal im garram det laiyinwan spirit insaid langa im.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn't listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

kriol: afta na jisas bin dalim olabat dijan stori blanga meigim olabat jinggabat weya god gibit olabat taim. imbin tok, "wantaim wan men bin abum wan tri langa im gadin, en imbin go en lukabat det daga langa det tri. bat im nomo bin faindim enijing.
english: He spoke this parable. "A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

kriol: ruma det sekanwan waif blanga neihowa bin abum fobala lilboi, en deibin gulum olabat neim teba, geiham, teihash en meiyaka.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

kriol: yumob irrim langa mi na. ebrijing weya yawei bin pramisim im wekinmen, det speshalwan mesinja gulum ilaija, bin hepin trubala langa det femilimob blanga king eiheb."
english: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of Yahweh's word, which Yahweh spoke concerning Ahab's house. For Yahweh has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah."

kriol: wal jisas bin jidanbat deya 40 dei en 40 nait, en im nomo bin dagadagat eni daga.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

kriol: detlot shop menija brom ola najalot kantri kaan bilib wanim bin hepin. yubin dai brabli krulbalawei, en yubin binijap olagijawan.'"
english: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more."'"

kriol: imbin jandim detlot eramiyan pipul brom sanraiswei en detlot filastain pipul brom sangodanwei en olabat bin binijimap olabat. wal yawei im stil wail langa olabat en im garra kipgon panishimbat olabat.
english: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kriol: yu na oldei jadjimbat melabat holot. yu gidap en panishim detlot praudbala pipul.
english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

kriol: dalim olabat wanim aibin tok, 'yumob bin brabli gudbinji wen yumob bin luk weya deibin bitsimap main serramoni pleis en deibin deigidawei ola juda pipul prisana en deibin libumbat det pleis jidan emtiwan, nomo garra enijing.
english: Tell the children of Ammon, 'Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says, "Because you said, 'Aha!' against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,

kriol: wal king deibid bin olredi pudumap wanbala tent deya, en deibin pudumdan det seikridwan boks insaid langa det tent, en afta king deibid bin abum sekrifais ofring blanga god, en imbin abum det serramoni blanga det ofring gulum feloship ofring.
english: They brought in God's ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

kriol: nomeda aibin dumbat ola gudbala ting blanga olabat, bat stil dei oldei dumbat nogudbala ting langa mi. nomeda ai laigim olabat detmatj, bat olabat heidimbat mi.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin kambek brom det jodan riba weya jon bin beptaisim im, det holi spirit bin jidan langa im, en det holi spirit bin deigidawei im langa det bush kantri,
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness.

kriol: wal ai dalim yumob. loda kristjan pipul garra bulurrum det nogudbalawei blanga detlot laiyawan titja, en detlot kristjan pipul garra meigim najalot pipul du tok nogudbalawei blanga det trubalawei.
english: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

kriol: yawei bin tok, "yubin jidan najing, bat mi na bin meigim yu jidan bos blanga main pipul olabat langa isreil. bat yubin bulurrum det wei blanga king jerabowam en yubin lidimbat main pipul olabat nogudbalawei. en detlot nogudbala ting blanga yumob meigim mi wail nomo lilbit na.
english: "Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

kriol: "wal manesa en ifreiyim det dubala san blanga yu hubin bon iya langa ijip bifo aibin kaman iya, dubala main san du jis laik rubin en simiyan main ronwan san dubala. en bambai wen ai garra hendimoba main kantri langa main san olabat, ai garra gibit haf langa manesa en ifreiyim du.
english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

kriol: wal mosis en joshuwa det san blanga nan, dubala bin singsing det song adbala wulijim detlot isreil pipul garra irrim.
english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

kriol: en if ai askim kwestjan langa yumob, wal yumob kaan ensim mi du.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

kriol: det kantri blanga olabat bin go brom det taun gulum heshban raidap langa detlot thribala taun gulum remamispa, betonim en mahanaiyim raidap langa det pleis gulum lodaba,
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

kriol: wal aibin gibit bigismob brabli gudwan gol en bigismob brabli gudwan silba blanga meigim brabli purdiwan detlot wol olaran langa det serramoni pleis,
english: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

kriol: wal wanim yumob reken? wi garra dum wanim yumob dumbat en merrit detlot gel brom najalot kantri du? wi kaan dum detkain nogudbala ting." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?"

kriol: imbin deigim benjamin garram im tenbala san neim bela, beka, eshbel, gera, neiman, ihai, rosh, mapim, hupim en ard. det najawan san blanga jeikob en reitjul neim josef bin jidan deya langa det kantri olredi, en imbin merrit langa wan gel neim eisanath. det dedi blanga det gel bin neim potafera, en imbin serramonimen langa det taun gulum heliyapalas. deya na langa det kantri, eisanath bin abum dubala boi blanga josef neim manesa en ifreiyim.
english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

kriol: wal king sedakaiya bin gibit oda langa im soljamob blanga lokimap mi langa det yad langa im haus. aibin stap deya na, en ebridei olabat bin oldei gibitbat mi damba brom det pleis weya olabat oldei gugumbat daga raidap ola damba langa det taun bin ol ranat.
english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers' street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

kriol: "wal nomeda wanim yumob dum blanga meigim miselp redi blanga det fait, bat stil yumob garra dai. det faiya garra barnimap yumob, en sambala pipul garra dai langa det fait. detlot enami blanga yumob garra binijimap yumob jis laik ola grashopa binijimap ola daga langa gadin.
english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

kriol: wal ebribodi bin ranabat ebriweya langa det taun, en deibin ol ran en grebum pol, en deibin pulum im atsaid brom det serramoni pleis, en deibin jadimap det dowa blanga det serramoni pleis.
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

kriol: wal aibin prei na, "yawei det brabli haibala boswan god, yu na oldei tridimbat ola pipul gudwei, en yu sabi wanim olabat oldei jinggabat en wotkain filing dei oldei abum. ai garra libum ebrijing langa yu bingga, wulijim ai garra luk yu garra panishim dislot pipul." lagijat na aibin prei.
english: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.

kriol: yawei bin brabli wail langa dubala, en afta imbin gowei na.
english: Yahweh's anger burned against them; and he departed.

kriol: afta na jisas bin dalim detlot pipul najawan stori, "geman wan olgamen bin abum tenbala bigwan mani, en imbin lujim wanbala. wal wanim yumob reken im garra dum? im garra laidim det lemp blanga im, en im garra klinim im kemp, en im garra lukabat ebriweya raidap im faindim det mani,
english: "Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn't light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

kriol: shema bin dedi blanga reiham en det grenfatha blanga jorakiyam. rekem bin det braja blanga shema en det dedi blanga shamai,
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

kriol: wal saiman en im fren olabat bin go lukabat jisas,
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

kriol: det kantri asiriya kaan seibum melabat, en melabat ronwan hosis en ola wepan kaan album melabat. wal melabat kaan tok langa detlot drimin sheip igin en gulum olabat god blanga melabat. detlot drimin sheip nomo god. oni yu na yawei det trubala god, en yu na oldei kain langa detlot pipul hu nomo garram enibodi blanga album olabat.'" lagijat na hoseiya bin tok.
english: Assyria can't save us. We won't ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, 'Our gods!' for in you the fatherless finds mercy."

kriol: bat ai nomo garram det rait blanga dalim yunbala blanga jidan langa main raidensaid en lefthensaid. oni god garram det rait blanga pikimat hu garra jidan langa det dubala pleis."
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared."

kriol: "yu si? king deibid bin dumbat det wek blanga god wen imbin laibala, en afta wen imbin dai, deibin gaburrumap im bodi wansaid langa im grengrenfatha olabat, en im bodi bin go nogudwan.
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

kriol: en ol detlot pipul hu jidan blanga jisas krais bin libum det nogudbala laif blanga olabat. im jis laik deibin kilim miselp en binijimap ol detlot ebrijing weya olabat bodi bin oldei wandi dumbat.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

kriol: bat yumob garra jinggabat. if olabat merrit langa eni men brom najawan klen, olabat kantri garra jidan blanga det klen, en wanim melabat abum garra jidan mowa lilwan.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

kriol: kwikbalawei ai bina faindim main ronwan pleis blanga kipum miselp seifwan brom det strongwan win en bigwan rein.
english: "I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm."

kriol: wal aibin jinggabat brabliwei dijan ting, en ai sabi god im jidan bos blanga ola gudbala en klebabala pipul, en ebrijing dei oldei dum. dei nomo sabi if god garra laigim olabat o heidim olabat. dei nomo sabi wanim garra hepin langa olabat.
english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn't know it; all is before them.

kriol: wal wen god bin joinimap wi garram jisas krais, imbin lidimap wi blanga jidan garram im, en imbin gibit wi det seimwan pawa weya im garram blanga bidim ola nogudwan ting langa dijan wel,
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

kriol: wal det olmen aisik bin tok, "tuleit na! det braja blanga yu bin kaman trikiwan, en imbin deigim det laswan wed main weya ai bina gibit langa yu."
english: He said, "Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing."

kriol: brom deya king omri en ola soljamob blanga im bin libum gibathan en deibin go blanga fait en deibin teikoba taisa. wal wen king simri bin luk deibin teikoba det taun, imbin go insaid langa det bigwan haus blanga det king en imbin meigim bigwan faiya en imbin barnimap det haus en imbin dai langa det faiya du.
english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

kriol: en afta yu garra kaman gulijap langa mi. oni yu miselp garra kaman. detlot najalot men kaan kaman langa det hil."
english: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him."

kriol: detlot femili blanga detlot wekinmen blanga det serramoni pleis hubin kambek brom det kantri weya deibin jidan prisana bin siha, hesafa, tebayoth, keros, siya, padon, lebana, heigaba, shalmai, henan, gidel, geiha, riyaiya, resin, nekoda, gasam, yusa, paseya, besai, meyunim, nefushesim, bekbak, heikafa, hehura, beslith, mehida, hasha, bakos, sisera, tema, nesai en hetafa.
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

kriol: wal detlot wekinmen blanga im bin toktok miselp na, "enibodi bin bajimap daga blanga im?"
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, "Has anyone brought him something to eat?"

kriol: en afta yawei bin shoum mi fobala wekinmen en holot bin abum hema.
english: Yahweh showed me four craftsmen.

kriol: "wal yu go na, mosis, dumaji mi jandim yu langa det king blanga gajim main pipul olabat. mi jandim yu blanga deigimat olabat brom det kantri." lagijat na god bin tok langa mosis.
english: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt."

kriol: wal detlot faibala filastain king bin lukinatbat langa olabat brom longwei, en afta wen detlot isreil pipul bin binij gibitbat detlot ofring, detlot faibala king bin gobek langa det taun gulum ekran. wal det ston weya detlot isreil pipul bin pudum det seikridwan boks, im stil deya tudei blanga meigim wi jinggabat wanim bin hepin deya longtaim.
english: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

kriol: imbin tok, "yu go en dalim king deibid mi garram thribala difrinwan ting blanga panishim im. en im garra pikimat wanbala blanga mi blanga dum."
english: "Go and speak to David, saying, 'Yahweh says, "I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you."'"

kriol: yubin pramisim langa yu neim blanga sori langa ola pipul blanga olabat nogudbalawei. wal yu sori langa mi na blanga ol main nogudwan ting.
english: For your name's sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

kriol: en im nomo wandim yu blanga bildimap det haus blanga det boks, dumaji brom det taim weya imbin deigidawei ola isreil pipul brom ijip raidap tudei im nomo bin jidan langa haus. en nomeda weya detlot isreil pipul bin oldei go, imbin oldei go garram olabat, en imbin oldei jidan insaid langa tent. en imbin oldei pikimat ola boswan blanga detlot pipul du. bat im nomo bin askim olabat wotfo dei nomo bin bildimap gudwan haus blanga im.' lagijat na yu garra dalim deibid.
english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

kriol: wal semyul bin tok shotkat langa king sol na, "yu jidan kwait, dumaji ai garra dalim yu wanim yawei bin dalim mi naitaim." wal king sol bin tok, "wal gowan. yu dalim mi."
english: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night." He said to him, "Say on."

kriol: olabat bin stap dumbat ola rait ting. dei oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting jis laik dei wok langa brabli dakbala pleis.
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

kriol: en afta dubala bin tok, "deya langa det roud wen imbin dalim yunmi ebrijing det oltestaman bin tok blanga im, yunmi bin abum brabli gudwan filing insaid langa yunmi jis laik yunmi bin womim miselp langa faiya."
english: They said to one another, "Weren't our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?"

kriol: en if yumob nomo wandi bulurrum yawei, wal tudei na yumob garra jinggabat hu yumob garra bulurrum. maitbi yumob wandim bulurrum detlot drimin weya yumob grengrenfatha olabat bin bulurrum longtaim deya langa mesapoteimiya, o maitbi yumob wandi bulurrum detlot drimin blanga ola emarait pipul iya langa dijan kantri weya yumob jidan tudei. bat ai dalim yumob. mi en main femili olabat garra bulurrum yawei det trubala god." lagijat na joshuwa bin tok.
english: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh."

kriol: detlot mamiwan en dediwan garra dagadagatbat olabat ronwan biginini en ola biginini garra dagadagatbat dei mami en dedi. detlot pipul hu stil jidanbat laibala, ai garra spredimat olabat langa ebri kantri.
english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

kriol: "bat yawei, ai nomo bin wandim yu blanga jandim nogudbala ting langa olabat. ai nomo bin wandim trabul garra kaman langa olabat. yawei, yu sabi ol dijan. yu sabi wanim aibin tok.
english: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven't desired the woeful day. You know. That which came out of my lips was before your face.

kriol: en im sabi melabat nomo bin dalimbat yumob det gudnyus blanga meigim yumob o enibodi preisimbat melabat.
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

kriol: en trubala ai dalim yumob. if enibodi bulurrum main wed, wal im kaan neba dai."
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death."

kriol: wal eibrahem bin tok, "nomo. yu kaan deigimbek main san langa main kantri,
english: Abraham said to him, "Beware that you don't bring my son there again.

kriol: en brom det kantri blanga rubin klen deibin gibit olabat detlot fobala taun gulum besa, jeihas,
english: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

kriol: wal king salaman bin jingat langa ol detlot lidamob brom ola klen en femili brom isreil blanga go langa jerusalem blanga deigim det seikridwan boks brom saiyan, det taun blanga deibid langa det serramoni pleis.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers' households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh's covenant out of David's city, which is Zion.

kriol: yawei, aibin reken ai kaan neba luk yu igin, en kaan neba luk enibodi hu jidan langa dijan wel.
english: I said, "I won't see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

kriol: ola heya blanga olabat bin jis laik heya blanga yanggel, en ola tuth blanga olabat bin jis laiga laiyan tuth.
english: They had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

kriol: afta na det yangwan san blanga nowa neim hem bin wokin langa det tent, en imbin luk im dedi leidan deya neigidbala. wal imbin go atsaid na, en imbin dalim shem en jeifeth det dubala braja blanga im,
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

kriol: wal sera bin luk det najawan san blanga eibrahem neim ishmeil. imbin det san blanga det wekingel neim heiga hubin kaman brom det kantri gulum ijip. en sera bin luk ishmeil bin tisimbat aisik.
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

kriol: wal neiman bin tok, "if yu nomo wandim enijing brom mi wal yu larram mi loudimap dubala dongki garram bigmob graun blanga deigimbek langa main kemp, dumaji brom tudei na ai kaan gibit sekrifais o barnim sekrifais ofring langa najalot drimin, oni langa yawei det trubala god.
english: Naaman said, "If not, then, please let two mules' load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to Yahweh.

kriol: "'wal langa det taim na ai garra gibit detlot speshalwan klos en det speshalwan wek en pawa blanga yu langa main wekinmen neim eliyakim, det san blanga hilkaiya. en eliyakim im garra jidan det dediwan blanga ola jerusalem pipul en blanga det king femili brom juda du.
english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

kriol: wal esta bin tok, "det men hu wandim binijimap melabat, im heiman, en im na det enami blanga melabat. im nomo laigim ola juwish pipul." wal heiman bin bradin detmatj wen im luk det king en im waif dubala.
english: Esther said, "An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!" Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

kriol: en if enibodi trai en seibum im ron laif, wal im garra lujim im laif. bat if enibodi lujim im laif blanga mi, wal im seibum im laif.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

kriol: det pawa blanga god weya wek langa wi, im det seimwan pawa weya god bin yusum blanga meigim jisas krais gidap laibala brom dedbala, en im det seimwan pawa gin weya imbin yusum wen imbin meigim im jidan bos deya langa hebin langa im raidensaid.
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

kriol: king josaiya yu irrimbat wanim mi garra dum. aibin luk yubin brabli nogudbinji wen yubin irrim wanim garra hepin langa dijan kantri en hau ola pipul garra binijap. yubin breigim yu klos soribalawei, en aibin irrim yu kraikraibat.
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, you shall tell him this, 'Yahweh, the God of Israel says: "About the words which you have heard,

kriol: bat yawei bin meigim det king stil jidan admen, en det king nomo bin larramgo detlot isreil pipul.
english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he didn't let the children of Israel go.

kriol: nomo jidan nogudbinji blanga detlot nogudbala pipul hu dumbat rong ting, en nomo teiknodis langa olabat.
english: By David. Don't fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

kriol: deibin meigim tenbala matiriyal, en detlot matiriyal bin jidan 12 mita longwei en 2 mita kroswei,
english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

kriol: afta tharran yubin gaburrumap main boun garram bif en skin.
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

kriol: en ebri sangodantaim wen im kaman blanga laidim det lemp, im garra barnim det gudsmelwan medisin du. dijan na det lowa blanga barnim det gudsmelwan medisin, en dis lowa garra jidan olagijawan.
english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.

kriol: 1 orait, mi na jeims, en mi wekinmen blanga god en blanga jisas krais det boswan. en mi raidimbat dijan leda langa ola kristjan pipul langa ebri kantri, en mi tok gudei langa main kristjan braja en sista olabat.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

kriol: meigim ol im femili olabat binijap, en nomo larram enibodi jinggabat im neim igin.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

kriol: "detlot pipul langa ola najalot kantri hu jidan wansaid langa det solwoda, dei garra hatjamp wen dei garra irrim yumob jinginatbat adbala wen detlot enami garra kadimbat en kilimbat yumob.
english: "The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: 'Won't the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

kriol: imbin dalim mi det haus wansaid langa det geit langa nowathsaid im blanga detlot serramonimen hu oldei wek langa det serramoni pleis.
english: He said to me, "This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

kriol: en mi na garra jidan faiyawan wol raidaran langa jerusalem blanga maindimbat det pleis, en ai garra jidan deya garram main brabli shainiwan lait blanga lukaftum main pipul.'"
english: For I,' says Yahweh, 'will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

kriol: nomo enijing kaan stapam yu wen yu wok langa det sabibalawei, en nomo enijing kaan meigim yu buldan wen yu ran.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

kriol: yumob sabi? jisas krais nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting. bat god bin wandi album wi, en imbin meigim im jidan jis laiga sekrifais ofring blanga ola nogudbala ting weya wibin dumbat, en blanga tharran na thru jisas krais wi gin jidan raitwei langa god.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

kriol: en iya mi jidan garram dislot pipul weya yubin pikimat blanga yu ronselp weya nobodi kaan kaundimap olabat.
english: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can't be numbered or counted for multitude.

kriol: wal detlot fobala najakain enimul bin oldei singsing lagijat na. en deibin rispek langa god brabli, en deibin oldei gibit theingks garram song langa det sambodi hubin oldei jidan langa det speshalwan boswan tjeya langa midul. im na jidan laibala olagija.
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

kriol: "pipul kaminap brom det kantri brom nowathsaid. dislot pipul olabat nomo lilwan, olabat brabli bigismob, en olabat brom det longweiwan kantri. bigismob king gitredibat blanga go langa wo.
english: "Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

kriol: yu reken wen yu dum wanim god wandim yu blanga dum, im oldei gibit yu gudbala ting?
english: that you ask, 'What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?'

kriol: wal ol detlot juwish pipul deya nomo bin seim laik detlot juwish pipul langa thesalonaika, dumaji deibin wandi lisin langa det wed brabli, en ebridei deibin oldei tjekoba langa det oltestaman blanga faindat if det wed weya pol bin tok im trubala,
english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

kriol: wal sambala serramonimen gulum ferasi bin kaman langa jisas, en deibin askim im kwestjan blanga trai en trikim im, "if eni men nomo wandim im waif, im lau blanga andimwei im?"
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?"

kriol: yu garra tok, 'yumob bin luk ebrijing weya yawei bin dum langa detlot pipul langa ijip. yumob sabi imbin lukaftumbat yumob en imbin deigidawei yumob, en yumob sabi imbin bringimap yumob iya blanga jidan garram im.
english: 'You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles' wings, and brought you to myself.

kriol: "wal main braja jonathan, aibin laigim yu detmatj, en mi brabli nogudbinji blanga yu na. yu nomo bin laigim mi seimwei laik ol detlot gel laigim mi. nomo. brabliwei yubin laigim mi mowa den ol detlot gel hubin laigim mi.
english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.

kriol: wal emnon nomo bin lisin langa teima, en imbin pulumdan im, dumaji imbin strongbala, en imbin dum nogudbala ting langa im.
english: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.

kriol: detlot doktabala en klebabala men bin kaman blanga ridim dislot wed, en blanga dalim mi wanim im min, bat olabat nomo sabi wanim im min.
english: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.

kriol: wal juda bin apset na, en imbin go en tok langa josef streit langa im feis. imbin tok, "yu nomo gitwail langa mi weya mi tok streidat langa yu. ai sabi yu jidan bos jis laik det king. bat stil yunmi garra tok mijamet.
english: Then Judah came near to him, and said, "Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord's ears, and don't let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

kriol: if yu gowei brom iya en krosoba langa det krik gulum kidron, wal yu garra dai en det bleim garra go langa yuselp." lagijat na king salaman bin tok.
english: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head."

kriol: deibin meigim det speshalwan tjeya blanga king salaman du. sambala pat blanga det tjeya bin abum det shainiwan boun brom elafen gulum aibri, en det najawan pat deibin gaburrumap garram det brabli gudwan gol.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

kriol: oni wi na hu jidan laibala garra gibit im theingks olagijawan. aleiluya! preisim yawei!
english: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!

kriol: god garra jandim det grengrensan blanga king deibid. det grengrensan im brabli strongbala, en im na garra seibum wi.
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David.

kriol: mosis en eliyeisa bin gajim ol detlot gol wanim detlot najalot pipul bin werrimonbat.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

kriol: olabat nomo bin wandi dagat daga en deibin gulijap dai.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

kriol: wal ai dalim yumob na. yumob garra larramgo det men fri na. en wen yumob larramgo im fri, mi larramgo im fri du. bat aibin olredi larramgo im fri. en aibin larramgo im fri lida langa jisas krais, dumaji ai wandi meigim yumob ol jidan gudbinji mijamet.
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

kriol: "wal king eiheb, lagijat na dis ting bin hepin dumaji yawei bin larram ol dislot speshalwan mesinja dalim yu laiya. bat yawei imselp tok langa yu, 'brabli bigwan trabul garra kaman langa yu.'" lagijat na maikaiya bin tok.
english: Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you."

kriol: if enibodi gibit feloship ofring langa mi, nomeda imbin pramis blanga dumbat, o gibitbat mi blanga presen, det enimul kaan abum enijing rong langa im if im garra meigim mi gudbinji.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

kriol: en ebribodi brom sanraiswei en sangodanwei garra sabi mi na jidan yawei det trubala god, en nomo eni drimin im riliwan.
english: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am Yahweh, and there is no one else.

kriol: en det waif hubin abum ola biginini bin jelas langa hena, en imbin oldei mokimbat im blanga meigim im nogudbinji, dumaji god nomo bin larram im abum eni biginini.
english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.

kriol: en yu nomo bin gibitbat daga langa detlot pipul hubin oldei jidanbat hanggribala, en yu nomo bin gibit woda blanga dringgim wen deibin jidanbat thestibala.
english: You haven't given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

kriol: meigim detlot boswan kaman brom ijip garram ola kopawan presen, en meigim detlot ithiyopiya pipul lidimap olabat bingga blanga prei langa god.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

kriol: en detlot men hu garra wek langa det serramoni pleis, en detlot serramonimen hubin femili lain blanga eliyeisa en ithama, dei garra sodimat det wek wen dei tjakambat det dubala speshalwan ston.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

kriol: if det pleis im longwei blanga weship yawei en blanga garrimap ola ofring daga en ola enimul blanga ofring weya yawei bin gibit langa yumob, wal yumob dum dijan.
english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,

kriol: king eiheb bin tok langa king jehosafet, "aibin dalim yu im nomo tok eni gudbala ting blanga mi. im oldei tok nogudbala ting!"
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?"

kriol: wal det fobala men neim yubyulas, pudins, lainas en klaudiya olabat tok gudei langa yu, en ola najalot kristjan pipul iya tok gudei langa yu du. wal timathi, yu garra trai en kaman langa mi bifo kolwethataim.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

kriol: wal det lowamen bin tok, "'yu garra laigim god brabliwei. yu garra gibit miselp laif langa im. holbit yu garra gibit miselp langa im. en yu garra abum filing oni blanga im, en yu garra jinggabat im oldei langa yu main, en yu garra adwek blanga im.' en 'yu garra laigim ola najalot pipul brabliwei jis laik yu laigim miselp.'" lagijat na det lowamen bin tok.
english: He answered, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself."

kriol: "isikiyel, yu redi blanga jadjim dislot boswan men na? yu gin dum, en meigim olabat jinggabat ol detlot nogudbala ting weya olabat grengrenfathamob bin oldei dumbat.
english: "Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

kriol: yumob tok, 'melabat brabli nogudbala en melabat sheim miselp. melabat fil brabli wikwan, dumaji detlot streinja pipul bin teikoba det seikridwan pleis langa det serramoni pleis.'
english: "We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of Yahweh's house."

kriol: "wal det boswan bin tok, 'yu nogudbala wekinmen. yu brabli leisibala. yubin sabi mi admen, en ai oldei gajimbat ebrijing eniwei en ai nomo oldei wek adbala.
english: "But his lord answered him, 'You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn't sow, and gather where I didn't scatter.

kriol: en god bin luk ol detlot ting weya imbin meigim, en imbin brabli gudbinji, dumaji ol detlot ting bin brabli gudwan. brom deya naitaim bin gowei, en wen imbin ailibala, imbin det namba 7 dei na.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

kriol: bat yu kaan neba bildimap. im blanga yu san, yu ronwan san na garra bildimap det serramoni pleis blanga mi.'
english: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.'

kriol: wal wantaim tharran kantri bin refait pipul kantri en deibin jidan deya olagija. detlot emanait pipul bin gulum olabat seimsumim pipul.
english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

kriol: en lagijat du det tang im jis laiga lilwan faiya insaid langa yumob bodi, en det faiya im kamat brom det helfaiya, en im spredimat ola nogudbala ting ebriweya insaid langa yumob, en im meigim yumob laif nogud.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

kriol: det feswan bin luk jis laiga laiyan, en det sekanwan bin luk jis laiga buligi, en det namba thriwan bin abum feis jis laik yunmi, en det namba fo bin luk jis laiga igulok weya im flaiflai.
english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

kriol: wal yawei det haibala boswan god bin tok, "ai garra panishim olabat! ola yangmen blanga olabat garra gitkil langa wo, en blanga olabat bigininimob garra dai, dumaji olabat nomo garra abum eni daga blanga dagat.
english: therefore Yahweh of Armies says, 'Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.

kriol: yawei na oldei meigim detlot brabli wikwan pipul jidan strongbala.
english: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

kriol: wal bilded bin tok, "wal yu jinggabat detlot dedwan pipul hu sheiksheikbat langa det pleis andanith langa det bigwan solwoda weya ola dedbala pipul oldei go.
english: "The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

kriol: en imbin jandim det wed langa ola keinanait pipul disaid langa det jodan riba en langa ola keinanait pipul det said langa det jodan riba en langa ola emarait, hitait, perasait en jebusait pipul hubin jidan langa det hil kantri en langa ola hibait pipul hubin jidan langa det hil gulum heman deya langa det kantri gulum mispa. king jeibin bin jingat langa ol detlot pipul na,
english: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

kriol: bat yuraiya nomo bin go langa im kemp. imbin go en kemp garram ola solja deya gin atsaid langa det dowa blanga det haus blanga king deibid.
english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and didn't go down to his house.

kriol: imbin git redi blanga kilim mi garram det shapwan spiya,
english: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

kriol: wal king deibid bin dalim itai, "yumob kaan bulurrumbat mi, dumaji ai garra wokabat langa bush kantri, en ai nomo sabi weya ai garra go. ai kaan meigim yumob bulurrumbat mi, dumaji yumob nomo main kantrimen olabat. yumob brom longweiwan kantri. en nomeda yumob nomo jidan langa yumob ronwan kantri, bat stil yu nomo bin jidan iya langa main kantri longtaim. en nomeda mi gudbinji blanga yumob, bat stil yumob garra gobek langa taun langa det nyubala king. en ai garra askim yawei blanga kain langa yu en jidan trubala langa yu." lagijat na king deibid bin tok langa itai.
english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, "Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

kriol: en imbin go en tok langa detlot najalot spirit hubin jidan prisana langa det dakbala pleis.
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

kriol: bambai na yumob garra askimbat miselp, 'weya detlot bosmen hubin meigim wi jidan bradinbalawei, en hubin oldei meigimbat wi peiyim olabat detmatj teks mani?'
english: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

kriol: wal deibin luk langa det buk gulum buk blanga laif blanga ola neim blanga detlot dedbala pipul weya deibin jadjim olabat, en if dei nomo bin faindim olabat neim deya, binij. deibin tjakam olabat langa det bigbala faiya du.
english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

kriol: en langa det kantri blanga det isaka klen deibin abum dislot taun gulum kedish, daberath, remoth en einam.
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

kriol: wal ola ebrijing weya king manesa bin dum wen imbin jidan king, en im preya langa yawei, en detlot woning brom im speshalwan mesinjamob, deibin raidimdan langa det buk gulum ola stori blanga ola king brom isreil.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

kriol: bat det geit langa det trubala laif im brabli lilwan, en det roud im brabli ad blanga bulurrum, en oni lilbit pipul faindim det roud.
english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

kriol: aibin galimap langa det lilwan haus ontop langa ruf weya dei oldei wotjimbat blanga enamimob. aibin weit blanga yawei det trubala god garra ensim mi bifo aibin tok langa im blanga main trabul.
english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

kriol: olabat na detlot trubala femili blanga eibrahem, dumaji wen god bin gibit im pramis langa eibrahem, imbin tok, "wen im det rait taim, ai garra kambek langa yunbala, en yu waif sera garra abum san."
english: For this is a word of promise: "At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son."

kriol: wal detlot haibala serramonimen bin pikimap det mani, en deibin tok, "dijan mani im blad mani, dumaji imbin pei blanga kilim det men ded. wal wi nomo lau pudum det mani langa det mani boks blanga dijan serramoni pleis."
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, "It's not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood."

kriol: en dubala bin jandap feis gija lukinat det lid, en det wing blanga dubala bin gaburrumap det lid.
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

kriol: detlot boswan wekinmen bin jidan trubalawan en blanga tharran na nobodi nomo bin deya blanga kaundimap detlot mani.
english: Moreover they didn't demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

kriol: afta na king sol bin jandim wed langa jesi, "mi laigim deibid. wal yu garra larram im stap iya en wek blanga mi."
english: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, "Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight."

kriol: wal wen imbin det namba 11 yiya langa det feswan dei blanga det manth, afta detlot bebalon amimob bin deigidawei king jehoiyakin en najalot pipul prisana langa bebalon yawei det trubala god bin tok langa mi,
english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh's word came to me, saying,

kriol: bat im nomo bin askimbat im najawan braja salaman o neithan det speshalwan mesinja, o benaiya, o detlot soljamob hubin oldei maindimbat king deibid.
english: but he didn't call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.

kriol: wal eibrahem bin oldei shifdimbat im kemp ebriweya langa det kantri gulum filastain, en imbin jidan langa det kantri longtaim.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

kriol: tok langa im, "seibum melabat. yu na seibya blanga melabat. majurrumap melabat en seibum melabat brom ola najalot pipul, wulijim melabat garra gibitbat yu theingks olataim en preisimbat yu holiwan neim."
english: Say, "Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise."

kriol: en det 4 einjul bin abum bigismob solja garram hos blanga album olabat. milyans en milyans deibin abum, 200 milyan solja olabat. ai sabi, dumaji deibin dalim mi det namba.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

kriol: wal ol detlot pipul langa hebin garra jingat brabli gudbinjiwei na. ola kristjan pipul, ola speshalwan mishanri en ola speshalwan mesinja blanga god, ol detlot na garra brabli gudbinji, dumaji god bin panishim det nogudbala taun bebalon na. imbin panishim det bebalon hubin oldei ardimbat olabat.
english: "Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her."

kriol: wal mosis bin oldei lukaftumbat ola ship en gout blanga im lambarra det serramonimen deya langa midiyan. wal wantaim imbin deigim detlot ship en gout najasaid langa det deset kantri, en imbin kamat langa det hil gulum sainai. det hil bin seikridwan hil blanga god,
english: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God's mountain, to Horeb.

kriol: wal wotfo yu dalimbat mi blanga go en dalim det king yu iya? im garra kilim mi ded." lagijat na obadaiya bin tok.
english: Now you say, 'Go, tell your lord, "Behold, Elijah is here".' He will kill me."

kriol: wal wen melabat en detlot bilibamob bin irrim det wed, melabat bin ol dalimbat pol nomo blanga go langa jerusalem.
english: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

kriol: en nomeda dubala bin gowei brom entiyak, bat stil ola bilibamob deya bin gudbinji, en det holi spirit bin deya garram olabat.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

kriol: god bin meigim det pramis langa wi longtaim wen imbin dalim detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga im.
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok langa mosis, "yu garra dalim eran im garra deigim det wokinstik blanga im, en im garra holdim ontop langa det riba en ola krik en ola wodahol ebriweya langa det kantri. en wen im dum lagijat, ai garra meigim ola woda ebriweya meigim miselp blad, en blad garra jidan langa ola woda bakit en dram du."
english: Yahweh said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.'"

kriol: "wal yu garra libum detkain ting en kambek langa mi. en if yu nomo kambek langa mi, wal ai garra kaman langa yu dregli en fait langa yu garram dijan bigbala shapwan naif iya langa main mawus.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

kriol: wal detlot ritjwan shop menija garra tok, "ol detlot gudbala ting weya deibin wandim langa det taun, olabat binij na. ola mani blanga det pleis en ola gudbala enijing weya deibin hipap, olabat binij na. dei kaan neba faindim detlot ting igin."
english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

kriol: wal king amasaiya blanga juda bin stil jidan laibala blanga 15 yiya afta king jehowesh blanga isreil bin dai.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

kriol: wal brom deya detlot isreil pipul bin shifdim olabat kemp langa oboth.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

kriol: "im meigim sambala pipul jidan ritjwan, en im meigim sambala pipul jidan powan. im meigim sambala pipul lobala, en im meigim sambala pipul haibala.
english: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.

kriol: mi nomo jidan haibala. mi nomo enijing, en nobodi laigim mi, bat ai nomo fogedabat wanim yu titjimbat mi.
english: I am small and despised. I don't forget your precepts.

kriol: en deya langa det taun gulum susa, ola juwish pipul bin kilim 500 men.
english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

kriol: en ol im san bin oldei plei det myusik garram detlot gita gulum hap, en detlot lilwan drum gulum simbul. olabat dedi bin jidan boswan blanga det sebis langa det serramoni pleis. en eisaf, jedathan en heiman deibin wek blanga det king.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh's house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God's house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

kriol: wal god nomo bin larram mikal abum eni biginini, dumaji mikal bin reken miselp haibala, en im nomo bin jinggabat god na brabli haibalawan.
english: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

kriol: detlot 50 speshalwan mesinja brom jeriko bin luk langa im en deibin tok, "det pawa blanga ilaija im langa ilaisha." deibin go blanga midim im en deibin nildan lida langa im
english: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, "The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha." They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

kriol: o enibodi hu garram kripulwan bingga, o kripulwan leig,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

kriol: imbin breigim det pramis weya imbin meigim, en im nomo bin larramgo detlot isreil pipul jis laik weya yawei bin tok langa mosis basdam.
english: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn't let the children of Israel go, just as Yahweh had spoken through Moses.

kriol: wal longtaim wen mosis bin stil jidan laibala, ol detlot isreil pipul bin teikoba ol detlot kantri sanraisaid brom det jodan riba. deibin bidim dubala king det said langa det riba, en deibin teikoba ol detlot kantri brom det anan riba raidap langa det jodan riba olawei raidap langa det hil gulum heman.
english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

kriol: afta na det einjul blanga yawei bin tatjim det daga garram im wokinstik, en streidawei faiya bin kamat brom det ston, en det faiya bin barnimap det bif en damba holbit, en afta det einjul bin gowei.
english: Then Yahweh's angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then Yahweh's angel departed out of his sight.

kriol: wal seimtaim wen jisas bin dai, det bigwan ketin insaid langa det seikridwan rum langa det serramoni pleis bin breik brom top raidap langa bodam, en ola graun bin sheik nomo lilbit, en ston bin breik ebriweya,
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

kriol: lagijat na ebrijing garra hepin, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, "god garra meigim jisas krais jidan bos blanga ebrijing." wal wen im tok jisas krais garra jidan bos blanga ebrijing, im nomo tok jisas krais garra jidan bos blanga god hubin meigim im jidan bos blanga ebrijing. nomo.
english: For, "He put all things in subjection under his feet." But when he says, "All things are put in subjection", it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

kriol: wal sofara brom det kantri gulum neima bin tok langa job,
english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

kriol: yubin kipum yu pramis yawei, en yu jidan brabli gud langa mi, yu wekinmen.
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.

kriol: im gibit oda langa dijan graun, en im duwit streidawei.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

kriol: wal ola juwish pipul bin jinggabat en dum wanim modakai bin tok blanga det dubala dei ebriyiya. dei garra dum en nomo slekap. en olabat femilimob en ola najalot pipul du wen deibin joinap garram ola juwish pipul garra kipgon dumbat lagijat du.
english: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

kriol: en nobodi bin dalim im blanga enibodi, dumaji imbin sabi wanim insaid langa olabat hat.
english: and because he didn't need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

kriol: sambala yu frenmob nomo trubala, bat yu ronwan fren gin album yu mowa den yu femili.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

kriol: wal yumob nomo wandi jidan drangginbala, dumaji det grog im deigidawei yumob en meigim yumob laif nogud. yumob garra larram det holi spirit jidan langa yumob brabliwei,
english: Don't be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

kriol: imbin gibit im det wed blanga dalim langa serababal det bos blanga det kantri. god bin tok, "ai garra sheikimap dijan graun en hebin du,
english: "Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, 'I will shake the heavens and the earth.

kriol: wal wen king sol bin nodisim deibid bin oldei win, imbin bradin langa im brabliwei.
english: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.

kriol: afta king eihes bin dalim yuraiya, "ebri ailibala yu garra yusum dijan bigwan teibul blanga ofring blanga main blanga ola barnapwan ofring, en ebri sangodantaim blanga ola sid daga ofring. ola daga en barnapwan ofring blanga main en blanga ola pipul yu garra abum iya langa dis nyuwan teibul blanga ofring, en ola wain ofring blanga ola pipul yu garra spilim iya du. en ola enimul weya dei kilim blanga sekrifais wal ola blad yu garra spilim deya du. bat yu garra libum det kopawan teibul blanga yawei wulijim ai garra yusum."
english: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, "On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king's burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by."

kriol: "ol yumob pipul hu abumbat trabul brom dumbat wanim god wandim yumob blanga dum, yumob garra gudbinji, dumaji yumob jidan blanga god, en im na garra lukaftumbat yumob.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok langa mi, "yu dalim det king en im mami blanga gidap brom dubala speshalwan tjeya, en hendimoba det kantri langa detlot enami.
english: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.

kriol: "yu jinggabat yu kantrimen neim beilak hubin jidan king blanga moweb longtaim. im nomo bin agamin langa melabat grengrenfatha olabat blanga det kantri, en im nomo bin kaman en fait langa olabat, dumaji im nomo bin abum det rait blanga melabat kantri. en yu reken yu garram det rait blanga melabat kantri tudei?
english: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?

kriol: wal detlot serramonimen bin tok, "wal wotfo mosis bin oldei larram men gibit im waif det speshalwan peipa en andimwei im?"
english: They asked him, "Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?"

kriol: wal wen ola pipul bin luk det king nomo bin teiknodis langa olabat, deibin jingat adbala. deibin tok, "libum deibid en im femilimob. olabat nomo bin dum eni gudbala ting blanga melabat. wal kaman na yumob isreil pipul. melabat gobek langa melabat ronwan kemp. libum king reiyabowam miselp. im gin lukaftumbat imselp." wal lagijat na deibin ol gibit bekboun en libum reiyabowam
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn't listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, "What portion have we in David? We don't have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David." So Israel departed to their tents.

kriol: bat detlot pipul hu laigim olabat braja en sista, olabat jidan langa det lait, en nomo eni nogudbala ting jidan garram olabat weya garra meigim olabat dum nogudbala ting.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

kriol: detlot pipul brom det dubala kantri gulum tema en shiba,
english: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

kriol: afta na yawei, det trubala god blanga isreil bin dalim mi
english: Then Yahweh's word came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

kriol: det brabli holiwan god, im na det lait blanga ola isreil pipul. im garra jidan wulijim det faiya, en ebrijing blanga yu garra barnbarn langa det faiya na, jis laik draiwan gras.
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

kriol: wen god im wail im garra deigidawei ola ebrijing brom olabat.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

kriol: "fo longtaim na, ola isreil pipul nomo bin weshipbat langa yawei en nomo bin teiknodis langa detlot serramonimen hubin titjimbat olabat blanga god. dei nomo bin kipum det lowa blanga god.
english: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

kriol: wandei ilaisha bin go deya langa shunam en deya na wanbala ritjwan gel bin jidan. imbin askim ilaisha blanga dagat daga garram im, en brom det taim na wen imbin go langa shunam imbin go blanga dagat daga langa det haus blanga det ritjwan gel.
english: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

kriol: brom deya na joshuwa en detlot isreil solja bin go langa det taun gulum libna, en deibin fait langa ola pipul deya,
english: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

kriol: en det brabli klebabala wekingel blanga im bin tok, 'olabat bisi gajimbat ola enijing brom detlot isreil pipul. dei bisi kadimatbat ola isreil gel blanga detlot solja, en yu san im bisi gajimbat ola purdiwan klos blanga imselp, en im bisi gajimbat ola purdiwan klos blanga yu du.'
english: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,

kriol: bambai na longtaim afta, wen ataseksis bin jidan det king blanga det kantri gulum pesha, wan men neim esra bin deya. imbin bulurrum det femili blanga im raidap langa det haibala serramonimen neim eran. wal iya na ola neim blanga esra grengrenfatha olabat. im stat brom esra. esra bin det san blanga seraiya hubin det san blanga esaraiya hubin det san blanga hilkaiya,
english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

kriol: yumob sabi na? dislot thribala ting na garra kipgon olagijawan. wi bilib langa god, en wi sabi im garra dum wanim imbin pramis blanga dum, en wi laigim im brabliwei du. en dijan na det meinwan ting brom detlot thribala ting. wi garra laigim god en im pipul olabat brabliwei.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

kriol: wal wen jisas bin binij toktok langa im wekinmen olabat, god bin deigidawei im langa hebin, en deya na im jidan raidensaid langa god.
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

kriol: ai sabi yumob reken ai kaan dalim det leimbala men mi larramgo im fri brom det nogudbalawei blanga im. wal wanim yumob reken? ai garra dalim im blanga gidap en gajim im sweig en wok?
english: For which is easier, to say, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Get up, and walk'?

kriol: ola juwish pipul bin brabli gudbinji detmatj en detlot najalot pipul bin laigim olabat en shoum rispek langa olabat.
english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

kriol: en aibin filim imbin holdim mi en imbin lidimap mi en imbin meigim mi jidanbat, bat aibin stil sheiksheikbat.
english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

kriol: dijan brabli gudbala nyus blanga det taun gulum jerusalem. yumob jingat brabli adbala brom det brabli haibala hil. nomo bradin blanga jinginat langa detlot taun blanga juda, "melabat god im iya na."
english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don't be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, "Behold, your God!"

kriol: en if dei tok, 'ai garram wed brom yawei,' wal yu garra dalim olabat,
english: Although you say, 'The message from Yahweh,' therefore Yahweh says: 'Because you say this word, "The message from Yahweh," and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, "The message from Yahweh,"

kriol: "yumob bin gudbinji wen yumob braja olabat bin abum det trabul, en yumob bin mokimbat olabat wen det enami blanga olabat bin binijimap det kantri blanga olabat, en yumob bin tok praudbalawei wen det trabul bin kamat langa olabat.
english: But don't look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don't rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don't speak proudly in the day of distress.

kriol: yumob bin garrimapbat det tent blanga det drimin neim molek, en yumob bin garrimapbat det sheip blanga det sta drimin neim refan. yumob nomo bin bulurrum yawei. yumob bin meigim detlot sheip, en olabat na yumob bin bulurrum. en blanga tharran na god garra panishim yumob en andimwei yumob langa det longwei kantri gulum bebalon.' lagijat na det speshalwan mesinja bin tok.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.'

kriol: yumob jinggabat blanga stilimbat en kilimbat en silipsilip garram najamen waif en meigim miselp gridi en dalimbat laiya. insaid langa yumob hat na yumob oldei jinggabat blanga dumbat olkain nogudbala ting, en yumob jidan nomo garram sheim, en yumob jelasjelas, en yumob tokinabat enibodi, en yumob jidan blasbala. yumob nomo jinggabat gudbalawei, najing.
english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

kriol: "main dedi, yu na oldei dum wanim rait. bat ola pipul langa dijan wel nomo sabi yu. bat ai sabi yu. en detlot pipul weya yubin gibit mi sabi yubin jandim mi langa dijan wel.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn't known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

kriol: en im garra pudum im bingga ontop langa det enimul hed en kilim im deya lida langa det seikridwan tent blanga main. wal detlot serramonimen blanga eran femili garra tjakambat det blad langa det fobala said langa det teibul blanga ofring,
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron's sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kriol: en yumob bin stapam det roud blanga olabat weya deibin trai ranawei brom detlot enami blanga olabat, en yumob bin grebum olabat en deigimbek olabat langa detlot enami blanga olabat. wal yumob nomo bina dumbat detlot brabli nogudbala ting langa yumob braja olabat lagijat.
english: Don't stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don't deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

kriol: bat yu garra dalim detlot pipul blanga jidan gudwei en nomo dumbat rong ting na en dei garra duwit langa yu, en trubala, ai kaan panishim olabat. dumaji deibin irrim langa yu, wal ai garra larram olabat jidan laibala en yu garra jidan laibala du." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul."

kriol: en det hon bin jingat brabli adbala. wal mosis bin tok langa god, en god bin ensim im garram thanda.
english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

kriol: afta na jeftha en im solja olabat bin krosim det riba, en deibin go en fait langa detlot emanait solja, en yawei bin meigim im win,
english: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and Yahweh delivered them into his hand.

kriol: "wen det laiyan im jingat brabli adbala, yumob reken enibodi garra bradin langa im? yuwai, dei garra bradin. wen yawei det boswan god tok blanga enijing, yumob reken det speshalwan mesinja garra spredimat det wed? yuwai, im garra spredimat." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?

kriol: wal wen det fait bin kipgon king eiheb bin deya langa im bagi wotjimbat detlot siriya solja. imbin jandapbat wansaid, en imbin trai holdimap miselp, en im blad bin weist en gaburrumap det bodampat blanga det bagi. en king eiheb bin dai sangodantaim.
english: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

kriol: wen yubin bon nobodi nomo bin kadim yu brom yu mami, en nobodi nomo bin washim yu garram woda, en nobodi nomo bin rabum yu skin garram solt en oliboil, en repdimap yu garram bleingkit.
english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren't washed in water to cleanse you. You weren't salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

kriol: afta na wen jisas bin kamat langa det haus, im nomo bin larram enibodi gowin garram im. oni det thribala wekinmen blanga im neim pida, jeims en jon en det lilgel dedi en mami bin go garram im.
english: When he came to the house, he didn't allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

kriol: wal ebrijing bin redi na. sambala solja bin blandim miselp sangodansaid brom det taun, en ola najalot solja bin jidan eniwei langa det kemp nowathsaid brom det taun, en det nait joshuwa bin silip miselp deya langa det gali.
english: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

kriol: wal aisaiya bin gowei, bat imbin stil langa det midul pat blanga det bigwan haus blanga det king wen yawei bin dalim im blanga gobek langa king hesakaiya, det boswan blanga ola pipul blanga yawei, en dalim im dijan wed. yawei bin tok, "mi na yawei, det god blanga yu grengrenfatha king deibid. aibin lisin langa yu preya en aibin luk yubin krai. ai garra meigim yu gudbala igin en langa thrideistaim yu garra go langa det serramoni pleis.
english: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, Yahweh's word came to him, saying,

kriol: main spirit preisim yu yawei. yawei, main god, yu brabli haibalawan. yu jidan brabli haibalawan garram yu brabli shainiwan lait.
english: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

kriol: wal wotfo yubin dum lagijat?"
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you see, that you have done this thing?"

kriol: "wal mi na yawei det boswan god garra kadimat detlot strongwan ship brom detlot wikwan ship.
english: "Therefore the Lord Yahweh says to them: 'Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

kriol: afta na wen det feswan san blanga im bin dai, juda bin tok langa det sekanwan san blanga im, "wotabat yu silip garram det waif blanga yu dedbala braja, dumaji det lowa blanga wi im tok lagijat na. yu garra silip garram im blanga gibit im beibi blanga yu dedbala braja, dumaji im nomo bin abum eni biginini blanga im."
english: Judah said to Onan, "Go in to your brother's wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother."

kriol: det bigwan naif blanga yawei, im jidan garram loda blad en fet wulijim det naif dei yusumbat blanga kilim detlot ship en nenigout blanga sekrifais. dumaji yawei garra abum dijan sekrifais langa det taun gulum bosra, en langa ebri lilwan taun langa det kantri gulum idam.
english: Yahweh's sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

kriol: blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei, en det najawan bard blanga det ofring garra barnap garram det sid daga ofring. wal lagijat na det serramonimen garra dum blanga meigim olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei.
english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh."

kriol: yusiyel, det san blanga hahaiya, det men hubin oldei meigim enijing brom gol, bin bildimbek naja pat blanga det wol. henanaiya, det men hubin oldei meigim gudsmelwan medisin bin bildimbek det naja pat blanga det wol gulum bigbala wol.
english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.

kriol: afta yawei bin tok langa mi igin,
english: Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah, saying,

kriol: dei sabi dum ol detkain klebabala wek, dumaji yawei bin meigim besalel en oholiyab en ol detlot najalot men klebabala lagijat blanga meigim det seikridwan tent blanga im, en wen dei garra meigim det tent, dei garra bulurrum det plen weya yawei bin gibit langa mi." lagijat na mosis bin tok.
english: "Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded."

kriol: wal jisas bin sabi imbin binijim ola wek weya god bin dalim im blanga dum. en blanga meigim det wed weya sambodi bin raidimdan langa oltestaman longtaim hepin trubala, jisas bin tok, "mi thesti."
english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, "I am thirsty!"
