kriol: wal ai garra dalim yumob stori na. wantaim dubala men bin kaman langa sebis. wanbala bin ritjmen, en imbin werrimon gudwan klos, en imbin abum golwan ring langa im bingga. det najawan men bin powan, en imbin werrimon rabishwan klos. en wen detlot pipul deya bin luk det dubala men, deibin dalim det ritjmen blanga jidan langa gudwan pleis, en deibin dalim det pomen blanga jidan langa nogudwan pleis. wal yumob jinggabat na. detlot pipul bin tridim det dubala men difrinwei, dumaji deibin luk dubala atsaidwei langa det klos weya dubala bin werrimon. wal wanim yumob reken? deibin dum gudbala ting deya? najing. dei nomo bin dum gudbala ting, dumaji god nomo luk wi atsaidwei. im luk langa insaidwei langa wi hat. en if yumob bilib langa jisas krais det haibala bos, wal yumob kaan tridim pipul difrinwei.
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

kriol: "yubin wandi andimwei mi nomo garram enijing. bat najing. det god blanga main grenfatha eibrahem en main dedi aisik bin luk dijan trabul weya aibin abum. im sabi aibin oldei dumbat gudbala wek blanga yu. en im na bin gibit pruf langa yu langa det drim weya yubin abum naitaim." lagijat na jeikob bin tok.
english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night."

kriol: "en det taim na ai garra meigim yumob jidan brabli strongbala langa yumob ronwan kantri weya aibin gibit langa yumob basdam. nobodi kaan deigidawei yumob brom deya igin." lagijat na yawei bin tok langa im ronwan pipul. binij na.
english: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them," says Yahweh your God.

kriol: en nomeda god bin pikimat mi blanga jidan king, bat stil mi wikwan tudei, en jowab en abaishai det dubala san blanga seruwaiya dubala strongbala. wal mi askim yawei blanga panishim dubala blanga dis nogudbala ting weya dubala bin dum langa ebna." lagijat na deibid bin tok.
english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness."

kriol: wal main braja en sista olabat, melabat wandim yumob garra jinggabat det trabul weya melabat bin abum deya langa det kantri gulum eisha. melabat bin abum trabul detmatj, en melabat nomo bin abum ronwan pawa blanga jidan strongbala blanga go thru langa det trabul, en melabat bin reken melabat garra dai.
english: For we don't desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

kriol: yumob bin bringimapbat ola blainwan enimul en ola sikwan en kripulwan enimul blanga sekrifais. yumob reken tharran rait? nomo! yumob trai gibit detkain enimul lagijat langa det gabman bos! if yumob gibit im rabishwan enimul im garra gudbinji langa yu en teiknodis wen yumob askim im blanga samting? nomo!" lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn't that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn't that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?" says Yahweh of Armies.

kriol: wal det shotwan men bin ran lida langa detlot pipul, en imbin galimap langa wan tri gulum sikamotri blanga luk jisas wen im gopas,
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

kriol: wal langa det olbalawei deibin oldei deigim buligi blad en gout blad en eshis brom det gabigabi weya deibin barnimap, en deibin oldei spilim det blad en eshis ontop langa ola pipul blanga meigim olabat fri atsaidwei.
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

kriol: wal wen deibin kamat langa det kantri, deibin kamat langa wan bigbala tri gulum mora. det tri bin jandap deya langa det seikridwan pleis langa det taun gulum shekam. wal det taim na ol detlot pipul gulum keinanait hubin oldei jidan langa det kantri bin stil deya yet.
english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

kriol: "langa dijan wel ola bigwan hil buldan en ola rok buldan du.
english: "But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.
