english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

kriol: brom deya yawei garra fait langa detlot enami laik imbin fait ola enami bifo.
english: Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

english: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

english: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, "You are a God who sees," for she said, "Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?"

english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

kriol: "wal yu lisin na garram yu irriwol. yu lisin langa det spirit blanga god en langa det wed weya im tok langa ola tjetj, dumaji langa detlot pipul hu garra win, ai garra gibit olabat det speshalwan daga brom top gulum mena. en ai garra gibit olabat waitwan ston du. aibin raidimdan nyubala neim blanga olabat langa detlot ston. nobodi kaan sabi detlot neim langa detlot ston. oni detlot pipul na hu gedim detlot ston gin sabi." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

kriol: jeiflat bin abum thribala san neim pasak, bimal en eshbath.

english: They said, "The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, 'Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?' We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, 'Bring your brother down'?"

english: "Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me," says Yahweh of Armies. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

english: "Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

english: Jeroboam didn't recover strength again in the days of Abijah. Yahweh struck him, and he died.

english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

kriol: aibin meigim dijan wel, en aibin meigim ola pipul blanga jidan langa dijan wel. aibin spredimat det skai, en aibin pudum loda sta deya.
english: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.

english: For Yahweh lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.

english: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

kriol: wal king deibid bin abum miting garram ol detlot hubin lukaftumbat detlot isreil pipul deya langa jerusalem. ol detlot hubin lukaftumbat detlot klen, en detlot hubin lukaftumbat ol detlot ebrijing blanga det kantri, en detlot lida brom ola femili, en detlot boswan lida hubin lukaftumbat det kantri en detlot enijing blanga det king en blanga im sanmob, en ol detlot boswan brom det king haus, en detlot wekinmen hubin oldei dumbat speshalwan wek, en ol detlot lida blanga ola soljamob, en ol detlot brabli haibala men, deibin ol majurrumap miselp langa jerusalem.
english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

kriol: wal wen pol bin tok lagijat, detlot men hubin jandap gulijap langa im bin dalim im. deibin tok, "yu kaan tok nogudbalawei langa det boswan haibala serramonimen blanga god."
english: Those who stood by said, "Do you malign God's high priest?"

kriol: ola enami blanga olabat garra kaman langa ola taun blanga olabat, en dei garra breigimap ola bigiswan geit langa detlot taun, en dei garra binijimap main pipul olabat, dumaji main pipul olabat bin oldei go olabat ronwei.
english: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "wantaim wan men bin gowei brom jerusalem blanga go langa det najawan taun gulum jeriko, en wen imbin wokwok langa roud, sambala men bin grebum im, en deibin beldim im, en deibin pulumat im ola enijing, en deibin kilim im haf ded, en deibin libum im deya wansaid langa det roud.
english: Jesus answered, "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

kriol: wal king sol bin tok, "ahimalek, yu en yu femili olabat garra dai."
english: The king said, "You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father's house."

kriol: en det king bin askim detlot serramonimen en detlot libaimen weya detlot presen bin kaman brom.
english: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps.

kriol: yumob nomo lau blanga dagat detlot enimul o tatjim olabat wen olabat dedwan, dumaji olabat nomo klinbala blanga serramoni.
english: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

kriol: en deibin gobek langa det kantri keinan weya olabat dedi jeikob bin jidan.
english: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

kriol: yawei yu meigim jidan kwait detlot pipul hu oldei tok laiyawei. yu jadimap mawus blanga ol detlot pipul hu tok praudwei.
english: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

kriol: yu jinggabat na. yubin gowei longwei brom mi. wal yu garra kambek na en dumbat ola gudbala ting weya yubin oldei dumbat basdam. if yu nomo kambek langa mi, wal ai garra kaman langa yu en deigidawei det goldinwan lempsten brom yu.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

kriol: bat det najawan jerusalem deya langa hebin jidan friwan, en im na det mami blanga wi, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, "det wuman hu nomo bin abum beibi garra gudbinji. nomeda im nomo bin filim det pein, bat stil im garra jingat gudbinjiwei, dumaji im garra abum bigmob biginini olabat. nomeda im hasbin bin libum im, bat stil im garra abum mowa biginini langa det gel weya im hasbin nomo bin libum im, dumaji god garra gibit im detlot biginini."
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

kriol: wal ola filastain pipul bin majurrumap miselp blanga fait langa detlot isreil pipul. deibin abum 30,000 hosis en bagi en 6,000 hosmen en detmatj solja wulijim sengraun, en deibin ol go langa det taun gulum mikmesh deya sanraisaid brom det taun gulum bethaben, en deya na olabat bin kemp.
english: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

kriol: mi brabli nogudbinji en mi wandim god blanga album mi. mi jingat brabliwei langa im blanga irrim mi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

kriol: olabat ol agri gija blanga olabat plen, en blanga fait langa yu.
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

kriol: if yu lendim mani langa pipul en yu meigim olabat peiyimbek mowa mani, wal bambai yu garra lujim det mani langa sambodi hu oldei kain langa ola po pipul.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

kriol: wal yumob kaan bradin. ai garra lukaftumbat yumob, en ai garra lukaftumbat ola biginini blanga yumob du." wal ola braja blanga josef bin jidan gudbinji na, dumaji josef bin tok gudbalawei langa olabat.
english: Now therefore don't be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones." He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

kriol: wotfo wi holot kaan go mijamet en fait blanga det kantri weya yawei bin pramis blanga gibit langa wi?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

kriol: wal wen deibid bin irrim det stori, imbin tok, "wen aibin luk doweg deya langa det serramoni pleis, aibin sabi im garra go en dalim king sol. wal mi na bin meigim det trabul kaman langa yu femili olabat.
english: David said to Abiathar, "I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father's house.

kriol: yawei laigim pipul en im garram soriwan filing blanga olabat. im nomo gitwail kwikbala en olataim im garram det filing blanga laigim pipul olagijawan.
english: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

kriol: dei nomo bin yusum det mani blanga meigimbat silbawan kap en boul en longwan wisul en tul blanga yusum langa ola lemp o eni silbawan o golwan enijing.
english: But there were not made for Yahweh's house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into Yahweh's house;

kriol: bat dijan na det bigwan ting weya wi garra dum. ol wi kristjan pipul garra laigim gija brabliwei, dumaji if wi laigim gija brabliwei, wal wi kaan jinggabat ol detlot nogudbala ting weya eni kristjan braja o sista dumbat langa wi.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

kriol: ai garra jandim main pawa brom skai, jis laik rein, en dijan wel garra jidan redibala, wulijim ebribodi garra jidanbat friwan en abumbat feyago. wal mi na yawei garra meigim dijan hepin."
english: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, Yahweh, have created it.

kriol: wal aibin kipgon tok, "wal dijan na det mesij blanga areibiya. ol yumob pipul brom dedan, hu jidan langa det deset kantri langa areibiya. yumob garra dalim ola trebalamob blanga bringimap woda langa detlot hu jidan thestibala. ola pipul blanga tema, yumob garra bringimap daga langa dislot pipul hubin ranawei brom olabat kantri.
english: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

kriol: afta na yawei bin dalim im blanga pudumbek im bingga insaid langa im kout, en mosis bin pudumbek im bingga insaid langa im kout, en wen imbin deigimat, im bingga bin gobek gudwan na.
english: He said, "Put your hand inside your cloak again." He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.

kriol: dumaji yubin jidan lagijat, yawei garra panishim yu pipul olabat, yu bigininimob, en yu waif olabat, en im garra binijimap ola gudwan ting blanga yu du.
english: behold, Yahweh will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions;

kriol: dei oldei tok lagijat, "wi gin gedim enijing wi wandim, en wi gin tok blanga enijing wi wandim. wi nomo garram bos."
english: who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?"

kriol: nomeda ai oldei jidanbat raitwei, yu oldei hantingbat blanga mi jis laik det strongwan laiyan. yu oldei hantingbat mi garram yu strongwan pawa.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

kriol: bat nomo ebribodi bin bilib wen deibin irrim det gudnyus. wi sabi tharran, dumaji det speshalwan mesinja neim aisaiya bin tok, "bos, nobodi bin bilib langa det wed weya wibin dalimbat olabat."
english: But they didn't all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our report?"

kriol: if yumob nomo duwit langa mi en nomo duwit langa main lowa en if yumob bin breigim det strongwan pramis weya aibin meigim garram yumob,
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

kriol: wal ol detlot isreil pipul bin majurrumap miselp langa det seikridwan pleis blanga yawei deya langa bethel, en deibin sori miselp en kraikrai raidap det san bin godan,
english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

kriol: wal wi nomo wandi dum nogudbala ting en silipsilip garram enibodi seimwei laik sambala grengrenfatha blanga wi bin dum langa mosis taim, dumaji 23,000 bin dai langa det seimdei blanga tharran.
english: Let's not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

kriol: wal mi oldei tok gudbalawei blanga yumob. bat ai kaan tok gudbalawei blanga yumob blanga dijan weya ai garra dalim yumob, dumaji wen yumob abumbat miting, yumob oldei meigimbat trabul en meigim det miting nogud.
english: But in giving you this command I don't praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

kriol: wen ai garra jandimwei yumob prisana langa det brabli longwei kantri blanga det taun gulum dameskas." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus," says Yahweh, whose name is the God of Armies.

kriol: bat if det dediwan nomo larram im merrit langa det yanggel, wal im garra stil peiyim det dediwan, dumaji imbin silip garram det yanggel.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

kriol: en mosis bin gajim im waif en ola san blanga im, en imbin pudum olabat langa dongki, en imbin gajim det wokinstik weya god bin dalim im blanga deigim, en deibin stat gobek langa ijip na.
english: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God's rod in his hand.

kriol: en nomeda god garra panishim im, bat stil god garra laigim im. im kaan tjakidawei im seimwei laik imbin tjakidawei sol blanga meigim yu jidan king.
english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

kriol: wal god im sabi wotkain filing ebribodi garram insaid, en imbin gibit im holi spirit langa detlot jintail pipul seimwei laik imbin gibit langa wi, en wen imbin gibit olabat im holi spirit, imbin shoum wi im laigim olabat du.
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

kriol: wal ontop langa det hil deibin abum wan pleis deya weya pipul bin oldei weship god, en wen king deibid bin kamat deya, imbin luk det gudwan fren blanga im neim hushai bin deya, en imbin luk im fren klos bin breikinwan, en imbin abum graun langa im hed blanga sori miselp. wal nomeda det men bin brom det traib gulum akait, bat stil king deibid bin oldei trastim im brabliwei,
english: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.

kriol: ai garra andimwei olabat lilbitlilbit blanga gibit yumob taim blanga spredat ebriweya langa det kantri.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

kriol: trubala ai dalim yumob. hebin en dijan graun garra tjeinj. bat main wed kaan neba tjeinj.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kriol: im na bin dai blanga meigim det wei blanga wi wulijim god garra larramgo wi fri brom ol detlot nogudbala ting weya wibin dumbat. im nomo bin meigim det wei oni blanga wi. imbin meigim det wei blanga ebribodi.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

kriol: brom deya jisas bin go nomo longwei brom olabat, en imbin baudan garram im feis langa graun, en imbin prei brabliwei, "main dedi, if yu wandim, yu gin deigidawei dijan trabul brom mi. bat yu nomo dum wanim mi wandim. yu garra dum wanim yu wandim."
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, "My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire."

kriol: afta na jonanan, det san blanga kariya bin tok langa gedalaiya sigridwei. imbin tok, "yu larram mi go en kilim ded ishmeil, det san blanga nethanaiya, en nobodi kaan sabi hubin dum tharran. wotfo king beilis bin larram ishmeil blanga kaman en kilim yu ded? tharran garra meigim detlot juwish pipul hubin majurrumap miselp langa yu bina ol gowei en spredat oloba igin. en im bina bringimap nogudbala ting langa ola pipul hu oldei jidanbat langa juda." lagijat na jonanan bin tok langa gedalaiya.
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, "Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?"

kriol: aibin jinggabat blanga ola ting weya aibin dumbat, en mi pramis blanga bulurrumbat yu wei.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

kriol: dislot pawa, im jis laik god bin tok kwaitbalawei. wal hu gin sabi im strongbala pawa?" lagijat na bilded bin tok.
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?"

kriol: yawei bin meigim strongbala pramis en im kaan breigim det pramis. imbin tok, "yu garra jidan haibala serramonimen olagijawan jis laik melkisadek."
english: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."

kriol: bambai na wen yawei bin binij tok langa job, imbin tok langa elifas, "mi brabli wail langa yu en langa yu fren dubala, dumaji yumob nomo bin tok trubalawei blanga mi. wanim main wekinmen job bin oldei tok, im trubala.
english: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

kriol: nomo jidan leisibala en tok, "det laiyan im deya atsaid. im mait dagadagat mi."
english: The sluggard says, "There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!"

kriol: wal jisas nomo bin tok enijing langa det olgamen, en ola wekinmen blanga im bin kaman langa im, en deibin tok, "yu album det olgamen en jandimwei im, dumaji im kipgon jingginatbat langa wi."
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, "Send her away; for she cries after us."

kriol: lagijat na jisas bin dalimbat detlot pipul wen imbin lenimbat olabat deya langa det juwish miting pleis langa det taun gulum kapeniyam.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

kriol: en mi oldei prei langa god en askim im blanga meigim yumob laigim yumob braja en sista olabat mowa en mowa ebridei,
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

kriol: en det bandri lain garra kipgon brom deya raidap sangodanwei, en raidap langa det hil kantri blanga gareb en raidaran langa gowa.
english: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.

kriol: en if wi kipgon larram im dumbat detlot klebabala ting, wal ebribodi garra bilib langa im, en ola roman bos garra kaman en teikoba dijan kantri blanga wi, en dei garra binijimap det serramoni pleis blanga wi."
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation."

kriol: im garra pudum im bingga ontop langa det buligi hed, en det buligi garra redi blanga sekrifais blanga deigidawei det nogudbalawei blanga im.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

kriol: wal wen pailat bin irrim olabat tok lagijat, imbin deigim jisas atsaid, en pailat bin jidan langa det speshalwan tjeya blanga im weya imbin oldei kotimbat pipul. det pleis bin neim ston roud, bat garram det hibru langgus deibin gulum det pleis geibatha.
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called "The Pavement", but in Hebrew, "Gabbatha."

kriol: wal wen det olgamen bin irrim jisas tok lagijat, imbin kaman langa jisas, en imbin baudan langa im futwei, en imbin askim im, "bos, yu album mi!"
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, "Lord, help me."

kriol: deibid bin lujim 20 solja langa det fait. bat deibin kilim ded 360 solja blanga ebna brom det benjamin klen.
english: But David's servants had struck Benjamin Abner's men so that three hundred sixty men died.

kriol: wal deibin abum 550 boswan blanga ola wekinmen hubin wek blanga ola ting weya king salaman bin bildimap.
english: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon's work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

kriol: afta hesran bin dai im san keilab bin merrit langa efrath, hubin det waif blanga im dedi. dubala bin abum san neim eshuwa, hubin stadimap det taun gulum tekowa.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron's wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

kriol: shalum, det san blanga kolosei, hubin bos blanga det kantri raidaran langa det taun gulum mispa, bin bildimbek det springwoda geit, en imbin bildimap ruf ontop langa det geitwei. imbin meigim det geit, en imbin pudum bolt en ba blanga lokimap det geit. en imbin bildimbek det wol wansaid langa det wel blanga shela wansaid langa det gadin blanga king, en imbin bildimbek det wol raidap langa detlot step weya bin godan langa det pat blanga jerusalem weya dei gulum deibidtaun.
english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king's garden, even to the stairs that go down from David's city.

kriol: "nobodi sabi wotaim ol dislot ting garra hepin. ola einjul langa hebin nomo sabi, en mi nomo sabi du. oni main dedi langa hebin im sabi.
english: "But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

kriol: ai garra fait langa yumob garram ol main pawa, dumaji mi brabli wail langa yumob na.
english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.

kriol: wal sambodi bin dalim king deibid blanga det speshalwan ofsaida blanga im neim ahithafel. deibin dalim im det ofsaida bin gibit im bekboun en bulurrum ebsalom, en wen king deibid bin irrim det wed, imbin prei langa god, "yawei ai wandim yu garra meigim det speshalwan ofsaida kaan jinggabat gudbalawei wulijim im garra tok eniwei langa ebsalom."
english: Someone told David, saying, "Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom." David said, "Yahweh, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness."

kriol: main god, brom wen aibin lilwan yubin titjim mi, en raidap tudei mi stil dalimbat pipul blanga ola gudwan ting weya yu oldei dumbat.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

kriol: wal aibin tok, "if yawei det boswan god nomo bin larram sambala pipul jidan laibala, wal jerusalem bina jidan wulijim det dubala taun gulum sadam en gamora weya god bin binijimap.
english: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.

kriol: bambai 500 men blanga det klen blanga simiyan, en deibin go sanraiswei langa idam. detlot san blanga ishai bin lida blanga olabat, en deibin neim pelataiya, niyaraiya refaiya en yusiyel.
english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

kriol: raidap det kantri garra jidan nomo garram enijing. im garra jidan jis laik deset kantri. en afta na yu garra sabi mi na bin dum ol dislot ting. "'dumaji yu reken yubin meigim det bigwan nail riba en yu reken yu bos blanga det riba,
english: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am Yahweh. "'"Because he has said, 'The river is mine, and I have made it,'

kriol: detlot midiyan pipul bin brabli strongbala, en detlot isreil pipul bin lafta blandim miselp langa ola keib en najalot pleis langa hil kantri,
english: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

kriol: yubin meigim im enami olabat bidimbat im, en yubin meigim olabat holot gudbinji nomo lilbit.
english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

kriol: wal yumob bin bilib langa jisas krais, en yumob bin larram im jidan bos langa yumob laif. en yumob garra kipgon jidanbat garram im,
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

kriol: wal nathenyul bin askim jisas na, "hau yu sabi mi?" en jisas bin tok, "aibin luk yu deya wansaid langa det figtri bifo filip bin jingat langa yu."
english: Nathanael said to him, "How do you know me?" Jesus answered him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."

kriol: wal det men bin tok, "hubin meigim yu bos blanga kotim melabat? maitbi yu garra kilim mi ded seimwei laik yubin kilim det men brom dijan kantri?" wal wen det men bin tok lagijat, mosis bin bradin, en imbin jinggabat na. imbin tok, "maitbi ola pipul sabi wanim aibin dum."
english: He said, "Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?" Moses was afraid, and said, "Surely this thing is known."

kriol: en imbin dum wanim imbin tok blanga dum. ol dijan ting bin hepin, dumaji ol yumob pipul bin dum nogudbala ting langa yawei en olabat nomo bin dum wanim yawei bin dalim olabat.
english: and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

kriol: en afta yawei bin dalim mi, "ai garra gibit yu main wed langa drim, en yu garra raidimdan brabli gudwei wulijim yu gin ridim kwikbala wanim ai dalimbat langa yu.
english: Yahweh answered me, "Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

kriol: yumob nomo garram eni pawa. ebrijing yumob dumbat, olabat jis najing. im jis laik yumob oni blowimbat win, en faiya kamat brom yumob mawus en binijimap yumob.
english: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

kriol: en yumob bin luk hau detlot brabli nogudwan klebabala ting en ol detlot trabul bin kaman langa olabat. ol detlot ting yawei bin dum bin brabli strongbala.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

kriol: en wanbala einjul brom god bin kamat langa olabat, en imbin jandap wansaid langa olabat, en det braitwan lait blanga god bin shain ebriweya langa olabat. wal detlot stakmen bin brabli bradin.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

kriol: en imbin dalim im, "wotfo yubin kaman iya drangginwan? yu nomo wandi kaman iya lagijat."
english: Eli said to her, "How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!"

kriol: wal ai kaan deigidawei det daga en dringk en bif brom main stakmen olabat en gibit langa najalot men weya ai nomo sabi."
english: Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don't know where they come from?"

kriol: brom det taim na wen eran bin go langa det brabli seikridwan rum blanga meigim miselp fri, raidap imbin kamat igin, nobodi kaan go insaid langa det seikridwan tent. wal afta imbin meigim miselp fri, en im femilimob en ola pipul,
english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

kriol: nomeda if im blanga dubala dei, o wan manth, o wan yiya, o longtaim, wen det klaud bin oldei jidan ontop langa det seikridwan tent deibin jidan, bat wen det klaud bin oldei gidap, deibin gidap du en shifdim olabat kemp.
english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn't travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

kriol: "bambai na wen yawei bin binij im wek deya langa skai garram im bigwan naif, im garra kamdan langa det kantri gulum idam, weya im garra panishim ol detlot pipul.
english: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

kriol: "wal nomeda yu braja o san o doda o det waif hu yu laigim detmatj, o det brabli gudfren blanga yu, dei mait dalim yu snikinwei blanga weshipbat detlot drimin sheip, detlot drimin weya yu en yu grengrenfathamob nomo bin weship, bat yu nomo lisin en teiknodis langa im.
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, "Let's go and serve other gods"—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

kriol: wal aibin tok, "yawei det boswan god, yu sabi wanim detlot speshalwan mesinja oldei dalimbat langa detlot pipul. dei tok det enamimob kaan kaman, en nobodi kaan jidan hanggribala, en olabat garra jidan kwaitbalawei langa dijan kantri."
english: Then I said, "Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, the prophets tell them, 'You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.'"

kriol: oloba langa detlot haibala deset kantri ol detlot men bin kaman blanga stilimbat ola ebrijing. aibin jandim ami blanga kaman en binijimap det kantri. nobodi kaan jidan gudwei iya na.
english: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Yahweh devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace.

kriol: en imbin gibit sambala mani langa detlot wekinmen. imbin gibit loda mani langa det wanbala wekinmen hubin sabi hau blanga hendulum mani gudwei. imbin gibit im $5,000. en imbin gibit lilbit mani langa det wanbala wekinmen hu nomo bin sabi hau blanga hendulum mani gudwei. imbin gibit im $1,000. en imbin gibit det najawan wekinmen $2,000. imbin gibit olabat detlot mani, en imbin tok, 'yumob garra yusum dijan mani blanga meigim mowa mani blanga mi wen mi gowei.' afta na imbin gowei brom deya,
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

kriol: im garra bilimap det riba ful garram frog, en detlot frog garra gowei brom det riba, en dei garra go en jidan ebriweya insaid langa det haus blanga yu, en dei garra galimap langa yu sweig du. en detlot frog garra go langa ola boswan wekinmen haus en langa ola pipul haus ebriweya langa dijan kantri, en dei garra jidan langa ebrijing weya ola pipul oldei yusum blanga gugum enijing.
english: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

kriol: detlot pipul hu oldei teiknodis en shoum rispek langa yawei garra jidan laibala longtaim, bat detlot nogudbala pipul hu nomo teiknodis langa yawei olabat garra abum shotwan laif.
english: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

kriol: wal king deibid bin dalim yuraiya, "wal yu irrim mi na. yu garra stap iya langa main kemp, en tumorro ai garra jandimbek yu langa det fait." en yuraiya bin duwit langa im, en imbin stap deya gin,
english: David said to Uriah, "Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart." So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.

kriol: detlot nogudwan gel en ola waif hu oldei silipsilipbat garram eni men jidan laik det brabli dipwan hol.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

kriol: det men hu go en gajimbat detlot sid daga wen dei redi, wal im brabli sabibala, bat det men hu silip oldei en nomo dum eni wek, wal im brabli silibala.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

kriol: wal ol dislot wed iya weya ai dalimbat yu, im trubala. en ai wandim yu garra kipgon dalimbat ola pipul ol dislot ting na. yu garra meigim detlot pipul hu bilib langa god oldei jinggabat blanga dumbat ola gudbala ting. ol dislot ting im gudbala, en im album ebribodi.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

kriol: en nomeda yubin abum bigwan trabul dumaji yubin bilib langa mi, bat stil yubin kipgon en nomo slekap.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name's sake, and have not grown weary.

kriol: if yumob bina bilib langa mosis brabliwei, wal yumob bina bilib langa mi du, dumaji detlot wed weya mosis bin raidimdan bin witnis blanga mi.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

kriol: en yu garra gibit im det pawa weya aibin gibit langa yu, wulijim detlot isreil pipul garra duwit langa im.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

kriol: wal basdam wi nomo bin sabi, en wi nomo bin lisin langa god wed. wibin oldei go najawei, en wibin wandim olkain nogudbala ting blanga meigim wi sedisfaid. en wibin lafta duwit. wibin oldei laigim ola ting blanga najalot pipul, en wibin oldei wandi ardim olabat, dumaji wi nomo bin laigim najalot pipul, en dei nomo bin laigim wi du.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

kriol: olabat jis laik detlot brabli wailwan hosis weya dei ranimapbat det gelwan hos ebriweya, dumaji olabat wandimbat olabat fren waif blanga silipsilip garram olabat.
english: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor's wife.

kriol: bat if enibodi nomo laigim det holi spirit, en im tok nogudbalawei blanga det holi spirit, wal god kaan larramgo im fri brom det ting. god kaan bringimbek im, dumaji im garra deigim det panishmen."
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation."

kriol: afta na deibin deigim det kout langa olabat dedi, en deibin tok, "yu sabi dijan kout weya melabat bin faindim?"
english: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, "We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son's tunic or not."

kriol: yumob sabi? det olbala lowa weya bin oldei meigim pipul dai bin gudwan lowa. bat det nyubala lowa weya meigim pipul jidan raitwei langa god im mobeda lowa.
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

kriol: en blanga tharran na imbin gitwail langa olabat, en imbin tok, 'dei oldei gobekgobek, en dei nomo duwit langa mi.'
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, 'They always err in their heart, but they didn't know my ways.'

kriol: wal job bin kipgon tok, "wotfo laif im brabli adwan? wotfo wi ardimbat detmatj?
english: "Isn't a man forced to labor on earth? Aren't his days like the days of a hired hand?

kriol: ol detlot wekinmen blanga det king bin oldei bringimap dringk langa detlot pipul garram ola goldinwan kap, en ola kap bin difrin. en deya na detlot pipul bin oldei dringgimbat loda wain dumaji det king bin oldei abum loda ebrijing blanga enibodi hubin kaman langa im kemp.
english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

kriol: wal yu garra abum panishmen blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yubin oldei dumbat."
english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations," says Yahweh.

kriol: yu garra dalim ol dislot pipul hu jidan garram yu iya langa bebalon, dijan mesij mi na yawei det boswan god bin tok langa detlot pipul hu stil jidan langa jerusalem. wen olabat garra dagadagatbat det daga en dringgimbat det woda olabat garra bradin en olabat garra sheiksheikbat nomo lilbit dumaji detlot bebalon ami garra gobek langa jerusalem en fait langa olabat en dei garra libum olabat nomo garram enijing. dijan na garra hepin dumaji detlot pipul langa jerusalem nomo bin gibitbat feyago langa ola po pipul.
english: Tell the people of the land, 'The Lord Yahweh says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: "They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

kriol: en nomeda deibin jidan strongbala pipul lagijat, bat stil ola enami blanga olabat bin deigidawei olabat. olabat enami bin bastimap olabat biginini olabat ebriweya langa roud, en deibin taiyimap ola boswan men garram tjein, en deibin kadimat olabat en meigim olabat jidan wekinmen.
english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

kriol: wal mi nomo wandi fosim yumob en dalim yumob hau blanga bilib. mi wandi wek mijamet garram yumob blanga meigim yumob gudbinji, dumaji mi sabi yumob bilib brabli strongbalawei.
english: We don't control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

kriol: wal peleg bin merrit, en wen imbin 30 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim riyu.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

kriol: main dedi bin meigim yumob dumbat adwek, bat ai garra meigim yumob dumbat wek brabli adbalawei. imbin beldim yumob garram wip, bat mi, ai garra beldim yumob garram stokwip weya abum ola shapwan neil.'" lagijat na deibin tok.
english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.'"

kriol: wal det holi spirit meigim wi laigim gija, en im meigim wi gudbinji, en im meigim wi jidan gudwei, en im meigim wi lisin en weit en nomo tok streidawei wen trabul kaman langa wi, en im meigim wi jidan kainbala en tridimbat pipul gudbalawei, en im meigim wi jidan wulijim najalot pipul gin trastim wi,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

kriol: en deibin bidim olabat, en deibin kilim ded det king en ola pipul langa det taun, en deibin kilim ola pipul langa ola lilwan taun deya wansaid langa det taun du. joshuwa nomo bin larram enibodi jidan laibala langa detlot taun seimwei laik weya im nomo bin larram enibodi jidan laibala langa iglan.
english: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.

kriol: enibodi hubin wokpas langa det pleis bin stilim ebrijing blanga im. en ola pipul langa ola gulijapwan kantri bin mokimbat im.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

kriol: basdam detlot pipul hubin jidan deya bin brom det femili lain blanga hem. bat langa tharran taim na wen hesakaiya bin jidan king blanga juda, detlot lidamob blanga simiyan bin go langa gera en deibin bitsimap ola tent en kemp blanga det femili lain blanga hem en detlot meyunait pipul hubin jidan deya. deibin andimwei detlot pipul brom deya, en deibin jidan deya miselp na, dumaji imbin gudwan kantri blanga olabat shipmob.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin tok langa mi,
english: Yahweh's word also came to me, saying,

kriol: bat det wei blanga ola nogudbala pipul im jis laik wen olabat wokwok langa det dakbala roud naitaim en dei kaan luk wanim bin meigim olabat buldan.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don't know what they stumble over.

kriol: wal dijan na detlot neim blanga ol detlot boswan hubin lukaftumbat ola ebrijing blanga det king. esmabeth det san blanga ediyel bin lukaftumbat detlot stowa rum blanga det king langa jerusalem. jonathan det san blanga yusaiya bin lukaftumbat najalot stowa rum. esrai det san blanga kelab bin lukaftumbat detlot wekinmen blanga detlot fam. shimiyai brom det pleis gulum rema bin lukaftumbat detlot greip tri. seibdai im brom det pleis gulum shefam bin lukaftumbat detlot wain. beilenan brom det pleis gulum geda bin lukaftumbat detlot olibtri en najalot tri weya deibin growap sangodansaid langa detlot hil. jowesh bin lukaftumbat ola oliboil langa det stowa rum. shitai bin brom det pleis gulum sheran en imbin lukaftumbat detlot buligi weya dei garram langa det plein kantri gulum sheran. shafat det san blanga edlai bin lukaftumbat detlot buligi langa detlot beli. obil brom detlot ishmeil pipul bin lukaftumbat detlot kemul. jedeiya brom det pleis gulum meranath bin lukaftumbat detlot dongki. jeisis hubin brom detlot heigrait pipul bin lukaftumbat detlot ship en gout.
english: Over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

kriol: en wanbala kilogrem garram ebri boiwan ship.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "yumob garra lafta teiknodis langa detlot lowa weya aibin dalimbat yumob tudei. if yumob teiknodis brabliwei yumob garra jidan strongbala en krosim det jodan riba weya yumob garra teikoba en jidan langa det kantri.
english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

kriol: yu si? jis laik im tok langa oltestaman, "detlot pipul hubin gajim blendibala daga nomo bin abum eni leftobawan daga, en detlot pipul hubin gajim lilbit daga nomo bin shot blanga daga."
english: As it is written, "He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack."

kriol: en wen aibin tok langa olabat lagijat, deibin kaman iya garram mi, en streidawei neksdei aibin kotim det men,
english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn't delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

kriol: blanga im rutpat im gin go nogudwan,
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

kriol: wal minbala bin kamat brom det serramoni pleis en minbala bin go thru langa det nowath geit en minbala bin go langa det sanrais geit. en deya na aibin luk wan lilwan krik bin kamat brom det sauth geit en imbin go sanraiswei.
english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

kriol: melabat nomo bin tenawei brom yu, en melabat nomo bin libum det roud weya yu shoum melabat.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

kriol: en ola solja bin kadimat miselp. sambala solja bin go lida langa detlot serramonimen garram detlot hon, en sambala solja bin go biyain langa detlot serramonimen hubin garrimap det seikridwan boks, en olataim weya deibin wokaran langa det taun, detlot serramonimen bin blowim detlot hon.
english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.

kriol: detlot pipul oldei bulurrumbat olkain drimin. dei nomo gudwan. deibin kadimdan wanbala tri langa det bush kantri, en meigimbat olkain drimin sheip.
english: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the ax.

kriol: en brom det kantri blanga benjamin klen deibin gibit olabat detlot fobala taun gulum gibiyan, geba,
english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

kriol: wal jisas bin lukaran langa im wekinmen olabat, en imbin tok, "im brabli adbala blanga ritj pipul blanga larram god jidan bos langa olabat."
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, "How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God's Kingdom!"

kriol: en blanga detlot lemp en blanga detlot lempsten,
english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

kriol: bambai na rubin bin kambek langa det wel. bat josef nomo bin deya, en rubin bin kraikrai blanga im braja detmatj, en imbin breigim im ronwan klos blanga sori miselp.
english: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn't in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

kriol: en brom deya imbin go nowathwei langa det pleis gulum enshemesh raidap langa det pleis gulum gelaloth deya sauthsaid langa det jampap langa det hil gulum edumim, en brom deya det boda bin go sauthwei langa det pleis gulum bowan ston,
english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

kriol: det najawan boiwan nenigout blanga esasel, olabat garra gibit laibala langa mi, en jandimwei langa deset kantri langa esasel blanga meigim detlot pipul fri brom olabat nogudbalawei.
english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

kriol: det boswan im redi blanga kaman jis laiga fama wen im kadimat ola gudwan daga brom det nogudwan pat. im garra hipimap ola gudwan daga, en im garra barnimap ola nogudwan pat deya langa det olagijawan faiya." lagijat na jon bin tok.
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."

kriol: wal josef bin go langa pailat, en imbin askim im blanga jisas bodi,
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.

kriol: brom deya jisas en im wekinmen olabat en sambala najalot pipul bin stat wok blanga go langa jerusalem. deibin ol gida shok, dumaji jisas bin wandi go langa det taun, en imbin wok lida langa olabat, dumaji olabat bin bradin. wal jisas bin gedim det twelbala wekinmen blanga im, en imbin tok langa olabat miselp,
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

kriol: "jeramaiya, yu garra gajim rolapwan peipa en yu garra raidimdan ebrijing aibin dalim yu blanga detlot isreil en juda pipul, en ola najalot kantri. yu garra raidimdan ebrijing weya aibin dalim yu brom det taim wen aibin fes tok langa yu wen josaiya bin jidan king, raidap langa tudei na.
english: "Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.

kriol: wal yumob go en dalim detlot wekinmen blanga jisas. yumob garra tok, 'jisas garra go lida langa yumob langa gelali. deya na yumob garra luk im jis laik imbin dalim yumob basdam.' en yumob garra dalim pida lagijat du." lagijat na det einjul bin tok langa detlot gel.
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.'"

kriol: yumob garra abum san en doda, bat yumob garra lujim olabat, dumaji detlot enami blanga yumob garra deigimwei olabat prisana.
english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

kriol: yumob garra lisin en duwit langa im. yumob kaan tenim miselp en gibit im bekboun, dumaji aibin jandim im. en if yumob gibit im bekboun, wal im kaan larramgo yumob brom det nogudbalawei.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don't provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

kriol: en yawei garra gaburrumap yumob dubala leig garram sowa wulijim yumob kaan gitbeda, en yumob garra abum loda pein brom detmatj sowa weya garra gaburrumap yumob hed raidap langa yumob fut.
english: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

kriol: "wal detlot 10 hon weya yubin luk, olabat na 10 nyubala bos. dei nomo jidan bos. bambai dei garra jidan bos garram det enimul. bat oni lilbit taim dei jidan bos.
english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

kriol: wal det serramonimen neim eliyashib bin bos blanga ola rum weya deibin oldei pudum ola sid daga blanga ofring, en det gudsmelwan medisin gulum freinkinsins, en ola boul, en ola sid daga, en ola wain en oliboil weya ola pipul bin gibit ola libaimen, en ola singamob en langa ola blijiman blanga det serramoni pleis. wal eliyashib hubin jidan gudfren blanga tobaiya, det men hubin kaman brom najawan kantri, bin meigim olabat deigimat ol detlot enijing brom wanbala bigwan rum en imbin gibit det rum langa tobaiya blanga jidan.
english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,

kriol: "ai nomo bin rabishim main kantri weya aibin growimap ola daga.
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

kriol: "'wal langa det dei na wen det tri garra dai en go langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul oldei go, yawei garra meigim detlot riba kraikrai blanga det tri. wen im garra dai ol det woda weya im oldei kamat brom andanith det graun en ola riba garra draiyap. det hil kantri gulum lebanan garra jidan brabli dakbala blanga shoum dei jidan soribala en ola tri langa det kantri garra ol draiyap.
english: "The Lord Yahweh says: 'In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

kriol: wal king deibid nomo bin lisin langa jowab, en imbin dalim jowab en detlot boswan solja blanga dumbat wanim imbin wandim olabat blanga dum. wal jowab bin gowei brom king deibid en imbin trebulin oloba det kantri blanga isreil, en afta jowab bin kambek langa jerusalem.
english: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

kriol: aibin tok langa yumob wen yumob bin jidanbat deya brabli ritjwan, bat yumob nomo bin irrim en teiknodis langa mi, najing. dumaji yumob bin dumbat lagijat olataim garram yumob laif. yumob neba bin teiknodis en duwit langa mi.
english: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, 'I will not listen.' This has been your way from your youth, that you didn't obey my voice.

english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

english: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.

english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

kriol: yawei, ai garra jinggabat blanga ola haibala ting yubin oldei dumbat. ai garra jinggabat ol detlot ting yubin oldei dumbat garram yu strongbalawan pawa longtaim.
english: I will remember Yah's deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

kriol: wal yu lisin langa olabat brom deya langa skai. larramgo ola pipul fri brom ol detlot nogudbala ting en bringimbek olabat langa det kantri weya yubin gibit langa olabat femilimob longtaim.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?"

english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "yumob garra wotjim miselp en nomo fogedabat yawei det trubala god blanga wi. nomo stap jinggabat en bulurrumbat detlot lowa weya ai gibitbat yumob tudei.
english: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

kriol: wal king omri bin dumbat detmatj nogudbala ting langa yawei, mowa den ola najalot king hubin jidan bifo im.
english: Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

english: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

kriol: wal det taim wen jesabel det waif blanga king eiheb, bin kilimbat ola speshalwan mesinja blanga yawei, obadaiya bin deigimwei 100 speshalwan mesinja, en imbin haidim olabat langa dubala keib, 50 langa wanbala, en naja 50 langa det najawan keib, en imbin oldei gibitbat olabat woda en daga.
english: for when Jezebel cut off Yahweh's prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

kriol: im braja shoma bin abum thribala san neim roga, jehuba en eram.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

kriol: ola isreil pipul bin wandi kilim olabat ded. bat dei nomo bin lau kilim olabat, dumaji ola boswan blanga detlot isreil pipul bin meigim det pramis garram detlot gibiyan pipul, en wen deibin meigim det pramis, deibin yusum det neim blanga yawei. wal ola isreil pipul bin gitwail langa detlot boswan blanga olabat,
english: The children of Israel didn't strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.

kriol: nomeda det boswan gin abum detmatj pawa, bat im garra stil dai naitaim wen im nomo redi blanga dai, jis laik ebribodi."
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

kriol: en deibin lafta peiyim sambala men mani blanga tok laiya stori blanga stibin, en detlot men bin tok, "melabat bin irrim stibin tok brabli nogudbalawei blanga mosis en blanga god."
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God."

kriol: wal det sekanwan san blanga juda bin sabi det beibi kaan jidan ronwan biginini blanga im, en wen dubala bin silip, im nomo bin weistim enijing insaid langa det gel blanga gibit im beibi. imbin weistim langa graun, dumaji im nomo bin wandim det gel blanga abum beibi blanga im dedbala braja.
english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn't be his; and when he went in to his brother's wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

kriol: "if wanbala men brom isreil, o streinja brom najawan kantri hu jidan langa yumob isreil pipul gibitbat mi bekboun en stat weship detlot drimin sheip, en afta im go en askimbat det speshalwan mesinja blanga faindat wanim ai garra tok, wal ai garra ensim im.
english: "'"For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I Yahweh will answer him by myself.

kriol: bat god bin shoum wi hau im garra meigim wi jidan raitwei langa im. en det lowa weya imbin gibit thru langa mosis dalim wi hau im garra meigim wi jidan raitwei langa im, en ol detlot wed weya detlot speshalwan mesinja bin raidimdan dalim wi tharran du. yumob sabi? god nomo yusum det lowa blanga meigim wi jidan raitwei langa im.
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

kriol: wal pida bin jandim ol detlot pipul atsaid brom det rum, en imbin nildan, en imbin prei langa god, en afta imbin tok langa det dedbala wuman, "tebatha, yu gidap." en det wuman bin opinim im ai dubala, en wen imbin luk pida, imbin gidap en jidan,
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, "Tabitha, get up!" She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

kriol: bat god nomo bin gibit im dijan kantri. imbin pramisim eibrahem im garra abum dijan kantri. bat im nomo bin gibit im eni kantri. imbin meigim det pramis langa eibrahem en langa im biginini olabat en langa olabat biginini olabat. god bin meigim det pramis wen eibrahem nomo bin abum eni biginini.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

kriol: yawei, yu lisin langa main preya. yu lisin langa mi wen mi jingat langa yu blanga album mi.
english: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

kriol: yumob sabi na? jisas na det boswan haibala serramonimen hu oldei lukaftumbat wi. im brabli gudbala, en im nomo garram eni folt, en im nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting. god bin kadimat im brom ola nogudbala pipul, en imbin meigim im jidan haibala langa hebin.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

kriol: detlot solja blanga im bin kaman laiga bigbala rein klaud. deibin trai blanga meigim melabat ranawei, en deibin hepi blanga binijimap melabat, bat melabat bin haidim miselp. en afta, yubin kilim ded olabat garram olabat ronwan spiya.
english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

kriol: en ola boswan brom ebri kantri bin kaman en silip garram im, en imbin meigim loda trabul blanga ola najalot pipul. imbin meigim olabat dumbat olkain nogudbala ting jis laiga drangginbala." lagijat na det einjul bin tok.
english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality."

kriol: bat aibin jingat adbala, "yawei yu na det boswan god, en yu nomo fosim mi blanga dum tharran. ebribodi olredi wail langa mi. dei reken mi oldei toktokbat garram trikibala wed." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: Then I said, "Ah Lord Yahweh! They say of me, 'Isn't he a speaker of parables?'"

kriol: jis laik dijan shot trasis bin fit brabliwei langa yu binji, wal lagijat na aibin wandim ola isreil pipul en ola juda pipul garra holdim mi brabli adbala. wal aibin dum lagijat na wulijim olabat garra jidan blanga main ronwan pipul olabat, wulijim olabat garra preisimbat en weshipbat main neim, bat olabat nomo bin dum."
english: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,' says Yahweh; 'that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.'

kriol: en imbin tok dijan speshalwan wed, "mi na beilam det san blanga biyowa. dijan na det wed brom god, en trubala ai gin luk gudwei.
english: He took up his parable, and said, "Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kriol: yawei bin tok langa im pipul isreil. imbin tok, "bambai det dei garra kaman wen ai garra album yumob dumaji wen yumob garra abum bigwan fait yumob garra jidan wulijim det haus weya yumob enamimob garra nokamdan. en nomeda ola enamimob garra bidim yumob, bat stil ai garra meigim yumob jidan brabli strongbala pipul igin wulijim longtaim wen deibid bin jidan king, ola isreil pipul bin jidan brabli strongbala pipul.
english: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,

kriol: ai nomo laigim detlot tufeis pipul hu nomo jidan trubalawei langa yu, bat mi, ai laigim ol yu lowa.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

kriol: weya trikimbat ola po pipul hu nomo garram enijing, en yumob oldei stilimbat enijing brom ola widogel en ola biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi.
english: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

kriol: jerabowam bin jidan king 22 yiya. imbin dai en deibin berrim im bodi, en im san neideb bin jidan det nyuwan king.
english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

kriol: en wen main braja en sista olabat bin irrim mi jidan iya langa dijan jeil, jisas krais det bos blanga wi bin meigim olabat jidan brabli strongbala, en dei nomo bin bradin blanga kipgon dalimbat ebribodi det gudnyus blanga jisas krais.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

kriol: sambala pipul bin gitbush langa deset kantri nomo garram eni roud blanga bulurrum, en nomo bin faindim eni bigwan taun blanga jidan deya.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

kriol: wal wen jowesh bin tok lagijat, detlot men nomo bin fait langa im san. bat deibin gibit im nyubala neim. deibin gulum im beilfait. bat garram olabat langgus deibin gulum im jerabeil. deibin gibit im det neim dumaji im dedi bin tok, "det drimin neim beil garra fait blanga imselp, dumaji det teibul im blanga im."
english: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, "Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar."

kriol: wal det men neim irestas bin stap deya langa det taun gulum korinth, en aibin libum det men neim trofamas langa det taun gulum mailitas, dumaji imbin sik.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

kriol: en langa detlot 7 dei nobodi langa yumob kantri nomo lau blanga abum det raising daga langa olabat kemp. en blanga det bifpat blanga det enimul weya yumob bin kilim langa det fes dei, wal yumob garra dagat holot det seim nait gin.
english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

kriol: yu na bos blanga deitaim en naitaim, en yu na bin pudum det san en det mun langa dubala pleis.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

kriol: "wal yumob sabi wanim mi toktok na? ol detlot lowa en ola wed weya detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga god bin raidimdanbat, dei ol garram det seimwan mining. ol detlot lowa en ol detlot wed tok, yu garra dumbat langa najalot pipul seimwei yu wandim olabat garra dumbat langa yu. if yu wandim olabat garra tridim yu gudbalawei, wal yu garra tridim olabat gudbalawei du.
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok langa detlot isreil pipul, "wen wibin stil jidanbat deya langa det bigwan hil gulum sainai aibin dalim yumob, 'ai kaan hendulum dis wek weya ai jidan bos blanga yumob. im maitbi tumatj blanga mi. ai kaan dum miselp.'
english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, "I am not able to bear you myself alone.

kriol: wal deibid bin tok, "wal hau yu sabi king sol en jonathan bin dai?"
english: David said to the young man who told him, "How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?"

kriol: bat langa main filing ai reken god bin meigim ola speshalwan mishanri jidan brabli lobala. imbin meigim melabat jidan jis laik detkain prisana weya dei kilim olabat ded lida langa ola pipul blanga lukinat. nomo oni pipul garra lukinatbat melabat. ola einjul garra lukinat melabat du.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

english: "Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

kriol: imbin gibit 22,000 buligi en 120,000 ship blanga det feloship ofring. en lagijat na deibin meigim det serramoni pleis seikridwan.
english: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated Yahweh's house.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "trubala ai dalim yumob. if yu bilib brabliwei langa god, yu gin dum detkain ting seimwei laik aibin dum langa dijan tri. if yu bilib brabliwei insaid langa yu hat, yu gin dalim hil blanga tjakam miselp langa solwoda, en im garra duwit langa yu.
english: Jesus answered them, "Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don't doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' it would be done.

kriol: yawei bin tok langa mi, 'nomo meigim trabul langa ola pipul langa moweb. detlot bigininimob blanga lot. yumob nomo go en fait langa olabat blanga olabat kantri. nomo. aibin gibit olabat det taun gulum eiya. ai kaan gibit yumob eni kantri langa moweb.'" lagijat na yawei bin tok langa mi.
english: Yahweh said to me, "Don't bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession."

kriol: yawei bin kamdan ontop langa det hil, en imbin jingat langa mosis blanga gowap ontop, en mosis bin gowap,
english: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

kriol: "ol yumob pipul hu rispek langa yawei en dum wanim im wekinmen oldei dalim yumob blanga dum, nomeda yumob wokwokbat langa dakbala roud nomo garram lait, yumob kipgon trastimbat det neim blanga yawei det trubala god blanga yumob.
english: Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in Yahweh's name, and rely on his God.

kriol: nomeda detlot juda pipul bin kantrimen blanga ola isreil pipul, bat detlot isreil pipul langa det nowathwan kantri bin deigimwei prisana 200,000 wuman en biginini langa det taun gulum sameriya en bigmob ebrijing du.
english: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.

kriol: en wen deibin kaman langa jisas, deibin tok, "yu dalim melabat. yu na det speshalwan men weya jon beptis bin tok garra kaman? o maitbi melabat garra weit blanga najawan men?"
english: and said to him, "Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?"

kriol: en aibin reken im gudwan wen yu laflafbat oldei, bat aibin faindat im nomo gudwan lagijat.
english: I said of laughter, "It is foolishness;" and of mirth, "What does it accomplish?"

kriol: yawei, hu gin kaman langa yu serramoni pleis? hu gin jidan langa yu seikridwan hil?
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

kriol: wen yu dum lagijat ola pipul langa isreil garra lisin wanim yumob bin dum, en dei garra bradin en nobodi kaan dum det nogudbala ting igin.
english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

kriol: wal ol detlot pipul hu laigim weshipbat langa detkain drimin sheip, olabat jidan medwan en dei jidan blainwan. olabat nomo sabi wanim trubala.
english: They don't know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can't see, and their hearts, that they can't understand.

kriol: wal detlot libai pipul bin garrimap det seikridwan boks garram pol en deibin garrimap langa olabat sholda jis laik yawei bin dalim mosis.
english: The children of the Levites bore God's ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh's word.

kriol: en det graun bin growimap olkain tri en gras en purdiflawa. en wen god bin luk ebrijing bin gudwan, imbin gudbinji.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

kriol: bambai if det men nomo wandim det gel, wal im lafta larramgo det gel fri. im kaan tridim det gel laiga prisana en selim im, dumaji det men bin fosim det gel blanga silipsilip garram im."
english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

kriol: "yumob garra gibit feyago langa enibodi brom najawan kantri, en langa detlot biginini weya nomo garram mami o dedi, en yumob kaan deigimwei det bleingkit brom eni widogel wen im owim yumob samting.
english: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow's clothing in pledge;

kriol: wal wen pida bin stil toktok, wanbala klaud bin kamat langa olabat deya, en det shedo bin gaburrumap olabat, en detlot thribala wekinmen bin bradin wen det klaud bin gaburrumap olabat,
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

kriol: afta tharran det men bin deigim mi langa det geit langa sauthsaid en imbin meshurum det wol blanga det rum weya olabat oldei gowin. wen imbin meshurum tharran, imbin wulijim det naja dubala geit.
english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
