kriol: if yu go langa yawei blanga jidan seif, en if yu jidan garram det brabli haibalawan,
english: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

kriol: langa det taim wen pipul brom ola difrinwan kantri en ola difrinwan langgus kaman iya, det taim na tenbala brom olabat garra kaman langa wan juwish men en tok, 'wi wandim yumob garra titjim melabat blanga yumob god. wi wandim kaman langa yumob dumaji pipul bin dalim melabat god im jidan garram yumob.'" lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: "In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, 'We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.'"

kriol: bat wen det rait taim bin kaman, imbin jinggabat ol detlot nogudbala ting weya detlot pipul bin dumbat, en imbin gibit jisas krais blanga pei blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting, en tharran na shoum wi god oldei rait, en im shoum wi du im na meigim detlot pipul hu bilib langa jisas krais jidan raitwei langa im.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

kriol: afta na detlot pipul bin tok, "wi garra lafta dum samting langa jeramaiya. sambala serramonimen garra jidan iya olataim blanga toktokbat langa wi, en klebabalamen blanga gibitbat wi woning, en speshalwan mesinja blanga dalimbat wi blanga god mesij. wi garra lafta dalimbat laiya stori blanga im, en wi garra stap lisinbat langa im."
english: Then they said, "Come! Let's devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won't perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let's strike him with the tongue, and let's not give heed to any of his words."

kriol: wal melabat dalimbat yumob det wed weya melabat bin irrim brom jisas krais. en iya na det wed. god im lait, en nomo eni dakbala jidan langa im.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

kriol: langa dubala yiya na, ai garra bringimbek ol detlot silba en gol ting blanga det serramoni pleis weya king nebakanesa bin deigim langa bebalon.
english: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of Yahweh's house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.

kriol: imbin jingat langa det speshalwan mesinja brom juda, "yawei bin tok yu nomo bin teiknodis langa im, en yu nomo bin dum wanim imbin dalim yu blanga dum.
english: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, "Yahweh says, 'Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh's word, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,

kriol: det dubala grup bin kilim ola pipul deya langa detlot pedik, en abimalek bin ran garram im grup raidap langa det meinwan geit,
english: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.

kriol: ailibala neksdei deibin go gulijap langa gibiya, en deibin meigim kemp deya redibala blanga fait,
english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

kriol: yawei bin dalim mosis blanga wonim detlot isreil pipul wen dei nomo klinbala blanga serramoni, dei nomo lau go langa det seikridwan tent weya jandap rait langa midul langa det kemp. if dei go deya, wal dei garra dai.
english: "'Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.'"

kriol: basdam king saihan bin jidan bos langa det taun gulum heshban, bat langa dijan taim na wen detlot pipul blanga moweb bin trai ranawei brom olabat enamimob, deibin go langa heshban blanga albumbat en seibum olabat, bat najing, dumaji im barnbarnbat garram faiya. en det faiya bin barnimap ola taun en pleis raidap langa ola boda en langa hil kantri du, dumaji detlot pipul langa moweb bin oldei laigimbat miselp.
english: "Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

kriol: im nomo wandim meigim wi blanga abumbat loda trabul en pein.
english: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

kriol: "wal trubala yawei det trubala god garra binijimap dijan wel, en im garra meigim dijan wel jidan wulijim deset kantri. yawei garra spredimatbat ola pipul ebriweya langa dijan wel.
english: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

kriol: en yumob garra album melabat du. yumob garra prei blanga melabat, dumaji wen loda pipul prei blanga melabat, god garra ensim detlot preya blanga olabat, en im garra gudbinji langa melabat, en afta loda pipul garra gibit theingks langa im.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

kriol: en yumob na garra deigim yumob dedimob pleis. yumob brabli nogudbala pipul, yumob bin deigim yumob dedimob pleis, redi blanga meigim yawei brabli wail langa ola isreil pipul igin.
english: "Behold, you have risen up in your fathers' place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

kriol: bat wanbala ting deya bin meigim mi brabli gudbinji langa yu. yu brabli nomo laigim ola nogudbala ting weya detlot pipul gulum nikoleiyatin pipul oldei dumbat, en mi nomo laigim detlot nogudbala ting du.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

kriol: bifo yumob bin bulurrum det nogudbalawei wen yumob bin stil jidan langa dakbala, en nomo bin sabi god. bat det bos blanga wi bin meigim yumob im ronwan pipul olabat, en yumob jidan jis laiga lait na, en yumob garra shoum ebribodi yumob nomo blanga det dakbala. yumob blanga det brabliwan lait,
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

kriol: ai garra gibit yu bigismob biginini olabat. dei garra jidan detmatj jis laik sengraun, en nobodi kaan kaundimap olabat.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

kriol: det gel weya garra merrit langa det king, im kaminap langa det bigwan haus. im brabli purdiwan. blanga im dres deibin meigim garram golwan kotin.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

kriol: en im garra gibit det najawan bard blanga det barnapwan ofring jis laik det lowa bin dalim olabat. wal lagijat na det serramonimen garra gibit det sekrifais blanga im nogudbalawei, en tharran garra meigim im jidan fri.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

kriol: en yu garra laigim im brabliwei. yu garra gibit miselp laif langa im. holbit yu garra gibit miselp langa im, en yu garra abum filing oni blanga im, en yu garra jinggabat im oldei langa yu main en dum adwek blanga im.'
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.' This is the first commandment.

kriol: brom deya langa main drim aibin luk langa det sambodi hubin jidan langa det speshal boswan tjeya langa midul, en aibin luk rolapwan peipa langa im raidensaid bingga. det peipa bin abum neim ebriweya langa im, insaid en atsaid, en imbin stak brabliwei garram sebenbala bush gam.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

kriol: nomeda im jidan laibala tudei, bat wi garra kilim im ded.
english: Let's swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

kriol: mi na det speshalwan men, en ai garra dai jis laik im tok langa oltestaman. bat det men weya garra hendimoba mi langa detlot serramonimen, im garra pudum imselp langa big trabul, en im mobeda blanga im if im nomo bina bon."
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born."

kriol: en if det ai blanga yumob oldei meigim yumob dum nogudbala ting en deigidawei yumob brom main wei, wal mobeda yumob libum det nogudbala ting jis laik yumob deigimat det ai en tjakidawei. im nogud blanga yumob if dei tjakidawei yumob langa det helfaiya garram dubala ai. mobeda yumob jidan garram det olagijawan laif garram wanbala ai.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

kriol: yumob bin gowei brom ijip langa det manth gulum abib, en god bin dalim yumob basdam yumob garra abum det serramoni gulum damba nomo garram raising langa det seimwan manth na. wen yumob abum det serramoni, yumob kaan dagat eni daga garram raising blanga 7 dei, en nobodi kaan kaman en weship langa god nomo garram ofring blanga gibit langa im.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

kriol: "aibin irrim detlot mesinja tok, 'irrim! ai garra dalim yumob blanga drim weya god bin gibit langa mi naitaim.' lagijat na dei oldei kipgon yusumbat main neim blanga dalimbat laiya. wal wotaim diskain ting garra stap?
english: "I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, 'I had a dream! I had a dream!'

kriol: yu nomo tok, "ai garra peiyimbek im blanga det nogudbala ting imbin dum." yu garra weit en trastim langa yawei blanga meigim ebrijing jidan raitwei.
english: Don't say, "I will pay back evil." Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.

kriol: melabat bin askim olabat blanga olabat neim du wulijim melabat gin raidimdan blanga yu hu detlot boswan hubin dalim olabat blanga dum dis wek.
english: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok, "wotfo yu jinggabat blanga det kripa nomo lilbit? yu nomo bin growimap det kripa. yu nomo bin wek blanga meigim det kripa kamat. yestadei imbin jis kamat miselp, en tudei imbin binij.
english: Yahweh said, "You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.

kriol: yawei bin dalim mi blanga dalim ola pipul, "mi na bin brabli wail langa yumob grengrenfatha olabat.
english: "Yahweh was very displeased with your fathers.

kriol: yu garra gibit det libai klen 48 bigwan taun. brom detlot 6 taun na garra jidan seifwan taun en if enibodi kilim sambodi ded, bat im nomo bin min blanga kilim im, wal im gin go langa det seifwan taun. en yu garra gibit olabat detlot 42 najawan taun garram gras kantri.
english: "The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "langa det kantri weya yumob garra teikoba, detlot najalot pipul oldei dumbat detlot nogudbala ting. olabat go langa klebabala pipul blanga faindat wanim garra hepin bambai en blanga askim ola najalot nogudbala ting du. bat yawei im dalim yumob nomo blanga dumbat detkain nogudbala ting,
english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.

kriol: wal det king blanga jerusalem bin neim edanisadek, en imbin irrim det nyus weya joshuwa bin binijimap det king en ola pipul langa det taun gulum eiyai seimwei laik imbin binijimap ola pipul langa jeriko. en king edanisadek bin irrim det nyus du weya joshuwa bin meigim pramis garram ola pipul brom gibiyan en imbin larram olabat jidan garram ola isreil pipul.
english: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

kriol: "isikiyel, yu jidanbat garram ol dislot pipul hu oldei gibit mi bekboun. olabat garram dubala ai, bat olabat blainwan, en olabat garram dubala irriwol, bat olabat kaan irrim mi en olabat oldei gibitbat mi bekboun.
english: "Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don't see, who have ears to hear, and don't hear; for they are a rebellious house.

kriol: wal ola kristjan pipul brom ebriweya tok gudei langa yumob, en yumob garra tok gudei langa ola kristjan pipul deya blanga melabat. en yumob garra sheikhen gija du.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

kriol: yumob irrim mi na. if yu garram irriwol, yu lisin langa mi.
english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

kriol: afta na yawei det trubala god bin jandim det speshalwan mesinja blanga im neim neithan langa king deibid, en wen imbin kamat langa im, imbin dalim king deibid, "dubala men bin jidan langa wan taun. det wanbala men bin ritjwan, en det najawan men bin powan.
english: Yahweh sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, "There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.

kriol: wal ai sabi ebrijing weya god bin dum garra jidan olagijawan. dumaji god bin meigim ebrijing brabli gudwan. wal pipul kaan edimap enijing en dei kaan deigidawei enijing brom wanim imbin dum. god bin dum dijan, en wi ol hatjamp blanga wanim imbin dum.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

kriol: detlot pipul hubin abum bigismob daga basdam, im garra meigim olabat jidan hanggribala, en dei garra wek adbala blanga gajimbat daga. en detlot pipul hubin jidan hanggribala basdam, im garra meigim olabat jidan bulap binji. im na garra gibit bigmob biginini langa det gel hu nomo abum eni beibi, en im deigidawei ola biginini brom det gel hubin abum loda biginini.
english: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.

kriol: lagijat na ebrijing garra binij. en hau yumob reken yumob garra jidan? yumob garra wandim det dei blanga god garra kaman, en yumob garra oldei jidan gudbalawei en bulurrum god, en yumob garra adwek blanga meigim det dei kaman kwikbala.
english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

kriol: en yu sabi det tri im gudwan o nogudwan wen yu luk wotkain daga im garram. det gudwan figtri daga kaan gro langa det nogudwan jigininbala tri en detlot greip daga kaan gro langa det nogudwan bindiyai bushis.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don't gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

kriol: det bif brom olabat blanga yu, jis laik det briskit en det biyainwan rait leig blanga det speshalwan ofring.
english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

kriol: if main pipul olabat teiknodis en duwit langa main lowa en wanim aibin titjimbat thru langa main wekinmen mosis, wal ai kaan neba meigim olabat gowei igin brom dijan kantri weya aibin gibit langa olabat grengrenfathamob." lagijat na god bin tok.
english: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses."

kriol: wen aibin ardimbat, aibin jingat langa yawei, en imbin ensim mi en larramgo mi fri.
english: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

kriol: yawei na bin tok im nomo bin jandim olabat en olabat dalimbat laiya en dei reken dei tok garram im neim. wal im garra jandimwei yu, en yu garra ol gitkil, yu en detlot speshalwan mesinjamob hu oldei dalimbat yu laiyawan wed." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: For I have not sent them," says Yahweh, "but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you."

kriol: "dijan na wanim yumob garra dum blanga yawei langa detlot barnapwan, sid daga, en wain ofring, en detlot feloship ofring. lagijat na yumob garra dumbat langa yawei wen yumob abum ol detlot serramoni, en wen yumob gibit det ofring wen yumob meigim pramis langa yawei, en det ofring weya yumob gibit garram yumob ronwan filing."
english: "'You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.'"

kriol: sambala ston bin brabli bigwan, gulijap 5 mita long en najalot 4 mita long en deibin pudum blanga det flopat langa detlot bigwan haus,
english: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

kriol: wal det king na jidan jis laik det san weya gidap ailibala en shain brabli braitwan langa det skai nomo garram eni klaud, en im jidan jis laik det san weya oldei meigim ola gras gro afta wen im rein.'
english: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.'

kriol: wal det king bin tok, "yumob ol leisibala! yumob oldei askimbat mi blanga larramgo yumob blanga abum det sekrifais serramoni blanga yumob god, dumaji yumob leisibala, en yumob nomo wandi wek.
english: But Pharaoh said, "You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, 'Let's go and sacrifice to Yahweh.'

kriol: if im nomo garram eni braja o anggul, im ronwan femili gin gajim ola kantri blanga im. detlot ola isreil pipul garra dum lagijat na. mi na yawei det trubala god bin tok langa yu."
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.'"

kriol: ai garra preisim yu gudbinjiwei garram holbit det filing insaid langa main hat. ai garra jidan gudwei en weit blanga yu.
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

kriol: en streidawei wen imbin tok lagijat, det men irriwol bin opin, en det tang blanga im bin go luswan, en imbin tok gudwei na.
english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

kriol: en ai garra jidan dedi blanga im, en im garra jidan jis laiga san blanga mi. en nomeda ai garra panishim im, bat stil ai garra laigim im. en ai kaan tjakidawei im seimwei laik aibin tjakidawei sol blanga meigim yu jidan king.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

kriol: yumob sabi? nobodi kaan heidim im ron bodi, dumaji im oldei fidim miselp en lukaftum miselp jis laik jisas krais oldei dum langa ola bilibamob, dumaji wi jidan jis laik det bodi blanga im.
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

kriol: en sol bin majurrumap olabat langa det pleis gulum besek. 30,000 men brom det juda klen en 300,000 men brom ola najalot isreil klen bin majurrumap miselp deya.
english: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

kriol: "wal yumob pipul garra lafta dalim olabat blanga detlot drimin. dei nomo bin meigim dijan graun en det skai, en dei garra binijap dregli. dei kaan jidan langa dijan wel enimo." lagijat na aibin tok.
english: "You shall say this to them: 'The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.'"

kriol: "wal yu jinggabat na. nomo eni trubala en gudbala men bin dai wen olabat bin stil brabli yangbala.
english: "Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

kriol: "afta na aibin kaman biyain langa jon beptis, en aibin dagadagat daga, en aibin dringgimbat det wain. en pipul bin tok, 'yu luk det men. im oldei dagadagat daga en dringgimbat det wain, en im fren blanga ola nogudbala pipul.'
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, 'Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!'

kriol: detlot na gin dalim yumob wanim yawei det trubala god bin dumbat.
english: Who doesn't know that in all these, Yahweh's hand has done this,

kriol: nomo bringim drimin sheip langa yumob kemp, dumaji det seim nogudwan ting garra jidan langa yumob weya jidan langa detlot drimin sheip. yumob garra heidim en nomo wandimbat detlot drimin sheip, dumaji detlot ting brabli nogudwan langa yawei."
english: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

kriol: "aibin pikimat wanbala men brom det juda klen. im neim besalel, en im det san blanga det olmen neim yurai en det grensan blanga det olmen neim huwa.
english: "Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

kriol: en mi oldei gibit main enijing langa detlot pipul hu laigim mi, en mi oldei bilimap olabat haus garram ola gudbala ting.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

kriol: wal det gabman bos bin tok langa im ofsaida olabat, en afta imbin dalim pol, "wal if yu wandi go langa det haibala kot, wal deya na yu garra go."
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, "You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go."

kriol: im garra gobek seimwei weya imbin kaman en im kaan kaman insaid langa dijan taun. dumaji mi na yawei det trubala god bin tok dijan.
english: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,' says Yahweh.

kriol: wanmo taim yawei bin jingat langa det yangboi, en det yangboi bin gidap, en imbin ran langa det olmen, en imbin askim im, "yubin jingat langa mi? wal mi iya na." wal det olmen bin jinggabat na maitbi yawei bin jingat langa det yangboi,
english: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; for you called me." Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.

kriol: en yumob nomo bin teiknodis langa im wen imbin jandim yumob brom keidishbaniya en imbin dalim yumob blanga go en teikoba det kantri weya imbin wandi gibit yumob. yumob bin gibit bekboun langa im.
english: When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, "Go up and possess the land which I have given you," you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God, and you didn't believe him or listen to his voice.

kriol: king josaiya bin kilim ola serramonimen hubin oldei weshipbat blanga detlot drimin sheip. en imbin barnimap ola boun blanga olabat ontop langa detlot teibul blanga ofring weya deibin oldei wek en imbin gobek langa jerusalem.
english: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men's bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.

kriol: dumaji deibin bilib, wal deibin fait langa ola strongbala ami, en deibin oldei bidim olabat, en deibin oldei dum ebrijing raitwei, en deibin gedim wanim god bin pramis. wal yumob sabi wanim bin hepin langa ol detlot pipul hubin bilib. wen detlot nogudbala pipul bin oldei tjakam olabat langa laiyan, det laiyan nomo bin kilim olabat,
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

kriol: afta na detlot gel hubin merrit langa detlot spirit bin abum biginini olabat, en deibin gulum olabat nefalim pipul, en afta wen olabat mami bin dai, detlot nefalim pipul bin kipgon jidanbat langa olabat mami kantri, en deibin ol brabli strongbala pipul, en deibin jidan bigneim.
english: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God's sons came in to men's daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

kriol: wen ai dalim detlot brabli nogudbala pipul, 'yumob garra dai', wal yu, isikiyel, garra lafta dalim olabat wanim garra hepin wulijim dei garra tenawei brom detlot nogudbalawei en jidan laibala. if yu nomo dalim olabat blanga libum det nogudbalawei, wal dei garra dai dumaji olabat oldei dumbat nogudbala ting. en if yu nomo dalim detlot pipul, wal det bleim garra gobek langa yu igin.
english: When I tell the wicked, 'You will surely die;' and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

kriol: en if yumob wandim god garra kaman en jidan garram yumob, wal yumob garra bulurrum im, en afta im garra kaman langa yumob. wal ol yumob kristjan pipul garra stap dumbat ola nogudbala ting. yumob oldei jinggabat dubalawei en yumob garra tenim miselp brom detkain en jinggabat oni wanwei.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

kriol: en wi kaan faindim enijing iya blanga gibit im weya im nomo bin gibit langa wi, dumaji im na bin gibit wi ebrijing, en imbin gibit wi win blanga jidan laibala du.
english: He isn't served by men's hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

kriol: brom deya jeihu en jonadeb bin go en dubala bin barnim en gibit det sekrifais ofring langa beil. jeihu bin abum im 80 solja weidabat redibala atsaid langa det seikridwan haus en bifo deibin go insaid imbin gibit oda langa olabat, "yumob garra kilim dislot pipul holot. if enibodi larram go enibodi fri im garra dai du."
english: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, "If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him."

kriol: wal wen isau bin tok lagijat, jeikob bin gibit im det damba en supsup, en isau bin dagat det daga en dringgimbat, en afta imbin gidap en gowei. oni blanga daga isau bin gibitawei det pleis blanga im weya im garra jidan bos, dumaji oni blanga abumbat daga imbin jinggabat.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

kriol: "main dedi deibid bin wandim bildimap serramoni pleis blanga weshipbat yawei det trubala god blanga ola isreil pipul,
english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

kriol: yumob sabi? wen yumob kristjan olabat abum detkain trabul, yumob garra album olabat, en wen yumob album olabat, wal yumob bulurrum det lowa weya jisas krais bin gibit langa wi.
english: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

kriol: en imbin meigim ola najalot isreil solja redi blanga fait langa detlot emanait solja lida. jowab bin bos blanga detlot isreil solja hu garra fait biyain, en imbin meigim im braja ebishai bos blanga detlot isreil solja hu garra fait lida,
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.

kriol: wal yu garra kipgon jidanbat garram mi. yu dalim mi haumatj mani yu wandim, en ai gibit yu if yu kipgon stap iya langa mi."
english: He said, "Appoint me your wages, and I will give it."

kriol: bethsheba bin pudumdan im hed raitdan en im nos bin tatjim det graun en det king bin askim im na, "wanim yu wandim?"
english: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, "What would you like?"

kriol: wal yumob sabi hau wi garra prei? wi garra prei garram det spirit blanga wi, en wi garra prei garram det main blanga wi du. en wi garra sing garram det spirit blanga wi, en wi garra sing garram det main blanga wi du.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

kriol: bat if det men bin jinggabat nomo blanga merrit langa det gel, en im reken god nomo wandim im blanga merrit, en if im gin hendulum det filing blanga im, wal im garra kipgon jidanbat singulbala en nomo merrit langa det gel. en wen im dum lagijat, wal tharran im rait du.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

kriol: "bat maitbi sambodi bin kilim sambodi ded, en im nomo bin heidim im, en im nomo bin min blanga kilim im wen imbin pushumdan im, o tjakambat samting langa im.
english: "'But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

kriol: ola pipul ebriweya melabat gudbinji blanga detlot lowa, en melabat gibit theingks langa yu blanga tharran.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

kriol: yu garra deigim ola silba en gol weya yu gajim brom ola pipul langa dijan kantri bebalon en detlot ofring weya ola isreil pipul en olabat serramonimen gibit blanga det serramoni pleis blanga olabat god deya langa jerusalem.
english: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem.

kriol: dumaji det woda garra jidan brabli klinbala en detlot lilwan krik garra jidan kwaitbala du.
english: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil," says the Lord Yahweh.

kriol: ai garra binijimap detlot serramoni pleis weya detlot grengrensan blanga det olmen neim aisik bin oldei go blanga weship. en ai garra binijimap ola speshalwan serramoni pleis blanga ol detlot isreil pipul. en ai garra binijimap detlot femili blanga det king gulum jerabowam.' lagijat na god bin tok." en lagijat na aibin dalim olabat main drim.
english: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword."

kriol: raidap det king deigim yumob langa najawan kantri jis laik dijan! det kantri garram ola greip fam blanga meigim wain, en sid daga blanga meigim damba, en bigmob olib daga blanga dagat en meigim oliboil, en blendibala shugabeig du. if yumob teiknodis langa wanim im tok wal yumob kaan dai. yumob nomo larram king hesakaiya trikim yumob wen im tok yawei garra seibum yumob.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and of honey, that you may live and not die. Don't listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, "Yahweh will deliver us."

kriol: en yumob garra tridim det lowa blanga merrit raitwei, en ebri hasbin en waif garra jidan trubala langa dubala selp, dumaji god garra panishim det hasbin hu silip garram naja men waif en det waif hu silip garram naja gel hasbin, en im garra panishim detlot singulwan pipul hu silipsilipbat garram enibodi du.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

kriol: blowim ola longwan wisul en hon en jingat gudbinjiwei langa yawei det bos blanga wi.
english: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.

kriol: afta wen olabat bin libum det pleis olabat bin kemp langa det taun weya bin buldan longtaim gulum ebarim, langa det deset kantri, sanraiswei langa det moweb kantri.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

kriol: wal detlot pipul bin tok, "wal wanim speshalwan klebabala ting yu garra dum blanga shoum melabat en meigim melabat bilib det wed weya yu tok im trubala? longtaim melabat grengrenfatha olabat bin dagadagat det speshalwan daga gulum mena deya langa det deset kantri jis laik weya im tok langa oltestaman. im tok, 'imbin gibit olabat daga brom hebin blanga dagat.' wal wanim yu garra dum?" lagijat na detlot pipul bin askim jisas.
english: They said therefore to him, "What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

kriol: en dei garra mokim mi, en dei garra spit langa mi, en dei garra beldim mi garram wip, en afta dei garra kilim mi ded. bat thrideistaim ai garra gidap brom det greib en jidan laibala." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again."

kriol: en afta na mosis bin bringimap detlot san blanga eran langa frantwei, en imbin meigim detlot werrimon shet en waitwan heinggitjif raidaran langa olabat binji, en imbin taiyimap het langa olabat hed, jis laik yawei bin dalimbat mosis blanga dum.
english: Moses brought Aaron's sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kriol: wal langa det taim na labaiyathan det bigwan solwoda enimul garra trai blanga gowei bat yawei det trubala god garra kilim im garram det bigwan shapwan naif.
english: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

kriol: afta tharran dei garra git brabli sik, en dei garra dai.
english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

kriol: "wen yumob irrim det laiyan jinginat langa bush kantri, yumob reken imbin faindim daga? yuwai. "wen yumob irrim det yangwan laiyan jinginat langa im kemp, yumob reken im garram samting blanga dagat? yuwai, im garram samting blanga dagat.
english: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?

kriol: olabat neks kemp bin langa refadim, en deya na dei nomo bin abum eni woda blanga dringgim.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

kriol: wal det dubala gel neim meri megdalin en det najawan meri hubin mami blanga josef, dubala bin luk weya josef bin pudum det bodi blanga jisas.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

kriol: nomo larram olabat win en meigim olabat jidan brabli bradinwan olagijawan. larram olabat sheim brabliwei en dai.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

kriol: en yumob garra gibit theingks langa wi dedi gudbinjiwei, dumaji im na bin meigim wi jidan raitwei langa im wulijim wi garra gedim ol detlot gudbala ting weya imbin pramis blanga gibit langa detlot pipul hu garram det lait blanga im,
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

kriol: ai kaan fil sori blanga yumob, dumaji yumob dumbat olkain nogudbala ting. ai garra panishim yumob brabliwei blanga ol detlot brabli nogudbala ting weya yumob bin oldei dumbat, wulijim yumob garra sabi mi na yawei, en mi na oldei panishim yumob.
english: My eye won't spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.

kriol: detlot fobala najakain enimul bin abum loda wing jis laiga bard. siksbala wing deibin abum, en ebriweya langa olabat bodi deibin abum ai, insaid en atsaid deibin abum. wal detlot najakain enimul bin oldei singsing. deitaim en naitaim dei neba stap singsing, "holi, holi, holi, det brabli haibala god. im brabli strongbala nomo lilbit. imbin jidan boswan lagijat basdam longtaim, en tudei im stil jidan lagijat na, en im garra kipgon jidanbat lagijat olagijawan."
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!"

kriol: bat sambala juwish pipul nomo bin bilib langa det wed, en deibin stat meigimbat trabul, en deibin meigim detlot jintail pipul gitwail langa detlot bilibamob.
english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

kriol: bat ol detlot pipul hu kipgon bulurrumbat det lowa blanga trai en meigim miselp jidan raitwei langa god, wal god garra panishim olabat, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, "god garra panishim ol detlot pipul hu nomo oldei kipum ol detlot lowa weya god bin gibit langa olabat."
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, "Cursed is everyone who doesn't continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them."

kriol: sameriya im jidan langa bigwan hil, bat detlot lida garra jidan jis laik det purdiflawa weya im draiyap en dai. blanga im gudwan ebrijing garra ol binijap kwikbala, jis laik wen sambodi luk det kukwan fig daga, en im dagat streidawei.
english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

kriol: wal detlot haibala serramonimen en lowamen en boswan olmen bin ol mokimbat jisas lagijat du.
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

kriol: wal im garra meigim yumob abum mowa pawa brom najalot pipul weya imbin meigim. olabat garra preisimbat en rispek langa yumob. yumob garra jidan ronwan pipul na blanga yawei, jis laik imbin pramis." lagijat na mosis bin tok.
english: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.

kriol: wal deibin kaundimap ol detlot men brom wan manth ol en oba, en det namba bin 6,200.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

kriol: en if yu binijimap olabat, wal ol detlot ijip pipul garra tok yubin deigidawei olabat dumaji yubin wandi binijimap olabat iya langa dijan hil kantri. yu kaan gitwail langa olabat en binijimap olabat.
english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, 'He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth'? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

kriol: det serramonimen garra luk im igin. if im luk det sowa bin go oloba langa im bodi, wal im garra dalim im, 'yu klinbala blanga serramoni'. if ol im skin bin go waitwan wal im klinbala blanga serramoni.
english: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

kriol: afta na jonathan bin dalim deibid, "tumorro wi garra abum det padi blanga det serramoni, en if yu nomo deya, wal main dedi garra luk yu nomo deya garram melabat,
english: Then Jonathan said to him, "Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

kriol: bambai na ola filastain pipul bin majurrumap miselp blanga fait langa ola isreil pipul, en ola isreil pipul bin majurrumap miselp blanga go en fait langa olabat. detlot isreil pipul bin meigim kemp langa wan pleis gulum ebanisa, en detlot filastain pipul bin kemp langa det taun gulum afek.
english: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

kriol: wal yawei nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ol detlot nogudbala ting. blanga tharran na im garra andimwei ol detlot nogudbala pipul brom det kantri blanga larram yumob jidan deya.
english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.

kriol: en langa detlot pipul hu garra win en kipgon dumbat wanim ai wandim olawei, wal ai garra meigim olabat jidan bos langa ebri kantri.
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

kriol: wal detlot kantrimen main olabat na detlot isreil pipul. god bin pikimat olabat basdam blanga meigim olabat jidan biginini blanga im, en imbin shoum det shainiwan lait blanga im langa olabat, en imbin meigim det pramis garram olabat, en imbin gibit olabat det lowa, en imbin shoum olabat hau blanga weship langa im trubalawei, en imbin gibit olabat ol detlot pramis na,
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

kriol: wal ebriyiya det lilboi mami bin oldei meigim lilwan kout blanga im, en wen imbin oldei go garram im hasbin blanga abum det sekrifais serramoni, imbin oldei deigim det kout langa det lilboi.
english: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

kriol: yubin bringimap detlot enami langa mi blanga abum krulwan padi det dei. nomo enibodi bin sabi wujeiwujei olabat garra go det dei na wen yubin panishim en binijimap melabat. detlot enami bin kilimbat main bigininimob weya aibin growimap en laigim olabat detmatj." lagijat na jerusalem bin tok.
english: "You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of Yahweh's anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.

kriol: wal blanga tharran na wen ai sabi wanim garra hepin langa mi, ai garra jandim timathi langa yumob,
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

kriol: wal det king eihesaiya blanga isreil bin go langa king jehosafet, en imbin tok blanga gibit king jehosafet sambala men blanga go garram im wekinmen olabat langa bout. bat king jehosafet nomo bin agri garram eihesaiya.
english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants go with your servants in the ships." But Jehoshaphat would not.

kriol: afta na, wen yubin meigim detlot libai pipul fri brom det panishmen blanga olabat nogudbalawei, wal olabat redi blanga wek na langa det seikridwan tent.
english: "After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

kriol: merarai bin abum dubala san neim malai en mushai. ol detlot femili bin kamat brom det wan men neim libai.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

kriol: wal timathi, ai garra gibit yu woning na, dumaji god en jisas krais dubala iya. en ai garra gibit yu dijan woning, dumaji wen jisas krais garra kambek blanga jidan king, im garra jadjim ola laibala pipul en ola dedbala pipul. wal iya na det woning weya ai garra gibit yu.
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

kriol: keidish, jokniyam deya langa det hil gulum kamul,
english: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

kriol: dei nomo dalimbat laiya blanga najalot pipul. dei nomo dum nogudwan ting langa pipul. dei nomo tok nogudwan stori blanga olabat.
english: he who doesn't slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

kriol: ebri naitaim ai wandim yu brabliwei. wen yu jadjim ola pipul iya langa dijan wel, olabat garra sabi yu lowa en olabat garra jidan gudbalawei.
english: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

kriol: bat dumaji main wekinmen keilab garram difrinwan main en im oldei duwit langa mi, ai garra bringimap im langa det kantri weya imbin luk basdam, en im bigininimob garra jidan langa det kantri, weya detlot amalekait traib en detlot keinanait traib jidan. tumorro na yu tenaran en gobek langa det deset kantri langa det solwoda gulum redsi." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

kriol: wal yumob irrim mi na. yumob garra oldei wotjimbat miselp, en yumob garra kipgon bilib strongbalawei, en yumob kaan bradin langa enijing, en yumob kaan larram enijing bidim yumob.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

kriol: yu si? detlot pipul hubin irrim det wed basdam nomo bin go langa det gudbala kantri en jidan gudbalawei garram god, dumaji dei nomo bin bilib langa im brabliwei. oni detlot pipul hu bilib brabliwei garra go langa det gudbala kantri en jidan deya gudbalawei garram god.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

kriol: wal ola men brom det thribala klen bin dalim joshuwa, "ebrijing yu dalim melabat, melabat garra duwit langa yu, en nomeda weya yu jandim melabat, bat stil melabat garra go.
english: They answered Joshua, saying, "All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

kriol: en langa berotha, en sibreiyim, det dubala taun weya jidan langa det boda langa midul langa det dubala kantri gulum dameskas en heimath. det boda garra binij langa det taun gulum heisohetikan en det boda langa det kantri gulum hauran.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

kriol: dumaji im nomo bin abum san, wotfo melabat fatha neim nomo deya langa ola isreil pipul? yu gibit melabat kantri thru langa melabat fatha brajamob." lagijat na deibin tok.
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father."

kriol: wal detlot tenbala gel bin gidap, en deibin laidim olabat lemp,
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

kriol: bat yawei bin tok adbalawei langa mosis en eran, "dumaji yunbala nomo bin trastimbat langa mi holbit wen aibin wandi shoum main seikridwan pawa langa detlot isreil pipul, yu kaan lidim olabat langa det kantri weya aibin pramis blanga gibit langa olabat." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you didn't believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them."

kriol: yu nomo bin peiyimbek yu pipul olabat blanga olabat nogudbalawei, en yubin meigim olabat fri.
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

kriol: wal yumob lafta werrimon sekbeigwan klos, en kraikraibat, dumaji mi stil wail langa yumob.
english: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn't turned back from us.

kriol: afta na deibin pikimat sambala men en det king bin jandim olabat garram dubala bagi blanga faindat wanim bin hepin langa detlot siriya ami.
english: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, "Go and see."

kriol: wal ailibala neksdei na deibid en im solja olabat bin fait langa detlot amalekait pipul raidap sangodan, en deibin kilim olabat ded. oni 400 yangmen bin gidawei brom olabat garram olabat kemul.
english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

kriol: "wen detlot laiyan jidan hanggriwan yu go en album olabat hanting blanga olabat daga?

english: Yahweh said to him, "Who made man's mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn't it I, Yahweh?

english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

english: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

english: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

english: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.

english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

english: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king's sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, 'Long live King Adonijah!'

kriol: ai garra gibit dijan taun langa king nebakanesa brom bebalon, en im amimob. olabat garra teikoba det taun,
english: Therefore Yahweh says: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

english: But she answered him, "Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs."

english: "To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: "The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

english: Now therefore listen to Yahweh's word: 'You say, Don't prophesy against Israel, and don't preach against the house of Isaac.'

kriol: en dubala bin luk im. bat dubala nomo bin sabi hu im.

english: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them."

english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;

english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

kriol: en imbin taiyimap main dubala fut en im wotjimbat mi na.'
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.'

english: "For I, Yahweh, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

english: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

english: I pray for them. I don't pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

english: He said, "I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock."

kriol: wal deibin pikimat faibala gudbala men brom det klen deya langa det dubala taun gulum sora en eshtayol, en deibin jandim olabat blanga lukabat gudwan pleis blanga jidan, en wen deibin kamat langa det hil kantri gulum ifreiyim, deibin jidan deya langa det haus blanga maika,
english: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, "Go, explore the land!" They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.

kriol: wal bilded bin kipgon tok, "blanga wi grengrenfathamob bin brabli klebabala. wal yu garra len brom olabat.
english: "Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim dubala, "det rait taim bin kaman na weya god garra shoum ola pipul mi na det speshalwan men en mi brabli haibala." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: Jesus answered them, "The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

kriol: if im hasbin nomo larram det gel kipum det pramis wen im irrim, wal det gel kaan dum. yawei garra larramgo im fri, dumaji im hasbin nomo bin larram im kipum det pramis.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.

kriol: en imbin luk jisas wokwok deya, en imbin dalim det dubala wekinmen blanga im, "deya na det yangwan ship blanga god."
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God!"

kriol: detlot brabli nogudbala pipul oldei ranawei dumaji dei bradin nomeda nobodi nomo ranimbat olabat, bat detlot gudbala pipul jidan brabli strongbalawei, wulijim laiyan.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

kriol: album melabat yawei! ola gudwan pipul ol gon na. tudei yu kaan faindim pipul lagijat enimo hu jidan trubalawei.
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

kriol: "trubala ai dalim yumob. wen det taim garra kaman weya god garra jadjim ebribodi, ebri nogudbala wed weya yumob bin tok eniwei, yumob garra dalim god wotfo yumob bin tok detlot wed.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

kriol: imbin tok langa mi, "det wed bin abum pawa blanga panishim pipul. god bin pramis blanga panishim pipul langa ola kantri. wansaid det wed dalim pipul, 'ebribodi hu stilim enijing, wal god garra jandimwei im brom im kantri.' det wed najasaid dalim pipul, ebribodi hu tok, 'trubala ai dalim yu,' bat im dalimbat laiya, wal god garra jandimwei im brom im kantri du."
english: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

kriol: mi na yawei hubin bringimap yumob brom ijip, dumaji mi na blanga yumob god. yumob garra jidan holiwan, dumaji mi na holiwan.
english: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

kriol: det binji blanga im, im brabli rafwan. im oldei breigim det wetwan graun wulijim aiyan wen im meigim mak brom wen im wokwokbat.
english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

kriol: en laswan na reitjul en im lilboi josef bin kaman, en dubala bin nildan langa graun lagijat du.
english: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

kriol: ai preisim yu, yawei, blanga shoumbat mi det wei. nomeda weya det naitaim im brabli dakbala, mi oldei jinggabat wanim yu wed tok.
english: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

kriol: yubin gibit detlot hosis det brabli strongbala pawa, en longwan heya langa olabat nek?
english: "Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

kriol: deibin tok, "trubala det bos bin gidap! imbin shoum miselp langa saiman!"
english: saying, "The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"

kriol: wal yawei, yu na det trubala god, en yu oldei lukaftumbat mi en seibum mi brom main enami olabat. yu na bin oldei album mi en meigim mi haibala,
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

kriol: brom deya jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin gowei brom jeriko, en loda pipul bin bulurrum olabat.
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

kriol: en wen wi oldei jinggabat detmatj, wi wandim det haus brom hebin. nomo dijan tent brom dijan wel. yumob sabi? wi wandim god garra gibit wi det nyubala olagijawan bodi, en im garra meigim wi werrimon det nyubala bodi jis laik wi werrimon nyubala klos.
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

kriol: "en najawan ting du. yu sabi wanim joweb bin dum. imbin kilim det dubala boswan blanga ola isreil solja. det dubala men bin ebna det san blanga nera, en amasa det san blanga jetha. yu sabi hau deibin kilim det braja blanga joweb en sambala pipul langa wo. wal afta na wen wibin ol jidan gudbalawei na joweb bin kaman en kilim det dubala blanga peiyimbek, bat dei nomo bin dum enijing rong, en blanga tharran na mi oldei abumbat loda trabul, dumaji im na bin meigim ebrijing rong blanga mi.
english: "Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.

kriol: mi na det speshalwan men, en ai garra dai, dumaji god bin meigim det plen blanga mi. bat im garra brabli nogud blanga det men hu garra hendimoba mi langa detlot pipul blanga kilim mi ded."
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!"

kriol: wal wan yangmen neim yutikas bin deya, en imbin jidan langa det windo, en wen pol bin kipgon toktok langa olabat, yutikas bin silip na, en afta imbin buldan atsaid langa graun. wal wen deibin godan blanga gajim im, deibin faindim im ded, dumaji det haus bin brabli haiwan.
english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

kriol: yumob dalimbat najalot pipul nomo blanga silip garram enibodi hasbin o waif. bat yumob oldei silipsilip garram enibodi. en nomeda yumob heidim ola drimin sheip seimwei laik god heidim olabat, bat stil yumob oldei go en gedimbat enijing brom detlot seikridwan pleis blanga ola drimin.
english: You who say a man shouldn't commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

kriol: wal longtaim wen yawei det trubala god bin meigim ebrijing, dijan wel bin jidan nomo garram tri en nomo garram gras en nomo garram purdiflawa. det graun bin jidan lagijat dumaji god nomo bin jandim eni rein langa dijan wel, en nobodi bin jidan langa dijan wel blanga wekim ola graun.
english: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

kriol: en langa oltestaman king deibid bin tok, "ai wandim god garra jadimap det wei blanga olabat jis laiga enimul langa trepyad. en ai wandim det wei blanga olabat garra meigim god panishim olabat.
english: David says, "Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

kriol: en langa roud deibin askim miselp, "hu garra pushumwei det bigwan ston brom det dowa?"
english: They were saying among themselves, "Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?"

kriol: wal eibrahem bin kipgon tok, "maitbi 40 gudbala pipul jidan deya." en yawei bin tok, "wal ai kaan binijimap det taun if 40 gudbala pipul jidan deya."
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, "What if there are forty found there?" He said, "I will not do it for the forty's sake."

kriol: wal deibin tok langa im, "yu garra dalim olabat, 'main lilwan bingga im mowa strongwan langa main dedi!
english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, "Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, 'Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us'—tell them, 'My little finger is thicker than my father's waist.

kriol: wal semsan bin go garram im dedi en mami langa det taun weya det gel bin jidan, en wen deibin wokpas langa wanbala fam, imbin irrim yangwan laiyan bin jingatbat,
english: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and his mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah; and behold, a young lion roared at him.

kriol: en langa oltestaman im tok, "ol yumob jintail pipul, yumob garra preisim det bos blanga wi. ola pipul ebriweya garra preisim im."
english: Again, "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him."

kriol: im garra jidan brabli gudbinjiwan dumaji im dum wanim yawei wandim. im kaan jadjimbat pipul rongwei, en im kaan teiknodis langa enibodi hu oldei meigimbat stori.
english: His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

kriol: wal ifreiyim bin abum najawan san neim refa, en det femili lain weya bin kamat brom refa bin reshef, tela, teihan, leidan, amihad, ilaishama, nan en joshuwa.
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

kriol: afta tharran king nebakanesa bin pokimat det ai dubala blanga king sedakaiya en imbin jidan blainwan en deibin taiyimap im garram tjein, en jandim im langa bebalon. king sedakaiya bin jidanbat langa jeil langa bebalon raidap imbin dai.
english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

kriol: en wen yumob bin joinap garram im, imbin gibit yumob ebrijing blanga jidan raitwei garram im, en im na haibala bos langa ola spirit en dibuldibul en pawa ebriweya langa dijan wel.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

kriol: wal ebribodi bin brabli gudbinji blanga tharran. detlot pipul langa juda, en detlot serramonimen, en detlot libai pipul, en detlot najalot pipul weya deibin kaman brom nowathsaid, en detlot najalot pipul brom najalot kantri hubin jidan langa isreil en juda olataim, olabat na bin brabli gudbinji.
english: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

kriol: olabat bin pudum det nogudbala drimin sheip blanga olabat insaid langa det serramoni pleis weya olabat bin bildimap blanga weshipbat mi en olabat bin meigim det pleis nogudwan.
english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

kriol: langa jerusalem dei garra toktok blanga im neim, en deya na dei garra preisimbat im,
english: that men may declare Yahweh's name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

kriol: bos, ai nomo wandim enijing mowa na. ai libum ebrijing langa yu.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

kriol: kambek yumob pipul hu jidan prisana. yumob gin gudbinji blanga wanim garra hepin na. kambek langa yumob kantri weya yumob garra jidan seif. aibin panishim yumob en yumob bin abum adtaim, bat ai dalim yumob na, ai garra kain langa yumob en ai garra gibit yumob mowa gudbala ting jis laik det dediwan hu gibit im feswan san detmatj enijing.
english: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

kriol: ai garra deigim olabat blanga gitkil, jis laik detlot lilwan ship en nenigout en boiwan ship." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

kriol: det dubala kantri gulum giliyad en manesa blanga main. det kantri ifreiyim jidan wulijim main speshalwan het, en det kantri juda im jidan wulijim main seikridwan stik.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

kriol: wal dijan na detlot neim blanga ol detlot men hubin lukaftumbat detlot klen blanga isreil. eliyeisa det san blanga sikri bin boswan lida blanga det rubin klen. shefataiya det san blanga meiyaka bin boswan lida blanga det simiyan klen. hashabaiya det san blanga kemyuwel bin boswan lida blanga det libai klen. seidok bin boswan lida blanga det eran femili. ilaihu bin wanbala braja blanga king deibid. imbin boswan lida blanga det juda klen. omri det san blanga maikul bin boswan lida blanga det isaka klen. ishmaiya det san blanga obadaiya bin boswan lida blanga det sebyulan klen. jeramath det san blanga esriyel bin boswan lida blanga det neftali klen. hosheiya det san blanga esasaiya bin boswan lida blanga det ifreiyim klen. jowal det san blanga pedaiya bin boswan lida blanga det sangodanwei manesa klen. ido det san blanga sekaraiya bin boswan lida blanga det sanraiswei manesa klen. jasiyel det san blanga ebna bin boswan lida blanga det benjamin klen. esarel det san blanga jeroham bin boswan lida blanga det den klen.
english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

kriol: "wal yawei garra gibit yumob det kantri weya imbin pramisim langa wi grengrenfathamob.
english: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

kriol: det sebenbala skiniwan buligi weya bin kamat biyain langa detlot fetwan buligi, en detlot lilwan daga weya bin jidan draiwan brom det deset win, wal olabat tok sebenbala yiya garra jidan brabli draiwan nomo garram eni daga.
english: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

kriol: yu si? nobodi kaan tok imbin beptais garram main neim, dumaji ai nomo bin beptaisim enibodi.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

kriol: wal basdam det king brom ijip bin binijimap det taun gulum gisa, en imbin teikoba en kilim ola pipul deya en imbin barnimap det taun. en afta wen im doda bin merrit langa king salaman imbin gibit det taun presen langa im,
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon's wife.

kriol: yu si? det seimwan holi spirit oldei gibit ol detlot difrinwan pawa langa difrin pipul. im na oldei pikimat hu garra gedim wujan pawa, en im na oldei meigim det pawa wek.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

kriol: preisim yawei, ola solwoda langa dijan wel, en ola bigwan enimul en ebrijing weya jidan raitdan langa bodam langa solwoda.
english: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

kriol: ola pipul preisim god! larram ola pipul ebriweya preisim yu brabliwei.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kriol: detlot pipul hu oldei jidan nogudbala, maitbi reken dei gin jinginat langa god blanga album olabat, bat najing.
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

kriol: wal king deibid bin duwit langa yawei, en imbin dum wanim ged bin dalim im blanga dum,
english: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Yahweh commanded.

kriol: if yu gedim najawan waif, yu kaan fogedabat yu feswan waif. yu garra kipgon gibitbat im daga en klos, en yu garra larram im silip garram yu.
english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

kriol: aibin kraikraibat jis laik det lilwan bard, en aibin jinginat sedwei jis laik dab. blanga main dubala ai brabli redwan brom lukinatbat blanga yu yawei. mi ardimbat nomo lilbit. yu kaman en album mi.
english: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security."

kriol: king josaiya bin deigimat ola stonwan hosis sheip brom det opin pleis blanga det serramoni pleis weya ola king blanga juda bin yusumbat blanga weshipbat det san. en imbin barnimap ol detlot bagi weya deibin oldei yusumbat blanga weshipbat det san du. detlot ebrijing na deibin oldei kipum langa det opin pleis blanga det serramoni pleis nomo longwei brom det haus blanga det boswan wekinmen neim neithanmelak gulijap langa det geit.
english: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of Yahweh's house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

kriol: en deibin ol kadim tri, en deibin garrimap det wud, en deibin bulurrum im raidap langa det seikridwan pleis, en deya na deibin pailimap ola wud raidaran langa det haus weya detlot boswan bin blandim miselp, en afta deibin meigim faiya, en det faiya bin barnimap ol detlot pipul deya insaid langa det haus, en deibin ol dai. det namba blanga detlot pipul hubin dai deya bin 1,000 men en wuman.
english: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

kriol: wal wen detlot wekinmen bin irrim jisas tok lagijat, deibin brabli hatjamp, en deibin tok, "if im adbala lagijat, wal nobodi kaan go langa hebin! god kaan seibum enibodi!"
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, "Then who can be saved?"

kriol: prayer lagijat na mi oldei prei blanga yumob, "dedi god, yu meigim ol detlot pipul toktok olataim blanga jisas krais, en yu growimap olabat en meigim olabat sabi brabliwei ola gudbala ting weya yu oldei gibit olabat." lagijat na mi oldei prei blanga yumob.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

kriol: en deibin oldei askimbat im olkain ting, dumaji deibin wandi trikim im en irrim im tok rongwei.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

kriol: wal tobaiya brom det kantri gulum eman bin jandap wansaid langa sanbalat en imbin tok, "wotkain wol dei garra bildimap? maitbi wanbala lilwan dog gin nokamdan det wol."
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, "What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall."

kriol: wal wen jisas bin tok dei garra lidimap im, imbin tok blanga det kros weya im garra dai.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kriol: ai larram detlot hu nomo laigim mi hitim mi langa main bekboun, en pulumbat main wiska. ai nomo bin gibit olabat bekboun wen olabat bin tok nogudbalawei langa mi en spit langa main feis.
english: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn't hide my face from shame and spitting.

kriol: lagijat na god bin tok en blanga tharran na, wi garra meigim miselp strongbala blanga tok, "det bos na oldei albumbat mi. ai kaan bradin blanga enibodi, dumaji nobodi kaan dum enijing langa mi." lagijat na wi garra tok.
english: So that with good courage we say, "The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?"

kriol: "wal iya na det king weya yumob bin pikimat. yumob bin askim mi blanga im, en yawei bin gibit im langa yumob blanga jidan bos.
english: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen and whom you have asked for. Behold, Yahweh has set a king over you.

kriol: yawei, kaman en jidan deya langa yu serramoni pleis garram det seikridwan boks, weya pipul sabi yu pawa oldei jidan.
english: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

kriol: "bat main pipul olabat, yumob bin nokap, bat nomo brom weshipbat langa mi.
english: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.

kriol: brom deya sambala serramonimen gulum ferasi en sambala lowamen bin kaman langa jisas brom jerusalem, en deibin askim im,
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

kriol: wal aibin kipgon tok, "wal dijan na det mesij weya yawei det trubala god bin gibit langa mi blanga detlot pipul brom det kantri gulum bebalon.
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

kriol: bifo det boswan garra kambek langa det brabliwan dei en abum det laswan kotkeis garram ebribodi, det san garra go dakbala en det mun garra go redwan jis laik blad,
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

kriol: yumob teiknodis en duwit langa ol detlot lowa na wulijim ebrijing gin jidan gudbalawei blanga yumob en wulijim yumob gin kipgon jidan langa det kantri weya yumob garra teikoba."
english: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

kriol: en wen detlot emanait solja bin luk detlot siriya solja bin ranawei, deibin ranawei du, en deibin gobek insaid langa det taun blanga olabat. en wen jowab bin luk detlot emanait solja bin gobek insaid langa det taun, imbin dalim ola isreil solja blanga libum olabat, en deibin ol gobek langa jerusalem.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

kriol: olabat jis laik detlot jigiwan dog weya dei oldei lukaranbat blanga daga, en if dei nomo faidim naf daga dei stat jinginatbat adbala.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren't satisfied.

kriol: "wal if yumob kaan lisin langa mi, god garra titjimbat yumob garram streinja pipul garram difrinwan langgus.
english: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,

kriol: wal ai wandi jidan garram yumob. bat mi nomo deya langa yumob. bat if ai bina deya, wal ai bina tok streidat langa yumob, dumaji mi wori brabli blanga yumob, en ai nomo sabi wanim blanga tok.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

kriol: wen pipul bin jidan sedwan aibin luk langa olabat hepiwei blanga meigim olabat fil gudwan, en ebribodi bin brabli gudbinji.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn't reject the light of my face.

kriol: wen sili pipul luk sambodi gedimbat panishmen dei len, bat sabibala pipul len wen sambodi titjimbat olabat.
