kriol: wal wen det king bin gedim det bednyus, imbin wandi kilim mosis. bat mosis bin ranawei langa det longwei kantri gulum midiyan, en wen imbin kamat langa det kantri, imbin jidan deya wansaid langa wan wel.
english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.

kriol: en yubin deigim detlot gudwan klos weya aibin gibit langa yu, en yubin meigim detlot drimin sheip werrimon detlot klos. en yubin yusumbat det gudsmelwan medisin en oliboil weya aibin gibit langa yu blanga gibit ofring langa detlot drimin sheip.
english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

kriol: wal mosis bin askim yawei na, "yu shoum miselp langa mi weya ai gin luk det brabli shainiwan lait blanga yu."
english: Moses said, "Please show me your glory."

kriol: nomeda imbin wikwan wen deibin kilim im ded deya langa det kros, bat stil imbin gidap laibala garram det pawa blanga god. en wen wi joinap garram im, wi jidan wikwan seimwei laik imbin jidan wikwan. bat wen mi dum det wek, mi dum det wek garram det pawa blanga god, dumaji mi jidan garram im.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

kriol: imbin pikimat wi blanga seibum wi thru langa jisas krais det bos blanga wi, dumaji jisas bin dai blanga wi blanga meigim wi jidan garram im. nomeda wi dai bifo im kambek, bat stil wi garra ol jidan garram im.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

kriol: bat wen king nebakanesa bin deigimoba melabat kantri, melabat bin jinggabat blanga kaman en jidan langa jerusalem. melabat bin ranawei brom detlot bebalon en siriya ami. blanga tharran na melabat jidanbat langa jerusalem na." lagijat na detlot reikebait pipul bin tok.
english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, 'Come! Let's go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we will dwell at Jerusalem.'"

kriol: det smok brom det faiya garra ardimbat olabat olagija, en det smok garra kipgon olagija. detlot pipul hu bulurrum det enimul en buldan langa det sheip blanga im, detlot pipul hu garram det namba bren blanga im neim langa olabat, ol detlot pipul na kaan abum spel brom det faiya. deitaim en naitaim dei garra kipgon barnbarn." lagijat na det namba 3 einjul bin tok.
english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

kriol: wal god garra panishim yu blanga tharran, en yu garra jidan blainwan. brom tudei na yu kaan luk det san raidap det taim wen god garra larram yu luk igin." wal streidawei wen pol bin tok lagijat, det klebabalamen bin filim im ai dubala go blainwan, en imbin wokaran eniwei blanga faindim sambodi blanga holdim im bingga.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!" Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

kriol: det graun welkam olabat hom, en bigismob pipul kraikraibat blanga olabat.
english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

kriol: lagijat imbin raidimdan det leda. imbin tok, "geshem bin dalim mi ola pipul langa najalot kantri tokabat yu en detlot juwish pipul, en imbin irrim olabat toktokbat. deibin tok yu garra tenim miselp en gibit bekboun langa det king. blanga tharran na yubin bildimap det wol igin. imbin tok yu wandim meigim miselp king,
english: in which was written, "It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

kriol: en wi sabi nomeda det boswan dibuldibul jidan bos blanga dijan wel, bat stil im nomo bos blanga wi, dumaji wi jidan biginini blanga god.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

kriol: wal detlot king bin deigim sebenbala nyuwan string langa det gel, en imbin taiyimap semsan garram detlot string.
english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

kriol: aibin tok, "king jehoiyakin jidan jis laik det breikinwan botul weya olabat tjakidawei, en nobodi nomo wandim yusum im enimo. blanga tharran na, im en im bigininimob garra go langa najawan pleis langa det kantri weya olabat nomo sabi.
english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? Is he a vessel in which no one delights? Why are they cast out, he and his offspring, and cast into a land which they don't know?

kriol: imbin meigim im jidan boswan blanga ol im gabman pipul, en imbin meigim im bos blanga ola kantri,
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

kriol: wal melabat god im tok, "main pipul olabat, nomo jidan soribala. yumob garra jidan gudbinjiwei na.
english: "Comfort, comfort my people," says your God.

kriol: en imbin pudum 3,300 boswan blanga detlot wekinmen blanga dalimbat olabat wanim wek dei garra dumbat.
english: besides Solomon's chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

kriol: wal det gel bin go en tok langa im mami, en afta imbin askim herod, "ai wandim det hed blanga jon beptis langa pleit, en yu garra gibit det hed langa mi iya na."
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, "Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer."

kriol: wen yu tok trubalawan wed blanga enijing, yu meigim ebrijing jidan gudwei, bat wen yu dalimbat laiyawan wed, yu meigim ebrijing go nogudwan.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

kriol: afta na jeikob bin dalim josef, "yu gitredi na, dumaji ai wandim yu blanga go langa shekam en luk ola braja blanga yu." en josef bin tok, "mi redi na, dedi."
english: Israel said to Joseph, "Aren't your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them." He said to him, "Here I am."

kriol: yumob na bin kilim bigismob enami, dumaji yawei det trubala god bin gibit yumob pawa blanga kilim ded det dubala midiyan bos neim oreb en sib. ai nomo bin dum enijing lagijat laik yumob." wal wen gidiyan bin tok lagijat langa olabat, dei nomo bin wail langa im na.
english: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?" Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.

kriol: det san blanga det wekingel bin bon eniwei. bat det san blanga det friwan gel bin bon dumaji god bin meigim pramis langa eibrahem blanga gibit im det san.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

kriol: en det men bin shoum olabat, en afta ola solja brom det dubala klen bin gowin langa det taun, en deibin kilim ebribodi ded. bat dei nomo bin kilim det men hubin shoum olabat. en dei nomo bin kilim im femili du,
english: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.

kriol: wal blanga det femili grup blanga geshan deya bin det dubala femili gulum libnai en shimiyai.
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

kriol: bat yu garra wotjimbat miselp en nomo larram ola enijing deigimwei yu brom god.
english: Don't let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

kriol: wen aibin abum det trabul, ol detlot pipul bin oldei trai en gajulum mi. bat yawei det trubala god bin oldei maindimbat mi.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

kriol: en afta deibin shoum ola isreil pipul detlot daga, en detlot isreil pipul bin gajim det daga, en deibin luk, en deibin reken trubala detlot pipul bin kaman brom longwei kantri. bat dei nomo bin jinggabat blanga askim yawei det trubala god blanga det ting.
english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn't ask counsel from Yahweh's mouth.

kriol: detlot pipul hu oldei jinggabat gudwei meigim gudbala ting hepin trubala, bat god garra binijimap detlot nogudbala pipul, dumaji olabat oldei meigimbat plen blanga dum ola nogudwan ting.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

kriol: en imbin dalim mi, 'ai garra gibit yu bigmob biginini olabat, en ola biginini blanga olabat garra jidan bigismob traib. en ai garra gibit dijan kantri langa ola biginini blanga yu olagija.' lagijat na god bin tok langa mi.
english: and said to me, 'Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.'

kriol: yawei garra tjakidawei yumob brom dijan kantri, en im garra bitsimap yumob raidap nobodi kaan jidan iya. lagijat na yawei bin dalim mi blanga tok."
english: For Yahweh says, "Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it."

kriol: bat maitbi yawei garra luk mi brabli nogudbinji, en bambai im garra jinggabat mi, en im garra gudbala langa mi en deigidawei ol dislot nogudbala wed." lagijat na king deibid bin tok.
english: It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me today."

kriol: bat wen det bout bin redi blanga gowei, pol bin wandi kipgon, en ol detlot bilibamob garram olabat waif en biginini olabat bin deigim melabat langa det jeti, en deya melabat bin ol nildan, en melabat bin abum preya,
english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

kriol: wal beilam bin ensim im, "king beilak brom moweb bin jandim olabat blanga dalim mi
english: Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

kriol: wal nobodi bin luk god. oni det ronwan san blanga im bin luk im, dumaji det san na god, en im jidan wansaid langa im dedi, en imbin shoum wi hu god.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok, "yumob go lida langa det taun, en deya na yumob garra faindim wan olmen, en yumob garra dalim im, 'det titja bin tok det taim blanga im bin kaman na, en im wandi abum det pasoba serramoni sapa garram im wekinmen olabat langa yu haus.'"
english: He said, "Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, 'The Teacher says, "My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples."'"

kriol: nomeda loda pipul wansaid langa yu mait dai, en bigmob pipul mait binij raidaran langa yu, bat nomo enijing kaan ardim yu.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

kriol: wal iya na ola najalot solja brom detlot 30 solja. esahel det braja blanga jowab, elanan det san blanga dodo brom det taun gulum bethlahem,
english: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

kriol: wal jehoiyada det serramonimen en king jowesh en detlot pipul bin meigim brabli strongbala pramis langa yawei blanga jidan im ronwan pipul olabat.
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be Yahweh's people.

kriol: dijan kantri bin gajimap det taun gulum eroya, gulijap langa det riba gulum anan en raidap langa nowathwei langa det hil gulum siriyon, det naja neim bin heman,
english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Zion (also called Hermon),

kriol: bat aibin irrim yu weya yubin tok blanga ishmeil, en ai garra gudbinji langa im en gibit im bigismob biginini du, en im garra jidan dediwan blanga twelbala king, en olabat garra abum bigmob biginini du, en ai garra meigim olabat bigiswan traib.
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

kriol: en wi garra gedim ol detlot gudbala ting weya god garram blanga im femili olabat, dumaji wi jidan biginini blanga god. en wi garra gedim ol detlot gudbala ting mijamet garram jisas krais, dumaji wen wi go thru langa det trabul jis laik weya imbin abum, wal wi garra jidan mijamet garram im deya langa det brabli shainiwan lait blanga im.
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

kriol: mi oldei prei blanga det naitaim garra binij, bat im jidan longwan en mi oldei tenimranbat miselp olnait.
english: When I lie down, I say, 'When will I arise, and the night be gone?' I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

kriol: "yawei, yu na det trubala god, en ai stil wandim yu blanga album mi.
english: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.

kriol: wal yu garra baku det daga weya yubin dagat en yu garra weistim ol yu kainwan wed.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

kriol: wal jehoiyada nomo bin wandi kilim ethalaiya deya insaid langa det serramoni pleis en imbin dalim ola boswan solja, "deigim im atsaid deya langa midul langa detlot men en kilim ded enibodi hu trai blanga seibum im."
english: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, "Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword." For the priest said, "Don't let her be slain in Yahweh's house."

kriol: "detlot pipul brom najawan kantri hu jidan langa det kantri blanga yumob, dei garra abum mowa pawa en yumob garra lujim yumob pawa en dei garra jidan bos blanga yumob.
english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

kriol: brom deya joshuwa bin dalim ol detlot isreil pipul blanga gobek langa olabat ronwan kantri, en deibin ol gobek en jidanbat langa olabat ronwan kantri.
english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

kriol: imbin abum bigwan haibala wol raidaran langa im garram 12 geit, en deibin abum 12 einjul maindimbat detlot geit. langa ebri geit deibin abum neim blanga detlot 12 klen blanga isreil.
english: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

kriol: yumob garra gibit rispek langa yawei det trubala god blanga wi, en oni langa im. yumob garra weship im en wen yumob meigim pramis, meigim det pramis oni langa im neim.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

kriol: lagijat na god garra dum. dumaji wen yu ron san askim yu blanga daga, wanim yu gibit im? yu gibit im ston? nomo! yu gibit im det daga.
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

kriol: aibin jandim im langa herod, en imbin tok langa im, en im nomo bin faindim eni rong langa im du, en imbin lafta jandimbek im langa mi na. "wal jisas nomo bin dum eni rong. ai kaan faindim eni risan blanga kilim im.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

kriol: en god bin gulum det draiwan pat graun, en imbin gulum det woda weya bin hipimap miselp langa wan pleis solwoda. en wen god bin luk ebrijing bin gudwan, imbin gudbinji.
english: God called the dry land "earth", and the gathering together of the waters he called "seas". God saw that it was good.

kriol: eni sabibala men kaan deigim silibala men langa kot. im kaan win. det silibala men garra oni laf langa im en meigimbat mowa trabul.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

kriol: lagijat na yumob garra dum. ebri sandei ebribodi garra pudum wansaid sambala mani. detlot pipul hu gedim bigmob mani garra pudum wansaid bigmob mani. en detlot pipul hu gedim lilbit mani garra pudum wansaid lilbit mani. en yumob garra hipimap ol detlot mani redi, dumaji ai nomo wandim yumob garra meigimap det mani wen ai garra kaman deya. det mani garra weit blanga mi deya redi.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

kriol: wal yu garra lafta dalim main pipul olabat hu nomo teiknodis langa mi. yu garra dalim olabat dijan stori blanga shoum olabat wanim mi toktokbat. dei garra bilimap woda langa det bigwan sospen en dei garra pudum ontop langa det faiya.
english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, 'The Lord Yahweh says, "Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.

kriol: longtaim langa oltestaman det speshalwan mesinja blanga god neim hebakak bin tok, 'ol yumob pipul hu oldei meigim fan langa det wed blanga god, yumob garra jinggabat na, dumaji yumob garra ol dai. wal yumob garra dai, dumaji yumob kaan bilib wanim god garra dum tudei. nomeda sambodi dalim yumob blanga det ting, bat stil yumob kaan bilib.' lagijat na det mesinja bin tok. en yumob tudei garra wotjim miselp en nomo larram det ting hepin langa yumob du." lagijat na pol bin tok langa detlot pipul langa det juwish miting pleis.
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

kriol: wal det faiya im barnbarn brabli hotwan, bat det rabishpat blanga det kopa en aiyan im nomo kamat. lagijat du wen mi testimbat main pipul olabat, dei neba tjeinj brom olabat nogudbalawei.
english: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.

kriol: wen dubala bin kamat deya jeihu bin kilim ded ola femili blanga king eiheb. deibin dai holot. dumaji yawei bin dalim ilaija dijan garra hepin.
english: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to Yahweh's word which he spoke to Elijah.

kriol: en det dei garra jidan jis laik weya det wanbala men im trai ranawei brom det laiyan en im midim det najawan jigiwan enimul gulum beya. en im jis laik det men hu gobek langa im kemp weya im reken im seif, bat najing, det brabli jigiwan sneik baidim im wen im pudum im bingga langa det wol.
english: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

kriol: en langa oltestaman im tok, "ol yumob jintail pipul, yumob garra gibit theingks langa god garram im pipul olabat."
english: Again he says, "Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people."

kriol: wal langa det namba 27 yiya wen jerabowam namba 2 bin jidan det king blanga isreil, yusaiya, det san blanga amasaiya bin jidan det nyuwan king blanga juda.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

kriol: yawei, yubin gibit melabat ola lowa, en yubin dalim melabat blanga teiknodis langa olabat trubalawei.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

kriol: bat det speshalwan mesinja bin tok, "nomeda yu gibit mi haf ola enijing blanga yu, bat stil ai kaan go en dagat o dringgim enijing garram yu.
english: The man of God said to the king, "Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

kriol: wal king deibid bin wandim majurrumap ola isreil lidamob en ola serramonimen en ola men brom det libai klen du.
english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

kriol: detlot nogudbala pipul oldei meigimbat plen blanga ardimbat pipul, en detlot nogud wed weya dei oldei toktokbat, dei barnbarnbat jis laik faiya.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

kriol: wal king sol bin tok, "deibid, aibin dum nogudbala ting langa yu. bat ai kaan dum enijing langa yu na, dumaji yu bina kilim mi tudei. bat yu nomo bin duwit. mi brabli granggibala, en aibin dum brabli nogudbala ting. wal main lambarra, yu lafta kambek na."
english: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly."

kriol: en deibid bin sabi na wanim god garra dum, en blanga tharran na imbin tok langa det saam blanga det boswan gulum masaiya. deibid bin tok, 'god nomo bin libum im deya garram ola dedbala pipul. im nomo bin larram im bodi go nogudwan deya insaid langa det greibyad.' deibid bin tok blanga det masaiya weya im garra gidap laibala brom det greibyad.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn't left in Hades, and his flesh didn't see decay.

kriol: wal yumob main ronwan pipul. wotfo yumob bin gibit mi bekboun? yumob nomo kambek langa mi, dumaji yumob heingbek blanga kipum ola drimin sheip, en yumob nomo wandi kambek langa mi.
english: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.

kriol: brom deya mosis bin tok langa yawei na, "yubin dalim mi blanga deigim dislot pipul langa det kantri. bat yu nomo bin dalim mi hu yu garra jandim blanga album mi. yubin dalim mi yu sabi mi brabli, en yu gudbinji langa mi.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, "Behold, you tell me, 'Bring up this people;' and you haven't let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, 'I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.'

kriol: "wal job, yu garra dalim god yubin dum nogudbala ting.
english: "For has any said to God, 'I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

kriol: en if yu larramgo fri enibodi hu dumbat nogudbala ting langa yu, wal wi dedi langa hebin garra larramgo yu fri du.
english: "For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

kriol: wal detlot emanait pipul bin sabi na deibin meigim deibid jidan enami blanga olabat, en deibin go en gajim loda solja blanga album olabat fait langa deibid. deibin gajim 20,000 solja brom detlot siriya pipul, sambala brom det pleis gulum bethreiyob en sambala brom det kantri gulum soba. en deibin gajim 12,000 solja brom det kantri gulum tob. en det king blanga det kantri gulum meiyaka bin go garram 1,000 solja blanga album detlot emanait pipul.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok langa mosis, "wen yu meigim eran en im fobala san jidan serramonimen blanga mi, yu garra abum dijan serramoni na. yu garra gajim brabli gudwan yangwan bul en dubala brabli gudwan boiwan ship,
english: "This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest's office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

kriol: en wen god bin luk det lait bin gudwan, imbin gudbinji.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another's foundation.

english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

english: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

english: The people said to Samuel, "Who is he who said, 'Shall Saul reign over us?' Bring those men, that we may put them to death!"

english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

english: Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive."

english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

english: They said to him, "We have come down to bind you, that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines." Samson said to them, "Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves."

english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly."

english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

kriol: "wal yumob garra jidan wekinmen en wekingel blanga detlot enami na weya yawei garra jandim langa yumob, en yumob garra jidan brabli hanggribala en thestibala en neigidbala nomo garram enijing, en yawei garra panishim yumob brabli strongbalawei raidap yumob garra dai.
english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

kriol: en if jisas krais det bos blanga wi larram mi, wal ai garra kaman langa yumob dregli du.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

kriol: yumob pipul joinin garram mi en dalim yawei im haibala. wi garra preisim yawei mijamet.
english: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let's exalt his name together.

english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, "Truly this man was the Son of God!"

english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

english: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for Yahweh's mouth has spoken it."

english: They said, "If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don't bring us over the Jordan."

english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you."

kriol: en wen yu san askim yu blanga fish, wanim yu gibit im? yu gibit im jigiwan sneik? nomo! yu gibit im det fish.
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

kriol: wal obadaiya bin go langa king eiheb en imbin dalim im, en king eiheb bin go na blanga midim ilaija na.
english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

kriol: en wen det san larramgo det prisana fri, wal det prisana jidan fri brabliwei.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

kriol: jisas bin tok, "enibodi hu laigim mi garra duwit langa main wed, en main dedi garra laigim im, en mi en main dedi garra kaman langa im en jidan garram im.
english: Jesus answered him, "If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

kriol: wal pida bin tok, "ai mait dai garram yu. bat ai kaan tok mi nomo sabi yu." en detlot najalot wekinmen blanga jisas bin ol tok lagijat du.
english: Peter said to him, "Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you." All of the disciples also said likewise.

english: Or don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

english: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

kriol: afta na jisas bin gibit adbala wed langa detlot pipul hubin jidan langa detlot taun weya imbin dumbat loda klebabala ting, dumaji detlot pipul nomo bin tenim miselp brom det nogudbalawei blanga olabat.
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn't repent.

kriol: ebrijing weya jidan laibwan en ola pipul du jidan langa god bingga.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

kriol: wal wanim yumob reken? det lowa im meigim det pramis blanga god nogud? nomo. det lowa nomo meigim det pramis nogud, dumaji det lowa nomo garram eni pawa blanga gibit wi laif. if det lowa bin abum pawa blanga gibit laif, wal im bina meigim ol detlot pipul hubin bulurrum det lowa jidan raitwei langa god.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

kriol: wal yawei det trubala god bin tok na, "ol yumob isreil pipul, mi na yawei bin meigim yumob. yumob nomo bradin. mi na bin seibum yumob. mi na bin gulum yumob neim. yumob na main ronwan pipul olabat.
english: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: "Don't be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

english: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, 'It is my people;' and they will say, 'Yahweh is my God.'"

kriol: brom deya det wuman bin abum lilboi. bat sambodi bin deigidawei det lilboi kwikbala. deibin deigim det lilboi langa god deya weya im jidan langa det speshal boswan tjeya. deibin deigidawei det lilboi deya, dumaji im garra jidan bos blanga ebribodi langa ola kantri. im garra jidan admen. bat im garra maindim olabat gudwei.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Yahweh has said to you, "You shall not go back that way again."

english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

english: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?

english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

english: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don't know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever."

english: Elimelech, Naomi's husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.

english: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh's indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.

english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn't see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn't hear them."

english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.

english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

english: "'As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

kriol: ol detlot kantri en ol detlot taun weya deibin teikoba brom saihan det king blanga detlot emarait pipul en og det king blanga detlot beishan pipul mosis bin gibit langa detlot klen blanga ged en rubin en haf det klen blanga manesa.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

kriol: bat eliyeisa en im men nomo bin ranawei. deibin jandapbat deya gin, en deibin fait langa detlot filastain solja garram olabat bigwan naif, en yawei bin album olabat blanga win det fait.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.

kriol: "blanga 23 yiya, brom det namba 13 yiya wen josaiya det san blanga eman bin jidan king langa juda raidap langa dijan dei na, yawei bin tok langa mi, en ai nomo bin blandim enijing blanga dalim yumob wanim yawei bin dalimbat mi. bat yumob nomo bin teiknodis, najing.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh's word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

kriol: en deibin go langa det kemp weya deibin oldei jidanbat, en deibin gowap langa det rum blanga olabat. ol dislot men na bin deya, pida, jon, jeims, endru, filip, tamas, bathalamyu, methyu, jeims det san blanga elfiyas, saiman peitriyat, en judas det san blanga najawan jeims.
english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

kriol: yumob sabi na? wi garra oldei dumbat ebrijing brabliwei blanga meigim miselp jidan gudwei en blanga album miselp jidan strongbala.
english: So then, let's follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, "You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don't know.

kriol: bat if det men bin sabi det buligi blanga im bin oldei wandi rijimbat najalot buligi, en im nomo bin pudum det buligi langa pedik, wal im garra peiyim det najawan men blanga im dedwan buligi. im garra gibit im det laibwan buligi, en im garra abum det dedwan buligi.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

kriol: wal god bin meigim yumob im brabli ronwan biginini, en blanga tharran na yumob garra jidan seimwei laik im.
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

kriol: trubala aibin jidan nogudwan brom det taim wen aibin deya insaid langa main mami binji, en seimwei du aibin jidan nogudwan wen aibin bon.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

kriol: wal wandei det king blanga det kantri weya eibrahem bin jidan bin go langa eibrahem garram det boswan solja blanga im. det king bin neim abimalek, en det boswan solja bin neim faikol. wal det king bin dalim eibrahem, "aibin nodisim god oldei albumbat yu olataim blanga ebrijing weya yu dumbat.
english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, "God is with you in all that you do.

english: He said to them, "How many loaves do you have? Go see." When they knew, they said, "Five, and two fish."

english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

english: Don't incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don't let me eat of their delicacies.

english: "Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child's life are dead."

english: But he doesn't know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn't the sound of his master's feet behind him?"

english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

kriol: wal det kripulwan men bin tok, "bos, ai nomo garram enibodi iya blanga pudum mi langa det wodahol wen det woda im boilap, en wen mi oldei trai en go langa det woda, sambodi oldei deya bifo mi."
english: The sick man answered him, "Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I'm coming, another steps down before me."

kriol: en ol detlot tri en daga blanga yumob, detlot grashopa garra dagadagatbat.
english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

kriol: wen pailat bin irrim jisas tok lagijat, imbin trai en faindim wei blanga larramgo jisas fri. bat wen imbin gobek atsaid langa detlot pipul, deibin jingat langa im, "if enibodi reken miselp im king, wal im meigim miselp enami blanga sisa det king blanga dijan kantri. en if yu larramgo jisas fri, wal yu nomo fren blanga sisa det king blanga dijan kantri."
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, "If you release this man, you aren't Caesar's friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!"

kriol: wal det hasbin blanga im bin gitwail brabli,
english: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, "This is what your servant did to me," his wrath was kindled.

kriol: en det judas askeriyat im na det men hu garra gibitawei jisas bambai langa detlot pipul hu garra kilim im.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

kriol: ola pipul langa dijan wel garra tok, 'wotfo yawei bin dum lagijat langa det kantri blanga olabat? wotfo imbin brabli wail langa olabat?'
english: Even all the nations will say, "Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?"

kriol: "wal yu nomo foget na. ai garra jidan garram yu ebriweya yu go, en afta ai garra bringimbek yu langa dijan kantri na. en ebrijing weya aibin pramis langa yu, ai garra duwit." lagijat na god bin tok langa det drim.
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you."

kriol: yumob sabi na? dijan na mi dalimbat yumob. yumob garra laigimbat gija."
english: "I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

kriol: en deibin tenaran en ran langa olabat.
english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

kriol: en joshuwa bin holdimap det spiya blanga im raidap ebribodi brom det taun bin dai. wal det dei na 12,000 men en wuman brom det taun bin dai.
english: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.

kriol: rem bin abum thribala san en deibin neim meis, jeimin en eka. en jeramiyel bin abum najawan waif en imbin neim etara. dubala bin abum san en imbin neim onam.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

kriol: im oldei jidan rait langa det dowawei langa im haus o ontop langa det brabli haibala pleis langa det taun,
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

kriol: wen nogudbala pipul meigim ebrijing rong, wanim ola gudwan pipul gin dum? najing!
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

kriol: langa sambala pipul det holi spirit gibit det pawa blanga dalim pipul wanim det wed blanga god im tok. en langa najalot pipul det holi spirit gibit det pawa blanga dalim pipul hau blanga dum wanim det wed blanga god dalim olabat blanga dum.
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

kriol: "en ol yumob enimul, yumob nomo bradin du, dumaji ola pedik garram grinwan gras na. en ola tri garram detmatj daga du.
english: Don't be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.

kriol: yumob sabi na? det lowa bin kaman brom god, en det lowa bin dalim wi wanim wi garra dum, en det lowa im gudwan.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

kriol: wal king manesa bin bildimbek ola nogudwan weship pleis blanga ola drimin weya im dedi king hesakaiya bin breigimap. en king manesa bin bildimap det weship pleis blanga weship det drimin gulum beil en imbin bildimap det stonwan sheip blanga det gelwan drimin gulum eshara, jis laik king eiheb brom isreil bin bildimap. king manesa bin weshipbat ola sta du.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

kriol: wal yawei bin tok langa eran, "wal yu jinggabat na. ai garra sherimat garram yu ol detlot speshalwan ofring weya main pipul olabat bin gibit langa mi, en weya nomo bin barn langa eni sekrifais. ai garra gibit olabat langa yu en langa yu bigininimob. im blanga yu olataim, det pat. "blanga detlot brabli seikridwan ofring weya main pipul olabat bin gibit langa mi, en weya nomo bin barn langa det teibul blanga ofring, olabat na blanga yu. det sid daga ofring, det nogudbalawei ofring blanga ola nogudbala ting ola pipul bin dumbat, en det peiyimbek ofring, en eni seikridwan ofring, olabat blanga yu en yu sanmob.
english: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, "Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

kriol: "mi na yawei det trubala god blanga olkain pipul. nomo enijing im adwan langa mi.
english: "Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

kriol: mosis bin tok langa det braja blanga im waif neim hobab hubin det san blanga jethro brom detlot midiyan pipul. imbin tok, "wi redi na blanga go langa det pleis weya yawei bin tok blanga gibit langa wi. imbin meigim det pramis blanga ola isreil pipul garra abum blendibala ebrijing. wal yu kaman garram melabat, en melabat garra sherimbat ebrijing langa yu."
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, "We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, 'I will give it to you.' Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel."

kriol: wal wandei ola wekinmen blanga jon bin agamin garram wanbala kantrimen blanga olabat blanga det lowa blanga washimbat miselp,
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification.

kriol: afta na det olmen bin tok langa im san olabat, "wen ai dai yumob garra berrim main bodi langa dijan seimwan greib wansaid langa im.
english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, "When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

kriol: olabat garra gajim loda pipul blanga stonim yu garram ston en olabat garra kadimap yu hafenhaf garram olabat bigwan naif.
english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

kriol: wotfo blanga yumob brabli haibala drimin neim apis bin buldan? yawei det trubala god bin kilim im en meigim im buldan.'
english: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn't stand, because Yahweh pushed them.

kriol: en yumob gin sabi ai gibit yumob dijan oda wulijim detlot serramonimen garra teiknodis langa main wed. dei garra teiknodis lagijat wulijim ai kaan binijimap det strongwan pramis aibin meigim garram detlot serramonimen, ol detlot biginini brom det femili lain blanga libai weya ol detlot serramonimen oldei kamat brom.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi," says Yahweh of Armies.

kriol: nobodi kaan tenawei brom yu olagija, dumaji ebribodi garra jinggabat yu. dei garra lukbek langa yu en weship langa yu. nobodi jidan brabli gudwan. oni yu na. en ola traib langa ebri kantri garra kaman langa yu, en dei garra baudan en tok gudwei langa yu, dumaji yu na bin dumbat ola gudwan wek, en ebribodi bin luk." lagijat na detlot pipul bin tok.
english: Who wouldn't fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed."

kriol: en garram holbit yumob filing yumob garra oldei wek adbalawei blanga jisas krais det bos blanga wi en nomo jidan leisibala.
english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

kriol: im gibit kemp langa pipul hu nomo garram femili, en meigim ola prisana jidan gudbinji en fri. bat pipul hu laigim faidabat garra jidan langa kantri weya nomo garram enijing.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

kriol: ai garra nokamdan dijan taun, wulijim enibodi hu garra gopas garra hatjamp en gedim shok.
english: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

kriol: maitbi yu reken yu dum ola raitwan ting, bat oni yawei sabi wanim yu oldei jinggabat blanga dum.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.

kriol: wal yawei bin kaman langa beilam en dalim im wanim im garra tok, en imbin jandimbek im langa beilak blanga gibit im det wed.
english: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and say this."

kriol: god blanga jeikob, wen yubin graulim olabat adbalawei, detlot hosis en ola men bin buldanbuldan ded.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

kriol: mi na bin pikimat im. aibin bringimap im brom longwei, en im garra dum det wek brabli gudwei.
english: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.

kriol: brom deya det namba 7 einjul bin spilimat im dish langa skai na, en streidawei sambodi bin jingat adbala brom det speshalwan tjeya langa det serramoni pleis langa hebin, "binij na!"
english: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, "It is done!"

kriol: yumob garra wotjimbat miselp en prei wulijim yumob kaan gobek langa det nogudbalawei. det hat blanga yumob wandi bulurrum det gudbalawei. bat det bodi blanga yumob im wikwan, en im wandi gobek langa det nogudbalawei."
english: Watch and pray, that you don't enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."

kriol: wal ola boswan wekinmen blanga im bin tok, "haibala king, melabat garra go en lukaran wan yanggel blanga jidan en maindimbat langa yu. en det gel garra leidan gulijap langa yu blanga meigim yu womwan."
english: Therefore his servants said to him, "Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm."

kriol: wal wen im taim blanga go langa det najawan pleis, det femili blanga kohath garra garrimap ol detlot seikridwan ting weya eran en im dubala san bin meigim redi en dei garra repdimap ol detlot ebrijing. det kohath grup nomo lau tatjim detlot seikridwan ting dumaji if olabat tatjim, wal olabat garra dai." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: "When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

kriol: wal elifas, bilded en sofara bin dum wanim yawei bin dalim olabat blanga dum, en imbin ensim det preya blanga job.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.

kriol: wal detlot haibala serramonimen bin majurrumap ola boswan olmen, en deibin askim miselp, "wanim wi garra dum na?" en deibin meigim olabat plen, en deibin gibit loda mani langa detlot solja,
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

kriol: brom deya jisas bin go lilbit longwei brom olabat, en deya na imbin nildan langa graun, en imbin prei langa god.
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

kriol: wal eisaf bin boswan blanga det sekan singamob. im femili lain bin gobek raitbek langa libai. olabat neim bin eisaf, berakaiya, shimiya, maikul, beiseiya, melkija, ithnai, sera, adaiya, ithan, sima, shimiyai, jeihath, geshan en libai.
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

kriol: en god bin jandim wanbala einjul langa jerusalem garram bigbala naif blanga binijimap ola pipul. bat bambai yawei bin nogudbinji, dumaji loda pipul bin olredi dai, en imbin jingat langa det einjul. imbin tok, "jaldu na! yubin naf kilim sambala!" wal wen yawei bin jingat langa det einjul lagijat, det einjul bin deya wansaid langa det pleis weya det jebusait men neim arauna bin oldei deigimatbat ola rabish brom ola sid daga.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, "It is enough. Now withdraw your hand." Yahweh's angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kriol: yu si? yumob kaan dum enijing langa dislot men. yumob garra libum olabat, dumaji if dei meigim olabat ron plen seimwei laik det dubala men bin meigim, wal wen olabat dai, ebrijing garra binij.
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

kriol: ol yumob pipul blanga yawei, yumob garra rispek langa im. wen enibodi rispek yawei, dei kaan jidan nomo garram enijing.
english: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

kriol: ai garra abum bigwan padi langa jerusalem garram ol main pipul olabat. nomo enibodi kaan kraikraibat en jidan sedwan enimo langa det taun.
english: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.

kriol: en im kaan jidan drangginwan, en im kaan faidabat langa pipul. im garra jidan kainwan en nomo agaminbat langa enibodi, en im kaan gridi blanga mani.
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

kriol: wal im garra lafta peiyim detlot weya im nomo bin gibit basdam, en im garra gibit im lilbit mowa. en im garra gibit langa det serramonimen, en det serramonimen garra gibit det enimul blanga abum det sekrifais ofring blanga im weya imbin dumbat nogudbala ting, en tharran na garra meigim im jidan fri.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

kriol: wal mosis bin kipgon tok, "wal wibin dum wanim yawei det trubala god blanga wi bin dalim wi strongbalawei. wibin libum det hil gulum sainai en wibin go thru langa det nogudwan deset kantri en wibin kamat langa det taun gulum keidishbaniya.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

kriol: en dei garra binijimap yumob holot langa dijan taun, en dei garra nokamdan ebri haus. lagijat na dei garra dum, dumaji yumob nomo bin sabi tudei na god bin wandi seibum yumob!"
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn't know the time of your visitation."

kriol: deibin tok, "det dedi blanga yu bin tridim melabat nogudwei en imbin meigim melabat dumbat ola adwek brabliwei. if yu meigim melabat wek oni lilbit en meigim melabat laif lilbit isiwan, wal melabat garra lisin en teiknodis langa yu." lagijat na detlot pipul bin tok.
english: "Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you."

kriol: "god bin gibit lowa langa mosis, en imbin gibit sambala wed langa ola speshalwan mesinja blanga im, en ol detlot ting na bigwan ting langa god. ol detlot lowa brom god bin kipgon raidap jon beptis bin kaman, en brom jon na melabat bin stat dalimbat det gudnyus blanga god, en loda pipul bin wandi bulurrum det nyubalawei blanga god.
english: "The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God's Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

kriol: olataim dei garra kaman en gugum det ofring lida langa det seikridwan tent weya ai garra jidan, dumaji deya na ai garra midim main pipul olabat en tok langa yu,
english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

kriol: "yu sabi? det bodi im faindim bodi, en det holi spirit faindim spirit.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

kriol: mi brabli nogudbinji en abumbat detmatj pein, dumaji dei kipgon askimbat mi, "weya yu god?"
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, "Where is your God?"

kriol: "wal yawei nomo laigim dislot sebenbala ting na, det sambodi hu oldei luk praudbalawei, det mawus blanga sambodi hu oldei dalimbat laiya, det bingga blanga sambodi hu oldei kilimbat pipul hu nomo bin dum eni rong ting, det main blanga sambodi hu oldei jinggabat blanga meigimbat nogudbala plen, det dubala fut blanga sambodi hu oldei wandim dum nogudbala ting kwikbala, det witnis hu kipgon dalimbat laiya, en det sambodi hu meigimbat trabul blanga im femili o fren olabat."
english: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

kriol: wal det bos blanga wi bin dalim melabat dijan wed weya melabat dalimbat yumob. wen jisas garra kambek, ol detlot bilibamob hu stil jidan laibala iya langa graun kaan gowap lida bifo detlot bilibamob hubin dai.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

kriol: wal ai wandim dalim yumob hau det brabli haibala god bin dum brabli klebabala ting blanga mi.
english: It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked toward me.

kriol: yu garra pudum det teibul insaid langa det seikridwan tent weya ai garra kaman en tok langa yu. det teibul garra jidan atsaidwei brom det ketin weya im blandimbat det seikridwan boks garram det dubala ston garram ola lowa.
english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

kriol: det men weya im kaman langa mi en im irrim main wed en im duwit langa det wed, wal ai garra shoum yumob wotkain men im.
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

kriol: wal detlot pipul bin irrim jisas wen imbin tok lagijat langa det shotwan men, en deibin reken god garra meigim im jidan king dregli, dumaji imbin gulijap langa jerusalem. wal jisas bin dalim olabat dijan stori.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God's Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

kriol: langa det taim na aibin jandap deya hafwei langa yumob en yawei, blanga dalim yumob wanim imbin tok langa mi, dumaji yumob bin bradin blanga det faiya en yumob nomo bin wandi go ontop langa det bigwan hil. "wal yawei bin tok,
english: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh's word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn't go up onto the mountain) saying,

kriol: en jisas bin askim detlot wekinmen blanga im, "blanga wanim yumob bin toktok langa detlot lowamen?"
english: He asked the scribes, "What are you asking them?"

kriol: wal blanga tharran na aibin jinggabat blanga askimbat taidas en det dubala braja blanga wi blanga go lida langa mi en boksimap det mani redi blanga gibit weya yumob bin pramis blanga gibit. lagijat na yumob garra abum bigmob mani redi, en yumob garra gibit det mani yumob ronselp gudbinjiwei, dumaji wen ai garra kaman langa yumob, if yumob nomo abum det mani redi, wal ai garra fosim yumob blanga gibit det mani, en ai garra meigim yumob nogudbinji.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

kriol: brabli boswan god, meigim melabat strongbala igin! yu luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis en seibum melabat.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kriol: en im garra pudum det sid daga ofring mijamet langa det teibul blanga ofring. wal lagijat na det serramonimen garra abum det serramoni blanga meigim det men o gel fri, en im garra jidan klinbala blanga serramoni.
english: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

kriol: brom deya bethsheba bin go blanga tok langa det king langa im rum, dumaji imbin rili olmen na, en ebisheg, det gel brom shunam bin maindimbat im.
english: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

kriol: wal shekam bin go langa im dedi, en imbin dalim im, "dedi, yu gedim det gel blanga mi, dumaji ai wandim im blanga main waif."
english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, "Get me this young lady as a wife."

kriol: ebribodi bin brabli gudbinji dumaji deibin meigim det brabli strongbala pramis na. deibin lukabat yawei en deibin faindim im en brom deya yawei bin larram olabat jidan gudbalawei nomo garram eni trabul brom ola enamimob.
english: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then Yahweh gave them rest all around.

kriol: im rait blanga gibit ebribodi feyago, bat sambala pipul dum rong ting jis blanga gajim lilwan damba.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

kriol: im garra garrimap det ofring garram im ronwan bingga. im garra bringimap ol detlot fetpat blanga det enimul en im briskit en im garra meigim tharran speshalwan ofring langa mi.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

kriol: afta na det serramonimen blanga det drimin neim sus bin go, en imbin gajim sambala buligi en purdiflawa brom det serramoni pleis atsaid langa det taun, en imbin bringimap detlot buligi en purdiflawa, dumaji deibin wandi abum sekrifais serramoni blanga det dubala speshalwan mishanri deya langa det geit blanga det taun.
english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

kriol: yawei det boswan god kipgon tok, "wen yumob grengrenfatha olabat bin meigim mi wail aibin meigim plen blanga dum loda brabli nogud ting langa olabat. en aibin dum detlot nogud ting, ai nomo bin sori blanga detlot pipul.
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: "As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath," says Yahweh of Armies, "and I didn't repent,
