english: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

kriol: bambai na wen jeikob bin kambek brom detlot pedik lilbit leitbala, liya bin go en imbin midim im hafwei, en imbin dalim im, "yu garra silip garram mi tunait, dumaji aibin pei blanga yu garram det bush medisin weya main boi bin faindim." wal jeikob bin silip garram liya,
english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, "You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son's mandrakes." He lay with her that night.

kriol: det speshalwan mesinja blanga god neim hoseiya bin tok, "detlot pipul hu nomo bin jidan main pipul, ai garra gulum olabat main pipul du. en detlot pipul weya ai nomo bin laigim, ai garra laigim olabat du." lagijat na god bin tok.
english: As he says also in Hosea, "I will call them 'my people,' which were not my people; and her 'beloved,' who was not beloved."

kriol: wal detlot serramonimen bin tok, "imbin deigim loda men 46 yiya blanga bildimbat dijan haus blanga god iya langa dijan serramoni pleis, en yu reken yu garra bildimap dijan haus thrideistaim?"
english: The Jews therefore said, "It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?"

kriol: wal king sol bin dalim im boswan wekinmen olabat, "yumob go en lukabat doktabala, en wen yumob faindim im, ai garra kaman en askimbat im blanga album mi." detlot wekinmen blanga king sol bin dalim im, "wanbala doktabala gel im blandimbat miselp deya langa det taun gulum endowa."
english: Then Saul said to his servants, "Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her." His servants said to him, "Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor."

kriol: en deibin gibit im taim blanga binij. bat wen deibin luk det dowa bin stil lok, deibin lafta gajim ki blanga opinim, en wen deibin opinim det dowa, deibin faindim olabat bos deya dedbala langa flo.
english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn't open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

kriol: en yawei garra tjeinjim yumob en yumob biginini olabat laif blanga wandi bulurrum im holbit, wulijim yumob garra laigim im garram yumob hat holbit, en yumob garra kipgon jidanbat langa det kantri.
english: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

kriol: detlot wikitwan pipul garra binijimap miselp garram olabat ron krulbalawei, dumaji olabat nomo wandim dumbat ola raitwan ting.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

kriol: en ai dalim yumob blanga ridimbat dijan leda langa ola kristjan pipul deya, dumaji jisas krais det bos blanga wi wandim yumob garra ridimbat dijan leda langa olabat.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

kriol: wal iya na det femili lain brom peres raidap langa king deibid. peres bin dedi blanga hesran, en hesran bin dedi blanga rem,
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,

kriol: en if imbin gibit yumob det wek blanga albumbat pipul, wal yumob garra albumbat olabat. en if imbin gibit yumob det wek blanga titjimbat pipul, wal yumob garra titjimbat olabat.
english: or service, let's give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

kriol: deibin sabi det boswan god na bin oldei maindimbat olabat, en imbin oldei albumbat en seibum olabat.
english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

kriol: ebribodi garra preisim im haibala neim. im na holiwan!
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

kriol: yawei det trubala god blanga melabat grengrenfathamob eibrahem, aisik en jeikob, olabat bin bulurrum yu brabliwei, wal yu album melabat blanga bulurrum yu brabliwei du en bilib langa yu olataim.
english: Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

kriol: dumaji wen yu dum lagijat langa im yu garra meigim im sheim, en yawei det trubala god garra gibit yu gudbala ting.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.

kriol: imbin lukabat blanga king eihesaiya en im wekinmen olabat bin faindim im langa sameriya. deibin deigim im langa jeihu en jeihu bin gibit oda blanga kilim im ded. deibin berrim im bodi dumaji deibin rispek im grenfatha king jehosafet, hubin wek blanga yawei gudwei. nomo eni femili blanga king eihesaiya bin jidan laibala blanga jidan king langa det kantri enimo.
english: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, "He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahweh with all his heart." The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.

kriol: "if yumob wandim jidan sabibala, yumob garra abum rispek en teiknodis langa yawei det trubala god basdam. bat ol detlot silibala pipul nomo laigim len en sabi enijing." lagijat na salaman bin tok.
english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

kriol: wen det titja bin tok imbin oldei trai blanga meigim pipul jidan gudbinjiwei, en imbin oldei raidimdan gudwan en trubala wed.
english: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

kriol: "bat yu garra lukaftumbat detlot pipul hu nomo garram enibodi blanga albumbat olabat en hu nomo garram enijing.
english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

kriol: imbin tok, "yumob garra abum oni 6 dei blanga dum yumob wek, bat langa det namba 7 dei yumob garra abum spel. langa det dei na, yumob kaan dum eni wek, bat oni majurrumap miselp blanga weship. wal det namba 7 dei im blanga mi na yawei, nomeda weya yumob jidanbat.
english: "'Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

kriol: mi dalim yumob lagijat, dumaji nomeda yumob bin jidan wekinmen o wekingel jis laiga prisana wen god bin jingat langa yumob, bat stil yumob jidan fri blanga jisas krais det bos blanga wi. en if yumob bin jidan fri wen god bin jingat langa yumob, wal yumob jidan jis laiga wekinmen o wekingel blanga jisas krais det bos blanga wi.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord's free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ's bondservant.

kriol: raidap det wed weya yawei bin tok bin hepin truwan. det wed yawei bin dalim josef bin hepin trubalawan.
english: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh's word proved him true.

kriol: en wen imbin 365 yiya ol, god bin deigim im laibala langa top garram im, dumaji inak bin oldei bulurrum god brabliwei.
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

kriol: wal langa det seim nait na sambodi bin kilim ded belshesa det king langa bebalon en detlot najalot kantri.
english: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

kriol: yu raidimdan ola nogud ting weya dei dumbat. nomo larram olabat joinin garram detlot pipul weya yubin meigim jidan fri.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don't let them come into your righteousness.

kriol: en wen jisas bin luk det gel, imbin jingat langa im, "gel, yu fri brom det siknis."
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, "Woman, you are freed from your infirmity."

kriol: heleb det san blanga beina brom det taun gulum netofa, itai det san blanga ribai brom det taun gulum gibiya deya langa det kantri blanga det benjamin klen,
english: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

kriol: bat ai dalim yumob. brom tudei na det speshalwan men garra jidan langa det raidensaid blanga det brabli haibala god." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God."

kriol: ai garra tridim yumob nogudbalawei, en ai garra meigim yumob jidan brabli nogud, en wen ola najalot pipul luk yumob, dei garra hatjamp brabliwei.
english: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.

kriol: wal detlot isreil pipul bin ol tok, "melabat garra bulurrum yawei det trubala god olagija. melabat kaan gibit im bekboun en bulurrumbat najalot drimin, dumaji im na bin deigidawei melabat grenfatha olabat brom ijip weya deibin abum adtaim, en melabat bin luk ola klebabala ting weya imbin dumbat, en imbin maindimbat melabat nomeda weya melabat bin go wen melabat bin wokabat langa ol detlot najalot kantri,
english: The people answered, "Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

kriol: "wen detlot solja brom bebalon garra bidim detlot ijip pipul ai garra meigim detlot isreil pipul brabli strongbala, en ai garra gibit yu pawa blanga tok langa olabat wulijim dei garra sabi mi na yawei det trubala god bin dum ol dislot ting."
english: "In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh."

kriol: det ami weya bin binijimap ola difrinwan kantri garra kaman jis laik det laiyan weya kaminap brom det pleis weya im oldei haidimbat miselp. det ami garra libum ol detlot taun blanga juda rabishwan, en nomo enibodi garra jidan deya laibala enimo.
english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

kriol: wal wen obadaiya bin wokwok, imbin midim ilaija hafwei. obadaiya bin sabi langa ilaija. en imbin baudan langa graun lida langa im en imbin askim im, "trubala yu ilaija?"
english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, "Is it you, my lord Elijah?"

kriol: en if enibodi nomo duwit langa im, wal god garra kadimat im brom im ron pipul en binijimap im.' lagijat na mosis bin tok.
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.'

kriol: wal ai dalim yumob. im nogud wen yumob toktok praudbalawei en reken miselp yumob gudbala, dumaji yumob sabi det nogudbala ting weya det men bin dum garra meigim ebrijing nogud. im jis laik det raising weya wi pudum langa daga. nomeda wi pudum oni lilbit raising, bat stil im meigim det daga go bigwan.
english: Your boasting is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

kriol: wen eran garra dai, wanbala san blanga im garra teikoba det brabli haibala serramonimen pleis brom im, en det san garra wek blanga mi deya langa det seikridwan tent, en im garra go insaid langa det seikridwan pleis weya ai garra jidan. wen det taim garra kaman blanga det san blanga teikoba brom eran, im garra werrimon detlot speshalwan klos blanga 7 dei.
english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

kriol: klebabala pipul oldei sabi wanim blanga dum, but silibala pipul reken dei sabi ebrijing, bat najing.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

kriol: en deya na aibin gibit olabat main wed en aibin titjimbat olabat main lowa en enibodi hu bulurrum main lowa garra jidan raitwei.
english: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

kriol: "wal det bigwan san bin jingat langa wanbala wekinmen, en imbin askim im, 'wotfo olabat meigimbat nois?'
english: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

kriol: wal det bos blanga ola solja bin go langa pol, en imbin askim im miselp, "yu dalim mi trubala na. yu garram det rait seimwei laik ol melabat roman pipul?" en pol bin tok, "yuwai."
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, "Tell me, are you a Roman?" He said, "Yes."

kriol: wen wi gibit rispek langa yawei im brabli gudwan tharran deya. wi garra kipgon olataim gibitbat rispek langa im. det lowa blanga yawei im brabli trubalawan. im oldei gibit pipul feyago.
english: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh's ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

kriol: en ola peig blanga ringimap det seikridwan tent en det pedik bin kopawan.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

kriol: enibodi hu laigim jidanbat drangginbala en abumbat gudtaim garram olkain ting garra lujim ebrijing. dei garra jidan powan.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won't be rich.

kriol: det gudbala men garra libum ola ebrijing blanga im langa ol im grenkid, en det gudbala men garra gajim ebrijing blanga det nogudwan men wen im dai.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

kriol: imbin gibit oda langa olabat blanga go garram im en weshipbat langa yawei deya langa im seikridwan tent weya mosis bin pudumap langa det pleis gulum gibiyan.
english: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God's Tent of Meeting was there, which Yahweh's servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

kriol: mi trastimbat yu na, main god. nomo larram main bedfren olabat bidim mi. if olabat bidim mi, olabat garra tisimbat mi, en ai garra jidan garram sheim.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don't let me be shamed. Don't let my enemies triumph over me.

kriol: wal mi na, luk, aibin joinin langa pol en im wekinmen olabat, en melabat bin gowei brom det taun gulum trowes garram bout, en melabat bin go langa det ailin gulum semothreis, en neksdei melabat bin go langa det taun gulum niyapalas,
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

kriol: enijing weya dedwan enimul buldan, im nomo klinbala blanga serramoni, en det kleiwan ting weya yumob gugumbat, yumob lafta breigim du,
english: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

kriol: wal detlot solja bin gajim det mani, en deibin go en dalim laiya ebriweya, en blendibala pipul bin lisin langa olabat, en tudei na sambala juwish pipul stil reken ola wekinmen blanga jisas bin deigidawei im bodi.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

kriol: bat olabat bin stil jingat adbala langa im, "kilim im! neilimap im langa kros en larram im dai deya!"
english: but they shouted, saying, "Crucify! Crucify him!"

kriol: afta deibin buldan ontop langa mi deibin jis libum mi deya na.
english: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

kriol: ai garra meigim det olagijawan strongwan pramis garram olabat. ai kaan neba stap dumbat gudbala ting blanga olabat, en ai garra meigim olabat rispek langa mi holbit, wulijim olabat kaan gowei brom mi.
english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

kriol: en imbin stat titjimbat olabat.
english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

kriol: en if eni men blanga eran femilimob im nomo klinbala blanga serramoni wen im kaman gulijap langa detlot seikridwan ofring weya detlot isreil pipul oldei gibit langa mi, wal im kaan wek langa det teibul blanga ofring enimo. dijan garra hepin olataim, dumaji mi na yawei.
english: "Tell them, 'If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

kriol: wal aibin kipgon tok, "yawei det boswan god im tok langa yumob isreil pipul na, 'if ol yumob isreil pipul jandim 1,000 solja brom wanbala taun blanga go fait, wal oni 100 garra kambek. en lagijat du langa det najawan taun, if yumob jandim 100 solja blanga go fait, wal oni tenbala garra kambek.
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: "The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel."

kriol: "en if im gibit bard blanga ofring, im garra gibit dab o pijin.
english: "'If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

kriol: olabat garra gajimbat ebrijing olabat wandim brom bebalon." lagijat na yawei bin tok.
english: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied," says Yahweh.

kriol: en yubin dalim melabat blanga bringimap det laswan san langa yu weya yu gin luk langa im,
english: You said to your servants, 'Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.'

kriol: isau bin merrit langa oholibama det doda blanga wan men neim eina hubin san blanga wan olmen neim sibiyan brom detlot hibait pipul. en oholibama bin abum thribala lilboi blanga isau neim jeyus, jeilam en kora. wal ol detlot biginini blanga isau bin ol bon langa det kantri gulum keinan.
english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

kriol: en imbin sabi hau blanga meigim olkain purdibala ting garram gol en silba en kopa,
english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

kriol: yumob garra tridimbat olabat gudwei laik ola isreil pipul, en yumob garra laigim olabat laik yumob laigim miselp. wal yumob garra jinggabat miselp du, dumaji yumob bin laik detlot pipul deya langa ijip. mi na yawei det trubala god blanga yumob.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

kriol: lagijat na det king garra tridim yumob nogudbalawei. en wen im dum lagijat langa yumob, wal yumob garra jinginat soribalawei langa yawei. bat im kaan teiknodis langa yumob, dumaji yumob bin wandim det king garra jidan bos blanga yumob." lagijat na semyul bin tok.
english: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day."

kriol: det taim na detlot pipul hu jidan lobala garra jidan haibala, en detlot pipul hu jidan haibala garra jidan lobala." lagijat na jisas bin tok.
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last."

kriol: en im nomo bin deigim det boks langa jerusalem. imbin libum det boks langa det haus blanga wan men neim obedidam hubin kaman brom det taun gulum geth.
english: So David didn't move the ark with him into David's city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite's house.

kriol: afta na wen jon bin beptaisim ola pipul, imbin beptaisim jisas, en jisas bin prei, en det skai bin opinap,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

kriol: en wen yu stil toktok langa det king, ai garra kaman insaid en bekimap det stori blanga yu." wal lagijat na neithan bin tok.
english: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words."

kriol: afta na wen mosis bin dai en wen detlot isreil pipul bin krosim det jodan riba, joshuwa en ola isreil pipul bin bidim ola king sangodansaid brom det riba, en deibin teikoba olabat kantri du. deibin teikoba ol detlot kantri brom det pleis gulum beilged deya langa det hil kantri gulum lebanan raidap langa det hil gulum heilak gulijap langa det kantri gulum idam. deibin teikoba ol detlot jodan riba kantri en ol detlot hil kantri en ol detlot plein kantri en ol detlot deset kantri. ol detlot kantri na bin blanga detlot traib gulum hitait, emarait, keinanait, perasait, hibait en jebusait. en joshuwa bin teikoba ol detlot kantri, en imbin kadimat ol detlot kantri, en imbin gibit detlot kantri langa ol detlot isreil klen, en deya na deibin jidanbat ola taim.
english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

kriol: pipul blanga bebalon, bambai yumob garra binijap. detlot pipul hu garra peiyimbek yumob blanga wanim yumob bin dum langa melabat, garra gudbinji.
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

kriol: en jeikob bin gajim sambala grinwan stik brom thribala tri gulum paplatri, amantri en pleintri, en afta imbin deigimat sambala bak brom detlot stik, en detlot stik bin abum detlot mak garram straipstraip,
english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

kriol: im rili adwan blanga godan en gajim woda brom det brabli dipwan hol. wal lagijat du im brabli adwan blanga sabi wanim enibodi jinggabat, bat enibodi hu sabi brabliwei, im na garra faindat wanim imbin jinggabat.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

kriol: "yumob irrim mi na! if yumob wandim dum wanim im rait, en duwit langa main wed, en pudum ebrijing langa yumob hat, wal yumob lafta teiknodis langa mi. yumob nomo nogudbinji wen najalot pipul tok nogudbalawei blanga yumob, en dei trai ardimbat yumob.
english: "Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don't fear the reproach of men, and don't be dismayed at their insults.

kriol: "wal ol yumob pipul langa ebri kantri, yumob garra lisin langa mi na wulijim yumob garra sabi wanim garra hepin langa main pipul olabat.
english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

kriol: bat if det sowa im spredat afta det serramonimen bin luk en dalim im 'yu klinbala blanga serramoni', wal im garra lafta gobek langa det serramonimen igin.
english: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

kriol: yu sabi wanim ai garra dalimbat yu im trubala, dumaji mi sabi brabliwei.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

kriol: kwikbala imbin kaman jis laik imbin flai garram det speshalwan einjul blanga im, en imbin trebul langa det win jis laik imbin abum wing.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

kriol: afta na deibin sing det laswan song blanga det pasoba serramoni sapa, en deibin go langa det hil gulum olib.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kriol: det shainiwan lait blanga yu shain laik det san, en det lait spredat ebriweya brom yu bingga weya yu oldei blandimbat det strongwan pawa blanga yu.
english: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

kriol: en ebritaim wen imbin oldei go en fait, deibid bin oldei win, dumaji yawei bin jidan garram im.

english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

kriol: wal wen neiyomi en det gel ruth bin kaman langa bethlahem, imbin taim blanga gajimbat ola sid daga en pudum langa haus. wal neiyomi bin abum wan kantrimen deya neim bowes. imbin ful kantrimen blanga det dedbala hasbin blanga im, en imbin jidan boswan, en imbin ritjwan du.
english: Naomi had a relative of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

kriol: ebrijing wanim king amasaiya bin dum bin meigim yawei det trubala god gudbinji, bat im nomo bin jidan laik im grengrenfatha king deibid. imbin bulurrum det wei blanga im dedi jowesh.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh's eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

kriol: wi sabi tharran deya, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, "nobodi gudbala. nomo enibodi.
english: As it is written, "There is no one righteous; no, not one.

kriol: blanga main pipul olabat kraikraibat langa mi na. dei tok, 'nomeda melabat bin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, yu album melabat yawei, dumaji yubin meigim pramis garram melabat. loda taim melabat bin tenim miselp brom yu, en melabat bin dum nogudbala ting langa yu.
english: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name's sake, Yahweh; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you.

kriol: brom deya det namba 4 einjul bin spilimat im dish langa det san na, en det san bin lau barnimbat ola pipul garram faiya.
english: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

english: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

kriol: ola daga en ola enijing kaan jidan longtaim. dei oldei binij streidawei wen yu yusum. wal ol detlot lowa bin kamat brom pipul,
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

kriol: wal detlot pipul hubin dai blanga det gudnyus bin ol jingat adbala na, "god, yu brabli haibala bos. yu brabli gudbala, en yu trubalawan du. longtaim melabat bin weidabat yu blanga bringimap detlot pipul brom ola kantri hubin binijimap melabat. wal wotaim yu garra jadjim olabat en panishim olabat blanga dijan weya deibin kilim melabat ded?"
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, "How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?"

kriol: aibin gulijap dai, bat yawei bin seibum mi. imbin stapam mi brom kraikraibat, en imbin album mi jidan langa det gudbala roud.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

kriol: go langa yawei blanga album yumob, en kipgon weshipbat im.
english: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

kriol: en im mobeda yumob nomo meigim pramis langa god.
english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

kriol: en wen aibin binij toktokbat ol detlot wed weya yawei bin dalim mi blanga tok, wal olabat bin grebum mi en olabat bin jingat adbala. olabat bin tok langa mi, "yu bina gitkil blanga dijan.
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, "You shall surely die!

kriol: main god, detlot praudbala pipul geingap langa mi blanga trai kilim mi ded, detlot pipul na weya dei nomo oldei jinggabat langa yu.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don't hold regard for you before them.

kriol: en yu kaan jinggabat blanga meigim enibodi jidan tjetj lida en pudum yu bingga langa im streidawei. yu garra jinggabat basdam if im rait langa god, dumaji yu nomo wandi god garra pudum bleim langa yu blanga det sambodi trabul. nomo. yu wandi meiksho yu jidan brabli gudbalawei langa ebrijing weya yu dumbat.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don't be a participant in other people's sins. Keep yourself pure.

kriol: en wen deibin kamat langa det bigwan ston gulijap langa det taun gulum gibiyan, amasa bin midim olabat. wal jowab bin deya du garram abaishai, en imbin werrim ola speshalwan klos weya deibin oldei yusum blanga fait, en imbin abum det bigwan naif blanga im langa det pautj langa im belt, en wen imbin go langa amasa blanga sei gudei langa im, det bigwan naif bin buldan, en imbin pikimap det bigwan naif garram im lefthensaid bingga.
english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

kriol: bat najalot pipul oldei dai nomo garram enijing. olabat oni abumbat detmatj pein.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

kriol: wal king manesa bin dai en deibin berrim im bodi gulijap langa det king haus. im san eman bin jidan det nyuwan king.
english: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

kriol: yu gin meigimbat klos brom detlot wul brom ola ship, en yu gin baiyim kantri garram det mani weya yubin gajim brom selimbat sambala nenigout.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

kriol: en ola sta garra buldan brom skai, en ol detlot strongbala ting weya jidan langa skai garra gowei brom olabat pleis,
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

kriol: wen aibin gowei brom dis kantri basdam, aibin abum femili en ebrijing. bat najing na. yawei det boswan god blanga ebrijing, en imbin tenim imselp brom mi, en imbin gibit mi bigis trabul, en aibin lujim main hasbin en main san dubala."
english: I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since Yahweh has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?"

kriol: nomo tok praudbalawei blanga wanim garra hepin tumorro. ebridei difrin ting hepin.
english: Don't boast about tomorrow; for you don't know what a day may bring.

kriol: melkiram, pedaiya, shenasa, jekamaiya, hoshama en neidabai.
english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

kriol: if ai flaiwei langa weya det san gidap, o if ai jidan weya det solwoda binij weya det san godan,
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

kriol: en yumob garra jidan serramonimen en wekinmen blanga yawei. yumob garra abum detlot silba en gol brom najalot kantri en yumob garra jidan brabli ritjwan.
english: But you will be called Yahweh's priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.

kriol: wal wi ol jidan wanbala pipul, dumaji oni wanbala holi spirit im jidan langa wi, en god bin pikimat wi blanga go langa wanbala pleis,
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

kriol: en trubala ai dalim yumob. mi na yawei det boswan god, en ai garra panishim yumob, dumaji yumob bin oldei wail en heidimbat main pipul olabat. en olabat garra sabi mi na yawei bin panishimbat yumob.
english: therefore, as I live," says the Lord Yahweh, "I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

kriol: yu kaan tridim streinja nogudbalawei, dumaji yumob na bin jidan streinja langa ijip, en yumob sabi det filing weya enibodi abum wen im jidan streinja langa najawan kantri.
english: "You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kriol: imbin meigim im pipul olabat jidan strongbala blanga preisim im. olabat na detlot isreil pipul hu im laigim brabliwei. preisim yawei det trubala god!
english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!

kriol: en shela bin san blanga keinan, en keinan bin san blanga apekshed, en apekshed bin san blanga shem, en shem bin san blanga nowa, en nowa bin san blanga leimek,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

kriol: "wal det taim na wen ai garra gajimbek det gel, im garra gulum mi hasbin. im kaan gulum mi bos.
english: It will be in that day," says Yahweh, "that you will call me 'my husband,' and no longer call me 'my master.'

kriol: en wen enibodi luk mi, wal im luk main dedi hubin jandim mi du.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

kriol: imbin bringimap det najawan enimul blanga barnapwan ofring, en imbin gibit det ofring laik det lowa bin tok.
english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

kriol: yawei na bin meigim det skai, graun, woda en ola ebrijing weya jidan langa olabat. im oldei dum wanim imbin pramis.
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

kriol: en if damitriyas en im meit olabat abum bedfiling langa enibodi, wal dei garra deigim olabat langa kot, dumaji wi garram bos iya, en dei oldei abum kotkeis ebridei.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

kriol: yu filing blanga kipgon laigimbat pipul im jidan ebriweya, brom longwei ontop raitdan langa graun. yu trubalawei im gajimap det skai.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kriol: yu si? jisas gin oldei seibum enibodi hu wandim kaman langa god thru im, dumaji im jidan laibala olagijawan, en im gin oldei askimbat god blanga olabat.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

kriol: wi jidan langa dijan laif weya pipul dai en olabat kraikrai nomo lilbit. en pipul woriworibat en gitwailbat en git sik du.
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

kriol: melabat bin dalim yu bifo wibin libum det kantri. melabat bin tok, 'yu larram melabat stap iya gin. melabat garra kipgon jidanbat jis laiga prisana en dumbat ola adwek blanga ola pipul iya langa dijan kantri.' lagijat na melabat bin tok, dumaji melabat nomo bin wandi dai iya langa dis deset kantri. mobeda melabat bina stap deya langa det kantri ijip en kipgon jidanbat jis laiga prisana en dumbat ola adwek."
english: Isn't this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, 'Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians'? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness."

kriol: wal det men bin dalim im waif, "yunmi garra dai na, dumaji yunmi bin luk god!"
english: Manoah said to his wife, "We shall surely die, because we have seen God."

kriol: bat deibid nomo bin bildimap det haus. det san blanga im neim salaman bin bildimap det haus.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

english: Don't strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. "For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?" This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

kriol: wal afta wen detlot isreil pipul bin meigim deibid jidan king blanga olabat, im en im solja olabat bin go langa det taun gulum jerusalem blanga fait langa det jebusait traib hubin oldei jidanbat deya. deibin gulum det taun jebus.
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

kriol: en aibin oldei gibit main daga langa ola biginini hu nomo garram eni dedi o mami.
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it.

english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

english: When he saw that he didn't prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was strained as he wrestled.

english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

kriol: langa det sangodansaid det kaliko bin jidan 22 mita longwei garram tenbala reil ontop langa tenbala pleit.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country."

english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

english: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

english: "Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart."

english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

english: When God caused me to wander from my father's house, I said to her, 'This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, "He is my brother."'"

english: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to live, that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

english: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

english: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.

english: Don't say, "Why were the former days better than these?" For you do not ask wisely about this.

kriol: afta na det men hubin werrimonbat detlot gudwan klos bin kambek, en imbin dalim yawei, "aibin dum wanim yubin dalim mi blanga dum."
english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, "I have done as you have commanded me."

english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

kriol: wal deibin kilim wanbala gout, en deibin gajim det kout blanga josef, en deibin sokum det kout langa det blad.
english: They took Joseph's tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

english: But I say, didn't they hear? Yes, most certainly, "Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world."

english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ's at his coming.

english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

kriol: det nek im longwan en im brabli purdiwan blanga yu, en yu nekleis im garram bigismob purdiwan ting heinginap raidaran langa yu nek.
english: Your neck is like David's tower built for an armory, on which a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men.

kriol: wal ai garra jandim najawan braja blanga wi garram taidas dubala. aibin testimbat im blendi taim, en aibin oldei faindim im oldei gudbinji brabliwei blanga album mi. en im brabli wandi go langa yumob, dumaji im sabi yumob garra dum wanim god wandim yumob blanga dum.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

kriol: bat god bin album mi olawei, en mi jandapbat iya tudei dalimbat det trubala stori langa ol yumob haibala men en najalot men. dijan stori weya mi oldei dalimbat ola pipul, im det seimwan stori weya mosis det grengrenfatha blanga ola juwish pipul bin tok longtaim, en im det seimwan stori weya ola speshalwan mesinja blanga god bin tok longtaim du.
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

kriol: wal king eiheb bin tok, "hu garra go lida blanga lidim det fait?" en det speshalwan mesinja bin tok, "yawei bin tok detlot yangwan soljamob hu jidan anda detlot gabman bos langa dijan kantri. olabat na garra fait langa ol detlot solja blanga king binaded." en king eiheb bin askim im, "hu garra tok blanga stadimap det fait?" en det speshalwan mesinja bin tok "yu na!"
english: Ahab said, "By whom?" He said, "Yahweh says, 'By the young men of the princes of the provinces.'" Then he said, "Who shall begin the battle?" He answered, "You."

kriol: basdam nomo enibodi drimin bin kipum olabat seif brom ola king blanga asiriya. wal yumob reken yumob god gin album yumob en dum gudwan ting blanga yumob? nomo!
english: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

kriol: yumob sabi? wen aibin go langa det kantri gulum mesadoniya, aibin abum detmatj trabul brom detlot pipul hu nomo bilib langa det gudnyus, en aibin wori blanga yumob detmatj du.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

kriol: en wen ola men langa det kantri luk yu, dei garra reken yu main waif, en afta dei garra kilim mi ded en grebum yu.
english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, 'This is his wife.' They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

kriol: nomo larram ol main enami rabishim mi. nomo larram olabat tok jigibalawei wen ai stat dumbat nogudbala ting.
english: For I said, "Don't let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."

kriol: yu panishim olabat na, dumaji olabat bin dum loda nogudbala ting. olabat laigim lukaranbat blanga trabul olataim. yawei, yu meigim trabul blanga olabat na.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

kriol: wal ola serramonimen bin ol jandap langa olabat ron pleis, en deibin luk langa ola libai pipul en deibin preisimbat yawei garram detlot myusik ebrijing weya king deibid bin gibit. deibin singim det song gulum im laigim olabat olagijawan, laik deibid bin dalim olabat. detlot serramonimen bin blowim detlot longwan wisul en ola pipul bin jandap.
english: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of Yahweh, which David the king had made to give thanks to Yahweh, when David praised by their ministry, saying "For his loving kindness endures forever." The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.

kriol: god, yu sori langa mi dumaji pipul kaman blanga fait langa mi. ol main enami olabat dumbat nogud ting langa mi olataim.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

kriol: wal yu sabi detlot lowa, indit? yu nomo lau medrim enibodi. yu nomo lau silip garram naja men waif. yu nomo lau stilimbat. yu nomo lau dalimbat laiya. yu nomo lau trikimbat enibodi. yu garra rispek en teiknodis langa yu mami en dedi."
english: You know the commandments: 'Do not murder,' 'Do not commit adultery,' 'Do not steal,' 'Do not give false testimony,' 'Do not defraud,' 'Honor your father and mother.'"

kriol: det gridibala garram dubala doda en det dubala garram seim neim, "gibit mi". wal dislot fobala ting nomo jidan sedisfaid. olabat na
english: "The leech has two daughters: 'Give, give.' "There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don't say, 'Enough!':

kriol: im waif seresh en ol im fren bin tok langa im, "dalim yu wekinmen olabat blanga pudumap det speshalwan pos blanga heingim pipul weya dei kilim ded. dalim olabat blanga pudumap brabli haibalawan. en ailibala askim det king blanga dalim im wekinmen olabat blanga binijimap modakai deya. afta wen yu go garram det king langa det dina yu garra brabli gudbinji." heiman bin brabli gudbinji wen imbin jinggabat, en imbin dalim im wekinmen olabat blanga pudumap det speshalwan pos.
english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, "Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet." This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

kriol: bin tok langa mi na, "yu garra raidimdan ebrijing langa peipa wanim aibin dalim yu,
english: "Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, 'Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

kriol: nomeda yumob isreil pipul bin oldei jidan jis laiga grin gras, bat stil ai garra jandim ami langa yumob jis laik det hotwan win weya kaman brom det deset kantri sanraiswei blanga binijimap yumob, en detlot ami garra deigidawei ola gudwan enijing brom yumob jis laik det hotwan win weya im draiyimap ola springwoda en ola wel.
english: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of Yahweh coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.

kriol: afta na deibid bin go en jidan langa det deset kantri gulum paran. wal wan men deya langa det taun bin neim neibal. imbin brom det femili gulum keilab, en imbin brabli ritjmen. imbin abum kantri langa det pleis gulum kamul, en imbin abum 3,000 ship en 1,000 gout, en imbin abum brabli purdiwan waif du. im waif bin neim ebigeil, en imbin brabli kleba gel. bat neibal bin brabli nogudbala, en imbin oldei temperap kwikbala. wal wandei neibal bin deigimatbat detlot wul brom ola ship blanga im deya langa det pleis gulum kamul,
english: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

kriol: mosis bin irrim detlot pipul bin stat grambulbat wen deibin jandap mijamet langa det dowawei langa olabat tent. mosis bin brabli nogudbinji, dumaji yawei bin brabli wail langa olabat na.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh's anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

kriol: beilak bin dum wanim imbin dalim im, en beilak en beilam bin pudum detlot enimul langa detlot teibul blanga ofring en deibin barnimap holot.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

kriol: ai garra lukaftumbat olabat blanga yu if yu larram mi go thru langa olabat en kadimat ola spadidwan nenigout en ola spadidwan biligout en ola blekwan ship. yu garra gibit mi detlot enimul na blanga peiyim mi blanga wek blanga yu.
english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

kriol: wal det holi spirit bin gowin langa pol, en imbin meigim im strongbala, en pol bin tok streidat langa det klebabalamen.
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him.

kriol: dumaji im nek im brabli bigiswan, enibodi hu oldei luk langa im sheiksheik nomo lilbit.
english: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

kriol: en deya na lida langa yawei imbin laidim detlot lemp jis laik weya yawei bin dalim im blanga dum.
english: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kriol: yawei oldei gibit ebrijing langa ol detlot pipul hu rispek im. im irrim olabat wen dei jingat langa im en im seibum olabat.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

kriol: wal jisas bin dalim det dubala wekinmen blanga im neim pida en jon blanga go lida en meigim ebrijing redi blanga det pasoba sapa blanga olabat.
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat."

kriol: "wal yawei bin gibit im wed, en imbin meigim dijan pramis, 'ai kaan neba gibit yumob enami olabat ol detlot sid daga en greip daga weya yumob bin plentimbat en dumbat adwek.
english: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, "Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,

kriol: dumaji yubin fogedabat langa mi en bin gibit mi bekboun en bin oldei dumbat ol dislot nogudbala ting, wal ai garra panishim yu brabliwei." lagijat na yawei det boswan god bin tok.
english: "Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: 'Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.'"

kriol: en leiban bin deigim sambala rileishan blanga im, en deibin go aftum jeikob, en deibin trebulin wan wik bifo deibin gajimap jeikob deya langa det hil kantri gulum giliyad.
english: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days' journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

kriol: garram im strongbala pawa im jidan bos olagijawan, en im wotjimbat pipul langa ola kantri. nomo gibit bekboun langa yawei.
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don't let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

kriol: yumob reken im larram yumob teikoba det kantri dumaji yumob gudbala en dum wanim yawei wandim yumob blanga dum, bat najing! im garra andimwei ol detmob, dumaji detmob brabli nogudbala pipul en im garra kipum det pramis weya imbin gibit langa wi grengrenfatha olabat eibrahem, aisik, en jeikob.
english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

kriol: keilab bin abum najawan waif neim meiyaka en deibin abum dubala san neim shebara en tairana.
english: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

kriol: ai garram naf medwan pipul iya olredi. ai nomo wandim yumob garra bringimap najawan medwan men iya langa main ronwan haus blanga meigim nyusans langa mi. ai nomo wandim lagijat." lagijat na det king bin tok.
english: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?"

kriol: afta na detlot thribala men bin askim eibrahem, "wujei yu waif sera?" en eibrahem bin tok, "im deya insaid langa tent."
english: They asked him, "Where is Sarah, your wife?" He said, "There, in the tent."

kriol: wal ebsalom nomo bin abum eni san blanga meigim det femili lain blanga im kipgon, en wen imbin stil jidan laibala, imbin bildimap bigis ting garram ston deya langa det pleis gulum king beli. imbin bildimap det ting blanga meigim ola pipul jinggabat im wulijim det neim blanga im kaan binij. en tudei dei gulum det ting ebsalom ston.
english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king's valley, for he said, "I have no son to keep my name in memory." He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom's monument, to this day.

kriol: en wen enibodi jidan gudbinji, yumob garra jidan gudbinji du garram olabat. en wen enibodi kraikrai, yumob garra kraikrai garram olabat du.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

kriol: "brom longtaim aibin tok wanim garra hepin, en ai nomo bin gibit yumob najawan woning. aibin dum kwikbala.
english: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.

kriol: wandei king eiheb bin tok langa neiboth, "gibit mi det greip fam blanga yu, dumaji im gulijap langa main haus, en ai wandi yusum det pleis blanga meigim gadin blanga growimap ola daga. ai garra gibit yu wan gudwan greip fam langa najawan pleis gin, o if yu wandim, ai gin peiyim yu mani."
english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, "Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money."

kriol: yubin bringimat yu pipul olabat jis laiga greiptri brom det kantri ijip. yubin andimwei pipul brom najalot kantri en yubin plentim det tri langa olabat kantri.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

kriol: wal yawei bin kipgon tok langa mi, "isikiyel, wotfo detlot isreil pipul oldei toktokbat dijan wed, 'ebrijing det speshalwan mesinja bin tok longtaim nomo bin hepin'?
english: Yahweh's word came to me, saying,

kriol: sambala pipul oldei tokbek garram gudbala wed langa det rait taim en dei meigim ebribodi brabli gudbinji.
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

kriol: brom deya king benaded bin jandim sambala mesinja blanga gibit det wed langa king eiheb brom isreil deya insaid langa det taun.
english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, "Ben Hadad says,

kriol: "wal wen melabat bin irrim det nyus, ola pipul deya langa melabat kantri en ola boswan blanga melabat bin dalim melabat blanga gajim sambala enijing en kaman langa yumob, en deibin dalim melabat blanga meigim miselp wekinmen blanga yumob en blanga askim yumob blanga meigim pramis langa melabat.
english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, 'Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, "We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us."'

kriol: en dei tok, "yawei nomo luk wi. det god blanga isreil nomo sabi wanim wi dumbat."
english: They say, "Yah will not see, neither will Jacob's God consider."

kriol: en wen deibin dagadagat daga, wan gel bin kaman deya langa olabat, en imbin garrimapbat lilwan ston botul ful garram detkain gudsmelwan oil weya kos loda mani, en imbin spilim det oil ontop langa jisas hed.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

kriol: "detlot sid weya bin buldan langa roud, dei jis laik detlot pipul hu irrim det wed. bat seitin im kaman en deigidawei det wed brom olabat wulijim olabat kaan bilib langa det wed en god kaan seibum olabat.
english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

kriol: jeikob bin duwit langa im mami, en imbin go en kilim dubala nenigout, en imbin bringimbek dubala langa im mami, en im mami bin meigim gudwan daga weya aisik bin oldei laigim dagat.
english: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

kriol: en detlot pipul wekinmen blanga jisas krais? wal mi wekinmen blanga jisas krais du. en ai garra tok brabli granggibalawei na. mi mobedawan wekinmen, dumaji aibin wek brabli adbala, en deibin tjakam mi langa jeil lodataim, en deibin beldim mi garram wip lodataim, en aibin gulijap dai lodataim du.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

kriol: if najalot pipul irrim yu nomo bin kipum det agamin sigrid, dei garra meigim yu jidan sheimwan en dei kaan abum rispek blanga yu igin.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

kriol: aibin bringimap im langa yu wekinmen olabat. bat dei nomo bin abum pawa blanga meigim im gudbala."
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him."

kriol: if yu wandim yu plen blanga wek gudwei, yu garra askim sambodi hu sabi basdam. bifo yu go langa wofait yu garra abum gudwan plen.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

kriol: wal yumob garra tok lagijat, "if god wandim, wal ai garra jidan laibala, en ai gin dum det ting."
english: For you ought to say, "If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that."

kriol: "langa det feswan dei blanga det feswan manth yu garra ringimap det seikridwan tent weya ai garra jidan.
english: "On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kriol: wal aibin dalim ola pipul en detlot wuman wanim yawei det boswan god blanga ola isreil pipul bin toktokbat langa detlot isreil pipul brom juda wen olabat bin jidanbat langa ijip. imbin tok, "ol yumob men en yumob waifmob bin meigim detlot strongbala pramis langa det gelwan drimin. yumob bin meigim detlot pramis weya yumob garra kipgon gibitbat ofring oni langa im, en yumob garra spilimbat wain ofring langa im, en yumob bin kipum detlot pramis. wal yumob gin dum lagijat. yumob gin kipum detlot pramis weya yumob bin meigim.
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, "Hear Yahweh's word, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!

kriol: wal yumob garra oldei lisin langa yumob tjetj lida en duwit langa olabat, dumaji dei oldei lukaftumbat yumob, en wandei god garra tjekap langa olabat. wal if yumob lisin langa olabat, yumob garra meigim olabat gudbinji weya dei dumbat det wek. bat if yumob nomo lisin langa olabat, yumob garra meigim olabat nogudbinji, en dei kaan album yumob.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

kriol: afta na yawei bin kadimat ola pipul, en imbin spredimat olabat langa ebri kantri, dumaji imbin miksimap olabat langgus, en dei nomo bin binijim det taun weya deibin bildimbat.
english: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

kriol: ai pramisim yu enijing yu askim mi. enijing yu wandim, ai garra gibit langa yu."
english: He swore to her, "Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom."

kriol: wal langa det taim na henanai det speshalwan mesinja bin go langa king asa en imbin tok, "yubin askim det king brom siriya blanga album yu, bat yu nomo bin askim yawei blanga album yu. wal yu kaan neba bidim detlot siriya pipul.
english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, "Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on Yahweh your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

kriol: yumob bin bringimap dijan dubala men iya. bat dubala nomo bin stilim enijing brom det serramoni pleis, en dubala nomo bin tok nogudbalawei blanga wi drimin.
english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

kriol: if eni men im silipsilipbat garram im dedi waif, wal im meigim im dedi sheim miselp. wal im en det gel dubala garra lafta dai mijamet, dumaji dubala ronwan folt tharran.
english: "'The man who lies with his father's wife has uncovered his father's nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kriol: yu dalim mi na. yu reken enijing brabli ad blanga mi blanga dum? neksyiya ai garra kambek igin en yunbala sera garra abum boiwan beibi."
english: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son."

kriol: ilaisha bin jingat langa gehasi en imbin dalim im blanga jingat langa det lilboi mami. en wen det mamiwan bin kaman insaid ilaisha bin dalim im, "iya na yu san."
english: He called Gehazi, and said, "Call this Shunammite!" So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, "Take up your son."

kriol: imbin meigim pleit en kap en jag en dish blanga yusum langa det teibul blanga det wain ofring. ol detlot ting imbin meigim garram gudwan gol.
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

kriol: wal najalot libai pipul bin boswan blanga detlot mani, en langa detlot stowa rum weya deibin kipum ola seikridwan ebrijing blanga god.
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God's house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

kriol: wal yu reken yu gin faindim bigismob buligi en ship blanga olabat blanga meigim olabat binji bulap? wanim yu reken? ola fish langa solwoda naf blanga olabat?"
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?"

kriol: wal pida bin tok, "nomo, bos. ai nomo bin dagat detkain bif, dumaji im nogudwan, en melabat nomo lau dagat."
english: But Peter said, "Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean."

kriol: wal sambala detkain pipul bin iya langa wi ron tjetj. bat deibin gowei brom wi, dumaji dei nomo bin joinin langa wi trubalawei. if dei bina joinin langa wi trubalawei, wal dei bina kipgon jidanbat garram wi. bat deibin gowei brom wi, en tharran na bin shoum wi dei nomo bin joinin langa wi trubalawei.
english: They went out from us, but they didn't belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

kriol: "ai garra larram streinja pipul kaman en stilimbat yumob ebrijing en dei garra deigimwei ola ebrijing.
english: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.

kriol: en ebritaim wen mosis en eran en detlot fobala san blanga eran bin oldei gowin langa det seikridwan tent o go langa det bigwan teibul, deibin oldei washim olabat bingga en fut deya langa det dish jis laik weya yawei bin dalim mosis blanga dum.
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

kriol: en nomo eni pipul jidan speshalwan seimwei laik ola isreil pipul jidan, dumaji yu na bin deigidawei melabat brom ijip weya melabat bin jidan prisana, en yubin meigim melabat jidan yu ronwan pipul olabat. en det nyus blanga ola bigbala ting weya yubin dum blanga melabat bin go ebriweya, en det nyus bin meigim yu neim brabli haibala langa ebri kantri. wen yubin seibum melabat brom ijip blanga meigim melabat jidan blanga yu ronwan pipul olabat. yubin andimwei ola najalot pipul brom olabat kantri wen melabat bin go langa detlot kantri blanga jidan.
