kriol: wal jisas bin gowin insaid, en imbin tok, "wotfo yumob nogudbinji en kraikraibat? det lilgel nomo bin dai. im oni silip tharran."
english: When he had entered in, he said to them, "Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep."

kriol: wal ola isreil pipul bin majurrumap miselp na. deibin kaman brom ebriweya langa det isreil kantri, brom det taun gulum den deya langa nowathsaid langa det kantri raidap langa det taun gulum biyashiba deya langa sauthsaid, en brom det kantri gulum giliyad deya langa sanraisaid. deibin ol majurrumap miselp langa det seikridwan pleis blanga yawei det trubala god deya langa det taun gulum mispa.
english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.

kriol: en blanga tharran na imbin gudbala langa mi, dumaji aibin oldei bulurrumbat det raitwei blanga im, en im sabi ai nomo bin dum enijing rong.
english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

kriol: wal king deibid bin dalim im, "aibin kaman iya blanga baiyim dijan pleis brom yu, dumaji mi garra bildimap teibul blanga ofring blanga weship langa yawei blanga stapam dijan nogudwan siknis. ai garra gibit yu det raitwan mani."
english: Then David said to Ornan, "Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people."

kriol: wal lagijat na mosis bin dalim detlot isreil pipul wanim yawei bin dalim im.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

kriol: en imbin go langa ola biginini blanga det olmen neim heima hubin bildimap det taun, en imbin baiyim det pedik weya imbin ringimap im tent blanga bigmob mani. imbin baiyim blanga 100 silba langa olabat kain mani.
english: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for one hundred pieces of money.

kriol: en im garra dum lagijat langa det namba 3 dei en namba 7 dei wulijim im garra jidan klinbala blanga det serramoni igin. afta im garra washim im klos en spilim det woda oloba langa imselp en im garra jidan brabli klinbala blanga det serramoni wen det sangodan.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

kriol: en im dalim laiyawan stori blanga det gel. im reken det gel bin silipsilip garram najawan men bifo dubala bin git merrit.
english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, "I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn't find in her the tokens of virginity;"

kriol: "yumob jinggabat na. if eni men libum im waif, en im merrit langa najawan gel, wal im breigim det lowa blanga god. en if enibodi merrit langa det gel hubin libum im hasbin, wal det men im breigim det lowa seimwei du. yu si? det lowa im stil kipgon.
english: "Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

kriol: im garra seibum jerusalem en bildimap ola taun langa juda igin. im pipul olabat garra jidan deya igin.
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

kriol: wal melabat gin tok langa yumob lagijat, dumaji melabat sabi trubala god bin gibit melabat det pawa thru jisas krais blanga dum det wek blanga im.
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

kriol: "wal yumob jinggabat na. maitbi wanbala men meigim det plen blanga medrimbat im enami, en im kilim im ded en im ranawei deya langa wanbala seifwan taun.
english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

kriol: wal yawei bin dalim hoseiya, "detlot isreil pipul bin stat dumbat ol detlot nogudbala ting deya na langa det pleis gulum gilgel. en deya na aibin stat heidimbat olabat. en ai garra andimwei olabat brom main kantri, dumaji deibin dumbat ol detlot nogudbala ting. ai kaan laigim olabat na, dumaji ola boswan blanga olabat bin gibit mi bekboun.
english: "All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.

kriol: haulong main enami olabat garra kilimbat mi? olabat reken mi jis laik olwan fens redibala blanga buldan.
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

kriol: bat if detlot pipul langa det taun nomo gibit miselp langa yumob, wal ol yumob solja garra redi blanga fait en majurrumap miselp raidaran langa det taun.
english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

kriol: mi gibit oda langa yumob blanga album olabat. det mani blanga pei blanga ola enijing garra kamat brom det mani weya det king oldei gedim wen ola pipul deya sangodansaid langa det yufreitis riba oldei peiyim det teks mani, wulijim det wek kaan stap.
english: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.

kriol: yu garra jidan brabli nogudbinji, en yu garra jelas langa ola najalot isreil pipul, dumaji ai garra dum loda gudbala ting blanga olabat. bat detlot men langa yu ronwan femili garra ol dai yangwan gin.
english: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.

kriol: wal jisas bin tok langa ebribodi deya, "wotfo yumob kaan bilib brabliwei? wotfo yumob oldei dumbat nogudbala ting? haulong ai garra stap iya garram yumob? en haulong ai garra kipgon shoumbat yumob? wal bringimap det lilboi iya langa mi."
english: Jesus answered, "Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me."

kriol: brom deya pol en sailas bin go langa det taun gulum debi, en brom deya dubala bin go langa det taun gulum listra. deya na wan biliba neim timathi bin jidan. im mami bin bilib langa jisas du, en imbin juwish gel. bat timathi dedi bin grik.
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

kriol: kora det san blanga isa brom det libai klen blanga kohath femili grup bin reken im det lida, nomo mosis. najalot bin joinap langa kora. deibin thribala brom det rubin klen. deibin deithan en ebiram, det dubala san blanga eliyab, en det san blanga peleth gulum on, en 250 najalot lida weya ola isreil pipul bin pikimat basdam.
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

kriol: brom deya yawei det trubala god bin dalim joshuwa, "yu garra majurrumap ola isreil solja, en yu garra go langa det taun gulum eiyai. yu kaan bradin en nogudbinji, dumaji ai garra meigim yu win det fait, en yu garra bidim det king en ola pipul blanga im, en ai garra gibit yu det taun en ola kantri blanga detlot pipul.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, "Don't be afraid, and don't be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.

kriol: brom deya king josaiya bin majurrumap ola lidamob brom juda en jerusalem,
english: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

kriol: bat ola pipul langa det juda klen en ola najalot isreil pipul bin laigim deibid brabliwei, dumaji imbin brabli gudbala lida blanga detlot solja.
english: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.

kriol: prayer wal ebritaim wen mi oldei jinggabat yumob, mi oldei gibit theingks langa god blanga yumob.
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

kriol: ai dalim yumob. if enibodi dum wanim main dedi langa hebin wandim im blanga dum, wal im na main femili."
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother."

kriol: ai nomo bin lisin langa ol main titja. ai nomo bin teiknodis langa olabat.
english: I haven't obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

kriol: en wen dubala bin kamat deya, jeikob bin askim dubala, "wotfo yunbala dedi nomo laigim mi na? yunbala sabi aibin wek adbala blanga yunbala dedi. en det god weya main dedi bin oldei bulurrum, bin oldei albumbat mi.
english: and said to them, "I see the expression on your father's face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

kriol: afta na joshuwa bin jingat langa ola pipul, "olabat! yumob kaman iya en irrim wanim yawei bin tok.
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, "Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God."

kriol: yu nomo larram main enami olabat kaman brom ebri said blanga kilim mi ded,
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

kriol: wal det olmen bin dalim olabat garram im bingga blanga gibit im samting blanga raidimdan det lilboi neim, en wen deibin gibit im, imbin raidimdan, "im neim jon." wal ol detlot pipul bin hatjamp wen det olmen bin gibit det neim,
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, "His name is John." They all marveled.

kriol: yu nomo bin larram main enami olabat deigim mi prisana. yubin kipum mi fri en seifwan.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

kriol: jeibes bin prei langa det god blanga ola isreil pipul. imbin tok, "dedi langa top, yu album mi, en gibit mi brabli gudwan kantri. yu jidan garram mi, en seibum mi brom ola nogudbala ting weya oldei ardimbat main bodi." lagijat na jeibes bin tok. en god bin kain langa im en imbin gibit im ebrijing weya imbin askim im.
english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, "Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!" God granted him that which he requested.

kriol: imbin tok langa mi, "dijan na, det dubala men weya god bin pikimat. imbin spilim oil langa dubala blanga meigim dubala im ronwan wekinmen, en im na bos blanga ebrijing langa dijan wel."
english: Then he said, "These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth."

kriol: wal streidawei wen detlot pipul bin jingat lagijat, wan einjul brom god bin meigim det king brabli sik, dumaji det king nomo bin rispek god, en imbin meigim miselp haibala seim laik god, en afta loda wem bin dagat det king bodi insaid, en imbin dai.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn't give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

kriol: wal jisas bin kipgon tok langa im wekinmen olabat, "yumob jinggabat na. mi jis laik det greiptri. mi na det brabliwan greiptri, en main dedi im jis laik det fama hu oldei lukaftumbat det tri,
english: "I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

kriol: "ola isreil pipul bin breigim detlot lowa blanga yu en olabat nomo bin duwit en lisin wanim yubin tok. dumaji melabat bin dum nogudbala ting langa yu, wal yubin panishim melabat na laik yubin tok blanga dum langa det lowa blanga yu wekinmen mosis.
english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice. "Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.

kriol: wal wen det wekinmen bin stil dalimbat det olmen, det namba 4 wekinmen bin kaman ranranbat en imbin tok, "blanga yu bigininimob bin abumbat padi langa det haus blanga yu bigiswan san.
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, "Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother's house,

kriol: wen yumob garra jingat en prei langa mi, wal ai garra ensim yumob.
english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

kriol: "yumob jinggabat detlot bard. dei nomo growimap gadin blanga gajim daga, en dei nomo garram haus blanga pailimap olabat daga. god oldei fidimbat olabat. en yu mowa haibala langa detlot bard.
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don't sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren't you of much more value than they?

kriol: yu si? wen wibin bulurrum wi ronwei, det lowa bin sterrimap det nogudbala filing blanga wi weya wibin wandi dum olkain nogudbala ting garram wi bodi, en wibin yusum wi laif blanga dumbat olkain nogudbala ting weya bina meigim wi dai.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

kriol: yu si? im nomo mi hu oldei dum wanim ai nomo wandim dum. det nogudbala filing insaid langa mi oldei meigim mi dum wanim ai nomo wandim dum.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

kriol: im pawa kaan neba binij, en im pipul garra jidan gudwei olagijawan. im garra jidan bos blanga ol detlot pipul blanga im grengrenfatha king deibid, en im garra meigim olabat jidan brabli strongbala. im garra oldei jidan bos en im garra jidan brabli trubalawan en im garra oldei gibit pipul feyago. yawei det boswan god garra meiksho im dum ebrijing imbin tok."
english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David's throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.

kriol: "wal mi na yawei bin gibit mosis dislot lowa na
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

kriol: olabat tok brabli nogudbalawei, en detlot nogudwan wed jidan langa olabat mawus. larram detlot wed dagat olabat, dumaji dei reken miselp detmatj. dumaji olabat oldei sweya, en oldei dalimbat laiya du,
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn't allow their livestock to decrease.

english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

english: Don't withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

english: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king's house;

kriol: afta na det men bin go langa det yangiswan san, en imbin tok, 'san, yu garra go en wek langa det gadin tudei.' en det san bin tok, 'yuwai, dedi.' bat im nomo bin go en wek langa det gadin.
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, 'I'm going, sir,' but he didn't go.

kriol: en imbin luk ol detlot daga langa im bigwan teibul, en imbin luk weya ol im wekinmen bin silip langa detlot bigwan haus. imbin luk hau deibin dum ebrijing blanga im, en detlot klos im wekinmen olabat bin oldei werrimon, en detlot wekinmen hubin oldei lukaftum im langa eni padi en ola sekrifais ofring imbin oldei gibit langa det serramoni pleis. wen det kwin bin luk tharran imbin brabli hatjamp.
english: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh's house, there was no more spirit in her.

kriol: afta na yu garra luk wujei im leidan, en wen im ded silip, yu garra go en lidimap det bleingkit blanga im, en yu garra leidan langa im futwei, en wen im weikap, im garra dalim yu wanim yu garra dum."
english: It shall be, when he lies down, that you shall note the place where he is lying. Then you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down. Then he will tell you what to do."

kriol: yu nomo gridi blanga ol detlot gudwan daga. maitbi im trai blanga trikim yu.
english: Don't be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

kriol: wal king deibid bin jandap lida langa detlot pipul en imbin dalim olabat. imbin tok, "wal main kantrimen olabat, yumob irrim langa mi na. aibin wandi bildimap det speshalwan pleis weya wi gin pudum det seikridwan boks wulijim wi gin go deya blanga weshipbat langa yawei det trubala god blanga wi. wal aibin meigim ebrijing redi blanga bildimap det serramoni pleis du,
english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, "Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh's covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

kriol: en det win oldei blo langa sauth en langa nowath en im oldei go raidaran en kambek en statbek igin.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

kriol: en jisas bin gowin langa det bout blanga saiman pida, en imbin askim saiman blanga pushum det bout lilbit longwei brom det beingk, en jisas bin jidan langa det bout, en brom deya na imbin toktok langa detlot pipul langa det beingksaid.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

kriol: en ai dalim yumob. melabat garra jidan trubala langa god, dumaji im na bin meigim melabat jidan wekinmen blanga im.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

kriol: wal det taim na det holi spirit bin meigim jisas brabli gudbinji, en jisas bin tok langa god na, "dedi, yu na bos langa hebin en langa dijan kantri, en ai gibit yu theingks, dumaji loda ting deya yu nomo bin shoum langa detlot pipul hu gulum miselp klebabala. bat yubin shoum detlot ting langa detlot pipul hu nomo gulum miselp klebabala. yuwai, main dedi, yubin dum lagijat na, dumaji yubin wandim lagijat."
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, "I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight."

kriol: nomo enibodi bin laigim im, en melabat bin gibit bekboun langa im. imbin abum loda trabul en pein langa im laif. nobodi nomo bin wandim luk langa im. melabat nomo bin rispek langa im, en melabat bin tok, 'im nomo enijing. im najing.'
english: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn't respect him.

kriol: en imbin tok langa olabat, "yumob nomo bradin. ai sabi hu yumob lukabat. yumob lukabat det bodi blanga jisas brom nesareth. imbin dai langa det kros. bat imbin gidap laibala na. yumob luk det pleis weya deibin pudum im bodi. im nomo deya.
english: He said to them, "Don't be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

kriol: en det men bin tok langa mi na, "isikiyel, yu garra lisin en teiknodis brabli gudwei blanga detlot ebrijing ai garra shoum yu. blanga tharran na aibin bringimap yu iya. yu irrim mi gudwei na wanim ai garra dalim langa yu, en yu garra dalim detlot isreil pipul wanim yubin luk langa olabat." lagijat na det men bin tok langa mi.
english: The man said to me, "Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel."

kriol: en jis laik king jerabowam, king omri bin lidimbat detlot isreil pipul blanga dumbat ola nogudbala ting en weshipbat ola drimin sheip en imbin meigim yawei det trubala god blanga ola isreil pipul brabli wail.
english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

kriol: "wal langa det taim na aibin dalim detlot boswan, 'yumob garra jidan en lisin langa ola trabul weya ola pipul abumbat. yumob garra gibit ebribodi feyago nomeda if im blanga yu ronwan pipul, o brom ol detlot najalot pipul brom difrinwan kantri hu jidan deya langa yumob.
english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, "Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

kriol: eshuwa en neira dubala bin abum fobala san neim ahusam, hefa, temeni en heihashtari.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

kriol: bat beilam bin ensim langa olabat, "nomeda if beilak gibit mi ol detlot silba en gol weya jidan langa im bigwan haus, bat ai stil garra dum wanim yawei main god wandim mi blanga dum, nomeda wanim lilwan ting im dalim mi blanga dum.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, "If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can't go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.

kriol: "wal if enibodi nomo lukinat gudwei wanim imbin dumbat, en im nomo bin gibit det mani weya imbin pramis langa mi, wal im garra bringimap peiyimbek ofring, wan dediwan ship o boiwan nenigout nomo garram enijing rong langa im. im garra peiyimbek wanim ol detlot boswan bin tok.
english: "If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh's holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

kriol: en jisas bin luk langa det wekinmen blanga im, en imbin dalim im seimwei du, "im na yu mami." en brom det taim na det wekinmen bin oldei lukaftumbat det mami blanga jisas, en det olgamen bin oldei jidan langa det kemp blanga det wekinmen.
english: Then he said to the disciple, "Behold, your mother!" From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

kriol: dei weidabat blanga gajim yu jis laik detlot pipul hu oldei stilimbat enijing brom enibodi olataim en meigim loda men jidan nomo trubala langa olabat waif.
english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

kriol: if enibodi gibit enimul langa det serramonimen blanga sekrifais, det skinpat blanga det enimul, im blanga det serramonimen.
english: The priest who offers any man's burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

english: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab's anger burned against David, and he said, "Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the evil of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle."

english: Then I said, "Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don't know Yahweh's way, nor the law of their God.
